so/ /yi dwags kyi gnas las skyes pa'i mi rnams kyis myos pa'i tshe/ lus mi zeg cing 'khyems ldem ldem pa dang / lhung ba sogs kyi sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ro/ /dud 'gro'i skye gnas las skyes pa'i mi rnams kyis myos pa'i tshe/ ngag gis tshig ci yang smrar mi nus pa dang / dud 'gro bzhin glen lkugs shing ldab ldib tu 'gyur ro/ /bdag cag gi ston pa shākya thub pas 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /skyon ni mang po nyer bsten pa'i/ /chang ni yongs su spang bar bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ci yin zhe na/ nga'i slob ma dge 'dun btsun pa rnams nyon cig chang 'di rtswa'i rtse la chags pa'i zil ba tsam yang 'thung na/ nga yi slob ma ma yin no//btsun pa gang dag chang 'thung na spyon pa lta bur gyur te/ lus ngag yid gsum rgya yan du btang zhing / ngag gis ngag 'khyal drag po smre btsogs kyi gtam sna tshogs smra zhing / yid la 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal phrag dog ser sna sogs nyon mongs pa thams cad 'bar bar gyur nas/ lus sems dran pa med par brgyal te/ rmongs shing gzhi dang byes la nyal bar byed pa'i dus su skyugs pa'i kha la khyis bldags pa dang / gos med par gcer bur gsang gnas sogs lus gzhan mi rnams kyis mthong nas ngo tsha ba'i 70

gnas su 'gyur ro/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i lha yang bros te/mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams khros pa'i rkyen gyis rgyu rkyen med par sna dang kha nas khrag dbyung ba dang / brag ri dang bzhon pa sogs nas lhung ba dang / me dang chu'i 'jigs pa la sogs su lhung nas/ sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong bar 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje dmyal ba'i tshe tshad ji snyed cig yod snyam na/ sa la 'brub khung gru bzhi ba zhig byas pa'i gzab dang ngos bzhir 'dom brgyad cu brgyad cu'i tshad kyi nang du til gyis gang bar byas nas/ bskal ba gcig 'das pa na til re phyungs pas til gyi gang bu de zad par gyur pa'i dus na/ rdo rje dmyal ba'i tshe yang de'i dus su zad par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal pyong ba lta ci smos/ nga'i slob ma dge 'dun btsun pa rnams nyon cig chang 'di 'thung ba la spro na khyed rnams sdug bsngal myong ba ma gtogs bde ba'i gnas ga la rnyed/ khyed rnams kyis chang zhes bya ba lha la mchod pa'i 'os su gyur pa na/ rang re rnams chang 'di mi 'thung zhes smra bar gyur pa 'di ci yin zhe na/ lha'i go 'phang ma thob pa'i phyir/ lha'i mchod pa 'di la longs spyod ga la nus/ dper na seng ge mchongs pa'i shul du wa yis mchongs na tshang ra chag ste shi ba 71

dang / bya khyung gis lding ba'i lam du bye'us 'phur nas gshog pa gcog pa'i dpe la ltos shig lha'i mchod par longs spyod par nus na/ sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i 'dul khrims dang /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bcas mtshams kyi spyod tshul la mi spro ba ci lags/ chang 'di chos skyong srung ma la sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar byen gyis brlabs nas 'bul bas/ de rnams kyis sems can gyi nyon mongs dug lnga la bsres nas bdud rtsir gyur par bzhes la/ sems can gyi nyon mongs pa zhi bar byas so/ /sha lnga zhes pa'i nang du mi rta khye gsum gyi sha yod de/ de rnams khyed kyis gsol bar nus sam/ bdud rtsi lnga zhes pa'i nang du dri chen dri chu zhes pa mi'i gshang gci gnyis yod de/ khyed rnams kyis de sbyangs rtog sbar gsum byas nas 'thung bar nus sam/gal te nus na chang 'thung ba yin mod/ mi nus na mi 'gyur ro/ /gsang sngags kyi lugs la chang 'di ni sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshul 'di ni rgyud sde gang las gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan dris na khyod ci smra/ rdo rje 'chang gis mi mkhyen pa ni ngo tsha med par khyod kyi tshul 'di/ ri bong gi mgo la rwa skyes pa dang / mo gsham la bu ye med pa dang 'dra'o/ /dge sdig shan 'byed chos kyi rgyal bo'i chad pa la kha gsag dang bslu ba 72

med pa'i phyir 'bad pa dang brtson pa'i sgo nas spangs pa dgos so/ /yang chos tshul bzhin du spyod pa'i rgyal po dang blon po dang ya rabs sogs mi rnams kyis legs par rab tu nyon cig chang zhes bya ba 'di la spyon pa'i chang dang / dpa' bo'i chang dang / bsnyems pa'i chang / phyug po'i chang / sbyin lo'i chang / ma mno ba'i chang zhes pa'i ming du btags so/ /smyon pa'i chang zhes pa ni/ rgyal po'i khrims 'cha' ba'i ya rabs rnams kyis chang 'thung na smyon pa ltar/ sems kyis tshul dang tshul min mi shes pa dang / dge sdig dang / bden rdzun mi 'byed pa dang / shab shub sogs mi shes par smyon pa ltar byed pas/ 'jig rten 'di la mi ngan par grags nas/ skye ba phyi mar yang dge sdig blang dor mi shes pas/ sngar bshad pa'i ngan song gi sdug bsngal myong ba lta ci smos/ dpa' bo'i chang zhes pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum brnyas shing smod la mi 'jigs pa'i dpa' bo dang / rgyal po dang blon po ya rabs rnams la brnyas pa'i tshig smras nas nan tur chad par gyur pa'i dpa' bo dang / gnyen bshes dang grogs mtshungs pa la ngan tshig smras nas brdegs brdungs 'thab pa sogs byas te 'bral ba mi shes pa ni dpa' bo'i chang ngo / /bsnyems pa'i 73

chang zhes bya ba ni/ rigs ngan pa yin kyang che bar bsnyems pa dang / dma' ba yin kyang mtho bar bsnyems pa dang / dbul bo yin kyang phyug por bsnyems pa dang / blun po yin kyang mdzangs par bsnyems pa dang / yon tan mi slob pa yin kyang mkhas par bsnyems pa'i chang ngo / /phyug po'i chang zhes pa ni/nga la gser dngul yod/ nga la nor phyugs sogs yod ces smras nas/ gzhan gyis btsal na/ gtod mi nus pa ngo tsha ba'i phyug po dang / zas chen po yod ces smras nas mi mang po 'dus te/ za ba la zad na ngo tsha ba'i phyug po'i chang ngo / /sbyin lo'i chang zhes pa ni/ bzhon pa'i rta mi la byen nas/ rkang 'theng bor gyur pa'i sbyin lo dang / lus la gyon pa'i gos ster nas gcer bur 'dug pa'i sbyin lo dang / rang gis za ba'i zas gzhan la ster nas rang gis ltogs pas sbyin lo'i chang ngo / /ma mno ba'i chang zhes pa ni/ phyi ma ster ba la sngar gyis ster na ma mno ba'i chang / phyi ma brjod pa'i tshig sngar brjod na ma mno ba dang / gzhan la smra ba'i dus su ma babs par sngar gyis smra na ma mno ba'i chang ngo / /spyir chang 'thung bas dang po lus kyi mthu stobs nyams pa dang / gnyis pa byad bzhin gyi mdog ngan par gyur te/ gnyer ma mang por gyur nas/74

rengs pa dang / skems par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ngag rno ba nyams pa ni/ smra ba la ldib par gyur nas/ ngag 'chal sogs smra ba'o/ /bzhi ba blo mi gsal ba ni/ rmongs par 'gyur ba dang / lnga ba 'di phyi'i dge sdig gis 'bras ma bsam par rmongs par shi ba'o/ /drug pa tshe 'di la sdug yus nyos pa de/de yong zhes thams cad kyis brnyas pa'i gnas su 'gyur ro/ /bdun pa tshe phyi ma la yang sngar bshad pa'i ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal myong nas/ gal te mi'i gnas su skyes na blo rmongs par gyur te/ gshis lugs ngan par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang rje btsun ye shes dpal 'byor gyi zhal nas/ /myos 'gyur gyi rigs gtogs tha ma khar grags pa'i dri ngan 'di ni/ sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba'i bcas pa mdzad dus ma byung ba ma gtogs chang dang 'dra bar bcas pa mdzad par 'gyur ba'i tshod du 'dug kyang / de dus ma dar bas ma mdzad la/ de byung tshul ni/ sangs rgyas 'da' tshul bstan nas/ lo mang po zhig song mtshams shig tu bdud kyi rigs can bud med cig gis smon lam log pa btab pa la brten nas/mngal khrag sa la lhung ba las sngo zhig skyes te/ de nas rim gyis rgya gar nag sogs su dar ba yin la/ de'i du ba rngub pa po 75

dag gi sems la 'byung bo'i gdon zhugs nas/ yang yang rngub 'dod skyes nas rngub par 'gyur ro/ /de'i nyes dmigs ni/lus la phan pa gang yang med par ma zad/ nad dang kha la dri ngan bskyed cing bag med pa'i gnas la sbyor ba dang / de rngub pa'i mi la bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong mi dgyes shing /yi dam gyi lha dang srung ma lta zhog 'jig rten pa'i lha klu dkar phyogs pa'ang mi 'khor ba dang / ngag gi nus pa gcod pas/ bzlas pa la nus pa med pa dang / mi de dge 'dun dang gtsug lag khang dang / rten gyi drung du song na dri ngan pas khyab par 'gyur ro/ /de'i rnam smin gye 'bras bus tshe phyi ma na ngan song gi gnas mi gtsang ba'i nang du skyes nas sdug bsngal dpag med myong zhing / gal te de las thar nas bde 'gro tsam thob kyang lus dri mi zhim pa bro bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes mkhas pa dag gi gsung bgros las 'byung bas/ de yang chang dang 'dra bar spangs par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang dpal o rgyan chen po lho nub srin po'i yul du bzhud dus su/ rje 'bangs spyi dang khyad par sngags pa rnams la zhal gdams 'di ltar gsungs so/ /nga yi rjes 'jug sngags 'chang tshogs rnams gson/ /pad 'byung srin po 'dul du 'gro ba la/ /mya ngan ma 76

byed zhal gdams 'di nyid ni/ /nga nyid bzhugs dang khyad med sems la chongs/ /sngags pa 'phung byed rgyu ni chang nag yin/ /chang la 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /nga rgyal phrag dog nyon mongs ma lus pa/ /slong ba'i rgyu kun 'di la tshang ba yin/ /de phyir chang nag ma 'thung zhal gdams yin/ /chang 'thung lha bsgom bzlas brjod byed pa ni/ /rab tsha zangs zhun khar ldud dmyal bar skye/ /chang 'thung zor 'phen mnan gtad byed pa ni/ /lha min 'khrug pa'i dmag dpon chen por skye/ /chang 'thung bla ma rdo rje spun la ni/ /bsdigs brdungs byed pa rdo rje dmyal bar sgye/ /chang 'thung chos rtsod nga rgyal byas pa yis/ /lce la thong bshol rmo ba'i dmyal bar sgye/ /chang 'thung gzhan la gri phyar khros pa yis/ /gnod sems byed pa yi dwags dmyal bar skye/ /chang 'thung gzhan gyi bud med la spyod pa/ /shal ma li yi sdong bos drag tu 'drud/ /chang 'thung rku 'phrog sna tshogs byas pa yis/ /yi dwags mtshon cha'i 'khor lo can du skye/ /chang 'thung ngo tsha khrel 'dzem bral ba de/ /glen cing lkugs pa dud 'gro'i gnas su skye/ /sngags pa chang 'thung khyi yi lus su skye/ /gal te mir skye na'ang smyon par skye/ /chang 'thung de phyir mdo dang rgyud sde nas/ /bkag phyir pad+mas chang 'thung gsungs pa 77

med/ /ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus kyi sngags pa rnams/ /chang 'thung o rgyan pad+ma'i gsungs yin zer/ /de dag nga yi rjes 'jug ma yin te/ /nag po bdud kyi rjes su zhugs pa yin/ /nga bsam nga bsgom nga mchod byed pa'i mis chang 'thung pad+ma nga nyid bslus pa yin/ /gsungs/ gzhan yang thang yig shel brag ma las/ rang la mi phan gzhan gnod kha zas 'di/ /mis 'phya rang 'phung chang nag bdud zas yin/ /'gyod pa phyi la ma byed sngon bsam thongs/ /rang gis rang nyid ma bslu rje 'bangs rnams/ /gsungs/ dran pa nyer bzhag las/chang gi nyes dmigs rgyas par gsungs pa rnams mdor bsdus te bshad na/ sems can dmyal ba ngu 'bod du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gang gis khyim gyi gnas nas phyung ste sdom pa blangs bsam gtan gyi bde bas sems sbyangs shing / zhi ba'i dge slong gi dge 'dun dag gis 'khor du chang brims te/ ra ro bar byas na/ de shi nas dmyal ba rab tu gdungs pa chen pos byas pa'i tshor ba myong bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na phra skam gyi kha gdangs pa'i nang du/ zangs dmar po bskol ba rab tu 'bar ba ldug go /de 'thung ba na mchu rkan lce ol gong glo snying pho ba rgyu ma sogs khog pa kun bsregs nas ro smad nas 'byung bar 'gyur/ chang 78

'thung de 'o dod 'bod cing ngu 'khrug cing smre sngags 'don to/ /yang ri gnyis shugs kyis rgyugs pa'i bar du 'thag go /yang skye bar 'gyur te/ skyes nas yang ri gnyis bar du bcug nas 'thag go /de nas thar nas rgyugs pas/ gshin rje gzhan dang 'phrad nas lcags kyi rdza ma'i nang du kha bub tu bcug nas bsreg par 'gyur/ de nas thar nas bros kyang lcags kyi khā rab tu 'bar ba dag gis bzung nas yan lag nying lag gi gnad tshigs tshigs su brgya'am stong du za'o/ /yang thar nas bros pas bkres skom pas mtsho mthong nas der rgyugs pa dang / mtsho de ro nye rab tu bskol pas gang ba yin te der khrus byed du 'jug go /zhugs par chu srin rnams kyis bzung nas kha bub tu drangs te ro nye de'i nang du skol lo/ /thar nas bros pas gshin rje rnams kyis mthong nas bzung mdung gis 'bigs mdung rtse bar 'ga' brgyab nas 'byung / bar 'ga' glo dang mgrin pa phugs nas 'byung ngo / /de las thar nas bros pas grong khyim dang mtsho steng ka phun sum tshogs pa mthong ste/ der rgyugs pas grong de'i nang du 'jug go /grong de kun kyang rab tu bskol ba 'bar ba de'i nang na srog chags mar ko ta ka kha mche ba rnon po rnams kyis gang ba yin te/ de'i nang du zhugs pa dang /79

khyem de'i sgo gcod srog chags mchu rnon rnams kyis za bar byed do/ /mir skyes na de sems 'khrug par 'gyur zhing dbul ba dang / lam po che dang bzhi mdo'i tshong ba dang / byis pa thams cad kyis bzhad gad par gyur cing bzhin gyi mdog ngan pa dang / so 'ba' zhig snang ba dang / rkang pa shin tu rdol ba dang /lus rtag tu bkres pa dang skom pas gdung ba dang / bu dang chung ma dang pha dang gnyen bshes rnams kyis btang bar 'gyur ro/ /gso sbyong ba rnams la chang blud na/ de shi nas dmyal ba sgra chen por skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na gso sbyong ba la chang blud pa ltar ro nye ba zhus pa lcags phor 'bar ba'i nang nas khar ldugs so/ /ldud pa na dmyal ba gzhan dag na med pa'i snying rje'i sgra chen po nam mkha' gang ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mir skyes na yid mi gzhungs par 'gyur zhing de dus thung ngus kyang brjed par 'gyur/ de yi yid gzhungs pa chung bas longs spyod med par 'gyur zhing skye bo'ang dga' bar mi 'gyur/ de'i nor de dag med par 'gyur zhing nad chung ngus kyang 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /sdom pa blangs ma thag la chang blud na/ de shi nas dmyal ba thams cad sgra 'byen du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na lcags kyi gtun shing brdeg pa na sgra chen pos dmyal ba'i 80

'khor de dag thams cad gang bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te khor yug ri dang chu bo dag med na gling bzhi bo yang sgra 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mir skyes na chu dkon pa'i yul dang 'brog tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dge bsnyen bslab pa'i gzhi lnga yod pa la chang 'thung ba yon tan yin par bslab pa'i gzhi 'dzin du bcug na/ de shi nas dmyal ba skra me 'bar bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der sgyes na me rab tu 'bar bas/ skra nas rkang ba'i bar du bsreg cing 'tshod la rab tu 'bar ro/ /rkang ba khye klad pa bya rgod/ dbus su wa dag gis za'o/ /mir skyes na rnam pa thams cad du chang med pa'i yul de lta bur skye bar 'gyur zhing gzugs dang ro mngon par shes par mi 'gyur ro/ /chang 'tshong ba ni chu mang bar byed la rin thang gzhan yin na gzhan du 'tshong te/ de la skyon kha na ma tho ba dzun dang / ma byin par len pa dang / chang 'thung ba de dag byung ngo / /de shi nas dmyal ba mo'i phye ma srin bur skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na rlung mkhris bad gan 'dus pa las gyur pa'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi 'byung ngo / /nad re res kyang nyin gcig la gling bzhi'i mi kun 'chi nus pa'i nad de lta bu 'byung ngo / /gzhan yang lus la srin bu dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ pags pa khrag sha tshil rus 81

pa rkang dag la phug cing 'thung ngo / /gshin rjer 'jigs shing ngu skad 'byin pa na mes bsreg cing 'tshod la 'bar bar byed do/ /mir skyes na de sdug bsngal ba dang dbul bar 'gyur ro/ /seng ge dang stag dang gzig dang ri skegs dang shang shang te'u dag chang gis brid de nyams pa byas la bzung nas bsad pa gang yin pa de shi nas dmyal ba lcags kyi me 'bar ba'i gtun shing gi yan lag nying lag thams cad bye ma'i tshad tsam du rlog go /de nas 'o dod 'bod cing ngu skad 'byen spe sngags 'don cing rgyug pa dang / gtun shing 'bar ba rnams kyis 'tshog go /gshin rje rnams kyis bzung nas yan lag thams cad 'tshog cing gsheg la 'dral lo/ /mir skyes na dregs can du skye bar 'gyur dbul bar 'gyur zhing sman pa dang sman sbyor ba dang bral ba'i yul ngan pa dang / rtswa dang mya ngan dang / mes tshig pas 'jigs pa mang ba'i yul ngan pa dag tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /chang ni g.yul 'gyed pa'i don du ji ltar glang po chen po'i g.yul du mi mang po gsod par 'gyur te/ de las bdag cag rgyal bar 'gyur bar bya'o snyam nas/ glang po che dag la chang blud de/ mi bsad na de dag shi nas dmyal ba rdo me 'bar ba char ltar 'bab par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na 82

me 'bar ba'i glang chen tshe srog 'phrog pas bzung nas lus phugs phye mar rlog cing / 'phen par byed yan lag nying lag thams cad so sor 'byed do/ /de nas thar nas gshin rje rnams kyis bzung zangs dmar po bskol ba'i nang du bcug nas bsreg cing 'tshod par byed do/ /mir skyes na des glang po che bsad par bshoms kyang glang bo che des gsod par 'gyur dbul zhing byad bzhin ngan la rkang ba dang lag pa bong bu'i rkang ba ltar 'gyur zhing lus rtag tu rtsub par 'gyur ro/ /chang ni bud med gzhan 'os pa ma yin pa la blud de/ blud nas kyang myos pas 'khrul par byas la/ de dang lhan cig tu mi tshangs par spyad na de shi nas dmyal ba 'chi med du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na khyi 'bar ba dag gis rlig pa 'byen cing / phyungs kyang slar skyes par 'gyur ro/ /yang 'byin tshe ngu skad 'byin no/ /de las thar nas bros pas ngam grog chen por bya rog rgod dang 'ug pa bya rta mi ka lcags mchu sen mo 'bar ba rnams kyis bzung nas/ yan lag nying lag so sor phyes te za'o/ /mir skyes na rgyal pos bzung zhing lus mdog ngan pa dang bzhin mdog ngan par 'gyur zhing de nyid du 'chi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur ro/ /chang ni dug sbyar nas dgra gsod par bya ba'i phyir 83

blud na/ de shi nas 'khor lcags tshal dgon par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na lcags kyi thag pas bcings nas lcags kyi 'khor lo bskor gshin rje dag gis mtshon chas 'debs shing sha lhag ma med par byed/ /de las thar nas bros pas lcags kyi sbrul rnams kyis bzung nas za'o/ /mir skyes na sbrul gyis 'dzin pa'am/ mgo'i nor bu 'byin par 'gyur ba'am/ sbrul rnams kyis srog dang 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can so so 'tsho bar bya ba'i phyir chang 'thung ba'i zong ngam rin byin na/ de shi nas dmyal ba rab rib kun bsags su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na mun nag las byung ba'i me nang du 'jug go /sreg cing 'tshod la gdung bas ngu zhing skad 'byin to/ /sog le dag gis kyang mgo nas rkang ba'i bar du phyed mar gsheg go /mir skyes na rtag tu skom pa dang bkres pas gdung bar 'gyur zhing der nor rdzas dang bral bar 'gyur la/ gang na bza' btung nyung ba'i gling de dag tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ / nad mi zad pas thebs pa dang bu btsas pa dag la chang 'thung ba'i zong dang rin gye don du gos kyi rgyu'am zas kyi rgyu byen na/ de shi nas dmyal ba gshin rje'i mtshams kyi dgon par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na rkang ba sen mo sogs gshin rje dag gis za zhing 84

mdung thung rtse mo 'bar ba dag gis lo 'bum phrag du mar 'tshog cing srog la gsheg cing gsod do/ /mir skyes na/ de yul ngan pa dang / gnas ngan pa dang ri brag ngan pa dag tu phag 'tsho ba dang long bar 'gyur ro/ /chang ji ltar kha cig ni dar ba lta bu dang / kha cig ni chu lta bu dang / kha cig ni zhog chu lta bu de ltar bcos nas 'brog dgon par zhugs pa'i ded dpon dag la blud de/ de'ang ra ro zhing shin tu ra ro bar 'gyur/ de kun gyes shin tu ra ro bar byas te/ ra ro de dag des bsad nas nor gang dang gang yod pa de 'phrog na des bslus pa yin pas 'jig rten na chom rkun pa zhes bya'o/ /des las kyis bskyod pa pa / shi nas dmyal ba shing shal ma li chen po'i nags su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na me 'bar ba'i rdo char gyis lus kun sreg cing 'bigs la gcod par byed de sa'i bar du sreg par byed do/ /zangs dang ro nyer bsres pa rab tu bskol pa'i chu rtag tu 'jigs pa zhes bya bar lo 'bum phrag du mar 'tshod la gshin rje rnams kyis ral gri mda' po che 'bar bas 'debs par byed do/ /mir skyes na/ mig gi mdog nag cing rtag tu khro la phrag dog mang bor 'gyur ro/ /chang gi dbang du byas nas sing po ltar bcos te/ 'brog dgon pa'i skye bo mang 85

bo dag la blud na/ de shi nas dmyal ba shing shal ma li chen por skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na chang gi las kyis byas pa'i shing shal ma li 'dab ma spu gri lta bu yal ga me 'bar ba lta bu dud pa bdug cing rlung dug 'byung ste/ dpag tshad gcig tshun la rlung dug lta bus gnod cing shing shal ma li chen po'i nags dpag tshad sum stong yod par tshud na mdog me du bar bsres pa dug lta bu'i shugs kyis sdug bsngal 'bum snyed myong ngo / /shing las spu gri lta bu'i char 'bab ste/ lag na ral gri mda' bo che thogs pas lus kun gshaṃg cing 'dral la dum bur byed do/ /kha cig gshin rje la 'jigs nas nags khrod na zhum zhum par 'dug pa/ bya rgod kyis mig 'byen cing khu ba'ang 'thung ngo / /kha cig gshin rje dang 'phrad nas ral gri dag gis 'debs shing gsheg go /kha cig shing khar 'dzegs pa shing las yal ga lhung bas/ de dag gi lus dum bu brgya stong bye bar rlog go /gang dag tshul de'i 'thor to la 'dzeg pa de dag ba tshwa'i chu bo bzhus par 'jug ste/ ji srid sdig pa ma zad bar du lo 'bum phrag du mar rgyus pa dang rus pa dang lus nyid kyis gnod pa myong ngo / /mir skyes na/ de yid rnam par g.yengs shing nad drag po'am snying nad dam ngal rkyen mang ba'am/ rkang 'bam gyis thebs par 86

'gyur zhing long bas nyam thag par 'gyur ro/ /bud med yon tan gzhan dag la thabs gzhan gyis spyod pa'i brid de blud nas ra ro bar byas te/ sems 'khrul bar byas na shi nas dmyal ba chu shing bsreg pa'i dud pa'i tshal du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na rgyang grags gsum du sa brkos pa'i nang me mdag dud pa 'khrigs par 'jug cing / de las thar nas bya du ba'i mdog gi phreng ba zhes bya ba'i mchu rnon po dag gis rus pa phug nas rkang za bar byed do/ /mir skyes na/ glo dang mjug to dag la gdon gyi nad kyis thebs shing dbul ba dang tshe thung bar 'gyur ro/ /dgra gsod pa'i phyir dang / chom rkun dang rgyal pos bkrabs pa gsod pa phyir blud na/ de shi nas dmyal ba me mdag dud pa'i tshal du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes nas me mdag spu gri lta bu'i rlung ldang la/ rlung gi shugs kyis der skyes pa rnams phan tshun du brdab pas lus phye mar rlog go /spu gris gsheg cing me dang nad mtshon pa tshwa'i tshor ba mchog tu tsha ba 'jigs pa myong ngo / /mir skyes na gzhang 'brum rims gsum pas thebs par 'gyur zhing rtag tu grang ba'i rims kyis thebs par 'gyur ro/ /phyi rol la blo mngon par zhen pa'i ngang tshul can dag slu ba'i bsam pas blud na/ de shi nas dmyal ba glog 87

gi na bun tshal du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na khri nyis brgyar dmyal ba'i mes gang ba der gshin rje rnams kyis bzung nas 'jug ste rkang ba nas mgo la sogs pa'i bar bteg cing bzhu'o/ /yang skyes yang sreg par byed do/ /mir skyes na yul ya ba na dang ba lhi ka der skyes shing bkol bas nyams par 'gyur te/ shugs drag pos bkol bar 'gyur ro/ /chang gis yid g.yengs na lam du 'jug pa la ngal bar mi 'gyur ro snyam nas lam du 'jug pa'i ched dang / rngon pa dag ri dwags gsod pa la 'gro ba mgyogs par 'gyur ro snyam nas blud na/ de shi nas dmyal ba kun tu rtog byed du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na gshin rje rnams kyis brgya'am/ yang na stong ngam bye ba brgya'am yang na stong du byed de/ sems can dmyal ba'i 'khor gzhan du gnod pa gang dang gang 'byung ba de thams cad kyi bzhi 'gyur der 'byung ste/ ji srid du de'i sdig pa'i las bcom zhing spangs la zad par ma byas pa de srid du gnod pa sna tshogasang dag byed du 'jug go /mir skyes na/ de mchog tu khro ba'i khro bar 'gyur zhing bka' blo mi bde bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa la sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ /las kyi rnam par 'gyur ba zhes bya ba'i mdo las/chang 'thung na ngan pa bag med pa sum cu rtsa lngar 'gyur bar 88

shes par byos shig sum cu rtsa lnga gang zhe na/ mngon par snang bzhin du nor zad pa/ nad mang bo 'du ba/ 'thab mo dang rtsod pa rnams skye ba/ khrel zhing ngo tsha ba la mi 'dzem pa mi snyan par grags par byed pa/ shes rab nyams par byed pa/skyid pa sngon chad ma bsags pa/ de'ang mi bsogs pa/skyid pa'i bsags pa kun zad cing med par byas pa/ gsang ba rnams smra ba/ las su bya ba rnams shor ba/ zhan te nyam chung bar 'gyur/ mya ngan gyi rtsa ba/ mar mi 'dzin pa/ phar mi 'dzin pa/ thar ba mi shes pa/ bram zer mi shes pa/ rigs btsun pa la bste stang rim gro mi byed pa/ sangs rgyas la rim gro mi byed pa/ dge 'dun la rim gro mi byed pa/ sdig byed pa'i grogs po la rim gro byed pa/ dge ba'i grogs po kun spong zhing khyad du gsod pa/ ngo tsha mi shes pa/ khrel gyi dogs pa med pa/sba zhing mdzes pa'i bag mi byed pa/ g.yem pa la bag med pa/ 'gro ba mang po'i yid du mi 'ong ba/ 'gro ba mang bos spangs pa/ rigs pa chen po dang / gnyen pa dang / rigs gcig pa spangs pa/ yang dag pa'i chos ma yin pa kun 'dzin pa/ yang dag pa'i chos kun spong ba/ nyes par byed stong ba'i mi rigs zhes bla mas smad pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa dang ring 89

du bral ba/ smyon par gyur pa'i las sems shing ngan pa'i skyon rnams sna tshogs su byed pa yin te/ shi nas sems can dmyal bar ltung zhing lus dang bral na'ang lam ngan par 'gro bas bla 'og kun gyis kyang mi btung zhing spong bar bya'o/ /zhes dang /bslab pa lnga'i mdo las/ chang 'thung ba ni tsha ba'i dmyal bar lhung zhing skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der lhung ba'i sems can ni lo stong phrag mang por 'tshod par 'gyur ro/ /de nas phyir phyungs nas chu bo rab med kyi ngogs su skyur bar byed do/ /gang du 'gro sa med par yang dang yang du skyur bar byed do/ /der dmyal ba'i bsrung ma rnams kyis mchil bas nya 'don pa ltar/ lcags sreg gis gzhi la rdebs par byed do/ /'di ltar sgogs te/ kye skyes bu ci 'dod/ jo bo skom mo/ /dmyal ba'i bsrung ma des lcags 'bar ba'i lcags kyus kha phye ste/ lcags bzhu ba'i khu ba ldug par byed do/ /de'i mchu sreg go /mgrin pa sreg go /brang sreg go /rgyu ma sreg go /snying yang sreg go /bshang lam nas mar 'thon par byed do/ /de rnams kyis sdug bsngal myong bar byed cing ngu la 'gre bar byed do/ /de'i dus su yang 'chi bar ni mi 'gyur te ji srid kyi bar du sdig pa'i las kyi 'bras bu myong bar byed do/ /de srid du de rnams kyis rnam par smin 90

pa'i tshor ba myong bar byed do/ /de'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tsha zhing rtsub pa'i chu bo ni/ /bar med shin tu bgrod par dka'/ /lcags kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma rnams/ /'dab ma rno ba'i steng du 'gro/ /chu bo rab med gzhi med par/ /chos min ji ltar spyod par 'gyur/ /gang zhig chang 'thung ba de ni/ /sdig pa chung ba ma yin no/ /de mir gyur kyang rtag tu brjed nges pa dang / lug ltar lkugs pa dang / shes rab 'chal ba dang /rig pa mi shes pa dang / rtag tu gnyid du 'gro ba dang / blo gros dman pa dang / gti mug che ba dang / 'jigs pa dang /skrag par 'gyur ba dang / dogs par 'gyur ba dang / phra ma can dang / tshig mi brtan pa dang / ser sna can dang / phrag dog can dang / nges par mi 'byung ba dang / ngo tsha med pa dang / khrel med pa dang / shes rab chung ba dang / dge ba'i chos rnams mi rig pa ste/ skye ba lnga brgyar gnod sbyin skye/ /skye ba lnga brgyar khye dang ni/ /mtha' yas spyon par skye bar 'gyur/ /chang 'thung ba yi nyes pa'o/ /myos par 'gyur ba'i chang gi btung ba'i rnam par smin pa'o/ /chang 'thung ba ni spangs pa yis/ /skyes pa'am ni bud med ni/ /thob ste de yi phan yon ni/ /sum cu rtsa drug mi dman par/ /'das dang ma 'ongs pa yi dus/ /da ltar 91

byung ba cung zad du/ /myur du shes par 'gyur ba dang / /rtag tu ngan pa gnas pa dang / /de ni spyo bar mi 'gyur zhing / /khyad par 'phags pa'i shes rab dang / /mi rmongs pa dang bag yod dang / /tshig ni shin tu gsal ba dang / /ngo tsha shes shing tshig ni gsal/ /'di ni log par smrar mi 'gyur/ /phra ma dang ni tshig rtsub med/ /don med pa la mi bstod cing / nyin dang mtshan du de bzhin du/ /byas pa shes shing byas pa tshor/ /'dod med rtogs dang tshul khrims ldan/ /khro ba med cing tshig ni drang / /'jigs pa med cing smra bar mkhas/ /ngo tsha khrel yod phun sum tshogs/ /'jigs pa med cing dogs pa med/ /yid gzhungs thob pa 'dzin pa dang / /don yod skye bo mang na mkhas/ /chang gi btung ba spangs pa yi/ /skye ba'am ni bud med kyis/ /phan yon 'di rnams myong bar 'gyur/ /lha rnams dang ni mi rnams su/ /de'i lus zhig nas shi ba'i pha rol tu bde 'gro mtho ris lha'i 'jig rten dang mtho ris su skye'o/ /zhes dang / las kyi rnam par smin pa bstan pa'i mdo las/ tshe 'di la chang gi dbang du sred pa ni/tshe phyi ma la chu'i srin bur skye'o/ /ci ste mir skyes na yang lha gor dang / dbugs mi bde ba'i nad kyis byings par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / dran pa nyer bzhag las/ chang ni dug gi mchog 92

yin te/ /chang 'thung ba la brten mi bya/ /chang 'thung ba la brten pa ni/ /dge ba'i chos rnams nyams par 'gyur/ /gang gis rtag tu chang bsten pa/ /de yi blo ni mi brtan zhing / /blo yo ba la chos med de/ /de lta bas na chang spongs shig /nyams byed nang na nyams mchog ni/ /chang zhes mkhas pa rnams kyis bshad/ /mi la nyams pas nyams byed pa/ /de lta bas na chang mi bsten/ /chang 'thung ba la brten byed pa/ /mi sdug sdig pa'i chos yin te/ /de lta bas na dug lta bu'i/ /chang 'thung ba ni rnam par spongs/ /chang 'thung ba la gnas pa'i skyon/ /nor zad ngan par brjod byed cing / /le lo shin tu bskyed byed pas/ /de lta bas na chang spongs shig /chang gis 'dod chags bskyed byed cing / /de bzhin khro dang gti mug dang / /yang dang yang du bsgyed byed pas/ /de lta bas na chang spongs shig /ces dang /don med gzhi ni chang yin te/ /sems can dmyal ba'i bzhad gad pa/ /dbang bo thams cad rnams nyams shing / /don med pa yi rgyur gyur to/ /tshig la shin tu dga' ba dang / /chags pa dang ni 'jigs pa dang / /ngag gi skyon dang rlom pa dang / /tshig rtsub gzhi ni de yin no/ /chang gis kun tu g.yeng ba'i yid/ /bya dang mi bya mi shes pa/ /mi de phyugs dang mtshungs pa 93

yin/ /de lta bas na chang spongs shig /chang gis g.yengs pa'i mi dag ni/ /gson yang shi ba dag dang mtshungs/ /gang zhig rtag tu gson 'dod pas/ /rtag par chang ni rnam par spongs/ /chang ni nyes pa kun gye gzhi/ /rtag par don kun med par byed/ /ngan song gsum gyi them skas te/ /mun nag gnas ni chen po yin/ /chang gis sems can dmyal bar 'gro/ /de bzhin yi dwags 'jig rten dang / /chang gi skyon gyis bslus pa yi/ /mi dag dud 'gro rnams su 'gro/ /dug gi nang du dug ni chang / /de bzhin dmyal ba'i nang nas dmyal/ /nad kyi nang nas nad mchog ni/ /chang zhes mkhas pa rnams kyis bshad/ /blo dang dbang bo nyams bshad cing //rin chen chos ni zad byed pa/ /tshangs par spyod byed 'jigs byed pa/ /mi bzang chang ni skyes gnas gcig /rgyal po dang ni bstan bcos mkhas/ /chang gis g.yengs par byed 'gyur na/ /tha mal mi dag chang 'thung ba/ /bslus par 'gyur ba ci zhig smos/ /chang la brten pa'i mi dag ni/ /chos rnams kun gyi sta re yin/ /ngo tsha med par byed pa'i mchog /yang ba dag tu nyes par bstan/ /chang gis 'phrog par gyur pa'i sems/ /bya ba dang ni mi bya ba//mi shes rnam par mi shes shing / /thams cad mi yis mi shes so/ /gang zhig chang la 94

brten byed pa/ /skye bo res 'ga' dga' byed cing / /res 'ga' yongs su gdung byed la/ /res 'ga' sdig pa byed pa yin/ /blo ni shin tu rmongs skye zhing / /'jig rten gnyis ni rnams 'jig byed/ /thar pa'i chos la me lta bur/ /sreg byed kho na chang yin no/ /mi gang dag ni chang spongs pa/ /chos kyi ngang tshul mnyam par bzhag /gang na 'chi ba med pa yi/ /gnas mchog dag tu nga 'gro'o/ /chang 'thung ba yis bslus pa dag /de ni byed pa dman pa yin/ /mi bzad sems can dmyal bar lhung/ /don med ci zhig yongs su gdungs/ /'thung ba'i tshe na chang zhim te/ /rnam smin tshe na mchog tu tsha/ /kim pa ka nang kim pa ka /chang zhes mkhas pa rnams kyis bshad/ /bdag la 'di yis mi gnod ces/ /blo ldan chang la yid ma rton/ /myong na bsil yang rnam smin tsha/ /chang gis dmyal bar 'gro bar byed/ /sdig pa'i chos rnams byed pa la/ /sems g.yengs pa dag dga' bar byed/ /phyi nas rnam smin tsha ba ru/ /blo ngan yongs su gdung bar 'gyur/ /gsungs/ mkhas pa sad dzas bu la springs pa las/ gang zhig 'thung nas ra ro gom tshugs dbang med 'dor/ /yul gong ma 'di'i bar yang 'khyams shing rdeg 'chos 'gyur/ /bza' dang mi bza' de bya de med 'dres par za/ /de 95

bas bu khyod myos 'gyur khu ba rtag tu spongs/ /gang 'thung na ni bdag la brtan med blo nyams shing / /phyugs dang 'dra bar mdza' bos spongs shing dgra bos 'phya/ /'dus pa bro gar byed cing glu len mkhar rnga brdungs/ /dge legs grags nyams rgyu de su zhig 'thung bar byed/ /de 'thung ngo tsha khrel yod dor nas ni/ / gcer bur phyungs kyang 'jom med spyon pa bzhin/ /rkun bu gcan gzan rgyu ba'i lam du 'gro/ /lus srog nyams rgyu de ni khyod kyis sgongs/ /de 'thung skyugs pas gos pas 'gyel gyur nas/ /kha yang khyi yis dogs pa med par ldag /dran med lam po che yang nyal 'gyur na/ /bag med rtsa ba rtag tu spangs par bya/ /gang zhig 'thung nas myos par 'khrul 'gyur te/ /'bris na an+ta dag kyang rme byung na/ /dud chen 'thibs te phan tshun thal mar byung / /phung khrol rtsa ba de ni su zhig 'thung / /gang zhig mthong na dpal gyi gzhir gyur rigs/ /je mtho je mtho gyur pa'ang brlag bdo ba/ /nor gyi dbyeg ldan khyim yang 'phung 'gyur ba/ /nyes mang gzhi rtsa de ni su zhig 'thung / /glo bur ngu zhing res 'ga' rgod par byed/ /ma nges smra zhing gdon gyis zin pa bzhin/ /ma brtags mang du smra zhing tshig rtsub 'byen/ /sgo gsum nyams byed de ni btung mi bya/ /gang zhig nyes pas sngon 96

gyi lha rnams myos/ /lha yi dbang bo'i dpal ni nyams gyur nas/ /skyabs 'dod phyir na rgya mtsho'i nang du gab/ /lha yang nyams byed de ni btung mi bya/ /mi bya ba yang bya ba bzhin du byed/ /mi bden pa yang bden pa bzhin du smra/ /zhum pa rnams kyang ma zhum bzhin du spyod/ /myos 'gyur rigs nyams sdug bsngal rgyur gyur pa/ /sdig pa'i srin mo byur ngan mngon sum bzhin/ /rtsod pa'i gzhi dang tha dad ma yin pa/ /snying gi mun pa mi zad de su 'thung / /de 'thung yid ni rab tu 'khrugs gyur nas/ /brtse ba'i pha dang ma yang gsod 'gyur zhing / /nyes med dge slong bram ze drang srong gsod/ /chom rkun dang ni log g.yem smad pa byed/ /rdzun dang phra ma tshig rtsub 'khyal ba smra/ /brnab sems gnod sems log lta'i mun pa 'dzin/ /mi dge'i rtsa ba de ni btung mi bya/ /gang zhig 'thung na tshul khrims ting 'dzin dang / /shes rab lta ba 'tsho ba cho ga dang / /dran pa shes bzhin dad pa brtson 'grus nyams/ /dge chos chud zon de ni btung mi bya/ /de 'thung sdig spyod rnams ni lus zhig nas/ /rab tu bzod dka'i sems can dmyal bar ltung / /yi dwags dud 'gro rnams dang spyon par 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal rtsa ba de ni btung mi bya/ /thub pas dga' ba can gyi mdo las ni/ /myos 'gyur nyes 97

pa sum cu so lnga gsungs/ /de phyir bu khyod bdag la phan 'dod na/ /nyes kun rtsa ba de ni btung mi bya/ /chang dga' dgos pa thams cad la/ /rtag tu bag med spyod par 'gyur/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis smad 'gyur zhing / /dkar po'i chos rnams 'grib par 'gyur/ /nyes kun rtsa ba bag med gnas/ /'di dang gzhan du rnam par rmongs/ /de bas skye bo chen po khyod/ /chang la dga' ba rtag tu spongs/ /gsungs/ rgyal sras thogs med kyis/ sdig sdug gtam ngan dug shing bskyed pa'i rlan/ /thos bsam bsgom pa'i sman shing sreg pa'i me/ /dran ldan myos par byed pa'i mi zad gdon/ /myos 'gyur kun tu spongs shig shes rab grub/ /gsungs/ dpe chos rin chen spungs pa las/ chang la yang tsha sings dang / bskol ma la sogs pa dang/ chang gi sred pa can rnams la drang don du gnang ba skad du gsungs pa yin gyi/ don la 'dul ba lung thams cad nas chang btung du ma gnang / der ma zad de/ gsang sngags kun nas kyang chang bsten pa'i rjes su bshad kyang / bde mchog gi rgyud bdud rtsi chang gi le'u nas/ bdud rtsi myang ba tsam ma yin pa/ tha mal gye sred pas chang 'thung ba la nyes dmigs dpag tu med pa bshad nas yod par 'dug sngon jo bo bod na bzhugs tsa na/98

jo bo'i zhal nas/ rtsa ba'i sde bzhi gang na yod pa na/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnas pa yin pas/ bod du rtsa ba'i sde bzhi 'dzugs/ phal chen pa'i mkhan po ngas bya gsungs/ gnyis po rgya gar nas spyan drongs gsungs pa la/ phyis bslab pa'i slob dpon zhus kyang ma gnang ste/ khyed bod chang 'thung ste 'chi/ de tsam gyis dmyal bar 'gro/ kho bo ni/ mi don med du dmyal bar bskyur ba'i gal ma mchis gsungs skad/ gter ston stobs ldan rdo rje'i zhal nas/ chang gis myos nas dge slong sdom pa shor/ /khyem bdag khrel shor lus mi thub pa dang / /a ṇi btsun mas bye byas bye phrug 'don/ /dngos su ngo tsha'i bcings pas lkog tu bsad/ /mi dge mtshams med mi rung las bsogs tshe/ /khyem gyi bdag mo a ṇi btsun ma rnams/ /ser mo chang la hab 'thung ma byed cig /khyad par 'dul khrims bsrung ba'i dge slong la/ /ston pas chang ni rtsa bkag mdzad pa dang / /gal te dge slong gang zhig chang 'thung na/ /de ni nga yi dge slong ma yin zhing / /nga yang de yi ston pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs gsang sngags rnal 'byor pa rnams kyang / /thabs shes rdzas dang dam rdzas dag gi phyir/ /bag yod bsten las bag med gyur pa'i las/ /bag med 'dod sred gzhan dbang chang gis 99

myos/ /don las nyams shing slar yang ngan song ltung / /zhes dang / rnal 'byor gang zhig chang gis myos/ /ngu 'bod dmyal bar 'tshod par byed/ /ces gsungs pas/ lta ba dgongs pa nus pa dang ldan pa ma lags pa/ bag med spyo thabs myos byed spong bar zhu/ 'o na sngon gyi grub dbang rnams kyis chang mang du bzhes pa dper na/ o rgyan chen po dang / ṭom snyi pa/ birlub/gtsang spyon pa/ 'brug smyon pa sogs rgya bod kyi grub brnyes rnams kyi rnam thar 'gran na/ ji ltar stag gis mchongs pa'i sar/ /wa yis mchongs na ske tshugs phud/ /ces pa ltar 'gyur/gsungs/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ chang gis 'jig rten brnyas 'gyur zhing / /don yal nor yang zad par 'gyur/ /rmongs pas bya ba ma yin byed/ /de bas chang ni rtag tu spongs/ /zhes dang / jo bo bka' gdams pas/ chang ni nyes pa kun gye rtsa ba yin/ /rtswa mchog zil ba tsam yang btung mi bya/ /gsungs/yan lag brgyad pa'i rgyud las/ ra ro dang po bag med gnas la gnas/ /rnam rtog ngan bcom bde ba yin snyam sems/ /ra ro gnyis pa glang chen spyon pa ltar/ / kha na ma tho tshul khrims 'chal ba'i gnas/ /ra ro tha ma sems med ro ltar nyal/ /gang yang mi shes mun pa'i gnas su 'gyur/ /zhes dang / snyan rgyud 100

rdo rje tshig rkang las/ bag med 'dod sred gzhan dbang chang gis myos/ /don las nyams shing slar yang ngan song ltung / /zhes dang / bde mchog sdom 'byung las/ /su zhig chang gis myos gyur pa/ /de la gegs ni mang bo 'byung / /sngags pa chang gis myos gyur gang / /ngu 'bod gnas su 'tshod par 'gyur/ /gsungs/ /gzhan yang dran pa nyer bzhag las/ rgyal po zhig gis/ mgron po skom pas gdung ba 'ga' la bur chang blud pas/dmyal ba ngu 'bod chen por skye bar gsungs/ gsang ba rgyan zhes bya ba'i rgyud las/ rdzun gyi tshig ni smra mi bya/ /chang ni btung bar mi bya'o/ /gsungs/ bka' gdams pha chos las la las mthun rkyen sna re tsam tshang bas chog snyam nas ngo mtshar che/khyed bsod nams chen po bsogs theg pa chen po 'di 'dra ba mnyan du yod pa zer nas/ snod ci 'dra mi blta bar/ bcud che re nye re la blugs te/ da gzod bla ma 'brom gyi rnam par thar ba la zer nas/ gsang sngags zab mo'i las skal tsho mi byed par zas skal tsho za/ bdud rtsir ming btags nas chang bag med tsho 'thung / thabs su ming btags nas sha bag med du spyod/ za dus sems can gzhan gyis go ba blangs nas 'chi ba ma byung bas/ sngags pa rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po/ rang gis lag 101

bdar te/ byang chub sems dpas pha ma/ sngags pas lha gsod pa lags mod/ de dus su ba glang gi mchod sbyin gyis nyen du che bar gda'/ de nas tshogs 'khor skad du ming btags nas/bag med mang bo 'dus nas bag med du 'khrab/ grub thob mang po bzi nas 'gyel/ des mi 'ong rang nyid sangs rgyas gson ma yin skad du/ sangs rgyas bdud rtsis nga rgyal te 'thab/de nas sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsung ni 'di lta ste/ nga dang /khyed dang / nan tar na ci ma mnyam pa dang / nga bla ma yin su cig po'i sras po yin/ su cig po'i dbon po yin/ dgon pa 'di la nga las dbang che ba su yod/ yul 'di na ngas dbang ma bskur ba'i mi su yod/ yon bdag gi rtsa ba yin rgyu nged kyi yin zer nas/ byes pa bu mo rang gi snabs lud 'phyid mi shes pa re la bla ma slob dpon du ming btags/ sgam sgom nyon mongs pa du mas gzir ba blang dor mi shes pa res/ bla ma sangs rgyas su thos pas/ 'o na nga rang yang a tsi bar 'ong ang snyam du bsgom ni bzang/ sangs rgyas kyi bya ba sems can gcig mi 'drongs gsungs/ bka' gdams bu chos las/ sangs rgyas kyis chang thams cad bkag de'i rgyu mtshan yang so sor thar ba thams cad thar ba'i sdom pa dang 'brel du 'ong / byang 102

chub sems dpa' las dang po pa tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms pa las 'gal ba bzhi bskyed du 'ong/ de dag gi yang dgag bya yin na rig pa 'dzin pa dag lha'i bskyed rim bsgom pa'i skabs su rig pa shin tu gsal dgos pa yin mod/ chang myos chu yin mod/ 'on te zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsir dngos su sgyur shes dgos so/ /gzhan du na lha'i sku mdog du ma/ phyag mtshan du ma/ lha dpag tu med pa'i nang du lha dpag tu med pa bsgoms pa la sogs pa/ so so skye bos myos chu ma 'thung yang mi 'chun gyis/ mi thub pa la 'thung na ci 'dra/ des na 'dir bde bar gshegs pas bkag bkag bzhin du 'thung na ni/bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' 'das kyi rtsa ba'i ltung ba 'ong /chos rgyus chung ngu la la na re/ 'dul ba dang nyan thos pa'i lugs la chang btung du mi btub/ nged gsang sngags yin pas 'thung bas chog zer te/ 'o na de tsam du khyod kyis rtswa mchog gang tsam 'thung chog na/ nged kyis rtswa mchog stong 'thung bas chog de'i rgyu mtshan ci yin na/ khyed kyis rtswa ba'i ltung ba shor bas chog pa la/ nged kyis yan lag gi ltung ba shor bas ci ste mi chog lar gsang sngags gsha' ma zhig mdzad na/ kri ya'i bskor bzhin du mdzad na ngo mtshar che/ gsungs/ bla ma zhang 103

rin po che'i zhal nas/ chang ni nyes pa kun gyi gzhi/ /mdo sde thams cad kun nas bkag /rdo rje rtse mo las kyang bkag /rgyud sde gzhan dang gzhan las kyang / /slob ma dbang bskur nod pa'i tshe/ /nyes pa kun gyi rtsa ba ste/ /chang ni rab tu sgongs zhes gsungs/ /spyir ni nyes ltung gzhi ma chang / /sgos su brtson 'grus bar chod dang / /le lo snyoms las bag med kyis/ /dge tshogs yon tan 'phrog pa'i bdud/ /rnal 'byor pa yis ma spangs na/ /phyag sogs yan lag bdun pa dang / /'phral gyi yi dam gcog par byed/ /do nub ra ro bag med pas/ /sang nas 'bad pa bya yis zer/ /sang yang bdud kyis chang blud pas/ /yang 'byams yang 'byams chang la 'byams/ /dge sbyor gtsang ma ci ma tshang / /bag med khyim sun 'byin la sogs/ /lus ngag yid gsum ma bsdams pas/ /mi dge bcu la sogs pa yi/ /bkag pa thams cad 'jol nyog spyod/ /de sogs chang gi nyes dmigs rnams/ /lhag pa'i bsam pas bskul ba yi/ /mdo sogs bshad par gzigs la spongs/ /cis kyang spongs par ma gyur na'ang / /dman sa zungs la ran par 'thung / /gsungs/mkhyen brtse rin po ches/ chang gis bzi ba'i nus pa zil gyis gnon thub pa/ rgyal dbang mtsho skyes rdo rje dang / grub chen 104

birlub sogs kyi rnam par thar ba dang spyod yul yin pa ma gtogs/ gsang sngags mos pas spyod pa'i gang zag lam zhugs pa rnams kyis btung bar ma gsungs te/ rgyud las/ su zhig chang gis myos gyur pa/ /de la gegs ni mang po 'byung / /sngags pa chang gis myos gyur gang / /ngu 'bod gnas su 'tshod par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ deng sang gi bla ma grub thob tu rlom pa rnams chang gis bzi thub pa 'dug gam mi 'dug mi 'dug na go bcad/ 'dug na rgyun tu rtogs pa la mnyam rjes med pa'i gdeng yod kyang / chang gis bzi ba dang smyon pa la khyad par med/ smyon pa dang dus mtshungs par thugs dam dang sgom gyi dran pa'i tshugs kha shor ba lta ci/ 'du shes ma 'khrul ba tsam yang med gsungs/ sngon rje phag mo gru ba'i zhabs shin tu bsnyungs pas/ sngags mkhan zhig na re/ chang gi nying khu gsol zhal gang tsam gsol ba byung na sku khams 'di bzang nas 'ong zhus pas/ khong gi zhal nas a rdzi rdzi/ chang gi rnam par smin pa ni shin tu 'jigs gsungs nas/ sku srog gi phyir du yang chang phor ba gang tsam yang ma gsol na/ gzhan rang dgar 'thung ba smos ci dgos/ des na khong las theg pa chen bo'i gsang sngags la mkhas pa sngar su ma byon te/ nga 105

gsang sngags pa yin zhes chang ma gsol 'dug pas/ deng sang nga gsang sngags pa yin zer nas/ chang la bag med du spyod pa 'di ni rang nyid 'phung ba'i rgyu yin pas/ rang legs su 'dod pa rnams kyis dang po bka' brgyud pa'i rnam thar ltar nyes skyon thams cad kyi rtsa ba myos 'gyur gyi chang spangs par bya'o/ /mkhas grub rjes mdzad pa'i sdom gsum rnam bshad las/chang ni nad pa la yang srog gi phyir yang gnang ba'i skabs med do/ /de yang rab byung gcig pu ma yin gyi/ chos 'di pa'i bslab pa blangs pa khyim pa yan chad kyis/ nad gso ba'i phyir yang rtswa ku sha'i rtse mo chang la nyugs pa khar bcug ste ro myang ba tsam yang mi rung na/ hub gcig gam gnyis su longs pa lta ci smos/ de ltar yang mdo rtsa las/ nad pas chang ni rtswa mchog gis kyang mi btung ngo / /dge bsnyen yan chad thams cad kyis mi blud do/ /zhes pa'i rgya cher 'grel ba las/ nad pas chang ni rtswa mchog gis kyang mi btung ngo / /zhes bya ba ni/ bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa thams cad nad pa'i yul la rjes su gnang ba de'i dmigs kyis bsal ba yin te/ ji ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis shākya na bar gyur pa dag la de nyid ma gnang bar gsungs pa yin no/ /de yang dge slong dag gang la ston pa 106

zhes zer ba khyed cag gis chang tha na rtswa mchog gis kyang mi blud mi btung ngo zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /dge bsnyen yan chad thams cad kyis mi blud do zhes bya ba ni/ dge bsnyen gyi mtha' yan chad/ chos 'di la bslab pa blang ba thams cad kyis kyang chang blud par mi bya'o/ /'dir ba/zhung ni/ dge bsnyen gyis mi bya ba'i las drug ste/ sems can btsongs pa dang / mtshon cha btsongs pa dang / chang btsongs pa dang / dug btsongs pa dang / rgya skyegs kyi las dang / til btsir ba'i las so/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /rang bzhin gye kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa las gzhan thams cad la gso ba'i don nyid ma gtogs so zhes bya ba'i lhag ma'o zhes bya ba ni/ bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa thams cad bkag pa la gso ba'i don nyid du ni/ma gtogs te/ dgag pa med do zhes gsungs pa de'i lhag ma ni/ myos par 'gyur ba'i btung ba bkag pa yin te/ 'di ni gso ba'i don du yang bkag par shes par bya'o/ /nad gso ba'i don nyid du bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa lhag par spyod pa la ni ltung ba med do/ /dper na sha bsngos par shes na bza' bar mi bya'o/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba dang bcas pa thams cad gso ba'i don nyid du ma 107

gtogs so zhes bstan pa'i lhag ma dmigs kyis bsal ba ni/myos par 'gyur ba'i btung ba ma gtogs so zhes bya ba 'di yin te/ sdig pa thams cad kyi sgor gyur pa yin pa'i phyir de la dmigs kyis bsal ba med do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar na nad gso ba'i don du rang la dmigs pa'i sha bza' ba sogs kha na ma tho ba thams cad gnang ba dmigs bsal yin kyang / chang ni nad gso ba'i don du yang gnang ba'i dmigs bsal med do zhes gsal bar bshad pas/ sha rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba yin pa dang / chang bag med du 'thung ba la skyon du mi brtsi ba sogs log pa'i chos lugs du mas sdig pa thams cad kyi sgor gsungs pa'i nyes pa rgyas par byed do/ /de'i phyir mdo dang bstan bcos theg pa che chung gi sde snod mtha' dag nas/ mtha' gcig tu chang la nyes pa thams cad kyi sgor gyur pa'i dgag pa rgya cher yang dang yang du lan cig ma yin par gsungs kyang / de nyid la 'jem pa med par spyod pa la skyon du mi byed pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'jig par byed pa'i rgyu gzhan gang las kyang stobs ches che ba yin la/ de yang bcas pa dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa gzhan gang yin kyang de dag la spyad pas nyes pa thams cad kyi sgor 'gyur tshul chang 'thung ba dang 108

mtshungs pa gcig kyang med pas/ de'i phyir bstan pa la gnod pas chang bsten pa dang mtshungs pa ci'ang med pas/ chang bcas rkyang yin kyang gnang ba'i skabs med pa yin no/ /bstan pa la gnod pa'i tshabs gzhan las ches che bas 'di'i gzugs brnyan tsam gyis kyang bstan pa la gnod par mthong ste/ rgyal po glang dar mas kyang bstan pa bsnubs pa'i rten 'brel du/ lha sa'i gtsang khang gi sgo la 'dam zhal byas pa la rab byung chang 'thung ba'i gzugs brnyan bris nas bzhag la/ bal bor rab byung gis chang bum 'khyer ba gzigs pas thugs phyungs te/kun mkhyen gnyis pa dbyig gnyen kyang mya ngan las 'das zhes grags so/ /de ltar yin na da lta bla gos dang mthang gos chang gi sgyugs pas g.yogs par byed pa'i khyu chen po dag gis rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyin re bzhin bri bar byed pa lta smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ gal te de ni nyan thos kyi rnam gzhag yin gyis/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i rab byung rnams la ni ci dgar gnang ba yin pas skyon med do zhe na/ de ni rgyud sde rin po che dag gi don la phyin ci log tu rtog pa'i log par rtog pa yin te/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ sdom pa bsgrag pa'i skabs su/ phung khrol kun gyi rtsa ba yi/ /chang ni rab tu spangs par bya/ /zhes 109

gsungs la/ de nyid bla med kyi dkyil chog tshad ldan du mar yang gsungs pa'i phyir dang / dus 'khor nas kyang dngos su dgag pa dmigs su phug pa mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i skabs su chang ma 'thung na/ dam tshig rdzas ni ji bzhin nyid/ /mi bsten pa ni bcu gsum pa/ /zhes pa'i nyes pa 'byung ba min nam zhe na/ de lta na dam rdzas kyi gtso bo sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga yin pas/ bshang gci dang khyi sha la sogs kyang dngos su ma bsten na dam tshig las 'das pa'i nyes par 'gyur ro/ /gal te de dag ni/ zas gzhan la sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lngar bsgoms nas byin gyis brlabs pa dang / bdud rtsi ril bu btab nas longs spyad pa tsam gyis chog go snyam na/ 'o na chang la yang tshul de nyid ci'i phyir mi mtshungs te/ dam tshig gi rdzas su mtshungs pa la bshang gci phor ba gang ba longs spyod mi dgos par bsgoms pa'am bdud rtsi ril bu tsam gyi chog la/chang lce la reg pa tsam gyis mi chog par myos par 'gyur gyi bar du 'thung dgos par smra ba ni/ blun po rang gi 'dod pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa'i bdud tshig yin par gdon mi za'o/ /gal te brtag pa gnyis las/ de la ga bur rgyu yi phyir/ /sha ni rab tu bza' bar bya/ khyad par du yang chang nyid 110

do/ /zhes gsungs pa ma yin nam zhe na/ de ni sngags pa bde ba chen po'i ye shes gong nas gong du rgyas par 'dod pas bstan pa la gnod pa'i dgag bya med cing / bde ba'i rten kun ta lta bu'i khams rgyas par gyur pa la brten nas bde chen gyi ye shes rgyas par byed nus pa'i dgos pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i gang zag khyad par ba'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ bde chen gyi ye shes bskyed pa'i phyogs na'ang med kyang sred pas 'jug pa'i sngags pa rab byung gi rtags can rnams kyis myos par gyur pa'i btung ba mngon gyur du spyod pa la ni/ bstan pa la gnod pa'i dgag bya ches che ba yin no/ /rgya gar gyi grub chen dngos su chang bsten pa dag ni/dngos kyi rig ma bsten pa la nyes pa 'byung ba'i gnas skabs dag las kyang ring du 'das nas/ tha mal gyis snang zhen mnyam rjes thams cad du rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis zil gyis gnon nus pa spyod pa spyad ran pa dag dang spyad zin pa dag gis/ rab byung gi rtags spangs te/ rnal 'byor pa'i gzugs kyis dngos su chang dang rig ma bsten cing / de 'dra ba la ma dad pa thams cad dzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis dngos su 'dul bar byed nus pa dag gis kun spyod yin gyi/ da lta chags sdang 111

mngon gyur mgo ma non par yod cing / tha mal snang zhen tha mal ba dag dang khyad par med par yod bzhin du grub chen dag gi kun spyod ltar 'chos pa ni/ mi zad pa'i dzun chen pos 'jig rten bslu zhing bstan pa nyams par byed pa'i sgo nas 'jig rten pha rol btang ba'i chos log yin par shes par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams yid ches tshad mar bzung nas/rang dang rang gi slob ma yon bdag rnams kyi gtso byas chos pa 'jig rten pa thams cad kyis smyo chu dug chu brlag chu 'phung chu myos 'gyur gyi chang 'di dug bzhin du bltas nas rgyang ring du dor bar bya'o/ /de ltar byed nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang po'i byen gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyangs bya'o/ / spras pa/ shes bya'i chos rnams phyag mthil skyu ru ra/ /rlon pa bzhag nas gzigs ltar sa ler mkhyen/ /zhal nas bden pa ma gtogs dzun mi gsung / /sangs rgyas thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyed kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byen rlabs kyis/ /tshe 'dir chos shor don yal nor yang zad/ /phyi mar dmyal ba ngu 'bod skye ba'i rgyu/ /chang gi 'dod sred zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ / nyes pa'i rtsa ba smyo chu chang 'thung na/ /shi nas 112

dmyal ba ngu 'bod gnas su skye/ /rab byung sdom pa can la chang blud na/ /shi na dmyal ba rab gdung chen por skye/ / dge slong gso sbyong blangs la chang blud na/ /shi na dmyal ba sgra 'byin chen por skye/ /dge bsnyen rnams la myos chang 'thung bcug na/ /shi na dmyal ba skra me 'bar bar skye/ /chang la chu mang blugs nas btsongs pa na/ /shi na dmyal me'i phye ma srin bur skye/ /gcan gzan bya la chang blud bsad gyur na/ /dmyal ba lcags kyi gtun shing 'bab par skye/ /glang po che la chang byin mi bsad na/ /dmyal ba lcags tshal dgon par skye bar 'gyur/ /sems —can 'tsho phyir chang gi rin byen na/ /dmyal ba rab rib kun bsregs zhes byar skye/ /nad pa bu btsas chang rin byen gyur na/ /dmyal ba gshin rje mtshams kyi dgon par skye/ /chang mang blud nas mi bsad nor 'phrog na/ /dmyal ba shal ma li yi nags su skye/ /'brog dgon skye bo mang por chang blud na/ /shal ma li yi dmyal ba chen por skye/ /bud med yon tan can la chang blud na/ /chu shing bsregs pa'i dud pa'i tshal du skye/ /dgra jag chom rkun gsod phyir chang blud na/ /dmyal ba me mdag dud pa'i tshal du skye/ /phyi rol pa rnams slu phyir chang blud na/ /dmyal ba glog gi na bun tshal du skye/ /lam 'gro rngon pa rnams la 113

chang blud na/ /dmyal ba kun tu rtog byed ces par skye/ /chang mang 'thung nas lha bsgoms sngags bzlas kyang / /zangs zhun khol ma khar ldud dmyal bar skye/ /chang 'thung mnan bsreg 'phangs gsum las byas na/ /lha ma yin gyi dmag dpon chen por skye/ /chang 'thung bla ma grogs la gnod byas na/ /shi ma thag nas rdo rje dmyal bar skye/ /chang 'thung mi tshangs spyod la zhugs gyur na/ /shal ma li yi sdong bor yang yang 'drud/ /chang 'thung gzhan gyi zas nor rkus 'phrog na/ /yi dwags mtshon cha'i 'khor lo can du skye/ /chang 'thung khrel dang ngo tsha med pa de/ /glen lkugs dud 'gro'i nang du yang yang skye/ /chang 'thung khyi yi skye ba lnga brgya len/ /mi ru skyes kyang spyon pa smyon mar skye/ /chang 'thung tshe 'dir don yal nor yang zad/ /tshe thung nad mang sdug bsngal du mas gzir/ /chang 'di 'thung na lus sems bde snyam pa/ /'ga' res smyos na e bzang snyam pa 'dra/ /smyo chu chang 'thung lam dong nang du 'gyel/ /mis 'phya rang 'phung chang nag bdud zas yin/ /de phyir mkhas btsun rnams kyis smad pa'i gnas/ /chang 'di kun gyis 'thung bar ma gyur cig /sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyi byen rlabs kyis/ /chang la sred pa gtan nas mi skye shog /'dis mtshon dge ba'i mthu 114

yis rang gzhan gyes/ /chang spangs chos la rtag tu spyod par shog /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gsum pa sdug bsngal thams cad kyi rtsa ba 'jig rten khyim thab bud med bsten pa'i nyes dmigs bsam pa ni/ bad sa'i rgyal po 'char byed kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das la bad sa'i rgyal po 'char byed kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni gtum zhing gzu lum che/ drag shul can lags pas/ bdag gis bud med kyi tshig gis/ sdig pa'i sug las mngon par 'du bgyis pa des/ bcom ldan 'das bdag sems can dmyal bar 'chi bar bdag gis yang dag par 'tshal na/ bcom ldan 'das bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du/ ci nas kyang bdag slan chad bud med kyi dbang du mchis nas/ sdig pa'i sug las mngon par 'du bgyed par mi 'gyur zhing / sems can dmyal bar mi ltung ba dang / bud med kyi 'gyur ldog rnams dang / bud med kyi bsten pa rnams dang / bud med kyi tshig rnams dang / bud med kyi rgyu rnams dang / bud med kyi g.yo rnams dang / bud med kyi sgyu rnams dang / bud med kyi mi brtan pa rnams dang / bud med kyi 'gyur ldog rnams dang / bud med kyi bsten pa rnams dang /115

bud med kyi tshig rnams dang / bud med kyi 'khrul pa rnams yang dag par bshad du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang /bcom ldan 'das kyis bad sa'i rgyal po 'char byed la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rgyal po chen po gnas de lta bu yongs su zhus pas khyod la ci bya/ bcom ldan 'das la bad sa'i rgyal po 'char byed kyis yang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci nas bdag bud med kyi dbang du mchis par gyur na/bud med ni ma rungs ma/ 'khon can gtum mo drag shul can lags te/ bcom ldan 'das bud med de ni/ bdag sems can dmyal bar mchis par bgyid 'tshal ba lags pas/bcom ldan 'das las don de nyid nyan par 'tshal lags so/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bad sa'i rgyal po 'char byed la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rgyal po chen po khyod kyis ji rang gi skyon rnams yongs su rtogs shig dang / de nas bud med kyi skyon rnams yongs su rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /de skad ces bka' stsal ba dang / bcom ldan 'das la bad sa'i rgyal po 'char byed kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ / bcom ldan 'das lags so lags so/ /skyes pa skyon ci lta bu dag dang ldan na/ skyes pa bud med kyi dbang du 116

mchis par 'gyur bas skyes pa'i skyon rnams bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la yang dag par rab tu bshad du gsol/ de skad ces gsol ba dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bad sa'i rgyal po 'char byed la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rgyal po chen po de'i phyir khyod legs par nyon la/ rab tu yid la zungs shig dang / ngas khyod la bshad par bya'o/ /bad sa'i rgyal po 'char byed kyis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin no zhes gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rgyal po chen po/ skyes pa skyon gang dag dang ldan na/ skyes pa bud med kyi dbang du 'gro bar 'gyur bas/ sgyes pa'i skyes bu'i skyon ni/ bzhi bo 'di dag yin no/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rgyal po chen po/ 'di la skyes pa 'dod pa rnams la chags par gyur cing / de 'dod pa rnams la bag med par gyur nas/ phyir zhing bud med la blta 'dod de/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa/ yon tan dang ldan pa/shes rab dang ldan pa'i dge sbyong dang / bram ze dag la blta bar mi 'dod cing / de tshul khrims dang ldan pa/ yon tan dang ldan pa/ shes rab dang ldan pa'i dge sbyong dang / bram ze dag mthong na bsnyen par mi byed/ bsten par mi byed/ bsnyen 117

bkur bar mi byed pas/ de tshul khrims dang ldan pa/ yon tan dang ldan pa/ shes rab dang dge sbyong dang / bram ze dag gis yongs su spangs pas/dad pa las yongs su nyams/ tshul khrims las yongs su nyams/ gtong ba las yongs su nyams shing /dad pa dang bral ba/ tshul khrims 'chal ba/ thos pa nyung ba/ser sna can du gyur pa/ yi dwags kyi yon tan gyi chos la kun tu spyod pa/ shes rab 'chal ba/ rma la chags pa/ btsog pa'i spyod yul can/ bshul bar mnan pa la mngon par dga' ba/mi gtsang ba la dga' ba/ bud med la dad pa che ba/ zhi ba yongs su mi 'tshol ba/ chags pa'i spyod yul can/ 'gro bar bya ba ma yin par song ba/ smad rab 'os pa mi gtsang ba'i srin 'bu dang 'dra ba/ snyigs ma len pa/ 'dod pa la brkam pa/khrel dang ngo tsha bor ba/ lha dang mi'i chos la nyams pa/ ngan par smad pa'i 'tsho bas 'tsho ba/ mkhas pas smad pa/ byis pa'i skye bo la brten pa/ sdig pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa/ sdig pa'i grogs po la brten pa/ sdig pa la kun tu 'jug pa/ sdig pa la gzhol ba/ bud med kyi thul 'og tu chud pa/ bud med kyis 'khol ba/ bud med kyi dbang du song ba/ bud med la gzhol ba/ bud med dang gnas pa/ rma'i sgo'i spyod yul can/ rma'i sgo 118

la brten pa/ rma'i sgo la gnas pa/ kha chu dang / snabs dang /mchil ma dang / ngar snabs dang / rnag dang / she'u rul dang / klad rgyas dang / mi gtsang ba'i spyod yul can/ lug dang / ba glang dang / bya gag dang / khyi dang / phag dang / bong bu'i spyod pa/ gnod pa'i 'tsho ba pha ma la phangs par mi 'dzin pa/ dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / sbyin gnas la phangs par mi 'dzin pa/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la dad pa yongs su nyams pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa las yongs su nyams pa/ sems can dmyal ba dang dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten la zhugs shing gzhol ba/ seng ge dang nam mkha' lding gi lus la yang dag par rjes su zhugs pa/lcags kyi shing shal ma li mthon po dang / me ma mur la gzhol ba/ sems can dmyal ba yang sos dang / thig nag dang /bsdus 'joms dang / ngu 'bod dang / ngu 'bod chen po dang /tsha ba dang / rab tu tsha ba dang / mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba chen por zhugs pa ni/ bud med kyi skyon 'di lta bu 'di dag thos nas kyang bud med la chags shing / bud med dang brten pas/ rgod pa dang / ngu ba dang / ca co 'don pa dang / bro brdung ba dang / glu blangs pa dang / rol mo byas pa 119

dag dran par byed cing / skyo ba mi bskyed/ yid 'byung bar mi byed do/ /rgyal po chen po/ byes pa'i chos la kun tu spyod cing /kun tu spyod pa de dag dang ldan pa'i skyes bu ni/ ngan song rnams su skye bar 'gyur te/ rgyal po chen po/ bud med kyi dbang du song nas 'dod pa la brten cing ngan 'gror 'gro bar 'jug pa ni/ skyes pa'i skyes bu'i skyon dang po yin no/ /de nas de'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa bka' stsal to/ /'dod pa dri nga mi gtsang smad par 'os pa dang / /mi mthun 'jigs byed mi rtag las byung sdug bsngal byed/ /don med 'phung bar byed cing dman pa yin pas na/ /mkhas pa su zhig 'dod pa'i skom la brten par byed/ /btsog pas gang ba'i chab khung dri nga lta bu dang / /mnan par gyur cing rul ba'i khyim rnams ji bzhin dang / /shi ba dur khrod sa na shin tu smad pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'dod pa rnams kyang shin tu smad pa yin/ /sbrang bu rma zhig mthong nas rgyug pa ji 'dra dang / /phag ni ngan sgyugs mthong nas rgyug pa ji 'dra dang / /khyi ni sha yi don du bshas sar 'gro ba ltar/ /de bzhin mi mkhas bud med dag la dga' bar byed/ /grags pa med cing mi snyan yon tan 'bri ba dang / /de las tshul khrims mtho la nyams par 'gyur ba 120

dang / /mtho ris nyams shing dmyal bar rtag tu ltung bas na/ /mkhas pa su zhig 'dod pa'i skom la brten par byed/ /ji ltar ha la ha la'i dug ni zos pa na/ /lus dag rmas shing rmongs pa skye bar 'gyur ba ltar/ /de bzhin 'di na byes pa rnams ni 'dod pa'i rgyus/ /rang gi lus kyi dbyibs ni dug tu mi rig go /ji ltar sgyu ma shin tu bslabs pa'i mi zhig gis/ /rnam par 'khrul ba'i sems can brgya dag dga' byed ltar/ /de bzhin byis pa bdag la bde bar 'dod pa rnams/ /'dod pa dga' ba'i rgyu las ngan 'gror rab tu ltung / /zas skom ston mo bzang bo tha dad pa dag dang / /glu bro sil snyan bzang ngo tha dad pa dag gis/ /khang ba mchog nas byung ba'i chung ma len pa ni/ /gnod pa rnyed pa yin zhing sdug bsngal bsog pa yin/ /'dod pa'i dga' la bskam pa dag ni gnod yin te/ /mi gtsang mtshon 'dra rmongs gyur dag la bsngags pa brjod/ /'dod pa dman pa dag la bsngags shing bstan nas ni/ /dman pa de dag ngan 'gror rab tu lhung bar 'gyur/ /gnod pa 'dod pa dag gis yul rnams rab bsngags shing / /'dod pa gnod pa yin la dga' ba'i byis pa rnams/ /de dag don med 'tsho ba rnam par spangs nas ni/ /mi bzad g.yang sa chen por 121

rab tu lhung bar 'gyur/ /nga rgyal rmongs pas bcom pa'i skye dgu 'di dag ni/ /rgya mtsho'i pha rol ma mthong ba yi bya bzhin du/ /lcags kyi me lce lnga bo dag la chags gyur nas/ /byis pa rnams ni rab tu 'bar zhing 'khrab par 'gyur/ /'di na byis pa myos shing shin tu rmongs pa rnams/ /shin tu mi mthong snod mchog yin par sems pa ltar/ /lam la rnam par rmongs rnams 'dod pa'i ched kyi phyir/ /rtag tu 'dir gnas 'di ni gya nom yin zhes 'dzer/ /gang phyir rnam pa sna tshogs las dag mi shes pas/ /'gro ba thams cad rab nyams rgud pa yod min pas/ /pha dang ma dang bu dang bu mo dag la ni/ /don gyis mchod pa mi byed gnod pa thos ma yin/ /de dag rtag tu bud med 'dris pas brdzod byed cing / /de 'dra'i las kyi tshul la rab tu 'jug par byed/ /de dag gti mug dra ba sdig pa rab gsog cing / /ngan 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur ba'i lam yang gsog par byed/ /mi rnams de dag der chags bde bar 'du shes shing / /pha dang ma yang yongs su rab tu spong bar byed/ /de dag mchod 'os rnams la mchod par mi byed cing / /smad par 'os pa'i 'dod pa dag ni tshol bar byed/ /phan tshun gdungs par 'gyur ba la ni gzhol byed cing / /rnam rtog mu yis nges bcom mi rnams 122

nyon mongs pa/ /bkur bsti yongs su tshol la dga' zhing ma 'phags rnams/ /chos ma yin par 'jig rten rab tu 'dzud par byed/ /gzhi de las ni mtshon cha dag dang lcags rnams dang / /de bzhin 'ching ba dang ni 'thab cing rtsod pa dang / /nges par 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal rab tu myong bar 'gyur/ /shi 'phos nas ni mnar med 'jigs su rung bar 'gro/ /tshe 'di nyid la de bzhin sdug bsngal 'byung 'gyur zhing / /nor nyams snying du sdug pa rab tu 'jigs 'gyur 'a// /mtho ris nyams shing dmyal ba rab tu lhung bas na/ /mkhas pa su zhig 'dod pa'i 'du shes bskyed par byed/ /lcags las grub pa'i nags tshal sngon po'i khrod dag tu/ /mkhas pas bdag nyid 'phred du bor ba de sla zhing / /mdzangs pa spu gri'i so yis bcad pa byas sla la/ /ral gri dag gi khrod du mal yang bcas sla zhing / /rab tu me 'bar thu lum bzung ba de sla la/ /de bzhin lcags kyi thu lum 'bar ba za sla zhing / /me dong 'jigs su rung ba rnams la reg sla yi/ /lag pa gnyis ni nam yang bud med reg mi bya/ /mis ni ji lta ji ltar 'dod pa rnams bsten pa/ /de lta de ltar bde ba thams cad rnams spangs shing / /'di ltar 'dod rnams gcig tu sdug bsngal mi gtsang ba'i/ /'dod pa sdug bsngal pa 123

dag rab tu rnam par spongs/ /'dod pa sdug bsngal kun gyi gzhi bor gyur pa dang / /gang phyir nor ni chud zar 'gyur bar byed pa dang / /yid 'ong skye bo rnams kyi nyams pa'i rtsa ba las/ /bud med nges par bsten pa gnod pa thob pa yin/ /skyes pa gang gis de 'dra'i chos tshul rig nas ni/ /bud med rnams la rtag tu bag med mi 'gyur ba/ /des ni rtag tu mtho ris lam yang ma spangs shing / /des ni byang chub dam pa rnyed par dka' ma yin/ /rgyal po chen po mi yi pha ma dag ni dka' ba byed pa yin te/ zla ba dgu 'am/ zla ba bcur mngal nas bzung ste/shin tu sdug bsngal bar song zhing / gcin dang phyi sa yang phyi bar byed/ pang du blangs nas nu zho ldud par byed/ phung po rnams skyed par byed/ mas bu rnams gso bar byed/ 'jig rten ston par byed/ 'dzam bu'i gling sna tshogs ston par byed/don du 'dod/ phun par 'dod/ grub pa dang / bde bar 'dod/ 'jig rten la phan par 'dod pa ste/ sbyin pa'i gnas yin la/ bu la phan pa dang bde bar 'dod pas/ de dag gis rang nor gyi tshogs kyis gzhan gyi khyim nas/ gzhan gyi bu mo blangs pa dang / de de la chags shing myos la 'chums shing brgyal ba dang / lhag par zhen pa dang / lhag par zhen cing 124

'dug par gyur nas/ gzhan gyi khyim nas blangs pa'i bud med de la chags shing myos pas/ sbyin pa'i gnas pha ma rgas 'khogs gtugs la lus nyam chung zhing / mig gis mi mthong ba dag brnyas shing longs spyod med pa dang / nor med par byas nas/rang gi khyem nas phyungs de skrod par byed do/ /rgyal po chen po 'di ltar pha mas dka' ba byed byed pa sbyin pa'i gnas la/rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par yang dag pa'i bde bas bsti stang du bya/ bla mar bya/ bstod par bya/ mchod par bya bar rigs na/des de'i tshe pha ma dag rang gi khyim nas phyungs bskrad nas/gzhan gyi khyem nas blangs pa'i bud med la/ bza' ba dang /btung ba dang / gos rnams kyis bsnyen bkur byed cing / bsti stang du byed/ gces su byed/ rim gro byed la/ mchod par byed cing / yang dag pa'i bde bas bsnyen bkur byed kyi/ pha ma la ni mi byed pas/ snying brtse ba med pa dang / mi blta ba dang /ngan pa'i sems dang ldan pa la ltos/ rgyal po chen po des bde 'gror 'gro ba'i chos gang yin pa de ni spang la/ ngan 'gror 'gro ba'i chos gang yin pa de ni yang dag par blangs te/ 'dug pa'i mi de bdag gis thos/ rgyal po chen po bud med kyi dbang du song nas/ 'dod pa rnams la bsten cing / pha ma la brnyas pa 125

dang / ngan 'gror 'gro bar 'jug pa de ni/ skyes pa'i skyes bu'i skyon gnyis pa yin te/ de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /gang dag pha ma rgas pa gso bar byed pa ni/ /de dag rtag tu bde zhing yid kyang bde 'gyur la/ /'di la lha dang bcas pa dang ni dbang bo dang / /de bzhin 'di la tshangs par bcas pa'i rigs su 'gyur/ /gang dag pha ma rgas pa gso bar byed pa ni/ /de dag song nas phyir 'ong ba yang 'grub 'gyur zhes/ /rgya mtsho chen po nas kyang bde zhing legs 'ong ste/ /de ltar byed pa dag ni rab mchog rnyed pa yin/ /gang dag pha ma rgas pa gso bar byed pa yi/ /tshong dpon de dag yon tan kun gyi gtsor 'gyur zhing / /de bzhin zhing las 'bras bu phun sum tshogs 'byung ste/ /bsod nams bgrangs pa'i don du brjod par mi nus so/ /gang dag pha ma rgas pa gso bar byed pa ni/ /de dag khur rnams khyer ba'i rnga mong rnams dang yang / /yang na glang dang bong bur rtag tu mi 'gyur te/ /mi rnams de dag spu gri'i so la rdzi mi 'gyur/ /gang dag pha ma rgas pa gso bar byed pa ni/ /de dag chu bo rab med dang ni me mur dang / /spu gri so dang ldan pa dag la mi brgal te/ /de dag zangs khu skol ba 'thung bar yongs mi 'gyur/ /126

gang dag pha ma rgas pa gso bar byed pa ni/ /de dag nor dang 'bru ni mi nyung mang ba dang / /chung ma bu dang bu mo dam pa dag dang yang / /baiḍūr+ya dang rin chen sa le sbram yang rnyed/ /gang dag pha ma rgas pa gso bar byed pa ni/ /de dag rab 'phrul lha yi pho brang dag dang ni/ /rtsub 'gyur dang ni 'dres pa'i tshal yang mthong 'gyur te/ /lha rnams du mas rtag tu mdun du bdar bar 'gyur/ /mi yi gtso bor gyur cing lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /thub pa chen po 'di 'dra'i gsung ni thob gyur na/ /rgas shing dbang bo shin tu nyam chung gyur pa yi/ /pha ma sbyin gnas dam pa su zhig gso mi byed/ /rgyal po chen po gzhan yang skyes bu dam pa ma yin na/ /skyes bu dam pa ma yin pa'i las byed cing /log par lta ba la mngon par zhen pa yin te/ de ni dge ba dang mi dge ba gang yin zhes bdag gi don mi shes shing mi brtan pa yin pas/ skye bo mang po rnams mi dga' zhing / byis pa'i skye bos bsngags pa la mngon bar dga' ba dang / 'dod chags dang zhe sdang gis rmongs par gyur pa dang / skyes bu mdzangs pa dag gis smad pa dang / khro bas zil gyis non cing /sdig pa'i las byed pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis yongs su spangs pa dang / longs spyod kyi 127

rgyags pas myos pa dang / ser sna can du gyur pa dang / gzhan la gnod par mngon par dga' zhing / chos ma goms pas mi dga' ba yin te/ rgyal po chen po skyes bu dam pa ma yin pa/skyes bu dam pa ma yin pa'i las la dga' zhing / skyes bu dam pa'i las la mi dga' ba de dag la ltos/ rgyal po chen po 'dod pa rnams bsten cing ngan 'gror 'gro bar 'jug pa de ni/ skyes pa'i skyes bu'i skyon gsum pa yin no/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /'dod pa rnams kyi gzhis ni skyes bu rnams nyams shing / /gzhi de las ni sdig pa dag kyang rab tu byed/ /log par lta bas rmongs na 'dir ni 'khyams 'gyur zhing / /de ni rnam par 'khrul pas ngan 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur/ /log dang ldan pas yon tan kun gyes rnam spangs shing / /de ni rtog pa med cing blo ni nor ba yin/ /gang dag chu klung dag tu ut+pal rtsa 'tshol ltar/ /log par lta bas yongs su 'khor bar byed pa yin/ /bde ba'i don du bdag nyid yongs su skyong byed cing / /chos ma yin la chags pa'i mi rnams mang po dag /de bzhin bde bar rgyu phyir 'dod pa rnams 'tshol ba/ /de dag gti mug rmongs pas sems can dmyal bar 'gro/ /gang dag 'dod pa rnams kyi don du rtag tu 128

ni/ /de bzhin sems la bcag pa'i skyes bu tha ma dang / /'dod pa'i bdag nyid can dang skye bo sdig can dang / /'du shes log pa dag la bde ba ga la yod/ /mi rnams de dag byas pa mi gzo sdig bcas shing / /dad pa rnams nyams tshul 'chos gus pa med pa dang / /'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rtag tu rnam par spangs pas na/ /dmyal bar bzod blags shin tu 'jigs su rung ba dang / /gzugs dang sgra dang ro la chags pa'i mi rnams ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang mkhas pa mi mchod cing / /log par lta bas chos kyang nyan par mi byed la/ /lan 'ga' 'ang dge 'dun legs par mchod par mi byed pas/ /'phags pa rnams kyis rnam spangs ngan song ltung bas na/ /de phyir mi yi srid pa 'di ni rnyed pa na/ /sbyin dul yang dag sgom la nges par bsten cig dang / /de las byang chub dam pa mchog kyang thob par 'gyur/ /rgyal po chen po skyes bu ni bzo'i gnas sna tshogs dang / las kyi mtha' sna tshogs dag gis 'tsho bar byed de/ rgyal po chen po 'di ltar yi ge'am/ rtsis sam/ grangs sam/ lag rtsis sam/ mtshon cha'am/ rgyal po chen po zho shas 'tsho ba'am/ zhing las sam/ tshong byed pa'am/ ba lang 'tsho ba'am/ de lta bu'i bzo'i gnas sna tshogs dang / las kyi gnas 129

sna tshogs dag gis 'tsho bar byed cing / 'di lta ste/ nor gyi phyir lam ma yin par yang 'gro bar byed/ lam ngan par yang 'gro bar byed/ gcong rong du chu bur can gye lam du yang 'gro bar byed/ mtshon cha'i lam du yang 'gro bar byed/ rgya mtsho 'jigs par yang 'jug par byed cing / grang ba'i dus na yang lhags pas gnod par byed/ dro ba'i dus na yang tsha bas gnod par byed/ bkres pa dang skom pa dag gis gnod bzhin du 'gro ba la yang spro bar byed/ longs spyod yongs su tshol ba la de lta bu'i sdug bsngal dag gis longs spyod yongs su btsal nas kyang / rang gi 'tsho ba dag gi phyir nye bar sgrub par byed pas/ dge sbyong dang bram ze dag dang / bkres pa dang / sdug phongs dang / slong mo pa dag la sbyin pa byen par mi bzod cing / bud med rnams kyis dbang du byas pa dang / bud med rnams kyi thul 'og tu chud pa dang / bud med rnams kyis bskol ba dang / bud med rnams la byams pa de nyid kyis/bud med de dag nyid gso ba'i phyir sbyin pa byin pa dang / tshul khrims yang dag pa len par mi nus shing / da de la chags la bud med kyis spyod pa bzod par byed cing / bud med kyis bsdigs pa dang / bltas pa dang / rgyab pa dag kyang bzod 130

par byed de/ de skyes par gyur kyang / bud med kyis bsdigs pa dang du len cing / mi dga' ba med par de'i ngor blta bar byed pa ni/ 'dod pa'i gzhis bud med kyi dbang du song ba yin te/ rgyal po chen po bud med la bsten cing / ngan 'gror 'gro bar 'jug pa des na/ skyes pa bud med la brkam zhing ngan skyugs kyi sgo la 'du ba dang / mi gtsang ba la dga' ba dang / shes bzhin med par spyod pa'i skyes pa'i skyes bu'i skyon bzhi pa yin te/ rgyal po chen po skyon de dag dang ldan pa'i skyes pa ni/ 'dod pa rnams kyi dbang du 'gro ba yin no/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /'dod pa rnams ni 'tshol ba na/ /rab tu myos pa ga la bde/ /'dod pa dman pa rnams bsten pa/ /de ni gang gis bde bar 'gyur/ /skyes bu dam pa ma yin pa'i/ /las rnams byed cing mi sngon la/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags tshol byed pa/ /de dag rab nyams chud kyang za/ /mi rnams gang dag mi mkhas pa/ /rnga mong bong bu'i chos spyod cing / /bud med mthong nas rab snyeg pa/ /ngan skyugs gnas la phag rnams bzhin/ /gang la byams pa gus bcas pa'i/ /'dod rnams dri nga mi gtsang yang / /'dod pa'i skyon rnams mi mthong ba sa yi 131

steng na dmus long bzhin/ /gzugs kyi 'ching bas bcings pa rnams/ /'dod pa'i 'du shes rab tu 'jug /byis pa'i 'dod rnams bsten pa dag /khyi dang wa rnams ji bzhin no/ /sgra dri ro dang reg rnams kyis/ gang la so so'i skye bo rnams/ /byes pa 'khor bar yongs 'khor ba/ /spre'u phur la btags pa bzhin/ /byes pa ma rig khebs pa rnams/ /mun pa'i phung bos bsgribs gyur cing / /bud med rnams la chags pa ni/ /mi gtsang gnas la khwa bzhin no/ /gang gis ngan 'gror rab 'jug pa/ /de ni bdud kyi spyod yul yin/ /ro myang 'du shes chags gyur pa/ /ngan skyugs gnas la srin bu bzhin/ /gsod pa'i gshed ma rnams kyis ni/ /ji ltar mi zhig bor ba ltar/ /shes na thar ba thob 'gyur zhing / /bud med dbang du 'gro mi 'gyur/ /'dod pa bud med blta byed pa'i/ /kun tu sbyor la 'jigs pa skye/ /byis pa mtshan mar 'dzin pa rnams/ /'dod pa'i sred pa rab tu 'phel/ /sos ga'i dus na mi zhig ni/ /dgon pa chen por song gyur nas/ /byes pas lan tshwa 'thung ba bzhin/ /skom pa'aphel zhing rab skyo ltar/ /de bzhin bden pa ma mthong ba'i/ /byes pa rmongs pa'i 'tsho ba rnams/ /'di na phyir zhing bud med la/ /'dod pa'i sred pa brtan par 132

'gyur/ /ji ltar mi lus mdze can la/ /srog chags rnams ni za ba ltar/ /'dod brkam so so'i skye bo rnams/ /de bzhin bud med rnams kyis zos/ /mi gtsang bum pa khra bo bzhin/ /kha dog ldan par snang mod kyi/ /nang na ha la ha la'i dug /drag po chen bo yod pa ltar/ /de phyir bud med brgyan pa dag /gang dang gang na snang ba yang / /gcin dang phyi sas gang ba yin/ /rkyal ba rlung gis bkang ba bzhin/ /'bru mar gyis ni bdar ba'i mtshon/ /gos kyis dkris pa ji bzhin du/ /de bzhin bud med brgyan pa yang / ral gri klong ba g.yogs pa bzhin/ /ji ltar me dong gang gyur la/ /du ba med cing 'bar ldan ltar/ /bud med de bzhin me 'dra zhing / /srin bu gtum po bzhin du g.yo/ /zhes dang / 'dod pa dman pa rnams bsten cing / /dman pa'i chos rnams bsten nas ni/ /nyes pa'i las rnams byed pa dag /de yis ngan 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur/ /shes rab 'chal ba mnar med par/ /song nas sdug bsngal tshor ba myong / /sangs rgyas rnams kyis bud med dag /phyi sa'i dri ltar mnam par bsgrags/ /de phyir dman pa rnams dang ni/ /dman pa'i bud med rnams bsten pa/ /byes pa de ni phyi sa yi/ /rkyal ba bzung nas gnas pa yin/ /ji 'dra'i las ni byed pa 133

ltar/ /de 'dra'i 'bras bu thob 'gyur te/ /rgyal po yi ni chad pa dang / /sdug bsngal bcings pa'ang myong bar 'gyur/ /bud med gzhi las skyes pa yang / /bsad dang bcings pa myong 'gyur zhing / /dmyal srung rnams kyis bsreg pa dang / /nges par 'chi'ang myong bar 'gyur/ /bud med rnams la brkam pa yi/ /blo ngan de dag bde mi 'gyur/ /gsal shing mthon po rnams su ni/ /btsugs shing chur yang bcug par 'gyur/ /sa yi ser khar bcug nas ni/ /de bzhin ral gris gdab bar 'gyur/ /de 'dra ba dag thos nas ni/ /de dag yid chad bde mi 'gyur/ /rmongs pa bud med lhan cig tu/ /yang dang yang du 'du 'dzi byed/ /sdug bsngal 'dod pa rnams bsten cing / /dman pa rnams kyang smra bar byed/ /rmongs pa rnams kyis chos thob nas/ /dge ba gsungs shes brjod byed kyang / /de sems bud med phyi bzhin song / /bye ba la ni bye la bzhin/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa thos gyur nas/ /yud tsam zhig ni yid byung yang / /ha la ha la'i dug 'dra ba'i/ / 'dod chags kyis ni de yang 'khrug /ji ltar phag ni yud tsam zhig /sngangs shing skrag pa byung gyur kyang / /des ni phyi sa mthong ba na/ /chags pa bskyed pa byed pa ltar/ /de bzhin byis pa bde 'dod rnams/ /rgyal 134

ba'i bstan pa spangs nas ni/ /'dod pa dman pa rnams bsten pas/ /des ni ngan 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'dod pa rnams la chags pyos nas/ /shin tu sdig pa'i las byas shing / /tshul khrims can dag bslu byas nas/ /phyis ni ngan 'gror 'gro bar 'gyur/ /shes rab can gyis dal rnyed cing / /de 'dra'i chos ni thos gyur nas/ /'dod kun spangs nas 'di la ni/ /mkhas pa mngon par rab byung zhig /ces gsungs/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi nyan thos ma btsun mo sngo sangs can gyis kyang / rgyal po 'char byed la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ gang zhig lo tog smin pa la/ /ser ltar yang dag ji bzhin mkhyen/ /bud med rnams kyis gnod med pa/ /de yi bstan la bdag dga' lags/ /'jig rten mgon po thams cad kyis/ /bud med rnams ni smad par gsungs/ /bud med rnams la mi blta ba/ /'jig rten mgon po rnams kyis bsngags/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang rang sangs rgyas/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos rnams/ /bud med bsten par mi mdzad de/ /de ni byes pa'i spyod yul lags/ /bud med rnams la bsten pa ni/ /kun nas bdud kyi zhags par gsungs/ /sdug pa rnams la chags pa ni/ /rku 'phrog dkrugs pa'i shul dang 'dra/ /mi rnams bud 135

med chags pa dang / /sdig pa'i las ni bgyid pa dang / /ye shes spong bar 'tshal ba yi/ /sems can rnams ni ngan 'gror 'khrid/ /mkhas pa thar ba 'tshal ba yis/ /bud med bsten par mi bgyi ste/ /zhugs bltams du ba mchis pa yi/ /dong du mchongs par mi dong lags/ /yid 'ong bka' mchid brgyas pa dang / /bltas pas kyang ni 'ching bgyid cing / /mi bzad dmyal bar ltung bas na/ /khyod ni bud med tshig ma gsan/ /zhes smras pas/ rgyal po yang sangs rgyas la dad de/ mdun du song nas chos zhus pas/ sangs rgyas kyis bud med bsten pa'i nyes dmigs sngar gye de rnams gsungs pas/ rgyal po 'char byed snang ba 'gyur nas/ dge bsnyen mdzad nas/ chos bzhin byas par gsungs/ mdo dran pa nyer bzhag las/ mi tshangs spyod kyi nyes dmigs rgyas par gsungs pa rnams mdor bsdus te bshad na/ 'di lta ste/ 'dod pas log par g.yem pa kun tu bsten cing bsgoms te mang du byas pa dang / las kyi nyer bsdogs dang / las kyi mjug dang / las mngon par bsten cing bsgoms te mang du byas pas/ sems can dmyal ba bsdus 'joms su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na/ shing ljon pa'i khrod du bya rgod kyis bzung nas rgyu ma za bar byed do/ /chu bo phur 136

bus gang bar bcug nas gshin rjes ral gris gsod par byed do/ /phur bus 'big cing gshin rje dag gis bzung nas/phan tshun du khyer tshe ngu zhing / zangs dmar po bskol zhing bzhus pas lus bsreg phur bus gang ba'i chu bo der sgol/nang lus bsreg kha cig nang du nub/ kha cig chu 'gram du byung /kha cig bya rgod kyis za'o/ /kha cig lus zhu'o/ /kha cig ni rdo bas dum bu brgya stong du rlog go /kha cig ni ba tshwas sreg pa na zhu'o/ /kha cig phra skam 'bar bas bzung nas mtshon gyis gsod do/ /kha cig ni lus rgyangs nas gsod/ kha cig kha bub tu bzhag nas gsod/ kha cig bum pa'i nang du 'jug par byed/kha cig bum pa'i nang du bcug nas btso/ kha cig bya rgod khwa ta dang wa khyi dag gis bzung nas za'o/ /de nas rgyug cing ngu ba na gshin rje rnams kyis gtun shing 'bar bas bsnun cing / shing dang / brag gseb/ sman ljongs/ phu chu'i gseb dang / ri gseb tu bcug nas gnod pa sna tshogs byed de/ de yang shing ljon pa mtho ba'i khar khrid nas sa gzhi phur bu btsugs pa'i steng du 'bab par byed cing der yan lag brgya stong du 'gyur/ yang bzung nas lo ma ral gri'i tshal du bcug nas 'dab ma spu gri ltar rno bas btsir/ las kyi dbang gis shing ljon steng na bud 137

med mdzes mas bos ba'i snang ba shar nas chags pas shing de la 'dzegs pa na/ lo ma ral gri lta bu dag gis sha rus rkang bar du gsheg par byed/ yang bud med mdzes ma des steng na gnas nas/ blta zhing 'dzum la khyod kyi slad du mo 'dir mchis na/ cis phyir bdag gi lus dang mi mjal byas pas 'dod chags kyi dbang gis shing lo ma ral gri lta bu de las mar 'bab/ babs tshe lo ma spu gri lta bu de dag kha gyen du lta ste/ sha rus gcod cing rkang yang brus te shin tu gnod pa bya sa so byas kyang da dung bud med la blta'o/ /bltas pa na bya rgod kyi mchu rnon pos mig 'byen cing/ rna ba gcod ngu ba na 'dab ma rnon pas lce gcod cing sna'ang gcod do/ /de'i yan lag dang nying lag thams cad gcod do/ /sa la babs pa dang bud med de shing khar 'dzegs pa dang / de mthong nas shing der 'dzegs nas sngar ltar sdug bsngal myong ngo / /yang ri bya rgod dang nye ba yod de/ ri de la 'dzeg pa dang bya rgod lcags kyi mchu can dag gis klad pa brtol zhing klad rgya brus mig kyang 'byin mgo yang 'dor bar byed/ klad rgya mig phyungs pa de dag dmyal ba mun pa 'thibs pa'i nang du brgyugs pa dang / yang bya rgod lus che zhing lto ba'i nang na me mdag yod pa 'ong ste bzung nas za'o/ /138
