de'i lto ba'i nang du song ba de dag lo 'bum phrag du mar bsreg go /de nas yul chu bo mtha' yas pha rol zhes bya ba zangs bskol cing bzhus pa'i chu chen po'i pha rol na/ bza' btung gnas mal nags tshal yod par mthong nas rgyugs pas/ chu bo rab med der lhung nas kha cig zhu'o/ /kha cig khwa'i mchu 'bar bas za'o/ /kha cig nya'i kha 'bar bas mid de yan lag nying lag zhu ba de dag thams cad chu bor der zhu bar gyur to/ /mir sgyes na de tshe thung zhing dbul la chung ma ngan pa dang / de gzhan gyi chung ma la rab tu chags par 'gyur ba'am/ de chung ma med par 'gyur la brnyas shing gzhan gyis bkol bar 'gyur ro/ /bud med 'os pa ma yin pa la tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i 'dod pas log par g.yem pa bsten pa de ni sems can dmyal ba tshor ba med par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na gsal shing 'bar bas ro smad 'bigs shing / de nas rgyab mdun dpung dang yan lag nying lag thams cad 'bigs par byed cing bsregs/ lcags kyi phra skam 'bar bas chag pa 'byen cing bya rgod kyis bzung nas za'o/ /mir skyes na de ma ning du 'gyur ro/ /bud med 'os pa ma yin pa'i khar bcug na de shi nas dmyal ba a la bud lta bur gcod par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /139

der skyes na gshin rje rnams kyis de'i khar phur bu bcug nas brdungs pas ltag par phug nas bsgul bas rna bar 'byung ngo / /lcags snod du zangs bskol ba khar blug pas kha rkan mid pa lto ba bsreg nas smad nas 'byung ngo / /mir skyes na las de dang rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu de'i kha nas dri rul ba lta bu 'byung ste/ srog chags gang gis tshor ba kun yid 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bud med gzhan 'dod chags mi 'dod pa de'i mngal ma yin par mthus bcug na/ de shi nas dmyal ba gnad gcod che bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na dza ra dza ra nyis 'gyur du byas pa bsreg pa rab tu 'bar ba de dag gis kha 'gengs/ji srid sdig pa'i las ma zad bar du lo 'bum phrag du mar ngu 'bod byed do/ /mir skyes na de'i chung ma gzhan dag la rab tu chags par 'gyur ba bzlog par mi nus te/ byas la bsags pa'i las kyi rnam par smin pa ni tshor ba ma myong gi bar du chud za bar mi 'gyur ro/ /byes pa gzhan ngu bzhin du mthus sba ba'i gnas su bcug pa ni de shi nas dmyal ba 'jigs par lta bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na sngon bu gang yin pa de mthong ste/ nga'i bu yin snyam pa'i sred pa 'byung ngo / /de nas bu de la gshin rje rnams kyis phur bus 'debs shing / der sba ba'i 140

gnas su phur bu btab pa mthong nas sems la sdug bsngal gyi gnod pa skye bar 'gyur te/ de nas lus la sdug bsngal 'di dag 'byung ste/ gshin rje mi dag gis kha sbub tu bzhag nas/lcags snod du zangs bzhus pa 'bar ba/ de'i sba ba'i gnas su blug go /blugs nas sba ba'i gnas long ga sreg go /long ga nas rgyu ma snying mtsher glo ba ol kong mid pa lce rkan klad rgyas par bsregs nas 'og tu byung nas 'gro'o/ /mir skyes na khu chu nyams par 'gyur zhing bu me da par 'gyur la de ma ning zhes bya ste skye bo kun gyis smad par 'gyur ro/ /rang gang la chags pa'i bud med yin bsam nas phyugs rmig zlum po gcig gi mngal du bcug na/ de shi nas dmyal ba 'khums par sgye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na ba'am rta rgod ma mthong ngo / /de chags pas ba'am rta rgod ma de la bsnyegs pas de dag gi khong ba'i nang lcags kyi me mdag 'bar bas gang ste/ de dang 'phrad nas tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i las byed pa'i de'i khong ba'i nang me mdag gis gang ba der 'jug par 'gyur te/ khong ba mun pa der lo 'bum phrag du mar bsreg cing 'tshod de ngu bar yang mi nus so/ /mir skyes na gang du rang gi chung ma yin na gzhan dag la 'dod pa'i log par g.yem pa rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu des 141

yul de lta bur skye bar 'gyur ro/ / skye ba gang zhig skye ba la 'jug par byed na de shi nas dmyal ba nyam nga ba mang bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na skye ba de nyid mthong ste skra 'bar zhing lus kun rab tu 'bar la rdo rje ltar sra ba des bzung ban yan lag nying lag thams cad la gnod byed do/ /shi yang 'tsho bar 'gyur te/ skye ba rab tu 'bar ba des 'jigs shing zhum par byed do/ /des ngam grog mthong ste/ de'i nang du lhung ngo / /de nam mkha' la gnas dang / de'i khwa mchu rab tu 'bar ba dag 'ong nas dum bur gcod do/ /de sa la lhung ba dang wa kha 'bar ba dag 'ong nas za bar byed do/ /gal te de'i rus pa dag zad par btogs kyang skye bar 'gyur ro/ /skyes pa dang gshin rje mi dag gis lcags kyi rdza ma rab tu 'bar ba dag gi nang du 'tshod do/ /ji srid sdig pa ma zad bar du lo 'bum phrag du mar 'tshod cing za la phye mar brlag go /mir skyes na des chung ma du ma chud za zhing chung ma gcig kyang mi 'grub la kun mi gzhan gyi drung du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan gyis bud med thob nas skye ba mang po dag la byen zhing bdag nyid kyang mngal lam mngal ma yin par 'jug na/ de shi nas dmyal ba gnod pa mi zad par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na gshin rje mi rnams 142

kyis rkang ba gyen du shing khar btegs shing de gyen du btags pa la mes sreg ste/ kha sogs lus kun sreg cing de'i tshe de'i mig phyungs shing skyes pa dag sreg go /nyam thag nas 'bod cing ngu skad 'byen la ngu zhing khro'o/ /skad 'byen tshe kha la me bcug ste glo 'tsher pho ba long ga 'doms dang gzhang sreg nas rkang ba'i bar du bsregs so/ /de sreg pa na nyam thag pa'i tshor ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i khwa de dag 'ong nas de'i lus la za bar byed do/ /mir skyes na de'i chung ma dga' zhing lta na sdug pa'ang gzhan gyis 'phrog pa dnge / chung ma de'i phyir 'jig rten 'di dang pha rol tu'ang 'o dod 'bod cing ngu bar byed la yongs su gdung bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /bud med gzhan ma rnyed par lug ma mo'am bong mo la 'jug par byed pa de dmyal ba a tsha zer bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na lcags kyis grog sbur chen po dag gis yan yag dang nying lag thams cad za bar byed do/ /sems can dmyal ba de dag gi lto ba'ang mes gang bar 'gyur te phyi nang sreg cing za'o/ /de nas yang skyes tshe srin bu dag gis sha zos khrag 'thung rgyus pa gcod rus pa 'cha' rkang 'jib rgyu ma dang gnye ma dag la za bar byed do/ /des za ba na 'o dod 'bod cing ngu la cho nge 'debs shing snying rje skad 143

du smre sngags 'don to/ /mir skyes na de la 'gran zla mang zhing /rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor du de'i 'grub pa med par 'gyur/dbul zhing nor rdzas thams cad nyams par 'gyur la tshe thung bar 'gyur ro/ /sring mo'am gzhan 'os pa ma yin pa de lta bu dag la spyod par byed na/ de shi nas dmyal ba kye hu da zer bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na de na lcags kyi ri rab tu 'bar ba kha spungs pa zhes bya ba gnam la thug pa zhig yod/ de la lcags kyi shing chen po dang lcags kyi khwa 'bar ba dag gis gang ste/ ri de rab tu 'bar la me lce gcig tu gyur cing me rgyun mi 'chad du 'bar ba las dbang gi ri de pad+ma'i tshal gyis khebs pa/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma de dag 'od 'phro bar mthong ngo / /gshin rje dag gis brdegs pa na der rgyug go /ri de la 'dzeg pa dang mes sreg cing khwa rab tu 'bar ba'i mchu rnon po des lus kyi cha so so nas za bar byed do/ /de nas yang skye bar 'gyur te sgyes nas sngar bzhin sdug bsngal yun ring myong bar 'gyur ro/ /mir skyes na de'i yan lag dang nying lag thams cad la dri rul ba 'byung zhing / mdze 'am de la sha bkra 'gran zla mang zhing phal che la dbul ba dang yul ngan par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong ma tshul khrims ral cing spyod pa ngan pa la mi tshangs spyad na de 144

shi nas dmyal ba mchi ma'i rgyun me lta bur skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na rab tu 'bar ba'i mes sreg pa na mchi ma gang byung ba de dag me'i mchi mar 'byung ste de dag gis lus sreg cing sdug myong bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang mig gi nang du seng ldeng mdag mes 'gengs shing rus brdung so sor byed la lcags kyi phur bu dang gtun shing dang mda' bo che rnams kyis lus gcod cing 'bigs la dum bur rlog go /phra skam rab tu 'bar bas gzhang gdangs pa'i nang du zha nye bskol bas bkang ste sreg la/ phyi rol me shin tu 'bar bas rab tu bsregs nas shin tu tsha zhing mi bzod pa rnam pa du ma myong ngo / /mir skyes na de skran can du 'gyur zhing skam po'am byad ngan pa'am sko ba'am lus tshal shing bsregs pa lta bur 'gyur ro/ /bud med kyi skye gnas ma yin pa kha 'am/ rkub tu lan cig 'dod pas log par kun tu bsten na/ de shi nas dmyal ba dbang po thams cad kun 'gag pa zhes bya bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na kha mes 'gengs shing lcags snod du zangs dmar po bzhus pa blugs nas brdzangs la/ 'og nas kyang srog chags ma ko ta ga'i mchur rab tu 'bar bas za'o me 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba bcu gcig gis bskor ba'i dbus na gdungs shing 145

sreg ste/ yang sos shing yang sreg go /grog sbur dag gis mig za/ zha nyes rna ba gang / ral gris sna bcad/ spu gris lce bcad/spu gri'i char gyis lus kun gsheg ste dbang bo thams cad sdug bsngal chen po myong ngo / /mir skyes na de'i chung ma sdom pa med par 'gyur la chung mas chom rkun pa dag gnyer nas gsod par byed/ de bzhin du rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor du g.yo thabs dang sbyar nas gsod par byed/ dug gis gsod par byed cing / gnyid log dang mtshon gyis gsod par 'gyur ro/ /'dod chags kyi sems kyis bud med 'os pa ma yin pa rjes su dran nas/ lag pas 'dod pa'i log par g.yem pa byas na de shi nas dmyal ba tshor ba mtha' med par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na me'i tshor ba dang / mtshon gyi tshor ba dang / ba tshwa'i tshor ba dang / nad kyi tshor ba ste/ tshor ba de dag yun ring myong ngo / /mir skyes na/ de dbul por 'gyur zhing / ri brag dang dgon pa dang 'jigs pa dang / ri brag sa dag gi g.yog bran du 'gyur nad rnams kyis rtag tu na bar 'gyur ro/ /dge sbyong du dam bcas pa gang zhig sngon gyi 'dod pa dag la sems gtong zhing ro myang bar byed la yid la byed/ tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pas ro myang bar byas pas mtshan mo nyal ba 146

na de'i rmi lam du bud med de nyid dang lhan cig 'khrig par byed do/ /sad nas kyang mi tshangs par spyod pa rmi lam du rmis pa de nyid kyi ro myang bar byed cing yang yid la byed rjes su yi ring zhing gzhan dag la yon tan 'dzin la de dang lhan cig goms par byed/ mang du byed cing de dang de nyid la dga' bar byed na/ de shi nas dmyal ba pad+ma ltar gas par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na bum pa dag gi nang du 'tshod cing lcags kyi bre bo che'i nang du lcags kyi gtun shing rnams kyis 'tshog go /de dag las thar nas mtsho chen po'i nang na pad+ma'i sdong po skyes pa mthong nas/ der song ba dang lam du phur bu btsugs pa dag gis rkang ba la phug go /rkang ba nyams pa de kha sbub tu lhung bas phur bu zug pas gan rkyal dang g.yas g.yon du 'gyel na phur bu zug 'dug na yang 'og nas phur bu zug tshe skad 'byin cing ngu'o/ /pad+ma de la lta zhing 'khod pa na rgyab nas gshin rje dag gis ral gri dgra sta mda' bo che mdung rnams kyis 'debs te/ 'ga' zhig pad+ma'i drung du phyin nas de la 'dzeg pa dang / pad+ma de yang seng ldeng gi me'i mdag ma lta bus gang zhing rdo rje ltar sra ba'i lo ma la 'dzeg ste/ de'ang kha zum par 'gyur ro/ /mir skyes na de mig yon du 'gyur 147

tshul khrims 'chal cing dbul la tshe thung bar 'gyur ro/ /dge sbyong du dam bcas pa kha cig gis tshangs spyod bsrung kyang /chags pa'i dbang gis tshangs par spyad pa'i dge ba 'dis lha'i 'jig rten du skyes nas lha mos yongs su bskor bar gyur cig ces log par bsngos na/ de shi nas dmyal ba pad+ma chen po ltar gas par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na ba tshwa'i chu bo'i rlabs zhes bya ba'i ba tshwa'i chu chen por zhugs pa dang / tshor ba shin tu tsha ba rtsub pa mi bzod par dka' ba dag myong ste/des rus pa rdo/ sgra nya lcibs/ sha 'dam du gyur/ ro nye skol ba chur gyur/ der skye ba rnams nyar gyur te/ chu bo des kha sa bub tu ded cing bskol to/ /'gram du chags na khwa mchu rab tu 'bar ba rnams kyis za'o/ /de nas bros kyang gshin rje rnams kyis lcags mdung gis btabs nas chu bo'i nang du 'jug steng du byung na/ rkang ba brla'i sbubs rgyab kyi sha dag 'tshod par byed/ mgul ba'i sha'ang chad par 'gyur/ rus pa'ang bskol bar 'gyur/ mgo'i sha chad cing thod pa'ang chad par 'gyur te/ de ltar lo 'bum phrag du mar bsreg cing bskol la 'tshod do/ /chu bo de las thar nas mtsho me tog dang bad+ma sngon po mthong ste/ der song bas pad+ma'i tshal de dag 148

lcags kyi pad+ma reg na spu gri ltar gsheg gcod za zhing rdungs par byed do/ /gshin rje rnams kyis gtses pa dag pad+ma de la 'dzeg pas/ pad+ma'i nang me mdag gis gang bas bsreg cing lo ma lcags las byas pa dag gis 'chum par byed/ khwa rnams kyis za zhing lce gcod rna ba 'bigs/ lus rnams zad par byed do/ /mir skyes na de dmu rdzing can du 'gyur zhing rtag tu bkres pa dang skom pas gdung la khro bar yang 'gyur ro/ /dge sbyong du dam bcas pa des sngon gye khyim na gnas pa'i bud med dag dang lhan cig rgod cing rtses pa dag de'i tshe tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa dran zhing yang dang yang du dran pa nyid du byed la de la chags shing yongs su rtog par byed/yang sems par byed cing dge ba'i chos la sems par mi byed la chos mi sgrub gnas mal na ba'i gsos sman sogs 'os pa ma yin pa'i yo byad mang bo 'chang ba de ni shi nas dmyal ba me thab tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na me thab kyi me 'bar bas bsregs te skad 'byen tshe kha mes 'geng ngo / /rna bar me 'bar ba 'jug snar yang me 'bar ba 'jug lus kun nas me 'bar bas ngu skad 'byin smre sngags 'don to/ /tshul khrims med pas bsod snyems zos pa la/ de'i lce lcags rab tu 'bar 149

ba'i mes sreg go /tshul khrims can gyis tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pas bud med la bltas nas mthong na de'i mig bsreg par 'gyur ro/ /chags pa'i sems kyis bud med mdzes ma gzhan dang rgod cing glu dbyangs len pa'i sgra 'byin pa dag la nyan nas thos na de'i rna bar ro nye rab tu bskol bas 'gengs par 'gyur ro/ /tshul 'chal gyi dge 'dun rnams kyis bdug spos bzung bas sna bcad cing bsreg par 'gyur te/ de ltar tshul khrims med pa'i dbang po lnga la las dang mtshungs pa'i chad pa drag po 'byung ngo / /mir skyes na de byad lag ngan cing long ba dang zha zhing dbul bar 'gyur la/dar la babs pa nyid kyi tshe 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /dge sbyong du dam bcas pa gang gis mi'i gar dang glu dbyangs dang rgyan dag gi sgra thos nas/ tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pa g.yeng ba'i blos dgod pa dang / sgeg dang / rtses pa de thos nas khu ba byung la/ byung nas kyang ro myang bar byed cing bsags na de shi nas dmyal ba lcags kyi me mdag tu skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na lcags kyi ra ba gru bzhi bas bskor ba'i nang du bcug nas mes sreg cing me char lcags kyi char rgyun mi 'chad du 'bab bo/ /lcags kyi char bas yan lag nying lag 150

thams cad phye mar rlog cing / me mdag gi char bas gdungs shing sreg go /mir skyes na de rtag tu chu bo chen po'i mnyan par 'gyur/ rtag tu 'jigs pa dang / nad bu can du 'gyur/glang po che'i sos 'tshe ste stag tu 'chi bas nyen par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa la sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ /rgya cher rol ba las ji ltar mi mkhas mi zhig ni/ /dri nga gla rtsi'i bum pa la/ /phyi rol ri mo bris pa zhig /mgo la khyer te song ba las/ /'gro ba de yi de yang ni/ /de las lhung de chags gyur nas/ /dri nga gla rtsi mthong gyur te/ /chags pa med cing 'bros pa ltar/ /de bzhin byis pa mi mkhas pa/ /bud med rnams la yid zhen cing / /kha dog gzugs dang dbyibs rnams la/ /brtags nas de la chags par byed/ /lus kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa/ /de la khye'u khyod rab rtogs shig /dur khrod rul ba'i dri la ni/ /mkhas pa su zhig chags par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / 'dod pa'i skyon ni bdag gis mtha' yas rig /'thab mo 'khon ces mya ngan sdug bsngal rtsa/ /'jigs byed dug gi lo ma 'dra ba ste/ /me dang 'dra zhing ral gri so dang 'dra/ /'dod pa'i yon tan bdag 'dod ma yin te/ /bdag ni bud med tshogs dang mdzes ma yin/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin bde bas zhi sems su/ /bdag ni mi 151

smra nags tshal gnas par bya/ /gsungs/ dran pa nyer bzhag las/ gtsug lag khang dang kun dgar brtson/ /chos kyi spyod tshul dga' med cing / /bud med chang la chags pa'i blo/ /de lta bu ni dge slong min/ /zhes dang / gang zhig rnyed dang bkur bsti dang / /gang zhig yul sdug sems byed la/ /bud med lta zhing de 'dod pa/ /dge min khyem min g.yon can yin/ /zhes dang / ri mor bris pa'i bud med la/ /mig gis lta bar mi byed do/ /'jig rten 'dod pa dam bcom pa/ /de lta bu ni grol zhes bya/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang / gang zhig bud med dbang song ba/ /mi ni ngan par byas pa ste/ /de ni dmyal ba 'dir 'gro ste/ /khyod kyi de yi rjes su myong / /zhes dang / bud med ngan song gzhi yin zhing / /kun nas nor ni zad par byed/ /mi gang bud med tshig nyan pa/ /de la bde ba ga la yod/ /don med chos la dga' ba ni/ /bud med g.yo dang phra ga dog mang / /'jig rten gnyis ni rnam 'jigs pa/ /skye ba rnams kyi mdun na gnas/ /de tshig shin tu mi brtan te/ /rtag tu 'dod chags bskyed la mkhas/ /de yi snying ni gzhan sems la/ /gzhan gyi tshul gyis smra bar byed/ /dang por gnyen zhing srung byed la/ /phyi nas sems ni rdo rje 'dra/ /sems ni yang la phan pa med/ /152

bkur bste dag ni dran mi byed/ /legs pa brgya ni chud zon la/ /mi legs gcig pu dran par byed/ /sdig pa'i sa gzhi bud med yin/ /snying ni glog gi ngo bo bzhin/ /skyes pa chags pa'i sems yod pa/ /'jigs pa'i rgyu ni bud med byed/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol tu/ /'jigs byed nang na bud med 'jigs/ /gal te bde ba mchog 'dod na/ /de ltar bud med rnam par spongs/ /bud med rtag tu spangs pa ni/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol bde/ /gang zhig dbul ba spong 'dod cing / /gang zhig bdag ni 'byor 'dod dang / /gang zhig mya ngan 'da' 'gro 'dod/ /mi des bud med spangs par byos/ /zhes dang / rin chen 'phreng ba las/ bud med chags pa phal cher ni/ /bud med gzugs bzang sems las byung / /bud med lus la don du ni/ /gtsang ba cung zad yod ma yin/ /kha ni kha chu rul ba dang / /so skyag mi gtsang snod yin te/ /sna ni snag snabs sna chu'i snod/ /mig ni mig rdul mchi ma'i snod/ /lto ba'i khong ni bshang gci dang / /glo ba mchin sogs snod yin par/ /rmongs pas bud med ma mthong ba/ /de yi lus la chags par byed/ /mi shes 'ga' zhig mi gtsang ba'i/ /bum pa rgyan la chags pa ltar/ /'jig rten mi shes rmongs pa yis/ /bud med 153

rnams la de bzhin no/ /lus yul shin tu dri nga ba/ /chags bral rgyu ni gang yin pa/ /de la 'jig rten ches chags na/ gang gis 'dod chags bral bar bkri/ /ji ltar bshang dang gci gzhi la/ /ngan skyugs phag rab chags pa ltar/ /de bzhin bshang dang gci gzhi la/ /'dod ldan ngan sgyugs phag rnams chags/ /lus kyi grong khyer mi gtsang ba/ /'byung ba'i bu ga 'dod pa gang / /de ni skye bo blun po yis/ /dga' ba'i don du nye bar brtag /khyod bdag nyid kyis bshang gci sogs/ /so sor mi gtsang mthong nas ni/ /de 'dus lus la ji lta bur/ /yid du 'ong ba nyid du 'gyur/ /khrag dang khu ba 'dres pa yi/ /sa bon mi gtsang snying bos skyed/ /mi gtsang ngo bor shes bzhin du/ /'di la 'dod cing gang zhig chags/ /zhes dang / mkhas pa chen po sa dzas bu la springs pa las/ 'dod pa'i phyir ni byis pa rnams/ /bud med rul ba bsten byed pa/ /'gro ba rul ba 'gro 'gyur zhing / /ngan song gnas su ltung bar 'gyur/ /'jigs pa chen po'i 'ching ba ni/ /bud med zhags pa mi zad pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'dod pa dang / /bud med bsten pa'ang ma bsngags so/ /lam 'dis byang chub bar bcad pas/ /sbrul gdug shin tu khro ba ltar/ /mkhas khyod bud med 154

rnam par spongs/ /mi gang dag ni bud med 'dod/ /de dag bde ba ga la 'gyur/ /bud med 'phung bar byed pa ste/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol 'phung / /rnam pa kun tu nor 'jig dang / /ngan song rtsa ba bud med yin/ /bu khyod bdag la phan 'dod na/ /de bas bud med rtag tu spongs/ /bud med rnams kyi rang bzhin ni/ /'dod can rnams kyis mi rigs te/ /skyes pa dang ni yid gcugs shing / /rtse dga' du ma byas nas kyang /sbrul gyis pags rnying 'dor ba ltar/ /bud med kyis ni glo bur 'dor/ /sbrang mas me tog rnying ba ltar/ /bud med kyis ni nor med pa'i/ /skyes pa rgan po 'dor byed cing / /gzugs byad ngan pa'ang 'dor ba yin/ /rab tu brtse bas bud med dag /thams cad du ni yongs bskyangs kyang / /bud med shin tu mi bzang ba/ /bdag gir byas pa mi nus so/ /de yi rang bzhin de yin te/ /bud med rnams ni sems mi bsrun/ /byas pa drin du mi gzo bas/ /rang gi skyes pa'ang gsod par byed/ /mchu so dang ni sder mo can/ /rwa can lag na mtshon thogs dang / /rgyal po ngan dang bud med la/ /nam yang yid brtan mi bya'o/ /bud med kha zas nyis 'gyur ste/ /g.yo sgyu dag ni bzhi 'gyur yin/ /phrag dog shes ni drug 'gyur te/ /'dod 155

pa brgya 'gyur yin rig bya/ /shing rnams kyis ni me dang ni/ /char gyis rgya mtsho chen po dang / /'byung bo kun gyis gshin rje ltar/ /skyes pas bud med ngoms mi 'gyur/ /su ka rtse yi kha chu yis/ /bye ma'i phung po ci ltar sbangs/ /skyes pa gzhon nu thams cad kyis/ /bud med gcig ni ngoms mi 'gyur/ /byi bo byed pa'i ngang tshul can/ /ma bsdams mi bsrun 'dod la brkam/ /rang gi chung mas mi chog ste/ /'jig rten dag na smad 'os yin/ /'di dang pha rol sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /gsod dang chad pa drag po myong / /sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye/ /de bas bu khyod de spongs shig /byi bo byed pa shal ma li/ /lcags kyi tsher ma rtse mo 'bar/ /sor ni bcu drug yod pa la/ /ngu zhing stobs kyis 'dzeg par 'gyur/ /bud med shin tu 'jigs 'jigs lta/ /mche rno lus che 'bar ba yis/ /gzhan gyi bud med 'phrog pa la/ /ci nas za bar kho nar 'gyur/ /gal te chung ma bsten na yang / /de yi nyes dmigs drug cu lnga/ /drag shul can gyi mdo las gsungs/ /de phyir bud med spang bar bya/ /bud med la chags spangs pa'o/ / zhes gsungs/ khyem gyi nyes pa bstan pa'i mdo las/ pho mos 'khrig pa'i 'dod spyod pa'i/ /yud tsam bde la chags pa ni/ /bskal ba du mar 156

sbyor ba yi/ /'bar ba'i khri la chags pa'o/ /lcags kyi khri bsreg 'bar ba la/ /tshe 'dir gtan du spyod sla yi/ /pha mas byen pa'i chung ma la/ /chags pa'i sems kyis blta ba yang / /sdig pa yin par ngas bshad na/ /'grogs shing bsten pa smos ci dgos/ /de yang de ci'i phyir zhe na/ /chung ma mya ngan rtsa ba'o/ /chung ma sdig pa'i rtsa ba'o/ /chung ma sdug bsngal rtsa ba'o/ /chung ma 'phung ba'i rtsa ba'o/ /chung ma gnod pa'i rtsa ba'o/ /chung ma 'ching ba'i rtsa ba'o/ /chung ma dgra yi rtsa ba'o/ /chung ma dmus long rtsa ba'o/ /shes rab spyan mig 'dzer byed pa'i/ /gzhi dang rtsa ba chung ma yin/ /dper na til 'bras sa la yi/ /lo tog phun sum tshogs pa la/ /rdo rje ser ba babs gyur na/ /'bras bu blang du med pa ltar/ /skyes bu dge ba'i lo tog la/ /bud med ser ba de bzhin no/ /dper na ut+pal me tog la/ /grang lhags ba mo babs gyur na/ /mdog nyams rnyid par 'gyur ba ltar/ /skyes bu dge ba'i me tog la/ /bud med grang lhags de bzhin no/ /dper na bco lnga'i zla shar la/ /sprin gyis g.yogs par gyur pa na/ /'od stong 'jig rten mi mthong bar/ /skyes bu dge ba'i zla ba la/ /bud med lho sprin de bzhin no/ /nyes mtha' yas pa'i bud med la/ /bltas shing gtam kyang ltung 'gyur 157

na/ /'grogs shing bsten pa smos ci dgos/ /zhes sogs mtha' yas par gsungs la/ de bas kyang sdom pa zhus pa'i rab byung nyams pa na nyes pa brgya stong 'gyur gyi che ste/ tshul khrims yang dag par ldan pa'i mdo las/ srog dang bral zhing shi ba ni sla'i tshul khrims ral zhing zhig pa ni de ltar ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ srog dang bral ba ni de nyid kyi skye ba zhig par zad kyi/tshul khrims zhig pa ni skye ba 'bum phrag brgya'i bar du rigs dang bral zhing bde ba spongs te/ rnam par ltung zhing nyams par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / bu ston snying thur las/ log par g.yem pas dmyal ba bsdus 'joms su/ /gsal shing 'bar bas ro smad 'bigs par 'gyur/ /de nas mi ru skyes kyang ma ning 'gyur/ /rmi lam bud med spyad nas ro myang yang / /dmyal ba pad+ma ltar gas nang du ni/ /bum par 'tshod cing gtun gyis 'tshogs gyur na/ /dngos su spyad na lta yang smos ci dgos/ /bud med mthong nas tshul min yid byed na/ /mig ni zangs zhun 'bar bas bsreg par byed/ /bud med glu dbyangs thos nas chags gyur na/ /rna bar ro nye skol nas blugs par skye/ /bud med glu dang gar la chags pa yis/ /khu ba byung na 'gyod par mi byed par/ /lcags kyi me mdag char ba lus la 158

'babs/ /gzhan gyi chung ma la spyad rdzun smra na/ /ngu 'bod chen po mun pa kun khyab par/ /spyi bo nas phug lce phyungs bcad kyang ni/ /skad cig re re skye zhing gcod par byed/ /mi ru skyes kyang dmus long 'on pa dang / /lam zan slong ba dag tu skye bar 'gyur/ /dge bsnyen ma la log par g.yem pa yis/ /rab tu tsha bar thal ba'i lhag ma yang / /med par bsreg cing tshe rabs bzhi brgya ru/ /za ma dag tu skye bar 'gyur ba yin/ /grogs kyi chung ma bslus nas spyad pa yis/ /rab tsha a la la zhes zer ba ru/ /skyes nas tsha ba'i rlung gis phyogs bcur 'khyer/ /tshe rabs stong phrag du mar yi dwags su/ /skyes nas rang gi sha la za bar byed/ /phag tu skyes nas ma sha za ba dang / /mi ru skyes nas pho mtshan gcod par 'gyur/ /bla ma'i chung mar log par g.yem pa yis/ /snying rje chen po zhes pa gong 'og tu/ /mtshon cha ral gris gcod par skye bar 'gyur/ /mi ru skyes kyang btsas ma thag tu 'chi/ /bdag nyid mi dbang bu mo la spyad pas/ /klad par seng ge sbrul gyi rtsibs logs dang/ /rgyab nas stag gis bza' zhing mes bsreg la/ /phyogs rnams kun nas gshin rje mda' 'phen 'gyur/ /bud med mtshan ma snyan dngags kyis bstod pa/ /skye ba lnga brgyar mngal gyi srin bur skye/ /chags pa spyad kyang 159

reg na smos ci dgos/ /zhes pa la sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ /slob dpon bai ro tsā na'i zhal nas/ bud med bya ba btsan dug ha la yin/ /sems can gang gis zos kyang 'chi bar 'gyur/ /bud med bya ba las kyi srin mo yin/ /sems can gang gis 'khor yang la 'ur 'chi/ /bud med bya ba dmyal ba'i 'dam rdzab yin/ /sems can gang gis 'khor ba'i 'dam la 'dzin/ /bud medakhya ba 'khor ba'i btson ra yin/ /gang gis 'bags kyang thar ba 'thob mi srid/ /bud med bya ba bdud kyi mya ngan yin/ /gang gis 'brel kyang sdug bsngal tshad med myong / /zhes gsungs/ gsang ba thams cad kyi spyi'i cho ga snying bo rgyan las/sbom sogs phra ba phra ba'i mthar/ /nyes pa rtag tu bsam par bya/ /sgra tsam la ni rab gzhol ba'i/ /sngags pa mnar med sogs 'gro bas/ /nga ni sngags pa zhes sgogs shing / /gsang ba'i lam la brten nas kyang / /tshul khrims yal bar dor mi bya/ /dkar ba'i gos la rab gnas te/ /ngo tsha rnam par dor nas su/ /log par g.yem la mngon par zhen/ /ngu 'bod sems can dmyal bar 'gro/ /zhes dang / te ru ka mngon 'byung las/ rnal 'byor med par rnal 'byor chos/ /phyag rgya la ni bgrod gyur dang / /ye shes med par ye shes tshul/ /dmyal 160

bar 'gro bar the tshom med/ /ces dang / de kho na nyid grub par/de nyid de nyid kyis shes nas/ /gang zhig lha mo la brten pa/ /de grub 'gyur gyi gzhan du ni/ /dmyal ba chen po ltung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / slob dpon je ta ri'i zhal nas/ mi skyong khyed ni gal te gsang ba'i lam la dgyes pa na/ /lam de rab tu rtogs dka' sems la rma 'byen tshig 'phro ste/ /bud med 'khyud sogs tshul bzhin ma yin yid la byed pa ldan/ /kha cig mngon sum 'khrig dang drag shul spyod la 'jug pa ste/ /thugs la gnod na thub pa'i bka' yang dug 'thung ba dang 'dra/ /de phyer khyod kyis gsang ba'i lam du zhugs pa'i rgyu mtshan las/ /khyod thugs 'dod chags la sogs dri mas gos pa 'di ni spangs/ /gang gzhan de 'dra byed pa'ang / /log par khyod kyis rnam sgrubs rigs/ /zhes dang / rgyud kyi rgyal po 'dul ba don yod grub pa las/ de tshe 'khrig pa bsten mi bya/ /brtul zhugs 'di ni skyon med yin/ /sdig ldan ci yang mi bya zhing / /gang la'ang khro dang chags mi bya/ /zhes dang / kha rag sgom chung pas/shes pa 'phro la lus la gnod/ /mkhas btsun rnams kyis smad pa'i gnas/ /nyes pa thams cad 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /chang dang bud med spongs shig ang / /skye ba dman pa'i bud med kyi/ /'khor 161

la phan sems che ba na/ /snying rjer brdzus pa'i chags sems kyis/ /chos kyi bar chad byed do ang / /gsungs/ po to pa'i zhal nas/ bud med 'di ni bdag gi chos dang mi mthun pa'i yid pham par byed pa'i dgra bo'o/ /thar ba'i srog rtsa gartsedi pa'i gshed ma'o/ /dkar po'i lo tog 'joms par byed pa'i ser ba'o/ /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'phrog par byed pa'i chom rkun no/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi bar du gcod par byed pa'i bdud mo'o/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar ba mi ster ba'i btson ra'i srung ma'o/ /nyon mongs pa mtha' dag kun nas slong bar byed pa'i dkrugs ma'o/ /sdug bsngal thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa'i dmyal ba'i me khang lta bu'o/ /snyam du bsam pas chags pa bzlog gsungs/ tshul khrims yang dag par ldan pa'i mdo las/ bud med bsten du ga la rung / /rgyal po'i pho brang ga la dga'/ /wu ba snying bo ga la yod/ /longs spyod rtag pa ga la yod/ /bud med dag la rung ba med/ /gsungs/ sngon rje btsun mi la ras pa la/ stod lung gi mi gzhon gcig na re/ sngags pa 'di tsho rab tshe 'di 'am/ /'bring 'chi kha'am/ bar do/ tha ma skye ba bdun nam bcu drug la/ sangs rgyas pas yon tan shin tu che bar gda'/ tshe 'dir 'dod yon 162

lam du byed pa yin pas/ der dngos po bsog chung ma yang bsten bu yang gso/ kha sha chang dang mi 'bral bar byas pas chog zer ba bden lags sam/ de ga byas pas chog na ni de ka dga' bar gda' ste/ de ji ltar lags zhes pa'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so/ /dus tshod da lta'i sngags pa ni/ /sngags pa'i ming tsam btags pa yin/ /ming tsam btags pas grol 'gyur na/ /khyod la'ang sangs rgyas ming btags pas/ /grol ba ra 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /khyad par khyod nyid bzhed pa yi/ /khyem pa'i sngags pa 'di rnams ni/ /phal cher nyon mongs dbang gis ni/ /tshe 'di'i don gnyer kho na yin/ /myos byed chang gis ra ro nas/ /don med rnga gog brdungs nas ni/ /snod min skye bo'i 'gram dag tu/ /gsang tshig bon du gyer pas na/ /rtsa ltung bdun pa char bzhin 'bab/ /bde chen byang chub sems mchog de/ /gtsug tor rtse mor son dgos na/ /nyon mongs phrug gu slog pas na/ /gsang sngags chos dang rgyab 'gal byas/ /de la sogs de mtha' yas pas/ /mang na gzhan la phog pa'ang srid/ /de ring 'dir yang smra mi btub/ /'jig rten pa yi kha dpe la/ /rgyab ni sa la ma reg pa'i/ /phyag ni rtse ba mi yong ngo / /de bzhin dka' ba ma spyad pas/ /sangs rgyas thob pa mi sred do/ /163

gsungs/ yang rje btsun mi la ras pa la/ skyid grong gi rabs chad bza' mi gnyis kyis nged kyi bu dod mdzod dang / khyed rang thugs 'gro ba'i bu mo gcig len zhus pas/ mgur 'di gsungs so/ /grogs dang po lha mo bzhad kha ma/ /blta ba'i gdong la chog rgyu med/ /bar du srin mo ro mig ma/ /phar cig lab na tshur gnyis rgol/ /skra la 'chang na sgyid la 'ju/ /dbyug pas brgyab na gzar bu 'phyar/ /tha ma rgan mo so med ma/ /srin mo'i sdang mig sems la gzan/ /bdud mo'i 'thab ya spangs pa yin/ /khyed kyi gzhon grogs nga mi 'dod/ /ces gsungs/ yang gnya' nang rtsar ma'i yon bdag rnams kyis bag ma gsar ba zhig gi rin la 'thab pa la zhal ta'i chos mang du gnang zhing mgur 'di gsungs so/ /khyed mgo la rdo khur gyi rang rtsis can/ /rang la rtsod med kyi phung rdo ma/ /mi la mi shor rang gis len/ /lus la dmar smug gi nang rul ma/ /yid la khyo 'dod kyi gzhungs ngan ma/ /lar phung gi rtsa ba bud med yin/ /yul gyi nad yams mi ngan yin/ /yul ngan dus ngan gyi mna' ma 'di/ /lo da la rin thang che bar 'dug /btsog la rtsod mi mang bar 'dug /de 'jig rten bsam brlag gi spyod pa yin/ /gzhon nu 'khrug pa ma byed rang tshod zungs/ /rgan pa 164

tsho g.yo sgyu ma byed rang la sdig /khrom 'dir tshogs kyi kha lo chos la bsgyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'thab rtsod zhi bar gyur gsungs/ pha dam pa la/ kun dgas/ bud med bsten pa to'am mi to zhus pas/ glang gi ltag khung du gnya' shing byung ba zla bo rnyed pas lan/ zla bo med na zhing rmo mi btub par gda' gsungs/ dam pa grongs na ngan bus ci ltar byed zhus pas/'khor ba'i rgyu khyem thab tu ma song na ji ltar byas kyang bde sna thag mi la ma shor bar gyis shig gsungs/ yang pha dam pa'i zhal nas/ chang dang bud med la dga' ba'i mis dge sbyor mi 'grub/ bla ma dang 'grogs yun thung ba'i mi la yon tan mi 'go sems la chos bya ba'i bsam pa med pa'i mi la khong na snying med par shes par gyis gsungs/ yang gcig pur bsdad na sdug bsngal gyi dra ba las thar te/ snying rlung can khyem thab la brtson/ skyes pas khyem thab byas kyi steng la dge sbyor med pa de rang yin gsungs/ rje btsun blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis/ tha na bud med dang dud 'gro sogs 'dod chags skye ba la mi blta mi sems/ glu'i sgra dang ngag la mi nyan sngar skyes pa'am/ bud med la sogs pa dang tshul ma yin par rtses pa bgad pa sogs dran par mi byed gsungs/ dge bshes sha ra pa'i zhal nas/165

bud med nyon mongs pa'i rtsa ba yin pas phyogs su mi bsten/chang ni nyon mongs pa'i rtsa ba yin pas 'chi yang mi 'thung gsungs/ dpe chos rin chen spungs pa las/ bud med kyi 'khor dang / lha khang gi phug ron 'dra ste/ chos 'khor bshig pa yin/ bud med kyi bsnyen bkur dang / gal snyi'i tho phyi'i sha rid dang / sbrang bu dang 'dra ste/ sdig sdug gtam ngan gsum 'byung ba yin gsungs/ da lta rnal 'byor pa kun gyis dang po dga' ye re/ tshod lta tsam la bud med re blangs phan tshun gcig gis gcig dge sbyor gyi grogs su 'gro ru re tsam na/gzhug gcig gis byur cig la bkal nas/ bu nyog gi gal du 'dzin te/ der tha ma gos bum tshun chad btsongs la bza' dgos gsungs/ rab tu byung ba'i bar du gcod pa'i mdo las/dper na mi la la zhig gis dgra bo bzung ste/ me mdag me lce med pa du ba med pa/ 'dom bdun pa'i dong du bcug pa de bzhin du/ gang la la me dang mtshungs pa'i 'dod pa dang / me dang mtshungs pa'i bud med la/ brten cing 'dod pa bsngags te gzhan yang 'dod pa dag la 'jug par byed pa de dag ni/gzhan yang me'i lhums su ltung bar byed do/ /de dag nad dang mya ngan de dag la nye bar sbyor ro/ /zhes dang / slob dpon 166

pad+ma'i zhal snga nas/ zab khrid pra khrid nyams su len no zhes/ /dbang bzhi bde stong rab 'byams bskur ro zhes/ /sdom pa gsum 'gal chos lugs skyongs byed cing / /sha chang bud med sdug las bag med spyod/ /de rjes 'brangs rnams bdud kyi pho nyas bslus/ /tshe 'di'i khrel med phyi ma'i dam tshig med/ /tha ma ngan song mnar med sdug bsngal smin/ /gsungs/ rje rin po ches mdzad pa'i gsang sngags kyi tshul khrims rnam bshad dngos grub snye ma las/ gzhan yang sde snod rgya chen po dang rgyud sde rnams kyi mdor bsdus pa'i tshig 'khrul ba yod pa rnams legs par gtan la 'bebs pa'i bshad rgyud rnams nges par ma byas par/ rgyud la sgra ji bzhin par bzung nas zhib tu mi rtog par nyes spyod la 'jug pa rnams kyi rjes su 'brang bar mi bya ste/deng sang zhib tu brtags nas 'jug dgos so/ /zhes shārnyi pas gsungs pa ltar shes rab can rnams kyis bya dgos te/ ji skad du/ 'on kyang gang dag bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' mdo sde rin po che'i tshogs la sogs pa ste sde snod du gtogs pa'i gsung rab rgya chen po ma mthong zhing ma thos la de bzhin du bya ba dang rnal 'byor la sogs pa'i rgyud rtsa ba dang phyi ma dang phyi ma'i phyi ma dang bcas pa 'khrul ba'i gnas gtan la 'bebs 167

pa ma thos shing ma mthong bar rgyud mdor bsdus pa 'ga' zhig gi tshig la sgra ji bzhin par 'dzin pas pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshig dang / bya ba'i rgyud la sogs pa las dang bya ba rab tu ston pa/de dag las ni/ lam sdug bsngal la kha zas la sogs pa bye brag can bza' ba yin la gang 'dod pa spyad du med pa'o/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud rgya mtsho lta bu 'di las ni ji ltar dga' bas longs spyad kyang 'ga' yang gang du yang nam yang mi nyams te/ ji ltar dga' ba spyod la rag go /bud med dang chang dang sha la sogs pa 'di dag ni mchod pa chen po mchod pa bzang po myur du 'grub par byed pa'o/ /zhes smra ba de dag rab tu ma rungs pa yin te/ de'i phyir bcom ldan 'das dus gsum sgrib pa med par mkhyen pa'i zhal snga nas tshul 'di 'dra 'byung bar gzigs te/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo bdun brgya lon nas bdud sdig can gyis nga'i bstan pa phye zhing 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs shing de nyid ngo shes par bya ba'i phyir ni chos rtags kyi phyag rnam pa gsum gyis nyid kyi bstan pa rgyas btab cing 'dir mi rung bar mdzad la/nag po bshad pa dang chen por ston pa rnam par dbye ba mdzad pa nyid kyi bstan par brtags pa rdo ka shi lta bu bzhag pa mdzad 168

de/ de'i phyir deng sang bstan pa la zhugs pa de dag gi zhib pa'i blos brtags par bya ba'i rigs kyis ma brtags par gzhan gyi sdig pa can la 'jug par mi bya'o/ /zhes so/ /gang yang de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa la gang yang gnang ba yin no/ /zhes stong nyid la lce rten byas nas rang gzhan bag med la sbyor ba yang gsang sngags kyi tshul gyi snang ba las zhib par dgag pa mdzad de/ ji skad du/ 'on te de nyid rnal 'byor pa/ /bdag cag la ni kha zas dang / /spyod lam sogs kun ci dga' bar/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la skyob pas gnang / /de yang de nyid gsal nyid du/ /zla gsang thig le la sogs las/ /rnal 'byor pa yis mi bya ba/ /ci yang med ces gsungs pa yin/ /zhes smras pa'i lan du/ yang dag pa yi rnal 'byor pa/ /dngos med rtogs shing brtse ldan pa/ /rgyal bas 'di gsungs bden mod kyi/ /da lta 'di 'dra 'ga' ma mthong / /rdzogs sangs rgyas ltar 'jig rten 'dir/ /ci bder gnas bya gang smra ba/ /khyod la rdzogs sangs mtshan ma'i cha/ /yod par ci yi phyir mi snang / /gal te sngags kyi bstan pa la/ /snod du gyur pa khyod yin na/ /bdag cag dam tshig la sdang bas/ /'gal ba smra bar gyur pa yin/ /gal te zas skom 169

sgo nas ni/ /rdzas sogs mnyam par slob byed na/ /sbyin la sogs pa'i lam gyes ni/ /mi slob ces pa ngo mtshar che/ /gal te sgyu ma ltar gnas na/ /'di la khyod kyi rten bcas na/ /bkres skom grang sogs gnod pa la/ /khyed kyi sgyu ma gang du song / /'jig rten gnyen gyis sngags pa la/ /tshogs can khyad par can gsungs pa/ /de cha khyod la yod min pas/ /rgyu med 'bras bu gang las byung / /bde bas byang chub thob 'gyur dang / /dga' bar spyod pa'ang spang ba ni/ /nyin mtshan bsgom brtson rnal 'byor pa/ /gang yin de la de gsungs so/ /zhes sogs kyi nan che bar slob dpon mtho btsun gtso lags kyis gsungs te tshig mang du dogs nas de tsam las ma spros so/ /gsungs/ rje btsun bde legs rin chen gyis/ las rgya gsang sngags gsar rnying gnyis nas bshad kyang / nyams su longs pa nyung ste/ sngags pa phal cher bud med kyi 'dam du chud pa'o/ /dper na skyes bu rta lam byang ba gcig rta dmu rgod srab mda' chad pa la zhon na/ cher tshe srog dang 'bral/ chung yan lag 'chag rtas dbang med du 'khyer/ gcong g.yang ngam/gad spriskobs la 30nga na ༄sgo rta ga lashākhya/ ba ra skabs su /bsnad pa ra 'ong ba shes te/ 'bab 'dod kyang rang dbang ma 170

byung / mis 'phya la rang 'gyod pa gnyis ka 'byung / de lta bu'i rta zhon pa brgyad brgya tsam la bsnad pa med par khrom thag chod pa re re tsam srid pa'o/ /de bzhin chags lam bsten pa'i gang zag snying rus kyi stobs zhan pa/ rtsa rlung thig ler dbang ma thob pas/ rta dmu rgod srab mda' chad pa la zhon pa ltar/phyag rgya ma bsten pas/ cher dge sbyor gyi skyes 'phel chad/tshe'i bar chad byed/ 'bring bsod nams chu chad pa ltar 'gyur/ tha ma skur ba ngan pa 'byung / rjes su 'gyod nas spang bar 'dod kyang / bu tshas 'brel rang dbang mi 'byung / rtag pa mtha' bzung gi rig pas dpyad nas/ so so skye bo rnams mi dad/ dam pa rnams kyi thugs kyis khrel/ dad pa can sun 'byin/ rtsa ltung bcu gnyis pa 'phog dwangs ma 'dzag bde ba 'chor/ rtsa ltung lnga ba 'phog 'gro don mi nus/ khyem pa dang khyad med du 'gyur ba'i skyon yod/ dgos pa'i byang sems nyams/ mi dgos pa'i nyon mongs cher 'phel/ lha dang mkha' 'gro gyes/ rang rgyud gzung 'dzin dang las rgya'i dbang du song / mthar shi nas ngan song du skye ba'i nyen yod de/ rdo rje chig rkang nas/ bag med 'dod sred gzhan dbang chang gis myos/ don las nyams shis sla ra༅ngaran song ltung / /zhes 171

gsungs so/ /nā ro paṇa chen gyis lo gcig shes rab ma bsten nas/ ti lo'i drung du phyin pas/ nā ro pa bde'am gsungs/nā ro pas/ bdag zer ba bzhin shes rab mas ma nyan/ shes rab mas zer ba bzhin bdag ma nyan/ bsam pa lta spyod ma mthun pas/ /don med sdug bsngal sna tshogs myang / /'dod yon sred pa'i bde ba yi/ /gnyis snang gzung 'dzin dbang du shor/ /gsungs/ de'i rjes su shes rab ma te lo par phul nas/ltos med bla ma sangs rgyas la/ /shes rab yon phul rnal 'byor bde/ /gsungs pas grub thob chen po de yang de lta bu gsungs na gzhan smos kyang ci dgos/ rje ras chung pa lta bu rlung sems la dbang thob pas kyang / lha gcig ldem bu phyag rgyar bzhes pa la/ shin tu sdug cing nyam thag ste/ yun ring bor dbang ma byung bar/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams/ /mthong thos dran pas ras chung pa/ /bsam gyin yi mug mchi ma bku/ /zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs so/ /mdor na chags lam pa nam mkha'i skar ma tsam yod kyang / /bar chad kyis ma khyer ba lam du slong ba nyi zla tsam 'byung ba'o/ /de phyir las rgya mi sten zhes gsungs so/ /bshes springs las/ gzhan gyi chung ma mi blta mthong na yang / /na tshod mthun par ma dang bu mo dang / /172

sring mo'i 'du shes bskyed kyi chags gyur na/ /mi gtsang nyid du yang dag bsam par bgyi/ /zhes dang / dran pa nyer bzhag gi tshig le'u byas pa las/ bye bo byed pa shal la li/ /lcags kyi rtse mo me 'bar ba/ /sor ni bcu drug yod pa la/ /ngu zhing stobs kyis 'dzeg par 'gyur/ /bud med shin tu 'jigs 'jigs lta/ /mchu rno las chen 'bar ba yis/ /gzhan gye bud med 'phrog pa la/ /'jus nas za ba kho nar 'gyur/ /zhes dang /mdo rgyud bstan bcos du ma nas bud med bsten pa'i nyes dmigs mtha' yas mu med pa gsungs so/ /des na sngon rgyal po khri srong sde'u btsan med shul du btsun mo dmar rgyan mas slob dpon bai ro tsa na la 'tsho ba drangs/ de nas 'dod chags kyis gdungs nas sku la 'jus tshe/ slob dpon gyes thabs mkhas byas/ ngas phyi sgo bcad nas 'ong zhes phyi sgor bud nas bros song skad/ de bzhin rang dang rang gi slob ma grwa pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i chos pa thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba bud med 'tshol ba phar zhog tshur byung na yang nyes dmigs bsams nas 'bros ci thub la brtson par bya'o/ /de ltar byed nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang bo'i byin gyes brlab tu gsol zhes bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyangs bya'o/ /smras 173

pa/ 'gro ba yongs kyi sngon nas ma 'dris pa'i/ /mdza' bshes chen po ston pa sangs rgyas de/ /spyi bo bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /bdag gzhan yongs la thugs rje spyan gyis gzigs/ /kun mkhyen khyed kyi zhal gye bum bzang las thon pa'i chos rnams slar yang dbyangs su len/ /'jig rten khyem thab me yi 'obs nas thon/ /rab byung bsil sar snyeg rnams dga' bas nyon/ /sdug bsngal gzhi ma bud med bsten gyur na/ /tshe 'dir bud med ngan ma'i dbang du song / /pha ma la yang brtsi bkur med pa'i khar/ /kha ngan spra zhing drin lan log 'jal byed/ /dam pa'i lha chos yong ba phar la zhog /bu dang bu mo byung nas kha mi sos/ /lto gos don du sdig las mang po byas/ /shi ma thag nas dmyal ba'i gnas su 'gro/ /'dod log spyad pa'i las kyi rnam smin gyis/ /shi na dmyal ba bsdus 'joms gnas su skye/ /chags pas bud med gzhan la spyad gyur na/ /ngu 'bod chen po mun pa'i nang du skye/ /sring mo la sogs 'os pa ma yin par/ /spyad na dmyal ba kye hud zer bar skye/ /dge slong ma la mi tshangs spyad gyur na/ /dmyal ba mchi ma'i rgyun ma lta bur skye/ /dge bsnyen ma la mi tshangs spyad gyur na/ /rab tu tsha ba'i dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur/ /grogs kyi chung mar 174

skog nas spyad byas na/ /rab tsha a la la zhes dmyal bar skye/ /bla ma'i phyag rgyar log g.yem byas gyur na/ /mtshon cha ral gris gcod pa'i dmyal bar skye/ /rang nyid mi dbang bud med la spyad na/ / gcan gzan sbrul gyis za zhing me mdas gsod/ /bud med gcig la rang gzhan mang po yis/ /spyad na gnod pa mi bzad dmyal bar sgye/ /bud med 'os ma yin pa'i khar bcug na/ /dmyal ba a la bud ltar gcod par skye/ /mi 'dod bzhin du mngal kyang ma yin par/ /bcug na dmyal ba mnar gcod che bar skye/ /byes pas mi 'dod bzhin du sba ba'i gnas/ /bcug na dmyal ba 'jigs par blta bar skye/ /bud med mngal du bsams nas dud 'gro la/ /bcug na dmyal ba 'khum pa zhes byar skye/ /skyes pa gang zhig skyes pa gzhan dag la/ /bcug na dmyal ba nyam nga mang bar skye/ /bud med ma rnyed lug gam bong mo la/ /bcug na dmyal ba a tsha zer bar skye/ /bud med skye gnas ma yin rkub sogs la/ /bcug na dbang po kun 'gags dmyal bar skye/ / bud med dran nas lag pas thabs byas na/ /dmyal ba tshor ba mtha' med zhes byar skye/ /rmi lam bud med spyad nas ro myang yang / /dmyal ba pad+ma ltar gas nang du skye/ /chags pas phyi mar lha mos bskor 175

smon na/ /pad+ma chen po ltar gas dmyal bar skye/ /bud med rnams la ster snyam yo byad rigs/ /bzung na dmyal ba me thab nang du skye/ /tshul khrims ldan pas chags pas bud med la/ /bltas na mig ni zangs zhun 'bar bas bsreg /chags pas bud med glu dbyangs nyan pa na/ /rna ba ro nye bskol bas 'gengs par 'gyur/ /mdzes mar chags nas khu ba phyungs gyur na/ /lcags kyi me mdag char ba lus la 'bab/ /bud med mtshan ma snyan dngags kyis bstod na/ /skye ba lnga brgyar mngal gyi srin 'bur skye/ /mi ru skyes kyang za ma ma ning dang / /zha long 'on pa dbang po ma tshang skye/ /dbang po yod kyang gzhan gyis gcod pa las/ /yang na nad ngan byung nas 'chad par 'gyur/ /de phyir dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ /'dod log spyod la 'jug par ma gyur cig /sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyi byin rlabs kyis/ /mi tshangs spyod pa nam yang mi dran shog /'di ltar 'bad las byung ba'i dge ba'i mthus/ /tshul khrims ldan pas sa steng khyab gyur cig /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//bzhi pa sha chang bud med kyi dbang du song nas/ srog gcod kyi las byas pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ mdo sde dran pa nyer 176

bzhag las rgya cher gsungs pa'i don mdor bsdus te bshad na de nyid las/ srog gcod pa kun tu bsten cing bsgoms te mang du byas pas las dang las kyi nyer bsdogs dang las kyi 'jug dang ldan pa'i sems can dmyal ba yang sos su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de yang rgya'am gdos kyis bya dang ri dwags gsod par byas na/ de shi nas dmyal ba yang sos kyi 'khor mi gtsang ba'i 'dam du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na mi gtsang ba'i 'dam nas srin bu mchu rnon pos lus phyi nas nang gi rkang la thug gi bar du za ba'o/ /de las thar na dud 'gro bya dang ri dwags su skyes nas gsod par 'gyur la/ lha dang mir skyes na'ang tshe thung bar 'gyur ro/ /rnyed pa dang / btsongs pa dang /blangs pa'i rgyu'i sems can dag srog gcod par byed do/ /mtshon gyis gzhan bsad cing srog dang bral bar byas na de shi nas dmyal ba lcags kyis bsgyur bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na lcags kyi ra ba rab tu 'bar ba 'phang du dpag tshad bcu yod pa'i nang du me 'bar te gshin rje'i mi dag gis mtshon rab tu 'bar bas lus gcod cing 'jig sreg cing gsheg go /mtshon gyi char phabs nas gsheg yan lag bcad cing gtub pa dang ngu'o/ /ral gri lo ma'i tshal du zhugs pas 177

mtshon gyi char gyis gsheg par byed do/ /gson pa dag bza' ba'i don du spu dbye bar bya ba'i phyir lcags kyi snod du 'jug cing rab tu bskol te/ 'jog par byed pa de shi nas dmyal ba snod du btso bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na lcags kyi snod nang du bcug nas me sbar te lo 'bum phrag du mar 'tshod do/ /de las thar nas lha mi'i nang du skyes na'ang tshe thung bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can gzhan la gnod pa sna tshogs pa byas na/ de shi nas dmyal ba gnod pa rnam par ma zhi bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na shing gi bar du btsir ba dang / khab kyis gtsag pa dang / gtun shing gis brdung ba/ lcag gis 'brab pa/ spu 'thog pa/ mgo la 'khor lo bskor ba/ zangs bskol bar 'jug pa/ lpags pa lus kun gtub pa sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa myong bar byed do/ /mir skyes na de rtag tu bcings pa dang gtses pa dang gnod pa dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor nas 'tshe ba dang mi bde bar 'gyur/ skye bo kun gyis kyang mngon par gtses te rtag tu sdug bsngal mi bzad par 'gyur/ gnyen 'dabs dang / mdza' bshes dang chung ma dang bu dag dang zhe 'gras par 'gyur ro/ /sems can gang dag log par lta ba las dang 'bras bu phyin ci log tu ston pa mchod sbyin dag la 178

phyugs bsub nas gsod par byed pa dang / rus sbal dag so phag gis mngon par g.yogs shing mun par 'jug par byed pa de dag shi nas dmyal ba mun par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na mun pa 'byung ba'i mes sreg par byed do/ /las kyi rlung gis bdas nas ri gnyis re rgyug pa'i bar du bcug pas thal bar rlog go /spu gri lta bu'i rlung gis yan lag dang nying lag thams cad zhig par byed/ so phag gis g.yogs nas snang ba med pa ma byas/ lus las byung ba'i mes sreg par byed do/ /mi'i nang du skyes na/ de rtag tu bcings pas bcings par 'gyur zhing tshe thung bar 'gyur ro/ /nags khrod na rgyu ba'i sems can ri dwags bya seng ge dred gung dang spre'u sogs bag phebs rgyu ba sgra dag gis skrag par byed cing rngon pas bsad pa'i bsam pa yod pa de shi nas dmyal ba kun tu mi dga' bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na me nang du bcug nas bya rog 'ug pa bya rgod khye dang srin po wa rnams kyi mchu rno la sgra 'jigs pa rnams kyis bsrung nas bcad cing za la 'jigs pa'i sgra des mi dga' bar 'gyur zhing srog chags mar ko ta ga'i mchu rnon pos rus pa'i gseb dang nang du zhugs nas za'o/ /mir skyes na rtag tu dman pa gzhan gyis zil gyis gnon cing nam yang de'i sems 179

la dga' ba mi skye/ las byed pa dag la don med dga' ba med cing bu chung ma gsod dang bcings par byed pa dang mi dga' ba rtag tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /sems zab par bdo ba'i sems can ni srog gcod pa mang po bag med pa la 'jug pa ste/de dag shi nas dmyal ba tshor ba bdo bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes na ba tshwa dang mtshon dang me dang ngam grog dang g.yang sa dang phur bu dang / me 'bar ba'i phreng ba'i rgyan byas pa'i tshor ba la rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par nyin gcig bzhin du 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /mir skyes na'ang 'gro lding dang / bar ba ra'i yul dang / rgya mtsho'i dbus kyi yul dang / si n+tu'i yul dang / zhar ba'i gling gi yul dang / gang na bran mchog tu sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ba der skye bar 'gyur zhing dbul ba'i bran du 'gyur/ sgo bsrung dang / yan lag dang nying lag thams cad nyams shing / ma tshang ba dang / lus skem pa dang /bkres pas yongs su gdungs shing grang ba dang / tsha ba'i gzhir gyur pa dang / shin tu sdug bsngal zhing gzhan gyis rtag tu gtses pa dang / byis pa dag gis dbyug pa dang / bong ba dag gis brdeg cing / skye bo kun gyis brnyas par 'gyur/ bu dang chung mas kyang rnam par spangs par 'gyur zhing / mngal nas skyes 180

tshun chad mchog tu sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa la sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ /yang dran pa nyer bzhag las/ mi ni gang zhig sdig byed pa/ /de dag nges par phangs mi byed/ /bdag gi yul la sdig pa byas/ /sdig pas sems can dmyal bar 'tshod/ /sdig pas sdig pa rjes su 'gro/ /de bzhin dge bas dge bar mthong / /sdig byed dge la sdang ba ni/ /sems can dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur/ /mi dge'i blo yis dge ba dag /btang nas ci phyir sdig par 'gro/ /rmongs pas rin chen bor nas su/ /ci phyir rdo yi rjes su rgyug /sangs rgyas rin chen la sogs pa/ /sna tshogs chos kyis mtshungs par gang / /mi yi chos ni thob pa dag /ci phyir mang du spyad mi bya/ /sdig pa yongs su spangs pa yin/ /sems ni rtag tu dge ba dag /mya ngan 'das pa lag na yod/ /rtogs pa rnams kyis mi mthong ngo / /thog ma dbus dang mtha' dge ba/ /bde ba'i chos ni rtag tu 'byung / /thog ma dbus dang mtha' mi dge /sdig pa'i las kyi 'bras bu yin/ /de ltar rtag tu sdig spangs shing / /rtag tu dge la dmigs par gyis/ /sdig pa yongs su spangs pa ni/ /rtag tu bde bar gnas pa yin/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /yang dang yang du sdig pas gdungs/ / byes pa gti mug dbang song ba ci yi 181

phyir na skyo mi bya/ /sdig pa yis ni sngon bsags shing / /phyi nas me yis sreg par byed/ /sdig pa'i rgyu las byung ba'i dmyal/ /sdig pa rnams su yongs su 'tshod/ /sdig pa don med smra ba ni/ /sems ni yang bas smra bar byed/ /tsha ba gang gis yongs bsreg pa/ /ci yi phyir na sdig pa byed/ /khyod kyi sgo dag du mar gyur/ /de lta bas na sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /de lta de ni sdig pa na/ /gshin rje pho nya du ma yis/ /las kyi zhags pas dbang song la /mi zad dmyal bar khrid par byed/ /ces dang / sdig pa byed pa'i mi dag ni/ /'jig rten kun gyis rnam par smad/ /dge ba byed pa rtag tu bstod/ /de bas sdig pa rnam par spangs/ /mi 'dod mi phan sdang ba yi/ /rnam par smin pa sdug bsngal ba/ /sdig pa sdig pa'i rnam smin de/ /de ltar blo ldan de spongs shig /sdig la rtag tu sdig pa yongs/ /sdig pa med la sdug med do/ /byed la ltos la sdig yod de/ /byed pa rnams kyi rjes su 'jug /sdig pa sems la rag las shing / /'bras bu sems la rag las te/ /sems ni rkyen las skyes par mthong / /rgyu dang rkyen las shin tu 'byung / /sems can sems kyis bslus nas su/ /sdig pa'i dbang gis 'ong ba dag /gnod pa'i mchog ste stobs che ba/ /sems can dmyal ba drag por 'gro/ /sems dbang gyur pa 182

'gro ba ste/ /rtag tu chos dbang 'gyur mi 'gro /chos spyod pa ni rtag tu bde/ /sdig spyod pa ni mi bde'o/ /gsungs/ bslab pa lnga'i mdo las/ /dge slong dag srog gcod pa ni/ sbrul dug can dang 'dra bar lta bar bya'o/ /sdig pa du ma dang ldan pa dgayi dwags kyi gnas su skye ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skye ba dang / dmyal ba'i skye gnas su skye bar 'gyur te/ de'i lus zhig nas shi ba'i pha rol du dmyal ba yang sos su skye'o/ /de ni dmyal ba yang sos su dmyal ba'i bsrung mas yang dag par bsreg pa dang / mtshon sna tshogs pa bzung nas dum bur gcod cing lus la phug pa 'bug par byed do/ /rnam pa lnga yi gcig go zhes pas las byed cing byed la/ dmyal ba'i sems can de yang dang yang du 'tsho bas na yang sos su skye'o/ /de rnams la yang sos kyi sdug bsngal gdug pa rtsub pa/ tsha ba 'joms shing 'joms la/ gang zhig la thams cad lci zhing srog gcod pa'i rnam par smin pa de'o/ /de mir skyes kyang tshe thung bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang bo yongs su ma tshang bar 'gyur/ gzugs ngan pa dang / shes rab 'chal ba dang / rtag tu skrag pa dang / rtag tu khro ba dang / nad dang bcas pa dang / mya ngan dang bcas pa dang / dga' ba dang 'bral ba dang / thams cad bral ba dang /183

rtag tu yun ring du 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skye ba lnga brgyar yi dwags dang / /nya sbrul ri dwags lug pa dang / /ma he khyi dang wa rnams dang / /srog bcad pa yi nyes pa'o/ /'di ni srog bcad pa'i rnam par smin pa'o/ /srog gcod pa ni spangs pa yis/ /skyes pa'am ni bud med lus/ /thob par 'gyur te phan yon ni/ /yon tan nyi shu mi dman par/ /yan lag nying lag phun sum tshogs/ /lus ni shed dang ldan pa dang / /rigs bzang bor ni myur du skye/ /yan lag gtsang zhing 'jam pa dang / /tshe ring ba dang bde ba dang / /dpa' zhing stobs dang ldan pa dang / /tshig ni mchog tu bzang ba dang / /lha dang bcas pa dga' ba dang / /'jig rten pa yi ngan mi byed/ /'phags pa'i tshig ngan mi brjod dang / /byad stems ngan pas mi 'chi zhing / /mtha' yas pa yi 'khor dang ldan/ /kha dog gzugs dang yang dag ldan/ /nad dang mya ngan nyung ba dang / /khyim gyi gnas ni mi spong dang / /gzhan gyis mi dgar mi 'gyur ro/ /srog gcod pa ni spangs pa yis/ /skyes pa'am ni bud med kyis/ /phan yon 'di ni myong bar 'gyur/ /lha rnams dang ni mi rnams su'o/ /de lus zhig cing shi nas bde 'gro mtho ris lha'i 'jig rten du nye 184

bar skye'o/ /zhes dang / rgyal po 'char byed kyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ mi rnams gang dag sdig byed pa/ /gtun bu drag po rnams kyis 'joms/ /sta re rnams kyis gsheg pa dang / /de bzhin gsal shing gzugs par 'gyur/ /mi rnams gang dag sdig byed pa'i/ /sems can rnams kyis lus la ni/ /lcags mdung rtse mo bzhi pa dang / /rtse gsum pa dang rtse lnga 'bab/ /mi rnams gang dag sdig byed pa/ /ral gri mchu can khwa rnams kyis/ /mgo yi klad pa btog 'gyur zhing / /wa dang spyang kis za bar 'gyur/ /mi rnams gang dag sdig byed pa/ /ngan skyugs rul ba dri nga zhing / /kun gyis snang bar ltung 'gyur la/ /spu gri'i chu klung rnams su ltung / /mi rnams gang dag sdig byed pa/ /rab tu tsha bar bsreg 'gyur zhing / /ngu 'bod dang ni ngu 'bod che/ /thig nag du yang bsreg par 'gyur/ /mi rnams gang dag sdig byed pa/ /thig nag tu ni skyes nas kyang / /yang dang yang du me mur dang / /spu gri chu klung rnams su lhung / /gang tshe lcags kyi zangs po cher/ /mi rnams gang dag 'tshod pa na/khye rnams kyis ni gtses gyur nas/ /de dag bde ba 'tshol bar byed/ /mi rnams gang dag sdig byed pa/ /dmyal ba drag po chen por ni/ /lhung nas dpung gnyen yod min zhing / /lcags 185

kyi thu lum za bar 'gyur/ /mi rnams gang dag sdig byed pa/ /lcags las grub ba'i brag chen dang / /mi sdug ri bo rnams kyis ni/ /de tshe kun nas lus 'joms byed/ /des ni rang gi las byas pas/ /'bras bu de 'dra thob 'gyur zhing / /de yis tshor ba myong ba na/ /de la skyob pa 'ga' yang med/ /ji snyed bsten pa thams cad ni/ /bdag gi mdun der 'ga' yang med/ /der ni mgon med bdag gcig pu/ /sdug bsngal tshor ba myong bar byed / /gang dag bde phyir don min par/ /sngon chad nyes pa spyad byas kyang / /pha ma de dag de ring ni/ /rnam par grol ba'i mthu yang med/ /gang dag bde phyir don med par/ /sngon chad nyes pa spyad byas kyang / /bu dang bu mo chung ma rnams/ /de rang bdag la grol mi nus/ /zhes dang / dran pa nyer bzhag gi mdo las/ srog gcod pa bsten pa ni sems can dmyal bar 'gro/ yi dwags kyi 'jig rten du 'gro/ dud 'gro'i 'jig rten du 'gro/ mi 'dod pa mi sdug pa yid du mi 'ong ba/ skye bo mkhas pa kun gyes smad par 'gyur ro/ /mir skyes na'ang tshe thung ba'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / legs nyes kyi rgyu 'bras bstan pa'i mdo las/ /srog gcod pa'i kha na ma tho ba des ni/ sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 186

'jig rten du ltung bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te mir skyes par gyur na yang / yang dag par smin pa'i 'bras bu rnam pa gnyis 'thob par 'gyur te/ tshe thung ba dang nad mang ba gang yin pa'o/ /zhes dang / las kyi rnam par 'gyur ba zhes bya ba'i mdo las/ ji ltar las kyi tshe thung bar zhe na/ chos bcus na tshe thung bar 'gyur te/ bcu gang zhe na/ srog gcod pa/ gcod du bcug pa/ srog gcod pa la bstod pa/ srog mi gcod pa la smod pa/ mngal gnas med par byed pa/ mngal gnas med par byed du bcug pa/ dgra bo la bsad par sems pa mi mdza' ba shi na dga' ba/ rten bcas sems can bsad pa/ 'thab mo la blta zhing dad pa dang bcu ste/ chos 'di bcus ni tshe thung zhing nad mang bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / srog gcod na de'i las kyis sa'i mdog nyams par 'ong ngo / /zhes dang / na pa rnam pa bcu 'gyur ba'ang go zhing shes par byos shig bcu gang zhe na/ dgra mod du 'gyur ba/ yid du mi 'ong bar snang ba/ tshe thung ba/ sdig pa'i las la sems pa/ sems can rnams 'jigs par 'gyur ba/ mi dga' bzhin nyal ba/ mi dga' bzhin sad pa/ rmi lam na sdig pa mthong ba/ phyis 'gyod pa/tshe thung ba'i las sems shing byed pa yin te/ shi nas lus dang 187

bral na las ngan par lhung zhing sems can dmyal bar skye'o/ /zhes dang / dge mi dge ba'i las kyi rnam par smin pa bstan pa'i mdo las/ bu tsha med pa ni bya phrug mang bo bsad pa las 'ongs so/ /bu tsha mang ba ni sems can mang po gsos pa las 'ongs so/ /tshe ring ba ni snying rje che ba las 'ongs so/ /tshe thung ba ni srog gcod pa las 'ongs so/ /zhes dang / tshe 'di la shan pa byed cing sems can mang bo'i srog gcod pa ni ral gri dang ral gri'i nags tshal gyi sems can dmyal bar ltung ngo / /tshe 'di la khra dang khye la sogs pa gtong zhing / rngon pa byed pa la dga' ba ni lcags kyi sog le'i dmyal bar ltung ngo / /tshe 'di la phag dang khye'i spu btog pa ni shin tu bskol ba'i dmyal bar ltung ngo / /tshe 'di la phag dang khyi dang rta'i 'bras bu bton pa ni rdo zug rngu'i dmyal bar lhung ngo / /tshe 'di la srog gcod cing 'dre srin la mchod pas ni lcags kyi snyung bu'i dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ro/ /srog gcod du bcug ste lha srin mchod du bcug pa na sta res gtubs pa'i dmyal bar ltung ste/ srung mas lus gtubs shing / lcags kyi bya mchu can gyis mig gnyis kyi 'bras bu btsogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/ slob dpon dpa' bos dran pa nyer bzhag gi tshig le'u byas pa las/ chags dang 188

gti mug 'jigs dang khro/ /mi gang mi ni gsod pa dang / /gzhan yang bskyed nas gsod byed pa/ /de dag nges par yang sos 'gro/ /gang gi phyir na lo stong phrag /mang bo yang ni de dag tu/ /btags shing btags shing yang 'tsho bas/ /de phyir yang sos yin par bshad/ /ces dang / ra dang lug dang wa dag dang / /ri bong bye ba ri dwags phag /gzhan yang bskyed nas bsad byas na/ /lus can bsdus 'joms 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gang phyir bsdus nas der 'don dang / /yang dag bsreg par byed pas na/ /de yi phyir na bsdus 'joms te/ /de ltar ming ni don mthun grags/ /zhes dang / yon tan dag gis che ba la/ /gnod pa drag po byas pa'am/ /pha ma bla ma bsad byas na/ /nges par bskal ba mnar med 'tshod/ /de dag der ni lus ngag gis/ /rus pa dag kyang lhag par 'gyur/ /gang phyir bde ba'i skabs med pa/ /de phyir mnar med yin par bshad/ /lus can gang dag gcig la gcig /gnod par dka' bas g.yul ngor gsod/ /sdig pa de dag sdug bsngal dang / /ldan pa'i ral gri sems can skye/ /gang phyir de yi sen mo ni/ /lcags byas 'bar rno de dag gis/ /gcig gis gcig gsod gang yin de/ /ral gri sen mo can du bshad/ /ces dang /189

sen mos shig la sogs bcom na/ /de dag lus ni cher 'gyur la/ /stong brgyar yang dang yang dag ni/ /brag sgong bo yis 'joms par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / 'bru yi nang na 'khod pa yi/ /srog chags mthong nas 'joms pa gang / /de ni lcags kyi gtun shing gis/ /yang dang yang du brdungs par 'gyur/ /shin tu khro zhing gtum pa dang / /g.yo byed rdzun du smra ba dang / /gzhan la gnod byed dga' ba ni/ /gshin rje srin por skye bar 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal kun gyi sa bon ni/ /chung ma la sogs dbye ba yis/ /lus ngag yid kyis sdig pa ste/ /des na phra yang spangs par bya/ /gsungs/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i zhal nas/tshe 'di'i phun tshogs ci tsam spyad gyur kyang / /'chi ba'i dus su chos min kun gyis bslu/ /dkar nag las kyi 'bras bu mi bslu bas/ /sdig spongs dge ba bsgrub la 'bad par bya/ /nyes med srog chags gsod pa'i las rnams ni/ /myur du myong zhing nges par myong 'gyur la/ /rang la smin na bzod pa'i thabs med pas/ /'di la shin tu shin tu 'jem par bya/ /gsungs/sngon rje mi la yar 'brog mtsho kha nas yar byon dus/ bud med mang bos nye'u chung mang bo bzung nas gson por gri yis gshags nas nang cha rnams lag pas gad dar byas te/ sa la 190

bkram dus su yang ma shi bar 'gul ba gzigs nas/ thugs la snying rje tshad med pa 'khrungs te spyan chab mang bo btang nas mgur 'di gsungs so/ /skyes chen mar ba lo tsā/ /chos dbyings rnam dag ngang nas/ /thugs rje spyan gyis gzigs la/ /'gro drug lam sna drongs shig /'tsho ba zas kyi phyir du/ /gzhan srog bcad nas za ba'i/ /srin mo kha dmar ma tsho/ /dar cig nga la nyon cig /spyir du sems can thams cad/ /thog med dus kyi pha ma/ /sgos su rang la tsher ma/ /zug pa mi bzod 'dug na/ /gzhan rnams bsad nas za ba/ /snying gis phod pa'i snying bsran/ /can tsho bsam mno thongs dang / /nang cha bton pa'i phyi shun/ /da dung bla log 'dre ba/ /'di la legs par ltos la/ /bsam mno gzhig 'brel chug dang / /'di 'dra snying gis phod pa/ /khyed kyi snying ni rdo'am/ /lcags kyi gar bu yin pa/ /tshe la nges pa med cing / /nangs par e sdod mi shes/ /bem rig bral ba'i dus su/ /rnam shes na rag dmyal ba'i/ /gnas su skye ba blangs na/ /lcags bsreg 'bar ba'i thang la/ /bzhag nas mtshon cha sna tshogs/ /lus la char bzhin 'bab pa/ /la sogs sdug bsngal mtha' yas/ /bshad na bshad kyis mi lang / /'di dang phyi ma'i bar na/ /dbugs kyi phar rgyu tshur rgyu/ /191

'di tsam zhig las med do/ /dbugs kyi rgyu ba chad tshe/ /nges par las ngan myong ngo / /de bas rang la phyi thag /bsrings la sdig pa spongs shig /dam pa'i chos la 'bungs dang / /nga yis smra ba'i glu 'di/ /'phral gang rna ba tsha yang / /phugs su cis kyang phan gyi/ /nyams su longs par gyis shig /ces gsungs pas/ khong rnams shin tu mos shing phyag dang bskor ba byas/sngar byas la bshags sdom byas/ phyis mi byed par dam bcas la las chos byed sgom bsgrub la brtson par gyur/ zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang rig 'dzin chen po gang shar rang grol gyes/ o rgyan gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung / /gnod byed kyi dgra bgegs sgol ba de/ /dag zhing du rnam shes skyel ba'i rtags/ /mi khyod kyis de ltar skyel nus sam/ /grub thob kyi rgyal po sha wa ri/ /gti mug gi phag rgod gsod pa de/ /'khor ba yi rtsa ba gcod pa'i rtags/ /mi khyod kyis de ltar gcod nus sam/ /gsang sngags kyi rgyal po ispro bo/ /nyin mtshan med btsun mos bskor ba de/ /bde stong du 'dod chags 'ching ba'i rtags/ /mi khyod kyis de ltar 'ching nus sam/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug lwa ba pa/ /nyin mtshan kun gzims rnal mdzad pa de/ /'od gsal la rgyun chad med pa'i rtags/ /mi khyod kyis de ltar 192

gzims nus sam/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug wize pa/ /rgyal khams kyi chang 'thung mdzad pa de/ /zag med kyi bdud rtsir rol ba'i rtags/ /mi khyod kyis de ltar rol nus sam/ /lho brag gi mar pa lo tsā pa/ /khyim thab kyi longs spyod bsog pa de/ /'dod yon kun lam du longs pa'i rtags/ /mi khyod kyis de ltar longs nus sam/ /rang grol gyis 'brug pa kun legs pa/ /cha lugs la nges pa med pa de/ /gzung 'dzin gyi 'khrul ba zhig pa'i rtags/ /mi khyod kyis de ltar zhig nus sam/ /mkha' 'gro yi dbang phyug me long ba/ /mang gseb tu gcer bur rgyug pa de/ /a mthas kyi ngo tsha zhig pa'i rtags/ /mi khyod kyis de ltar zhig nus sam/ /mi mjed kyi ston pa shākya thub/ /khams gsum gyi 'du tshogs sdud pa de/ /gzhan rgyud kyi bsam pa mkhyen pa'i rtags/ /mi khyod kyis de ltar mkhyen nus sam/ /lar nyams myong la brtan pa ma thob par/ /rgyu 'bras la khyad gsod ma byed cig /gcan gzan gyi rgyal po mchongs rjes su/ /wa skyes kyis mchongs na ltag tshigs 'bud/ /the tshom med zhig pa'i ming can pa/ /sngar byas kyi las la 'gyod pa bskyed/ /da yong gi sdig spong dge sgrub la/ /nyin mtshan du dal med 'bungs na legs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rang gzhan kun gyis 193

las rgyu 'bras khyad du mi gsod par da nas bzung ste sdig spong dge sgrub la 'bad par bya'o/ /de ltar byed nus par spyi bo'i bla ma thub pa'i dbang bos byen gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyangs bya'o/ /smras pa/ 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus sa ler mkhyen/ /byams dang brtse bas 'gro la chos bstan nas/ /bde la 'god mkhas sangs rgyas thugs rje can/ /spyi bor bsgom nas de gsung glu ru len/ /sha chang bud med gsum gyi dbang du song / /chags sdang gti mug gsum gyis kun bslangs nas/ /mi gsod pa dang gzhan la gsod bcug na/ /shi na dmyal ba yang sos nang du skye/ /ra lug wa dang ri bong bye ba phag /bsad na dmyal ba bsdus 'joms gnas su skye/ /bla ma pha ma yon tan can bsad na/ /bskal ba gcig la mnar med dmyal bar skye/ /phan tshun 'khrugs nas g.yul ngor bsad gyur na/ /ral gri'i sen mo can gyi dmyal bar skye/ /sen mos lus kyi shig rnams bcom gyur na/ /brag gnyis bar du 'joms pa'i dmyal bar skye/ /'bru yi nang gi srog chags bsad gyur na/ /lcags kyi gtun shing dag gis brdungs bar 'gyur/ /rgya'am gdos kyi ri dwags bsad gyur na/ /yang sos nye 'khor mi 194

gtsang 'dam du skye/ /rnyed btsongs blang rgyu'i sems can gang yin yang / /bsad na dmyal ba lcags kyis bsgyur bar skye/ /gson por lcags zangs bcug nas rab bskol te/ /bsad na dmyal ba snod du btso bar skye/ /gnod pa sna tshogs byas nas bsad gyur na/ /gnod pa rnam par ma zhi dmyal bar skye/ /mchod sbyin phyir du sgo phyugs kha bsums nas/ /bsad na dmyal ba mun par sgye bar 'gyur/ /ri dwags skrag par byed cing gsod snyam na/ /dmyal ba kun tu mi dga' zhes byar skye/ /sems can mang bo bag med bsad gyur na/ /shi nas dmyal ba tshor ba bdo bar skye/ /gzhan yang srog gcod chen po'i dmyal bar skye/ /'bring gis yi dwags chung ngu dud 'gror skye/ /tsha grang bkres skom glen lkugs sdug bsngal myong / /mi ru skyes kyang tshe thung nad mang zhing / /lo 'bras sman sogs mthu chung yul du skye/ /srog gcod byed la dga' zhing gsod par 'gyur/ /slar yang ngan song gsum gye gnas su skye/ /sdug bsngal myong bzhin 'phral la sdig bsags na/ /nam yang ngan song gnas nas thar mi 'gyur/ /bdag gzhan kun gyis tshe rabs thams cad du/ /srog gcod las 'di byed par ma gyur cig /sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyi byen rlabs kyis/ /pha ma sems can srog la 195

byams par shog /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /srog gcod byed pa'i sgra yang mi thos shog /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//da ni mjug bsdu ba ni/ de ltar yang yang bshad na/ dus ngan bskal ba snyigs dus 'dir mi thams cad skyon gyi rang bzhin yin pa dang / khyad par sha chang bud med gsum la sred pa che ba'i chos par rlom pa phal che ba zhig gi mtshang la phog nas/ phan thogs ma dgos tshig pa zos nas/ bshad mkhan rang la dgra ru bltas te/ slar las ngan bsogs pa'i nyen 'dug de bas thub pa'i bstan pa nyams dma' ba'i dus 'dir gang la bsam kyang nyes pa'i rgyu kho na las mi 'dug pas/dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar gsung rnams sems la bcings te/ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su bsdad nas rgyal ba'i dgongs don bzhin rang rgyud 'dul ba la brtson par byas na legs te/bu ston rin po che'i zhal nas/ gnyis med gsungs pa'i nyin byed nub gyur cing / /bstan 'dzin skye bo'i thun mtshams 'od dang bral/ /nag po'i phyogs gyur sdig spyod 'byung bo'i bya/ /lta ngan sna tshogs bzung ste rang dgar spyod/ /chos min spyod pa'i phyogs ni stobs ldan zhing / /dam pa'i las la spyod rnams 196

nyams dus 'dir/ /bdag lta bu yi rtsom pas ci zhig bya/ /dben par bag yod byas na mi legs sam/ /kye ma kho bo sngon gyi bsod nams dman/ /chos nub log spyod dar ba bod kyi yul/ /blun po bkur zhing mkhas rnams rtsa ltar dor/ /chos ldan brnyas pa'i gangs ri'i yul 'dir skyes/ /dam pa'i tshul bzung tshul 'chos mkhan po ste/ /snyan par smra na mi chos kha gsag can/ /kun dang bstun na col chung blo sna mang / /rang tshugs bzung na gyong po shing lag can/ /bdag gis spyod pa ci ltar byas gyur kyang / /ngan pa'i bsnyad ma btags pa ma byung zhing / /thams cad dga' ba'i spyod pa ma shes pas/ /gcig pur dben par gnas na mi legs sam/ /bdag gis chos min smra ru chos dang 'gal/ /chos bzhin smra na bod rnams dgra ru sdang / /ci yang mi smra kun gyis blun zhes brnyas/ /kye ma da ni bdag gis ji ltar bya/ /nyan bshad bstan pa 'dzin ces gsungs pa yang / /nges 'byung rnam dag khrims la bsten bcas nas/ /nyan po gzur gnas don gnyer blo ldan la/ /mkhas pas sde snod 'chad la dgongs pa yin/ /tshe 'di'i snyan grags 'dod pas 'khor bsdus te/ /ma dad mi 'dod bzhin du chos 'chad cing / /lag len mi byed chags sdang sgye ba'i 197

rgyu/ /'chad nyan 'di yang 'khor ba'i zhags pa yin/ /rtsod pas bstan pa 'dzin ces bshad pa yang / /rang gzhan grub mtha'i gzhung lugs kun shes nas/ /pha rol yang dag lam la gzhug pa yi/ /lta ngan rigs pas bzlog la dgongs pa yin/ /rang nyid grags 'dod pha rol dma' dbab 'dod/ /g.yo sgyu'i rtsod pa tshig rtsub ngan sems can/ /ngag 'khyal sna tshogs smra zhing gzhan rgyud bsreg /de lta'i rtsod pa 'di yang dmyal ba'i rgyu/ /gzhan don chos kyi gtso bor gsungs pa yang / /gdul bya'i dbang bo khams dang bag la nyal/ /tshogs dang sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' shes shing / /rang don ma chags gdul bya 'dul la dgongs/ /rang nyid rnyed grags bde bstod don gnyer bas/ /mngon shes med par gzhan don byed pa ni/ /gshog pa med par mkha' la 'phur ba bzhin/ /gzhan don mi 'grub rang don nyams pa'i rgyu/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas mang bos ma thul zhing / /mthu chen rgyal sras rnams kyis ma thul ba/ /smad na khong khro bstod na dregs pa skye/ /mtho la phrag dog mnyam la 'gran sems can/ /dma' la nga rgyal rtsub pa'i sems 'chang ba/ /chos mthun tshig gis spras kyang chags sdang skye/ /byes pa'i skye bo 'di 'dra bdag gis ni/ /da ltar 'dul 198

bar mi nus rang sems thul/ /zhes dang / sa skya parnyi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi zhal nas/ blo gros gzur bor mi gnas shing / /sdug bsags byas pa'i rnal 'byor can/ /legs nyes dpyod pa'i shes rig med/ /deng sang blun po'i kun spyod mtshar/ /nor gyis nor 'tshol tshong ba la/ /g.yo sgyu che zhing smod par snang / dzun gyis nor 'tshol zog po la/ /ngo mtshar che zhes gtsug na mchod/ /yin lugs bshad na 'khon 'dzin byed/ /btang snyoms bzhag na bstan la gnod/ /g.yo can bla ma ring du spong / /rtog dpyod ldan pa'i skyes bu yis/ /yon tan mchog dang ldan pa len/ /yid 'ong pad+ma'i dzing bu la/ /'dab chags ngang ba ngang gis 'du/ /shes rig med pa'i blun po rnams/ /g.yo sgyu'i chos dang tshul la dad/ /'bad nas btsal kyang khye rgan gyis/ /a krad las gzhan ci zhig rnyed/ /blo gsal skye bo gzhan la phan/ /bsil drod sman gyis tsha grang sel/ /blo dman skye bo gzhan la gnod/ /sdong dum skam po 'chag pa'i rgyu/ /kye ma 'dzam gling byang phyogs 'dir/ /spang bya 'ga' yang ma spang zhing / /rtogs bya 'ga' yang ma rtogs pas/ /kun mkhyen thob pa'i dus mi snang / /kye hud deng sang thub bstan 'di/ /nub ri'i rtse la song ba yi/ /'od zer ldan 199

pa'i nyi ma bzhin/ /ring bor mi thogs nub par 'gyur/ /de bas blo ldan mkhas pa'i tshogs/ /cung zad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i khur 'dzin pa/ /tha snyad 'du 'dzi'i rtsol ba dor/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i 'o ma bsrubs/ /thos bsam mar gyi snying bo longs/ /rang don bsgrub pa'i blo dor la/ /gzhan phan nyi ma'i 'od zer bkye/ /shes bzhin dran pa'i gos gyon la/ /rin chen bstan pa'i rgyal sa gzung / de skad smra ba'i btsun pa ngas/ /khyad par gus ldan bla ma bsten/ /byed pa gnyis ldan gsung rab nyan/ /blang dor tshul la blo mig phye/ /gsungs/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ da lta shin tu ngan pa'i mis/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa nub tu nye/ /da ni ma bsngags ngan spyod dar/ /log par lta ba mang ba ma rmongs pa dag gis bcom ldan gyi/ /bstan pa'i ljon shing bcad kyis med/ /da ni snying rje med pa yis/ /chos lugs bor zhing rang bzo byed/ /brkam chags pha rol ma mthong bas/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsnyal gyes med/ /da ni gdul dka' ngo tsha med/ /sdig la dga' zhing tshul 'chos byed/ /sdig can rnams kyis thub pa yi/ / bstan pa'i zam pa bcag gis med/ /da ni mgo breg nyams mi len/ /spyod 'chal smad pa lus la 'chol ngan 200

g.yo can gyis thub pa yi/ /bstan pa'i tshong 'dus bcom gyis med/ /da ni khro dang nga rgyal dang / /rgyags cho4 byed cing rnyed la zhen/ /sdig pa sna tshogs byed pa'i mis/ /chos kyi gru bo bcag gis med/ /da ni thub pa'i bstan pa yang / /cung zad tsam zhig lus par zad/ /thub pa'i bstan pa gangs chen mtsho/ /ring bor mi thogs skam par 'gyur/ /seng ge'i sgra yi bstan pa ni/ dus kyi 'khor los rab bcom nas/ /myur ba nyid du 'jig par 'gyur/ /gang dag 'di 'dra'i dus bab tshe/ /bde 'dod rnams kyis phan pa'i don/ /da ni legs par brtag par rigs/ /dus kyi 'khor lo ngan byed pa/ /ma rabs shes rab 'chal ba dang / /tshul 'chal dag dang bsten mi shes/ /nyes pa bsten cing tshul khrims spangs/ /dben pas 'jigs shing 'du 'dzi 'dod/ /mi mkhas bslab nyes slob dpon nor/ /gdug rtsub nga rgyal brnyas smod che/ /ngan pa'i mi la yid rton pas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa ma rung zhes/ /zhi zhing bde ba'i dus ni zad/ /gdug rtsub mi zad dus ni byung / /shes rab can gyi mi rnams dang / /dpang gyur skye bo rnams ni zad/ /de lta'i dus rnams 'byung ba'i tshe/ /rang gi yul 'khor rnams spangs te/ /gzhan gyi ljongs su phyin nas kyang / /der yang 201

nags 'dabs dben pa ru/ /spra ba nyung ste gnas par bya/ /gsungs/ rje dge 'dun grub kyis/ lar da lta gangs ri'i khrod 'di na/ /rang bstan pa 'dzin par khas len yang / /gzhan bstan 'dzin dgra bo'i dwangs mar 'dzin/ /tshul 'di la skyo ba gting nas skyes/ /zhes dang / slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ /rgyal bas kyang ni ma mgu na/ /bdag 'dra ngan pas smos ci dgos/ /zhes dang / rje mi la ras pas/ bstod ra brjod na rang mthong skye/ /smad ra brjod na khong khro skye/ /yin lugs bshad pas mtshang la 'phog /gsungs/ rje rin po ches/ deng sang thub pa'i bstan pa nub tu ni nye/bstan pa'i rtsa lag mchog rnams ni 'das/ sems can gyi skal ba bzang bo bri ba'i skabs su ni gyur/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang sngags kyi theg pa'i nyams len gyi gnad snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i brgyud pa ni chad/ de'i stobs kyis bshad pa dang sgrub pa mdzad pa rnams kyang snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag gi gnad med par tshig dang yi ge tsam mthong ba dang / thos pa lta bur byas te/ lcags kyu med pa'i glang po che bzhin du/ rgyal ba'i bka' la gya tshom gyis zhugs nas/ rang rang gi 'dod pa'i dbang gis/ 'di bden gyi gzhan ni gti mug go /zhes 202

phyogs yongs su bzung nas nyams len cher mi byed par/ rtsod pa 'ba' zhig lhur len to/ /der ma zad gzhan gyi skyon 'ba' zhig rtogs pa la zhugs pas pha rol gyi yon tan la lta ba'i mig ni long / —rang gi skyon la rtog pa'i bsam pa ni bral/ rnyed pa dang bkur ste'i zhags pas bcings pa la brten nas/ lkog tu gyur pa'i gang zag dam pa re re tsam yod na'ang / phrag dos/ dang nga rgyal gyi mun pa chen pos blo yi mig bsgribs pas mthong ba'i lam du gyur pa ches shin tu dka'o/ /bdag gis kyang 'dod phyogs kyi bshad pa yod pa rnams la lo sbrel gyi bar du thos pa cung zad bgyis shing / man ngag zab par grags pa 'ga' yang yang zhus pa'i mthar/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyis dgongs pa/ thos pa'i rjes 'jug sgrub pa snying bor byed/ /skye ba'i rdzongs las tshegs chung thar bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rig nas sgrub pa la mos pa drag po byung gsungs/ mkhas grub rjes/ snum zad mar me lta bu'i bstan pa 'di/ /kho bo'i legs bshad go tshe blo gros kyis/ /rdzogs ldan bzhin du bya bar nus na yang / /skal ngan rnams kyis sa 'og gter bzhin sbas/ /da ni dus la bsdad pa med pa dang / /lang tsho'i dpal yang ston ga'i sprin ltar g.yo/ /skye bo phal cher skal ba med mthong 203

nas/ /mang thos bdag ni gcig pur chos don sems/ /zhes rang gi rtogs pa brjod nas/ dben gnas ri bo mdangs can nyid du phyag phab ste/ thugs dam nyag gcig tu gzhol bar mdzad do/ /de bzhin du mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtshos/ 'on kyang skye bo phal cher phal la chags/ /legs bshad don du mi gnyer phrag dog gis/ /legs par bshad dang mkhas pa'i tshogs la smod/ /'di 'dra'i skabs su dben pa bsten na legs/ /zhes gsungs/dam pa gong ma rnams kyi rnam par thar ba dang gsung bzhin ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su zab mo'i sgrub pa la gzhol bar bya'o/ /'dod yon 'du 'dzi'i nyes dmigs bsam na tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blos btang nas/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyis bsngags pa'i ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal du gnas rgyu'i skal ba zhig byung na/ nyes byas kyi sgo thams cad rang 'gags la song / yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad 'bad med lhun grub tu byung nas/ rang don 'grub pa tsam du ma zad/ gzhan don kyang 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung ba chos nyid yin te/ de yi rgyu mtshan ni dben par gnas pa tsam gyis/ 'jig rten gyi dbul phongs dang / gzhan dbang du 'gyur ba dang / khas 204

nyen dang / pho ma skyes pa dang / bkra mi shis pa dang / klung rta rgud pa dang / bde skyid med pa dang / mi mkhas pa dang / mi btsun pa dang / mi bzang ba dang / chos mi 'phel ba dang /tshe phyi ma'i bsod nams mi yong ba dang / thar ba mi thob pa dang / nyams rtogs yon tan mi skye ba dang / nyon mongs pa'i gnyen pos mi gnon pa dang / dngos grub mi thob pa dang /tshogs bsog mi nus pa dang / gdams pa mi zab pa dang /rgyal ba mi mnyes pa dang / 'gro don mi 'ong ba dang / grogs nye gnas ngan pa dang 'phrad pa dang / bu sogs nye du ngan pa dang 'phrad pa dang / rnyed pa mi thob pa dang / sbyin gtong med pa dang / smon gnas ngan pa dang bcas nyes skyon nyi shu rtsa lnga bo 'di ma spangs bzhin rang 'gags la 'gro/ gzhan yang / 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang /nga rgyal dang / phrag dog dang / ser sna dang / gyod sna dang / gtam ngan dang / brnyas smod dang / brdeg brdungs dang / bka' bkyon dang / khral 'jal dang / bu lon dang /'tsho skyong dang / bsogs pa dang / rku ba dang / 'phrog bcom dang / dmag las dang / dkor zas dang / dud chang dang / tshul 'chos dang / g.yo sgyu dang / ngal dub dang /205

lus nad dang / sems sdug dang bcas nyes skyon nyer lnga bo 'di yang shugs kyis 'gags nas/ phyug po'i rab dang /rang dbang thob pa'i rab dang / kha dregs kyi rab dang / pho skyes kyi rab dang / bkra shis ba'i rab dang / klung rta dar ba'i rab dang / bde skyid kyi rab dang / mkhas pa'i rab dang / btsun pa'i rab dang / bzang bo'i rab dang / chos 'phel gyi rab dang / phyi ma'i bsod nams kyi rab dang / thar ba'i lam gyi rab dang / nyams rtogs kyi yon tan gyi rab dang /gnyen pa'i rab dang / dngos grub kyi rab dang / tshogs bsags kyi rab dang / gdams ngag gi rab dang / rgyal ba mnyes ba'i rab dang / 'gro don gyi rab dang / grogs nye gnas kyi rab dang / bu sogs nye du'i rab dang / rnyed pa'i rab dang / sbyin pa'i rab dang / smon gnas kyi rab dang bcas yon tan nyer lnga bo 'di bsgrub mi dgos bzhin rang bzhin shugs kyis thob/ gzhan yang / lus sems bde ba dang / rgyun du dal ba dang / rig pa dwangs pa dang / nyams dga' spro ba dang bla ma dgyes pa dang / yi dam mnyes pa dang /mkha' 'gro 'du ba dang / yul lhas bsrung ba dang / snyan grags che ba dang / dad gus skye ba dang / dag snang 'byongs pa 206

dang / 'chi ba dran pa dang / nges 'byung dang / byams pa dang / snying rje ba dang / byang chub kyi sems dang / so thar sdom pa dang / byang sems sdom pa dang / sngags kyi sdom pa dang / sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang /brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab 'phel ba dang bcas yon tan nyer lnga bo 'di yang shugs kyis 'ong ba yin zhes spyan snga ba klong chen pa sogs bla ma gong ma mang pos gsungs/ des na ri khrod du bsdad pa la yon tan brgya phrag du ma yod tshul mthong nas/ skal bzang las 'phro can rnams kyis kyang ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal bsten pa la yid spro bar bya'o/ /'di ltar bshad pa sngon chad ma byung ba'i brjod rgyu zhig dang tshig gi sdeb sbyor legs po zhig dang / gzhan rgya chen po yod du re ba zhig ma yin mod/ 'on kyang rang gi yid la goms pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na gzhan 'ga' zhig gis mthong na phan srid snyam nas bshad pa yin te/ slob dpon zhi ba lha'i spyod 'jug las/ sngon chad ma byung ba yang 'dir brjod med/ /sdeb sbyor mkhas pa'ang bdag la yod min te/ /de phyir gzhan don bsam pa'ang bdag la med/ /rang gi yid la goms phyir ngas 'di brtsams/ /dge ba bsgom phyir bdag gi dad pa'i 207

shugs/ /'di dag gis kyang re zhig 'phel 'gyur la/ /bdag dang skal ba mnyam pa gzhan gyis kyang / /ci ste 'di dag mthong na don yod 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rnam 'grel las/ skye bo phal che phal la chags shing shes rab rtsal med pas na legs bshad rnams/ /don du mi gnyer kho nar ma zad phrag dog dri ma dag gis sdang ba dang / /yongs gyur des na bdag la 'di ni gzhan la phan pa yin zhes bsam pa'ang med/ /sems ni yun ring legs bshad goms pas lhur len bskyed phyir 'di la dga' ba skyes/ /zhes dang / dza yā parnyi ta'i zhal nas/ phal che bas chos don du mi gnyer/ gnyer kyang chags sdang gi dbang gis/rang la dga' ba rnams kyis bstan bcos la lta rtogs dang /mi dga' ba rnams kyis byas pa la kha gtong ba sogs kyi rgyu mtshan shes pas/ gzhan la phan yong bsam pa'i re ba med rung / blo gzu bor gnas pa 'ga' zhig dang / rang las blo dman pa rnams la phan pa'ang srid snyam zhing / gtso cher bstan pa'i mig rkyen la phan res lhag bsam rnam par dag pas rgyud skul te brtsams/ zhes dang / bu ston rin po che'i zhal nas/ ma ltar brtse ba'i bla mas legs bskyangs shing / /mi yi seng ge'i gsung rab pad+mo'i tshal/ /me tog la dga'i bung ba ltar bsten 208
