pas/ /mu mtha' yas pa'i chos la blo gros rgyas/ /de ltas bdag kyang shākya'i gsung rab mtsho/ /gting mtha' yas par brgal bar 'dod pa yin/ /de yi gting mtha' rtogs par ma nus kyang / /ngo mtshar don gyi rin chen cis mi rnyed/ /rnyed kyang dbul bo'i lag gi rin chen ltar/ /bdag gi legs bshad dri ma med pa 'di/ /'gran 'dod phrag dog sdang sems kyis bsgribs nas/ /gzur gnas yid ches gnas su su zhig len/ /len pa med kyang dam chos bdud rtsi yis/ /rang gi yid kyi zug rngu cis mi sel/ /gal te 'ga' zhig len na de dag gi /gdungs pa'i rims nad 'joms par mi 'gyur ram/ /zhes dang / rje rin po ches/ rang gi yid la goms par bya phyir dang / /skal bzang gzhan la'ang phan pa bya ba'i phyir/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i yongs su rdzogs pa'i lam/ /go sla'i ngag gis bshad pa'i dge ba des/ /'gro ba kun kyang rnam dag lam bzang dang / /'bral med gyur cig ces ni smon lam 'debs/ /rnal 'byor ngas kyang smon lam de ltar btabs/ /thar 'dod khyod kyang de bzhin 'debs 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rang rgyud dang phyi rabs 'ga' re la phan pa'i smon lam kyang 'debs pa legs so// 209

smras pa/ e ma rgyal sred mchil snabs bzhin du dor/ /dben par dka' ba spyad mthar sangs rgyas pa'i/ /ston pa thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyed kyi rnam thar zin par byin gyis rlobs/ /sangs rgyas khyed kyi gsung rab dgongs don bzhin/ /da dung yang yang bshad la rab spro yang / /deng sang dus ngan bskal ba snyigs dus 'dir/ /mang bo bshad na nyan mkhan snang ba sun/ /khyad par sha chang bud med dbang du song / /'dod sred che ba'i chos pa 'jig rten pa'i/ /mtshang la phog tshe phan pa phar la zhog /tshig pa zos nas tshig ngan bshad nyen gda'/ /kye ma thub pa'i bstan pa nyams dma' zhing / /rang yang 'chi la nye ba'i dus skabs 'dir/ /bshad pa bzhag nas dben pa'i dga' tshal du/ /dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar skyong la 'gro/ /sngon chad ma gsungs pa yi brjod rgyu zhig /med kyang chos la bag chags 'jog pa'i phyir/ /slar yang bshad pas rang dang skal ldan la/ /tshe rabs kun tu phan pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /'di la 'gal 'khrul nongs pa ci mchis pa/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas spyan sngar bshags/ /nongs pa rgyu bcas byang zhing dag gyur nas/ /'di las bstan 'gror phan par byen gyis rlobs/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal bstan nam gnas 210

bar/ /glegs bam 'di yang mi nyams sa steng 'dir/ /gnas nas sangs rgyas bstan pa'i zhabs tog dang / /'gro ba yongs la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /glegs bam gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /nad dang dbul phongs 'thab rtsod mi 'byung zhing / /mthong thos rgyud kyi 'dod sred kun zhi nas/ /dben pa'i gnas su bsam gtan bsgom par shog /bdag ni deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /'jam dbyangs dbyangs can lha mos rjes bzung nas/ /gting dpag dka' ba'i gsung rab rgya mtsho la/ /shes rab thogs pa med par 'jug par shog /lhar bcas 'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa yin par yid ches nas/ /skye ba kun tu snying stobs chen po yis/ /ston pa'i dam chos ma lus 'dzin gyur cig /rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang / /rgyal sras dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe brtan/ /rgyal blon 'khor 'bangs mnga' thang 'byor ba rgyas/ /rgyal khams bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /ces rmad byung sprul ba'i glegs bam zhes bya ba 'di ni rang nyid phyogs med kyi rgyal khams mang por 'khyams tshe/ chos pa 'jeg rten pa phal cher ba zhig la byams pa dang snying rje ni med/las rgyu 'bras kyang mi brtsi bar/ sha chang bud med gsum gyi 211

dbang du song nas/ srog gcod la sogs mi dge'i sdig pa byed pa mang bo mthong ba'i rkyen byas rtsom 'dun yod pa'i khar/lung rtogs yon tan du ma'i mnga' bdag dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med rin po che'i sprul sku dang / tsho 'du'i mkhan rin po che'i yang sprul/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa'i nyang gi mtshams pa dang / bsod nams rin chen/ lha bzo ba dang yi ger mkhas pa'i dge slong khro rgyal 'bum dang /lha khang dbu mdzad skal bzang skyabs/ thos bsam sgom la brtson pa'i slob bu gnas brtan dang / pad+ma dkar 'dris/bslab gsum rgyan gyis mjes pa'i spyi'i bla ma dang / stag yan dge slong / dad gtong blo gros che ba'i klu skyabs dge slong dang /bla rgan mgo dkar/ nges 'byung byang sems ldan pa'i mtshams pa rag shis dang / myang ba'i bla ma/ dad brtson snying rje che ba'i zho 'ong snyan grags dang / tshul khrims/ gzhan yang bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes shing 'phags nor bdun gyis phyug pa'i bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dge 'dun pa sogs skal ldan gyi slob ma/ dad ldan gyi sbyin bdag pho mo brgya phrag du mas bdag cag rnams dang / ma 'ongs pa'i gang zag rnams kyi sems la phan pa'i legs bshad cig dgos zhes bskul ba'i 212

ngor/ rang dang slob ma phyi rabs rjes 'jug rnams kyi shes rgyud kyi 'dod pa dang / chags zhen je chung du 'gro ba'i phyir/phyogs med kyi rgyal khams dang / nges med kyi ri khrod 'grim pa'i rnal 'byor zhabs dkar pas/ lhag bsam dag pa'i sgo nas/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi byang phyogs dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing gi shar phyogs/ mdo smad tsong kha'i skyes ri'i lho phyogs/ rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho'i 'khrungs yul/ reb gong gser mo ljongs kyi sa cha/ sngo ljang nags tshal rgyas pa'i gong rol/ spang gzhongs me tog bkra ba'i 'dabs rol/ rong dang 'brog pa gnyis kyi so mtshams ri bo ma tho la yangs pa nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil ba'i rtse mo nam mkha'i mthong rgya che zhing / 'od gsal nyi 'od 'khyil ba'i lha khang bde ba can nas sbyar ba'o/ /'dis kyang slob ma sbyin bdag pho mo rnams kyi gtso byas pas ma sems can thams cad la phan thogs par gyur cigagrangs med rgyal kun thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gar/ /mtshan ldan bshesi gnyen mchog gi rnam rol ba/ /skyabs gcig 'khor lo'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang / /byang chub thob kyang rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs/ /gang thugs zab gsang dpal gyi be'u las/ /213

thon pa'i rmad byung sprul ba'i glegs bam zhing / /bdag sogs skal ldan gdul bya'i gtsug nor du/ /sngon med 'gran bral rgyan mchog 'di na rmad/ /gsung rab 'di ni mthong dang thos pa dang / /dran pa tsam gyis skye rgu mtha' dag gi / mi dge rgyun chad dge bcu'i dpal la rol/ /rnam mkhyen sa mchog thob la som nyi bral/ /'di nyid 'bri brko byed po skal bzang skyabs/ /blo ldan bsam bzang bde chen la sogs kyis/ /rnam dag bsam pa'i blo yis dang blangs te/ /sor mo'i 'du byed rtsal las legs par bsgrubs/ /'dir 'bad dge bas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /drin can bla ma mchog dang mi 'bral zhing / /nges 'byung byang chub sems kyis rgyud sbyangs nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /sarba maṅga lo// 214

༄༅ / /bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i o rgyan sprul pa'i glegs bam bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ dri med nam mkha' lta bur rnam dag cing / /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i lha/ /thog ma'i sangs rgyas srid zhi yongs kyi dpal/ /chos sku kun tu bzang por gsol ba 'debs/ /snang srid 'khor 'das chos kun 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /mkha' ltar yangs shing nyi ltar rab gsal ba'i/ /don dam byang chub sems kyi gnas lugs de/ /rang gsal rjen par rtogs par byen gyis rlobs/ /zab gsal thugs kyi klong ni mkha' las yangs/ /'khor 'das chos rnams gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /so sor ma 'dres sa ler gzigs pa yi/ /drug pa rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgrib g.yogs kun bral phyi nang zang thal gyi/ /rang sems gsal stong me long chen po ru/ /'khor 'das chos rnams gzugs brnyan yongs shar nas/ /ltad mo thams cad mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'khor 'das 215

chos kun lag mthil skyu ru ra/ /rlon pa bzhag nas bltas ltar sa ler mkhyen/ /zhal nas nam yang rdzun gyi tshig mi gsung / /sangs rgyas thugs rje can la gsol ba 'debs/ /sprin med mkha' la nyi ma shar ba bzhin/ /blo gros snang ba phyogs med rab rgyas nas/ /shes bya'i chos rnams gcig kyang ma lus pa /thams cad sa ler shes par byen gyes rlobs/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ /chos sku yum chen mo la gsol ba 'debs/ /smra bsam brjod med yum chen ther phyin gyi/ /dgongs pa ji bzhin rtogs par byen gyis rlobs/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams mtha' yas na/ /bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas yongs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba kun gyis gsungs pa'i dam chos rnams/ /rtsol med rgyud la 'char bar byen gyis rlobs/ /mkha' ltar yangs shing nyi ltar gsal ba'i thugs/ /rje btsun gsang ba'i bdag por gsol ba 'debs/ /shes bya'i chos rnams me long gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /dri med sems la 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /thugs dgongs chos kyi dbyings las rab yangs pa'i/ /kun mkhyen 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /ji lta ji snyed chos rnams thams cad kyi/ /gnas lugs ji bzhin rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /216

phul byung stong nyid snying rje'i gter chen po/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ / byams dang snying rje bla med byang chub sems/ /bdag gzhan rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs las rab sprul ba'i/ /rig 'dzin pad 'byung zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' khyab pad 'byung thugs dang rang sems gnyis/ /dbyer med ro gcig 'dres par byin gyis rlobs/ /gsung rab yi ge na gcig yan chad po/ /gdams par shar nas gdul byar 'chad mkhas pa'i/ /jo bo yab sras gnyis la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsung rab gdams par 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel ma lus pa/ /thugs la shar nas gzhan la 'doms mkhas pa'i/ /rgyal ba yab sras gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos kun sems la 'char bar byen gyis rlobs/ /'khor 'das chos kun gzigs pa'i mkhyen rgya can/ /sa skya yab chen lnga la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag gzhan mi shes skog gyur 'khor 'das kyi/ /chos rnams sa ler shes par byen gyis rlobs/ /rtogs pa nam mkha'i khyon ltar rab yangs pa'i/ /bka' brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /stong gsal khyab gdal nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /sems kyi gnas 217

lugs rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /ye shes spyan gyes 'khor 'das chos kun gzigs/ /kun la dbang bsgyur dam pa sangs rgyas dang / /ma cig lab kyi sgron mar gsol ba 'debs/ /rtogs pa nam mkhar mnyam par byen gyis rlobs/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i thugs bcud zab rgyas chos/ /stsol mdzad rtsa ba'i bla ma thams cad la/ /gsol ba 'debs so chos lugs gang la yang / /dag snang phyogs med 'char bar byin gyes rlobs/ /chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i klong yangs su/ /rig pa gu yangs yan pa blo bde ngas/ /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /chos la dag snang sbyong tshul dga' bas 'chad/ /chos nyid yangs pa'i klong na dga' yal le/ /gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa yis gtso byas pa'i/ /phyogs bcu'i chos mdzad skye bo pho mo rnams/ /sems kha yangs po gyis la dga' bas nyon/ /de yang phan bde'i 'byung gnas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyi bstan pa spyi dang khyad par 'jig rten khams 'dir dar ba'i rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i ring lugs grub mtha' gang la'ang dad gus dag snang sbyong bzhin nyams len bya ba'i tshul cung zad tsam zhig brjod pa ni gang bshad par bya ba'i chos so/ /de ji ltar 'chad na/ chos pa 'jig rten pa rnams 218

yid ches shing khungs btsun pa'i phyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang / rgya bod kyi mkhas grub tshad ldan rnams kyi gsung gi lung 'dren mang po byas rigs pas kyang bsgrubs nas 'chad par bya ste/ de yang snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi ngo bo stong ba nyid dang /rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi ngo bo stong ba nyid dang /bla ma phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs kyi ngo bo stong ba nyid dang / phyi nang bar gsum gyi nam mkha'i ngo bo stong ba nyid rnams/ don dam pa 'od gsal stong ba nyid kyi ngang du rgya mtsho la rgya mtsho 'dres pa'am/ nam mkha' la nam mkha' 'dres bzhin so sor dbye ru med par ro gcig tu 'dres nas phyogs ris med par khyab/ rgya chad med par gdal ba/ 'gyur ba med par lhun gyis grub pa/ rtag pa rgyun gye khor mo yug tu gnas pa de nyid la/ chos kun gyi gdod ma'i gnas lugs mtha' bral chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i klong yangs zhes bya la/ chos kyi dbyings bde ba chen pa'i klong yangs po de na nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon/ chu nang du zla ba/ me long nang du gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs bskyed sgon lam dang / rang gzhan sems can thams 219

cad kyi spyi mthun gyi las bzang ngan bsags pa'i rgyu rkyen rten 'brel la brten nas rgyal ba rigs lnga'i zhing dang / rigs drug sems can gyi gnas rnams kyi gtso byas dag dang ma dag pa'i zhing khams rab 'byams mtha' yas mu med pa rgya khyon dpag tshad bsam las 'das pa chags shing / zhing khams de dag thams cad na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' tshad med grangs kyis mi zin pa dang / sems can gye rigs bsam gyis mi khyab brjod kyis mi lang ba rnams sgyu ma rmi lam gyi snang ba bzhin ma 'dres so sor snang zhing / zhing khams de rnams kyi sangs rgyas re re'i sku'i ba spu'i khung bu re re dang / sku'i phyi nang gi rdul phran re re'i khyen dang / zhing gi rdul phran re re'i steng na/phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rdul snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i zhing khams chags shing / sangs rgyas tshad med pa bzhugs nas/sems can grangs med pa la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba rnams kyang phan tshun 'dres pa med cing / gnod par 'gyur ba med par yangs cha dang bcas te gnas shing / zhing khams de dang de 'dra ba'i chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus par mtshams med par yongs su gang nas yod pa rnams rgya mtsho chen po'i wu ba'am/ chu yi chu bur bzhin zhing khams la chags pa la 'jig pa sogs 220

gang byed pa thams cad sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi sgrib med ye shes kyi spyan gyis so sor ma 'dres par sa ler gzigs pa'i tshe ngo mtshar ba'i ltad mo chen po yod par gsungs te/ dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas mdzad pa'i chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston las/ chos kun rang bzhin gdod nas rnam dag nyid/ /'gag pa med pa'i rang rtsal mtha' yas ni/ /gnas skabs dag dang ma dag sna tshogs pa'i/ /rten 'brel snang ba sgyu ma tsam du 'char/ /ji ltar me long ngos la bzhin snang ltar/ /'jig rten zhes bya phyi na yod min yang / /byes rnams ci tsam snang ba de tsam la/ /bden par bzhed de so sor a thang chad/ /ji ltar rmi lam snang ba sna tshogs de/ /snang dang mi ldan gnyis ka yin pa ltar/ /'khor 'das snang ba sna tshogs thams cad kyang / /bden brdzun bral ba de ltar shes par gyes/ /de bas gdul bya'i snang ba ji bzhin du/ /mngon pa gong 'og 'jig rten gdags pa dang / /dran pa nyer bzhag sangs rgyas phal po che/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dus kyi 'khor lo sogs/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos chen po mang zhig tu/ /'jig rten gnas tshul mi 'dra mang gsungs kyang / /rgyal bas 'jig rten zhen pas ma gzigs phyir/ /gang yang mi 221

gnas gang du'ang 'gal ba med/ /de'i phyir chos kyi rnam grangs thams cad la'ang / /ma chags mi zhen mi gnas mi 'dor ba/ /bung bas me tog rtsi bcud len tshul gyis/ /bdag gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'dir bshad bya/ /gling bzhi ri rab lha gnas dang bcas pa/ /rgya mtsho'i phyi rol khor yug gcig gis bskor/ /'og gi rlung bzhi dkyil 'khor la thug pa/ /'di ni gling bzhi'i 'jig rten khams gcig yin/ /chu zheng de yi nam mkha' 'das pa na/ /slar yang gling bzhi'i 'jig rten gzhan zhig yod/ /'di ltar gcig nas gnyis su brgyud pa yis/ /stong du tshang tshe rgya mtsho gcig gis brten/ /phyi rol khor yug gcig gis bskor ba ni/ /spyi phud stong gi 'jig rten khams zhes bya/ /de 'dra gcig nas gnyis su bgrangs pa ni/ /stong du tshang tshe stong gnyis bar ma yi/ /'jig rten khams zer rgya mtsho gcig la brten/ /phyi nas khor yug 'bring bos bskor ba yin/ /stong gnyis bar ma'i 'jig rten kho na ni/ /stong phrag gcig tu longs tshe stong gsum gyi/ /stong chen po yi 'jig rten khams zhes bya/ /gangs chen mtsho yi rgya mtsho chen pos brten/ /phyi rol khor yug chen pos yongs su bskor/ /gling bzhi re re'ang bye ba phrag brgya yod/ /'di tsam mnyam du chags shing 'jig pa ru/ /thun mong mngon pa'i bstan 222

bcos dag las bshad/ /mchog gi sprul sku gcig gi zhing du 'dod/ /theg chen ltar na stong gsum 'jig rten nyid/ /bye ba phrag brgya rab 'byams mtshams sbyor te/ /de nyid bye ba phrag brgyar longs pa na/ /rab 'byams rgyud ces bya ba'i 'jig rten khams/ /de yang bye ba phrag brgyar rtsis pa na/ /rab 'byams rgya mtsho bar ma'i rgyud ces bya/ /de yang bye ba phrag brgyar longs pa'i tshe/ /gzhi dang snying bo me tog gis brgyan pa'i/ /'jig rten khams te sprul sku gcig gi zhing / /re re'ang rang rang rgya mtsho'i khor yug bcas/ /zhing de'i rdul re langs de snyed gnas/ /'di tsam chags 'jig stongs gnas mnyam du byed/ /gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i/ /zhing khams de ni rnam snang gangs chen mtsho'i/ /spu'i khung re na'ang bye ba phrag brgyar gnas/ /sku yi rdul phran re la'ang de snyed gnas/ zhing de'i rdul re la'ang de snyed gnas/ /rnam snang de ni rgyal ba shāka thub 'di'i/ /longs spyod yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku yin te/ /de yi sku dang zhing la gang gnas pa'i/ /zhing khams de kun gcig tu bsdoms byas pa/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku re re'i zhing du gsungs/ /tshul 'di nam mkha' ji srid khyab gyur pa/ /de snyed rgyal ba'i sku dang zhing yang gnas/ /shin tu nges pa'i don du sku 223

dang zhing / /tshad med pha mtha' bzung bar mi nus so/ /de ltar 'jig rten rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa/ /la la nyon mongs la la yongs su dag /la la kun nas nyon mongs dag par ldan/ /la la dag zhing kun nas nyon mongs te/ /la la spyi'u tshugs la la snel zhi'i zhing / /rgyu dbyibs rgyan dang 'gro ba'ang tha dad nyid/ /de ltar pha mtha' yas par gnas pa las/ /kho bo cag gi brten gnas zhing 'di ni/ /rnam par snang mdzad gangs chen mtsho rgyal de'i/ /phyag gi lhung bzed nang na pad+ma yi/ /sdong bo yal ga me tog rab rgyas pa'i/ /ze'u 'bru nyer lnga brtsegs mar gnas pa las/ /bcu gsum pa yi steng na gnas pa yi/ /dbus ma'i snying bo me tog gis brgyan zhing / /de las dbus kyi rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i zhing / /de las dbus kyi rab 'byams rgyud kyi zhing / /de yang dbus kyi rab 'byams mtshams sbyor zhing / /de'i dbus gling bzhi ri rab bye ba ni/ /phrag brgyas brgyan pa mi mjed 'jig rten khams/ /'gro rnams nyon mongs las mi mjed pa'i phyir/ /zhing gi skyon nas smad par bya ba dang / /zhing 'di'i sems dpa' rnams ni lhag par yang bzod dang ldan pa'i yon tan bsngags pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten khams 'di mi mjed ces su brjod/ /ces dang / bskal ba bzang bo 224

'di yi 'og rol tu/ /mun bskal chen po drug cu 'das pa'i rjes/ /sgon bskal snyan pa chen po zhes bya ba/ /de la sangs rgyas khri phrag gcig 'byung ngo / /de nas mun bskal chen po khri 'das nas/ /skar ma bkrams pa zhes bya'i sgron bskal la/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas brgyad khri tshang bar 'byung / /yang ni mun bskal sum brgya 'das pa'i 'og /sgon me'i bskal chen yon tan bkod pa la/ /rgyal ba brgyad khri dang ni bzhi stong 'byung / /de tsam mdo las rgyal bas lung du bstan/ /de bzhin nam mkha' ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /bskal ba'i phyi mtha' thug pa yod ma yin/ /'di ni 'jig rten khams 'di'i rnam gzhag ste/ /de bzhin phyogs bcu'i nam mkhas gar khyab par/ /dag dang ma dag zhing khams rgya mtsho rnams/ /kha cig stongs shing la la 'jig dang chags/ /gzhan dag gnas sogs rgya mtsho'i lbu ba ltar/ /go mtshams med cing rgyun mi 'chad par snang / /zhing khams mtha' dag mthong ba'i mig dag pa/ /'phags mchog rnams kyi gzigs yul ltad mo che/ /zhes gsungs/ kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pas mdzad pa'i rdo rje glu'i dkar chag las/ chos thams cad gdod ma nas rnam par dag pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams rgya chad dang phyogs lhung med par rgyal 225

ba thams cad chos kyi skur ro gcig tu gyur pa las/ rang byung ye shes 'gag pa med par gsal ba'i dgongs/ pa las bzhengs te/ gnas rnam dag stug po bkod pa longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhing du/ rigs lnga mtshan rdzogs rdo rje 'chang gi zhing khams su bkod pa las/ thugs rje sprul ba'i skur bzhengs te gdul bya'i don du zhing khams rnam par bkod pa'i rigs lnga gangs chen mtsho so sor snang ba las/ shar phyogs su mi bskyod pa gangs chen mtsho yi phyag mthil na/ rdo rje rnam par brtsegs pa'i zhing khams nyi shu rtsa lnga brtsegs mar gnas shing / ba spu'i khung bu thams cad nas spos chu'i rgyun gangs chen mtsho 'bab pa la zhing khams gangs chen mtsho brten pa dang / lho phyogs su rin chen 'byung ldan gangs chen mtsho'i phyag mthil na/ rin po che rnam par brtsegs pa'i zhing khams nyi shu rtsa lnga brtsegs mar gnas shing / ba sru'i khung bu thams cad nas spos chu'i rgyun gangs chen mtsho 'bab pa la zhing khams gangs chen mtsho brten pa dang / nub phyogs su snang ba mtha' yas gangs chen mtsho'i phyag mthil na pad+ma rnam par brtsegs pa'i zhing khams nyi shu rtsa lnga brtsegs mar gnas shing / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas spos chu'i rgyun gangs chen mtsho 'bab pa la 226

zhing khams gangs chen mtsho brten pa dang / byang phyogs su don yod grub pa gangs chen mtsho'i phyag mthil na rgya gram rnam par brtsegs pa'i zhing khams nyi shu rtsa lnga brtsegs mar gnas shing / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas spos chu'i rgyun gangs chen mtsho 'bab pa la zhing khams gangs chen mtsho brten pa dang /dbus phyogs su rnam par snang mdzad gangs chen mtsho'i phyag mthil pad+ma'i steng na/ 'khor mo rnam par brtsegs pa'i zhing khams nyi shu rtsa lnga brtsegs mar gnas shing / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas spos chu'i rgyun gangs chen mtsho 'bab pa la zhing khams gangs chen mtsho brten pa thams cad na/ gdul bya sems can gyi rigs khams gsum rigs drug 'khor ba'i chos so cog rang snang ba so so'i ngo kha la/ 'dul byed rgyal ba'i sprul skus gang la gang 'dul dpag tu med pa'i chos kyi sgo dang /theg pa'i rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pas/ 'gro ba rnams mngon par mtho ba dang / nges par legs pa'i byang chub la 'god pa'i 'phrin las dpag tu med pa mdzad pa las/ khyad par du rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhing khams gzhi dang snying bo me tog gis brgyan pa 'khor lo rnam par brtsegs pa las/ bcu gsum pa thugs gtad dpal gye be'u la brten pa'i 'jig rten 227

gyi khams mi mjed ces bya ba gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas bye ba phrag bcus bkod pa/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gye khams bskal pa bzang bo'i rdo rje 'chang dang thub pa sprul pa'i sku stong gis gdul zhing so so'i sku bye ba phrag brgya brgyar sprul nas snga phyir gshegs shing da ltar bzhugs pas/ chos kyi sgo dang theg pa'i rnam grangs dpag tu med pas sems can gyi don mdzad pas/ khyad par du gling bzhi bar ma'i 'jig rten mi mjed lho yi 'dzam bu gling gi tshe lo brgya ba'i dus su/ dpal kun tu bzang po rdo rje 'chang gi sgur bzhengs te/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / de nyid thun mong gi gdul bya la shākya thub pa'i skur bzhengs te/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas zhi ba'i dbyings su mnyam par bzhag pa'i rjes su/ phyi nang gi bka' bsdu bar mdzad de/ de dag gi don blo dman pa rnams kyis rtogs par bya ba'i ched du rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa so so'i don phyin ci ma log par bstan pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dge ba'i bshes gnyen du sprul nas sngags dang mtshan nyid kyi theg pa so so'i don 'grel bar mdzad pa'i padhi ta rgyan drug mchog gnyis la sogs dpag tu med pa dang / grub chen brgyad cu la sogs 228

pa mtha' yas pa'i tshogs su sprul te/ 'phags pa'i yul du chos kyi sgron me snang bar mdzad pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sprul par bshad de/ rnga bo che'i mdo las/ mya ngan ma byed kun dga' bo/ /nga ni phyi ma'i dus su ni/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyid sprul nas/ /khyod la sogs pa'i don byed 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar 'dzam bu'i gling 'di nyid du sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa bla ma dag pa'i bshes gnyen mkhas shing grub pa dpag tu med pa snga phyir/ sems can gye don la byon pa thams cad kyis bka'i dgongs pa dpag tu med pa bkral zhing don gyi snying bo phyogs gcig tu bsdu bar mdzad pa las/ rgya gar chu bo gaṅgā phan chad grub thob brgyad cu la sogs rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug brnyes pa dpag tu med pa byon pa rnams kyis gdul bya'i don du/ phyi nang gi nges pa don gyi snying bo rdo rje'i mgur la sogs pa dpag tu med pa bzhengs shing / khyad par mnga' ris bod kyi yul gangs can ri bo'i 'gram/ rigs gsum mgon po'i gdul zhing me tog ku mu da'i kha rgyas pa lta bu'i khrod 'di nyid du bde bar gshegs pa'i sprul pa yang dag pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa dpag tu med pa snga phyir gshegs shing byon pa rnams kyis 'gro ba'i 229

don la chos kyi sgo dang / theg pa'i rnam grangs dpag tu med pa gsungs shing khyad par bstan pa snga dar gyi dus na/ bsam yas mchims phur grub chen nyi shu rtsa lnga/ lha sa dang yer par grub chen brgya rtsa/ lho brag mkhar chur nyi shu rtsa gcig dpal chen chu bo rir sum cu rtsa lnga la sogs pa byon pa rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu dang mgur bzhengs pa bsam gyis mi khyab la/ bstan pa bar dar gyi dus su yang bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i don la grub pa brnyes pa du ma byon zhing / rdo rje'i glu mgur du bzhengs pa tshad med pa las/ de dag gi nang nas phul du gyur pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mar pa mi la dang / dwags po gling ras dang /'khrul zhig rgya ras dang / grub chen me long rdo rje la sogs pa rnams kyis ri khrod phyogs med du 'grims sgrub pa snying bor mdzad dka' spyad dang du blangs/ chos nyid zab sar 'khyol bas/ rang don rtogs pa'i mgur bzhengs pa dang / khyad par du tshe gcig gis bla na med pa'i byang chub 'dod pa rnams dang /snying bo'i nges don nyams su len par 'dod pa rnams dang /thar ba dam pa'i rigs la gnas pa rnams zhi ba'i chos la bskul ba'i phyir/ gzhan don du rdo rje'i mgur bzhengs pa la mtha' yas/ zhes dang / dza ya parnyi ta'i zhal nas/ rgyal ba'i 230

dbang po rnams ni nam yang zab mo'i chos kyi sku las g.yo ba med bzhin du/ ji ltar yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po dang / dpag bsam ljon shing las 'dod dgu mtha' dag 'byung ba'am/ nor bu chu shel dri ma med pa tshon sna tshogs pa dang phrad na de dang de'i kha dog mdzes par 'dzin pa ji lta ba bzhin gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa dang /dbang po'i rim pa dang mthun par sprul pa'i gzugs kyi rnam rol bgrang bar dka' ba ji snyed pa dag ston pa yin te/ /mdo las/ rgyal pos 'dul ba la rgyal po/ dge sbyong gis 'dul ba la dge sbyong / bram zes 'dul ba la bram ze/ dri zas 'dul ba la dri za/ rgan po'i gzugs su sprul to zhes dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ re 'ga' zhi la re 'ga' khro/ /re 'ga' bgegs chen don mdzad cing / /sgyes dang ri bo thams cad do/ /zhes dang / gur las/ gang du snang nas kyang sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /so sor snang nas kyang sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /chang 'tshong ma dang / smad 'tshong mar snang nas sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs pas/ mtshon nas zhing khams la lar dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i snang brnyan/ la lar mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa'i sangs rgyas dang / gzhan yang 231

byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang mkhas pa parnyi ta dang / grub pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la gnas pa dang / a wa dhu ti dang / bhu su ku dang / ku sā li dang /'khor los bsgyur ba la sogs pa'i rgyal po dang / khams kyi rgyal phran dang blon po dang / bram ze dang / dge sbyong dang /khyim bdag dang / yid bzhin nor bu dang / gru gzings dang /zam pa dang / sman dang / zas dang / gos dang / ri bo dang / bya dang / ri dwags la sogs pa mdor na snod bcud kyi rnam pa 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i gzugs kyi rnam rol du mas 'gro ba rnams rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i spyod pa dang /gtam gyis mtshams sbyar te mthar nges par zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa chen bo'i sar bkri bar mdzad pa kho na las mi 'da' ba yin la/ de dag gi nang nas kyang ches cher rab mchog phul du byung ba gtso bo'am dam par gyur pa ni/ thar 'dod rnams la ma nor ba'i lam tshul bzhin du 'doms par mdzad pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa/ de las kyang zab mo'i smin grol gye bka' drin stsol ba'i mtshan nyid ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi gzugs kyi rnam par rol ba rnams yin te/ ba tshwa can gyi chu klung gi mdo las/ lnga brgya tha mar gyur pa na/ /nga nyid slob 232

dpon gzugs 'dzin te/ /nga yin snyam du yid byos la/ /de'i tshe de la gus pa bskyed/ /ces dang / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gye rgyud las/ de ltar slob dpon gzugs 'dzin te/ /sems can rjes su bzung dmigs nas/ /phal ba'i gzugs su gnas pa'o zhes gsungs/ rje btsun gsang ba'i byen gyes mdzad pa'i skyes bu gsum gyi lam gye rim pa 'khrid du sbyar ba las/ gling bzhi ba dang nyi zla dang / /ri rab dang ni 'dod lha dang / /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten stong la ni/ /stong ni spyi phud yin par 'dod/ /de stong la ni stong gnyis pa/ bar ma'i 'jig rten khams su 'dod/ /de stong la ni stong gsum ste/ /mnyam du 'jig cing 'byung ba yin/ /sprul pa'i sku yi zhing khams so/ /stong gsum bye ba phrag brgya la/ /mtshams sbyor 'jig rten khams su 'dod/ /mtshams sbyor bye ba phrag brgya la/ /rgyud kyi 'jig rten khams su 'dod/ /rgyud kyi 'jig rten bye ba brgya/ /bar ma'i 'jig rten khams yin no/ /bar ma bye ba phrag brgya la/ /bkod pa rab 'byams 'jig rten khams/ /longs sku'i zhing khams yin par 'dod/ /spyir du 'jig rten mtha' med cing / /nam mkha'i khams kyang mtha' med la/ /sems can khams kyang mtha' med do/ /ga sungs/ yang mi mjed kyi zhing ni/ mngon pa mdzod kyi 233

gnas gsum pa'i 'grel ba las/ sangs rgyas gangs chen mtsho'i lhung bzed kyi nang na/ stong gsum nyi shu rtsa lnga brtsegs yod pa'i bcu gsum pa mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'di yin/ steng 'og 'jig rten gyi khams rnams kha cig zla ba khams pa lta bu/ kha cig pad+ma'i dbyibs lta bu/ kha cig shing rta'i dbyebs lta bu/ steng g.yogs med pa dang / la zhi dang /spyi'u tshugs la sogs pa'i dbye ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kha cig na nyi zla med par sangs rgyas nor bu brtsegs pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu'i 'od kyis gsal bar byed pa dang / stong gsum gcig na nyi zla gcig gis byed pa sogs mang du gsungs snang / mi mjed kyi zhing 'dir gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa re re la nyi zla re re'i bya ba byed do/ /zhes bshad do gsungs/ sems nyid ngal gso'i 'grel ba shing rta chen mo las/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams te/ mchog gi sprul sku gcig gi sku mnyam du bstan nas/mdzad pa bcu gnyis snga phyi med par snang bas 'dul ba'i 'jig rten zhes bya'o/ /de las gzhan pa'i phyogs bcu na 'jig rten la tshad med de/ zlum po dang / zla gam dang / gru bzhi la sogs pas nam mkhas gar khyab na khyab cing / sems can 234

la'ang mgo steng du lta ba dang / 'phred dang thur du lta ba'i rigs tshad med pas gang ba yin gsungs/ rje btsun tshul khrims blo bzang gis mdzad pa'i man ngag nyer mkho mthong ba don ldan las/ zhing gi bkod pa'i dbyebs ni/ nor bu dang /rgya mtsho dang / ri rab dang / rdo rje dang / seng ge dang / lha'i dbang po'i gtsug phud dang / zla gam dang / nyi zla dang / bad+ma dang / mig dang / mdzod spu dang / sangs rgyas kyi phyag lta bu la sogs pa yin te/ mdo phal po che las/ phyogs rnams kun na zhing rnams rgya mtsho snang / /la la zlum po la la zur gsum ste/ /de dag la la phyogs na gru bzhir gnas/ /nor bu pad+ma 'khor lo yan lag brgyad/ /kun kyang las rnams rgya mtshos rnam par bris/ /zhes so/ /'jig rten la la na gling bzhi yod la/ la la na gling bzhi med pa'i sgo nas 'jig rten rnams mi 'dra ba yin te/mi mjed 'di na gling bzhi yod la/ bde ba can gling bzhi med/sangs rgyas ri rab 'od yang dag par 'phags pa'i zhing yid rab tu dga' ba zhes bya ba na/ 'dzam bu gling la dpag tshad bye ba yod la/ gling gzhan gsum la brgyad khri brgyad khri yod par bshad/ shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams na gser dngul gyi them skas la 'dzegs te sum cu rtsa gsum du 235

'gro ba dang / mi rnams lha la mi smon cing / lha rnams 'dzam bu'i gling na sangs rgyas bzhugs zhes smon par mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing gi bkod pa las gsungs so/ /'jig rten la la na 'od med la/ la la 'od dang bcas pa ste/ phal po che las/ zhing rnams la la 'od med de/ /mun pa'i 'jigs pa shin tu che/ /reg na sdug bsngal spu gri 'dra/ /lta na mi bzod skyi yang g.ya'/ /zhing rnams la la lha 'od can/ /la la khyem gyi 'od can te/ /la la nyi zla'i 'od dang ldan/ /zhing rnams la la rang gi 'od/ /shing gi 'od can dri ma med/ /la la ri yi 'od can te/ /zhing rnams la la nor bu'i 'od/ /la la mar me'i 'od can te/ /zhing rnams la la sangs rgyas 'od/ /zhing rnams la la pad+mo'i 'od/ /spos chu'i 'od dang ldan pa yod/ /smon lam dbang gis rnam par snang / /zhes so/ /'jam dpal zhing gi bkod pa las/ sangs rgyas nor bu brtsegs pa'i rgyal po'i zhing na nyi zla med par sangs rgyas kyi smin mtshams kyi 'od kyis gsal bar byed par bshad/ sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po'i zhing mi 'dzum pa bya ba na/ stong gsum ril bo nyi zla zung gcig gis snang bar byed par bshad do/ /'jig rten rgyan med pa dang / rgyan dang bcas pa yod/ rgyan yod pa la'ang rin po che dang dpag bsam gyi shing la sogs 236

pa'i sgo nas tha dad pa du ma yod de/ phal po che las/ zhing gi rgyan mang bye ba yis/ /zhing rnams la la legs par bris/ /rgyan dang tshul rnams tha dad par/ /sna tshogs mig yor lta bur snang / /zhes so/ /de bzhin du 'jig rten la la sangs rgyas med/la la na sangs rgyas yod/ de yang stong gsum gcig na sangs rgyas gcig yod pa dang / sangs rgyas mang bo yod pa'ang yod te/ phal bo che las/ zhing rnams la la sangs rgyas med/ /zhing rnams la la sangs rgyas bcas/ /la la'i zhing na sangs rgyas gcig /la la sangs rgyas mang po'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'jig rten la la bskal ba gcig tu gnas pa dang / 'jig rten la la bskal ba du mar gnas pa yod de/ phal po che las/ zhing rnams la la bskal ba tsam/ /la la bskal ba bcu ba ste/ /zhing rnams la la rdul mnyam pa'i/ /bskal ba bye bar brjod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs la/ /de bzhin du phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par/ 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med pa chags nas sems can dpag tu med pas gang nas yod pa yin te/ bzang spyod las/ nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ci tsam pa sems can ma lus mtha' yang de tsam mo/ /gsungs/ de rnams la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen 237

po bskor bar gsungs te/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rdo rjes/mkhas par grags pa 'ga' zhig gis sbyar ba'i yi ge las/mdzod kyi tshig rigs de kho na snying bor bzung nas/ gling bzhi la dbang ba'i 'khor los bsgyur ba las lhag pa'i 'khor lo can ma bshad do snyam yus pa'i tshig gleng mod na'ang / mdo rgya cher rol ba las/ 'og min yang stong gsum gye khongs su gtogs par bshad cing / stong gsum la dbang ba'i 'khor los bsgyur ba yod pa chos dang don rnam par nges pa las 'byung / phal chen las ni/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po rin chen mang zhes bu dang bcas pas zhing khams grangs med pa la longs spyod par yang bshad cing / 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ mang pos bkur ba la sogs pa'i rgyal po rnams rigs sngags grub par yang bshad/ dus kyi 'khor lo las/ rtsod pa'i dus su rigs ldan drag po zhes bya ba'i 'khor los bsgyur bas gling bcu gnyis la chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur bar bshad pa sogs mdzod las ma bshad pa'i gtam mang po zhig mchis pas/mang du thos pas blo gros btsal bar bya'o zhes dang / rdzogs pa chen po dgongs pa zang thal gyi rgyu 'bras kyi dbye ba mun sel sgon me las/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi byang shar gyi mtha' na pho 238

thams cad khye gzugs/ mo thams cad bud med kyi rnam pa dang /shar lho'i mtshams na pho thams cad phag gzugs/ mo thams cad bud med kyi rnam pa dang / lho nub kyi mtshams na pho thams cad srin gzugs/ mo thams cad bud med/ nub byang mtshams na pho thams cad ra'i gzugs/ mo thams cad bud med kyi rnam par yod par gsungs pas/ rgya nag phyogs su khyi mgo can lus po mi la khyi'i mgo can khye skad sgrog cing khye dri mnam pa yul de'i bud med thams cad lha ltar mdzes pa la/ mo rigs rnams khye mgo can la mi dga' ba/ khye mgo can rnams rgya nag pho brang gi phyogs su yong dus de rnams khye'i sha la dga' bas/ khye thams cad gsod mkhan zhig 'dug zer te/ byang shar gyi khyi mgo can ni de dag yin pa 'dra'o/ /rgya yul gyi phyogs shig tu spang bu chung zhes pa mi mtho gang tsam pa las skyes pa'i lung ba khengs pa la bod nas 'ol pa rnams 'ong dus de thams cad 'ol bas za ba la/ dpung bsgril te mda' chung 'phen pa sogs yod zer/yang rgya'i phyogs 'ga' zhig tu rgya phrag mig can zhes phrag mgo gnyis na mig yod pa dang / tsu ta'i yul du mi thams cad rkang ba gcig pa/ 'gro dus mi gnyis bsdebs/ lag pas dpung pa phan tshun la 'khyud de rgyug pa yod zer/ sham+bha la'i yul gyi 239

gangs ri'i mthar gnas pa'i skye pho rnams kyi pho'i dbang bo brla g.yas dang mo'i dbang po brla g.yon par gnas pa ste phyed lus can yod par gsungs la/ de 'dra bas mtshon pa'i mir skyes kyang lus kyi rnam 'gyur ma rungs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod par 'dug gzhan yang tshe lo bcu pa'i dus su skyes pa rnams lo bcu thub pa'i smon lam 'debs/ bu mo skyes pa rnams lo lnga lon pa na khyem thab la gtong / bong tshad ring ba la tshe lo brgya pa'i mtho gang dang / thung ba la chag gang 'byung bar gsungs/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i mdo las/ 'di nas byang shar gyi phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams bzhi khri nyis stong 'das pa na/mya ngan gyis 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams la dbyar zla drug gi ring la char gtan nas mi 'bab pas 'bru dkon zhing / skye bo thams cad gzugs ngan pa/ nyon mongs che ba/ sa phyogs thams cad tsher mas gang ba/ chu rnams kyang snum gye snyigs ma bzhin du 'bab pa zhig tu/ rgyal po chags sdang zhes bya bas 'bangs kyi 'bru nor thams cad phrogs nas chad pas gzir bar byed pa zhig yod par/ de'i 'jig rten du sangs rgyas snying rje'i sems yid la byed pa zhes bya ba phebs nas lo bdun gyi bar du chos bstan kyang / 'jig rten de'i skye 240

bo gcig gis kyang don ma rtogs/ skye bo thams cad kyis brnyas smod bsdigs pa la sogs pa'i bsnyen bkur ma yin pa kho nas dus 'das kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa ni skyo ngal med par bzhugs te/ de nas lo bdun brgya'i 'og tu skye bo khrag khrig sum brgya sum cu so drug 'bras bu bzhi la 'god par mdzad ces dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas spyod 'jug gi rnam bshad du gsungs pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams mthe bong can zhes bya bar sgyes pa'i skye bo thams cad lus tshad mthe bong tsam las med pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa khru gang tsam pa'i tshad du byon nas chos ston pa sogs mtha' klas pa bsam mi khyab kyi bshad tshul ji snyed cig yod de/ 'di dag blo la chud pa la theg pa chen po'i gzhung mang po zhig thos bsam bgyis shing / bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs pa la rag las zhes 'ol kha bzhad pa'i rdo rjes gsungs/ snying rje pad+ma dkar po las/'jig rten gyi khams mthe bong can na tshe lo bcu ba'i dus su/mi mthe bong tsam gyi nang du/ sangs rgyas skar ma la dga' ba zhes bya ba sku khru gang ba sor bdun gyi tshad tsam pa yod par bshad ces bu ston chos 'byung las gsungs/ yang kha cig na re/lus dang lus 'phags na rkang bzhi ba gnas/ sgra mi snyan gu ge 241

rkang gsum/ de'i zla ba la co la mig bzhi/ rnga yab na srin po gdong ring / rnga yab gzhan na mig gsum pa/ g.yo ldan na ko ci rna bo che/ lam mchog 'gro na gi cha mgo gnyis pa gnas zhes bcom ldan ral gris ṭīka na bkod 'dug zer/ sngon bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can gyes/ dam chos pad dkar gsungs pa'i snga dro'i yun gcig bar bskal lnga bcu'i yun tsam du snang ba'i rdzu 'phrul bstan pa'i lo rgyus bzhin du sangs rgyas dang sar gnas kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bskal pa mang po skad cig dang / skad cig bskal bar bsgyur nus/stong gsum yungs 'brur shong ba dang / yungs 'brus stong gsum khyab par byed nus/ 'das pa ma 'ongs pa dang / ma 'ongs pa 'das par bsgyur ba la sogs pa rnam par 'phrul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa ston nus par gsungs te/ rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud las/ de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings nyid la/ /dus gsum dus bzhir mi dmigs kyang / /ye shes rig pa'i khyad par las/ /skad cig bskal pa de skad cig gsungs/ /gzhan yang gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa las/ 'jig rten mgon po skyob pa yis/ /bsam gtan las dang klu rnams dang / /sangs rgyas bdag nyid che rnams kyi/ /bsam gyis mi khyab bzhir bshad do/ /242

zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ bsam gtan pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mthu dang / las kyi mthu dang / klu mchog gi rdzu 'phrul dang /sangs rgyas kyi mthu bzhi ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas bzhi yin par gsungs/ khyad par du sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ sngon byang chub sems dpa' shugs 'chang gis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gtsug tor gyi mtha' rtogs par 'dod nas/ sum cu rtsa gsum dang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten dang / de bzhin du steng phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya 'das pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams brjo can zhes bya ba na de bzhin gshegs pa pad+mo'i dpal gye snying po'i rgyal po bzhugs pa'i sa rnams su rim gyis phyin te bltas kyang dbu'i gtsug tor gyi mtha' ma mthong bar phyir bog gsungs pas na/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab/ sngon mo'u 'gal gyi bus sangs rgyas kyi gsung gis ci tsam la khyab blta dgongs nas nub phyogs bde ba can dang /de nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bye phrag brgya 'das pa na 'od zer can gyi 'jig rten gye khams zhes bya ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer kun nas 'byung ba 'khor bcas bzhugs pa'i gnas su byon te nyan pas kyang gsung chung du ma song da 243

dung kyang lhang lhang thos pas gsung gi mtha' ma mngon par phyir log gsungs pas na/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab/ thugs kyis kyang shes bya thams cad la yongs su khyab pa yin te/ gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma las/dgongs pa zab mo nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /cir yang sa le'i thugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsungs pa dang / bsngags 'os bsngags bstod las/ khyod 'ba' zhig gi ye shes kyis/ /shes bya thams cad khyab lags kyi/ /khyod las gzhan pa thams cad kyis/ /shes bya kho na lhag pa lags/ /zhes dang / bcom ldan dus kun rtogs pa'i chos/ /rnam kun 'byung gnas thams cad ni/ /lag mthil skyu ru ra lta bur/ /khyod kyi thugs kyi spyod yul gyur/ /chos rnams g.yo dang mi g.yor bcas/ /gcig dang sna tshogs so so la/ /mkha' la rlung dag rgyu ba bzhin/ /khyod kyi thugs dag thogs mi mnga'/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad lag mthil du sgyu ru ra rlon pa bzhag nas bltas pa ltar/ thams cad sa ler mkhyen pas na sangs rgyas kyi thugs kyi gsang ba ni bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /de bzhin du 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ nam mkhas ji snyed khyab gyur pa/ /sku yis kyang ni de snyed khyab/ /sku yis ji snyed 244

khyab gyur pa/ /gsung gis kyang ni de snyed khyab/ /gsung gis ji snyed khyab gyur pa/ /thugs kyis kyang ni de snyed khyab/ /thugs kyis ji snyed khyab gyur pa/ /'od kyis kyang ni de snyed khyab/ /'od kyis ji snyed khyab gyur pa/ /ye shes kyang ni de snyed khyab/ /ye shes ji snyed khyab gyur pa/ /sprul pas kyang ni de snyed khyab/ /ces dang / lung bstan dngul dkar me long las/ 'byung lngas gar khyab bad+ma bdag gis khyab/ /khams drug ma zad bdag gi gzugs mi 'dzad/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin mtha' bral pad+ma la/ /tshur mthong skye bos kho bo ji ltar shes/ /zhes dang / zhal chems mu tig brgya phreng las/ snang srid 'khor 'das pad+ma nga yi zhing / /sangs rgyas sems can bad+ma nga yi 'phrul/ /'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgyar gang 'dul gye/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas sgyu 'phrul bkod pa re/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyes mi khyab pas/ chos dang gang zag yongs la dag snang sbyong dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin/gzhan yang ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo las/ skra rtse'i khyon la'ang sangs rgyas mang bo ni/ /gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma ji yod snyed/ /rgyal ba de dag zhing yang de snyed de/ /de dag mtshan nyid mi 'dra skal mi mnyam/ /skra yi khyon la 'gro ba lnga rnams te/ /sems can 245

dmyal dang dud 'gro'i 'gro ba dang / /gshin rje'i 'jig rten lha dang mi rnams zhugs/ /'dres pa med cing gnod par 'gyur ba med/ /de dag gnas su mtsho dang rgya mtshor bcas/ /chu klung de bzhin mtsho dang lteng ka rnams/ /'dres pa med cing gnod par mi 'gyur te/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i chos rnams bsam mi khyab/ /de yi gnas su ri bo du ma ste/ /khor yug dang ni lhun po rab lhun dang / /btang bzung dang ni btang bzung chen po dang / /'bigs byed bya rgod phung po gangs kyi ri/ /gnas der sems can dmyal ba mi bzad pa/ /tsha dang rab tu tsha ba nyams mi dga'/ /des na sems can dmyal skyes tshor ba yis/ /sdug bsngal de dag rjes su myong bar byed/ /de yi gnas na lha yi gzhal med khang / /de dag dpag tshad bcu gnyis dbyangs dga' ba/ /lha rnams stong phrag mang po de dag kyang / /lha yi dga' ba shin tu bde ba myong / /de yi gnas su sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhing / /'jig rten rig pa'i bstan pa 'bar bar snang / /gang gis rnam dag spyod pa ma sbyangs pa/ /ye shes bral ba dag gis de mi mthong / /zhes dang / sangs rgyas kyi yul dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa la 'jug pa'i mdo las/ stong gsum gyi lha dang mi ni ches nyung gi phyi rol pa'i drang srong 246

mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa gcig gis shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam gye sa'i khyon la sems can mthong ba ni de bas ches mang ngo / /de dag gis stong gsum du mthong ba bas ni nyan thos rnam par thar ba brgyad las bsam gtan pa'i gang zag gcig gis shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam la mthong ba ches mang ngo / /de dag gis stong gsum du mthong ba bas ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa brgyad las/ bsam gtan pa gcig gis shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam la mthong ba ches mang ngo / /de dag gis stong gsum du mthong ba bas ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan gyis shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam la gzigs pa ches mang ngo gsungs/sngon byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sku'i ba spu'i khung bu gcig tu song ba'i tshe/ de na zhing khams dang bcas pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems grangs las 'das pa'i mtha' ma chod par phyir ldog dgos pa byung / de yang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku lus kyi ba spu'i sgo nyi ma'i 'od ces bya ba na/ byang chub sems dpa' khrag khrig du ma dang / gser gyi khri re re la yang rtse mo khri nyis stong rin po che'i khang bzang skyed tshal du mas brgyan pa yi ge drug pa'i chos sgra sgrog pa/ ba spu de'i nang na yang / rgyal ba'i 247

dbang po zhes bya ba'i ba spu'i khung bu na/ lha'i gser gyi ri brgyad khri/ rin po che'i brag ri ljon shing dag dang / zas gos lha'i rang bzhin las grub pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' dag longs spyod cing / yi ge drug pa'i chos sgra sgrog go /ba spu de 'das pa na/ sman chen po zhes bya ba'i ba spu'i khung bu na/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyed ma thag bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong / rdo rje dngul gser/ in+d+ra nī la/ pad+ma rā ga mar ga ta/shel gyi ri rtse mo brgyad khri yod pa dri za'i sil snyan gyi sgra las/yi ge drug pa'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs 'byin cing / gang sems thog ma bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag stong ba nyid mtshan ma med pa sems te/ kye ma ho/ sdug bsngal skye rga na 'chi sogs las skyobs/ skyil mo krung bcas te lus drang por bsrang nas dran pa mngon par bzhag ste/ ri de dag la 'khod do/ /ba spu de 'das pa na/ sna tshogs pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i ba spu'i khung bu na/ rang sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma me 'bar ba dang / char 'bebs pa dang / cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston cing / rin chen sna bdun las grub pa'i ri'i rgyal po brgya phrag stong dag la 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i dpag bsam gyi sdong bo rtsa ba mu tig lo ma gser dngul/ me tog man shel 248

las byas pa dag las rgyan cha du ma dang / ka shu ga'i gos rnams 'phyang ngo / /de 'dra ba'i ri dag la rang sangs rgyas dag bzhugs nas/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyang yi ge drug ma'i sgra ston no/ /thams cad kyi tha ma na ba spu'i bur rgyal mtshan gyi rgyal po na/ rin po che'i ri brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / dpag bsam dang / tsan dan dang / byu ru'i shing de snyed yod cing /rin chen 'bar ba'i khang brtsegs na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sgu 'dzam bu'i gling du mngon par phyogs shing chos 'chad pa phar phyin drug yi ge 'bru drug tu ston par mdzad pa yang bzhugs so/ /mdor na skra tsam khyon la dus gsum tshad snyed kyi sangs rgyas byang sems bzhugs nas/ yi ge drug pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrog cing / de dag las byung ba'i 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig ba spu'i sgo bye ba phrag brgya nas phyung ste/ 'gro drug gi bag chags sbyong ba'i tshul rgyas pa za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo las gsungs/ rje btsun tā ra na thas mdzad pa'i bzang spyod 'grel ba 'phags mchog gsang mdzod las/ sngon tshong dpon gyi bu khye'u nor bzang gis/ sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyi spyan snga na/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang bo rin chen pad+ma'i khri la bzhugs pa mthong ste/ de'i ba spu'i khung bu re re nas kyang 249

'jig rten gye khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'od zer gye sprin mang po thon nas/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs par snang bar byas te/ sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar byed pa la sogs pa rnam par thar ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i cho 'phrul chen po nyi shu rtsa gcig mthong ngo de nas nor bzang dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sku lus kyi cha shas rnam par phye nas/mthar ba spu'i khung bu gcig la yang / dbus su mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams dang bcas pa'i phyogs bcu rab 'byams mu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bkod pa mtha' dag dang /de dag kyang bskal pa chags pa dang 'jig pa'i bar gyi tshul rnams ma lus pa/ gzugs brnyan gye tshul tu mthong ngo / /kun tu bzang po de'i mtshan bzang po re re la yang sngon gye mtha' mur thug gi bar gye 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dang / sangs rgyas rnams dang 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor yang bstan/ phyi ma'i mu mtha' thug gi bar gyis yang bstan/ sangs rgyas re re'i drung du kun tu bzang bo re re yang 'dug de dag gi lus re re la yang dus gsum du byung ba'i shes bya thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan yang mngon par bstan pa yang mthong / sangs rgyas rnam snang gi 250

spyan snga na bzhugs pa'i kun tu bzang po'i phyag brkyangs te nor bzang gi spyi bor bzhag pa'i tshe/ phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas re re'i zhabs 'bring na yang kun tu bzang bo re re bzhugs pa'i phyag g.yas pa'ang nor bzang gi spyi bor bzhag par gyur cing / de nas kun tu bzang pos sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul phra ba snyed po de dag mnan te mngon par brjod pa'i phyir tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis smon lam btab pa/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na sogs 'byung ngo / /'di ni zhing khams rnam par dag par byed pa dang /rnam par thar ba mtha' yas pa de lta bu thob pa'i phyir rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang smon lam gdab dgos so zhes gsungs/bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom rdzogs chen pa chos dbyings stobs ldan rdo rjes mdzad pa'i mdo rgyud rin po che'i mdzod las/ don la chos rnams bden par ma grub kyang / /gdul bya'i las snang 'dul byed rdzu 'phrul mthu/ /chad med bsam 'das brjod pa'i yul dang bral/ /rdul snyed steng na mkha' mnyam 'byung ba bzhi'i/ /rdul phran ji snyed dang mtshungs 251

'jig rten khams/ /sangs rgyas sras dang slob mar bcas pa snang / /skra rtse'i khyon la dus gsum rgyal ba'i zhing / /ma 'dres gsal bar yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpe/ /khang ba gcig tu mi brgya'i rmi lam ni/ /mi 'dra du ma rmis pa phan tshun du/ /mi gnod mi phan mi shong med dang mtshungs/ /shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam gyi sa'i khyon la//phyi rol drang srong nyan thos byang sems dang //rgyal ba rnams kyis rim bzhin sems can grangs//stong gsum lha mi kun las lhag par mthong / /mi mjed bde ldan ngur smrig rgyal mtshan zhing //rab brgyan rab sgogs rdul bral sgon ma bzang //'od bzang 'da' dka' rgyal mtshan bzod pa'i zhing / /dpal gyi 'jig rten snga ma'i bskal ba'i yun/ /phyi ma'i zhag la zhag de bskal ba'i yun/ /phyi ma'i zhag des zhag de bskal ba'o/ /rdul phran gcig na zhing 'di 'khod pa yin/ /zhes 'grel ba dang bcas rgya cher gsungs/ bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma 'gro mgon gseng khang rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam thar thams cad mkhyen par bgrod pa'i them skas las/ spyir sangs rgyas rnams kyi sprul pa'i bkod pa ni/ kun rtog gi spros pa med kyang thabs mkhas pa'i smon lam rnam par dag pa'i mthu kho na las 'byung zhing /de yang rgyud bla ma las/ ji ltar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /'od 252

zer dpag tu med 'dres shing / /rtag tu bya ba kun la 'jug /'jig rten la yang snang bar byed/ /de bzhin zag med dbyengs na yang / /sangs rgyas dpag tu med 'dres shing / /mdzad pa gcig ni mdzad pa la/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas rnams la/ nga dang nga'i zhes 'byed byed kyis rgyud tha dad pa'i rnam gzhag med kyang / rigs rus dang mdzad pa sogs tha dad pa mi 'gal ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas mthar thug tu gsungs pa dang / rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs lta bu'i rgyal sras bdag nyid chen po re re'i sprul pa'i bkod pa yang rje bdag nyid chen pos/ bsod nams mchog rab rab 'byams rgyu las 'khrungs pa'i sku mchog tu mdzes pa khyod kyi sku/ /nam mkha'i mthas gtugs gtugs pa med pa'i zhing mchog kun tu du ma'i 'gro la mig 'phrul bzhin/ /la lar bltams shing zhing gzhan du yang byang chub tshul ston ston pa khyod kyi sku yi ni/ /bkod pa mchog 'di 'di dang gzhan du ma lus lus can 'gro kun kun mkhyen gyur kyang brjod mi nus/ /zhes zhing mi 'dra ba du mar sprul pa'i bkod pa dus gcig tu ston par gsungs na/zhing re re lta smos pa'i phyir dang / 'jug pa las kyang / rang gi lus la lus rnams kun nas ston par byed pa'ang yin/ zhes 253

sogs kyi rang 'grel du/ lus brgya kun tu ston pa dang lus re rer yang 'khor byang chub sems dpa' brgya dang ldan par kun tu ston to zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sa dang po pas sprul ba brgya dang / sa gnyis pa pas stong 'gyur dang / sa gsum pa nas 'bum 'gyur du gsungs pas sangs rgyas rnams dang rgyal sras bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi sprul pa'i bkod pa bgrang las 'das pas/ skad cig re rer yang sems can grangs med pa smin grol gyi lam la 'god par mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas la nges pa 'dren par bya'o zhes gsungs/ de ltar gsung rab dgongs 'grel rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyis gang gsungs pa ltar/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gye rgyal ba rnams thugs chos sku nam mkha' lta bu'i dbyings su dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres nas yod cing / de las tshur nam mkha'i gar khyab kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad la longs spyod rdzogs pa dang / sprul ba'i sku'i bkod pa bgrang las 'das pa bstan te/chos kyi sgo mo mtha' yas pa gsungs nas 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad pa'i tshul rnams/ sa thob kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sgrib med ye shes chen po'i spyan gyis sa ler gzigs nas/ dngos su 254

sku grangs med pa sprul nas sangs rgyas de rnams mchod cing chos kyang gsan/ sems can la yang bstan nas phan 'dogs pa yin la/ nged rnams kyi sems la brtan pa ma thob pas dngos su de ltar mi nus pas yid kyis bya dgos/ de la thog mar tshe 'dir nges don ston pa'i bla ma'i gsung bzhin chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba'am/ gzhi ma/ 'byung gnas lta bu'i rang gi sems nyid gnyug ma'i ngo bo gdod nas stong gsal 'dzin med khyab gdal klong yangs spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la blo lhod kyis glod nas mnyam par bzhag pas/ rig pa dwangs snyigs phyes nas/ mnyam gzhag shel gyi me long ltar sgrib med gsal bo byung ba dang de'i ngor chos kun gdod ma'i gnas lugs mtha' bral chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i dag dang ma dag pa'i zhing khams/ sangs rgyas sems can rnams gcig kyang ma lus pa thams cad so sor ma 'dres par khra shigs se mngon sum lta bur yod par mos nas/ yid kyis rang gi lus zhing gi rdul snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam par sprul nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal ba dang / la las mchod pa 'bul ba/ la las sdig pa bshags pa/ la las rjes su yi rang 'bul ba/ la las chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba/ la 255

las mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs pa/ la las dge ba rdzogs byang du bsngo ba ste/ yan lag bdun pa 'bul mkhan grangs las 'das pa yod par dmigs nas ngag gis/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /zhes dbyangs dang bcas bzang spyod nas 'byung ba ltar 'don/maṇ+ḍal rgyas bsdus gang rung 'bul/ shes na gsol 'debs rgyas pa bya/ bsdu na/ chos sku kun tu bzang por gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /'dren mchog shākya'i rgyal por gsol ba 'debs/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos sku yum chen mo la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhyen rab 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'phags pa thugs rje chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /mthu stobs gsang ba'i bdag por gsol ba 'debs/ /o rgyan bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs/ /mnyam med jo bo chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ / rgya bod mkhas grub yongs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /'dren pa'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /drin can bla ma 256

rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar byin gyis gyis rlobs/ /tshe dpal bsod nams rgyas par byen gyes rlobs/ /chos la phyogs ris med par byen gyis rlobs/ /dag snang phyogs med 'byongs par byin gyes rlobs/ /dam chos ma lus 'dzin par byen gyis rlobs/ /rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas 'thob par byen gyes rlobs/ /bstan 'gro yongs la phan par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang gzhan don kun 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba btab pa la brten nas phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams mtha' yas mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi sku las 'od dang 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa byung nas/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi lus sems la zhugs pas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung du ma'i tshogs ngan pa thams cad dang / khyad par chos dang gang zag gi phyogs ris la brten nas chos spong gi las ngan pa bsags pa rnams mun pa'i gling du nyi ma phog pa bzhin lhag med du sbyangs/ lus dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du byas/ tshe dpal bsod nams lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad yar ngo'i zla ba ltar gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byas/257

khyad par chos dang gang zag yongs la dad gus dag snang 'byongs pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag song snyam pa'i mos pa dung dung bar bya/ slar yang mos gus gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba phur tshugs su btab pa la brten nas/phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rgyal ba rab 'byams rnams kyi thugs ka nas nyi ma 'bum phrag dus gcig la shar ba las kyang ches cher dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad la phog pas ma dag pa'i nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs nas/ phyi snod 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dag pa'i zhing dang gzhal yas khang / nang bcud kyi skye 'gro sems can thams cad mtshan dpe'i mdzes pa'i lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig tu gyur song snyam pa'i mos pa bya/ de nas/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang phyogs bcu yi/ /zhes bzang spyod smon lam 'don/ khyad par phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun gyi dam chos ma lus pa 'dzin pa'i smon lam 'debs pa ni shin tu gal che ste/bu mo dpal 'phreng gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed gang lags pa de thams cad kyang / 'di ltar dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa'i smon lam chen mo'i khongs su 'dus shing 258

khong du chud de/ bcom ldan 'das dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa ni/ de ltar yul che ba lags so/ /zhes dang / bcom ldan 'das dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa ni chos kyi sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong sdud pa lags so/ /gsungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i gsang ba'i mdo las/ dam chos 'dzin pa'i bsod nams ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis nan tan du/ /bskal ba bye bar brjod mdzad kyang / /mthar phyin par ni 'gyur ma lags/ /zhes sogs phan yon tshad las 'das pa yod pa la dgongs nas rje bdag nyid chen pos kyang / rgyal sras smon lam gaṅgā'i klung rnams ni/ /dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam nang 'dus par//gsungs phyir dge rtsa ji snyed bsags pa ni/ /kun kyang thub bstan rgyas pa'i ched du bsngos/ /gsungs/ bsngo smon gye khyad par ni/ kun mkhyen bu ston rin po ches/ bsngo ba smon lam gyi khyad par rgyu 'di lta bu la brten nas 'bras bu 'di 'dra zhig tu zhes rgyu sngon du byas nas 'bras bu la smon pa bsngo ba yin/ rgyu sngon du byas kyang rung ma byas kyang rung / 'bras bu 'di lta bur gyur cig ces pa smon lam yin/ bsngo ba gang yin smon lam yin smon lam yin tshad la bsngo ba yin smon lam yin tshad la bsngo ba yin pas ma khyab po gsungs so/ /des na 253

dam chos ma lus 'dzin pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam rgya chen po 'debs shing / rang gi chos gang shes tshad po nyams su len pa la yang brtson par bya'o/ /de ltar phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams la dmigs nas/ yan lag bdun pa phul ba'i bsod nams kyi phung bo ni nam mkha' gang bar rtag tu 'byung zhes dpal sbas kyis zhus pa'i mdo las gsungs shing skye ba 'di nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du/ tshe rabs thams cad du sangs rgyas byang sems mang bo'i zhal mthong zhing dam pa'i chos dang nam yang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /smras pa/ zab gsal thugs dgongs nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nyid las/ /las 'bras skyid sdug legs nyes sa ler mkhyen/ /mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag sangs rgyas rnams la 'dud/ /yangs so che'o mkha' mnyam rgyal ba'i thugs/ /thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par byen gyes rlobs/ /chos dbyengs khyab gdal klong de gu re yangs/ /gu yangs nyams dga'i ngang nas glu dbyangs len/ /rang sems snang grags 'khor 'das chos rnams kyi/ /ngo bo gdod nas stong zhing spros dang bral/ /sgye med chos dbyengs nam mkha' lta bu yi/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor 260

nyams re dga'/ /nam mkha'i 'ja' dang chu yi zla ba dang / /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ji bzhin du/ /chos dbyings klong na sangs rgyas zhing khams dang / /'jig rten khams rnams ma 'dres so sor snang / /bzang ngan rgyu rkyen 'dzom pa'i rten 'brel las/ /'khor 'das bzang ngan sna tshogs cir snang yang / /dper na sgyu ma rmi lam ji bzhin du/ /snang bzhin stong la stong bzhin snang ba mtshar/ /rdul gcig steng na phyogs bcu'i rdul snyed kyi/ /grangs mnyam zhing khams rgyal ba sras bcas bzhugs/ /de ltar chos kyi dbyengs rnams ma lus pa/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas gang bar gsungs/ /de dag chu bur mig gis mi mthong yang / rang sems gsal ba'i yul la khra lam mer/ /yod par mos nas rab lus grangs med sprul/ /bstod dbyangs sna tshogs sgrog bzhin phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten khams dang sangs rgyas zhing kun na/ /mchod tshogs gang yod blo yis blangs nas 'bul/ /bdag gzhan mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis/ /sdig pa byas tshad bdag gis mthol lo bshags/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rang bzhin dge tshogs la/ /rab tu dga' bas rjes su yi rang bya/ /bdag dang 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi/ /blo khar 'tsham pa'i chos 'khor bskor bar 261

bskul/ /'gro ba'i don du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams/ /bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i phyir du bsngo/ /de'i mthus rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ /phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas par shog /'gro kun gnas skabs kun tu bde zhing skyid/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas go 'phang myur 'thob shog /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gaṅgā'i klung / /bye ma snyed kyi grangs mnyam gang lags pa/ /de dag dam chos 'dzin pa'i smon lam du/ /'dus zhes bu mo dpal phreng mdo las gsungs/ /de'i phyir bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can gyis/ /tshe rabs kun tu phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /dam chos ma lus 'dzin pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /rnam dag smon pa'i gnas kun myur 'grub shog /e ma phyogs bcu'i chos mdzad pho mo rnams/ /sdug btsir sgom gyis sa rgya mi chod pas/ /gar bzhugs chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang dang/ /shes par gyis la sems kha yangs po mdzod/ /sems kha yangs pa'i sgo nas phyogs bcu yi/ /sangs rgyas yongs la yan lag bdun pa phul/ /sa steng bla ma yongs la zhabs tog sgrubs/ /chos lugs grub mtha' yongs la dag snang sbyong / /rang nyid gang mos chos 262

de nyams su longs/ /chos kyi rtsa ba sems la thug 'dug pas/ /kun gyis byang chub sems gnyis thugs dam gyi/ /mthil du zungs dang bde skyid nyi ma 'char/ /glu 'di thos tshad skye bo pho mo yis/ /grub mtha'i phyogs ris chags sdang kun zhi nas/ /thams cad thugs mthun dad gus dag snang sgos/ /ris med bstan 'gro yongs la phan par shog /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ / de yang phyogs bcu'i zhing na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gdul bya sems can rnams la dam pa'i chos ci lta bu gsungs pa yin nam snyam na/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi gso sbyong las/ de yang ji skad du/ bzod pa dka' thub dam pa bzod pa ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog ces sangs rgyas gsungs/ /rab tu byung ba gzhan la gnod pa dang / /gzhan la 'tshe ba dge sbyong ma yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam gzigs kyis gsungs so/ /mig ldan 'gro ba yod pa yis/ /nyam nga ba dag ji bzhin du/ /mkhas pas 'tsho ba'i 'jig rten 'dir/ /sdig pa dag ni yongs su spongs/ / skur ba mi gdab gnod mi bya/ /so sor thar ba'ang bsdams par bya/ /zas kyi tshod kyang rigs par bya/ /bas mtha'i gnas su gnas par bya/ /lhag 263

pa'i sems la yang dag sbyor/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /bcom ldan 'das gtsug gtor can gyis gsungs so/ /ji ltar bung ba me tog las/ /kha dog dri la mi gnod par/ /khu ba gzhib nas 'phur ba ltar/ /de bzhin thub pa grong du rgyu/ /bcom ldan 'das thams cad skyob kyis gsungs so/ /bdag gis rigs dang mi rigs la/ /brtag par bya ste gzhan rnams la/ /mi mthun pa dang gzhan dag gis/ /byas dang ma byas rnams la min/ /bcom ldan 'das 'khor ba 'jig gis gsungs so/ /lhag pa'i sems la dpag bya ste/ /thub pa'i thub gzhi rnams la bslab/ /nyer zhi rtag tu dran ldan pa'i/ /skyob pa mya ngan med pa yin/ /bcom ldan 'das gser thub kyis gsungs so/ /sbyin pas bsod nams rab tu 'phel/ /legs bsdams dgra sogs mi 'gyur ro/ /dge dang ldan pas sdig pa spongs/ /nyon mongs zad pas mya ngan 'das/ /bcom ldan 'das 'od srungs kyis gsungs so/ /sdig pa thams cad mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/ /yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /thams cad du yang sdom pa legs/ /kun tu bsdams pa'i dge slong 264

ni/ /sdug bsngal kun las rab tu grol/ /ngag rnams bsrung zhing yid kyis rab bsdams te/ /lus kyi mi dge ba dag mi bya zhing / /las lam gsum po 'di dag rab spangs na/ /drang srong gsungs pa'i lam ni thob par 'gyur/ zhes bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi gso sbyong 'di lan cig bsgrags pas kyang bskal pa mang por bsags pa'i sdig sgrib 'dag cing / sangs rgyas rnams kyi byen rlabs thob par 'gyur ro/ /'di gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs de yang lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyis mchod pa'i rten du 'gyur ro gsungs/ /de bzhin du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mdo sngags kyi chos sngar yang gsungs shing da lta yang gsungs la/ phyin chad kyang gsung bar 'gyur bas/ de dag thams cad la dag snang sbyangs nas 'dzin pa'i smon lam 'debs dgos so/ /khyad par du bdag cag gi ston pa 'di bskal ba dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas sangs rgyas te rtag tu chos 'chad pa yin te/ mdo sde pad+ma dkar po las/ bskal ba bye stong bsam gyis mi khyab par/ /de yi grangs ni sus kyang bzung med par/ /byang chub dam pa de ni ngas rnyed de/ /ngas ni rtag tu chos kyang rab 'chad do/ /zhes dang / 'khor lo sdom 265

pa'i lo rgyus las/ bdag cag gi ston pa thog ma med pa nas sangs rgyas te/ sangs rgyas ma thag bde mchog gi rgyud rgyas par gsungs pa la/ sems can bsod nams kyi dbang gis re 'ga' dar la re 'ga' nub par 'gyur zhes bshad/ rgyud las/ rdzogs ldan dang po bya ba'i rgyud/ /sum ldan gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud/ /nyis ldan gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud/ /rtsod ldan bzhi ba bla med do/ /zhes dang / ye shes rol pa'i rgyud las/ bskal pa kun gye sngon rol nas/ /phyi ma'i mu mtha' thug gyur pa/ /de srid bla med gsang ba'i chos/ /rmad byung rgyal po 'gro ba la/ /gsungs so gsung ngo gsung bar 'gyur/ /gsungs/ sku thog 'di la sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan nas sku dngos dang / gzhan yang rdo rje 'chang sogs su sprul nas/ mdo sngags chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa yin/ ma 'ongs pa na yang sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa yang dang yang du bstan nas 'gro la chos ston cing / dus deng sang yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gye skur sprul nas/ chos gsungs nas 'gro don mdzad par mdo rgyud kun nas yang yang gsungs pa'i chos dang gang zag yongs la dag snang bya'o/ /yang kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pas mdzad pa'i theg pa mtha' dag gi don gsal bar byed pa grub 266

mtha' rin po che'i mdzod ces bya ba las/ thog ma dang mtha' ma med pa'i dus nas/ grangs med pa'i rdo rje 'chang rim pas byon te/ bzhugs la/ slad kyi 'byon pa rnams kyis dbang po shin tu rnon po'i gdul bya rnams la rnam grangs dpag tu med pas gsungs te/ mtshan brjod las/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /ma 'ongs rnams kyang gsung 'gyur la/ /da ltar 'byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /yang dang yang du gsungs pa rnams/ /zhes pas dus dang tshad dang ris su chad pa 'ga' yang med de/ thog ma med pa'i sngon rol nas rdo rje 'chang byon nas gsungs pa rnams phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa sangs rgyas nyid sems dpa'i tshul du bstan pa tshad med pa'i tshogs kyis/ bla na med pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs rgyud sde bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams gzung zhing / zhing khams 'di dang phyogs bcu gzhan du/ rdo rje 'chang dpag tu med pa snga phyir gshegs te/ da lta bzhugs pa dang bcas pa'i mdun du dus rtag par gnas pas thos pa bzung nas/ zhing de dag las ma g.yos bzhin du zhing khams tha dad pa rnams kyi nang du/ rgyud kyi ming dang rnam grangs tshad med pa ston par byed de/ de'ang sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rdo rje phyag na rdo rje/ gsung rdo rje spyan ras 267

gzigs/ sku rdo rje 'jam dbyangs la sogs pa 'bras bu'i sems dpa' tshad med pas/ rang gis gsung ba bo dang / zhu ba po dang / sdud pa po dang / chos dang gnas kyi rol ba mdzad nas gsang ba chen po rnams 'gro ba'i don du snang bar mdzad nas/ gsang ba chen po rnams 'gro ba'i don du snang bar mdzad pa yin te/ he badz+ra las/ 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga / /rang gi tshogs sdud 'khor kyang nga / /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'ang nga / /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /de'i phyir phyag na rdo rje ni sngon rol pa'i sangs rgyas te/ ngan song sbyong rgyud las/ sangs rgyas kun las sngar sangs rgyas/ /mi shes dri ma kun bcom pa/ /rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ /rdo rje rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin/ /phyag na rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces 'byung ngo / /des gzung ba'i rgyud la dus 'di tsam nas gsang sngags byung zhes thog mtha' bsam par mi nus la/ ston pa 'di kho nas gsungs zhes tshad gzung du med de/ 'jig rten khams na rdo rje 'chang gi rol pa tshad med pa'i phyir/ re zhig mi mjed 'di'i dbang du byas na/ snod bcud kyi rim pa chags nas ma stongs kyi bar la thun mong gi sangs rgyas stong dang / sems dpa' gnyis byon pa'i tshul bstan nas/ dang po'i sangs rgyas rnam gzigs kyis phyi'i rgyud 268

sde 'ga' gsungs par 'dod la/ shākya thub pas rgyud bzhi rdzogs par gsungs pa dang / kha cig tu shākya thub pa'i rnam pas dngos su gsungs te/ des na bcom ldan shākya thub/ /nyid kyi zhal nas ljags bzang ba/ /ring zhing yangs pa skyongs mdzad de/ /zhes pa dang / dpal ldan 'bras spungs su dus 'khor gsungs pa la sogs pa dang / gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa rnams rdo rje 'chang gi rnam par bzhengs te gsungs par 'dod la/ ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas mos pas gsungs par 'dod do/ /de dag kyang phyag na rdo rje dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bzung nas rtag par gnas la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i ston pa/rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje sems dpa'/ rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas brjod du med pa'i tshogs kyis 'og min na rtag par bzhugs nas/ 'khor dpag tu med pa la sngar gsungs/ da lta gsungs/phyis kyang gsung ba'i phyir du kho ra khor yug tu snang ba yin no/ /de dag gis gsungs pa'i rgyud kyang sngon bskal ba dang po nas 'di'i bar la phyag na rdo rje dang / dbang thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / grub thob dang rigs sngags 'chang dang / mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bzung nas/ lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang mi'am ci dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i 269

gnas so so na dar zhing spyod pa las/ khyad par du 'dzam bu gling gi za hor dang / siṅga la dang / o rgyan la sogs mkha' 'gro'i gnas na bzhugs pa las/ slob dpon chen po klu sgrub snying bo dang / pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / bi ma la mi tra la sogs pas spyan drangs nas/ skal ldan so so la brgyud pa dag gi nyams su blangs pas grub pa brnyes pa'i grub chen brgyad cu la sogs pa rgya gar du byon pa dang / sngon rgyal blon gyi dus su bod du yang mang du byon pa yin no/ /rnam gzhag 'di ltar khong du ma chud pa'i blo chung sgo skur smra ba dag rgya gar du ma grags pas rgyud yang dag pa ma yin te bod kyis byas pa'o zhes yang dag pa'i rgyud lung dang mdo mang po la skur ba 'debs pa ni ngan 'gror yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyu gsog pa kho na'o/ /de'ang rgya gar gyi rgyud rnams kyang u rgyan dang / sham+bha la dang / ma la yā la sogs pa'i yul nas grub thob chen po rnams kyis spyan drangs te/ rgyud thams cad ni rgya gar na'ang bzhugs pa ma yin te/gal te bzhugs su bcug kyang khyed kyis lan re tsam phyin pas de thams cad mthong bar mi nus la/ gtsug lag khang chung re na bzhugs pa'i mdo rgyud kyi ming byang du ma 'dus pas gzhan rnams min par mi 'gyur ba'i phyir sngon gyi lam ston chen po 270

rnams la smad par mi bya'o/ /bod 'dir rgya gar na yod pa dang med pa'i mdo dang rgyud mang po bzhugs te/ sngon gyi slob dpon pad+ma la sogs pas o rgyan la sogs mkha' 'gro'i gling rnams nas mdo sde mang du bsnams nas byon te bsgyur zhing / mdo yang nyi ma dngos grub kyi mes ma tshig gong du rgya nag la 'gyur ba'i mdo rnams las/ phal po che dang / mya ngan las 'das pa dang / 'dul ba lung la sogs pa mang po zhig rgya nag gi par+bhe ta hwa shang ma hā yā na'i blo las/ bai ro tsa na dang sba sang zhis lo tsā byas te bsgyur ba yin no/ /de'i phyir chos dang gang zag gi tshad ni thams cad mkhyen pa las gzhan gyis bzung bar mi nus te/ dkon brtsegs las/ 'od srungs/ nga'am nga dang 'dra bas chos dang gang zag gi tshod bzung bar rung gis/ gzhan dag gis ma yin te/ log par ltung ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /chos kyang bka' yang dag pa ni sangs rgyas kyi gsung ste/ sprul sku de yang sngon byung gi da lta med do mi bsam ste/ rtag tu mos pa'i ngor 'byung la/ des sngon mdo dang rgyud ma grags pa gsal bar byed pa'ang srid pas skur ba mi gdab la/ chos gang la yang thar ba'i lam du 'jug cing 'khor ba spongs par ston pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab tshad mar bzhag ste/ rgyud 271

bla ma las/ khams gsum dag na nyon mongs spongs byed gsungs/ /zhi ba'i yon tan brjod par mdzad pa gang / /de ni drang srong gsung yin ldog pa gzhan/ /zhes bsgrubs la/ sangs rgyas ni rtag par bzhugs pas gdul bya'i don mdzad la/ byen gyis brlabs pa'i bka' yang / ri dang shing dang pad+mo dang dpag bsam shing dang / skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang / bya dang ri dwags las chos kyi rnam grangs kyi sgra 'byung ba de yang bkar gsungs pa yod na/ sngar byung gis/ da lta mi —srid ces log par mi blta ste/ byin gyis brlabs pa dag 'byung srid pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gang la yid ches pas dam par bzung nas yi dam du bya bar 'thad kyis/ gzhan la skur ba nam yang gdab par mi bya ba kho na'o/ /gsang sngags rnying ma'i rgyud kyi 'byung tshul 'ga' zhig las/ phyag na rdo rjes za hor gye yul/ ma la ya'i ri/ rgyal po dza zhes bya ba la dbang bskur zhing glegs bam gyi char phab nas mi'i yul du snang bar byas pa la/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa 'dus pa la sogs pa dang / sgyu 'phrul dra ba la sogs pa mang du byung gsungs pa'ang de kho na bzhin te/ dgongs pa lung ston las/ 'dzam gling shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi/ /mi la skal ldan grwa ma che/ /rgyal po dza 272

zhes bya ba la/ /phyag na rdo rjes ston par 'gyur/ /zhes 'byung la/rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud las/ rgyu la sbyor ba rgyu yi chos/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas/ /'bras bu'i theg pa'i nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa dang yang mthun pa yin no/ /sngon gyi dus su byung ba dag bcos ma yin na/rtsom gzhi gang la byas/ de ltar na phyis 'byung ba rnams bcos mar 'gyur te/ don sngon ma bas lhag tu ma byung / tshig cung zad mi 'dra ba dang / mang nyung byung ba las med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gsar rnying gi rgyud chen po 'di dag la slob dpon grub chen mang du byon zhing / dbang dang byen rlabs zam ma chad par 'dug pas yang dag pa 'ba' zhig ste/ slob dpon de dag gis 'grel ba dang man ngag mang du mdzad pas yid ches par gzung ngo / /de'ang rgya gar na gsang sngags zhes pa tsam las/'di ni gsar ma'o/ /'di ni rnying ma'o zhes so sor dbye ba med na yang / bod 'dir 'gyur snga phyi so sor grags te/ bai ro tsa na la sogs pa rgyal blon snga dar gyi dus su bsgyur ba nas bzung ste/ paṇ+ḍi ta smri ti'i bar du bsgyur ba'i rgyud la rnying ma zhes 'dod la/ lo tsā pa rin chen bzang bo man chad la bsgyur ba'i rgyud la gsar ma zhes grags so gsungs/ gzhan yang khong 273

gi zhal snga nas/ blo chung zhing shes rab kyi mig rgyang thung ba dgatheg pa'i grangs dang grub mtha'i rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam gzhag la dngangs shing mi bden to zhes smra ba ni/ba glang la sogs ma he dag bdag cag dud 'gro rnams ni rwa dang bcas pa'i phyir/ mi dang lha rnams kyang rwa can kho na'o zhes 'dzin pa bzhin no gsungs/ grub thob o rgyan pas chag lo'i gdan sar byon pa'i tshe/ sngags rnying ma la chos min bya ba 'dug zer te/ mthong rgya chung ba yin/ thang snye ha ra na/ rnying ma'i rgya dpe bzhugs pa'i ming rkyang yang bris na/ 'bum gyi po ti gcig tsam cis kyang 'ong / mi rig pa yi gzugs la mi rigs na/ /the tshom za ba'i chos la smos ci dgos/ /zhes pas chos spongs ma byed gsungs/ 'dzam gling rgyan gcig phyag mchod zhing mchog sangs rgyas gnyis pa bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mnyam med jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i rnam par thar ba rgyas par phye ba yongs su grags pa las/ jo bo'i thugs dgongs la gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs dang / gdams pa dang nus mthu dang / mkhyen rgya nga bas che ba med snyam pa'i thugs rgyal yang cung zad dus der byung nas/ rgya gar nub phyogs su byon pa'i shul gar rmi lam du mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rgyud sde 274

mang po bstan nas thugs rgyal bcag yang rang gi lhag pa'i lha seng ldeng nags kyi sgol mas zhal mngon sum du bstan te jo bo'i mdun du byon nas/ khyod parnyi ta sngags mkhan yin nam gsungs/ jo bos lags gsungs pas/ 'o na sgrub thabs 'ga' zhu bas 'di dang 'di mkhyen nam gsungs/ de kun gyis dpe yang mthong ma myong gsungs pas/ 'o na khyod sngags la mkhas pa'i thugs rgyal che na gsungs/ yang khyed mi'i yul na spu rtse tsam las med/ sngags kyi dpe don mang po mkha' 'gro ma'i lag na yod pa yin gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur/ jo bo'i thugs rgyal yang der bcag gsung ngo / /jo bo nyid kyi zhal nas/rgya gar na bzhugs pa'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad bris nas bri ka ma la shī lar bzhugs nas yod gsung ngo / /theg pa chen po gsang sngags la/ la las bzhir 'dod/ la las lngar 'dod pa la jo bo'i bzhed pas/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/rtog pa'i rgyud/ gnyis ga'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de bdun du bzhed de/ de skad du dpal ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud chen po las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyud so so'i dbye ba gsungs pa/ bya ba'i rgyud stong phrag bzhi/ spyod pa'i rgyud 275

stong phrag brgyad/ rtog pa'i rgyud stong phrag bzhi/ gnyis ga'i rgyud stong phrag drug rnal 'byor gyi rgyud grangs med/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis/ rgyas par phye na grangs med/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis/rgyas par phye na grangs med do/ /zhes so/ /de la bya ba'i rgyud kyi gzungs thams cad dang / rig pa mchog gi rgyud dang / gar mkhan mchog gi rgyud dang / legs par grub par byed pa'i rgyud dang / dpung pa bzang po'i rgyud dang / 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / tsun dha'i rgyud dang / rdo rje gtsug tor dang / a mo bha pa sha dang / rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud chen po la sogs pa'i stong phrag bzhi bo ma lus par mkhyen/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud dang / lag na jo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud la sogs pa stong phrag brgyad po ma lus par mkhyen/ rtog pa'i rgyud/ sgrol ma 'byung ba'i rgyud dang /dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyud dang / rtog pa kun las btus pa'i rgyud la sogs pa stong phrag bzhi bo ma lus pa mkhyen/gnyis ga'i rgyud/ sgyu 'phral dra ba dang / pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug la sogs pa stong phrag drug po ma lus pa mkhyen/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ ta thā saṃ kra ha dang / dpal mchog dang po dang / 'jig 276

rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba dang / rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud la sogs pa grangs med pa rnams mkhyen/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa bshad rgyud dang bcas pa dang / zla gsang thig le dang / gshin rje gshed nag po dang /dpal mchog dang po dang / lha thams cad 'dus pa dang /thams cad gsang ba dang / 'dul ba don yod dang / ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa dang / rnam par snang mdzad sgyu 'phrul dra ba dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa chung ngu dang / gnyis su med par rnam par rgyal ba dang / rdo rje gtsug tor gye rgyud la sogs pa stong phrag bcu gnyis/ rgyas par phye na grangs med pa bzhugs pa rnams ma lus par mkhyen/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud/dpal nam mkha' dang mnyam pa dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dang / sgyu ma chen bo dang / rdo rje gdan bzhi dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang / sangs rgyas thod pa dang / dges pa rdo rje 'bum phrag lnga la sogs pa rgyud sde stong phrag bcu gnyis/ rgyas par phye na grangs med pa bzhugs pa ma lus par mkhyen/ rgyud sde de rnams mkhyen par yang rigs te/ dus dang gnas skabs gzhan du gsan par ma gtogs pa nub gcig gi rmi lam du gsan pa yang blo'i yul las 'das pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang rgyud 277

sde thams cad mkhyen snyam pa'i thugs dgongs mnga' ba la nub gcig rmi lam du/ go sau ma pu ri'i sgo srung gi paṇ+ḍi ta ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa dang mjal/ gser ma ṇi pa tra snyim pa gang phul/ brda'i phyag bcu gnyis btsal nas/ rgyud 'bum phrag gcig dang bzhi brgya lnga bcu rtsa lnga gsan/ mnal sad pa na thams cad ma brjed par mkhyen nas gda' skad/ de'i nang don dam pa'i rgyud drug ces pa mthar thug 'ba' zhig ston pa yang bzhugs gda' skad/ de nas yang gsang sngags la nga las mkhas pa med snyam pa'i thugs rgyal mnga' ba la nub gcig rmi lam na mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ mkha' 'gro ma mang bos sngags kyi glegs bam mang bo khyer nas rgyud 'di 'di skad bya ba yin na/'di khyod kyis shes sam zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs pas/ jo bos sngar mtshan yang ma thos pa'i rgyud mang bo bzhugs nas gda'/ logs shig na glegs bam nag chung zhig 'dug 'di ci yin zhus pas/ 'di rnams khyod kyis shes pa rnams yin gsungs pas der thugs rgyal chag jo bo'i zhal nas/ mi yul na theg pa chung ngu'i 'dul ba nyung / de bas theg pa chung ngu'i mdo sde mang / de rnams las theg pa chen po'i mdo sde mang / de thams cad pas theg pa chen po'i mngon pa mang / de thams cad 278
