pas bya ba'i rgyud mang / de thams cad pas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud mang / de thams cad pas ma rgyud mang / de thams cad phyogs gcig tu bzhag pa bas shes rab kyi rgyud mang ste/ mi yul na bzhugs pa ma gtogs pa'i lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi gnas na yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs/ 'gro ba mtho dma'i don yang 'di nas byas pa mang gsungs/ yang jo bo'i thugs dgongs la/ 'on kyang mi yul na bzhugs pa'i theg pa chen po gsang sngags la nga las mkhas pa med snyam pa'i thugs rgyal mnga' ba la/ phyis bod du byon nas bsam yas be dkar gyi gling gi dkor mdzod cig kha phye nas rgya dpe la gzigs pas/ sngar gsan gzigs ma mdzad pa'i rgyud sde mang po bzhugs shing gda' skad/ de slob dpon pad+ma'i rdzu 'phrul gyis lha klu'i yul dang / dpal shrī na len+d+ra nas rgyud sde thams cad bsam yas su spyan drangs pa mnga' ba yin gsungs/ jo bo'i zhal nas gsang sngags 'di la mi shes pa med snyam ste/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis kyang nam mkha' nas gzhal yas khang dpag tu med pa'i sgo phye nas rgyud sde mang bo bstan pa rnams 'di na mi gda'/ theg pa chen po'i gsang sngags 'di la mtha' mngon rgyu yod yong mi 'dra gsungs nas thugs rgyal chag bod kyi rgyal po la rjes su 279

yi rang ba mdzad nas bod du bstan pa dar dus de 'dra rgya gar du yang ma byung gsungs/ yang bsam yas su byon nas/ rgya dpe la gzigs shing bskor ba mdzad/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ rgya gar du me dgra lan gsum byung bas tshig pa 'dra/ rgya gar na med pa'i dpe mang bo 'di na snang gsungs nas/ dbu ma snang ba/ phal po che la sogs pa bzhengs te rgya gar du bskur/ dbu rur gshegs par zhu ba phul bas kyang / rten 'di na bzang gsungs nas gshegs su ma gnang / des na sngon rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus su dar zhing rgyas pa la sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo rjes kyang rjes su yi rang phul/ tshad mar bzung / bsngags pa brjod na/ gzhan rjes 'jug nged rnams kyis de ltar byed dgos pa smos ci dgos/ de'i phyir de'i dus su dar ba'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos thams cad la dad gus dag snang phyogs med du sbyong bzhin nyams su len par bya'o/ /yang slob dpon gsang phu ba'i zhal nas/ bsam yas kyi dpe khang na/ rgya gar nas spyan drangs nas/ bod du ma 'gyur ba'i chos mang bo yod/ nga la dzu 'phrul zhig yod na/ zab shos shig bsgyur na/bod kyi ston pa 'di kun nga la ji skad zer na/ 'di 'dra ba'i chos shig gang nas byung / tshig legs te khungs la the tshom za 280

zer nas/ sgro skur byed cing log lta 'phel ba las mi 'ong 'o skol bod kyi ston pa 'di tsho/ mi tshe bshad skam re la bskyal nas/mngon shes kyi sna rtse bag re yang mi bsgrub par/ pho tshod 'od to dpags kyis/ phyogs gcig tu kha tshon rbad kyis bcad de/ chos zab mo la sgo skur btab nas ngan 'gro'i g.yang la 'gro ste/ rang re'i thos pa phyogs res nga rgyal nas brlags pa yin gsungs pa'i lung bstan thog tu bab 'dug pa sa/ jo bo yab sras sogs bka' gdams pa rnams la dad pa yod pa rna mas kyis gsung 'di rnams sems la bzhag nas rang gis rang ma brlag pa re gal che/ kun mkhyen tho'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa'i grub mtha' thams cad kyi byung khungs dang 'dod tshul ston pa legs bshad shel gyi me long las/ bka' brgyud pa'i grub mtha' byung tshul las/ mnyam med dwags po rin po ches/ phar phyin theg pa'i lugs la stong nyid la/ phyag rgya chen por gsungs pa yod tshul mdo lung mang bo drangs nas bsgrub pa'i bstan bcos mdzad pa la/ 'ga' zhig gis mdo tshig de 'dra bka' 'gyur na mi snang zhes zer mod/ rgya nag tu bsgyur ba'i bka' 'gyur khrod na mdo de dag snang la/ tshig ris ji lta ba bzhin min kyang don gcig pa/ da lta ra gyi sangs rgyas 281

mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i mdo sogs bod du bsgyur ba'i mdo gzhan 'ga' zhig na'ang snang zhes bdag gi bla ma thams cad mkhyen pas gsung ngo / /zhes gsungs/ yang rgya nag gi yul du nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs byung tshul las/ rgya nag gi bka' 'gyur na/ po ti lnga brgya dang drug cu rtsa drug bstan 'gyur po ti nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / hwa shang mkhas pa mang pos brtsams pa'i gzhung che ba po ti brgya dang lnga bcu nga gsum/ de thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pas bka' bstan bcos gnyis ka po ti bdun brgya dang bzhi bcur longs pa yod pa/de'i nang na bod la ma grags pa'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos mang bo yod par gsungs/ des na bod kyi bka' bstan na med pa'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams bsgyur nas nyams su len rgyu ma byung yang / sngar 'gyur yod pa'i gsar rnying gi mdo rgyud rnams la spang blang byas/ chos spong gi las la yang bag tsha med par 'jug pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pa rnams dug bzhin du spangs nas/kun la dad gus dag snang sbyangs pa la 'bad na/ skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du dam pa'i chos kyis phongs par mi 'gyur zhes blo gros dang ldan pa rnams la snying gtam du smras pa lags pas yid la zungs shig yang gnam chos dang gter chos dang /282

dag snang gi chos skor rnams la yang dad gus dag snang bya dgos te/ mkhas grub rā ga a gyes mdzad pa'i rdzogs chen sangs rgyas lag bcang las/ 'o na chos 'di bka' gter gang yin zhe na/ 'di'i lung byang las/ de snga byung ba 'di rnams ni/ /gter gyi rigs su gtogs na yang / /brgya rtsa'i nang du cher mi gtogs/ /che chung med de chos tshan re/ /gter kha re la gtogs pa'o/ /gnam chos thugs gter snyan brgyud zer/ /zhes 'byung ba dang / rig 'dzin dgongs pa'i lde mig las/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i gsang tshig bcud/ /bka' yin gter yin dag snang che/ /grags stong skye med rang sgra che/ /zhes gsungs pas/thugs rje chen pos dngos su gsungs pa'i bka' yin/ thugs gter yin pas gter yin/ gter snod dang sa la ma brten pas gnam chos yin/ dngos su snyan du brgyud pas na snyan brgyud yin no/ /'o na de lta bu gang zag mi'i brgyud pa las ma brgyud cing / sa'i gter nas kyang 'thon pa ma yin pa'i chos de lta bu 'byung bar mdo rgyud gang las bshad ce na/ mdo las bshad pa dang / rgyud las bshad pa dang / grub thob gong ma'i rnam thar las kyang 'byung bas rtsod pa med pa'o/ /dang po ni/byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ de ltar dad pa la gnas 283

pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi snod du rigs nas/de'i drung du gshegs nas byang chub kyi lam yang dag par ston to/ /zhes dang / chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' dad pa phun sum tshogs pa la la ni/ sangs rgyas mi bzhugs na yang nam mkha'i dkyil dang rtsig pa dang /shing rnams las chos 'byung ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' bsam pa rnam par dag pa la la ni/ rang gi yid kyi spyod pa nyid las gdams ngag rjes su bstan pa thams cad 'byung ngo / /zhes dang / chos kyi sgo mtha' yas pa'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal 'byung ba chen po bzhi ni nam mkha'i dbyengs nas 'byung gi de bzhin du chos kyi sgo mo mtha' yas pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs kyi gter nas 'byung ba yin no/ /gter chen po la spyod shes par byos shig chu klung rol ba'i mdo las/ nga yis bstan pa'i chos kyi gzhung / /thugs nas thugs kyi dkyil du sbos/ /yang na sa yi snying bor bya/ /ci'i phyir mu stegs can mgo rgod/ /nges don dkrugs par gyur ta re/ /de'i phyir chu klung rgyun mi gcod/ /ces dang / mdo las/ don la nges pa'i gdengs rnyed nas/ /sems la chos gter 'bum phrag 284

rdol/ /zhes dang / gsang ba bsam gyes mi khyab pa'i mdo las/sems can gyi bsam pa dang mthun par skad mtha' yas pas theg pa ma lus pa thams cad/ sems can gyi bsam pa bzhin ston pa'i sgra 'byung ste/ nam mkha' ji srid khyab par gsung gi sgras chos ston pa yin te/ zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ lus can kun gyes bya dang ni/ /shing dang 'od zer thams cad dang / /nam mkha' las kyang chos kyi sgra/ /rgyun mi 'chad par thos par shog /ces dang / mdo dgongs 'dus le'u lnga bcu pa las/ da ni dus gsum bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi snying bo ste/ /stong bar sbas pa'i don 'di la/ /brda' dang dpes mtshon lde mig gis/ /mnyam nyid rig pa'i gter sgo dbye/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa rgyud kyi lung ni/ ye shes gsal ba'i rgyud las/ su zhig thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /gter dang ldan no khyad par che/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rig pa'i rgyud las/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs gter ni/ /rdza shing snod la yongs mi brten/ /zhes dang / rin chen spungs pa'i rgyud las/rgyud don gnas pa'i gter sgo phye/ /nam mkha'i mdzod gter nyid longs spyod/ /ces dang / rin chen rtsar gyi rgyud las/ phyi nang grags pa'i da la kun/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi gter nas 285

phyungs/ /lha sngags cho ga las tshogs dang / /thams cad thams cad de bzhin 'byung / /zhes dang /ye shes gsang ba'i rgyud le'u lnga ba nas/ gsang ba'i da la ye shes gter/ /mdo sngags gter gyi mdzod 'dzin cing / /rig pa'i bstan pa sgogs pa'i bdag /ces dang / 'jam dpal gter gtad las/ dam pa mchog gi rang gter stsal//dbul sel gter ldan sku drin che//zhes dang /ye shes gsang ba'i rgyud las/ gsang mdzod rig pa thugs kyi gter/ /bstan pa'i spyi 'grel gsang rgyud 'di/ /gu lang lung gi gser zo ru/ /seng ge'i 'o ma blug pa bzhin/ /snying gi dkyil du sba bar gyis/ /zhes dang / lung bskor dgu ba'i le'u brgyad pa nas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi gab gter 'byung / /sku gsum bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba'i dgongs gter 'byung / /chos sgo mtha' yas bstan pa rgyas/ /rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs gter 'byung / /man ngag rgya mtsho'i bstan pa rgyas/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i gtsug gter 'byung / /dgos 'dod yid bzhin bstan pa rgyas/ /zhes dang / rig pa rgyal po'i rgyud las kyang / dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs gter yin/ /rdza shing snod la yongs mi brten//zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa grub thob gong ma'i rnam thar las 'byung tshul ni/ rgya gar du te lo 286

pas rdo rje 'chang dag snang la zhal gzigs nas chos gsan pa dang / mi tri pas sha wa ri pa zhal gzigs nas phyag chen gsan pa dang / zhi ba lhas 'jam dbyangs zhal gzigs nas blo sgong gsan pa dang / mi tra dz+wa kis thugs dam lha drug zhal gzigs nas khrid drug gsan pa dang / dza larnya ra pas phag mo zhal gzigs nas chos gsan pa dang / mdor na rgya gar gyi grub chen phal cher gyis yi dam lha la dbang lung gdams pa gsan pa kho na mang la/ bod du yang sa chen kun snying gis 'jam dbyangs zhal gzigs nas zhen pa bzhi bral gyi khrid kyi rtsa tshig gsan pa dang / yang 'bi rla ba zhal gzigs nas gnang ba'i lam 'bras nye rgyud dang / gtsang pa rgya ras kyis sangs rgyas rabs bdun zhal gzigs nas rten 'brel kho bo lugs kyi rtsa tshig gsan pa dang / grub thob tshem bu pas rdo rje phag mo zhal gzigs nas thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid gsan pa dang / bo dong pa rtogs ldan sangs rgyas mgon pos o rgyan zhal gzigs nas seng gdong ma'i sgrub skor rgyas par gsan pa dang / rje dus mkhyen gyis dag snang la rgyal po i n+d+ra zu ti sogs grub thob bzhi dang mjal te/ phag mo zhal bzhi ma sogs khyad chos mang du gsan pa dang / rje /rma pak+ṣi la ber nag can sogs kyis dngos su 287

gsungs pa'i gdams pa mang po dang / rje rang byung pas o rgyan zhal gzigs te mkha' 'gro snying thig rtsa gsum dril sgrub sogs mang du gsan/ grub thob o rgyan pas phag mo zhal gzigs nas o rgyan bsnyen sgrub kyi rtsa tshig gsan pa dang / 'bri khung pa thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi grags pas ras chung pa zla ba drug tu 'bral med du bzhugs pa gzigs nas me tri snyan brgyud gsan pa dang / mi 'khrugs pa'i zhal gzigs nas dbang lung gsan pas mi 'khrugs nye brgyud dang / rje rgod tshang pas phag mo zhal gzigs nas mos gus phyag chen gyi 'khrid gsan pa dang /dus phyis nam mkha' 'jigs med kyis 'bras mo gshong du phag mo dang thod 'phreng sde lnga zhal gzigs nas/ phag mo'i ḍā ma ru'i sgra las byung ba'i rig 'dzin srog sgrub ces gnam chos thugs gter yongs su grags pa dang / de bzhin du gu ru chos dbang dang rat+na gling pa 'ja' tshon pa sogs la yang o rgyan rin po che sogs kyis dngos nyams rmi lam du gsungs pa'i snyan brgyud kyi skor shin tu mang po yod pa yin pas/ des na chos 'di yang sngon gyi lo rgyus de rnams dang mtshungs pa'i je tshom med pa lags so/ /de lta bu ni sngon dus dang bskal pa bzang dus yin gyi/ da ni dus snyigs pas de lta bu mi 'byung 288

ngam snyam na/ chos spyod thams cad mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyud las/ dper na mar me 'chi kha ru/ /'od ni gsal bar 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin nga yi bstan pa yang /nub khar zab mo'i chos dar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / pad+ma bka' thang las/ mi thog re song gter ston re re 'byung / /zhes dang / o rgyan chen pos lung bstan kun gsal me long las/ ji srid sangs rgyas bstan pa ma rdzogs par/ /zab mo'i gter gye bstan pa ga la rdzogs/ /ji srid sems can las spyod ma zad par/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs rje ga la rdzogs/ /ji srid las 'phro can rnams ma rdzogs par/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i chos rnams ga la rdzogs/ /zhes dang / pad+ma gling pa'i lung bstan las/ dus shin tu snyigs ma lung bstan skabs/ de dus lung ba re na gter ston sprul sku'o/ /dper na spang la sha mo nang brdol 'byung / /zhes dang /gter kha rnying ba lha 'bum gyi gter kha las/ dus da lta'i dus 'di gsal bar lung bstan pa'i skabs o rgyan gyi sprul pa mang po 'byung zhing gter thams cad brdol ba dang / o rgyan pad+ma dang thugs rje chen po'i bstan pa dar bar lung bstan to/ /de ltar go zhing thos kyang dad pa mi skye na ni/ o rgyan rin po che dang de'i chos la las 'phro med pa yin te/ bde mchog nyung ngu'i 289

rgyud las/ mos pa sgyu ma'i sems can la/ /spyod pa sna tshogs ston mdzad de/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis gdul bya la/ /thabs ni sna tshogs ston pa ste/ /zab mo'i chos ni ston pa la/ /gal te mos par ma gyur kyang / /smad pa ru ni mi bya ste/ /chos nyid bsam mi khyab dran bya/ /zhes pa ltar smad mi rung ste/ rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud phyi ma las/ bdag gi sems kyi gnas gtan la ma phebs par 'khrul nas 'di skad du/ 'di ni sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa ma yin gyi/ 'di dag ni rang bzo can gyis byas pa yin no/ /zhes zer ba dag 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gsang ba'i bdag po/ mi blun po de dag ni 'gro ba gnyis su 'gro bar rigs par bya ste/gnyis gang zhe na/ sems can dmyal ba dang dud 'gro'o/ /zhes dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ gang zhig chos mchog gtso bo 'di/ /rgyal ba'i mchod pa'i chos kyi mdzod/ /sa steng mis ni spangs byed pa/ /de ni mnar med dmyal bar 'gro/ /zhes dang / yum rgyas pa las kyang / chos spangs pa'i 'bras bus ngan 'gro mtha' med du 'khyams tshul rgya cher gsungs pa yid la byas te/ ngag bsdams te rang rang rnams bsrung bar byas nas/rang gis rang ngan song du bsgyur bar mi bya ba gal che'o/ /des na chos 'di ni shin tu zab cing ngo mtshar du mas khyad par 290

'phags te/ thugs rje chen pos dngos su gsungs pa'i bka' dri ma med pa/ kha gsar pa man ngag snon bris ma khyer/ brgyud pa thag rul du ma song bar brgyud pa nye/ mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma yal dus da lta ba la dgongs pa'i chos yin pas byin rlabs phan yon khyad par du 'phags pa 'di lta bu zhus chog pa ni tshe sngon tshogs bsags shing smon lam rnam par dag pa las byung ba yin pas/ the tshom med pa'i dad pa dang mos gus bskyed mdzod cig /ces gsungs so/ /rje btsun chos kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa'i nor bu ke ta ga'i bye dor las/ yang ke ta gar/ zab chos bka' rgya can dang / sa chos rdo chos/ gnam chos gter chos su grags pa gang dang gang zog po mkhan dzun mas sbyar ba/ zhes pa nas khye ltogs zas yin min gtsang mi gtsang gang la phrad pa bzhin du tsham tshom med par len mi rigs te/ zhes spyi gtam zhig gsungs pa la 'di skad gsol bar bya'o/ /zab chos bka' rgya can ni dge lugs pa/ sa skya/ bka' brgyud thams cad la yod cing / rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang rang gis bka' rgya mdzad pa'i zab chos kyang ches mang bas/ gsung de ha cang thal che bar sems/ gnam chos thams cad rdzun ma yin na spang gong phyag rgya/ lha tho tho ri'i dus su gnam las babs pa'i chos yin 291

pa la/ de ni gzhung 'di na rnam dag gi gras su bzhag 'dug pas/ gnam chos kyi mtshan gzhi drag shos de dag par 'jog na/ma dag pa'i gnam chos gzhan lo brgyar btsal kyang mi rnyed do/ /sa chos rdo chos zer ba'i tha snyad su la'ang ma grags pas/sa las thon/ brag las 'thon zer ba yod kyang de thams cad gter chos yin pas so sor smos mi dgos shing / de dag kyang zog po rdzun mas sbyar bar ma nges te/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/phyi ma de tshe dus dag tu/ /dge slong dgra bcom zhes bya ba/ /zhes pa nas/ sngon ni ngas ni gang bshad pa'i/ /theg pa chen po'i mdo sde yang / /de yi tshe na bum pa las/ /dka' thub chen po 'dren par byed/ /glegs bam de la des bltas nas/ /de la sngags ni zlos pa na/ /zhes lung bstan pa bzhin/ dge slong dgra bcom par grags pas bum ba bzang bo zhig nas mdo la sogs pa'i chos gang 'dod bton nas/ nyams su blangs pa'i lo rgyus kyang chos 'byung mang por 'byung / mdo sde mdzangs blun du khyim bdag cig gis khyim gyi ka ba las bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa'i cho ga thon pa'i lo rgyus kyang snang ba'i phyir ro/ /skal ba dang ldan pa dag la sa rdo ri brag gang nas kyang dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi 'byung ba yin te/ bsod nams thams 292

cad sdud pa ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo las/ dri ma med pa'i gzi brjed/ chos 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa gus pa dang bcas pa rnams ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan na 'dug kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi zhal ston par mdzad cing chos kyang thos par mdzad do/ /dri ma med pa'i gzi brjid/ chos 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis chos gter ri dang ri sul dang shing gi nang na bcug pa dag yod de/ gzungs dang chos kyi sgo mtha' yas pa glegs bam du byas te/ byas pa dag kyang lag tu 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /gter chos thams cad zog po rdzun mas byas par gsungs pa cung zad rtsing ste/ zhi byed kyi rgyud rnams dur khrod dpal gyi rgyu skar rol ba nas pha dam pas gdan drangs pa dang / ma hā ma ya'i rgyud o rgyan gye yul nas ku ku rī bas phyungs pa dang / rdzogs rim rlung sems dbyer med rdo rje gdan nas phyungs pa dang / seng gdong ma'i sgrub bskor rdo rje gdan gye shar phyogs pha bong g.yag 'dra ba'i 'og nas bla ma rdo rje gdan pa dang / bā ri lo tsā pas phyungs pa dang / ku ru ku l+le'i sgrub bskor 'ga' zhig rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs lha mo dud sol 293

ma'i nu 'bur na yod pa sgrol mas lung bstan te/ bla ma gnyal lo tsā pas phyungs pa dang / lha sa'i dkar chag ka ba bum pa can nas jo bo rjes phyungs pa dang / phan gnod las tshogs kyi skor 'ga' zhig ka ba shing lo can/ sbrul mgo can/ seng mgo can rnams na yod pa/ bla ma zhang dang jo gdan dkon mchog grags gnyis kyis sna 'ga' tsam phyungs pa dang / ro snyoms skor drug ti phu pa'i lung bstan bzhin ras chung pas lho brag mkhar chur sbas pa phyis su 'gro mgon gtsang ba rgya ras kyis gter nas bton pa dang / sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu rje dwags po rin po che dang / skyes bu ye shes rdo rje dpon slob gnyis kyis mtsho maṇ+ḍal nag po la gter du sbas pa/ dwags brgyud pa dung tsho ras pa rin chen bzang bos gter nas bton pa dang / rnam sras kyi sgrub skor 'ga' zhig bya rgod gshong nas gnyal ba nyi ma shes rab kyis phyungs pa dang / pu tra ming sring gi sgrub skor bsam yas nas lha btsun byang chub 'od kyis phyungs pa sogs rnying ma kho nar ma zad/ rgya gar dang bod kyi grub mtha' thams cad la yod la/ rang re dge ldan pa la yang / srad rgyud kyi mgon khang du 'dul nag pa dpal ldan bzang bos gter du sbas pa'i chos rgyal gyi las tshogs 'ga' zhig rgyud chen sangs rgyas rgya 294

mtshos bton pa dang / kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas kyang gter lung nas/ ma cig gi lung bstan dang gter rdzas bzhes pa dgongs par mnga' ba ltar lags/ khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan pa'i mnal lam du/ rje bcun tsong kha pa chen po dgung lo bco lnga bzhes pa'i tshod tsam la rgya ras bzang po'i na bza' gsol ba zhig gis/ bya khyung dgon pa'i mchod rten gyi steng na gter 'ga' zhig 'don rgyu yod tshul gyi bka' phebs pa byung na'ang / khri chen mdo khams su ma phebs pas gter bzhes rgyu ma byung 'dug dpal mchog gi rgyud las kyang / rgyud dang rgyud kyi rgyal po gang / /phyag na rdo rje khyod nyid kyis/ /gter nas gter du phyungs shing stsal/ /ces gsungs pas/gter chos thams cad rnying chos dang / gter chos 'don ma/ban thams cad zog po rdzun ma yin mi dgos pa 'dra lags gsungs/ sngon rgya gar gyi rgyal po dza'i pho brang steng du gser gyi glegs bam gyis char babs pa/ khong gis mgo thog tu bzhag nas gsol ba btabs pa'i byin rlabs kyis tshig don thams cad thugs la shar/ 'khor rnams la bstan par rgyal po 'khor bcas sangs rgyas par gsungs/ sngon bod kyi lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi dus spang gong phyag rgya pa/ tshirnya maṇi'i brkos 295

phor gser gyi mchod rten/ mdo sde za ma tog gi snying bo yi ge drug ma rnams mkha' las babs pa mchod par mdzad pas/dgung lo brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gcig bzhugs te bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ de bzhin du gter ston mi 'gyur rdo rje'i gnam chos thugs gter sogs phyis su 'byung ba rnams la yang dad cing gus pas nyams su blangs na rgyud la phan thogs par 'gyur bas de lugs gyis/ gal te nyams su ma lon kyang dag snang sbyong ba ma/na ngag mchog go /ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dgon pa na gnas pas ni/sangs rgyas kyi gter rnyed par 'gyur/ ye shes kyi gter rnyed par 'gyur/ sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / da ltar byung ba shes pa'i gter rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /gzhon nu ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sangs rgyas kyi gter rnyed par 'gyur zhe na/ gzhon nu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dben pa na spyod cing dgon par gnas na mngon par shes pa lnga 'thob ste/ lnga ga zhe na 'di lnga ste/ lha'i mig dang / lha'i rna ba dang / pha rol gye sems shes pa dang / sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi yul te/ gzhon nu mngon par shes pa 'di lnga 'thob par 296

'gyur ro/ /des mi las 'das pa'i lha'i mig gis/ shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med dpag tu med pa rnams mthong ngo / /de bzhin du lho dang nub dang byang phyogs kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med dpag tu med pa rnams mthong ste/ de sangs rgyas mthong ba dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhon nu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sangs rgyas kyi gter rnyed pa yin no/ /gzhon nu ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos chos kyi gter rnyed pa yin zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag phyogs bcu na chos ci ston pa de yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos lha'i rna ba'i kham sa kyis thos te/de chos nyan pa dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhon nu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos kyi gter rnyed pa yin no/ /gzhon nu ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ye shes kyi gter rnyed pa yin zhe na/gzhon nu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ye shes de dang ldan pas chos thams cad 'dzin te/ kun bzung nas mi brjed cing sems can rnams la chos ston te/ gang gi don gang yin pa de yang rab tu shes so/ /gzhon nu de ltar na byang chub 297

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ye shes kyi gter rnyed pa yin no/ /gzhon nu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / da lta byung ba shes pa'i gter rnyed pa yin zhe na/ des mngon par shes pas 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sems can thams cad kyi sems dang spyod pa shes par 'jug ste/ gzhon nu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos sngon gyi mtha' dang /phyi ma'i mtha' dang / da ltar 'byung bar shes pa'i gter rnyed pa yin no/ /gzhon nu mdor na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de lta bu'i chos la gnas pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad 'thob par 'gyur te/ de nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis kyang ma yin na/ pha rol rgol ba thams cad lta ci smos/ de la ni 'di skad ces bya ste/ mkhas pas rtag tu dgon gnas te/ /sangs rgyas gter dang chos kyi gter/ /ye shes gter dang mngon mtho'i gter/ /mngon shes lnga yang myur du 'thob/ /ces dang / chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo las/kun dga' bo/ gang gi chos yongs su gnas par bya ba'i phyir/chos kyi rnam grangs 'di dag glegs bam la bris te gter du 298

sbas nas mchod na/ de'i de nyid thob pa bcu 'thob ste/ gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan rab tu thob pa sangs rgyas mthong ba'i gter dang / lha'i rna ba rab tu thos pas chos nyan pa'i gter dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun rab tu thob pas dge 'dun mthong ba'i gter dang / rin po che'i lag pa rab tu thob pas zad mi shes pa'i gter dang / mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pas gzugs kyi gter dang / g.yog mi byed pas g.yog gi gter dang / spobs pa rab tu thob pas dam pa'i gter dang / phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcod pas mi 'jigs pa'i gter dang / sems can rnams nye bar 'tsho bas 'tsho ba bsod nams kyi gter dang / zhes sogs dang / rgya cher rol ba las/ brjod pa med pa dran pa'i gter dang / blo gros rab tu 'byed pas blo gros kyi gter dang / mdo sde thams cad kyi rnam nges khong du chud pas rtogs pa'i gter dang / thos pa thams cad kun tu 'dzin pas gzungs kyi gter dang / legs par bshad pas sems can thams cad tshim par byed pas spobs pa'i gter dang / dam pa'i chos yongs su bsrung ba chos kyi gter dang /dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs rgyud mi gcod pas byang chub kyi sems dang / mi skye ba'i chos la grub pa bsgrub pa'i gter te/299

gter chen po brgyad thob par 'gyur ro gsungs/ mkhyen brtse rin po che'i zhal nas/ de la gcig gis gter zer ba'i phyogs thams cad la sgro skur byed pa ni/ lce la thong bshol lnga brgyas rmo ba'i las yin no zhes dang / kha cig chos gter zer ba mi 'thad par 'dod pa ni shin tu snying rje ba'i gnas/ mdo'i phyogs nas kyang gang zag mthon po la gnas pas chos kyi gter rnyed par bshad pa'i phyir dang / zhes dang / sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter kha las/ ji srid sangs rgyas bstan pa ma rdzogs par/ /de srid gter gyis 'gro ba dpag med 'dren/ /de phyir gter la dad dang gus par gyes/ /zhes dang / chos rgyal rin chen phun tshogs kyis/ kho bo'i rdo rje slob dpon mnga' ris paṇa chen des/ chos kyi zab gnad rnams kyi rgyud pa dang /chos la sel med cing / mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs chil le ba gter ma yin pas/ gter chos tshad ldan ltar byed dgos gsungs/ bka' gdams bu chos kyi lha'i rgyal po'i skyes rabs kyi skabs/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ da bod du'ang yun ring bo song bas gdul bya skal ba dang ldan pa dag ni/ rang rang dang 'tsham pa'i chos bstan nas lam la bkod/ da re zhig bod na nga'i gdul bya tsam med/ 'di thams cad kyang rgyal ba rgya mtsho kho 300

rang gi zhing khams yin/ sngar yang rgyal rabs thams cad gter yig tu bkod pa las/ bshad pa dang bcas te yi ger bkod pa med de/ kho bo sbas pa'i brtul zhugs can yin/ sngon lha ma srin 'dul ba'i dus su bsam yas na gter du sbas pa yod/ de nga'i sprul pa zhig gis 'don/ de nas rab tu byung ba thams cad gzhi tshul khrims la 'god pa'i dus su/ gter du sbas pa yod de/ de yang nga'i sprul ba zhig gis 'don/ de thams cad kyang 'jol mo nyog tu mi sgogs/ rgyal ba'i bka' chems rim pa gsum rgyal rabs dang bcas pa ni/ sbed mkhan kyang rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ rgyal po nyid kyang rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ de'i blon po thabs la mkhas pa'ang rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi sprul pa/ de dag gi gter kha phal che ba nyid ni lha sa nyid na yod de/ sngon skye ba snga ma phan chad du ma 'ongs pa'i dus rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas rgyal por ji ltar 'gyur ba dang / de'i mdzad pa ji ltar mdzad pa dang / mdzad pa thams cad kyang gter du ji ltar sbed pa dang / gnyer kha mkha' 'gro mas ji ltar byed pa dang / deng sang ka ba bum pa can nas gter yig ji ltar 'don tshul dang / mkha' 'gro mas ston tshul dang /dus 'di na srid cig na rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi/ bu slob 301

ming can 'di tsam zhig 'byung ba ni/ sngon gyi dus na 'di yin la sogs pa nying 'phros du ma zhig yod pa de dag bskal bar kyang mi rdzogs gsungs/ des na ma ṇi bka' 'bum la sogs pa'i gter chos rnam dag rnams la nyams len byed mi nus kyang / log rtog dbang gis chos spong gi las ngan pa gsog par mi bya'o/ /yang bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can gyi bstan pa 'di la sngon dus rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du nyan thos sde ba bco brgyad byung ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan cung zad brjod na/ rtsa ba'i sde bzhi las so sor gyes nas/ nyan thos sde ba bco brgyad byung ba yin/ de yang rtsa ba'i sde bzhi ni/ phal chen sde/gnas brtan sde/ yod smra'i sde/ mang bos bkur ba'i sde bzhi yin/ de bzhi las gyes pa'i nyan thos sde ba bco brgyad ni/ slob dpon dul lhas/ shar dang nub dang gangs ri dang / /'jig rten 'das par smra ba dang / /rtag par smra ba'i sde ba rnams/ /lnga tshan dge 'dun phal chen pa/ /gzhi kun pa dang 'od srungs sde/ /sa srung sde dang chos srung sde/ /mang thos gos dmar slob ma dang / /rnam par phye ste smra ba'i sde/ /thams cad yod par smra ba yin/ /rgyal byed tshal gnas 'jig byed gnas/ /gtsug lag khang chen gnas brtan pa/ /sa sgrogs ris dang srung ba dang / /302

gnas ma bu yi sde rnams ni/ /kun gyis bkur ba rnam pa gsum/ /yul rnams slob dpon bye brag gis/ /tha dad rnam pa bco brgyad gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phal chen sde las/shar gyi sde dang / nub kyi sde dang / gangs ri'i sde dang / 'jig rten 'das par smra ba'i sde dang / rtag par smra ba'i sde ste lnga gyes/yod smra'i sde las/ gzhi kun pa'i sde dang / 'od srung sde dang /sa srung sde dang / chos srung sde dang / mang thos sde dang / gos dmar slob ma'i sde dang / rnam par phye ste smra ba'i sde dang bdun gyes/ gnas brtan sde las/ rgyal byed tshal na gnas pa'i sde dang / 'jigs byed gnas na gnas pa'i sde dang / gtsug lag khang chen na gnas pa'i sde ste gsum gyes/ mang bkur sde las/sa sgrogs ris kyi sde dang / srung ba'i sde dang / gnas ma bu'i sde ste gsum gyes pas/ thams cad bsdoms pas bco brgyad do/ /de rnams kyi skad rigs kyang mi 'dra ste/ phal chen sdes tha mal ba'i skad kyis smra/ yod smra'i sdes saṃ skṛ ta'i skad kyis smra/gnas brtan sdes 'bring du 'don pa'i skad kyis smra/ mang bos bkur ba'i sdes skad zur chag skad kyis smra/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung rang rang gi skad kyis 'don skad/ des na skad rigs mi 'dra bo nyan thos sde ba bco brgyad po yang / thub pa'i bstan pa 303

'di las so sor gyes pa yin pas dad pa byed dgos te/ dul lhas/ shākya seng ge'i bstan pa ni/ /de ltar dbye ba bco brgyad du/ /'gyur te 'gro ba'i bla ma de'i/ /sngon gye 'phrin las nges pa yin/ /gsungs/ de'i rten 'brel gyis bod du yang / sangs rgyas bstan pa gcig las grub mtha' mi 'dra ba bco brgyad byung ste/ de yang nyan thos rtsa ba'i sde bzhi lta bu la/ snga 'gyur rnying ma dang / gsar ma bka' brgyud pa dang / bka' gdams pa/ sa skya pa zhes grub mtha' rang rkang tshugs pa bzhi byung / de bzhi las gyes te grub mtha' mi 'dra ba bco brgyad byung tshul ni/de yang snga 'gyur rnying ma la/ ring brgyud bka' ma/ nye brgyud gter ma/ zab mo dag snang gi skor gsum gyes/ gsar ma bka' brgyud pa la/ garma pa/ 'brug pa/ 'bri gung / stag lung pa bzhi gyes/ bka' gdams pa la/ bka' gdams gzhung ba dang / man ngag pa gnyis gyes/ de las mched pa'i dge lugs pa la/ gzhung ba dang / snyan brgyud pa gnyis gyes/ sa skya las ngor ba gyes pas gnyis/ gzhan pha dam pa'i zhi byed/ ma cig gi skor/ shangs pa bka' brgyud pa/ jo nang ba/ bo dong ba ste/ grub mtha' mi 'dra ba bco brgyad byung ba thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa kho na las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du 304

byung ba yin pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che sgo sna tshogs nas phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas par byung la/ log lta spu tsam yang mi byed par/ grub mtha' ris su ma chad par thams cad la dad gus dag snang sbyong bzhin/mchod bstod bkur ba la brtson par byas nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnas nas sems can la bde skyid tshad med par 'byung bar 'gyur te/ legs bshad 'phrul gye lde mig las/ rang rang chos lugs mi 'dra sna tshogs kyang / /thams cad shākya thub pa'i chos lugs te/ /de phyir chos dang gang zag gang la yang / /skur ba mi gdab dag snang phyogs med bya/ /dper na sngon tshe sangs rgyas 'od srung dus/ /rgyal po kri kri de yi rmi lam du/ /ras yug gcig la mi zla bco brgyad kyis/ /bgos pas mi re la ni ras yug re/ /thob kyang rtsa ba'i ras yug ma nyams par/ /rmis pa shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la/ /nyan thos sde ba bco brgyad 'byung ba dang / /de dag thub pa'i bstan la ro gcig tu/ /'gyur ba'i snga ltas yin par gsungs pa ltar/ /de bzhin bod yul gangs can ljongs 'a di na/ /chos lugs grub mtha' mi 'dra sna tshogs shig /yod kyang phan tshun chags sdang mi bya zhing / /dag snang phyogs med 305

byas na mkhas pa yin/ /zhes dang / e ma tshad ldan skyes bu dam pa dang / /chos la dag snang 'byung bar ma byung kyang / /sdang shugs tshul gyis chags sdang cher byed pa/ /rang gzhan 'khor bar 'ching ba'i zhags pa yin/ /de phyir mang thos chu bo kun 'dus pa/ /legs bshad rba klong g.yo ba'i rgya mtsho nas/ /nyer babs yan lag brgyad ldan chu rgyun 'dis/ /kun slong dri ma mtha' dag da khrus shig /gsungs/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos khri gung thang pa rin po ches/ gangs can bstan pa'i srol 'byed pad+ma 'byung / /de don rgyud la sbyor ba a ti sha /de la 'khrul ba sel mdzad tsong kha pa/ /rnam gsum dbyer med tshad ma'i lung gis grub/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan la de nyid dang / /dbyer med paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ /rnal 'byor nyams myong can gyis legs brtags na/ /chos kun dgongs pa gcig tu 'bab par gsungs/ /'phags yul grub mtha' mang yang kri kri'i mdor/ /gsungs bzhin ston pa'i dgongs par mi 'gal na/ /gangs can grub mtha' tha dad thub dgongs su/ /'gal bar 'dod pa phyogs lhung gtam du zad/ /ces dang / grub mtha' so so'i bzhed gzhung phyogs tsam mthong / /kun kyang rnam grol sgrub pa'i thabs su go /de'i phyir yab rje'i bstan la yid 306

ches rnyed/ /chags sdang rmongs zhen dor ba'i rnam thar yin/ /gsungs/ garma pa kun mkhyen chos kyi grags pas/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i lung dang rtogs pa'i chos/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i sgo nas 'dzin mdzad pa/ /gangs can khrod kyi mkhas grub ma lus ni/ /mos gus yul las log lta'i yul ma yin/ /'on kyang snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dbang gyur cing / /khyad par bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan gnas skabs su/ /lta ba'i snyigs ma'i dri mas gos pa yi/ /rab tu byung rnams lta dang tshor bas 'khrugs/ /de la rgyal blon dus kyi lo paṇa rnams/ /rgyal pos bkas bcad lta ba klu sgrub lugs/ /theg pa che chung gzhung lugs blo sbyong mdzad/ /rnal 'byor bla med bsgyur ba re zhig bkag /de lta na yang snga 'gyur ci rigs pa'i/ /rnying ma'i rgyud rnams sbas te bsgyur ba las/ /theg pa rim dgu'i yang rtse rdzogs chen byung / /rgyal khrims zhig nas chos lugs nyams gyur kyang / /'dul 'dzin rnams kyis bstan pa'i me gsos shing / /sangs rgyas ye shes la sogs lo tsā pas / /dgongs 'dus mdo sogs bsgyur ba mang du yod/ /slad kyi lo chen rin chen bzang po dang / /'gos 'brog mar pa lho brag pa la sogs/ /lo tsā du mas gsang sngags gsar brgyud dang / yo ga rnal 'byor chen po dar bar spel/ /rnying 307

ma'i sngags 'chang sbyor sgrol sgra ji bzhin/ /sngags log sun 'byen brtsams la rtsod byas gyur/ /de'i tshe dpal ldan mar me mdzad dpal ni/ /'phags pa'i yul nas bod 'dir spyan drangs nas/ /lha btsun lo tsā rnams kyi bzhed pa ltar/ /bstan pa byi dor mdzad cing skyes bu gsum/ /lam sgon la sogs brtsams nas slob ma bskyangs/ /a ma na si phyag rgya chen po'i skor/ /do ha rnal 'byor ma rgyud 'chad pa dang / /phal chen sde pa 'dzugs par dgongs pa rnams/ /rgyal sras 'brom gyis bkag la ma mnyes kyang / /bod kyi de'i dus gdul bya la 'tsham zhing / /yod smra phal chen sde gnyis ma gyes pas/ /jo bo'i 'phrin las rgyas pa'i grogs su song / /sku mched rnam pa gsum nas bka' gdams pa/ /gzhung dang gdams ngag mtshan nyid gsum du gyes/ /'brog mi'i srol 'dzin lam 'bras rgyud gsum bcas/ /rje btsun sa skya pa yi ring lugs bzung / /mar pa'i bshad rgyud mes rdog mtshur gsum dang / /rje btsun mi las grub pa'i 'go btsugs te/ /mnyam med sgam po ba zhes bya ba ni/ /brgyud pa chu bo gnyis 'dres la brten nas/ /'phrin las rgya che dar drags yun ring ba'i/ /slob brgyud bod dang rgya nag la sogs gang / /dus phyis bka' phyag sa skya pa yi ni/ /bla ma mkhas grub rnams la 308

gtugs pa las/ /mkhas pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal zhes pas/ /mdo sngags bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pa byung / /zhes dang / lta ba'i khyad par dpal ldan a ti sha'i/ /rdo rje'i glu dang dbu ma'i man ngag dang / /gyer sgom las brgyud lhan cig skyes sbyor sogs/ /phyag rgya pa dang shin tu mthun pa byung / /blo sbyong gdams pa'i lam ngo kun gzhi dang / /be'u bum sngon por bshad pa'i lta bsgom mthun/ /nā ro mai tri dag la jo bo gus/ /de yi lo rgyus lam yig nang du gsal/ /de lta na yang gro lung pas mdzad pa'i/ /bstan rim zhes byar mai tri pa'i lta ba/ /skyon dang bcas zhes dngos su dgag pa mdzad/ /'jig rten la brten bka' phyag mthun par gyur/ /sa skya pa yi lam bskor rnam pa dgu/ /lam 'bras lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med dang / /phyag rgya chen po rnam drug dbye ba sogs/ /brgyud pa 'di dang lta sgom gcig gyur kyang / /rje btsun grags pas phag mo'i brda' dbang dang / /rngog lugs brgyud rim la sogs skyon bzung zhing / /khyad par chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ /sdom gsum rab dbye thub pa dgongs gsal dang / /phyogs bcu'i spring yig dri lan ci rigs su/ /lta sgom skyon 'dogs lhag par 'bri gung pa'i/ /grub mtha' 'gog bzhed mthing slad mdzad na yang / /phyogs snga phal cher 309

ma longs ltar snang gi /dgag pa mdzad par mthong nas bu ston dang / /rgyal sras thogs med red mda' pa rnams kyang / /phyag rgya chen po'i lta ba ji bzhin bzhed/ /so so'i zhal gdams mgur du don de gsal/ /rgyal ba yang dgon pa yi gdams ngag tu'ang / /sa skya pa dang lta ba mthun zhes gsungs/ /jo mo nang pa'i lta ba phal cher yang / /sa dwags gnyis las khyad par gyur bzhed kyang / /dgongs gcig pa dang grub mtha' mang po mthun/ /tshul des 'dra min dbye ba shes par gyes/ /rje btsun tsong kha pa de sngon gyi dus/ /gsung bgros thor bu rnal 'byor chen po'i khrid/ / byang rtse gung ru rgyan bzang pa sogs la/ /lta khrid phyag rgya pa dang mthun par gsungs/ /phyis dus dpyad pa rdzogs shing 'jam dbyangs kyi/ /zhal gyi gdams pa gzhung lugs chen po yi/ /lta ba rnyed nas mgon po klu sgrub kyi/ /srol 'dzin sangs rgyas bskyangs dang zla grags kyi/ /dgongs pa mchog tu rtogs nas lta ba ni/ /rig pas dpyad sgom kho na 'thad pa'i tshul/ /'khor ba'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzin lhan skyes dang / /dngos su 'gal ba'i bdag med bsgom dgos zhes/ /lhag mthong chen mo drang nges rnam 'byed dang / /lam rim chung ba lta khrid zhal bzhes sogs/ /snga rabs kun gyi lta sgom gnyis 310

ka las/ /khyad par 'phags shing rim lnga chos drug gi /gdams pa la yang zab khyad du ma zhes/ /rang tshugs thub par mdzad par mthong gyur nas/ /phal cher de yi rjes 'brangs lugs gzhan dor/ /ci rigs zhen ltas de la 'du mi byed/ /da lta de yi lta sgom 'gog pa mang / /nang du'ang cung zad lta grub bye brag yod/ /de lta na yang 'phrin las lhag par rgyas/ /lta sgom mthun dang mi mthun nges par mdzod/ /de ltar mang du thos shing rnam par dbye ba'i blo yod kyang / /dwags po bka' brgyud mkhas dang grub pa dag gi lugs bzung zhing / /bstan 'dzin che rnams kyis ni lugs la phrag dog mi byed par/ /de 'dra'i chos spong mi gsog rang gi brgyud pa 'dzin pa yin/ /dkon mchog brtsegs pa gang pos zhus pa'i mdor/ /bde gshegs me ro ghan+ta'i bstan pa'i mthar/ /dge slong rnyarma shri dang dran pa thob/ /ya sha rab tu 'dren pa zhes bya bzhi/ /skye ba rim par brgyud pa yin mod kyi/ /snga phyi'i chos kyi bstan tshul mi 'dra bas/ /de yi lugs zhes snga ma snga ma dag /phyi mas bkag kyang bstan pa ma nyams par/ /gsungs shing rgyal po kri kri'i rmi ltas ltar/ /ston pa shākya'i dbang po'i bstan pa la/ /nyan thos gyes pa bco brgyad byung na yang //bstan pa ma nyams tshul 'dis dag snang sbyongs//gsungs 311

pa ltar chos lugs grub mtha' gzhan rnams kyang shes par byas nas kun la dad gus dag snang sbyong bzhin rang nyid gang mos chos la thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa mkhas pa'i yang rtse lags so/ /gzhan yang bod yul gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir sngon chad dar ba'i chos lugs grub mtha' mi 'dra ba 'di rnams/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' du ma'i rnam 'phrul rgya bod kyi mkhas grub mtha' dag gis rdzun bral bden pa'i dbyangs gcig gis chos min dang ma 'dres ma sbrags par/ dam pa'i chos gtsang ma mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi lam po che las drangs te/ 'khrid phyogs re res kyang gang zag re mthar phyin/ sangs rgyas kyi sa ru skyel ba'i gdengs ldan du bstsal ba'i gnad ma 'phyugs pa'i sgos/phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa rje btsun grol mchog pa'i khrid brgya zhes yongs su grags pa ni 'di lta ste/ thog mar zhen pa bzhi bral gyi khrid dang gcig de nas blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid dang gnyis/ rten 'brel snying po'i khrid dang gsum/ skyid sdug lam 'khyer gye khrid dang bzhi/ sum pa'i blo sbyong gi khrid dang lnga/ ma cig gcod khrid dang drug snying bo don gsum gye khrid dang bdun/ sems nyid ngal gso'i khrid dang brgyad/ skyes 312

bu gsum gyi khrid dang dgu/ bstan rim gyi khrid dang bcu/srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi khrid dang bcu gcig dbu ma chen mo'i khrid dang bcu gnyis/ bka' gdams lkog 'khrid kyi khrid dang bcu gsum/ bka' gdams lha bzhi'i thub pa'i khrid dang bcu bzhi/ bka' gdams lha bzhi'i spyan ras gzigs kyi khrid dang bco lnga/ bka' gdams lha bzhi'i mi g.yo ba'i khrid dang bcu drug bka' gdams lha bzhi'i sgol ma'i khrid dang bcu bdun/po to pa'i dpe chos kyi khrid dang bco brgyad/ thig le bcu drug gi khrid dang bcu dgu/ sher phyin bka' babs drug gi khrid dang nyi shu tham pa/ zhi byed lam lnga'i khrid dang nyer gcig sgom rim thog mtha' bar gsum gye khrid dang nyer gnyis/ byams chos lnga'i khrid dang nyer gsum/ rang stong gi lta khrid dang nyer bzhi/ gzhan stong gi lta khrid dang nyer lnga/ sbas don gye lta khrid dang nyer drug tshe khred dang nyer bdun/ sgol dkar gyi khrid dang nyer brgyad/ tshe dpag med dkar po'i khrid dang nyer dgu/dmar khrid tshems bu lugs kyi khrid dang sum cu tham pa/ dmar khrid dpal mo lugs kyi khrid dang so gcig dmar khred zla rgyal lugs kyi khrid dang so gnyis/ /dmar khrid skyer sgang lugs kyi khrid dang so gsum/ bde mchog dmar khrid dang so 313

bzhi/ kye rdo rje'i dmar khrid dang so lnga/ phyag rdor 'khor chen gyi khrid dang so drug gtum po'i khrid dang so bdun/ phag mo ku rma bā da'i khrid dang so brgyad/ ku ru ku l+le'i khrid dang so dgu/sbyor drug gi khrid dang bzhi bcu tham pa/ dus 'khor snyan brgyud kyi khrid dang zhe gcig so rgyan bsnyen bsgrub kyi khrid dang zhe gnyis/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid dang zhe gsum/lam bskor phyi ma bsam mi khyab kyi khrid dang zhe bzhi/ lam bskor phyi ma pad+ma badz+ra gyi khrid dang zhe lnga/ lam bskor phyi ma ḍod+dhi pa'i lhan cig skyes grub kyi khrid dang zhe drug lam bskor phyi ma'i gtum mo'i lam stegs kyi khrid dang zhe bdun/ lam bskor phyi ma'i yon po srong ba'i khrid dang zhe brgyad/ lam bskor phyi ma'i phyag rgya'i lam khrid dang zhe dgu/ lam bskor phyi ma'i phyag chen yi ge med pa'i khrid dang lnga bcu tham pa/ lam bskor phyi ma'i mchod rten drung thob kyi khrid dang nga gcig mdo rgyud bsre ba'i khrid dang nga gnyis/ bar chad gsum sel las/ phyi rol gdon gyi bar chad sel ba'i khrid dang nga gsum/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi bar chad sel ba'i khrid dang nga bzhi/ ting nge 'dzin sems kyi bar chad sel ba'i khrid dang nga lnga/ phyag chen sdug bsngal gsum sel gyi khrid dang nga drug gnyug ma dran gsal 314

gyi khrid dang nga bdun/ dag pa gsum gyi khrid dang nga brgyad/rang byen rlabs kyi dmigs pa nyi shu rtsa dgu'i khrid dang nga dgu/ lam sbas bshad kyi khrid dang drug cu tham pa/ brda don gsal ba'i khrid dang re gcig gsang 'dus rim lnga'i khrid dang re gnyis/ grol ba'i thig le'i khrid dang re gsum/ spros med kyi khrid dang re bzhi/ rnal 'byor bzhi rim gyi khrid dang re lnga/ 'jigs byed kyi rwa khrid dang re drug yab la brten pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i khrid dang re bdun/ yum la brten pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i khrid dang re brgyad/ dril bu rim lnga'i khrid dang re dgu/ nag po rim bzhi'i khrid dang bdun cu tham pa/ bde mchog dkar po'i khrid dang don gcig gdan bzhi'i khrid dang don gnyis/ma hā mā ya'i khrid dang don gsum/ bde mchog bong zhal can gyi khrid dang don bzhi/ phag mo sgom drug gi khrid dang don lnga/ nā ro chos drug gi khrid dang don drug ne+e gu chos drug gi khrid dang don bdun/ phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma'i khrid dang don brgyad/lam 'khyer gsum gyi khrid dang don dgu/ sems 'chi med kyi khrid dang brgyad cu tham pa/ su kha chos drug gi khrid dang gya gcigabadag med ma'i nang khrid dang gya gnyis/ lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid dang gya gsum/ phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid dang gya 315

bzhi/ phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi ba'i khrid dang gya lnga/ sku gsum ngo sprod kyi khrid dang gya drug rlung sems gnyis med kyi khrid dang gya bdun/ sras mkhar ma'i khrid dang gya brgyad/ rngog pa'i bsre 'pho'i khrid dang gya dgu/ snyan brgyud kyi shog dril bzhi'i khrid dang dgu bcu tham pa/ snyan brgyud kyi khrid dang go gcigalus med mkha' 'gro'i chos bskor dgu'i khrid dang go gnyis/zhang gi zab rgya'i khrid dang go gsum/ dpal chen rga lo'i sbyor drug gi khrid dang go bzhi/ phag gru'i thel lugs bskor gye khrid dang go lnga/ dgongs gcig gi khrid dang go drug stag lung pa'i chos drug gi khrid dang go bdun/ bla sgrub kyi khrid dang go brgyad/lo ras thub pa lnga lngan kyi khrid dang go dgu/ ri chos so drug gi khrid dang brgya tham pa/ mgon po sku rags ma'i khrid dang gcigadapal gur gyi mgon po'i nang khrid dang gnyis/ do ha skor gsum gyi khrid dang gsum/ grub thob chos drug gi khrid dang bzhi/pad+ma lam rim gyi khrid dang lnga/ rgyal po bka' 'bum gyi khrid dang drug nor bu mthong grol gyi khrid dang bdun/ sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu'i khrid dang brgyad do/ /de ltar 'khrid tshul brgya dang brgyad/ rang gis gang las gang thob pa'i/ /yi ge ji bzhin nyung ngu'i tshig /don chen snying bo cha tsam bkod/ /thun 316

mong thun mong min pa'i khrid/ /spyi bsdoms gcig dril sngon btang nas/ /dngos gzhi rang rang ma 'dres pa'i/ /'khrid rim rgya mo'i thags pa'i dpe/ /brgyud ldan dam pa gong ma yi/ /dgongs pa phan tshun ma 'dzings par/ /lugs gang de las rang blo yis/ /nan gyis bcos pa'i dri ma bral/ /sangs rgyas rnam sprul rgya bod 'dir/ /sngon byon mkhas grub ma lus pa'i/ /bzhed pa'i zab gnad kun 'dus pa/ /'di 'dra thos pa skal ba che/ /kho bos zab khrid re re nas/ /dka' ba dang blangs btsal ba'i chos/ /khyed cag tshegs med dus gcig tu/ /rna bar len pa ngo mtshar rmad/ /snga ma'i bsags rgyab dbang byas pas/ /mi tshe chos kyi snang bas 'das/ /'tshol dang nyan dang dri dang sems/ /mthar ni yi ge'i lam du bris/ /rang gi tshe rabs phyi ma yi/ /chos kyi bag chags gso byed dang / /dus 'dir don gnyer dad ldan 'ga'/ /srid na de la'ang phan gyur cig /ces tshegs chung ngus chos kyi gnad bde blag tu rtogs pa'i khrid brgya'i dpe la bltas nas chos lugs gang la yang dag snang sbyong bzhin rang nyid gang mos chos de nyams su len pa la brtson par bya'o/ /grub chen skal ldan rgya mtsho'i rnam thar yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po las/ rje 'di nyid kyis bod gangs can gyi khrod 'dir/317

sngon byon pa'i skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi lugs srol 'dzin pa mang du yod kyang / de thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin mkhan yin gsungs nas/ rang phyogs dang gzhan phyogs zhes phyogs ris mi mdzad par/ thams cad la dag snang gis khyab par mdzad cing / chos sgor zhugs pa thams cad la dag snang 'ba' zhig mdzad pa yin gsungs/ khong gi mgur 'bum las/gzhan chos lugs grub mtha' sna tshogs la/ /yid g.yo ba'i dad pa skyes na rab/ /de min kyang dag snang sbyong ba dang / /don med par mi smod dam bca' yin/ /zhes dang / chos rang rang mos pa'i ngo na zab/ /mchog sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs dam pa/ /sa dge ldan gsar rnying kun la yod/ /gzhan ma smod kun la dag snang sbyongs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar chos lugs grub mtha' gang la'ang dag snang sbyongs par bya'o/ /rgya ra'i btsun pa sangs rgyas ye shes kyis/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' yas pa rnams la phyogs zhen dang zhen lta'i dri ma spangs te/ gzu bor gnas pa'i blos phyogs med ris med kyi sgo nas nyams su blangs shing / nyams su len pa mi lcogs kyang thams cad la phyogs ris spongs pa'i dad pa chen po bskyed na thabs mkhas pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /gsungs/ yang / gang la phyogs lhung 318

rab tu spangs/ /mkhas grub phyogs ris med pa yi/ /rjes su 'brangs shig shes ldan dag /ces dang / bka' brgyud gong ma thams cad kyis/ /zhi phyag rdzogs gsum thams cad la/ /snying bo byed pa mang snang bas/ /dad pas de rjes 'brang ba lags/ /zhes dang / rgyal ba'i bstan pa thams cad la/ /phyogs ris med par dad thob nas/ /tshul bzhin nyams su len par shog /tshul bzhin nyams len ma nus na'ang/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad la/ /phyogs med dad pa byed par shog /gsungs/ paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes kyis/ dbus gtsang mnga' ris bar gyi grub pa'i mtha'/ /kun kyang rgyal bstan kho na yin pas na/ /phyogs lhung gdon gyis sdang shugs ma mdzad par/ /dag snang nor bu'i 'od kyis khyab na legs/ /zhes dang / 'brug pa kun legs kyis/ phyag chen dang rdzogs chen dbu ma gsum/ /mkhas pas bltas na gcig tu 'dug /blun po chos spongs mdzad 'dod rnams/ /so sor phye la nga yis sgoms/ /zhes dang / rje btsun chos kyi dbang phyug gis/ bla ma chos brgyud grub mtha'i kha 'dzin smod/ /rang gzhan chags sdang bstod smad sgo skur spangs/ /lta ba kha 'khyer gsang ba mi 'chol bar/ /nang du sems shing kun la dag snang sbyongs/ /zhes dang / 'ol kha bzhad 319

pa rdo rjes/ rtag tu dam tshig ngo lkog med par srungs/ /dag snang khyab gdal phyogs ris med par sbyongs/ /zhes dang / rje btsun grol mchog pas/ yongs la dag snang ris med pa/ /de'i tshe ma dag gang du 'tshol/ /kun khyab skyabs yul ma lus pas/ /dus gcig byin gyis rlobs 'di mtshar/ /zhes dang / o rgyan chen pos/ dag snang mos gus phyogs med du byed pa shin tu gal che bas na gzab shig ces gsungs/ de ltar rgya bod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyis gsungs pa rnams/ 'dir yi ge mang du dogs nas ma bris so/ /des na ring brgyud bka' ma dang / nye brgyud gter ma/zab mo dag snang gi chos bskor gang la yang dad gus dag snang phyogs med du sbyong bzhin/ rang nyid gang mos chos de nyams su len pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /yang phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas par 'dod pa dang / ma sems can thams cad la bde skyid tshad med pa bskyed par 'dod pa'i phyi rabs kyi bstan 'dzin gyi skyes mchog rnams kyis/ sngon byon mkhas grub gong ma dang da lta'i skyes bu dam pa mang bo'i rnam thar dang gsung bzhin/ chos lugs grub mtha' gang la dad 320

gus dag snang skye ba'i legs bshad mang po rtsoms la zhogs dang / ma 'ongs pa na bstan pa dang 'gro ba sems can la phan thogs rgya chen po yong / de ma yin par khyi ngan 'ga' res dngos su 'dzin ma thub par/ rjes nas sus ma tshor bar nywa la 'dzin pa ltar/ grub mtha'i phyogs ris che ba 'ga' res/dngos su 'gog ma thub par lkog nas yig ngan mang po bris te 'gog pa de rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan 'dzin brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams la gnod pa chen po skyel bar 'gyur bas/de lta bu'i dpe ngan rdzas dug 'jog mi rung / gal te bzhag song baspyomar bltas na yang grub mtha' gzhan tshor log lta skyes nas chos spong gi las ngan pa bsags te phyi mar ngan song du skye bar 'gyur bas/ de lta bu'i dpe cha tsam yang nang du 'jog par mi bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di shin tu zab cing rgya che bas na/ grub mtha' gcig gnyis kyis phyogs re ba las yongs rdzogs zin pa dka'/ yongs rdzogs zin pa la bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis gcig gis gcig la dad gus dag snang sbyong bzhin/ bstan pa'i bdag po dpal ldan sa skya pa dang ri bo dge ldan pa rnams kyis bstan pa'i gzhi bzung / rnying ma bka' brgyud sogs grub mtha' 321

gzhan rnams kyis bstan pa'i zur brgyan nas thams cad kyis bzung na/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa rin po che yongs su rdzogs pa sgo sna tshogs nas phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur ram snyam pas/ de ltar du mdzad du gsol zhes bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams la bdag gis thal mo sbyar nas lan brgya'i bar du gsol ba 'debs pa lags so/ /smras pa/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun la sogs phyogs bcu yi//sangs rgyas yongs la gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsung bzhin chos byas nas/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par byen gyes rlobs/ /ston pas sngon dus chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus/ /tshig lhug tshigs bcad gnyis ka gsungs pa bzhin/ /'dir yang tshig lhug rnams kyi bar skabs su/ /slar yang tshigs su bcad nas dbyangs su len/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos/ /sngar yang gsungs shing phyin chad gsung 'gyur la/ /da lta yang dang yang du gsung ngo zhes/ /mdo sngags rgya bod mkhas grub mang pos gsungs/ /sde snod gsum las gsang sngags rgyud sde mang / /gsang sngags nang nas ma rgyud shin tu mang / /de dag kun las shes rab 322

brgyud mang zhes/ /jo bo'i rnam thar yongs grags ma las gsungs/ /byang chub sems dpa' dad pa phun tshogs la/ /sangs rgyas mi bzhugs na yang nam mkha'i dkyil/ /rtsig pa shing rnams las ni chos 'byung zhes/ /dam chos yang dag sdud pa'i mdo las gsungs/ /gsang sngags rgyud dang rgyud kyi rgyal po gang / /gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje khyod nyid kyis/ /gter nas gter du phyungs shing bstsal to zhes/ /rgyud kyi mchog gyur dpal mchog rgyud las gsungs/ /gter chos yin tshad thams cad rnying chos dang / /gter chos 'don pa'i gter ston thams cad po/ /zog po rdzun ma zhig yin mi dgos zhes/ /thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi rdo rjes gsungs/ /rgya gar nyan thos sde ba bco brgyad dang / /bod du dar ba'i grub mtha' ma lus pa/ /'gro kun bde thabs nang pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /chos lugs yin pas dag snang sbyongs par rigs/ /sngon byon skyes chen dam pa mang bo yis/ /mdo rgyud bstan bcos kun gyi gnad bsdus pa'i/ /khrid yig mi 'dra brgya rtsa phyogs gcig tu/ /rje btsun grol mchog pa yis bsgrigs la ltos/ /mkhas grub nyis 'dzoms skal ldan rgya mtsho yis/ /skyes chen gong ma'i srol 'dzin grub mtha' kun/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin mkhan yin gsungs nas/ /phyogs med 323

dag snang 'ba' zhig mdzad par gda'/ /ring brgyud bka' ma nye brgyud gter ma dang / /zab mo dag snang chos bskor gang la yang / /phyogs med dad gus dag snang sbyong bzhin du/ /gang mos chos la nyams len byas na legs/ /bod du dar ba'i grub mtha' phal cher la/ /'ga' res phyi rol pa las lhag par du/ /sdang ba chags sdang gdon gyis spyos pa'i rtags/ /chos ma shes pa'i rang mtshang bstan pa yin/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa shin tu rgya che ba'i/ /grub mtha' re res khos bzung snyam na yang / /rags rim tsam las thams cad zin pa dka'/ /bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa 'dzin 'dod na/ /sa dge gnyis kyis bstan pa'i gzhi ma gyis/ /phyag rdzogs sogs kyis bstan pa'i zur brgyan nas/ /kun gyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa zungs shig ces/ /yang yang bskul bas de bzhin 'dzin par sgon/ /bdag ni deng nas sangs rgyas ma thob par/ /tshe rabs kun tu rgyal ba sras bcas kyis/ /gsungs pa'i dam chos ma lus 'dzin pa dang / /mkha' mnyam 'gro la phan thogs 'byung bar shog /rnar snyan yid 'bab chos kyi glu dbyangs 'di/ /gsar rnying grub mtha' gang gis thos na yang / /rgyud kyi chags sdang phyogs ris kun zhi nas/ /chos lugs yongs la dag snang skye bar shog /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi 324

tshigs su bcad pa'o//de yang phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bod du nyi ma shar ba ltar gsal bar mdzad pa'i o rgyan rin po che/ jo bo rje/ rje rin po che rnams thugs rgyud gcig tshul ni/ lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan lha gcig jo bo a ti sha'i bka' gdams glegs bam rin po che'i lha'i rgyal po'i skyes rabs las/ mkhan brgyud du ma zad/ dge slong byang chub sems dpa' rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dang ldan pa dri med mtsho las skyes pa'i rdo rje ni rgya gar nas 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po zhig tu sprul par grags te/ dpal te ru ga'i bzhed pa ni kho bo kho na yin par byed/gdul bya'i dbang gis bod 'dir lan gnyis gsum tsam zhig 'ong ste sprul pa'ang de ltar 'gyed do/ /de dus kyi lo rgyus ni da lta'i sngags pa phal che bar grags kyang / khyed cag la shes 'dod kyang med pas bstan mi 'tshal/ zhes dang / gzhan yang nga nyid o rgyan pad+mar byas te bod kyi lha 'dre 'dul ba'i dus kyi chos rnams da lta'i sngags pa rnams la dar ba 'di yin te/ zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang bka' gdams glegs bam rin po che'i rgyal bu dkon mchog 'bangs kyi skyes rabs las/ 'di nas skye ba gzhan gyis ma chod par/ /bod khams mgon med yul du 325

thugs rjes song / /bod 'di rgyal po dag la tshad mar byed/ /mi dbang mdzod la bod khams bde bar skyongs/ /o rgyan yul du ji skad smros pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang gnas der lha 'dre 'dul du 'gro/ /zhes bla ma dri ma med pa o rgyan du sprul nas bod khams kyi lha 'dre 'dul ba dang / sprul pa gcig ni bal po'i mthil du 'gro/ /zhes bal po pad+ma badz+ra dang / sprul pa gcig ni rgya gar gnas chen 'grims/ /zhes dpal ldan a ti sha dang / sprul pa gcig ni mdo khams smad du 'gro/ /zhes tsong kha pa chen po dang lnga ka thugs rgyud gcig pa glegs bam rin po cher bshad pa rnams la dgongs nas thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas/ rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma 'byung / /lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan mar me mdzad/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar mdzad de la 'dud/ /ces dang / de bzhin rje 'bar chung pa bkra shis rgya mtshos/ gzi brjid 'od dpag med mgon o rgyan rje/ /a ti sha dang 'jam mgon blo bzang grags/ /ye shes gcig las rnam 'gyur chu zla'i gar/ /nges pa snying nas rnyed pas lan brgyar 'dud/ /ces gsungs pa rnams tshad mar bzung nas o rgyan bka' drin can/ mnyam med jo bo rje/ 'jam mgon bla ma 326

rnams kyi chos dang rgyud 'dzin rnams la bzang ngan phyogs ris med par dad gus dag snang sbyong bzhin mchod bstod bkur ba la brtson par bya'o/ /yang rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i legs bshad sa gsum gyi sgon me lta bu'i lam rim bsdus don las/ 'dzam gling mkhas pa yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /snyan pa'i ba dan 'gro na lhang nge ba/ /klu sgrub thogs med gnyis las rim bzhin du/ /legs brgyud byang chub lam gyi rim pas ni/ /skye dgu'i 'dod don ma lus skong bas na/ /gdams pa rin chen dbang gi rgyal po ste/ /gzhung bzang stong gi chu bo 'du ba'i phyir/ /dpal ldan legs par bshad pa'i rgya mtsho'ang yin/ /bstan pa thams cad 'gal med rtogs pa dang / /gsung rab ma lus gdams par 'char ba dang / /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag rnyed pa dang / /nyes spyod chen po'i g.yang sa las kyang srungs/ /de phyir rgya bod mkhas pa'i skye bo ni/ /skal ldan du mas bsten pa'i gdams pa mchog /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa yis/ /yid rab mi 'phrog dpyod ldan su zhig yod/ /gsung rab kun gyi snying bo bsdu bsdu ba/ /tshul 'di thun re ston dang nyan pas kyang / /dam chos 'chad dang thos pa'i phan yon sogs/ /rlabs chen bsdud par nges pas de don bsam/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 327

nyams su blangs na/ gzhan chos lugs grub mtha' gang la yang log lta mi skye bar gdams par shar nas/ dad gus dag snang 'char ba byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i khyad chos yin te/ bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rje 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/ bdag cag gi ston pa thugs rje can gyi chos gang gsungs tshad po sems can rnams mngon mtho lha mi/ nges legs thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i thabs sha stag yin la/ de dag rnams kyi brjod bya'i don thams cad tshur bsdu na/skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim par 'du la/ de yang skyes bu chung ngu'i skabs na mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang dang / skyes bu 'bring gi skabs na nges legs thar ba tsam dang / skyes bu chen po'i skabs na thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob thabs yin par go nas kun la dad gus dag snang skye ba byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i khyad chos yin gsungs/ bdag gi yongs 'dzin dge bshes chen mo'i zhal snga nas/ sa skya rnying ma jo nang pa sogs su gang la'ang ma gus pa dang brnyas smod gtan nas bya mi rung /tha na bon gyi g.yang 'gugs byed pa la yang / de sems can la phan pa bsgrub pa'i thabs shig red/ bon gyi drang srong chen po rnams kyis sems can la phan pa'i thabs su gsungs pa red 328

bsams nas dag snang sbyongs dgos/ bod 'di la bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang /mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho gnyis sku drin shin tu che ba yin te/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis bod kyi lha 'dre thams cad dam la btags nas da lta thams cad la chos byed rgyu yod pa 'di khong gi drin yin gsungs/ phyi rol mu stegs pa'i grub mtha' la gtan nas smod mi rung / sems can gyi las bsam gyes mi khyab/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa yang bsam gyis mi khyab pas na/ ci 'dra yin mi shes/ khyad par du rgyud sde nas mu stegs can la smod mi bya zhes gsungs pas dbang bskur sogs thob nas de dag la smod mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan phyi rol pa'i lha dbang phyug chen po sogs gsang sngags kyi snod rung gi gdul bya yin pas na'o/ /byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i che ba bzhi po 'di lam rim gyi gnas skabs kyi dgos pa'i phan yon yin gsungs/des na rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsung bzhin gang la dad gus dag snang sbyong ba la brtson par bya'o/ /gzhan yang ko'u shāka gi lan bstan bcos lta ngan mun sel las/ kun rtog grub pa'i chags sdang la brten nas/ /gzhan phyogs ris su bcad nas smod byed pa/ /dam chos spong ba'i las ngan gsog pa yin/ /thar 329

'dod rnams kyis 'khrul med lam bzang la/ /'bad cing dag snang phyogs med sbyong ba 'di/ /nam gzhag gtan gyi 'dun ma yin par go /thar 'dod thar pa'i lam la 'god pa'i phyir/ /log rtog lung dang rigs pas sel ba ni/ /bstan la phan pa'i dgag sgrub yin mod kyi/ /rang gzhan grub mtha' chags sdang la brten nas//skyes bu dam pa rnams dang de yi lugs/ /smad pa'i dgag sgrub 'di rnams dmyal ba'i rgyu/ /thar 'dod rnams kyis dgag sgrub gnas 'di la/ / bag yod bsten nas blang dor mdzad 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / rgyal dbang lnga ba rin po ches/rgyal kun shes rab ral gri rnon po'i mtshon/ /rnam dpyod dpung pas btegs nas thub bstan gye/ /log rtog dra ba gcod mdzad tsong kha pa/ /'jam dpal rdo rje ngur sprig zlos gar mkhan/ /phra zhib mdzangs pa'i nor bu ke ta gas/ /lan brgyar bgrungs pa'i khyod gsung dwangs pa'i chur/ /'khrul ba'i rnyog ma kun mkhyen ye shes kyis/ /phra rab rdul tsam gzigs pa'i gnas ma gyur/ /'on kyang bye brag smra pas sher phyin rnams/ /thub gsung min zhes rgol ba ji bzhin du/ /gzhung lugs mang thos mkhas pa ko'u shāka gis/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa'i gsung la rnam par gshung / /tshul der ma bzod 'jam dbyangs chos dga' bas/ /blo gros rnam par 330

yangs pa'i bshes gnyen dang / /rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ /rtsod ldan rdo rje thog gi rjes 'gro mdzad/ /phan tshun dam bca' 'gog pa'i lung rig gis/ /thal 'gyur 'phen pa rgya bod mkhas pa'i lugs/ /smod tshig ku re'i tshul du rtog ge yi/ /ngang tshul yin gyes 'khon du 'dzin rnams rmongs/ /gsungs/ rgyal sras thogs med rin po ches/ chos lugs tha dad 'dzin pa mang po rnams/ nged kyi chos 'di kho na mchog yin/ gzhan rnams dman pa dang nor ba yin gsung gin gda' na'ang/ de rnams kyi mtshan nyid ni ma rtogs/ chos de rnams nyams su blangs pa la gang zag bzang po mang bo byung ba yin zer gyin gda' bas/ chos de rnams bzang po yin yongs snyam pa byung lags gsungs/ rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i nyams mgur las/ rnam thar gtsang ma dge ldan bka' brgyud/ /phyogs re 'dzin pa'i grub mtha' min no/ /mdo sngags thams cad gdams par shar ba'i/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i nying khu lags so/ /a ho ye nying khu lags so/ /bde la mi rtog phyag rgya chen po/ /zhi gnas ltengs po'i tshom 'jog min no/ /rang sems spros bral gnas lugs mthong ba'i/ /bde gsal sgom gyi rang babs lags so/ /a ho ye rang babs lags so/ /zhes gsungs 331

pa rnams la go rgyu chen po 'dug pas blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis de lta bu'i lam la slob pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /yang 'jam dbyangs kha che'i paṇa chen pu bye shris mdzad pa'i rje rin po che'i bstod pa tsong kha brgyad cu pa las/ lho brag grub chen las kyi rdo rje la/ /gsang ba'i bdag po'i snyan brgyud gdams ngag dang / /mdo rgyud lam gyi rim pa gsan pa yis/ /brgyud pa'i bka' babs thob pa'i tsong kha pa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rje bdag nyid chen pos grub chen las kyi rdo rje'i mdun nas gsang bdag snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa sogs thob nas bstod pa mdzad pa las/ rgyal ba'i gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin rdo rje 'chang //de yi gsung rgyun bdud rtsis blo gros lus/ /legs par rgyas pa'i rgyal sras 'gro ba'i mgon/ /skye rgu'i gtsug gi rgyan la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsang ba'i bdag po dpal ldan bla ma yis/ /brtse bas bzung tshe bla ma'i yon tan kun/ /legs par mthong zhing yid ches chen po yis/ /the tshom bral ba'i gsung bzhin sgrub par shog /ces thugs smon mdzad pa ltar rje rin po che lta ba'i dogs pa grub chen las gyi rdo rjes/ yi dam phyag na rdo rje la zhus pas/ gzhom med kyi sgra zhig gis zhus lan bdud rtsi sman mchog ces bya ba'i gdams pa bstsal nas gnang ba'i dus 332

su/ nam mkha' na mkha' 'gro ma mang pos mgrin gcig tu/las kyi rdo rje bla ma'i mchog /phyag na rdo rje yi dam mchog /bdud rtsi sman mchog chos kyi mchog /blo bzang grags pa slob ma'i mchog /ces bsngags brjod gnang ba byung / khong la phul nas gzigs pas lta ba'i dogs pa thams cad chod tshe thugs dgyes nas/ gsang bdag gsung gi bdud rtsi yis/ /yid kyi re ba rdzogs par byas/ /nyon mongs nad las rgyal bar gyur/ /lcang lo can du phyin nam snyam gsungs/ zhus lan gyi nang na ci gsung yod dam snyam na de'i yig rnying khungs thub cig las/dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa/ ye shes kyi ḍā k+ki ma thams cad kyi snying gtam/ rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag gi gsang tshig theg pa'i yang rtse/ sman mchog chen po'i sgrub pa/sems nyid 'od gsal gyi rtsad chod gsungs/ yang las kyi rdo rje rig pa'i ngo bo stong ba 'di sus kyang ma bcos pa rgyu med rkyen med pa ye gdod ma nas gnas pa yin/ 'di la bcas bcos ma byed par/ kho rang gang 'dug gi steng du zhog dang gol sa med/ de bzhin du rang bzhin gsal ba 'di ye gdod ma nas stong ba dang dbyer med du lhun gyis grub pa/ de'i rtsal thugs rje 'gag med gang shar yang rang bzhin gyis rdul tsam yang ma 333

grub pas/ gsum ka zung 'jug chen por shes par gyes dang dbyer med du sangs rgya ba yin zhes phyag chen ji lta ba bzhin gsung 'dug pas kun gyis tshad mar bzung nas/ 'di lta bu'i chos thams cad la dag snang sbyangs par bya'o/ /gzhan yang lho brag grub chen las kyi rdo rje la yi dam phyag na rdo rjes dngos su gsungs pa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa'i mthar thug bskyed rdzogs bdud rtsi'i thigs pa las/ dngos 'dzin 'khrul snang ma zhig na/ /stong nyid bsgoms pa gol sa'i gnas/ /stong nyid blo dang ma bral na/ /gnyis snang chos kyis grol mi nus/ /sku lnga bsgrub byar 'dod pa dang / /dug lnga spang byar 'dod pa dang / /sangs rgyas thob byar 'dod pa dang / /'khor ba spang byar 'dod pa sogs/ /dgag sgrub der 'dzin ma chod na/ /yang dag snying bo'i don mi rnyed/ /dmus long nam mkha'i mtha' 'tshol 'dra/ /nam yang 'khor ba'i gnas su 'khyams/ /blo 'das tsam la blo zhen kyang / /blos byas chos kyis grol mi nus/ /don dam blo yi spyod yul min/ /blo zad chos zad theg pa'i rtse/ /rang sems chos sku dngos med la/ /rig pa'i ming 'dogs ma mdzad cig /lta rgyu med pa'i byang chub la/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying bo can/ /smra bsam brjod med ngang la zhog /blo las 'das nga/'i ngang la 334

zhog /byar med ngang la lhug par zhog /zhog ces bya ba blo yi tshig /zhog dang ma zhog tha snyad med/ /ming med rjes med rtag gzhi bral/ /rtag na blo ni dbyengs su zhi/ /dgag sgrub spong len klong du yal/ /sprin tshogs mkha' la dengs pa 'dra/ /rnam rtog ma spangs rang sar dag /lar ni lta sgom spyod 'bras bzhi/ /lta ba zhe 'dod med par gyis/ /sgom pa blo sgom 'dzin pa zhig /spyod pa byar med zhen med skyongs/ /'bras bu chos sku rang chas la/ /gzhan nas bsgrub pa'i yid smon dor/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong theg pa'i chos/ /rgyud 'brel man ngag brjod mi langs/ /de dag thams cad 'dus pa'i bcud/ /mar gyi yang zhun lta bu yi/ /man ngag bdud rtsi'i thigs pa 'di/ /bcud mchog seng ge'i 'o ma 'dra/ /snod mchog gser bum lta bu yi/ /las kyi rdo rje khyod la byin/ /zhes pa la sogs rdzogs chen gyi chos skad grub mtha' gzhan dang ma 'dres par yod pa'i phyir lam 'di nyid kyis grub pa brnyes par ma zad/ rje tsong kha pa'ang dbu tshad kyi grub mtha' 'jog skabs ma gtogs nyams bzhes phyag rdzogs dang mthun tshul rje gung ru dang / rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho sogs kyis bshad cing / don du'ang grub chen la lta ba'i sgo 'dogs bcad pa'i zhus lan bdud rtsi sman mchog tu bltas 335

pas shes par nus so/ /de ltar min na rje tsong kha pa tha snyad kyi gnas la mkhyen rab che ba'i phyir/ go yul gyi lta ba tsam la grub chen bsten mi dgos pa'i phyir ro zhes dge rtse rin po ches gsungs/ grub chen las kyi rdo rje'i gsung kun gyis tshad mar 'dzin dgos te/ rwa sgreng khri chen rin po che'i zhal nas/ lho brag grub chen las kyi rdo rje ni/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i bla ma yin pas de rang cag rnams kyis khas len dgos pa yin na/ kho bo'i rgyab skyor ni de nyid yin gsungs/ rje rang nyid kyis kyang nyams su bzhes te/ khong gi zhal nas/ bdag gis kyang mdo phyogs kyi bshad pa yod pa rnams la/ lo sbrel gyi bar du thos pa cung zad bgyis shing / man ngag zab par grags pa 'ga' yang yang zhus pa'i mthar/ rgyal ba sras bcas kyi dgongs pa/ thos pa'i rje 'jug sgrub pa snying bor byed/ /skye ba'i rdzong la tshegs chung thar bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rigs nas sgrub pa la mos pa drag po byung gsungs/ des na man ngag zab par grags pa ni grub chen las kyi rdo rjes gang stsal ba rnams yin par thag chod/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang de bzhin du nyams su blangs na skal ba bzang ngo / /bla ma mchod pa las/ sgrib med lhan skyes dga' ba'i rol pa dang / /dbyer med brtan g.yo 336

kun khyab kun gyi bdag /thog ma mtha' bral kun bzang don dam gyi/ /byang chub sems dngos khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs par/ de'i khrid yig man ngag gi gter mdzod las/ bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyid brtan g.yo kun gyi bdag po dang / des brtan g.yo kun la khyab pa la sogs pa gsung 'di dag gi don shin tu rtogs par dka' zhing / ma rtogs na bla med kyi lam gyi srog mi rnyed la/ rtogs na shin tu don che zhes dang / 'di lta bu'i gsang ba'i gnad rnams ni/lung tsam skyabs su gyur pa rnams dang / rtog ge'i rig pa la mkhas pa tsam gyis cha tsam yang shes par mi nus kyi/ bla ma dam pa'i bka' drin kho na la rag las par gsungs te/ brtag gnyis las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /gang du yang ni mi rnyed de/ /bla mas dus thabs bstan pa yis/ /bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /zhes gsungs shing / rdo rje 'chang blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis kyang / gzhan gyis brjod min bde chen lhan skyes/ /gang du yang ni rnyed pa min pa/ /khyod zhabs bsten cing khyod gsung thos pas/ /mngon sum 'gyur mdzad bka' drin zla med/ /rje btsun blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ /bka' drin chen po snying nas dran pa'i/ /sgo gsum dang 337

bas gsol ba 'debs so/ /sgrib bral bde stong dbyer med lhan skyes/ /myur du skye bar byin gyis rlobs shig /ces gang gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsungs/ yang gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud du/kun tu bzang po zhes pa don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes la yang dang yang du gsungs pa ltar yin gsungs/ yang bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rwa sgreng khri chen rdo rje 'chang rin po che'i gsung gi zin bris kun gsal nor bu'i me long las/ gzhi dus kyi rlung sems dbyer med de/ spros pa dang bral ba'i cha nas bde ba dang / rang bzhin gyes ma grub pa'i cha nas stong ba ste/ de nyid dbyer med zung 'jug tu yod pa de la/ gzhi dus kyi bde stong dbyer med zer/ zhes dang /rlung sems dbyer med ces pa'i rlung sems kha cig gis phyi rol gyi rlung bser bur ldang ba de lta bu zhig yod dam snyam pa ni mi 'thad de/ sems gsal rig dbyer med pa de'i gsal ba'i cha nas sems dang / yul la bya ba byed pa'am rig pa'i cha nas rlung du bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang sngags kyi skabs su bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes de/ bde ba/ gsal ba/ stong ba/ shes pa thams cad yin te/ ngo bo la dri mas ma gos pas 'od gsal ba/ rang bzhin gyes ma grub pas stong ba/338

spros pa dang bral bas bde ba chen po/ sna tshogs snang ba'i cha nas sems yin pas/ tshul 'di lta bu la sngar bshad pa ltar/mtshan nyid pas rig pa'i rgyas bkab nas skur ba 'debs mi rigs shing / rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gis nyan rang dang sngags la ma zhugs pa'i byang sems sogs la yang gsang sngags mi ston par gsungs pa yang 'di dag blo yul du ma shong bar skur ba 'debs par dgongs pa yin pas/ rang cag rnams kyis kyang de'i gnad shes pa gal che gsungs so//gzhan yang rang lugs nang pa sangs rgyas kyi grub mtha' dang / gzhan mu stegs byed dang bon po sogs kyi grub mtha' yang sdang sems kyis smod par byed pa dang / khyad par du yang bod 'dir ni sngar bshad pa ltar sa dge rnying 'brug sogs so so'i grub mtha'i kha 'dzin bgyis te/ gzhan dag la sdang zhing smod par byed pa ches mang la/ de ltar byas na rtsa ltung drug pa 'byung ba yin pas/ de dag gi legs cha blangs te nyams len dang mos gus sogs ma byas kyang chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshul nges par byas nas btang snyoms su 'jog par bya/ zhes dang / rang gzhan gyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa gang yang rung ste blo gros kyi mig phyogs lhung ling tog gis nongs pa dag gis/ 'di lta bu ni snga phyi'i go 339

rim 'chol ba'o snyam pa dang / rtog ge'i tshig skam dang mi mthun no snyam pa dang / rang gi grub mtha'i snying bor rlom pa'i dpe chung re gnyis dang mi mthun pa sogs rgyu mtshan du byas nas dam pa'i gsung la smad par byed mi rigs te/ mdo sngags kun la nang byan chud pa'i bdag nyid chen po dag gis zab mo'i tshig don dang go rim tsam la 'khrul pa shes bya la mi srid pas/zhing dam pa la brten nas rang gzhan gyi rgyud la bsod nams ma yin pa'i sa bon mi 'debs par zhu zhes dang / bde lam 'chad pa'i skabs su yang / spyir gsar rnying shar 'brug sogs kyi grub mtha' kun la phyogs lhung gis sdang shugs byed mi rigs te/ de dag rang rang gi lam la brten nas kyang sangs rgyas pa'i thabs yod la/ de'i phyir chos spong gi las 'gog pa'i slad du kho bos kyang dus rgyun grub mtha' ris su ma chad pa mtha' dag la dag snang sbyong dgos tshul nan gyis zhus pa yin gsungs pa ltar grub mtha' gang la dag snang sbyangs par bya'o/ /dzā ya paṇ+ḍi tas gsan yig gsal ba'i me long las/ spyir lus dag pa de rigs 'ja' lus grub pa mkha' spyod grub pa/ lhag med du gshegs pa/'od skur grol ba/ 'od skur yal ba/phung po zag med du gyur pa rnams ming gi rnam grangs las/ rags pa 340

don gcig pa/ la la lus de ga dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bsu ba dang bcas/ dril bu dang ḍā ma ru'i sgra khrol le/ nam mkhar je mthor je mthor gyur pa'i tshul dang / la la skra sen la sogs pa lus kyi snyigs ma rnams bzhag nas dwangs ma 'od sgur yal ba'i tshul dang / la la na bza' spud de slob dpon pad+ma gung thang la thog nas srin yul du gshegs pa lta bu bcas pa'i tshul de dag 'phags yul grub pa thob pa brgyad cu'i nang nas/ dā ri ka pa 'khor bdun brgya dang bcas te mkha' spyod du gshegs pa dang / ku ku rī pa grong khyer pi la sa tru'i skye bo'i tshogs mtha' yas pa dang lhan cig gshegs pas mtshon grub chen brgyad cu po las rang nyid gcig pu dang / la la 'khor dang bcas pa phal cher sku lus ma spangs par gshegs pa dang /'jigs byed chos 'byung du/ lā li ta badz+ra 'ja' lus brnyes nas rdo rje btsun mo'i zhing du gshegs par bshad/ bod du sa lugs dkar po rnam gsum la rje btsun rtse mo dang / bka' brgyud phyogs la ras chung rdor grags dang ras pa zhi ba 'od sogs lus de nyid du mkha' spyod nye lam 'grub pa byung skad dang / snga 'gyur du rgya gar du dga' rab rdo rje/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ shrī sirnya sogs paṇa grub rnams dang / bod du bai 341

ro tsa na nas bzung nyang shes rab 'byung gnas yan gye nye lam rdzogs pa chen po'i snying thig gi bla brgyud rnams rje bla ma'i gsan yig rin po che gang gā'i chu rgyun du/ 'di yan snang gsum zad sar 'khrol nas 'ja' lus grub ste mkha' spyod du gshegs pa sha stag go zhes bka' stsal/ gsungs/ slob dpon rin bo che gru kyā grub chen blo bzang dkon mchog gis/ pha bong byang chub shing gi nags khrod du bya btang ba'i tshul khrims sgrub pa 'ba' zhig mdzad/ 'grongs gdong / sems gsal stong rig pa hrig ge ba/ zhes sogs zhal gdams dang / zhag shas 'khris su mi yong bar bsgul bskyod sogs ma byed ces grongs pa/ slar sku gdung yer bar skyel ba'i sta gon mtha' dag grub pa'i tshe/ phung po 'ja' ltar dngos med du yal bas rjes 'jug rnams go don chung bas/ grongs pa las kyang khong rang rnams ca ka ma dag pa lta bu'i ha las pa byung 'dug ces gsungs/ de bzhin du snyigs dus 'dir yang sa dge rnying 'brug sogs dben par sgrub la gzhol ba mang po'i nang nas re gnyis re 'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub pa dang / gshegs khar ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bzang bo bstan nas gshegs pa mthong thos rnams la dad gus dag snang sbyangs par bya'o/ /yang de 342

nyid las/ rang phyogs sol ba ltar gyur kyang dkar snyam pa dang /gzhan phyogs dung ltar song yang nag snyam pa'i dbang gis/rang gi bla ma gong ma dag gis yig cha bzhag pa rnams kyi tshig don gyi cha la skyon zhugs shing / bcom ldan 'das kyi dgongs par ma song yang / de nyid shes bzhin du zhen kha'i dbang gis/da dung lung dang rigs pa 'brel med mang po drangs nas sgrub pa dang / gzhan phyogs kyi bla ma gong ma rnams la skyon cung zad med cing / bcom ldan 'das kyi dgongs par song ba mthong yang da dung kun slong ngan pas/ lung dang rigs pa ltar snang mang pos phyin ci log tu bsgrub e thub lta ba dang / dbang lung man ngag gang yang rang nyid kyi ma thob bzhin du gzhan la 'chad pa sogs mtha' yas pa zhig mthong zhing thos gsungs/des na blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis de lta bu'i gtam la yid brtan mi bya'o/ /dpon byang ba'i zhus pa'i lan/ kun mkhyen dol po shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis phul ba'i chos kyi shan 'byed las/ yang khyed rnam rtog ma 'gag par mi rtog ye shes mi 'thob pa la mtshar du brtsis nas rnam rtog 'gag pas mi rtog pa de dag gti mug tu mdzad par gda' ba/ de ltar gang nas bshad pa lags sam/ 'di yang bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung 343

rab las ches phyi rol tu gyur par mngon te/ rnam par rtog pa ni sgrib pa gnyis kyi ngo bor gsungs pa'i phyir dang / rnam rtog 'gag pa nyid las mi rtog ye shes thob gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang ji skad du/ rgyal ba'i yum las/ rab 'byor shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni rnam par mi rtog pa'o/ /rnam par mi rtog pa las sangs rgyas su brjod do/ /rnam par mi rtog pa las byang chub tu brjod do/ /zhes pa la sogs pa dang / 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa'i mdor yang / rigs kyi bu rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes las gud na 'phags pa'i ye shes med do/ /zhes pa dang /'phags pa yon tan rin po che sdud par yang / skye ba med dang skye ba gnyis gar mi rtog pa/ 'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /kye rdo rje rgyud du yang / lus la ye shes chen po gnas/ /rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs/ /zhes pa la sogs pa dang / de'i 'grel bar 'phags pa rdo rje snying bo'i zhal nas kyang / lus la ye shes chen po bzhugs/ rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs par grub ste/dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i rtog pa dang bral ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ye shes rtog pa'i dra ba dang bral ba zhes pa nges pa'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dpal sam bu 344

ṭi las kyang / kun rtog thams cad rnams spangs pa/ /stong nyid snying bo khyod la 'dud/ /kun mkhyen ye shes phung bo can/ /ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa dang / rtog pa'i gnas ni spangs nas su/ /blo ldan gang zhig mi rtog gnas/ /thugs kyi rdo rje gsungs pa bzhin/ /de las dngos grub the tshom med/ /rtog pas dmyal bar 'gro 'gyur zhing / /'gro drug rgya mtshor 'khor bar 'gyur/ /rtog pa las ni rnam grol nas/ /dri med zhi ba'i gnas su 'gro/ /zhes dang / rnam rtog rmongs pa chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ltung byed yin/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na/ /mkha' bzhin dri ma med par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ /de bzhin du rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud du yang gsungs pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes de yang 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par grol ba'i ngor ro gcig pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/dper bgyis na/ nam mkha'i khams rtog pa dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba ste/ mi rtog pa rnam par mi rtog pa lags so/ /zhes pa dang / rtog pa sdug bsngal rgyur gyur pa/ /ji srid ma spangs bar du ni/ /'jig rten 'di ni sangs rgyas min/ /kun mkhyen zhes kyang mi bya'o/ /zhes pa dang / dpal rdo rje 345

phreng ba mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud du yang / rnam rtog kun nas zad pa las/ /yang dag ye shes bde chen skyes/ /zhes gsungs shing / phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud du yang / rtog dang bral ba'i ye shes ni/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba mngon sangs rgyas/ /rtog dang bral ba de la ni/ /gsang sngags 'grub par bstan pa yin/ /de yi 'bras bu rnam dag pa/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal 'gyur/ /gang zhig rtog la gnas byed pa/ /de la dngos grub mi 'byung ngo / /de lta bas na rtog spangs la/ /sngags kyi gzugs ni bsam par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / mngon par brjod pa 'bum par yang gsungs pa/ ye shes sku ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /kun rtog thams cad spangs pa yi/ /bsgom pa de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ /zhes pa la sogs pa gzhan yang gsung rab dri ma med pa rnams su rnam pa mi rtog pa'i bsngags pa rgya cher gsungs te/ 'dir yi ge mang du dogs nas ma bris so/ /de lta bas na rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bde ba chen po'i sku sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la sogs pa thams cad rnam rtog 'gag pa'i mi rtog pa yin pa'i phyir/ galta mug yin pa ha cang thal bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang / rgyal ba byams pa'i zhal snga nas/ 'khor gsum 346

rnam par rtog pa gang / /de ni shes bya'i sgrib par 'dod/ /ser sna la sogs rnam rtog dang / /de ni nyon mongs sgrib par 'dod/ /ces pa dang / der ni sgrib pa thams cad de/ /de zad nas ni grol bar 'dod/ /ces gsungs shing / slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos kyang / rnam par rtog las ma gtogs pa'i/ /'khor ba zhes bya ci yang med/ /rnam rtog de dang bral bas na/ /khyod ni rtag tu mya ngan 'das/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / slob dpon seng ge bzang pos kyang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi nyon mongs pa rnam par rtog pa'o/ /zhes pa la sogs pas sgrib pa thams cad rnam par rtog pa las ma 'das par gsungs pa'i phyir rnam par rtog pa 'gag pa na sgrib pa zad pa nyid yin te/ zhes gsungs/ des na deng sang kha cig gis mi rtog pa zhig yin phyin dran med brgyal ba gnyid mthug dang khyad med ces zer ba rnams mdo sngags kyi lung 'di dang 'di 'dra ba la mtha' yas pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur bas chos spong gi las tshabs chen mi gsog par gang zag rtog pa mthon por gyur pa rnams kyis 'jog bsgom gtso bor mdzad pa la dad gus dag snang sbyang bar bya'o/ /yang stag tshang lo tsā pas rje rin po che la 'gal ba'i khur chen star snang bco brgyad btegs 347
