pa'i tshigs bcad ni/ gang dag dpal ldan zla ba'i rjes 'brangs nas/ /ma dag 'khrul ba'i snang ba tshad grub tu/ /rigs pa du mas dpyad nas khas len pa/ /'di la 'gal ba'i khur chen 'di ltar yod/ /yul kun dzun dang yul can bslu med 'gal/ /yul der 'khrul dang de la tshad mar 'gal/ /rjes dpag yod dang sgrub ngag med pa 'gal/ /mthun snang med dang chos can tshad grub 'gal/ /phyi don tshad bcas rdul phran tshad grub 'gal/ /rigs drug tshad ma gdos bcas tshad grub 'gal/ /skra shad med dang rlung nag yod pa 'gal/ /rjes grub med dang dngos po yod pa 'gal/ /gzhan skyes med dang sa myug rdzas gzhan 'gal/ /bden rdzun yod dang yang log med pa 'gal/ /yan lag la dpyad bum pa mi rnyed dang / /skad cig la dpyad zhig sa rnyed pa 'gal/ /rang rgyud smra bas rang bzhin smras pa dang / /rang bzhin med blo de'i ngor grub pa 'gal/ /nyon mongs can min ma rig yod pa dang / /shes par gyur pa'i shes sgrib med pa 'gal/ /gzhung gzhan nas 'byung kun gzhi rang rig sogs/ /'gog na rang lugs de dag mi 'dod dang / /sde bdun las gsungs tshad ma mi 'dod dang / /rang lugs tshad ma'i rnam bzhag shes pa 'gal/ /mi rtog sogs rtogs rnal 348

'byor mngon sum dang / /de yis sbyor lam rtog par mi slebs 'gal/ /gzhan sems shes pa yid mngon yin pa dang / /bden bzhi shes pa rnal 'byor mngon sum 'gal/ /kun mkhyen ye shes chos kun 'jal ba la/ /shes bya'i phyed la tshad ma min pa 'gal/ /rdzas yod bdag smra gnas ma bur nges dang / /rnam shes bdag smra'i bu sems yod pa 'gal/ /zhes rje rin po che la dgag pa btang ba de'i lan/ bla ma byams pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i rdo rje'i gzegs ma las/ slar yang 'gal ba'i khur chen btegs pa'i tshigs bcad ni/ gang dag dpal ldan zla ba'i rjes 'brangs nas/ /dag dang ma dag kun rdzob tshad grub 'di/ /rigs pa du mas dpyad nas 'gog byed pa/ /'di la 'gal ba'i khur chen 'di ltar yod/ /tshig zur tsam yang zhal bzhes ma gnang ba'i/ /bcas ldan dge slong rlabs chen rdzun gsung 'gal/ /me phar bus na sma ra tshur tshig pas/ /rang tshig dngos 'gal smra ba'i seng ger 'gal/ /rjes dpag sgrub ngag yod med gnyis ka 'gal/ /zla ba'i rjes 'brangs de nyid 'gog pa 'gal/ /chos rnams thams cad ltos grub yin pa dang / /rdul phran cha med 'dod na shin tu 'gal/ /las kyi nus pas brnag yod ci zhig 'gal/ /phyogs snga 'gog rlom rang lugs 'gog pa 349

'gal/ /tha snyad tsam gyis gzhan dang rang mtshan gyi/ /gzhan gyes khyad par mi shes gzhan 'gog 'gal/ /'grel med tshig tshogs 'gal ba'i kha grangs tsam/ /rigs par smra ba'i mkhas la shin tu 'gal/ /mi 'gal 'gal bar 'dzin pa rang gi skyon/ /'bad nas gzhan la bsgyur bar byed pa 'gal/ /thal ba 'brel med rang 'phangs rang gis 'gog /smyon pa min pa'i skye bo kun dang 'gal/ /ma rig bag chags ma rig pa min pas/ /de nyid shes par sgrub pa khyod nyid 'gal/ /blo gros chung ngus sbrang bu gsod snyam pas/ /rdo bas pha yi klad pa bcom la ltos/ /'jam dbyangs bla mar gnod pa bya snyam nas/ /zla ba'i lugs kun snying nas sun 'byin 'gal/ /bco brgyad grangs ka tshang tsam thal ba yis/ /rang mtshang ston dang mkhas par rlom pa 'gal/ /kun mkhyen ye shes chos kun mi mkhyen dang / /ma rig pa yis shes bya phyed 'jal 'gal/ /rab tu mi gnas dbu mar nan 'tshengs nas/ /gzhi med bag tsam skur 'debs byed pa 'gal/ /zhes lung rigs gis bsgrubs nas lan rgya cher btab pa rnams la bltas na mkhas pa zhig gis mi 'gal ba zhig la 'gal ba ltar snang du ma 'phud thub cing / 'gal ba zhig kyang rig pas mi 'gal bar sgrub shes pas/ mkhas pa'i dbang bo 350

rnams kyis gsungs pa rnams sgra ji bzhin par mi 'dzin par de yi dgongs pa btsal shes na/ de gnyis kyang don gyes 'gal ba med par shes nas dad gus dag snang skye bar 'gyur ro/ /yang/ mkhas mchog dbyeg gnyem gyis/ theg chen nam mkha'i pad+mo la/ /klu sgrub bdud kyi sprul ba byung / /phu bo de yi rjes su 'brangs/ /gsungs pa dang / rgyal dbang lnga bas/ gar 'brug bla ma pho rog khyu dang 'dra/ /'on kyang pad+ma dkar po phug ron tsam/ /gsungs skad/ kun mkhyen pad dkar gyis/ sa steng 'di na pad dkar kho bo tsam/ /e yin mi yin drang bor ltos dang gsal/ /gsungs skad/ yang 'ga' res/ rgyal dbang la sgu bstod gsol 'debs shig zhus pas/ za hor paṇa chen bod la bka' drin che/ /'phyong rgyas las 'khrungs sku la 'das 'khrungs med/ /da lta shar 'brug gnyis kyi kha gnon mdzad/ /rgyal dbang rin po che la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gsungs skad/ rje tho'u bkwan rin po che la grwa pa 'ga' res/ bla ma rin po che rnam gsum la sku bstod gsol 'debs shig dgos zhes zhus par/khong gi zhal nas/ ma mo'i dal sha bzhes pa'i sgo mang pa/ /rgya nag phu dung gyon pa'i lcang skya pa/ tshwa sgog g.yer gsum za ba'i tho'u bkwan pa/ /mtshungs med bla ma gsum la gsol ba 351

'debs/ /zhes gsungs nas bzhad skad/ gsung de rnams kyi rgyu mtshan lo rgyus rnams shes na/ log lta mi skye bar ma zad dad gus dag snang skye ba'i rgyur 'gyur la/ de bzhin du bla ma gzhan gyis zur za dang dgag pa btang ba rnams kyi dgongs pa lon na rab/ gal te ma lon kyang bstan 'gro gzhan la phan pa'i dgongs gzhi 'dra ci 'dra yod mi shes snyam du gang la'ang khas mi gtong bar dag snang sbyangs par bya'o/ /'dzam gling sangs rgyas gnyis pa mnyam med jo bo rjes/ dngos nyams rmi lam du/gsang sngags kyi rgyud mtha' yas pa gsan pa'i nang gi don dam pa'i rgyud drug ces pa mthar thug 'ba' zhig ston pa de rnams bod du— bsgyur rgyu yin na/ rnying ma'i rdzogs chen dang /phyag chen/ do ha 'dra ba rkyang yin par snang / deng sang gang zag dbang po yang rab cig char ba'i gang zag rin chen gser las dkon/ rim gyes pa mang ba'i dbang gis/ nges don gye rgyud mang po'i dgos pa chung / de bas drang don mang bo bsgyur bshad gnang na/ sangs rgyas gyi bstan pa yun ring gnas shing /sems can thams cad la bde skyid yun ring 'byung bar dgongs nas/ bod gangs can gyi lha skal phyag na pad+mo'i rnam 'phrul 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis mnyam med jo bo 352

chen po la/ do ha sogs nges don gyi chos mang bo ston du ma bcug ste/ jo bo'i rnam thar du/ ldog gi tsha snar byon nas/ gang zag gcig gis/ gcig char du 'jug pa'i ngor do ha zhus nas gsungs pa la/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi zhal nas/ mar me ci dgos lha bshos de ci dgos/ zhes sogs rnams bod la mi phan pa zhig yong ba 'dra/ 'di bod du mi legs zhus nas bka' bsdams/ yang mchims phur/ dhe ba rā tsa dang / nā ga rā tsa dang /'gar dge ba/ lo tsā pa dang bzhis zhus pas/ dug gi sngags can dug gis mi tshugs bzhin/ /zhes pa'i skabs su/ 'brom gyis 'dis bod la gnod pa las mi yong/ phyin chad mi gsung bar zhu zhes gsol/ yang jo bo'i zhal nas/ ngas phal chen pa'i sde zhig gzugs sam gsungs pa la/ dge bshes ston pas/bla ma de mi mdzad par zhu/ bod du 'di mi legs zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ gsang sngags kyi sdom pa dang / do ha'i glu la sogs pa bshad dbang yang med/ sde gzugs dbang yang med na/ kho bo bod du 'ong ba la don ma mchis gsungs/ thugs skyo ba ltar mdzad rung / 'brom ston pa rin po ches de dag rnams 'dzug tu ma bcug pas jo bo'i bstan pa rgyas pa'i grogs su song gsungs/ des na gsang sngags kyi mthar thug do ha rdo rje'i 353

glu la sogs pa/ 'dod yon ma spangs rgyan du rol bzhin/ rdo rje'i glu dang gar byas gang zag dbang po yang rab tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgya ba'i gdams pa zab mo rnams la dad gus dag snang sbyong bzhin/ rang nyid gang mos kyi chos de la thos bsam sgom gsum byed pa la brtson par bya'o/ /gzhan yang rgya gar na paṇ+ḍi ta'i lta ba'i rtsod pa nyan pa'i skye bo 'ga' zhig gis glu blangs par/ mi pham thogs med lta ba ni/ /skye bo kun la bdud rtsi nyid/ /'phags pa klu sgrub lta ba ni/ /la la'i sman dang la la'i dug /ces smra skad/ ka dpe las/ gcig char ba yi sman chen de/ /rim gyis pa yi dug tu 'gyur/ /rim gyis pa yi sman chen de/ /gcig char ba yi dug tu 'gyur/ /zhes dang / rig 'dzin dpal ldan bkra shis kyis/ khyad par yod de blo kha dman pa la/ /blo chen chos lugs bstan na mi 'chun pas/ /kho rang blo dang 'tsham pa'i chos ston gces/ /blo bzang skal ba ldan la gong ma ston/ /ces dang / yang ka dpe las/ gang zag sbyangs pa'i 'phro can la/ /gcig char ba ni bstan par bya/ /gang zag dang po'i las can la/ /rim gyis pa ni bstan par bya/ /gsungs/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis/ rje rin po che la stong phyogs las snang phyogs la gtsigs su che dgos par yang yang gsungs/354

skyob pa 'jig rten mgon pos/ stong nyid las rgyu 'bras/gsang sngags las 'dul ba ste/ deng sang gdul bya la ltos nas/ mi zab pa ni zab par gsungs/ rtogs bya'i don zab mo dang / de rtogs par bya ba'i thabs gnyis las thabs gtso gsungs/ rje blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas/ mthon po'i lta ba de lta bu ni o rgyan chen po sogs sngon byon pa'i dus skabs bzang po'i gdul bya dbang po yang rab tu gyur pa de dag rgyud tshod dang 'tsham pa'i dbang gis mngon du gyur par snang yang / deng sang gi skye bo shes rgyud tha mal las cung zad kyang ma 'phags pa dag la/ lta ba mthon po de lta bu'i phan pa las cig shos su 'gyur ba'i nyen che bar sems gsungs/ dpon ston rin chen sgang pas/ chos rgyud dang 'tsham par mi byed par/ /theg pa la mtho bsnyegs byed pa 'di/ /rta rgod la bu chung bskyon pa 'dra/ /rang rgyud dang 'tsham pa 'di gal re che/ /zhes dang / mdo las kyang /byes dang rgan gye kha zas tha dad bzhin/ /de yi chos kyi rang bzhin tha dad do/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang / /rnal 'byor pa yang blo khyad kyis/ /gong ma gong ma dag gis gnod/ /bsungs/de dag rnams la dgongs nas/ rje bdag nyid chen pos/dbang po yang rab kyi chos phyag chen do ha sogs gdams ngag 355

zab mo rnams gsang nas thugs nyams su bzhes kyang / snyigs dus 'dir gang zag dbang bo yang rab dkon par mkhyen nas do ha sogs la rtsal bton nas ma gsungs par/ gang zag mchog dman bar ba thams cad la phan thogs pa'i phyir skyes bu gsum sogs lam thun mong ba dang / thabs kyi cha la rtsal bton nas gsungs pas/ deng sang bstan 'gro yongs la phan thogs rgya chen po 'byung ba 'di ka lags/ rje rin po ches mdzad pa'i sa gsum gyi sgron me byang chub lam rim chen mo'i lhag mthong ston pa'i thog mar/ 'dir sa mthon po'i lhag mthong rnams re zhig gtso bor mi ston gyi/ so so skye bo'i dus kyi bsgom par bya ba'i lhag mthong gtso cher ston pa yin gsungs/bar zhig na/ sems 'phro ba'i yul dang 'phro mkhan gyi sems rnams brtags pa na stong bar rtogs pa dang / stong bar rtogs pa'ang btsal ba'am dpyad pa na stong bar rtogs pa dang / de dag kyang stong nyid bsgom pa'i tshe byed par gsungs shing dpyad nas stong bar rtogs pa des mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor la 'jug par gsungs zhes pa dang / mjug na/ so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis mang du dpyad pa'i dpyad pa de nyid kyis gnas cha brtan po rnyed pa nas lhag mthong thob nas 'ong bas 356

zung 'brel kyang de nas 'jog pa yin no/ /zhes dang / 'di dag gi sgo nas zhi lhag gi skyong tshul la'ang khyad par du ma zhig dbye dgos par snang mod kyang tshig mang bas 'jigs nas ma bris so gsungs/ legs bshad gser phreng las/ chos nyid la mtha' bzhi la sogs pa'i spros pa gang du'ang mi 'dzin zhing /de mtha' dag nye bar zhi ba tsam la spros bral lam/ gshis lugs mthong zhes btags pa tsam ste/ yon tan rin po che sdud pa las/ gzugs rnams mi mthong tshor ba dag kyang mi mthong zhing / /zhes sogs drangs pa dang / rim lnga gsal sgon las/bram ze chen po'i do ha sogs kyang sngar bshad pa'i lam mthon po'i skabs de dag tu spros pa gzhan dor nas/ lhan skyes ye shes kyi skor nyid snying bor byas te skyong dgos pa'i tshul ston pa yin gsungs/ paṇa chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i phyag chen yang gsal sgron me las/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsal sgon sogs su do ha sogs nas gsungs pa ni sngags lam mthon po'i nyams len yin gsungs pa bka' gzhan du mi 'gyur ba yin te/ zhes gsungs/ khri gung thang pa rin po ches/ sa rnying bka' brgyud pa sogs lta bar grags tshod dang bstun nas dgag bzhag byas pa yin gyi/ rtsa ba'i slob dpon rnams 357

kyi bzhed pa'i dbang du byas na lta ba'i dbye ba cher med do gsungs/ yang snga rabs pa rnams kyis glod rab ces bshad pa la/ khri gung thang pa rin po ches/ sngags kyi rtogs pa mthon por song ba'i skabs su/ de 'dra'i dus shig kyang yod dam snyam/'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid ni/ /glod na grol bar the tshom med/ /ces pa 'di sa ra ha'i gsung yin zhing / dper na skud pa lta bu ha cang grim drags pas mdud pa byung ba de glod na rang babs su zhig 'gro ba bzhin/ sems rnam rtog gis bcings pa la bcos par bzhag na/ sems kyi ngo bo rang yal du 'gro gsungs/ 'o na rdzogs chen gyi lta ba de gang dang mthun snyam na/ dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lugs kyi rang stong dbu ma dang /gzhan stong dbu ma gnyis kyi gzhan stong dbu ma dang mthun/rags pa phyi yi dbu ma dang phra ba nang gi dbu ma gnyis kyi phra ba nang gi dbu ma dang mthun/ chos 'khor rim pa gsum gyi/'khor lo tha ma dang mthun zhes dbu ma'i rnam nges bde gsheṭa snying bo'i rgyan las gsungs/ mnyam med po to pa'i gsung sgros dpe chos rin chen spungs pa las/ slob dpon klu sgrub dang / thogs med nas brgyud pa bar ma chad pa/ gdams ngag bum pa gang byo lta bu/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam tshang la 358

ma nor ba 'di la brtson 'grus rab tu brtsams na/ tshe 'di nyid la mthong lam skye/ brtson 'grus 'bring bar dor skye/ brtson 'grus tha mas kyang skye ba bdun la sogs pa brgyud nas skye ste/mthong lam skyes pa de ga la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub zer ba yin gsungs/ de la yang mnyam gzhag gtso bor byed pa dang / rjes thob gtso bor byed pa gnyis yod pas/ de gnyis las mchod gang che zhe na/ mthong lam skye ba la mnyam gzhag gtso bor byed pa myur/ mthong lam skyes na yang rjes thob gtso bor byed pa mchod che gsungs/ 'o na mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyi dus bskal ba grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags dgos pa dang 'gal lo zhe na mi 'gal te/sangs rgyas pa'i dus grangs med gsum nges pa can du 'dod pa 'dini/ theg pa chung ngu dngos po smra ba'i lugs yin te/'dis gang zag gi blo phyogs gcig tu ma nges pas sangs rgya ba'i dus la nges pa med de/ rtag tu ngu dang nor bzang la sogs bzhin/ /zhes pa/ 'phags pa rtag tu ngus shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'tshol ba'i tshe/ nyin mo dang mtshan mo yid la ma byas/ bkres pa dang skom pa yid la ma byas/ tsha ba dang grang ba yid la ma byas/ lus dang srog la ma ltos par btsal zhing 359

bsgoms pas/ tshe gcig la lam bzhi rgyud la skyes pa yin gsungs/ tshong dpon gye bu nor bzang gis/ tshe gcig la dge ba'i bshes gnyen brgya rtsa bcu gnyis bsten nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi bka' bzhin du brtson 'grus chen po'i nan tan byas pas/ tshe gcig gis don thams cad 'grub pa yin gsungs/ gzhan yang 'phags pa kun dga' bos/nyin gcig bsgoms pas 'phags pa dgra bcom pa thob pa'i gtam rgyud dang / slob dpon lwa wa pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yi ge a'i gdams ngag bsgoms pas/ nub gcig gis phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob ba'i lo rgyus sbyar/ der ma zad de/ dbus su rnal 'byor pa phyag pa khri mchog dgung lo sum cu pa la jo bo rje dang mjal nas gdams ngag zhus nas bsgoms pa'i tshe na/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ dus de ring nas ming yid la ma byed/ rus yid la ma byed par byams pa dang / snying rje byang chub kyi sems 'ba' zhig sgoms shig gsungs pas/khong gis kyang de bzhin mdzad pas/ dgung lo sum cu rtsa lnga ba la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob nas/ rtsig pa dang ra ba la thogs pa med pa zhig byung skad/ des na rang re la don phyin ci ma log pa zhig skyes phyin lam la 'bad rtsol byed ma nus 360

kyang / dbang bo tha shal gcig ma gtogs pa tshe gcig gis mthong lam skye ru btub/ mthong lam skyes na/ sa lam shugs la bgrod pa yin gsungs/ sdud pa las kyang / shes rab pha rol phyin 'di su yi lag thob pa/ /ring bor mi thogs 'dren pa rnams kyi byang chub 'thob/ /ces dang / gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo las/ rigs kyi bu mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ 'dod na zhag bdun gyis kyang byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'gyur/zhes dang / rdzogs rim gyi rnam bshad rdo rje gsal byed las/gzhan yang 'di snyam du sems te/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud las/lus dang ngag sems rdo rje la/ /rdo rje 'jam pa rab tu bsgom/ /lus dang ngag sems la spros pas/ /rdo rje 'jam pa 'dra bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing / de'i 'grel ba sgon gsal las/ rdo rje 'jam pa ni yid kyi rang bzhin gyi sgyu ma'i sku dang / de rang gi lus ngag yid gsum bsgom par ma zad khams gsum lus ngag yid gsum la spros nas bsgoms pas rdo rje 'jam pa dang 'dra bar 'gyur ba dang / zhes pa nas/ so so'i skye bo rnams kyis mi mthong zhing mi reg pas na ting nge 'dzin 'di ni mi snang ba zhes bya'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis rim pa gsum pa'i sgyu lus grub pa'i 361

yon tan bshad nas/ de'i tshe rang gi lus ngag yid gsum sgyu lus su bsgoms shing dngos gnas la grub pa de bzhin du/khams gsum 'gro ba gzhan rnams la yang spros te bsgoms pas/rang dang 'dra ba'i yon tan dngos gnas la thob par gsungs/'di dag dang gnad gcig pa rdzogs chen gyi chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba'i mgo rtsom pa na skye ba la dbang bas/ sems can sum stong la rig pa bcug pas thams cad gcig tu grol ba'i mthu chen po thob par gsungs pa gnad gcig ste/ pha rol bo de dag gis lam ma bsgoms kyang / lam bsgom pa po'i rnal 'byor de dang / las kyi rgyu ba gcig pa'i rten 'brel la brten nas/ sa lam gye rtogs pa thams cad skad cig ma 'ga' zhig la rdzogs par byas nas grol ba thob pa dang 'tshang rgya ba yod cing / dper na te ru gas drag po btul ba'i dus su/drag pos rlung dbu mar 'jug pa'i sdud rim sngon du 'gro ba dang / dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dbang bskur ba sogs bgyis pa la ma ltos par/ dus myur ba'i skad cig nyid la/ sa 'og tu sangs rgyas par bde mchog gi gleng gzhi rnams las 'byung zhing / rdo rje dbyings kyi rgyal po chen po'i gleng gzhi las kyang / bcom ldan 'das kyis drag po dbang phyug chen po 'gug 362

pa'i ched du/ rdo rje lcags kyu dang zhags pa sogs mngags pa na/de dag gis ma thub/ rdo rje 'bebs pa mngags pas dbang phyug la dbang med du ye shes babs te/ rang gis rang la brdeg cing 'tshog par 'gyur/ der bcom ldan 'das kyis thugs rje chen pos bsgral ba las dbang phyug skad cig la sangs rgyas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thal ba'i dbang bor gyur/ slar yang sngar gyi lus la bkug nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa sogs mchis gsungs/ rje dwags po lha rjes/ dge bshes snyug rim pa la tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgya ba srid dam zhus pas/ tshe 'di la ltos pa spu tsam med pa zhig dgos pa yin gsungs/ mnyam med bo to pa'i gsung sgos be'u bum sngon po las/ bya rnyi las shor ba'am/ mi btson las shor ba ci la yang phyi mig mi lta bar 'bros pa ltar/ tshe 'di dang phyi ma la sogs pa gang la yang mi chags par/ tha mal pa'i rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa thob par byed pa'i bsam pa dang ma bral ba gcig gis sgrub pa la 'bad na/ gsang sngags dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam la nye ring med par gnyis ka shin tu myur ba yin gsungs/ des na de 'dra ba'i gsung gang la yang /gzhung gzhan dang 'gal bar 'dug snyam nas log lta spu tsam 363

yang mi bya bar/ dag snang sbyong bzhin de ltar bya'o/ khri gung thang ba rin po ches/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi 'dren tshul yongs grags rgyud bla ma'i dngos zin ltar dang / der cung zad mi 'dra ba/ rin chen phreng ba las/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang gi/ /lha rnams kun las babs pa dang / /de bzhin du ni mya ngan las/ /'das pa ston pa'i mdzad pa yin/ /zhes lha las babs pa gcig tu bgrang ba dang / theg bsdus las/ bzo'i gnas la sbyangs pa dang / bdud btul ba gnyis dngos su ma bgrang bar/ mu stegs can gyi gnas su gshegs pa dang / zhes de dag gi lta ba sun dbyung ba'i phyir mu stegs lhag spyod sogs kyi drung du phebs nas thar lam 'tshol ba'i tshul bstan pa gcig tu bgrang/ mdo 'ga' zhig tu bstan pa gnas pa gcig tu bgrang la/ la lar bstan pa nub pa'ang gcig tu bgrangs te/bu ston chos 'byung las/ thabs la mkhas pa zhes pa la sogs pa'i mdo las/ dam pa'i chos nub pa la mkhas pa zhes chos nub pa'ang mdzad pa gcig tu gsungs te/ chos don du mi 'gyur bas na nub par bstan pas/ sems can la chos spong gi las mi 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir yin te/ zhes pa lta bu ci rigs yod cing / mchog gi sprul sku so so la'ang rang rang gi mdzad pa ston 364

tshul mi 'dra ba du ma gsungs pas/ rnam pa gcig kho nar kha tshon gcod mi dgos so zhes gsungs/ sangs rgyas re res thugs bskyed tshul dang / sangs rgyas tshul gyi bshad pa mi 'dra ba du ma byung ba ltar/ rje bla ma sangs rgyas tshul la'ang / seng ge'i nga ror 'tshang rgya ba dang / yang 'jam dbyangs kyi lung bstan gcig tu/ de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes dbang po zhes bya bar 'tshang rgya ba dang / ma cig gis/ ma 'ongs bskal bzang sangs rgyas bdun pa yin/ /zhes byams mgon nas bgrang ba'i bdun pa spyan legs su 'tshang rgya bar gsung ba sogs dang / thun mong ma yin par rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dang ngo bo gcig pas bskal ba dpag med kyi sngon nas sangs rgyas pa dang / yang bskal ba dpag med kyi snga rol tu dbang po'i tog gi spyan sngar mjal tshul 'di'i sgo nas bsgrubs na'ang de'i dus nas bzung ste gsang sngags kyi myur lam la tshul bzhin du slob pa'i gdul bya shin tu dbang rnon yin pas bskal ba ches mang bo'i sngon rol nas sangs rgyas zin par grub ste/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ so skyes rang bzhin pa'ang dbang bzhi ba thob la dam tshig dang sdom pa ma nyams na bsgom pa sogs ma byas kyang / snyigs dus kyi skye ba bcu drug tshun la nges par rdo rje 365

'chang gi go 'phang 'thob par rgyud sde rnams las gsungs pas 'gyur med lung rigs kyis grub pa'i phyir zhes gsungs/ des na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mdzad pa rnam thar mi 'dra ba mtha' yas pa gdul bya rnams la ston pas/mtha' gcig tu bzung nas gzhan rnams la smod pa sogs mi bya'o/ /yang dpal ldan sā ra ha'i do ha rdo rje'i glu las/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te/ /gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu thams cad ster byed pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / 'phags mchog klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i chos dbyings bstod pa las/ gang zhig kun tu ma shes na/ /srid pa gsum du rnam 'khor ba/ /sems can kun la nges gnas pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /ces dang / rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhabs nas/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /legs tshogs rtsa ba gcig pu gang / /rang bzhin dri ma dang bral ba'i/ /'od gsal rang gi sems nyid do/ /zhes dang /bdag gi yongs 'dzin dge bshes chen mos mdzad pa'i bsang yig las/ gdod nas rnam dag gnyug sems dwangs pa'i mtsho/ /dkar nag las rlung bser bus 'du byed las/ /phan gnod 366

yul gyi rba rlabs gang g.yo ba/ /chu la rlabs bzhin rang sems ngang du thim/ /gsungs/ brtag gnyis las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /zhes dang / mdo las/ bde gshegs snying bos 'gro ba yongs la khyab/ /'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas rgyu/ /zhes dang / rgyal ba byams pas/ rigs yod phyir na lus can kun/ /rtag tu bde gshegs snying bo can/ /bsdus rgyud las/ mkha' khyab mkha' yi rdo rje can ni yul rnams kun bral lus kyi dbus dag tu yang de bzhin zhes dang / gzhan yang bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gye snying la gnas/ /zhes dang / rang gi sems la gnas par gyur pa yi/ /bde gshegs rnams la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /zhes dang / rje btsun gzhon nu nor bzang gis mdzad pa'i pad+ma'i zhal lung las/ mdor na 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang rgyud 'od gsal gyi rlung sems la brten nas byung bas na/ 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi zhes brjod pa/ de bzhin du rdzogs chen gyi skabs 'dir/ rdo rje snying bo'i gzhi mthar thug pa shin tu phra ba'i 'od gsal/ rang byung gi ye shes ngo bo la sgrib pa'i bslad ma zhugs pa'i ka dag dang / rtsal la ye shes lnga dang stobs bcu/sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad sogs de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan 367

'byen pa'i nus pa rang chas su yod pa shel la 'od dang / me lcags la me dang / rnga la rnga sgra/ 'o ma la mar gyi tshul du lhun grub ces brjod pa ka dag chos sku'i sgrub gzhi dang / lhun grub longs sku'i sgrub gzhi de gnyis zung 'jug gi gnyug sems de nyid man ngag gis ngo sprad de/ lha sngags ye shes kyi snang cha zhig yod pa smin byed dbang / grol byed lam gyi sbyangs 'bras kun bzang rta mchog rol ba'i rang zhal mngon du gyur pa de/ sbyangs gzhi sgo gsum gyi dwangs ma las rgyun mi 'tshol ba'i don yin pas na rgyu 'bras lhun grub ces gsungs pa'i gnad 'di ma go ba 'ga' zhig gis/ 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo dang / rgyud bla sogs bstan bcos rnams nas/ phung khams skye mched kyi gos kyis dkris pa'i nang du mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i snying bos bstan pa sgra zin la thugs rtse gtad de ji bzhin du khas blangs na/ mu stegs grangs can pas shes bya kun la khyab pa'i rtag pa/ gcig pu'i bdag dang / rigs pa can pas/ dkar la 'tsher ba/ snum la 'dril ba rdul phran tsam gyi bdag dang / rang gi snying du gnas par 'dod pa dang mtshungs pas lung rigs gnod pa mang bas 'khrul gzhi skye bar mi bya gsungs/ rwa sgreng khri chen rin po che'i gsung gi zin bris kun gsal me long las/ bde stong 368

dbyer med kyi ye shes de la/ bka' brgyud pa rnams kyis gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zer la/ gzhan yang sa dge rnying gsum thams cad dgongs pa gcig tu 'bab cing / de la rnying ma ba rnams kyi man shel dang dpe sbyar nas bshad de/ de yang man shel de nyid nyi ma'i rkyen dang phrad na 'od sna lnga ba phyi gsal du 'char la/ nyi ma'i rkyen dang ma phrad pa'i tshe phyir gsal du med kyang / de ltar 'char ba'i nus pa nang gsal du yod pa ltar/ bde stong lhan skyes kyi ye shes de yang ma dag pa'i gnas skabs su phyi gsal du med cing / nang gsal du yod pa dang / de nyid bskyed rdzogs kyis sbyangs pa byas pa las/ rig 'dzin bzhir rim par song ste/ mthar rig 'dzin bzhi ba'i skabs su phyi gsal du 'char ba yin/ rig 'dzin bzhi ni/ rnam smin tshe dbang phyag chen lhun gyis grub/ /ces gsungs/ yang bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes de dri ma ma dag pa'i gnas skabs su/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa can dang / de nyid lam dus su bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor bsgoms pas don gyi 'od gsal sogs su 'char ba dang / mthar tha mal gyi snang ba phra mo yang spangs te/ sangs rgyas pa na/ 'bras dus kyi zung 'jug gi sgur 'char yang / de dag gi gnas skabs thams 369

cad du yang / rkyen gyes so sor bsgyur ba tsam ma gtogs/don bde stong dbyer med de nyid las ma 'das pas gcig pu nyid rnam pa thams cad du 'char ba yin/ de'i phyir sa ra ha'i do ha las/ gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid/ /gcig pu'i nyams kyis du ma'i gar mdzad do/ /ces gsungs pa yin pas tshul 'di mtshan nyid pa rnams la mi 'grigs kyang / nged sngags pa rgan po rnams la 'grig cing / 'di dag gi skabs su rtog ge'i rigs pas rgyas bkab na/ zab don gyi go ba stor bar 'gyur bas/ de ni rnam pa thams cad du mi rung zhing /tshul 'di la dgongs nas rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang rang nyid kyis kyang sngags kyi skabs su rtog ge'i pa la cung zad bka' bkyon mdzad pa yod do gsungs/ spyir sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gsungs pa zhig rang cag rnams la bshad rgyu med mod kyang / 'ga' zhig ni rgyud sde sogs su gsal bar ma gsung bar gab pa'i tshul du gnas pas bla ma'i zhal las rtogs dgos pa shin tu mang gsungs/ rigs drug gnas sbyong 'di nyid rnying ma'i chos so snyam nas sdang shugs mi byed par nyams len mdzad na nges par las ngan sbyongs pa las mchog tu gyur pa yin zhing / 'di tsam du ma zad/ sa dge rnying 'brug sogs kyi 370

legs cha mtha' dag dang / mtshan nyid sngags sogs rta shig phrug pa ltar gcig grogs su gcig 'khyer ba zhig byung na 'tshang rgya ba'i thabs su 'gyur gyi/ de ltar ma yin par tsha grang ltar 'gal bar bzung zhing / khyad par dge lugs rnying ma zhes sogs grub mtha'i kha 'dzin gye zhen khog bgyis te/ bdag bstod gzhan smod byas na chos spong gi las tshabs che bar 'gyur bas/ de dag gi gnad kyang mkhyen pa gal che bar yod gsungs/ mdor na sngags bla med kyi skabs su zung 'jug gi don nam/ lta ba'i don la go ba chags pa zhig gnad du che zhing /de chags na sngags kyi thabs mkhas kyi lam la nges pa rnyed cing /sngags la ma brten par 'tshang rgya ba med pa'i gnad rnams kyang legs par shes par 'gyur bas/ 'khon ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i lta ba gtan la dbab tshul dang / gzhan yang shar 'brug rnying ma sogs kyi lta ba gtan la dbab tshul rnams la yang ring du 'dris par bya'o gsungs/ gzhan rje skal bzang rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/ snying dbus kyi mi shugs rlung sem/sa de/ /skyabs kun 'dus ngo bor yid ches nas/ /ci za ci 'thung bdud rtsi'i ros/ /yongs 'khor lo'i lha tshogs zhen med rol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rang cag so skyes rnams kyi snying dbus na 371

mi shig pa'i rlung sems shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems yod tshul shes na/ sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol ba'i gnad khyad par can yod de/ sems rtogs na ye shes yin pas/ sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi 'tshol ba'i 'du shes rab tu bsgom par bya'o gsungs/ des na bla ma skyes chen rnam pa 'di'i gsung re re la brten nas kyang mdo sngags kyi lam gnad rnams shes shing /rang gzhan grub mtha' gang la dad gus dag snang skye bar 'gyur bas/ blo gros can rnams kyis de lta bu'i gnad la nges pa rnyed par bya'o/ /yang jo bo rjes/ 'brom rin po che la 'chi kha bar do'i skabs su rigs lnga la sogs pa'i zhi khro'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa'i snang ba mthong bar gsungs te/ bka' gdams glegs bam las/ gzhan yang hūṃ rje nga la nyon/ /de'i tshe shar nas bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ri bo tsam /rang gi kha dog nyid byas te/ /rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i snang bar 'ongs/ /de'i tshe lho nas bcom ldan 'das/ /rin chen 'byung gnas gong bzhin 'byung / /de'i tshe nub nas bcom ldan 'das/ /snang ba mtha' yas gong bzhin 'byung / /de'i tshe byang nas bcom ldan 'das/ /don yod grub pa gong bzhin 'byung / /gzhan yang rnam snang la sogs pa/ /lha yi tshogs rab du ma 372

mthong / /mdor na n+t+ra rje nga la nyon/ /zhi khro'i lha tshogs dpag med mthong / /goms pa'i skyes bus shes gyur nas/ /grogs dang skyabs gnas dga' bar tshor/ /kun la skyabs 'go gsol ba 'debs/ /de dag kun gyi rjes su 'brangs/ /de dag kun gyi gnas lugs ston/ /bla ma dag kyang der byon no/ /de tshe shes par byas gyur te/ /rnam shes rig pa thogs med pas/ /rab tu chos kyi dbyings la 'pho/ /'bring ni bla ma'i thugs gar 'pho/ /tha ma yi dam thugs shar 'pho/ /gtan gyi btsan sa bzung zhing zhu/ /de tshe 'di dus gang goms pa'i/ /bag chags dngos su sad par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ de bzhin dus 'khor las/ 'chi ba 'od gsal gyi skabs su stong gzugs kyi snang ba mu med du 'char bar gsungs pa dang / spyan snga lha gzigs ras pas/bar dor he ru ka sku mdog sprin gyi gdugs can 'jal bar gsungs pa dang / blo sbyong legs bshad kun 'dus las/sngags pa 'gar/ bar do'i rig 'dzin gyi gnas su/ phyag rgya chen po bsnyen pa'i ngor/ rigs drug gang du yang ma gtogs pa'i 'od lus shig yod par gsungs/ des na rdzogs chen pas/chos nyid bar do la/ sgra 'od zer gsum zhi khro'i snang ba 'char bar gsungs pa dang / rang 'od lus su gsal zhes gsungs pa 373

rnams gnad gcig par gda' bas/ bar do'i thos grol sogs/ bka' gter dag snang gi chos skor rnams su bar dor 'char tshul mi 'dra ba mang po bshad kyang / gang zag gi blo'i bye brag yin pas/ gang la yang dad gus dag snang 'ba' zhig bya'o/ /rje btsun tā ra na tha'i rnam thar ma bcos lhug pa'i rtogs brjod las/ mkhas pa kha cig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'am/ skyes bu dam pa 'ga' re la phyogs 'dzin gyis zhen ngo bstod mgo 'gas pa tsam byed cing / sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las shes bya thams cad la khyab pa yang ma shes/ theg pa chen po'i thabs la mkhas pa yang ma go nas/ rang nyid lta ba mchog tu 'dzin/ sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' gzhan rnams la dgrar blta/ mu stegs la sogs pa'i ming yang thos su mi rung ba skad byed de/ blo chung shes rab can du re ba ya re cha/ rang rang gi skal ba dang 'tsham par ston pa'i phyir/ grub mtha' dang theg pa gong ma gong ma thams cad la 'og ma 'og ma rnams dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lta sgom spyod pa khyad 'phags re yod cing /skyon spangs tshul dang yon tan lhag tshul re yang yod/ che ba du ma dang ldan mod/ 'on kyang rgyang 'phen pa'i grub mtha' tshun chad ma rig pa 'joms byed kyi phyogs su gtogs shing / rtswa'i bu 374

gar nyal ba'i srin bu phra mo tshun chad kyang sangs rgyas byang sems kyi smon lam gyi stobs las yin par shes nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang dam pa'i chos kyi sgo rnams la gzhan las khyad par du 'phags par mi phyed pa'i dad pa ma thob kyang / gzhan rnams la yang brnyas sems dang khong nas 'khrugs pa'i 'dam rdzab tu ma byings pa 'di yang kho bo'i rnam par thar ba ste/gsungs/ yang spyir chos su bzang da cha gcig nas mi shes te/skabs su babs pa gcig byed dgos/ bya byed gang dga' da mi shes te/ dus dang bstun pa gcig byed dgos/ tshad pa'i nad la ga bur las bzang ba med kyang / tshad pa ma smin pa la dug tu 'gro'o/ /yang rnam pa gcig tu na/ rgyal khab gzhan gyi gleng brjod re zhig bzhag bod yul 'di na nyid grub mtha' tha dad yin/ lta ba tha dad yin zer nas/ ko long mgo gas gas dang / rke 'phrang wa ba ras ras byed kyin 'dug ste/ spyir nang ba yin/ sgos su theg chen pa/ yang sgos su dbu ma par khas blangs phyin/ grub mtha' tha dad ni yod don mi 'dug yod rang yod na ni so so tha dad nas su ngan yang / nang 'thab de ma 'khrugs shor ba'i grib can rkyang bar 'gro nyen yod/ lar bod 'di sngon chos kyi bka' srol rkang 'dzin so so du ma zhig 375

byung 'dug kyang / dge 'dun shas cher rigs su ma chad spyi la bzhugs/ da lta chos kyi bka' srol mang bo zhig ni nub/ ma nub pa tsho la'ang gzhan rnams la rkang 'dzin cher mi gda'/ dge 'dun ni spyi la bzhugs mkhan su yang med/ thams cad a ma kha zhags la song / sa dge bka' gsum dang / rnying ma bar grags pa ste/ bzhi bo 'di sgra che bar gda'/ de dag tu ma gtogs pa ci rigs pa deng sang yang yod mod/ zhen 'then mkhan skya ser nyung / bar skabs lan cig dge ldan pa'i lugs dar rgyas che grags pas snying du ma sdug nas/ sa bka' rnying gsum grub mtha' gcig zer gyen dpung pa phyogs su gzhibs/ 'dun ma gcig tu sgril rgyu'i khungs byas/ dge ldan pa la phyir 'bud kyi 'phyar ka brjod 'dogs yid la dran tshad kha nas bton/ de'i lan du khong tshos kyang tshur la khyed rnams thams cad la thar ba thob pa'i chos yod ri shi byas pas/ bod yul gyi bstan pa'i thed ro cung zad yod pa de'ang rnam pa du mar gyes/ phan tshun thams cad bya rog dang 'ug pa'i tshul du song ba der gda'/ sa bka' rnying gsum ni grub mtha' gcig rung mi gcig rung gcig go zhes khas blangs pa de yin/ rje btsun tsong kha pa chen pos mdo sngags thams cad du chos skad sngar gyi bod rnying ma dang mi 'dra 376

ba tsam rigs par mdzad pa ni bden te/ 'on kyang khong gi bzhed pa thun mong ma yin pa rnams kyi nang nas/ kha cig gis sum cha tsam/ la las phyed tsam/ 'ga' zhig gis sum gnyis tsam/ gzhan rigs thams cad byas te grub mtha' rnying bar 'dod pa phal cher yang de'i grub mthar khas len par 'dugader ma zad sgom pa la khyad yod srid/ go yul gye lta ba rang la tshig tsam min pa khyad che rang he he/ de'i lugs de nag po yin rang yin na/ gzhan phal cher yang nag khra ru ka yong nyen gda'/des na ming btags so sor 'dzin pa tsam ma gtogs/ grub mtha' gsar rnying gi dbye ba rang zhig yod yod mi 'dra/ phyis deng sang bka' brgyud du grags pa'i rkang 'dzin gtso bo gnam dgrol ba de/ gar 'brug gnyis su gda' na'ang / de'i nang tshan chen po zhig gis/ rje btsun mi la'i lugs yin zer ba'i dbu ma bsgom tshul na shing rta'i dpyad pa bdun gyi sgo nas bsgom tshul dpyad sgom gsal bo bris pa dang / yang chen po gzhan zhig gis/ dbu ma 'jug pa dang phyag chen don gcig gsungs shing / lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi man ngag gi nang du dbu ma'i gtan tshigs chen po bzhi bsgom dgos skad pas/ mdor na phyis kyi bka' brgyud pa skad chen rgyang grags kyi bshes 377

gnyen tsho yang / dge lugs dang 'dra min la de'i lugs kyi gnad kyang ma longs/ de las khongs kyang chung du song ba gcig byas/ rang lugs su 'dod pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams dang 'gal khyab tu song ba de dba' lod 'khyer na ngo so 'phyar mkhan kho nar 'dug des na lta spyod sgom gsum kun phan tshun 'dra se ba rkyang ba la/ 'khrugs long mang bo yod pa 'di rnyed bkur dang kha drag snying la bzhag pas lan gsungs/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos khri gung thang ba dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes mdzad pa'i 'jam mgon rgyal ba gnyis pa la bstan pa'i snying bo gsal bar mdzad pa'i tshul las brtsams te bstod pa don dang ldan pa zhes bya ba las/ kye hud dge 'dun bstan pa 'di/ /dpal dang 'byor ba rab rgyas kyang / /bshad dang sgrub pas ches phra ba/ /bsams kyin snying nas shes pa 'phyo/ /zhes gsungs/de'i rgya cher 'grel ba bstan pa'i de nyid snang ba zhes bya ba las/'jam mgon bla ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de nyid kyis yang dag pa'i lam gyi srol phyes kyang / dus yun ring 'gyangs te da lta skye bo rnams blo'i mthu rim bzhin bri bas rmongs pa'i mun pa 'thibs shing snyigs ma'i brlang spyod sna tshogs pa'i rdul gyes g.yogs nas bstan pa'i srol mi mngon par byas/ dam par 378

khas 'che yang dam pa'i tshul dang mi mthun pa sdom pa gsum gyi nyams len dang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gye yon tan ci yang med par chags sdang g.yo sgyu'i 'khor lo bskor te/ rnyed bkur 'du 'dzi 'ba' zhig don du gnyer ba ming dge ba'i bshes gnyen du btags pa du mas rigs mthun gyi grwa slob rang gi rjes su zhugs pa thams cad la rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dang mthun pa'i gdams pa sna re'ang ston rgyu med par/ dgra 'dul gnyen skyong tshe 'di'i snang shas bsgrub pa'i thabs kho na bstan te blo sna thur du 'khrid pa ches mang la/ yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / de'i rjes su tshul bzhin du slob pa nyung bas/dus ngan snyigs ma'i ngang tshul 'di lta bu bsams kyin skyo ba'i gnas yin no/ /kha cig 'di snyam du da lta ri bo dge ldan pa'i bstan pa rgya bod hor gsum kun tu dar zhing / grwa tshogs dang sbyin bdag sogs gang sa nas 'phel rgyas che bas grub mtha' gzhan thams cad las dbu 'phang mtho ba deng dus 'dra ba sngar ma byung ba lta bu yin pas bstan pa ches cher dar skabs yin gyi/ nyams dma' ba'i dus ga la yin snyam na/ rnyed bkur snyan gsum kho na don du gnyer ba dag de ltar sems pa bden yang / thar ba don du gnyer ba rnams kyis bla ma'i yon tan/379

bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib/ rang gi gtan 'dun gang bsams na'ang 'dun pa dang snying bo ma nor bar/ dgos pa'i gtso bo ngos zin pa 'di gal che ste/ mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi mas/ dam pa rnams kyi chos kyi khri/ /legs bshad smra ba'i dpal gyis mtho/ /'jig rten phun tshogs dpal rnams kyis/ /khyim gyi rgyal po mthon por byed/ / gang dag rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi/ /dgongs don smra la nus med pa/ /longs spyod ldan pa'i sgye bo ni/ /mang yang bstan la dgos nus med/ /legs bshad 'od brgya'i snang ba can/ /bshes gnyen nyi ma gcig gis kyang / /thub bstan gling bzhi ma lus pa/ /gcig char nyid du gsal bar nus/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ stobs 'byor mnga' thang kha drag dbang che sogs khyem pa'i dbang du byas pa'i dpal 'byor rgyas tshul yin la/ chos kyi dbang du byas pa'i dpal 'byor ni rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin du legs par bshad pa'i dga' ston 'gyed cing de don nyams su len pa kho na yin gyis/ rnyed bkur 'du 'dzi sogs bstan pa nyams byed yin pas dpal dang byur ma nor ba dgos pa'i phyir te/ sangs rgyas kyi sde snod kyi mdo las/shā ri'i bu de lta mod kyi bcom ldan 'das 'od srung gis de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i gsung rab de ni lhag par 380

rnyed pa dang bkur ste byed pas nub par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan te/ shā ri'i bu 'di ltar chos 'dul ba 'di ni rnyed pa dang bkur stis myur du nub par 'gyur ro/ /shā ri'i bu dper na mi dbul bo zhig gis gter chen po rnyed nas gzhi de las bde ba dang yid bde ba nyams su myong ngo / /shā ri'i bu de bzhin du ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ dge slong dag 'di ltar khyem pa la brten pa dang / phu dud byed pa dag 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /shā ri'i bu de la khyim pa gang dag kyang 'jig rten gyi zang zing gis yid bde bar bya ba'i phyir de dag gi las kyi mtha' rim bzhin du byed par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na dge slong de dag kyang 'jig rten gyi zang zing lhur len par 'gyur te/ 'jig rten gyi zang zing gis 'khor ba'i chog mi shes pa dang / nye du la 'dod par mi 'gyur ro/ /bdag nyid shes bzhin du khyim pas shes par bya ba'i phyir bdag nyid dgra bcom pa yin par sgogs par byed do/ /de dag de ltar shes par byed pa yongs su 'tshol ba nas sangs rgyas kyi byang chub 'dor bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang /gzi brjid can gyi mdo las/ rnyed pa dang bkur ste la brten dge slong gi kun nas nyon mongs pa bye ba phrag brgyad cu rtsa dgur 'gyur te/ de dag gis mtshams med pa'i sa 'thob par 381

'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs shing / lhag pa'i bsam pa bskul ba'i mdo las kyang / rnyed pa dang bkur ste ni gcig tu bag med pa'i rtsa ba yin par brtag par bya'o/ /rnyed pa dang bkur sti ni dge ba'i rtsa ba 'phrog par brtag par bya'o/ /rnyed pa dang bkur ste ni nga rgyal dang / rgyags pa dang / dregs pa bskyed par brtag par bya'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa la/ zla ba snying bo'i mdor yang bstan pa 'jig pa'i rgyu mang du gsungs pa'i gtso bo 'du 'dzi la dga' bar byed do/ /khyad par du dge ldan pa'i bstan pa 'di la gnod pa'i rkyen che shos 'dod yon la g.yeng bas 'khyer ba 'dis byed par jo bo yab sras kyi lung bstan te/bka' gdams glegs bam las/ 'dod yon bdud kyi g.yab mo 'byung / /zhes 'di'i lung bstan gyi skabs su gsungs la/ rje bla mas kyang de la dgongs te lhung bzed kha spubs pa'i steng du mchod rten brtsigs nas 'dod yon la mnan pa byas tshul dam pa'i gsungs la 'byung ba ltar ro/ /des na gang zag khyad par can srid pa'i phun tshogs la zhen pa gting nas log pas rnyed bkur sogs kyis cung zad kyang kha 'khrid mi nus pa re gnyis la gos 'bum ri ba dang / khang ba brtsegs pa lnga brgya ba'ang 'os par 'dul ba'i mdo las gsung ba ma gtogs/ snyigs 382

ma'i skye bo col chung rnams la rnyed bkur byung ba ni chos kyi bar chad du 'gro ba las mthun rkyen du 'gro ba nyung ste/ de'i phyir mnyam med jo bo chen pos/ bsod nams zer ba'i 'du 'dzi de yang chos kyi bar chad yin pas spongs/ zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar na bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib ni stobs 'byor che chung gis mi 'jog la/ der ma zad phyi'i cha lugs tsam dang / phyag bskor ba/ gar thig 'dri mchod sogs lus kyi dge sbyor kho nas kyang bstan pa bzung bar mi 'gyur/ ngag gis bzlas brjod klog 'don rta dbyangs kho nas kyang bstan pa 'dzin mi nus par/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ni gtso bo sems kyi steng nas 'jog dgos pa'i phyir te/ bzhi brgya ba las/ shākya gos med bram ze ste/ /gsum po rnams kyi chos yid dang / /mig dang rna bas 'dzin byed pa/ /de phyir thub pa'i gzhung lugs phra/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /sems steng nas 'dzin tshul yang ma mtha' 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal du shes nas de las thar 'dod bcos ma tshun chad dang / bdag med phra rags kyi don la sgra spyi'i go ba rags re tsam chags na'ang thar ba'i sa bon 'jog nus la/ de med par rtsa rlung dang sku bsgom pa sogs zab zab 'dra ba ci tsam bsgom ste snang ba ban bun gyi rtags 383

thon pa byung yang 'khor ba'i 'khor lor 'khor ba las med de/grub chen skal ldan rgya mtshos/ chos stong nyid snying rje snying bo can/ /'di'i dmigs 'khrid gtso bor mi byed par/ /lus 'phrul 'khor gtum mo'i rlung sbyor sogs/ /ngo mtshar yang rkyal ba phus gter yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ gang 'dzin rgyu'am gang la nan tan bya ba'i yul gyi bstan pa ngos zin par bya dgos so/ /des na tshul khrims yang dag pa'i mdo las/ dge slong dag shes pa ni 'grib/ srog ni 'chad/ tshe'i 'du byed ni 'dor/ ston pa'i bstan pa'ang nges par 'jig par 'gyur na ci'i phyir brtson 'grus dang brtul ba brtan pos sgrub par mi byed/ ces gsungs pa ltar 'tsho ba'i srog ni ri gzar gyi 'bab chu bzhin myur du 'gro zhing / phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'ang nyi rgas kyi grib so bzhin 'grub par nye ba'i ngang tshul bsam ste brtson 'grus dang brtul ba brtan pos thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas snying bo ci lon byed cing / long pas glang rnga zin pa bzhin tshe rabs thams cad du yang dag pa'i lam bzang 'di dang mi 'bral ba'i phyir smon pa'i mtshams sbyor nan tan du bya dgos gsungs pa 'di rnams gnad che bar 'dug pas/ kun gyi sems la bzhag nas sangs 384

rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan pa'i bya ba kho na bya'o/ /mdor na 'brom chos kyi rgyal pos/ bstan pa thams cad gru bzhir lam gyis 'khyer shes pa nga'i bla ma/ zhes jo bo'i che ba brjod pa ltar/bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer zhes pa la'ang dam pa 'ga' zhig gis/ sho rde'u ji ltar 'phangs kyang gru bzhi lam gyis 'bab pa bzhin/ nyams len gyi sgo gang nas brtsams kyang bstan pa'i gnad thams cad de'i nang du khrig khrig 'dus nas 'ong ba la bzhed pa dang / la la dag gis sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi/ bslab pa gsum dang sngags kyi lam ste/ lung rtogs kyi gru bzhir byas nas de thams cad tshang ba'i don du bzhed la/ rje ngag dbang byams pa'i dris lan zhig tu/ skyes bu chung 'bring gi bsam pa rnam dag 'khor bcas yan gru gcigaman ngag bdun bslab bya phar phyin dang po lnga dang bcas pa gru gcig shes rab kyi phar phyin mtha' bral lta ba'i bskor gru gcig gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bskor gru gcig tu 'jog ces lam gye gtso bo rnam gsum sngags dang bcas pa la gsungs pa rnams bshad tshul gyi rnam grangs tha dad tsam las don la gcig ste/ bshad rgyud rdo rje'i phreng ba las/ nang ni gsang 'dus la rab dga'/ /phyi rol nyan thos kyi spyod pa/ /de 385

lta'i man ngag rim pa yis/ /slob ma rnams la rjes su bstan/ /zhes dang / rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ nyan thos spyod pa skyongs byed cing / /sngags kyi theg pa'i rim par gus/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin/ mdo sngags gnyis kyi lam yongs su rdzogs pa phyogs rer ma song bar thams cad la blo sbyangs nas bstan pa thams cad gru bzhi lam gyis 'khyer mkhas sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo rje dang / 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa yab sras/ skyabs mgon rgyal ba paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis lta bu la yid smon bya dgos te/ kun mkhyen khri gung thang ba rin po ches/ phyogs rer ma gyur thos pa'i chos/ /bsam dang sgom pas nyams blangs nas/ /rgyal ba rgyas pa'i lam bzang bo/ /tshang la ma nor rnyed gyur cig /ces gsungs pa ltar smon lam yan chad 'debs pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /smras pa/ chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i klong yangs nas/ /chos gsung 'gro kun bde la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /chos rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos kun sem sa la 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /chos pas glu dbyangs len par mi 'os mod/ /'on kyang chos kyi glu dbyangs yin pas na/ /skabs rer 'chad nyan gnyis ka spro ba'i phyir/ /rnar snyan yid 'bab chos kyi glu 386

dbyangs len/ /o rgyan jo bo 'jam mgon bla ma gsum/ /sku tshe snga phyi byas nas so so ru/ /byon pa ma gtogs thugs rgyud gcig pa'i tshul/ /bka' gdams glegs bam dag las gsal bar gsungs/ /bstan pa thams cad 'gal med rtogs pa dang / /gsung rab ma lus gdams par 'char ba'i tshul/ /sa gsum sgon me byang chub lam rim gyi/ /che ba bzhi bo brjod pa'i skabs su gsungs/ /lam rim shes na chos lugs gzhan rnams kyang / /'gro kun 'phral phugs bde ba'i thabs su go /dag snang skye ba lam rim khyad chos zhes/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgya mtshos gsungs/ /tha na bon pos g.yang 'gugs byed la yang / /'gro la phan thabs bon gyi drang srong gis/ /gsungs pa red snyam dag snang sbyongs dgos zhes/ /bdag gi yongs 'dzin dge bshes chen pos gsungs/ /rnam thar gtsang ma dga' ldan bka' brgyud 'di/ /phyogs re 'dzin pa'i grub mtha' ma yin par/ /mdo sngags gdams par shar ba lags so zhes/ /rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i mgur las gsungs/ /las kyi rdo rje 'jam mgon bla ma la/ /zhus lan bdud rtsi'i sman mchog gnang ba'i dus/ /nam mkha'i khams nas mkha' 'gro mang po yis/ /mgrin gcig bsngags brjod mdzad ces yongs la grags/ /gsang 387

bdag gsung gi snyan brgyud gdams pa rnams/ /rje btsun bla ma'i gsang ba'i nyams len du/ /shes na phyag rdzogs do ha'i gdams pa rnams/ /dbang rnon rnams kyis gdams pa'i snying bor go /rang lugs nang ba sangs rgyas grub mtha' dang / /gzhan lugs mu stegs bon sogs grub mtha' la/ /sdang sems smod pa nam yang mi rung zhes/ /rwa sgreng khri chen rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs/ /lta sgom spyod gsum 'dra se rkyang ba la/ /'khrug long mang ba yong ba rnyed bkur dang / /kha drags snying la bzhag pas lan no zhes/ /mkhas pa'i dbang bo tā ra na thas gsungs/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas 'dul ba'i bstan pa 'di/ /rnyed dang bkur stes myur du 'jig pa'i tshul/ / 'dul ba'i sde snod dag las gsung ngo zhes/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos gung thang pa yis gsungs/ /bsod nams 'dzad pa'i rgyu ni bsam ngan yin/ /bsam ngan nang nas ring lugs dar ba la/ /gzhan lugs dgag na snyam pa 'di nyid las/ /lhag pa'i bsam ngan 'jig rten khams na med/ /de'i phyir rang lugs dar phyir gzhan lugs la/ /dgag pa gtong ba'i bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rigs/ /dngos su lta zhog rmi lam skabs su yang / /yid la nam yang mi skye'i smon lam thobs/ /bsod nams skye ba'i rgyu ni 388

sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa 'dzin cing rang gzhan grub mtha' kun/ /dar zhing rgyas na snyam pa 'di yin pas/ /de 'dra'i bsam sbyor gong du 'phel bar mdzod/ /tshe rabs kun tu ston pa sangs rgyas gsung / /mdo sngags bstan pa gcig kyang mi nyams par/ /thams cad gru bzhi lam du 'khyer nus pa'i/ /smon lam 'debs pas de bzhin thebs par shog /ces pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /da ni skye 'chi 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsams nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa'i gang zag gis chos lugs grub mtha' yongs la dad gus dag snang sbyong bzhin/ rgyal ba sras bcas rgya bod kyi mkhas grub gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar gsung sgros 'di rnams rgyud steng du bskor nas nyams len byed pa gal che bas/ de'e tshul 'dir cung zad tsam zhig brjod par bya ste/ de yang sangs rgyas gnyis pa mnyam med jo bo'i rnam thar chos kyi 'byung gnas las/ khu byug bzang bos sems bskyed gdams pa bstan/ /gdams pa'i gtso bo mchog tu bsngags pa der/ /rgyal bu tshe 'dir phun sum tshogs gyur kyang / /skye ba gtan gyi so nam ma byas na/ /dal 'byor mi lus thob pa dgos pa chung / /phyi rabs nor shor na 389

yang 'pham po lags/ /rgyal bu klu sgrub snying pos 'di skad gsungs/ /rmi lam sgyu 'dra rang bzhin spros dang bral/ /sems nyid ma bcos rang bzhin gnyug ma'i ngang / /gang gis 'di gnyis blo la ma bsam na/ /'khor ba'i 'dam du byengs par 'gyur ro ang / /rgyal bu don dam mnyam gzhag nam mkha' 'dra/ /rjes thob sgyu 'dra las 'bras bsam par rigs/ /bla mas zab mo'i chos de bstan pa na/ /sbyor ba'i lam brnyes dpa' bo'i ting 'dzin thob/ /de'i tshe rje la rtogs pa 'di phul ba/ kho bos ting 'dzin gcig la mnyam bzhag tshe/ /nam mkha' sprin dang bral ba ji bzhin du/ /gsal zhing dwangs la rnyog pa mi gda' na/ /bla ma chos kyi gnas lugs de lags sam/ /de nas ting 'dzin de las sad pa na/ /snang yang zhen pa med pa'i sems can dran/ /rdzun yang phra zhib las la bag yod thob/ /bla ma bdag gi nyams de ma 'khrul lam/ /lan du bla ma'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /legs so khyod ni bsod nams bsags pa'i bu/ /nga ni sgro skur med pa'i dge slong yin/ /mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bur dag na yang / /rjes thob snying rjes 'gro kun 'dren par byed/ /bden pa gnyis kyi cha lugs de ltar lags/ /de ni bdag gi gdams ngag dam pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di 390

shin tu zab pas nyams su longs/ yang rje bdag nyid chen pos mdzad pa'i gsang sngags kyi bslab bya dngos grub snye ma las/lam ci tsam zhig bsgom par bya snyam na/ 'di la 'khrul ba che bas slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas ji ltar gtan la phab pa de nyid bshad par bya'o/ /de yang snying bo rgyan las/ drang srong chen bo bi shwa mi tra dang / rig sngags 'chang gi slob dpon gzhon nu sde dang / rgyal ba'i zhabs dang / rin chen ldan dang /bram ze bzang po'i bshes gnyen la sogs pa rnams/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa ni log par rtog pa dgag pa las/ blangs par bya ba nyid yin te/ sangs rgyas ni bsod nams kyis nye bar bsgrubs pas so/ /lam bskyed pa'i rim pas tha mal pa'i dngos po spangs te/ gzugs kyi skus ser sa can gyi don byed pa ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur bas/ /lha'i rnam pa dang spyod pa phyin ci ma log pas bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar kha cig gis/stong ba nyid bstan pa ni log rtog dgag pa tsam gyi phyir blangs par bya ba yin te/ sangs rgyas nyid ni bsod nams kyi tshogs kyis bsgrub par bya ba yin pas so/ /bskyed rim gyis tha mal gyi dngos po spangs nas/ gzugs skus sems can gyi don byed pa 391

ni sangs rgyas su 'gyur bas/ lha bsgom pa dang spyod phyogs phyin ci ma log pas sangs rgyas bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes 'dod pa dang / yang de nyid las/ gzhan yang bram ze stong nyid blo dang / kha che'i mkhan po rab snang byed dang / a nan+ta badz+ra dang /dge bsnyen si ti ka ra dang / mkhas pa chen po dpal gyi seng ge dang / snang mdzad rdo rje dang / dge slong theg chene dpal dang /legs sbyin bzang bo dang / dpal sham thabs sngon po can dang / rgyal ba'i zhabs dang / rin chen ldan dang / bram ze mthong ba'i bshes gnyen dang / dge slong ma dga' mo la sogs pa bskyed pa'i rim pa dang spyod pa'i tshul gsungs pa ni chad par smra ba dgag pa dang / rten 'brel gyis rten 'brel gyi 'bras bu bsgrub pa dang / zab mo'i don gyes 'jigs pa'i 'jig rten pa rnams re zhig bzung ba'i thabs su gsungs pa las/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste/ de mi mthun pa'i rgyu las skyes pa ma yin pas/ 'dir stong ba nyid mtshan ma mthong ba bsam gyis mi khyab cing spros pa rnam par chad pa ni/ rnal 'byor pas bsam pa'i tshul gyis 'jig rten na 'bras bu mchog dang ldan no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar kha cig bskyed rim dang spyod pa 392

rnams gsungs pa ni/ chad lta dgag pa dang zab mo'i don rnams dang / don la 'jug pa rnams re zhig bzang ba'i thabs su gsungs pas/ sangs rgyas ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rnam par mi rtog pa yin la/ de ni mi mthun pa'i rgyud spros pa'i rtogs pa las mi skye'o/ /des na spros pa dang bral ba'i stong nyid tsam zhig bsgoms pas sangs rgya'o zhes 'dod de/ de gnyis ni phyogs re re bas sangs rgyas 'dod pa yin no/ /de bkag nas lam phyin ci ma log pa gsungs pa ni lung snga ma'i 'phro nyid las/re zhig phyogs tsam mthong ba'i zhugs pa ste/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi lam nges par rnyed par ma yin pas/de'i phyogs su rnam par lta ba dang bral bas gnas par bya ste/lta ba'i tshul spros pa dang bral bar rtogs pa dang / bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i ting nge 'dzin la rim gyis 'jug pa dang / dam tshig rnams nye bar bsten pa dang / rim gyis 'jug pa'i spyod pa'i tshul shes pa rnams ni theg pa mchog la nges par skyes pa ste/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i lam gyi de nyid mngon du rtogs nas/ 'dod pa'i yon tan dang ldan par 'gyur bas/lam gyi rim pa dang sbyar te tshul gnyis dang ldan pa 'di nye bar bzung bar bya'o zhes lam phyogs re bar ma song bar lta spyod 393

gnyis ka la gnas dgos pa dang / dam tshig rnams bsten nas bskyed rdzogs gnyis la rim can du 'jug par gsungs te/'di ni gsung rab spyi dang khyad par rgyud sde'i don lung dang rigs pas gtan la 'bebs pa la mkhas pa'i thar 'dod blo gros can rnams kyi yid 'phrog pa'i lam gyi rnam gzhag yin pas/ skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyis tshul gnyis kyi shing rta'i srol chen po 'dir zhugs nas rdo rje 'chang gi sar 'gro bar bya'o//zhes gsungs pa ltar blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis mdo sngags gang gi dus su thabs shes ya ma bral bar zung 'jug gi lam la slob par mdzod cig ces 'doms so/ /yang bka' gdams bstan pa'i sgon me mnyam med po to pa'i chig lab ring mo las/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho chen po 'dir/ dus thog ma med pa nas 'khyams pa 'di/ rang sems ma rtogs pas lan nas 'dug sems ma rtogs pa sgrib pas lan/ sgrib pa tshogs gsog ma shes pas lan/tshogs gsog ma shes pa dad pa med pas lan/ dad pa med pa 'chi ba ma dran pas lan pa yin/ da 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs nas thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob par 'dod pas/ rang gi sems rtogs dgos/ sems rtogs par 394

byed pa la sgrib pa sbyongs dgos/ sgrib pa sbyongs par byed pa la tshogs gsog dgos/ tshogs gsog pa la dad pa dgos/ dad pa gsha' ma de 'chi ba rjes su ma dran na mi skye/ 'chi ba gsha' mar dran nas chos min cis kyang mi phan par 'dug snyam tsa na/'jig rten gyi phun sum tshogs pa ci la yang blo mi 'jug pa zhig 'ong ba yin gsungs/ lar chos mang bo shes pa'i kha na yang mi 'dug gdams ngag zab mo'i kha na yang mi 'dug bla ma bzang po zhig dang mjal nas/ rang sems chos skur 'gro ba'i zhad du 'dug bla ma bzang po 'tshol ba'i dus da lta yin pa la/kha cig na re/ bla ma de'i drung du 'gro ba gang nas 'ong / de bas bsgom brdzus btab na rang drag zer ba'i mi yang mang bo 'ong zhing 'dug bla ma bzang po mjal ba la tshogs dpag tu med pa bsags dgos par 'dug pa/ da lta bla ma mi 'tshol bar brdzus nas bsdad pas ga na 'ong / bla ma bzang po dang mjal na/ bla ma'i byen rlabs kyis rang la ting nge 'dzin skye/ des sems rtogs nas sangs rgya ba yin te/ la la sangs rgya ba bas mis mi 'phya tsam la dga' bar 'dug gsungs/ yang 'dul ba ka ri ka nas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa man chad kyi bka' sde snod rgyud sde thams cad kyang gang zag gcig gi chos yin/ dus 395

dang gnas skabs 'ga' zhig la dgongs nas gsungs pa yin/mi dgos par gsungs pa 'ga' zhig kyang med/ chos thams cad gcig pa yin/ nga cag gi chos dang / khong cag gi chos byas nas gzhan gyi chos la smad na dmyal bar skye bar 'phags pa brgyad stong pa nas gsungs/ gang zag su thod thod la smra mi rung / chos thams cad bsam pas byed pa yin pas/ khong la thugs dgongs ji 'dra yod mi shes gsungs/ yang kha cig na re/sngags dang 'dul ba 'gal ze ra te/ des ma go ba yin/sngags kyi rten du mi rung ba zhig byung na/ 'dul ba min/'dul ba dang 'gal ba gcig byung na de gsang sngags min pa'i rtags yin/ ston thog 'don pa la res zhing la chu gtong /res rmos nas khag ma byed de/ de dag kyang nus pa phyogs gcig tu bsdebs nas khag ma la ston thog 'don pa yin gsungs/ lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyi zhal nas/ bdag gces 'dzin dgra yin/ gzhan gces 'dzin gnyen yin/ snang ba badzun yin/ sems nyid nam mkha' yin/ zhes dang / bdag 'dzin sdug bsngal gye rtsa ba yin pas rtsad nas bcad na legs/dam chos byang chub kyi lam yin pas nyams su blangs na legs/snang ba brdzun gyi rang bzhin la bden par ma bzung na legs/396

rang sems sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa yin pas don dang du gnyer na legs/ gsungs/ lar rtse gcig sdod pa'i zhi gnas de/ /gti mug gi kha snon mi bgyid 'tshal/ /'dzin med rang gsal gyi sgom pa de/ /blo kha 'tsham gyi dgra la mi bskur 'tshal/ /ma bcos gnyug ma'i ye shes de/ /khams 'dus kyi nyams la mi bgyid 'tshal/ /gsungs so/ /sngon jo bo rje la/'brom ston pas/ chos thams cad kyi mthar thug gang lags zhus pas/ chos thams cad kyi mthar thug stong nyid snying rje'i snying bo can yin gsungs/ dper na 'dzig rten na sman dpa' bo gcig thub bya ba nad thams cad kyi gnyen por 'gro ba zhig yod pa yin/ dpe de bzhin du sman dpa' bo gcig thub lta bu/chos nyid stong ba nyid kyi don rtogs na nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi gnyen por 'gro ba yin gsungs/ des na stong ba nyid kyi don phyin ci ma log pa zhig rtogs na sman dpa' bo gcig thub dang mtshungs te/ lam gyi chos thams cad de'i khongs na yod gsungs/ 'o na don rtogs pa zhig la stong ba nyid kyi lta sgom kho nas sangs rgya ba lags sam zhus pas/ 'di ltar snang tshod grags tshod 'di thams cad rang gi sems las ma byung ba med/ sems rig pa stong ba dngos med du rtogs pa de lta ba 397

yin/ de la ma yengs pa dran pa rgyun chags su gnas pa sgom pa yin/ de'i ngang nas sgyu ma lta bu'i tshogs gnyis gsog pa de spyod pa yin/ de da lta nyams 'og tu chud pa zhig yod na rmi lam du 'ongs/ rmi lam du 'ong na 'chi khar 'ong / 'chi khar byung na bar dor 'ong / bar dor byung na mchog gi dngos grub thob nges pa yin gsungs/ mnyam med po to pa'i lam rim las/ 'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa thams cad kyang / sems nyid rtogs ma rtogs kyi khyad par yin/ sa dang lam gyi rim pa thams cad kyang / rtogs pa 'phel ba'i ming gi rnam grangs yin/ gsungs pa ltar nyams su blangs na myur du sangs rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /bdag cag gi ston pa'i gsung rab brgyad stong ba las sems can rnams dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bral bas/ rang gi sems kyi de kho na nyid yongs su ma rtogs par ngar 'dzin pa dang / nga yi bar 'dzin pa dang / gsob dang gsog la brtags nas/ dge ba dang mi dge ba la sogs par brtags pas/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas sdug bsngal nyams su myong ba yin no gsungs/ chos dbyings rang bzhin med par bstan pa'i le'u las/ sems ni gzugs can ma yin pa/ bstan du med pa/ snang ba med pa/ thogs pa med pa/ rnam par rig byed 398

ma yin pas/nang na mi gnas/ phyi rol na mi gnas/ gnyis ga'i bar na mi gnas pa'i phyir/ yang dag par yongs su grub pa ma yin zhing / de la rnam par grol ba med do/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin no gsungs/ myang 'das kyi mdo las/ sems kyi rang bzhin don dam pa stong ba'o/ /don la stong ba nyid ni ye shes so/ /de la stong ba zhes bya ba ni/ stong ba dang mi stong ba gnyis ka mi mthong ba'o gsungs/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las 'ong srungs sems ni nang na yang med/ phyi rol na yang med/ gnyis ka na med pa yang mi dmigs/ 'od srungs sems ni dpyad du med pa/ bstan du med pa/ rten ma yin pa/ snang ba med pa/ rnam par rig pa med pa/ gnas med pa'o gsungs/ byams pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das/ nang gi sems ji ltar lta bar bgyi/ bka' stsal pa/ sems ni dbyebs med pa nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /gsungs/ jo bos kyang / sems ni shin tu brtag dka' ste/ kho dog med pa dbyibs dang bral ba ni nam mkha' dang 'dra bar ma grub pa'o gsungs/ phyag chen yi ge bzhi ba las/ sems nyid 'di dang po gang nas byung / bar du gang na gnas/ mthar gar 'gro brtag pas/ dang po byung sa med de/rgyu dang rkyen las ma byung ba'i ye nas rtsa bral du 'dug khar 399

du gnas sa med de/ kho dog dbyibs su ma grub/ 'gyu ba stong 'gyu/ snang ba stong snang du 'dug mthar 'gro sa med de/'dir song gi yul dang rjes med pas/ 'gyu ba rang grol/ snang ba rang sangs su 'dug des na sems nyid 'di ni dang po rgyus ma bskyed pas/ mthar rkyen gyis mi 'jig dus glo bur du ma byung bas/ gang stongs dang 'phel 'grib med/ snang srid kun la khyab pas phyogs dang ris su ma chad/ dngos po dang mtshan mar ma grub pas/ 'di zhes mtshon du med/ gang du yang ma grub la cir yang 'char ba/ yod med rtag chad kyi mtha' las 'das pa/ dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med cing / rang bzhin ye nas dag pa'i 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa ste/ sems nyid 'di ye nas sangs rgyas yin gsungs so/ /mkha' 'gro'i snying thig las/sems dus gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa gang gis kyang ma bslad par da lta'i shes pa gsal la ngos bzung med pa rang babs chos nyid la bsal bzhag med par 'jog bcug la/ kye skal ldan rnams da lta'i rig pa rang gsal rjen pa 'di la ma yengs par ltos shig dri med dag pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ /rang rig chos sku 'gyur ba med/ /sal le sang nge wal le ba/ /sprin med ston ga'i nam mkha' bzhin/ /mi 'gyur brtan pa ri bo bzhin du 400

zhog /mi g.yo dwangs pa rgya mtsho bzhin du zhog /yangs dog bral ba nam mkha' bzhin du zhog /gang ltar gnas kyang rig pa'i ngang yin zhog /gang ltar shar yang rig pa'i mdangs yin zhog /'phro gnas rang rig dwangs sangs phyed par zhog /ji ltar bya rnams gang du 'phur na yang / /mkha' las ma 'das de bzhin rig pa'i ngang / /chos rnams rang gsal g.yo ba med par zhog /gsungs/ slob dpon chen po'i zhal nas/ 'o skal ldan bu kun rdzogs pa chen po zhes kyang bya/ phyag rgya chen po zhes kyang bya/ lhag mthong rtogs pa zhes kyang bya/ lta ba khregs chod la sogs pa ming gi rnam grangs du mar phye yang / don la rang rig kun tu bzang po sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa rnal ma skyon med 'di kho na yin te/ rtog pa snga ma 'gag phyi ma ma skyes pa'i bar de na gsal stong rjen pa/ 'di yin med pa'i gsal zhing dwangs pa smra ru med pa'i nyams su myong rgyu zhig 'dug pa/ de ka ltar ye gdod ma nas gnas pa yin te/ skabs su glo bur rkyen gyes rtog pa sna tshogs su shar ba yin pas/ da ni dus de ring nas bzung ste sangs rgyas lag tu gtad pa yin pas/ da phan chad gnas lugs 'di dang ma bral bar 'di ka ltar du nyams su longs shig dang tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgyas thob par gdon 401

mi za'o/ /gsungs/ rdzogs pa chen po tshig gsum pa'i rgyud las/kye gsang ba'i bdag po rang gi rig pa 'gag pa med par wal ler gsal ba 'di sangs rgyas yin no/ /rang gi rig pa 'gag pa med par wal ler gsal ba 'di dang 'bral ba med pa'i sangs rgyas chos sku bsgom du med do//rang gi rig pa 'gag pa med par wal ler gsal ba 'di sangs rgyas yin pa rang gis ngo shes pas chog go gsungs/ gsang ba'i bdag po'i zhal nas/rig pa'i ngo bo stong ba 'di sus kyang ma bcos pa/ rgyu med pa/rkyen med pa/ ye gdod ma nas gnas pa yin/ 'di la bca' bcos gang yang ma byed par kho rang gang 'dug gi steng du zhog dang gol sa med/ ka dag gi klong du 'tshang rgya ba yin/ gsungs/phyag chen yi ge bzhi ba las/ rnal 'byor pa nam 'chi ba'i tshe/phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad la chags zhen rtsa ba nas bcad la/ don dam par sems la skye 'chi med/ phyag rgya chen po yid la bsgom du med par thag bcad/ bsgom med kyi ngang la yengs med du bzhag pas bar do med par ye shes zang thal du sangs rgya'o gsungs/ sa chen kun dga' snying bo la rje btsun 'jam dbyangs gtso 'khor gsum gyi zhal gzigs dus/ gtso bo'i zhal nas/ tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min/ /khams gsum 402

la zhen na nges 'byung min/ /bdag don la zhen na byang sems min/ /'dzin pa byung na lta ba min gsungs/ /rje rin po ches rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal gzigs dus su/ gang la gnas pa med par ni/ /sems nyid nam mkha' lta bur sgoms/ /de yi grogs rnams kun la 'bad/ /bse ru lta bur gnas par bya/ /zhes dang / yul gyi snang ba nam mkha'i me tog bzhin/ /sems kyi 'dzin pa bde gshegs su yis rnyed/ /dbyengs rig gcig pa mo gsham bu yis bsgrubs/ /de 'dra de dag gang yin rgyal ba'i lam/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dbyengs rig dbyer med rang bzhin stong ba nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la blos 'dzin pa dang bral bar 'jog pa la brtson par bya'o/ /sa skya parnyi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan rin po che'i zhal nas/ phyag rgya chen po goms par bya/ /yod dang med pa la sogs pa/ /dngos po'i gnas lugs de la med/ /bsgom bya sgom byed la sogs pa/ /bsgom par bya ba yod ma yin/ /sems la dngos po ma grub pa'i/ /sems kyi ngo sprod ga la yong / /tshig gi yul las 'das pa'i phyir/ /brjod par bya ba ci yang med/ /rnam rtog med pa'i chos rnams la/ /sems kyi rnam g.yeng gang yang med/ /dam pa'i don du de ltar yin/ /zhes dang / de bzhin du rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan 403

gyi mgur las/ chos thog mar skye ba med pa la/ /gnas pa dang 'gag pa ga la srid/ /skye 'gag med par bsam pa yi/ /rnam rtog 'phel bas zhog la thongs/ /gzhog sa rang yang zhog la thongs/ /'jog pa rang yang rnam rtog yin/ /rang byung gnas lugs ma rtogs shing / /'dzin med kyi gdams ngag ma goms pas/ /ci ltar byas kyang 'dzin par song / /'dzin med bsams kyang 'dzin par song / /gsal lam 'gags kyi bdag med yin/ /zung 'jug gi gnas lugs rtogs par shog /gsungs/bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas/ byas pa'i chos kyis blo 'das don mi mthong / /don dam spros bral blo yi yul las 'das/ /blo 'das phyag rgya chen po rtogs 'dod na/ /ci yang mi sems rtse gcig glod la zhog /nang du kha bltas rang gi sems la ltos/ /bltas pas blta bya lta byed gnyis dang bral/ /gsal stong ma 'gag rig pa rjen par 'char/ /de la ma yengs rtse gcig dran pas zungs/ /de ltar rgyun du bskyangs na grub chen dang / /sangs rgyas la sogs dngos grub rnam gnyis 'byung / /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad byon gyur kyang / /gdams pa'i mthar thug de las med do ang / /lus kyi 'dug stangs mig gis lta stangs dang / /dbang po'i phyed bcings la sogs sna tshogs 404

pas/ /rig pa ngang la mi gnas bar du gcun/ /klong du gyur nas ci bder 'dzad par zhu/ /gsungs/ rje btsun mi la ras pa'i zhal nas/ nam mkha' 'di la dpe longs la mtha' dbus med pa'i sgom zhig gyis/ /nyi zla gnyis la dpe longs la/ /gsal 'grib med pa'i sgom zhig gyis/ /zhes dang / sems dang nam mkha' khyad med na/ /chos sku klong du gyur pa yin/ /'di dang phyi mar khyad med na/ /gnas lugs klong du gyur pa yin/ /gsum̐ngs/ yi dam phyag na rdo rjes/ mkha' ltar dag pa'i lta ba la/ /rig pa'i khyung lding yan du chug /gser gling bsam gtan sgom pa la/ /ma yengs rgyun du gnas par mdzod/ /ces dang / mu mtha' bral ba'i lta ba la/ /gdengs kyis chod pa shin tu gces/ /bsam du med pa'i sgom pa la/ /dran pas zin pa rab tu gces/ /gsungs/ mkhas pa'i dbang bo rje btsun tā ra na tha'i mgur las/ sems gsal rig bde ba'i nyams myong 'di/ /gnas phyogs cha med pa mkha' las yangs/ /dus rtag tu 'pho 'gyur ye nas sangs/ /don cang med ma yin bde bar myong / /de rig kyang myong bya myong byed bral/ /gzhan sdug bsngal dang zug rngu'i ming yang stor/ /zhes dang / sems ro dang 'dra na sgom chen min/ /sems pa med kyang ngo shes can/ /nam mkha' lta bur 405

dpangs mtho la/ /sa gzhi lta bur mi g.yo rgya re che/ /mar me ltar gsal la shel ltar dwangs/ /chu ltar ngang gis dal ba la/ /zhes dang / rje lho brag mar pa'i mgur las/ shar chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du phyin/ /rje mi tre chen po'i bka' drin gyis/ /gzhi chos nyid skye ba med par rtogs/ /sems stong ba nyid la sbar zin byas/ /don spros bral gnyug ma'i ngo bo mthong / /sku gsum ma dang mngon sum mjal/ /mi kho bos spros pa de nas chod/ /gsungs/ mnyam med dwags po lha rje'i zhal snga nas/ de yang sems kyi ngo bo ma bcos ma bslad pa rnam pa gsal ba dag pa dus thams cad du rgyun chad med pa yin/ de la gnyis te/ snang ba la nges pa dang / snang la ma nges pa'o/ /ston kha'i nam mkha' lta bu dang /sems nyid gnyis su med par rtogs pas te/ yar sangs rgyas la mi re/ mar 'khor ba la mi dogs/ gzhan gyis bsgyur yang mi 'gyur ba ste/ snang la nges pa yin/ ma nges pa ni/ nyams myong la'ang bzhi ste/ zhi gnas kyi bde ba gsal ba mi rtog pa'o/ /nyams la res yod res med pa snyam byed pa ste/ mi rtog pas rgyu byas nas mar la ldog pa'i nyen yod/ gzugs khams dang gzugs med pa 'gog pa'i rgyur yang 'gro nyen yod/ dang po slob pa'i dus su rig pa gsal sing nge ba la slob/ de yang shes 406

pa ma yengs pa la slob/ de yang rig pa'i ngo bo la yang ma yengs par bya/ de la goms tsa na rang la nges shes skye ba yin/ sems kyi ngo bo ma shor bar byas nas/ rnam rtog ci tsam yang 'phro ba yin/ dper na nam mkha' rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa yin yang sprin dang na bun dang khug sna la sogs pa ci tsam yang 'ong ba yin/ de nam mkha' rang la dwangs nas 'gro ba dang 'dra ste/ de yang rnam rtog grogs su 'gro ba bya ba yin gsungs/ras chung rdo rje grags pa'i zhal nas/ras chung ba la lta ba med//lta ba nam mkha'i mthongs su shor/ /mtha' dbus med par shor te thal/ /shor kyang phyi rjes bcad ri shi /ras chung ba la sgom pa med/ /bsgom pa mtsho mo'i gting du shor/ /kha gting med par shor te thal/ /shor kyang phyi rjes bcad ri shi /gsungs/mkhas pa chen po chos ldan rab 'byor dbyangs kyis mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgon me rin po che'i phreng ba las/ rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /stong ba nyid kyi rang bzhin no//stong ba nyid du mi bsgom te//mi stong bar yang bsgom mi bya/ /stong dang mi stong 'dzin pa la//tha mal pa yi rnam rtog skye/ /stong ba zhes bya rnam rtog ste/ /des na de nyid spang bar bya/ /'ga' yang mthong ba med pa ni/ /mthong ba'i mchog ces 407

yin par gsungs/ /zhes dang / slob dpon kā ma la shī las mdzad pa'i sgom rim bar ba las/ de nas rtsa ba'i snying rje bsgom par byas nas byang chub kyi sems bsgom par bya'o/ /byang chub kyi sems de ni rnam pa gnyis te/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'o/ /de la kun rdzob pa ni snying rjes sems can mtha' dag mngon par 'don par dam bcas nas/ 'gro ba la phan gdags pa'i phyir sangs rgyas su gyur cig snyam du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa'i rnam pa'i sems dang po bskyed pa'o/ /de yang tshul khrims kyi le'u las bstan pa'i cho ga bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la gnas pa mkhas pa pha rol po las sems bskyed par bya'o/ /de ltar kun rdzob pa'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas/ don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i phyir 'bad par bya'o/ /don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems de ni 'jig rten las 'das pa spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba/ shin tu gsal ba/ don dam pa'i spyod yul dri ma med pa/ mi g.yo ba/ rlung med pa'i mar me'i rgyun ltar mi g.yo ba'o gsungs/ rgyal sras thogs med rin po che'i zhal nas/ snying la zhugs pa'i dgra bo 'di ni tshe 'di'i snyan grags don gnyer yin gye de dag spangs phyir dben pa'i gnas 408

su rang sems khugs la yun du goms par mdzod/ dben pa'i gnas su yun ring goms na snang ba sems kyi rol par mthong ste rang sems chos sku'i ngang du glod na re dogs spong ba nyid la the tshom med/ re dogs gnyis po rtsad nas chod pa gang de 'jig rten 'di dang pha rol tu'ang sangs rgyas yin gyi phyi rol ma 'dris rang sems nyid la 'dri bar gyis/ ji bzhin smras pas rgyun chags 'di ni thogs med ces byas sbyar ba yin gyis gzhan dag gis kyang tshig 'di'i don rnams nyams su longs dang 'bras bu yid 'ong 'byung / zhes gsungs pa bzhin tshe 'di'i snyan grags sogs 'jig rten chos brgyad spangs nas/don dam byang chub sems kyi gnas lugs la goms par byas na ring bor mi thogs par 'bras su sangs rgyas tshe 'dir thob par 'gyur ro/ /sngon jo bo rje rgya gar shar phyogs bha du ra'i grong na bzhugs dus bud med gcer bu rus rgyan can zhig res ngu res dgod pa zhig gzigs nas/ yid kyis gsol ba btab pas/ nga res ngu res dgod pa'i don shes sam gsungs/ ma 'tshal zhus pas/ sems can rnams rang rgyud kyi ye shes ma rtogs par 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal la spyod pas ngu ba yin/rtogs na da lta nyid du sangs rgyas pa yin pas dgod pa yin 409

gsungs nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dbang tshegs chung la don che ba byen rlabs kyi lugs bya ba dbang bskur nas rnal 'byor ma'i zhal ji lta bar gzigs/ gdams ngag ma lus par zhus zhes chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston las gsungs/ des na myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'dod pa'i dbang dang gdams ngag 'di 'dra ba zhus nas nyams su len dgos te/ ma cig lab kyi sgon ma'i zhal nas/ ci yang yid la ma byas na/ /dmigs med ngang la bzhag pa yin/ /zhes dang /lus ni ro yi tshul du bzhag /bdag po med pa'i tshul du bzhag /sems nyid nam mkha'i tshul du bzhag /mtha' dbus med pa'i tshul du bzhag /mar me rlung gis ma bskyod bzhin/ /gsal la mi rtog tshul du bzhag /rgya mtsho rdzi yis ma bskyod bzhin/ /mer la dwangs pa'i tshul du bzhag /gsungs/ sngon rje mi las lug rdzi gcig la/ gsal bya ma 'gag lhug par zhogastong sang nge / gsal la hrig ge dga' yal le/ byas pas lug rdzi de grol skad/ pha dam pas rdzi bo gcig la/ lta ba 'dod pa zad pa la gyis/ sgom pa ma yengs pa la gyis/ spyod pa ma bcos pa la gyis/ 'bras bu re dogs med pa la gyis gsungs pas/ 'dod pa thams cad zad pa'i rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig 410

cig byung skad/ des na dam pa gong ma rnams kyi gsung 'di ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /dgyes pa rdo rje las/ gang du yid kyis ma bsgoms na/ /'gro ba thams cad bsgom 'gyur te/ /bsgom pa med pa'i sgom gyis ni/ /thams cad chos ni yongs shes bya/ /zhes dang / sa ra has/ sems ni nam mkha' 'dra bar bzung bya ste/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin du ni sems nyid bzung / /yid des yid ma yin par byed gyur na/ /de ni bla med byang chub 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ dmigs pa med pa'i sems su ni/ /gnas pa byang chub nyid yin te/ /de phyir dmigs med sems goms na/ /bla med byang chub 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dpal ri khrod zhabs kyis/ ci yang mi sems te/ ci la yang mi sems pas ni byang chub 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /gsungs/ chos kyi rgyal po'i mdo las/ yang dag pa'i bden pa'i gzhung rtogs na/ sdig to kun ni byang ngo / /zhes dang / lang gar gshegs pa las/ 'gro ba gang gis sems mthong na/ /duḥ kha kun las thar bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang /bsam gtan gyi sgo'i mdo las/ phyi rol gyi mtshan mas grub par byed pa ni/ bskal pa grangs med pas kyang 'thob par mi byed do/ /nang gi sems kyi tshor ba'i ngo bo nyid rig na yud tsam gyis 411

sangs rgya'o/ /zhes dang / gtsug tor gyi mdo las/ chos thams cad mtshan ma med pa'i ye shes bde ba la gnas pa de ni/ lus 'di bor nas bla na med pa'i byang chub dran pa dang ldan par 'gyur te/ lus sems bral ma thag bya skogs pa nas 'byung ba bzhin/ yang rab kyi lus la bla na med pa'i byang chub 'thob ste/yid kyi lus thob nas 'gro ba dang 'ong ba med do/ /zhes dang /chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo las/ sems mnyam par bzhag na yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin shes par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs/ pha dam pa'i zhal nas/ bla ma dkon mchog spyi bor dran par gyis la mos gus kyis gsol ba thobs dang / chos nyid kyi nam mkha' mtha' nas langs te mchi'o/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro snying gi dkyil du sgoms la/ gsang sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod nyams su longs shig 'od gsal gyi nyi ma mtha' nas 'char te mchi'o/ /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rang gi sems su blos thag chod la/ chos nyid zab mo'i don la ltos shig ye shes kyi 'od zer yongs la khyab ste mchi'o gsungs/ yang chos la bzod pa ma thob kyi bar du/ las rgyu 'bras khyad du ma gsod cig gang la bdag med par ma rtogs kyi bar du/ rang sems gnyen po dang ma 'bral zhig sems nyid nam mkha' 412

dang dbyer med ma 'dres kyi bar du/ theg pa rang sa na bden pas/ chos la phyogs ris ma byed cig gsungs pa ltar lag len la gang thebs gyis shig ang / chos dbyengs mdzod las/ dkar dmar yul du snang ba'i rnam pa la/ /dbang po mi bsdu mig kyang mi 'gul bas/ /bdag la mi bsam gzhan la mi rtogs par/ /phyam phyam yangs pa chen po ngang gis zhog /rgya bskyed dpangs bstod spro bsdu bral ba'i sems/ /kun mnyam rang byung ye shes dgongs pa la/ /phyi nang bar med nam mkha' 'dres pa'i nyams/ /bde gsal spros dang bral ba'i ting 'dzin 'char/ /gsungs/ phar phyin bdun brgya pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa la blta bar 'dod na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid mi sgom pa'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes dang / bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i mdo las/ nam mkha' ma bsgrib na gsal lo/ /chu ma bsnyog na dwangs so/ /sems ma bcos na bde'o gsungs/ nyi ma rab tu snang ba'i mdo las/ bka' stsal ba/ rnal 'byor gang zhe na/ sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba/ ma bcos pa ma bslad pa/ rnal ma de la bya'o/ /spyod pa zhes bgyi ba gang zhe na/de ltar ma nor bar nyams su len pa la bya'o/ /zhes dang / phal po che las/ 'du shes kyi 'dzin pa dang bral ba la ni thams cad 413

ma.o pa'i rang byung gi ye shes thogs pa med par 'byung ngo gsungs/ ting nge 'dzin dam pa'i mdo las/ sems ting nge 'dzin la gnas na/ phyogs bcu'i stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / skar ma dang /'bab chu dang / gtsang bo dang / rgya mtsho dang / ri dang / tshal dang / klung dang / lung ba dag kyang skyu ru ra'i 'bras bu lag mthil du bzhag pa bzhin mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan gyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas na dzu 'phrul gyi phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du yang phyin zhing /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rlung dang / me dang / chu dang / sa dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / skar ma dang / gza' dang / ri bo dang / tshal dang / shing dang / lha'i pho brang dang /klu'i pho brang sprul nus te/ de bas na bsam gtan gyi nus pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab par rig par bya'o/ /zhes dang / ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ rdul bral ting 'dzin stong ba'i rig 'di ni/ /byang chub sem/sa dpa'i dga' ba rtogs byed pa/ /des ni sangs rgyas ye shes myur du thob/ /gsungs/ rje rgod tshang pas gshegs khar/ nga nam mkha' lta bu'i sems la skye 'chi med/nam mkha' lta bu'i sems la mtha' dbus med/ nam mkha' 414

lta bu'i sems la bcings grol med/ nam mkha' lta bu'i sems la mtho dman med/ ces gsungs nas sems nyid rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba chos sku nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag nas gshegs so/ /nged rnams kyis kyang 'chi khar de bzhin bya dgos so/ /bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig gis/ sems kyi ngo bo gcer mthong mdzub tshugs su ngo sprad nas de nyid bsgoms na/ gzhung lugs kyi sbyangs pa ma bgyis kyang sa lam gyi rtogs pa shugs kyis 'char ba 'byung ste/ 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ rtogs pa gsha' ma skyes gyur na/ /skyes bu gsum gyi rim pa 'di/ /sbyangs pa'i 'bad rtsol mi dgos par/ /ngo bo nyid kyis shugs las 'byung / /gsungs/ /gzhan yang khong gi zhal nas/ sgrub rgyun chad med mdzad na/ snang ba slob dpon du shar nas 'ong /snang srid ma lus thams cad kyang / bde chen gye ngang du rtogs nas mchi/ zhes dang /rnam rtog gi rang bzhin go tsa na//mkha' la 'phur ba'i bya rjes de/ /rgod po rnams kyis mi dpyod ltar/ /tha snyad kyi 'dod 'dun zhig nas 'gro/ /gsungs/ rje btsun grol mchog pa'i khrid brgya las/ sems rang lugs su lhod bzhag pas/ rtogs pa rang sar nyal zhi gnas ngos bzung med 415

pa'i shes pa gsal sing nge / rang rig rang gsal du rjen ne ba de la/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa zer ba yin/ sems can gyi sems kyi mtshan nyid zer ba yin/ dngos po'i gnas lugs zer ba yin/ rang gi sems bya ba ngos bzung med pa'i shes pa gsal sing nge ba 'di yin mod/ bla mas de ngo sprad pa yin/slob mas de shes par byed pa yin/ de ltar ngo shes pa la da sems ngo shes pa zer ba yin/ sangs rgyas mkhan/ 'khor bar 'khyams mkhan/ dga' ba dang mi dga' ba/ mdor na srid dang zhi ba'i chos kyi byed mkhan thams cad 'di yin/ sngar rtog pas bsgribs nas ngo ma shes pa yin/ da lta rnam rtog rgyun chad pas ngo shes pa yin no/ /sems de la ngos bzung ci yang med pa sems kyi rang bzhin yin/ med bzhin sa le wal le ba de sems kyi mtshan nyid yin/ stong gsal rig pa'i ngo bo sing nge ye re ba de ngo bo yin no/ /de la ngo shes pa zhig mdzod/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes par ngo sprad pa'o gsungs/ sngon gtsang spyon he ru gas bon po rdo rje snying bo la/ sems 'tshol gyi khrid btab nas dus la babs pa dang / ngo sprod du mgur 'di gsungs so/ /sems 'tshol skyes bu rdo rje snying bo nyon/ /'tshol mkhan de ka sems de yin pa'i phyir/ /gzhan du btsal bas rnyed par ga la 'gyur/ /416
