ral gri rno yang rang gis rang mi chod/ /mig dbang gsal kyang rang gis rang mi mthong / /chus 'khyer kha skom chu nyid 'tshol ba dang / /nam mkha'i mdud pa grol ba'i ngal dub dang / /mo gsham bu shi'i mya ngan ma byed cig /ma stor sems nyid gzhan du 'tshol ba ltar/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sems las gzhan na med/ /des na rang gis rang la yid ches mdzod/ /rang gi sems kyi gnas lugs glu 'dir nyon/ /kun gzhi skye med rang gi sems nyid 'di/ /dang po rgyu med rgyu yis stong gin gda'/ /tha ma 'gog med ngo bos stong gin gda'/ /'khor 'das phyogs ris mtha' dag bral gyin gda'/ /dngos po med pa'i mtshan ma kha dog bral/ /gcig tu ma grub du mar snang gin gda'/ /tshig dang bral yang tshig tu brjod kyin gda'/ /rtsol bas btsal tshe gab nas sdod kyin gda'/ /glod nas bzhag tshe rang zhal ston gyin gda'/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bon po sems ngo 'phrod de chos par gyur to/ /gsang 'dus rim lnga las/ sems dang sems byung spros pa kun/ /nye bar zhi ba de yi tshe/ /'od gsal ba yi ye shes ni/ /mi rtog mtha' dbus med par 'char/ /gsungs/ rje btsun skal ldan rgya mtsho'i mgur las/ rje na ro mi tri'i bzhed pa gang / /dpal mar mi yab sras thugs dam mthil/ /sems mi 417

rtog khyab gdal chen po'i ngang / /dus rgyun du 'jog la phyag chen zer/ /gsungs/ slob dpon seng ge bzang bo'i zhal snga nas/ kye ma gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyis/ /dub pa dag gis ngal gso'i gnas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i lugs/ /ring mo zhig nas mthong ba yin/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo rjes/'khor ba la yid 'byung ba'i glu las/ bla ma'i gdams ngag ces bya bdud rtsi'i ro/ /gang gis mnyam par 'jog pa de tsam zhig /yongs su btsal gyis gzhung mang ci zhig dgos/ /thams cad yid ni 'khrul bar byed pa'i rgyu/ /zhes dang / tshe 'di yun thung shes bya'i rnam pa mang / /tshe yi tshad kyang ci tsam mi shes pas/ /ngang bas chu las 'o ma len pa ltar/ /rang gi 'dod pa dang du blang bar bya/ /zhes dang / yang / tshe thung nad mang longs spyod dman/ /dus ngan snyigs ma bar chad mang / /yun ring sdod pa'i mthu med pas/ /snying bo myur du bsdu bar rigs/ /lho brag mar pa'i zhal nas/ deng dus bstan pa'i snyigs ma la/ /tshe la longs med rkyen mang bas/ /shes bya'i gshis la ma 'chor bar/ /sgrub pa nyams su longs shig gsungs/ /rje btsun mi la ras pas mang bo bslab las don thog tu/ /dar cig bzhag pa phan zhes gsungs/ /de bzhin du mkhas grub mang bos gsungs pa rnams 418

sems la bzhag nas/ tshegs chung don che/ gcig shes kun grol gnad kyi gdams ngag sems ngo skyong ba la 'bad par bya'o/ /yang ma cig gi zhal nas/ nam mkha' la dpe byas pas lta ba la phyogs ris mi gda'/ bar snang la dpe byas pas bsgom pa la ngos bzung mi gda'/ bu chung la dpe byas pas spyod pa la tig gtad mi gda'/ zhes gsungs so/ /kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams pas mdzad pa'i chos dbyings mdzod kyi 'grel ba lung gi gter mdzod las/ mdor na rtsa rlung thig le'i thabs sam/gzhan yang rung ste sems spro ba dang gnas pa la sogs pa'i thabs ci byed kyang / rig pa gsal dag shel gong 'dra ba blo bral rjen la bud nas/ lta sgom dang gnyen po med pa de chos sku zang thal chen por ngo sprod do/ /'di la gsal nyams dang phyed dgos te/ gsal nyams ni gnas cha sa le ba yin la/ chos sku ni gsal rig gnas cha dang bral ba ste/ snang stong gsal ba de/ mi rtog pa la sogs pa dang ma 'dres par rig ge rjen ne ba de yin pas/ zang thal ma thal dang / rig cha dang gnas cha'i khyad yod pas 'dzol sa med do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang de nyid las/ ro stod ser byas lta stongs phyal byas/ mig kyang phar 'phrul tshur 'phrul bar snang gi dbyings dang thag ring bor 419

gtad pas/ rig pa rgya bskyed/ sgo lnga rang yan du 'phyor bcug nas bsgoms pas/ phyi nang bar med du phyal song nas/ lus dang nam mkha' 'dres pa'i nyams dang / bde gsal mi rtog pa zang thal chen po'i nyams dang / rig pa zang thal chen po'i nyams 'char te/ snang ba thams cad sang seng khral khrol zang thal ba snyam pa dang / shes pa zang thal rjes med phyal phyal ba snyam pa dang / thams cad zang thal rgya grol stong bar thag chod nas/ ci yang med pa'i ngang ci yang 'char snyam pa dang / ji ltar brtags shing bsams kyang rnam rtog btsal gyis ma rnyed par nga skye mi srid/ sngar yang skyes pa mi 'dug da lta rtogs pa su la nga mi 'dug par/ rnam rtog mang zer ba ci yin na ang snyam pa la sogs pa/ zang thal gyi nyams brjod las 'das pa 'char ro/ /gsungs pa ltar bsgoms na lta ba la bogs thon par 'gyur ro/ /mkhyen brtse rin po ches mdzad pa'i khrid yig dran pa nyer bzhag las/ 'di ltar phyi yul lnga'i snang ba thams cad ni med bzhin 'khrul ngo la snang bas rmi lam lta bu/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel 'tshogs pa las glo bur du snang bas sgyu ma lta bu/ med pa yod par snang bas mig yor lta bu/ snang bzhin du bden par ma grub pas smig rgyu lta bu/ phyi nang gang la'ang snang bas brag cha lta bu/420

rten dang brten par med pas dri za'i grong khyer lta bu/ snang la rang bzhin med pas gzugs brnyan gyi snang ba lta bu/ med snang cir yang shar bas sprul ba'i grong khyer lta bu ste/ dngos po med pa'i stong gzugs sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad du bltas pas yul snang ba dzun pa'i rang bzhin du go la/ de ltar snang ba'i mkhan po yul can sems kyi gshis lugs la brtags pas/ yul snang ma 'gags la/ yul gye 'dzin rtog ni/ chos nyid stong gsal nam mkha' lta bur rtogs pa'i ngang du 'jog pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o/ /rje rang rig ras pa'i zhal nas/ gnas chen gangs dkar gye rgyal po te ser slebs skabs/ rig pa sprin thag chod pa lta bu/ gting gsal ba/ gu yangs 'ching grol med pa/ rig pa phyi nang med par zang thal ba/ snang ba cir yang ma 'gag pa/ ci snang gang shar gang 'byung thams cad rig thog na gsal sing nge / phyogs dang mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/ ci tsam ma 'gag par shar ba/ de tsam gyi gsal cha che ba/ shar ri shar tshad rang gsal 'od gsal chen po 'ba' zhig tu go /sngar gye rnam rtog 'og 'gyu rgyun chad med pa de ka rang gi rig pa rgyun 'chad pa med par go zhing / sngar gyi go ba tsho dang mi 'dra ba'i 421

yid ches kyi shes pa gting nas grol bas rnam rtog phra rags dang / bzang ngan gyi ming med pa/ cir snang gang shar thams cad kyi phan gnod med cing re dogs dang bral ba/ shar ma shar khyad med kyang sna tshogs su 'char bzhin 'gyus bzhin du gsal ba/ kha yengs mig yengs dang mchongs rgyug byas bzhin du gu yangs pa/ bsgom yod dang med dang min dang yin gyi gleng brjod thams cad hrul gyis zhig byed rgyu thams cad sing gis zad pa'i brjod bral rang byung gi rig pa rgyun chad med pa/ thun dang thun mtshams mi dgos pas rang la yid gting nas ches pa'i nyams shig shar/ zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i nyams rtogs khyad par can dang ldan pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor pa zhig bya dgos pas nyams len la brtson par gyis shig kun mkhyen klong chen pas/ bogs 'byin nam mkha' dwangs shing sprin med tshe/ /nyi mar rgyab phyogs mkha' la rab bltas pas/ /stong gsal shes pa spros dang bral bar 'char/ /zhes dang / sdud pa las/don 'di gang yin nam mkha' la brtag par gyis/ zhes dang /bde mchog bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud las/ mdun gyi nam mkha' de nyid la/ /dbang po gtad la cog ge bzhag /gsal la mi rtag ye shes dag /da lta nyid du 'char bar 'gyur/ /sa ra 422

has/ bar snang la ni yid dang rlung dang mig /dus gcig tu ni yang dag legs sbyar na/ /rgyal po'i yon tan rin chen nges par skye/ /zhes dang / sna tshogs rnam rtog spangs shing mi sems par /gal te mig gis nam mkhar phye byas na/ /phyogs bcu'i lam rnams nyid ni rnam par shes/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mtha' dag 'di las thob/ /zhes dang / sems ni nam mkha' 'dra bar bzung bya ste/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin nyid du'ang sems bzung bya/ /zhes dang / kun byed las/ don 'di nges par rtogs 'dod na/ /dpe ni nam mkha' dag la dris/ /zhes pa dang /yum bar pa las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnal 'byor du byed pa ni nam mkha' rnal 'byor du byed pa yin no zhes dang /rig 'dzin shrī sirnya'i zhal nas/ sangs rgyas dang sems can gyi khyad par ni/ rig pa rgya che chung gnyis las med/ sems can gyi rig pa dum bur gnas/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs khyab gdal du gnas pas nam mkha' lta bur rgya bskyed cig nam mkha' la shar mtha' med/ lho mtha' med/ nub mtha' med/ byang mtha' med/ gsungs/ ma cig gi gcod nam mkha' sgo 'byed las/dbyings rig bsres nas ma yum chen shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dgongs pa la ngo sprod pa ni man ngag bla na med pa 423

yin par gsungs/ 'di lta bu'i bla ma'i man ngag la brten nas sems ngo sprad na/ sems nyid rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba/dper na lag mthil du gter bzhag nas bltas pa dang 'dra ste/ do ha las/ bla mas smras pa gang gi snying zhugs pa/ /lag pa'i mthil na gnas pa'i gter mthong 'dra/ /gsungs/ de lta bu'i man ngag la brten nas sems ngo sprod pa'i bla ma de ni phyag bya ba'i yul yin te/ rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ gser bzang po 'dra ba'i sems kyi dbyings/ /de gcer mthong dam pa phyag gi yul/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nyams su len pa la yang brtson par bya'o/ /de yang phyi'i nam mkha' la bltas nas mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus su du ba la sogs pa'i rtags bcu dang / 'od lnga'i snang ba'ang rlung sems dbu mar chud pa'i nam mkha'i dbyings kun tu snang bar byed de/ phal po che las/ rang bzhin dmigs su med pa las/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par bkra/ /la la nam mkha'i dkyil na gsal/ /sna tshogs brjod kyis mi lang ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yang dag pa'i ting 'dzin brtan pa'i rtags de rnams mi 'dod kyang ngang gis 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rwa sgreng khri chen rdo rje 'chang gi zhal nas/ dge mi dge'i rnam rtog gang yang med pa'i lung ma bstan sems kyi rang 424

bzhin 'od gsal ba de nyid/ dper na shel dkar dri ma med pa de tshon dmar ser gang dang 'phrad pa na de'i kha dog can du 'gyur ba bzhin du dge sems khyad par can byang chub kyi sems rin po che dang phrad pa zhig gi ngang nas dge sbyor mdzad dgos gsungs/ de yang sems kyi skabs su sems kyi ngo bo rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba de sgrib gnyis kyis sbags nas yod cing / lam nyams su blangs pa'i stobs kyis rim gyis dri ma je dag dang yon tan je gsal du gyur te/ mthar sangs rgyas pa'i tshe 'od gsal chos dbyings bde stong dbyer med kyi ngang du ro gcig pa'i rgyun gcig par 'gyur ba yin gsungs/ des na slob ma rnams kyis kyang da lta'i dus su bla mas bstan pa'i lam 'di dag phyin ci ma log par nyams su blangs na/ rim gyis tha mal gyi snang zhen sogs je dag tu gyur te/ mthar rang sems bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gnas lugs nges don gyi bla ma'i go 'phang mngon du gyur pa na/ bla ma'i go 'phang thob pa zhes bya/ gsungs/ sngon rje btsun mi las mnyam bzhag gi ngang nas rje ras chung pa rgya gar du phar phebs pa dang / tshur 'byon pa sogs lkog gyur gye chos thams cad sa ler gzigs pa byung /rje btsun ras chung pas/ ras chung phug na bzhugs dus 425

mnyam gzhag gi ngang nas/ spyir srid pa'i rtsa rtse thams cad gzigs shing / sgos su rje mi las gnya' nang grod phug tu chos 'chad pa sogs ci mdzad gzigs pa byung / sngon nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang pos mnyam gzhag gi ngang nas phyogs bcu'i zhing khams thams cad gzigs pa byung / grub thob thang stong rgyal pos mnyam gzhag gi ngang nas rgya gar gyi ri nur ba dang /mon yul gyi nags ri la me shor ba/ zangs bzo bas zangs rku ba/ nye gnas kyis spyod ngan gang byed pa sogs gzhan gyi skyid sdug legs nyes thams cad gzigs par gsungs/ grub chen las kyi rje'i gsang ba'i rnam thar las/ bdag snying rje dang stong nyid la mnyam par bzhag tsa na/ byeng rgod kyis g.yeng ma myong /ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang nas bskal pa chen po lnga stong gi skye ba ji lta ba bzhin du dran te/ rang gi yul dang pha ma dang / nor dang /bla ma dang / 'khor dang chos 'di la byas dang / yi dam la 'di byas rnams ji lta ba bzhin mthong dran no/ /dus rgyun chad med par ni skye ba brgya dran zhing / skye ba bcu drug ni nyal ba'i rmi lam bzhin du dran te/ ched du gnyer nas blta dgos pa ni mi snang ngo / /gsungs/ de bzhin du nam mthong gi bar du tshogs gsog sgrib pa sbyong bzhin/ gnas lugs kyi ngang la mnyam par 426

'jog pa la brtson par byas nas/ rab tshe 'dir grol ba/'bring 'chi khar grol ba/ tha ma bar do'am/ skye ba phyi mar grol nges pa'i gdengs thob pa zhig bya'o//mdor na 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad snang stong sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin sems kyis rol pa/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo gdod nas stong gsal 'dzin med khyab gdal klong yangs spros bral nam mkha' lta bur gtan la phabs nas/ de'i ngang la rig pa kha yan du glod nas mnyam par 'jog pa'i tshe/ khyung chen mkha' la lding ba bzhin tshur la bsdu rgyu med par har sangs rgya yan/ phar la spro rgyu med par rang babs cog bzhar/ rong khung dog sa nas la kha mthon por bud pa bzhin/gu yangs la blo bde ba/ zang thal la phyam gdal ba/ ri mthon po'i rtse nas nam mkha' la bltas pa ltar/ yangs pa che ba gsal ba dwangs pa/ thang chen po'i dkyil nas rta gom 'gros can la zhon nas 'gro ba ltar snang so bde la sa lam chod pa/ rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du gru btang nas zla ba gcig tsam song na phyi'i sa gzhi ri'i snang ba rnams nub nas/ rgya mtsho dang nam mkha' gnyis 'dres te mtha' dbus med par sngo mer re gnas pa ltar/ yun ring mnyam par bzhag tshe gzung 'dzin gyi snang ba rnams nub nas/ dbyings rig gnyis 'dres te mtha' dbus 427

khyab gdal 'od gsal chos kyi dbyengs su nam yang mer re gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de lta nam gnas kyi bar du bla ma la gsol ba 'debs bzhin mnyam gzhag la brtson par bya'o/ /khye'u rab snang gi mdo las/ chos rnams rmi lam sgyu ma zhes/ /gang gi stong nyid dran gyur na/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol nas/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'tshang rgya nges/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa chos yang dag par sdud pa las/ dper na sgyu ma'i mkhan po zhig /sprul pa thar bar bya ba'i phyir/ /des ni sngar nas de shes nas/ /sprul pa de la chags pa med/ /srid gsum sprul pa 'dra bar ni/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mkhas pas shes/ /'gro ba'i ched du go bgos te/ /'gro ba de ltar sngar nas shes/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar chos thams cad snang stong sgyu ma rmi lam ltar blta zhing / de ltar ma rtogs pa'i mar gyur sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po bskyed nas 'gro ba'i don la 'bad par bya'o/ /da ni bshad rgyu ha cang mi mang bar de tsam zhig byas/tshur bsdu bar rigs te/ rje gu na ma nyis mdzad pa'i legs bshad 'phrul gyi lde mig las/ 'dod chags la sogs nyes brgya 'joms pa'i sman/ /sman gyi mchog ni chos kyi gtam bzang yin/ /yin lugs legs bshad smra na kho bo mkhas/ /mkhas pa 428

dgyes pa'i legs bshad bshad kyis nyon/ /'on kyang sngon tshe rgya gar 'phags yul du/ /dpal ldan chos kyi grags pas rnam 'grel brtsams/ /bstan bcos mkhas pa'i mdun sar 'grims pa na/ /phrag dog dbang gis khye yi mjug mar btags/ /de la chos kyi grags pas 'di skad gsungs/ /khyi ni grong srang kun tu 'gro ba ltar/ /nga yi chos 'dir 'phrin las 'byung zhes gsungs/ /phrag dog byed mi rnams la nyer dgongs nas/ /skye bo phal cher phal la chags zhes sogs/ /sho lo ka 'di slar yang bcug par grags/ /gzhan yang slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po yis/ /tshad ma kun las btus pa brtsams pa na/ /tshig don brling zhing rtogs par dka' ba las/ /de don ser skya pa la sogs pa yis/ /mu stegs 'ga' yis ji bzhin ma go bas/ /phyogs kyi glang pos rtog ge mi shes zhes/ /mu stegs de dag rnams kyis smad ces thos/ /tshul 'dir dgongs nas tshad ma rnam nges su/ /'jig rten blo gros blun po zhes sogs gsungs/ /gzhan yang 'khrul bral rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /ngur smrig gar rol rje btsun tsong kha pa'i/ /thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i smon lam du/ /zhi gnas spangs te zung 'brel bsgom par shog /ces pa 'di la 'brug pa'i bstan 429

'dzin che/ /mi pham pad+ma dkar pos skyon brjod byas/ /gzhan yang mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa yis/ /khams gsum bla mar bstod pa'i gsol 'debs su/ /dpal ldan sa gsum 'gro ba'i mig gcig pu/ /zhes pa 'di la gtsang chung chos grags kyis/ /sa gsum 'gro la 'dren pa mig gcig ni/ /nyung ba'i skyon yod ces ni skyon brjod byas/ /de ltar rgya bod mkhas grub mang po yis/ /gsungs la'ang skyon brjod byed tshul de ltar na/ /phrag dog dug sbrul mang po'i khrod nang du/ /mi smra'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa gdams par go /zhes dang / rje rin po ches/dmu rgod 'dul dka'i sems can 'di rnams la/ /bshad pas phan thogs chen po ga la 'gyur/ /de bas sgrub pa lhur len dben pa bsten/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka 'tshengs pa'i lam rnyed snyam/ /zhes dang / mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtshos/ 'on kyang skye bo phal cher phal la chags/ /legs bshad don du mi gnyer phrag dog gis/ /legs par bshad dang mkhas pa'i tshogs la smod/ /'di 'dra'i skabs su dben pa bsten na legs/ /zhes dang / mkhyen brtse rin po ches/ /da ni rmi lam tsam gyi mi tshe 'dir/ /rnam g.yeng chos su ming btags des ci bya/ /kun brtags rtog dpyod rnon po ci dgar thongs/ /rig pa 'od 430

gsal klong du ngal gsos shig /ces gsungs pa ltar da ni tshe mjug la mgo'i nyi zer tsam yun thung ngu 'di'i ring la/ rnam g.yeng gi spros pa gzhan dor nas ri khrod dben pa'i gnas su sems nyid 'od gsal gyi dbyings su ngal gso bar bya'o/ /smras pa/ rab mdzes sku ni gser gyi ri las mjes rab snyan gsung ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs las snyan/ /rab gsal thugs ni nam mkha'i dbyings las gsal/ /rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs/ /myur du sangs rgyas go 'phang 'thob pa'i thabs/ /yan lag bdun pa la sogs rgyal sras kyi/ /spyod pa rnams la slob pa'i smon lam 'debs/ /rnam dag smon lam 'grub par byen gyis rlobs/ /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rdul gyi grangs mnyam pa'i/ /rang lus grangs med sprul nas gus phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang 'bral ba med par shog /dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis sprul pa'i tshogs/ /kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bu yis/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mchod/ /rgyal ba sras bcas 'phrin las 'jug par shog /bdag gzhan mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis/ /bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung ma lus pa/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal 431

ba sras bcas spyan sngar bshags/ /sdig ltung thams cad byang zhing dag par shog /dus gsum rgyal ba'i rmad byung mdzad pa dang / /skye 'phags rnams kyis dge ba bsags tshad la/ /rab tu dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo / /dge tshogs mi zad gong du 'phel bar shog /phyogs bcu'i zhing na mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /bzhugs pa rnams la 'khor lo dung dkar sogs/ /phul nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /dam pa'i chos dang 'bral ba med par shog /mya ngan 'da' bar bzhed pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /g.yung drung rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gdan phul nas/ /bskal chen grangs med bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /gsol ba btab pa bzhin du thebs par shog /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnams/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa dar ba dang / /'gro kun sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /bsngo ba smon lam btab tshad 'grub par shog /nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong gnyen po ru/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong legs gsungs pa'i/ /ston pa shākya thub pa'i bstan pa dang / /tshe rabs kun tu 'bral ba med par shog /phyi ru nyan thos byang sems spyod pa skyong/ /nang du gsang sngags rim gnyis rnal 'byor brtson/ /gsang ba 'od gsol 432

rdzogs chen don la spyod/ /o rgyan pad+ma'i bstan dang mjal bar shog /rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel ma lus pa/ /gdams par shar nas gzhan la 'doms mkhas pa'i/ /sangs rgyas gnyis pa jo bo yab sras kyi/ /bstan pa rin po che dang mjal bar shog /phul byung rnam thar gtsang ma'i khrims dang ldan/ /rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa'i snying stobs che/ /bde stong mchog gi rim gnyis rnal 'byor brtson/ /blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan dang mjal bar shog /bdag gzhan deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dal 'byor rten thob dge ba'i bshes dang mjal/ /thos bsam sgom gsum 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sgos/ /rgyal bstan ma lus 'dzin skyong spel bar shog /bdag ni skye ba 'di yi 'og rol tu/ /mngon dga' la sogs phyogs bcu'i zhing kun tu/ /song nas sangs rgyas thams cad mchod byed cing / /'brel thogs gang 'dod zhing du 'dren par shog /bstan pa spyi dang khyad par thub dbang gi /bstan la phan pa'i o rgyan glegs bam 'di/ /bstan pa nam gnas bar du legs gnas nas/ /bstan dang 'a gro ba yongs la phan par shog /mdor na chos kyi dbyengs dang mnyam pa yi/ /rgyal kun mchod bstod dam pa'i chos 'dzin cing / /nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro la gang 433

'dod byin/ /chos bstan sangs rgyas sa la 'god par shog /phyi ltar lag len sde snod gsum ltar spyod/ /nang ltar gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi ltar spyod/ /gsang ba phyag rdzogs do ha'i lugs ltar spyod/ /mdo sngags yongs la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /byen rlabs dngos grub ji snyed yod pa kun/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can la/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams thams cad la/ /nad yams mu ge 'thab rtsod mi 'byung zhing / /char chu dus 'bab lo phyugs rtag tu legs/ /'gro kun bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad gnam la bkra shis shog /pad+ma 'dab brgyad sa la bkra shis shog /bar 'dir 'khod tshad yongs la bkra shis shog /bkra shis chen pos phyogs kun khyab gyur cig /ces bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i o rgyan sprul pa'i glegs bam zhes bya ba 'di ni ji ltar brtsams pa'i lo rgyus cung zad tsam zhig brjod na/ bdag gis sngon dus sprul pa'i glegs bam mang bo zhig brtsams pa rnams la bltas nas/ o rgyan chen po'i rjes 'jug dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi sprul sku rnam gsum dang / mag gsar 434

rdo rje 'chang gi sras gnyis/ bla ma bzang bo rgya mtsho/ rtogs ldan mkha' 'gro/ nyang gi mtshams pa/ lha khang dbu mdzad sogs reb gong phyogs kyi dad can sngags 'chang mang bos skyabs mgon khyed kyis sngar gdul bya yongs la phan pa'i sprul pa'i glegs bam mang po brtsams pa bka' drin che/ da dung khyed kyis o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi thugs bcud bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i zab gnad thams cad tshang ba'i sngar med legs bshad kha gsal/ pad 'byung sprul pa'i glegs bam zhes bya ba zhig rtsom dgos zhes snga phyi rim pa byas yang yang bskul ngor/ bdag gis kyang brtsam dgos snyam/ mtshams la bsdad nas/ zhag mang po'i bar du sa skya'i gsung gi o rgyan bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig la brten nas gsol ba btab pa'i nub gcig gi tho rangs nyams snang la/ o rgyan gyi gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas la 'khor phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' grangs las 'das pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba zhal gzigs pa'i snang ba shar/ de dag rnams la dngos su 'byor ba dang yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa rgya chen po phul nas rab tu gus pas thal mo sbyar te/ bdag gis chung nas bzu nga ste dus da bar du gsol ba btab kyang lha zhal da bar du mi gzigs pa 435

thugs rje re chung zhus pas/ khong gi zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te/ dgyes bzhin bka' stsal ba/ kye rigs kyi bu nyon cigangs sngon khyod kyis bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub pa'i rten 'brel du/ thog mar mtsho snying nas rje rin po che'i rnam par bstan nas rgyud byin gyis brlabs te lam rim gnang / de'i rjes su rma 'gram ri khrod bkra shis nyams dga'i gling na 'dug dus jo bo rje'i rnam par bstan nas thugs ga'i sgo phyes/ thig le bcu drug gi ting nge 'dzin gye dbang bskur/ bka' gdams glegs bam gnang / da ni zhal dngos su bstan nas chos dngos su gnang ba yin pas dga' bar mdzod cig spyir rgyal ba thams cad ye shes kyi klong du ro gcig kyang / sgos su nged rnam pa gsum thugs rgyud gcig tshul khyod kyis sngar shes pa de ka ltar yin la/ khyad par du phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa ma lus pa/ rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i rnam 'phrul du go dgos shing / rtsa ba'i bla ma yang rang gi sems kyi rnam rol/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo yang gdod nas stong ba nam mkha' bzhin 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub pa/ brtan g.yo kun la khyab pa 'khor 'das kyi 'char gzhir gyur pa/ stong gsal chos sku ru ngo shes na/ chos kyi gting go ba yin gsungs/436

yang zhus pa/ da ni rgyal dbang khyed kyi thugs bcud bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i gnad thams cad 'dus pa'i pad 'byung sprul pa'i glegs bam zhes bya ba zhig brtsam na snyam pas/khyed kyi dgongs don ji lta ba bzhin rtsom nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes zhus pas khong gi zhal nas/ 'o gsang sngags kyi mthar thug rgyud kyi dgongs don bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i gnad rnams rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul klong chen rab 'byams pa dang / mkhyen brtse sogs mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams kyis brtsams pa dang / khyod kyi rtsa ba'i bla mas gsungs pa rnams nyams su longs na de gas chog par 'dug de'i lhag gcig mi dgos/ de bas ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus su rgyal po kṛ kṛ'i rmi lam gyi lung bstan ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di phyi rol pa sogs kyis mi 'jig par/ nang pa'i chos pa nang phan tshun gyi chos kyi bzang ngan brtsad nas chags sdang 'thab rtsod byas/ bstan pa 'jig par gsungs pas/de'i phyir ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus su chos pa 'jig rten pa su zhig gi mgo thog tu bzhag kyang / chos kyi phyogs ris kun zhi nas/ dag snang phyogs med du 'char ba'i sngar med pa'i legs bshad bstan 'gro la phan pa'i o rgyan sprul pa'i glegs bam 437

zhes bya ba zhig rtsoms dang bzang zhes thugs ka nas 'od zer zhig byung nas bdag gi snying khar zug pa dang dus mnyam du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang thugs ka nas 'od zer byung / thugs rje 'od zer gyi dbang bskur ba'i mthar/'od zer rnams tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las 'khor 'das kyi gzugs brnyan 'char ba'i me long chen po zhig tu gyur pa bdag la gtad nas/ me long 'di la bye dor gyis la ltos dang 'khor 'das kyi ltad mo thams cad mthong bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs nas yar je mtho je mthor song nas 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du phebs nas mi snang bar gyur pa dang /rang yang mnyam gzhag gi ngang la rang bzhin gyis gnas nas bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams 'bar ba byung / de la brten nas rtsom 'dun yod pa'i khar/ slar yang chos lugs gang la dag snang che ba'i khrims ldan mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho'i sprul sku dang /rtogs ldan 'khrul zhig nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa nam mkha' rgya mtsho/ thugs rgyud bzang zhing blo gros che ba'i a 'gron sprul sku/ dad gus che ba'i mtshams pa bsod nams rgyal/ chos mthun ri khrod pa dbal ri'i dge slong rnam gnyis sogs dad can bu slob du mas kyang bskul ngor/ gsar rnying chos la phyogs 438

ris med pa'i rnal 'byor pa gu yangs yan pa blo bde zhabs dkar pas/ dben gnas nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i bkra shis 'khyil ba nas sbyar ba'o/ /smras pa/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la/ /lus ngag yid gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs pa'i dam chos rnams/ /rang gzhan rgyud la skye bar byen gyis rlobs/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir chos dang gang zag la/ /phyogs med dad gus dag snang sbyong tshul dang / /dam pa gong ma'i rnam thar gsung bzhin du/ /nyams len byed tshul glegs bam bzang po 'di'i/ /par gyi kha 'go blo ldan mkhan pos mdzad/ /par yig bzang po skal bzang skyabs kyis bris/ /par de hor nag mtshams pas zhib tu brkos/ /par shing bkra shis 'khyil ba'i dgon par bzhugs/ /'dis mtshon dge tshogs 'brel thogs 'gro kun gyis/ /rgyal ba'i dam chos 'dzin pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /de mthus mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag sogs/ /rgyal khams thams cad chos kyis gang bar shog /gsar ma'i chos kyis bstan pa'i gzhi ma mdzad/ /rnying ma'i chos kyis bstan pa'i zur brgyan te/ /gsar rnying gnyis ga'i thugs mthun khrims gtsang sgos/ /thub bstan yun ring 'dzin pa'i bkra shis 439

shog /phan bde 'byung gnas thub bstan rin po che/ /phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa dang / /rgyal khams yongs la bkra shis lo legs shing / /bkra shis chen pos sa gsum khyab gyur cig /ces bstan 'gro yongs la phan pa'i o rgyan sprul pa'i glegs bam gyi par byang nyung 'dus 'di ni/ phyogs med rgyal khams 'grims pa'i rnal 'byor pa gu yangs yan pa blo bde zhabs dkar pas/ nyams dga' rig pa dwangs pa'i dben gnas bkra shis 'khyil ba nas sbyar ba'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa dang 'gro ba yongs la phan pa dpag tu med pa jogs par gyur cig /sarba maṅga lo/ /440

༄༅ / /chos bshad gzhan phan nyi ma bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /bar du grangs med bskal bar tshogs gnyis bsags/ /tha mar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ /chos 'khor bskor ba'i ston par mgos phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nyi ma 'od po che/ /bod yul mun pa'i gling 'dir 'dren mkhas pa'i/ /sngon byon rgyal blon paṇa grub thams cad kyi/ /sku drin yang yang dran bzhin gus pas 'dud/ /mchod 'os skyabs gnas ma lus 'dus pa'i sku / /dngos grub kun stsol rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams/ /mi 'bral spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /bdag gzhan smin cing grol bar byen gyis rlobs/ /mi lus rnyed dka' 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ /ngan song ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal legs bsams nas/ /mi dge spangs nas dge ba sgrub pa'i tshul/ /bla ma rnams kyi gsung bzhin 'dir bshad bya/ /441

'o/ de yang 'gro ba yongs kyi sngon nas ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po/ mnyam med zas gtsang sras po de nyid kyis/ dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/ mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ yul rgya gar bya rgod phung bo'i ri sogs nas/ mtshan dpes mdzes pa'i sku yi 'od kyis phyogs kun 'gengs bzhin/ yan lag drug cu'i gsung gis lha klu gnod sbyin grul bum sogs 'gro ba so so'i skad du chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa thams cad mdo hril gyis dril na/ mi lus rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ shi na sdig pa byas pa rnams ngan song gsum dang ngan 'gro'i rigs su skyes nas sdug bsngal myong zhing / dge ba byas pa rnams kyis mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi go 'phang thob nas bde zhing skyid pas/sdug bsngal mi 'dod par bde skyid 'dod pa rnams kyis/ tshe 'dir sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba chung ngu la yang 'dzem/ bde ba'i rgyu dge ba mtha' dag sgrubs zhes gsungs pa ngas de ring khyed rnams la bshad rgyu'i chos so/ /chos bshad de la chos gtam dang lung 'dren mang po byas/ a mchod kyis chos 'don 'don/ lung ba'i chu bzhur bzhur byas/ shu ru ru thogs pa med 442

par bshad na/ khong rnam pa go rigs bzang ba'i mkhas pa rnams kyis nyan na tshig rna bar snyan cing bsam na don sems la phan pas bzang yang / khyed tshos ngo mi shes pa'i khyem pa pho mo rnams kyis nyan na tshig mi go bsam na don ma shes tshe/ chos thun ring na skabs shig nyan na yang mi 'dod par yul du song na/ 'ga' res de ring bla mas chos ci gsung gi zhes dris na/chos mang po gsung gi nged tsho skye bo mi nag pa las sgrib che bas nyan pa tsam ma gtogs ci yang mi go 'dug zer/ bla ma'i gsung bzhin bsgrub na 'dod kyang sgrub tshul mi shes/ skad cha byas te bshad tshe nyan na tshig go bsam na don shes tshe/ chos thun ring yang gcig gis gcig la gtam shab shub cig kyang byed du 'jug kha rog bla ma'i gsung chos la nyon zer/ chos bshad 'grub tshe rang gi sems la 'dzin rgyu/ gzhan gyi mi la bshad rgyu gnyis ka yod pas phan thogs shin tu che bas/ des na da res ngas skye bo pho mo dad can yongs la phan pa'i phyir/'jig rten pa'i skad cha ltar byas nas chos bshad rgyas pa zhig byed rgyu yin pas/ da khyed rang rnams kyis ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du/'thob bya bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 443

go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang myur ba myur du thob par bya/de'i phyir du mtshan ldan gyi bla ma 'di'i drung nas de ring nyin dam pa'i chos la nyan par bya'o snyam pa'i gser sbyangs btso ma lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems bzang po de sngon du btang nas/nga'i chos bshad kyi 'go tshugs nas mjug ma rdzogs kyi bar du/dper na nad pa bsam shes kyis sman pa bzang po'i tshig la nyan pa bzhin du/ yid gzhan du ma g.yeng bar rna ba legs par gtod la gsan par 'tshal/ 'o skol rnams skye dka' ba gling bzhi yi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa lho 'dzam bu'i gling du skyes/thob par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob/mjal bar dka' ba'i mtshan ldan gyi bla ma dang mjal/ thos par dka' ba'i mdo sngags kyi chos thos kyang / mi dge'i sdig pa spangs nas dkar po dge ba mi sgrub pa 'di ci yis lan zer na/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ shi na mi dge ba'i dbang gis ngan song gsum dang ngan 'gro'i rigs su sdug bsngal yod tshul dang/ dge ba'i mthus mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi go 'phang thob na bde skyid che tshul ma shes pa'am/shes kyang ma bsam pas lan pa yin/ de bsam phyin mi dge ba spangs nas chos mi byed pa'i rang dbang med/ 'o na dal 'byor 444

rnyed dka' ji ltar bsams dgos zer na/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che zer ba de/ da lta'i rang re'i lus rten 'di la zer/ da res nged tsho thams cad mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad du ma skyes par ga le sos dal du bsdad yod pas dal ba zer/chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen rang gzhan gyi 'byor ba bcu tshang bas na 'byor ba zer bas/ de lta bu'i mi lus thob pa'i dus 'dir chos bsgrub na nor bu rin po che las dgos 'dod 'byung ba ltar/ 'di phyi'i bde skyid thams cad 'byung bas na mi lus rin po che zer ba yin/ 'o skol rnams kyi skye ba sngon mar tshul khrims rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung / sbyin sogs dge ba rnam par dag pas grogs byas/ smon lam dri ma med pas mtshams sbyar nas/ da lta dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che 'di nyid thob pa yin/ da phyin chad mi lus shig thob pa la rab 'du'/ khrims nyis brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gsum bsrung dgos/ de min kyang tha na mi dge bcu spong gi tshul khrims tsam zhig nges par bsrung dgos te/ mi dge ba bcu ni/ srog gcod/ ma byin len/ mi tshangs spyod/ rdzun/ phra ma/ tshig rtsub/ ngag 'khyal/brnab sems/ gnod sems/ log lta 'di rnams yin/ 'di rnams ma byas na tshul khrems yin te/ deng sang byed mkhan 445

mang / tshul khrims bsrung ba gcig pus mi chog de'i steng du dkon mchog la mchod pa/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur/dbul phongs la sbyin gtong / pha mar brtsi bkur sogs dge ba bsgrub dgos kyang / de sgrub pa ni shin tu dkon/ de'i steng du bdag phyi mar dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che thob/ mtshan ldan gyi bla mar mjal/ zab rgyas kyi chos thos/ tshul bzhin nyams su blangs te myur du sangs rgyas nas sems can thams cad la phan rgya chen po thogs par gyur cig ces pa lta bu'i smon lam dri ma med pas mtshams sbyor dgos/ da lta khyed tshos phar ltos dang / skye bo khri phrag mang po 'tshogs pa'i khrod na rgyu de gsum sgrub pa nyin par gyi skar ma ltar dkon/ blo kha tshur log la rang gis spyod tshul la ltos dang / rgyu de gsum bsgrub pa phar zhog nyin gcig tsam yang dge ba gtsang sang nge ba 'di byas zhes dran rgyu rin chen gser bas dkon/ mi dge bcu nyin re bzhin byas pa bgrang na lam srang dang gram pa'i rdo bas mang /phyi mar 'gro sa thur dang / myong rgyu sdug bsngal min pa med pas/ mi lus mi thob par thag chod/ da dung sngar bzhin mi lus shig thob nas 'ong snyam pa'i blo de/ dper na dpyid dus zhing la sa bon ma btab par ston thog bzang po zhig skyes nas 446

'ong snyam pa dang 'dra bas don go ci yang med de/ 'phags pa nyi ma'i snying bos zhus pa'i mdo las/ dper na skyes bu stobs dang ldan pa zhig gis yungs dkar gyis bkang ba'i sgom bu zhig kha sbubs te/ shin tu drag par sprugs shing ma lus pa byas pa'i shul der yungs dkar 'bru re re gnyis gnyis chags par dka' na/ mang po smos kyang ci dgos/ de bzhin du ngan 'gro dang mtho ris kyi khyad shes par bya'o zhes gsungs/ dper na gyang ngos su sran ma gtor na sa la lhung nas re gnyis tsam ma gtogs chags dka' ba ltar/ sran ma sa la lhung ba rnams ngan song gsum dang ngan 'gror skyes pa'i tshod tsam yin/ gyang ngos su re gnyis chags pa mi lus rin po che thob pa'i tshod dang mnyam zhes sngon gyi dam pa 'ga' res gsungs/ 'o na de 'dra yin na mi mang ngo snyam na/ da nged rang tshos bsam blo ma btang ba yin/ khyed tsho dbyar mi med pa'i lung stong zhig tu song dang /lung ba de'i phu mdo bar gsum na/ bya bye'u ri dwags rta nor ra lug 'bu srin sogs srog chags yod tshul la ltos dang /bod gangs can khrod kyi mi'i grangs tsam yod/ mi lus rin po che nyung ba de gcig pus shes/ grog tshang chen po gcig la ltos dang / rgya mkhar chen po zhig na yang mi de 'dra yod pa dkon/447

lung ba gcig min lung ba de nas yang phar nang gi lung bar song kyang de bas mang / lung ba de na mi rang nyid gcig pu min pa med/ srog chags dud 'gro phra mo bgrang gis mi lang de bzhin du sa steng thams cad na yod pa yin/ sa phyogs gcig min/ sa steng gi dud 'gro 'di rnams las ri rab kyi chu mtshams man chad kyi dud 'gro mang / dud 'gro de bas yi dwags kyi sems can mang / yi dwags las dmyal ba'i sems can rnams mang ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ dmyal ba ni sa chen po'i rdul tsam mo/ /yi dwags ni bye ma'i grangs tsam mo/ /dud 'gro ni chang gi sbang ma tsam mo/ /lha dang lha min ni kha ba bu yug tsam mo/ /mi ni sen mo'i steng gi rdul tsam mo gsungs/ pha dam pa'i zhal nas/ spyir sems can tsam gyi lus mthong na/ /mi lus thob pa med pa tsam/ /sgos kha 'thor ba yi lus mthong na/ /mi lus thob pa srid pa tsam/ /zhes gsungs/ de ltar mi lus rin po che rnyed dka' bar ma zad don che ste/ mi lus 'di'i steng nas dge ba bsgrub na/ mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang / nges legs thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob pas na yid bzhin gyi nor bu las lhag ste/ rje bdag nyid chen pos/ dal ba'i rten 'di yid bzhin nor las 448

lhag /'di 'dra rnyed pa da res tsam zhig yin/ /zhes gsungs/des na da lta nged rang tshos gser dngul srang gang do re rnyed nas/ phyi nas bor song na/ a kha/ kho bos gser ram dngul de 'phangs zer 'gyod pa skyes/ de btsal na rnyed pa zhig red/ mi khom pa'i gnas rnams su bskal pa brgya khrir btsal kyang rnyed dka' ba'i mi lus rin po che yid bzhin gyi nor bu las lhag pa zhig thob pa 'di don med chud zos su gtong mi rung ste/ slob springs las/ gang zhig thob nas skye ba'i rgya mtsho'i mthar phyin cing / /byang chub mchog gi dge ba'i sa bon 'debs gyur pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang yon tan ches lhag pa'i/ /mi nyid de ni su zhig 'bras bu med par byed/ /ces gsungs/ da res mi lus rin po che thob nas mi dge ba byas na/ gser snod rin po che'i phra du mas brgyan pa zhig mi gtsang ba kha lud dang bshang gci sogs kyi snod byas pa las kyang ches shin tu blun te/bshes springs las/ gang zhig gser snod rin chen spras pa yis/ /mi gtsang phyags bdar byed pa de bas ni/ /gang zhig mi ru skyes nas sdig pa'i las/ /bgyid pa de ni ches rab blun pa lags/ /zhes gsungs/da res chos dar ba'i yul du skyes nas/ chos rnam dag 449

cig ma byas na/ dper na rin po che'i gling du phyin nas lag stong mchan du bcug nas phyir log pa dang 'dra ste/ 'phags pa dpa' bos/ 'di na rmongs pa bsod nams gter/ /cung zad tsam zhig mi bsags pa/ /de dag 'jig rten pha rol du/ /mi zad mya ngan khang bar 'jug /rin chen gling phyin tshong pa ni/ /lag pa stong bar rang khyim bzhin/ /zhes gsungs/ da res dge ba ma bsags sdig pa byas na phyi mar mi lus thob pa phar zhogabade 'gro'i sgra tsam yang mi thos te/ spyod 'jug las/ dge ba dag kyang ma byas la/ /sdig pa dag kyang nyer bsags na/ /bskal ba bye ba brgyar yang ni/ /bde 'gro'i sgra yang thos mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ da res mi dang dud 'gro'i che khyad/ bu dang bu mo'i bzang ngan yang chos yod med kyi steng nas 'byed pa yin pas / tshe 'di'i kha gso tshul rgyab dro thabs tsam mi'i mi tshad dud 'gros kyang shes nas byed pa yin pas/ chos med phyin chad nas rnga ma dang rwa gnyis med pa ma gtogs dud 'gro dang khyad par spu tsam yang med/ rang res tshe 'dir mi gzhan gyi mgo skor rdzun gtam gleng 'then/ rkus byas jag la song nas rgyu nom khyer 'ong nas phyug por btang na/ de la blun po sems med 'ga' res yid smon byas bu rgod po zer bstod ra gtong 450

ba de/ 'jig rten rgad po rnams nyon mongs pas 'khrul ba'i gtam yin te/ chos kyi lug sa la bstun na de bas bu ngan zhig gzhan na med/ dper na jag rkus byas pa zhig de ring skyid kyang / sang gnangs lta bur rgya nang du khrid nas mgo gcod nges zhig la de'i rgyu mtshan shes pa'i mi zhig gis mi smon par snying re rje zer ba ltar tshe 'dir cung zad bde rung shi ma thag nas dmyal bar 'gro ba'i mi zhig la/ de'i rgyu mtshan shes pa'i chos pa zhig gis/ bu rgod zer ba phar zhog snying re rje/ las ngan po/ srog ma chad kyang ro/ dbugs dang ma bral yang bem po dang mtshungs zhes smad pa'i gnas yin te/ yang 'ga' res jag rkus g.yo sgyu khram rdzun ma byas bzhin rgyu nom bsags phyug po byas kyang de la yang bu dang bu mo bzang bo mi zer/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dper na glang rgan gyis rtswa chu 'thungs nas grod pa 'grangs pa bzhin/ tshe 'di yud tsam zhig gi bde ba yin pas don go chung / 'o na bu dang bu mo bzang po gang la zer na/ tshe 'dir mi dge ba spangs nas/ dge ba rnam par dag pa byas na tshe rabs gtan du bde zhing skyid pas/ 'jig rten khams 'di na de bas bu dang bu mo bzang po zhig dkon pas/ smon na de la smon dgos/ bu rgod po yang de la zer dgos/ dper na gru 451

yod dus chu chen po la brgal dgos pa dang / dpa' bo'i dpung tshogs 'dzoms dus dgra 'dul dgos pa dang / chu lud drod gsher 'dzoms dus sa bon 'debs dgos pa dang / cang shes kyi rta pho yod dus sa thag ring po'i lam bgrod dgos pa dang / 'dod 'jo'i ba mo yod dus 'o ma bzho dgos pa dang /gser dngul gyi gling du phyin dus ci theg len dgos pa bzhin du/ da res sngon gyi dge ba'i mthus/ mi lus rin po che thob/dbang po sgo lnga tshang / rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang mjal/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis zin/ lha chos byed dbang yod/ byed thabs shes pa'i dus 'dir/ tshe 'di'i yul mkhar gnyen bshes rgyu nom gang la'ang ma chags par byas/ tshe rabs gtan du bde zhing skyid pa'i so nam la chos shig mi byed pa'i thabs mi 'dug snyam du bsams nas/ chos byed pa la blo thag rbad chod byed dgos te/ chos byed blo yod kyang 'chi ba ma bsam na/chos sang phod bya snyam pa'i ngang la phyi bshol byas nas/ chos kyi skal ba 'chad pas 'chi ba bsam pa gal che ste/ 'chi ba ji ltar bsam dgos zer na/ sngar yul mi khyem mtshes pha spun nye 'brel/bla ma mched grogs sogs/ skye bo pho mo 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu song ba rnams la soms dang / rgan rgon 'ga' res ma 452

ṇi 'don dus 'phreng ba bgrang ba bzhin sngar mang po 'jig rten phyi mar song tshar ba de rnams kyang bsdad na ma 'dod pa min/ sdod rtsis mang du byas kyang 'dug dbang ma byung ba yin pas/ 'o skol thams cad de'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pas bdag da bar ma shi ba bzang / ma shi yang rnam g.yeng gi dbang du song nas chos shig ma byas pa 'di skyon re che snyam du blo chos la bskul dgos/ dper na gsod sar 'khrid pa'i sems can gyis gom pa spos pa ltar/ lo zla zhag dang snga dro phyi dro tsam song na'ang 'chi bdag gi drung du thag je nyer 'gro ba yin te/tshoms las/ dper na nges par gsad pa dag /gom pa gang dang gang bor bas/ /gsod pa'i drung du bsnyegs pa ltar/ /mi rnams srog kyang de bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang tshe nam mkha'i glog dang ri gzar gyi 'bab chu shing steng gi lo ma rtswa kha'i zil ba dang 'dra ste/ rgya cher rol pa las/ skyes bu'i tshe 'gro nam mkha'i glog 'dra ste/ /ri gzar 'bab chu bzhin du myur mgyogs 'gro/ /zhes dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las/ ci ltar shing gi yal ga yi/ /lo ma me tog 'bras bu rnams/ /thams cad ltung ba'i chos nyid de/ /mi rnams tshe yang de bzhin no/ /zhes dang / bu mo bdun gyi rtogs brjod las/453

'dor bar 'gyur ba'i lus srog la/ /chu dang rtswa yi zil ltar ltos/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nges par myur du 'chi yang /deng sang phal cher gyis kho bos gzhon dus dgra btul gnyen bskyangs/ rgyu nom pa bsags/ bu dang tsha bo cher song nas/ nga mi rgan la zhabs tog legs po byed tsa na chos byas na yongs/da rung chos byed ma ran snyam nas chos la phyi bshol byed pa de/dper na bud med rul ma zhig gis/ snga dro nyi ma tsha mo shar dus nas bzung ste/ chur brlon pa sogs mi skems par/ phyi dro nyi ma nub rir phyogs dus bskam na dbyar yin na rul/ dgun yin na 'khyags nas/ za rgyu'i nyams la mi phan pa ltar/ lo gzhon dus nas bzung ste chos mi bya bar/ lo lon dus kha'i so log mgo yi skra dkar/ lus kyi stobs zad/ sems kyi dpa' zhum/ yar gyi la mi chod/ mar gyi thur mi phebs/ mig gis rgyang mi rig rna bas sgra mi thos pa'i dus chos byed pa phar zhog tha na langs 'dug kyang dka' ste/ rgan rgon bla rgan lo lon tsho la ltos dang / yar la langs dus rta rgan shed ngan gyis ldang 'dug mi nus pa bzhin du/ rkang ba'i grogs lag pas byas/yun ring bar du ldang ma nus par g.yas g.yon du shed kyis 'phags/ yar langs pa'i shul du rkang pas mi rjes/ lag pas 454

khyi rjes 'dra ba gnyis phab nas/ mi zhig langs song ba dang mi 'dra bar mi khyi gnyis langs song ba zhig dang 'dra/ 'gro ba'i dus chang gis bzi ba'i mi bzhin phar 'khyor tshur 'khyor/skabs rer lus kyis yo srong mi thub par log sa la sdod dus sa rdo chad pa bzhin 'ong shas sa la stigs se brgyab nas a yo a na kha nas 'chor/ chos byed na lus kyis phyag bskor byed pa yin te/ lo lon dus phyag bskor mang po phar zhog brgya phyag tsam yang dus gcig la 'tshal dka'/ ngag gis kha ton byed dgos pa yin te/ kha ton mang po phar zhog tha na ma ṇi zhig 'don rgyu yin yang / so log lce ldib nas bton sar mi 'gro/smra mi dag sgra log bton na byes pa gzhon nu 'ga' res lad mo byas nas dgod/ sems kyis byams snying rje byang chub kyi sem tha dang lha sogs bsgom dgos pa yin te/ sgom phar zhogad lta dran pa da lta brjed nas gzhan kun gyis khyod la ci byung zer/ rgas dus chos byed dka'/ rgan rgon 'ga' res chos byed pa'i dbang du btang yang / deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bu ngan khrel med na rag mang / pha ma rgan rgon gyis nyin par gyi lto bcag mtshan mo'i gnyid bcag sgyu lus chu ser/rkang lag la ser kha 'gas rag gi bar du las ka las/ sdig 455

sdug gtam ngan gang la'ang ma 'dzem par/ rgyu nom pa btsal/gos legs po zhig rnyed na bu la bskon/ rang gis rtsag chad sogs hral hrul gon/ zas zhim po zhig yod na bu la byen/rang gis zas lhag ngan ngon zos/ dka' tshegs dka' las myangs nas yun ring bar/du bskyang bskyangs na/ bu yar cher song / rang lo lon dus/ da bus drin gzo zhig byed mod snyam yod dus/ re sa'i bus re log ge gtong ba mang / ci byas nas gtong zer na/ mna' ma bdud mo dang gnyis ka kha 'cham khog 'grig tshe rgan rgon lo lon bza' lhag tu 'gro/ zas zhim po zhig yod na gnyis gas mnyam za byas/ pha ma rgan rgon la grang la nyog pa'i bza' btung ster/ pho bar mi bde rung ltogs tshe za dgos/ dro 'jam legs pa'i gon pa zhig yod na gnyis gas gyon/ chad chod hral hrul gyi lci mo drin can pha ma rgan rgon la bskon/ mi theg kyang 'khyags tshe gon dgos/ rgan mos chu blangs ja bskol me bus mna' ma'i g.yog dkar dkar la khar nag nag byed dgos/ rgad po rta rjes la song lug 'tshos/ shing btus/ bzo byas/ yar langs/ phar brgyugs nas bu yi g.yog dkar dkar la khar nag nag byed dgos/ 'ga' res de ba tshang la g.yog po rgad po zhig yod pa de gang nas yin zhes 'dri/456

'ga' res de kho rang gi pha rgad po red g.yog po ma red zer nas dgod/ yang rgan rgon gnyis kyi su yin yang las ka ma thub par nyal bsdad na/ bu dang mna' ma bdud mo gnyis kyi ya gi tshang gi rgad po/ ma gi tshang gi rgan mo de tshos las ka re las gi zer/ zur gtam sna tshogs byed/ mna' mas kha gnyer mchu gcu ma dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur rtsog pa brgya phrag ston/ bu yis 'chi med ma/ 'phung rgan ka zer tshig ngan rdo log 'dra ba khog tu 'jog yar la 'ong dus sdang mig mar la 'bud dus rkang thos brgyab tshe rang gi drin gyis bskyangs pa'i bu yis de 'dra byas pa de/ gzhan dgra zhig gis byas pa dang mi 'dra lhag par snying nad che/ bya ba 'di'i rtsog ang snyam nas 'dang log rgyag rgyu rkyang yong / shi sa na skyid med kyang / sdug thug nas shi na tshad red zer/ bla ma skyes bu dam pa zhig byon na/ 'bri ma mo rgod ma gsum po 'dzoms yang / rgad po 'ga' res a pa lo lon red/ bla ma de ba tshang la 'pho lung zhig zhus zhes bshad na/bu yis re zhig bar du kha mi grag khyod shi ma shi gnyis ka pha la 'pho lung can po min/ shi dus 'pho ba zhig 'debs thub na tshad tshad yin/ khong tsho'i kha mi sos pas ma ṇi cha re thon la kha rog sdod dang bzang zer/ rgad po rgan mo 'ga' res/ khyem 457

mtshes g.yas g.yon yul mi tsho la bu dang mna' ma'i bya spyod bshad nas cung zad re ngus nas bu ngan gyis go mi nyan/ go na a khos khyod la sdug ci yong gi yod/ kho mi kha btang nas/nangs par nas khyod la skyid sa zhig yod na de la song / 'di nas ma 'dug zer/ rgan rgon gyi snying la mi 'bab pa'i tshig mda' 'dra ba mdung 'dra ba byung tshe/ sems sdug nas chos gzhan phar zhog tha na ma ṇi tsam yang khar mi 'ong / gzhan 'ga' res a mye ma ṇi re thon zhes bshad na/ a mye'i las ngan pa yin nam/ ma ṇi yang khar mi 'ong gi zer/ mig mtha 'a la chu 'khyil u shu sngam pa 'then/ de bu dang mna' ma gnyis kyi gcig shi song nas las la ngus pa min/ bu yi bya spyod ngan pa'i stabs yin/ khyed tshos ltos dang / deng sang rgan rgon lo lon mal sa dron po na bsdad/ bu yis dro 'jam gyi gos bskon/zhim pa'i zas byen/ mngar ba'i ja blud/ da chos kyi ma ṇi thon zer ba e yod ki cig soms dang / des na rang gi kha dbang phung bo stobs yod dus su chos byed dgos/ yang bu bzang bo skyes pha ma rgan rgon la byams yang / tshe mjug la mgo'i nyi zer 'dra bas yun thung / chos byed khom med par 'jig rten phyi mar lag stong du 'gro dgos pas/ rgas dus chos legs po zhig 458

gang gi sa nas bsam na 'ong dka'/ yang gal te chos rgas nas 'ong ba'i dbang du btang kyang / 'dzam gling tshe la nges pa med/ nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi gdon stong phrag brgyad cu sogs 'chi rkyen grangs mang rgas khom med par glo bur du 'chi nyen yod de/ tshoms las/ snga dro skye bo mang mthong ba/ /phyi dro kha cig mthong mi 'gyur/ /phyi dro skye bo mang mthong ba/ /snga dro kha cig mthong mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / skyes pa bud med mang bo dang / /dar la 'bab pa'ang 'chi 'gyur na/ /de la mi 'di gzhon zhes te/ /gson pa'i gdengs drod ci zhig yod/ /ces dang / rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtshos/ dus da nangs dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi /gros byed dus lus bde sems kyang rgod/ /dgung srod la bab dus dur khrod du/ /lus bya khyi'i za ba cang bden nam/ /zhes gsungs/ khyed tshos ltos dang / rgya khe ba zhig gi lag na ma rgan pags pa dang / lu gu'i tsha ru gnyis kyi tsha ru mang / mi rgan pa gzhon pa gnyis kyi gzhon pa 'chi ba mang / ya gi tshang gi rgad po/ ma gi tshang gi rgan mo/ pha gi tshang gi bla rgan shi zer ba thos pa nyung / ya gi tshang gi bu tsha/ ma gi tshang gi mna' ma/ pha gi tshang gi tsha bo shi song a ho da rung lo nyung yin/ 'chi ma ran zer ba thos rgyu mang / des na nam 'chi cha med pas/ chos da lo 459

sang phod gnyis kyi da lo/ zla ba snga ma phyi ma gnyis kyi snga ma/ de ring nangs par gnyis kyi de ring / snga dro phyi dro gnyis kyi snga dro byed dgos/ yongs la 'chi ba zer ba'i 'brug bzhin grags pa/'chi bdag zlog med thog dang 'dra ba de glo bur thog tu byung ba'i tshe/ gang gis kyang phan pa med de/ o rgyan rin po che'i zhal nas/ sman pa'i rgyal po dngos su byung gyur kyang / /tshe yi 'phen zad srog la 'thud mi shes/ /dbang bo che yis khrims la gtugs su med/ /smra mkhas can gyis yus shags 'debs su med/ /mi thebs yod pa glud du gtong du med/ /zas nor gro zan gcig dang 'grogs dbang med/ /mar gyi dkyil nas spu bton bzhin du 'gro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'chi nad kyis thebs nas mal sa'i nang du lhung tshe/ khyim tshang bza' ba 'ga' res mo pa sman pa bos/ mo pas kha tsho yab yab mo btab/ sman pas lag pa tsho grab grab rtsa myang / de gnyis ga'i kha la mi 'dang ni ma red/ mi thub mi 'gyu ba'i sku rim mang po bkyal tshe/ khyim tshang bza' ba 'ga' re phyogs phyogs su rgyug nas/ gcod sngags mgo mdung ba kha nag ka bla rgan mgo rdo kha ser ra mang po bos/ 'ong nas yar gyi phu bcad/ gcod sngags rnams kyis rnga brdungs/ dung bus/ bla rgan rnams kyis thal mo rdeb nas/460

chom chom 'ur 'ur byas sku rim bton na/ sku rim 'don gi yod pa zhig dang mi rig par gcod sngags bla rgan rnams kyis nad cig khyer 'ong yar gyi phu nas bsdad/ mar gyi nad pa'i steng du snon gi yod pa zhig dang 'dra bas/ ja mtshams tsho la dris na/ je thud je sdug red/ khong gi las 'di ngan gi u shu zer dus/ gcod sngags 'ga' res rnga phog bla rgan 'ga' res dril bu bsdus/ ja myur mo byas nas 'thung / zhwa rul gon/rnga rul khur/ rtsam khug bzung / da 'chi rgyu red bzang zer ni 'dra ba ltar byas/ gcig bskyur gnyis bskyur byas nas yul du brgyugs/ song shul na nad pa'i mtha' la nye 'brel rnams 'dus nas/ 'ga' re ngu / 'ga' res khyod nad 'di'i 'og nas da res mi 'chor gyi e yin nam/ kha chems 'dra bshad rgyu yod na bshad na dga' zer/ kho rang gis kyang da nges par 'chi rgyu red snyam nas sdug shi na nye 'brel 'di tsho la 'bral rgyu red snyam nas sdug bral nas phyi mar gang du 'gro snyam nas sdugamig nas mchi ma re gnyis dor/ kha chems re gnyis bzhag nas shi 'gro dus snying 'dra ba'i bu dang / chung ma/ grogs po yod kyang yid tsam 'grogs dbang med/ lo brgyar thub pa'i zas gos yod kyang shul du bzhag nas rang nyid gcig pur 461

rgyus med cha med kyi bar do'i 'phrang ring brgyud nas 'jig rten phyi mar 'gro ste/ ljon shing gi mdo las/ gcig pur myur du 'gro dgos na/ /blo gtad thub pa'i grogs yod dam/ /lo brgya thub pa'i zas yod kyang / /shi ba'i nangs par ltogs par 'gro/ /lo brgya thub pa'i gos yod kyang / /shi ba'i nangs par gcer bur 'gro/ /zhes gsungs/ de ltar 'gro dus chos med na rang skal chad pa yin/ shul na 'dug pa'i bu ngan khrel med 'ga' res/ pha ma rgan rgon bla rgan gyis rgyu nom bsags tshad kyis/ dge rtsa byed pa phar zhog spun zla cha re yod na/ rgyu nom kho la dbang kho'i yin/ gzhan la don dag med zer/ tsha bo mi 'grigs kha 'khon lag 'dzing byed/ sha nye pha spun yul mi bsam shes kyis bar nas bshad dus/ rgan rgon shi ba zhig dang mi 'dra/ gyod cig bres nas la 'og nas thag ring zhig tu bros song ba zhig dang mtshungs/ rang ma shi gong du chos shig ma byas na/ shi dus bu yis byed mod snyam pa don go ci yang med/gzhan rgan rgon phyug po 'ga' re shi dus ltos dang ha go yong /shi na gang du 'gro zer na mdo sngags nyams su len mkhan sogs dge ba stobs chen byas pa rnams/ shi ma thag nas sangs rgyas pa'am/ yang na dag pa'i zhing du 'gro/ yang na mtho ris lha 462

mi'i yul du skyes/ pha ma mi rta gsod mkhan sogs sdig pa stobs chen byas pa rnams shi ma thag nas dmyal ba'i gnas su lhung / yang na yi dwags su skye/ yang na dud 'gror skye/ gshin rje chos rgyal gyi mdun du 'gro mi dgos/ yang dge sdig 'dres ma byas pa nged tsho 'dra ba'i skor 'di ni/ gshin rje chos rgyal gyi mdun du song nas/ dge sdig gi shan phyes nas yar mar zhig la 'gro dgos/ de min gzhan gang la'ang 'gro sa med/ dge sdig gi shan ji ltar 'byed zer na/ rang re tsho 'chi dus gshin rje chos kyi rgyal pos yar la gshin rje pho nya mdog mi sdug pa zhags nag sked du drangs pa/ thu ba g.yas zed g.yon zed byas pa zhig btang ba des/ ske la zhags nag bskon nas 'then tshe/rang re 'chi nad kyis thebs pa yin/ shi tshe gshin rje pho nya des bsha' lug ltar khrid dus/ nged tsho dang mnyam du lhan cig skyes pa'i lha zer ba zhig yod pa des snod dkar po'i nang du/dkar po dge ba gang byas tshad kyi grangs ka rde'u dkar po bsags yod pa de phrag pa g.yas su bkal nas sngon nas bsus/ yang mnyam por 'ong ba'i bdud zer ba zhig yod pa des snod nag po'i nang du/ nag po mi dge ba byas tshad kyi rde'u nag po bsags yod pa phrag pa g.yon du khur nas/ phyi nas 463

ded de/ bzhi bo de sa'i 'og thur du las dbang gis lam chen 'then yod pa der zhugs nas 'gro dgos/ yang sdig pa mang po byas pa'i mi yin na/ gshin rje pho nya brgya phrag mang po 'ong nas rke dang yan lag la 'chor med kyi zhags nag mang po btags mtshon cha rdo dang dbyug pas rdungs sod chod rgyob gtubs zer/sgra mi snyan pa bsgrags nas khrid song dus/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po de gang na yod zer na/ sa 'di'i 'og dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu 'das pa'i mtshams na yod/ lcags kyi khang ba gru bzhi ba ngos rer dpag tshad bcu gnyis yod pa/ sdig can gyi snang ngo de bas shin tu rgya che ba/ nang na seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i khri'i steng na/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po sku chen po 'jigs su rung ba thod pa'i gnyer ma re re'i nang du skya mi brgya phrag re dus gcig tu gshib nas song yang yangs khrol le 'dug pas/ phyag g.yas srid gsum yongs rdzogs nang du sa ler gsal ba'i srid pa las kyi me long dang / g.yon khram shing dkar nag thogs nas/ seng ge dkar mo gangs ri'i rtse la 'byungs bzhin bzhugs pa'i mdun gyi g.yas g.yon na/ stan mthon po la gshin rje blon po a ba glang mgo can dang / stag seng dred mgo can sogs mgo brnyan mi 'dra ba mang po bsdad 464

pa'i mtha' skor phyogs mtshams su/ sdig can la chad pa gcod pa'i gshin rje'i pho nya mdog mi sdug pa mang pos mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs nas/ rgya dmag 'tshogs pa ltar shig shig 'gul 'khrigs byed pa'i sa der slebs na/ mi mang pos dge sdig gi shan 'byed kyin yod dus shig yin na cung zad 'dug dgos/de 'dra med par kun khom yod dus shig la slebs phyin/ de ma thag nas blon po mang po yod pa'i 'dabs der tsog pur bsdad na/ g.yas g.yon gye lha dang bdud gnyis kyang bsdad tshe/gshin rje chos kyi rgyal pos skye bo pho mo su yin yang spyan gnyis kyis hur re ba gcig la gzigs nas/ 'o khyod gling gi mchog gyur 'dzam bu'i gling du skyes/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i bstan pa dang mjal/ bstan 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis/ngas dge sdig gi rtsis grangs zhib mo brgyab nas dge ba byas pa yar dang / sdig pa byas pa thur du gtong gin yod ces gsungs pa los go go na chos dar ba'i yul yin pas/ chos mang po byas los yod/ yar bla ma dkon mchog la mchod pa/mar dbul bo ngan slong la sbyin gtong / bar pha ma rgan pa la brtsi bkur/ phyag dang bskor ba/ smyung gnas bsnyen gnas/ kha ton bzlas brjod/ thos bsam sgom gsum sogs/ dge ba'i 465

las ci 'dra byas/ srog gcod ma byen len mi tshangs spyod/ rdzun phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal/ brnab sems gnod sems log lta sogs/ sdig pa mi dge ba ma byas mod/ byas sam ma byas drang bor shod gsungs tshe/ yul cha med gshin rje 'jigs su rung ba'i stabs kyis/ chos byas pa rnams kyi kha nang tsho la yang re zhig gi bar du cang 'ong dka'/ sdig can smos ci dgos/ chos byas pa'i mis blo phab nas 'di skad zhu/ 'o chos rgyal chen po lags/ khyed kyi gsung bzhin bdag gis sngon bsags dge ba'i mthus gling gi mchog gyur 'dzam bu'i gling du skyes/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i bstan par mjal/ chung nas bstan dang bstan 'dzin rnams la dad/ cher song bla ma mang po bsten/ dbang lung khrid gsum mang po thob/ khyad par khyed kyi dge sdig gi rtsis grangs zhib ces gsungs pa yang go thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi gsung gang yang mi bden mi srid snyam/ dkon mchog la mchod 'bul/ dbul phongs la sbyin gtong / bla ma la zhabs tog sogs dge ba'i las la gang thub 'bad yod lags/mi dge sdig pa'i las shes bzhin byas pa med ma shes bzhin du/rkang 'og tu 'bu gcur ba sogs byas 'dra yod snyam skabs skabs bshags pa mang po byas lags zhus tshe/ g.yas kyi phyogs 466

nas lhan cig skyes pa'i lha yar bzhengs nas/ phyag gsum 'tshal te/ khyod kha rog dang ngas bshad zer ba'i lag brda byas/'dzum zhing bzhad bzhin yar la 'di skad zhu/ 'o chos rgyal chen po bdag la snyan cung zad g.yor dang / nga mi 'di dang lhan cig skyes pa'i lha yin/ mi 'di'i cha rgyus thams cad nga la gsal/ zhu rgyu mang po nga'i kha na yod/ mi 'di skyes pa'i yul 'di/ pha ma'i ming la 'di skad zer/ pha ma gnyis kyang bla ma dang chos phyogs la dad gus che/ dkon mchog la mchod 'bul/dbul phongs rnams la phan thogs e thub blta ba zhig yin/kho'i ming la 'di zer/ chung nas chos dad che/ rtsed mo zhig byed kyang chos 'chad nyan mchod 'bul sbyin gtong bsgom bzlas zhig gi lad mo byed/ cher song nas bla ma 'di 'dra bsten/ dbang lung khrid gsum 'di 'dra thob/ chos 'di 'dra byas/ kho bos sngar byas rnams la dzun med bden/ mi 'dis dge ba gang byas kyi grangs 'di yin zer rde'u dkar po mang po g.yas phyogs su spungs nas/ da mi 'di sangs rgyas kyi zhing zhig gam/ lha mi'i yul zhig tu gtong bar zhu zer tshe/ g.yon nas mnyam por 'ong ba'i bdud langs nas/ mi 'di dang lha 'di gnyis kyis sdig pa ma byas zhes zhus pa dzun yin/ sdig pa ma 467

byas na 'di ci red zer/ rde'u nag po kha shas yod pa bzhag nas/ mi 'di yi 'di ma yin pa'i sdig pa byas pa yod pas dmyal bar gtong dgos zer/ de ltar bshad res byed dus/gshin rje chos kyi rgyal pos snang srid thams cad gsal ba'i srid pa las kyi me long nang du ltos nas/ mi khyod kyis dge ba gang byas 'di red ltos zer nas/ me long ngos mar la bstan pa'i nang du bltas dus/ rang gis tshe 'dir bla ma zhig la 'bul ba zhig btegs pa'am/ ngan slong zhig la sbyin pa zhig btang ba yan chad kyi dge ba gang byas thams cad sa ler shar yod pa mthong tshe dga'/ gshin rje pho nya rnams kyis dge sdig gi rde'u mang nyung rtsis rgya ma yang lci btegs nas/ khram shing dkar po la mi'i ming 'di 'dra zer ba zhig gis dge ba 'di 'dra byas pas/ mtho ris lha'am mi yul 'di 'dra zhig tu song nas bde skyid 'di 'dra myong dgos sogs kyi yi ge bris tshe/gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal nas mi lus thob pa don ldan byas 'dug gsungs/ lam chen dkar po zhig bstan nas/khyod lam pha kir zhugs la song dang / lha'am mi yul du 'gro ba'i lam yin/ yang sngar bzhin dge ba sgrubs la shog gsungs/gang bstan gye lam der zhugs nas 'gro/ lha'am mi yul 468

gzhan du 'gro dgos na/ mi des kha phyir phyogs nas lho 'dzam bu gling du 'gro ba'i mi 'dra yod na/ de bzhin dge ba sgrubs dang phyi mar mtho ris kyi gnas su 'gro zhes shod cig zer/dga' bzhin mtho ris kyi gnas su 'gro ba'i mi de bas skyid pa zhig med/ de ltar 'gro ba zhig ci nas kyang byed dgos/ yang sdig pa mi dge ba byas phyin chad/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal pos sngar bzhin 'dri/ dris na la la dngangs nas lus po 'dar/ la las mig nas mchi ma 'byen/ la las rdzun zhu/ dzun ci ltar zhu zer na/ lags/ nga chung dus bsam ma shes pas/ chos shig dgos snyam pa yid la ma shar/ cher song nas chung ma zhig blangs/ mi dgos pas bu bu mo mang po byung / bza' ba nya nyog mang po'i kha ma sos rgyab ma khebs nas sdig pa mi byed ka med byung / 'khor ba sdug bsngal gye rgya mtshor skyes pa'i stabs kyis chos byed rgyu'i khom skal ma byung / cung zad khom yang bsam log po ngas 'dang log cig brgyab nas don gnyer ma byas/'dang log ji ltar brgyab na/ bla ma rnams kyis dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal tshe tshad sogs bshad pa yang yang go yang / ga re yar bltas gnam red mar bltas sa red/ gnam na gshin rje chos rgyal yod don med/ sprin 'dra yod mod/ yod rung su la'ang 469

gshog pa ni med/ 'gro ni mi thub/ sa 'og na 'ba' 'bu 'dra yod mod/ gshin rje chos rgyal 'dug tshul med/ yod rung lam ni med/ bye ba ltar khung bu brkos nas ga la 'gro/ bar 'di'i mig gis mthong sa rna bas go sa na gshin rje chos rgyal zer ba zhig yod rab med/ gal te yod rung rma chu 'bri chu sogs la bskor sa yod pas bskor gtong mod/ de'i sgor 'gro ci la dgos/ gal te song yang gshin rje chos rgyal gyis dge sdig gi rtsis grangs gang gang len/ rdzun 'dra bshad na los chog deng sang gi bla ma rnam pa tsho yang nom pa la ngan gi nged tsho e skrag bsams nas/ nom pa len thabs byas pa los yin/ chos byas ma byas thams cad gang zhig cig la mag mag bud 'gro bas/chos byas pa 'di red ces bshad rgyu grags rgyu gang yang mi 'dug snyam chos don gnyer ma byas lags/ da khyed kyis dge sdig gi rtsis grangs zhib mor byed pa mngon sum du mthong tshe yid mi ches pa'i rang dbang med pas/ da nga phyir cig thongs dang / yul na rgyu nom yod nga dbang che dus shig la shi 'ong ba yin pas chos ji 'dra byas kyang chog chos mang po byas nas 'ong lags/ zhes zhus tshe/ g.yon nas mnyam por 'ong ba'i bdud langs nas phyag gsum 'tshal/ 'dzum bzhin 'di skad zhu/ e 470

ma chos rgyal chen po bdag la cung zad snyan gson dang / nga mi 'di dang mnyam du 'ong ba'i mnyam por 'ong ba'i bdud yin/mi 'di'i cha rgyus thams cad nga la gsal/ zhu rgyu mang po nga'i kha na yod/ mi 'di skye ba'i yul ni 'di/ pha ma'i ming la 'di skad zer/ pha ma gnyis ka chos la mi dad sdig la dga'/gzhan zhig la gnod cig skyel e thub dang / rgyu nom zhig tshur len e thub blta ba zhig yin/ mi 'di yang pha ma ngan pa'i rigs yin pas chung ngu'i dus nas sdig pa la dga'/ rtsed mo zhig byed kyang dmag las 'khrug rtsod rku 'phrog cig gi lad mo byed/ rta rgan g.yag rgan zhig la zhon nas 'gro yang / song ma song gnyis ka sna sprugs lcag brgyab 'ob bsdigs rkyang ba byas/lam nas khyi rgan zhig mthong yang rdo rgan zhig gis mchan nas rgyag e thub blta/ ri mgor song na/ bye'u phrug blangs yar gyi brag dmar gyi rgyab nas rgod dang / bra byi bzung nas ngan gsod byas/ sha sbrang bzung nas ong sha bcad shul du me tog btsugs/ bung ba bzung khog stod smad byas bcad nas sbrang rtsi 'jib pa sogs thub tshod kyis sdig pa byas/ cher song nas sdig grogs mang po bsdus/ mi bsad rta ded rkus byas pha ma la brdung ra lug ri dwags nya sogs bsad/ ri bo la me bzhag471

mthu gtad ngan las byas/ sangs rgyas mi bden/ chos mi bden/ dge 'dun mi bden las rgyu 'bras med zer/ bla ma rnams kyis chos ci tsam bshad kyang rdo thog tu chu blugs pa dang 'dra/ khas lags so ya ya zer/ bla ma phar 'dzur 'phro la sngar ltar sdig pa byed/ bla mas chos ji 'dra zhig gsungs kyang je thu je sdug tu song nas chos nang du mi bsnyen pa'i 'dre zhig 'di'i nang na yod/ skabs shig sdig sgrib kyis bkab nas chos bshad byas pa nyan mi 'dod zhen pa log mi zhig gis gzhan gyi nor rdzas blangs tshul sogs nyon mongs 'phel ba'i gtam bshad na de la nyan/ yid smon byed/ mi 'dis sdig pa mi dge ba ma byas pa gcig kyang med/ sdig pa gang byas kyi grangs 'di yin zer nas/ rde'u nag po mang bo g.yon phyogs su spungs/ da ni chos rgyal chen po khyed kyis gsung gang yang 'byon mi dgos/ mi 'di dmyal ba ma gtogs 'gro sa med/ las kyi me long nang du blta rgyu med/ rgya ma la gzhal rgyu cang med khrid zer/ g.yas nas lhan cig skyes pa'i lha bzhengs te bzhin mdangs gnag nas/mi 'di chung ngu'i dus bsam ma shes/ cher song sdig grogs kyi dbang du song nas/ sdig pa mi byed pa'i dbang ma byung / dge ba yang byas yod zer rde'u dkar po kha shas yod pa bzhag nas/472

mi 'dis sngar zhus ltar du phyir cig thongs dang / nga yang phyi bzhin 'brang nas dge ba gang byas kyi grangs bsags nas 'ong lags zer/ de'i lan du mnyam por 'ong ba'i bdud bgad nas 'di skad zer/ ha ha sngar gshin rje chos kyi rgyal pos dge ba byas pa thur du btang / sdig pa byas pa yar la btang ba su yod/ mi khyod 'jig rten khams na yod dus mi 'di gshin rje chos rgyal gyis yar la btang ba yin zer ba gcig kyang mthong thos yod dam/ spyon pa zhig gis bshad bshad byas/ yin min mang po ma lab par kha rog sdod/ yar nyon zer dus mag se 'dug dgos/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal pos las kyi me long la bltas/ me long gi ngos mar bstan nas/ mi de la khyod kyis sdig pa byas pa 'di red ces bstan dus nang du bltas tshe/sngar srog gcod rkus jag sogs ci byas tshad kyi sa phyogs bya tshul thams cad sa ler yod pas/ dzun ma chud tshe/ da zhu ba 'dra byas na phan thogs e yod snyam nas phyag 'tshal chos rgyal chen po lags/ mi nga snying re rje/ nga rang yar cig thongs zer zhu ba mang po byed pa'i bar der/ gshin rje'i pho nya rnams kyis dge sdig gi rtsis grangs brgyab/ rgya ma la gzhal/ khram shing nag po'i ngos la mi ming 'di 'dra zer ba zhig gis mi dge ba 'di 473

'dra byas/ dmyal bar song nas lo'am bskal ba 'di tsam zhig tu bzhag nas tsha grang gi sdug bsngal 'di 'dra myong gi 'jug dgos/ de las thar nas mi yul du skyes kyang dbul bo nad can dbang bo mi tshang ba 'di 'dra zhig tu skye dgos sogs kyi yi ge bris/ de nas gshin rje chos kyi rgyal pos/ ngas khyod snying ma rje ba min/ khyod rang gis khyod rang snying ma rje ba red/ las ngan pa nga'i mi tshad sangs rgyas kyis kyang de bzlog tu med/khyod kyis mi lus thob pa don med byas 'dug gsungs nas/ da mi 'di ma 'jog par dmyal ba'i gnas su khyer lo'am bskal ba 'di 'dra'i bar du zhog gsungs tshe/ gshin rje'i pho nya rnams kyis mi de'i rke la 'chor med kyi zhags pa nag po btags nas khrid/ lus la mtshon cha rnon pos brgyab/ sod chod rgyobs gtubs zer spyi bo sa la btsugs nas lam nag por thur du 'khrid dus/ 'dzam bu'i gling du 'gro ba'i mi 'dra yod na nga bzhin khyim tshang gi lto rgyab rang gi zas gos kyi phyir du sdig pa ma byed/ byas na dmyal bar 'gro gi zhes shod/ khyad par nga'i yul du 'gro mi 'dra yod na/ bu dang tsha bo 'di 'dra yod/ kho las ngan po dmyal ba'i gnas su khrid thal/ kho la phan pa'i dge rtsa re gyis zhes shod zer/ mi de'i sdug cig gzhan na med/474

de ltar mi 'gro ba zhig ci nas kyang byed dgos/ deng sang wang am bhan zhig gi mdun du song nas tshig 'ga' zhu dka' na/yul thag ring sa cha med/ 'jigs rung gshin rje chos rgyal gyi mdun du song nas bshad shes byed pa bu kho bzang zer mkhan zhig gis kyang dka' rab yod/ sngon mo'u 'gal gyi bu dzu 'phrul gyes nam phyed cig la ma gang na yod 'tshol du mar dmyal bar song ba'i lam zhig na/ ming gcan gzan wa zer ba'i mi zhig 'dre dmag 'jigs su rung ba mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa mang pos bzung / rke la 'chor med kyi thag nag btags nas/'dre mang bos sngon nas thur du 'then nas shugs drag brdung ded la shog zer/ phyi ma rnams kyis brdungs nas shed kyis 'then myur du khrid zer/ g.yas g.yon na 'dre dmag mang bos mtshon cha rdo dang dbyug pas brgyab nas/ sod chod rgyobs gtubs zer/ mi snyan pa'i sgra skad kyis nam mkha' gang / sa rdul gyis bar snang gang / 'dre dmag gis lung ba gang nas 'gro ba mthong / khong cung zad thugs 'jigs nas/ a tsi 'di ci'i rnam smin ngan pa zhig yin nam dgongs/ 'dre dmag de rnams la/ mi 'di su yin 'di ltar sdug po byas nas ci'i phyir 'khrid ces dris pas/ nang nas gcig gis/ mi 'di ni 'dzam 475

bu'i gling gi mi ming mi snyan pa gcan gzan wa zer ba dud 'gro'i ming can de yin/ mi ngan ming ngan 'dis 'jig rten khams na yod dus/ ra lug tshon po mang po bshas nas khang chen bkang / sdig can bya khra btang nas ri bong bzung / ri skyibs la 'og brgyud de khyi ngan btang nas/ 'phyi ba sha ba la sogs ri dwags sna tshogs la gnod pa byas/ dge 'dun mthong na gshe zhing skur ba 'debs/ dbul bo rnams mthong na khro zhing bsdigs nas brdungs/ khog gi bsam pa sol ba las kyang nagakha lag sbyor ba tsher ma bzhin du rtsub/ mi dge'i las ni rnam pa sna tshogs byas/ bshad na brjod kyis mi lang / sngar zla ba lnga ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin par 'dre dmag brgya dang lnga bcu song nas/ 'dzin ma thub shor song / zla ba phyi ma 'di'i nang la 'dre dmag nyis brgya dang lnga bcus da zin/ mkhan po mi ngan 'di la 'dzam bu'i gling na bu smad nye 'khor mang bo yod kyang / da 'di ltar 'khrid dus phyi na ki lhang 'debs pa'i mi gcig gi ra mda' yang mi snang gi chos min gzhan gang gis phan pa med/dge ba byed dgos zer/ mi de'i mig nas mig chu kha sna nas khrag 'dzag bzhin mar dmyal bar khrid song / de nas yang song tshe/ sdig can gyi skye bo pho mo grangs med pas gos phud de shing 476

gi yal ga la bkal nas gcer bur gdug pa'i chu chen po la brgal ba mthong / chu'i phar kha na yig mkhan gyes so so'i ming bris nas yig mdzod la mnan tshe/ sdig can rnams kyis da ma bzang zer 'gyod cing ngus shugs ring bton nas/ sdig pa byas na dmyal bar ltung ba dang / dge ba byas na mtho ris su skye ba sngar ma shes zer/ chu de'i lho dang byang na glang dang stag mgo can gyi srin po 'jigs su rung ba gnyis kyi lag na ral gri rnon po thogs nas/ sdig can yongs la sdang mig gis bltas/ kha gdangs mche ba gtsigs skad drag pos ma gtong myur du khrid cig song zhig zer tshe/ sdig can de rnams dngangs shing skrag nas/ a ma da ci bya zer/ gnam du kha bltas te shed kyis ngu ba mthong / de nas yang song tshe/ lcang sdong chen po zhig gi gong na/skye bo pho mo bcu dal bar 'dug pa mthong / de dag la khyed rnams 'dir bde bar sos dal du 'dug pa bzang / 'dir ci la bsdad dris pas/ de rnams kyis khong tsho 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi yin/ 'jig rten na mi'i ming rus mthun pa yod pas/gshin rje'i pho nya rnams kyis nor nas khong tsho bzung nas 'ong bas/ ming dang rus ma mthun pas slar btang ba yin te/ phung bo dbyar rul/ dgun 'khyags nas/ slar yul du log sa ma 477

rnyed nas 'dir bsdad pa yin zer/ 'phags pa mo'u 'gal gyi bu khong la kun gyis tshur bltas nas ngus/ mkhan po 'jig rten na nor rdzas bsags te/ dge ba ma byas shi tshe nor zas gzhan gyis spyad/ gser g.yu sogs rin po che ci yod kyang bdag cag rnams la phan pa ci yang med kyi/ phyi nas bu smad bu sogs kyi dge rtsa btang ba bdag cag la phan gyis/ da lta zas skom yod pa de yin lags/ dge sdig gi thag da dung ma bcad/ steng du bde sdug ci yong cha med zer/ de nas yang song tshe sdig can grangs med pa dang 'phrad de/ de rnams la mo'u 'gal ma'i ming sus e thos dris pas/ nyin gcig la gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i sems can 'gro ba mchis mo'u 'gal ma su yin zer/ ming ma go lags/ mkhan po slar 'dzam bu'i gling du gshegs na/ bdag cag gi bu smad dang bu tsha bo rnams la/ bdag las ngan pa'i dbang gis dmyal bar lhung 'dug nyi ma re re la sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa myong ba bdag cag gi don du chos thon mchod sbyin thongs/ ming nas smos la bsngo smon gyis dang sdug bsngal las thar nas yar mtho ris su 'ong gi gzhan 'jig rten gyi zas nor longs spyod bshams/ glu gar rol mo sna tshogs byas kyang bdag cag gis mi 478

mthong / rna bas mi thos phan yang mi thogs zhes smros shig zer/de rnams la 'di nas gshin rje chos rgyal gyi mkhar po che yod sar thag nye ring ci yod dris pas/ shin tu ring ngo / /mkhar sgo na 'jigs rung gyad stobs can khri/ zhang blon chen po grangs med pas mda' mdung sogs mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs te sgo bsrung nas yod zer/ de nas yang song song nas mkhar sgor slebs tshe sngar bshad pa ltar snang / gshin rje lus khru bdun yod pa lag na shang lang thogs pa 'gyeng nas 'dug pa zhig la/gshin rje sgo 'di srung nas zla grangs ci song dris pas/ bdag gis sgo 'di srung nas bskal ba bzhi bcu tham pa song zer/bskal pa yun ci tsam zhig la zer dris pas/ sgo bsrung des/ sgo 'di'i rdo ba chen po chu zheng mthug srab dpag tshad bzhi bcu yod/ sdig can rnams brgal nas/ rdo de zad tsa na bskal ba gcig go smras/ sgo drung na sdig can mang bo yar langs nas 'dug sdig can grangs med pa sgo nang du yar zhugs nas 'dug nang na sdig can gyi mi 'ga' re la/gshin rje chos kyi rgyal pos skad gseng mthon pos dge sdig ci byas da shod cig byas pa'i skad sgo nas thos tshe/ phyi sgo na yod pa'i sdig can rnams kyi snying 'phar spyid pa 'dar/ sa gcig tu 479

sdod mi tshugs par da ci bya zer yar langs mar bsdad sa la bltas/ gnam la bltas nas ngus tshe/ 'phags pa mo'u 'gal gyi bus de rnams la snying rje drag po skyes spyan chab shor/ de nas phar bltas tshe gshin rje'i pho nya mdog mi sdug pa mi dmar glang gi mgo can khri tsam zhig gis lcags kyi tho ba re bzung nas yar mar phar tshur du rgyug nas/ kho rang tshos byas pa'i las yin pas/ thogs shig rdungs shig zer/ shan pas lug mang 'ded pa ltar sdig can grangs med pa lcags sgog gis rkang ba dang lus sbrel nas/ mar lam du bcug ste brdungs nas ded tshe/sdig can thams cad skrag nas rgyug 'tshengs rgyag byas lcags sgog la thogs nas phal cher log yar langs nas rgyug pas sa 'tshub chen po byung / sa rdul gseb na ngu 'bod chen po byas/phyi mig bltas/ kha yar 'khor lho rgyal 'dzam bu gling du 'gro ba'i las can gyi mi re yod na/ mi kun la chos gyis/ sdig pa ma byed mi nyan gi shod/ khong tsho'i yul mi rnams la nged tsho'i don du dmigs la dge ba re sgrubs/ ming nas smos la bsngo ba re gyis dang phan thogs par 'dug ces shod/ a ma las 'di'i ngan nam da ci byed gang du 'khrid pa yin zer/ smre sngags mang po 'don bzhin mar dmyal khams bco brgyad du 'gro ba mthong 480

tshe/ 'phags pa la snying rje tshad med skyes spyan chab mang bo shor/de nas khong gshin rje chos rgyal gyi khri drung du song nas/ rgyal po chen po/ sdig can gyi mi rnams khyed lam thug par gzhan du 'gro sa ma mchis na/ rgyal po chen po bdag gi ma de spyan sngar babs sam/ thugs su chud dam smras pas/ rgyal pos yig mkhan rnams bos te bka' stsal pa/ btsun pa 'di'i ma mo'u 'gal ma zhes bya ba'i ming yod dam/ yi ge la ltos shig gsungs pas/ bltas nas ma rnyed tshe/ rgyal pos mkhan po/rtag par dge ba dran nas tshangs par spyod cing / dkon mchog la mchod pa 'bul zhing mdo sde dang lag pa mi 'bral la/dbul phongs la byams pa de shi ma thag nas mtho ris su skye bas de 'dir mi 'ong / dge 'dun la brdeg cing gshe ba dbul bor 'phrog cing bshus pa dang / mtshams med pa lnga'i las byas pa de shi ma thag tu dmyal bar ltung / 'dir mi 'dong gsungs/slar yig mkhan rnams kyis dge sdig gi yi ge'i mdzod thams cad klog nas/ zhib tu btsal bas mo'u 'gal ma dmyal bar song nas lo gsum song zer ba'i yi ge rnyed/ de nas yang mar dmyal bar song / 'phags pa rang gi rdzu 'phrul dang / sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje'i mthus/ dmyal ba'i sems can rnams kyi 48 1

sdug bsngal bsal te/ bde ba la bkod/ ma yar blangs nas rim pas lha yul du khrid nas bde la bkod gsungs/ des na da lta rgya yis khrid nas nyi ma kha shas btson khang du bzhag tshe bzod dka' na/ 'jigs rung gshin rje'i pho nya mang bos khrid nas tsha dmyal sogs nas bskal bar sdod dgos pa ga la bzod snyam du blo ldan bsam shes rnams 'di la zhig skrag dgos/ 'o na mi dge ba'i mthus mar ngan song gsum du sgyes na sdug bsngal ci 'dra zhig yod zer na/ 'di nas dpag tshad sum khri nyis stong 'das pa'i 'og rol na/ dmyal ba yang sos yod/ de nas dpag tshad bzhi stong bzhi stong gis chod pa'i 'og na rim pa bzhin/ thig nag bsdus 'joms/ ngu 'bod/ ngu 'bod chen po/ tsha ba/ rab tu tsha ba/ mnar med rnams yod/de rnams la tsha dmyal brgyad zer/ tsha dmyal brgyad kyi thad ga'i byang phyogs na grang dmyal brgyad yod/ tsha dmyal brgyad kyi nye 'khor dang phyogs phyogs na/ nye 'khor ba'i dmyal ba/ nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba yang yod/ dmyal khams bco brgyad po der skyes na/ tsha grang gi sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yod/ bshad na brjod kyis mi lang / 'on kyang rags rim tsam zhig bshad na/tsha dmyal brgyad kyi 'og thams cad lcags sreg gi sa gzhi/ khor 482

yug thams cad lcags sreg gi ra ba/ steng thams cad nas me lce 'bar zhing 'khrug pa yin/ yang sos su skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyis/ sngon las kyi dbang gis gcig gis gcig mthong tshe khros/ dper na/ pha bsad kyi bus lag dmar mthong ba ltar phan tshun gcig gis gcig la mtshon cha sna tshogs pas rdeg res byas pa'i lus tshal ba brgya stong du song ba dang brgyal thabs su 'gyel tshe nam mkha' nas khyed rnams sos par gyur cig ces pa'i sgra byung ba dang yang sos/ de ltar mtshon bsnun pa'i sdug bsngal yun ring myong / thig nag na gshin rje'i pho nya rnams kyis der skye ba rnams kyi lus la thig nag po brgyad dgu la sogs btabs te/ lcags kyi sog le me 'bar bas klad khrag 'thor bzhin 'dra zhing sta re ste'u dang ral gris gshags tshe khrag 'bab cing / slar yang 'byar tshe sngar ltar gshags/bsdus 'joms na/ gshin rje'i pho nya mdog mi sdug pa mang pos der skyes pa rnams lcags kyi ri chen po ra lug gi gdong ba 'dra ba gnyis re'i bar bsdus nas til mar btsir ba ltar btsir tshe khrag gi chu rgyun 'bab/ gyes pa na yang sos 'ong / de nas yang btsir ba'i sdug bsngal myong / ngu 'bod na/ gshin rje rnams kyis der skyes pa rnams lcags khang me 'bar ba'i nang 483

du bcug sgo zum nas me sbar bas sreg tshe/ 'bros sa mi 'dug snyam du ngu 'bod lhang lhang byed/ ngu 'bod chen po na/lcags khang nyis rim gyi nang du bcug sgo phyi nang gnyis ka zum nas me 'bar bas bsregs tshe sgo nang ma nas thar kyang phyi ma nas mi thar snyam shed kyis ngu 'bod chen po byed/ tsha ba na lcags zangs dpag tshad mang bo yod pa dmar por song ba'i nang du yos ltar brngo zhing / mdung rnon po me 'bar bas 'phongs nas btsugs tshe spyi bor 'thon/ dbang bo'i sgo nas me lhab lhab 'bar/ sa gzhi la pags pa bshus te phur bas glang gi ko ba ltar brgyangs/ rab tu tsha ba na/ lcags zangs dpag tshad lnga brgya de bas lhag tsam gyi nang du khro chu zed zed khol gyin yod pa'i nang du 'phangs tshe sha zhig nas keng rus ltar 'gro khar blangs tshe sos/ slar nang du 'phangs nas sdug bsngal myong / gsal shing rtse gsum me 'bar ba 'phongs nas btsug tshe/yar rtse phrag pa g.yas g.yon dang spyi bor thon cing dbang bo'i sgo thams cad nas me 'bar ba dang / zangs zhun khol ma kha ru blud nas khog rnams tshig ste smad nas 'byung / mnar med na phyogs mtshams thams cad nas me 'bar bas lus mar me'i sdong bu ltar bsregs pa'i sdug skad thos pa tsam las me dang 484

sems can so sor mi mthong / sdug bsngal bsam gyes mi khyab pa myong / dmyal ba'i mi ji 'dra tsam zhig tsha zer na/ 'jig rten 'di'i me 'di las bdun 'gyur gyis bskal ba 'jig pa'i me tsha/ bskal pa 'jig pa'i me las bdun 'gyur gyis dmyal ba'i me tsha/ dmyal ba'i me la bltas na/ 'jig rten gye me 'di kha ba ltar bsil/ dmyal ba'i me stag cig sa steng 'dir lhung 'ong rgyu 'dra zhig yin na/ spra ba'i nang du me stag lhung ba ltar sa steng tshig nas nur 'gro bar gsungs/ des na rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal nas/ me bsreg rab 'bar lcags kyi khang ba'i nang / /bcad gtub btsir ba'i khrag gi chu klung 'bab/ /dbang bo'i sgo nas lhab lhab me 'bar ba'i/ /tshul 'dir mi 'jigs snying la gdon gyis brlams/ /zhes gsungs/grang dmyal brgyad kyi 'og thams cad kha ba'i thang / 'khyag rom gyi gcong rong zab mo/ mtha' thams cad gangs ri'i phreng bas bskor ba/ steng nas kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa/ phyogs phyogs nas rlung drag po ldang zhing mun pa 'thibs pas nyin mtshan ngo mi shes/ chu bur can du skyes pa'i sems can gos med gcer bur 'dug pa'i lus la kha ba bu yug rlung gis phyogs bzhi nas btab bas/ lus la chu bur byung nas 'khum/ chu bur rdol nas 485

rmar song nang nas rnag khrag 'dzag a chu zer ba ni sdug bsngal cher song bas skad gdangs drag pos a chu zer/ kye hud zer ba ni/ sdug bsngal de bas che bas skad shed kyis 'don mi nus par rkan gyi phug nas kye hud zer/ so tham pa ni/ sdug bsngal de bas che bas skad 'don ma thub par so tham tham byed/ud pal ltar gas pa ni rlung chen pos btab pas kha dog sngo zhing ser kha drug tu gas/ pad+ma ltar gas pa ni/ pags pa sngon po rnams bshus te sha rjen dmar hu re tshal ba bcur gas/pad+ma chen po ltar gas pa ni/ ser kha brgya'am/ de bas mang bar gas nas grang ba'i sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa yun ring myong / grang dmyal gye chu de ci tsam grang zer na/ dgun gyi chu 'khyag 'di las brgya stong 'gyur gyis grang / grang dmyal gye chu de'i nang du nged tsho'i mdzub gu lta bu zhig gtong rgyu yin na/de ma thag mtshams de nas chad 'gro ba red/ grang dmyal gyi chab rom tsam zhig kyang sa steng gi mtsho zhig gi nang du lhung rgyu yin na/ de ma thag mtsho de dbyar yin yang 'khyag 'gro bar gsungs/ des na rgyal dbang lnga bas/ mun nag gangs ri'i sbubs kyi 'thor rlung khrod/ /grang reg rnon po'i mtshon gyis nyam chung lus/ /brgya stong mang bar gas kyang mi 'chi ba'i/ /byed po 486
