mi dge dgra 'dis rtag tu mnar/ /zhes gsungs/ nye 'khor ba'i dmyal ba na/ me mur gyi 'obs pus mo nub pa tsam yod/ de la rkang pa bzhag na gzhob thul gye tshig 'gro zhing yar btegs na yang sos/ ro myag mi gtsang ba'i 'dam la chud pas srin 'bu lcags zangs kyi mchu khab 'dra ba mang pos/ lus phug nas rus pa la thug gi bar du za/ mtshon cha rnon po gzengs pa'i thang la rkang pa bzhag na 'big cing bteg na sos/ shing sdong can gyi rtsa ba ru bsdad na/ shing lo 'bab pa ral grir gyur nas lus po gcod sa la 'gyel tshe khye mang bo 'ong nas rgyab gzhung sogs nas za/ shal ma li'i sdong bo lcags kyi yal ga mdung ltar rno zhing lo ma spu gri ltar rno ba/ kha gyen thur du bltas nas yod pa 'bab 'dzeg byas na yal ga rnon pos lus phug lo ma rnon pos sha gcod/ skom pas chu klung gi 'gram du brgyugs na/ thal tshan gye chu bo rab med kyi nang du lhung ste sha rus 'tshig par 'gyur ba sogs sdug bsngal che/ nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba ni/ sgo dang ka ba thab dang thag pa skam pa gtun dang phyags ma sogs kyi dbyibs lta bu'i lus blangs te/sdug bsngal ma nges pa sna tshogs myong / dmyal khams bco brgyad po de'i tshe tshad ci tsam zhig zer na/ tsha dmyal brgyad kyi 487

nang nas tshe thung shos yang sos kyi tshe tshad ni/ mi lo khrag khrig gcig ther 'bum chen po drug dang ther 'bum gnyis yin/gzhan rnams kyi tshe tshad ni de bas ches shin tu ring ba yin/grang dmyal brgyad kyi nang nas tshe thung chu bur can gyi tshe tshad ni/yul ma ga rnya'i bre bo che'i khal brgyad cu 'gro ba'i til gyi bang ba nas lo brgya brgya re song ba'i 'phror til re phyung bas/ til khal yongs rdzogs zad pa'i yun de tsam zhig yin gsungs/gzhan rnams kyi tshe tshad ni de bas lhag gis ring ba yin/ nye 'khor ba dang nyi tshe ba gnyis kyi tshe la nges pa med/ rnam smin gang yod zad rag gi bar du 'chi rgyu med gsungs/ 'o na de e bden/ khyed gnas der phebs pa lta bu zhig gsung rgyu yod pa 'di 'dra gang na yod zer na/ nga ma song kyang gshin rje chos rgyal gyi grong khyer yod tshul de 'khrid tshul rnams/ thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i gsung ma ṇi bka' 'bum na 'dug dge sdig gi shan phyes nas yar mar la gtong tshul nyag phrug dang / gling bza' 'das log gnyis kyi rnam thar na bshad yod/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal tshe tshad rnams lam rim sogs na gsungs yod pas 'di bden/ nged rang tsho'i phyogs gzhan gyi skad cha zhig bshad rgyu yin na de'i nang 488

nges ni brgya mi nges ni stong yod kyang / phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyis thams cad mkhyen pas na de la rdzun med/ yang 'o na chos kyi nang na/ dmyal ba'i chags tshul sdug bsngal yod tshul gsungs pa mi 'dra ba mang bo snang ba de ci yin snyam na/ dper na nged tsho'i nag can mang bo zhig phyogs phyogs nas bzung rgya nang du khrid nas gsod rgyu yin na/ de bzung nas 'khrid tshul gsod sa/ gsod mkhan/ gsod tshul sogs mi 'dra ba dang mtshungs/ 'o na tshe tshad mi 'dra ba mang bo gsungs 'dug pa de ci yin nam snyam na/ dper na nyes pa'i che chung gis btson ma la la sdug bsngal yun ring myong du 'jug pa dang / la la yun thung ba sogs ma nges pa dang 'dra'o/ /des na rgya khrims kyi 'dra mi 'dras ci bya/ rgya khrims 'og tu mi 'gro ba byed pa gal che ba ltar/ dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal tshe tshad 'dra mi 'dras ci bya/ de ru mi 'gro ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos/ yi dwags ni 'dzam gling 'di'i 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya 'das pa'i 'og rol na yod/ de ru skye ba'i yi dwags rnams kyi kha khab mig ltar chung / lto ba ri rab ltar che/ rkang lag 'jag skya ltar phra/ skra gzengs mig dong du lhung / rgyu ma stong ba sgal tshigs la 'byar/ zas skom ma myong bas kha dang lus skam/ tsha grang gis gdung bas mdog sngo la nag489

zas skom mi rnyed 'chi rgyu med/ cung zad rnyed pa zos na khog tu song tshe mer gyur nas lus 'tshig sos dus zla ba tsha/dgun dus nyi ma grang / tsha grang bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa myong / de las kha 'thor ba rgya mtsho'i 'gram dang 'jig rten khams 'di na yod pa rnams kyis kyang /bkres skom brdeg rdung sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong / tshe tshad ni mi lo chig khri lnga stong gi bar thub/ dud 'gro ni/ ri rab kyi chu mtshams man chad kyi khong gseng rgya mtsho'i nang na/ che chung mdog dbyebs mi 'dra ba chang gi sbang ma ltar yod/ mun pa 'thibs pas lag pa'i brkyangs bskums mi mthong / gcig gis gcig mnan nas dbugs kyi dbyung jub tsam yang dka'/che bas chung ba thams cad kham shad byas za/ chung ba rnams che ba'i steng du rub nas za/ de nas kha 'thor ba'i dud 'gro mi'i gnas na yod pa 'di rnams la mi theg pa'i khal bkal/ dbyug pas brdung / rgyab tu sgal rma btod/ 'phongs bshus rgas 'khogs kyang nyin gcig sdod du mi 'jug 'chi rag bar du sdug bsngal pyong / ra lug shan pas sa la bsgyel kha btsum khog tu lag pa btang / srog rtsa bcad/ yang na mgo bcad nas bsad/ ri dwags rnams khye dang gcan gzan gyis ded nas 490

bsad/ rngon pas me mda' brgyab nas gsod pa sogs/gsod za bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal yod pa da lta mig gis mthong ba 'di rnams yin/ tshe tshad ring bas bskal ba thung bas nyin zhag las mi thub pa yod pas mtha' gcig tu ma nges/nged tsho 'dir mi dge ba chen po byas pa'i mi shi ma thag nas ri gzar gyi rtse nas rbab 'dril ba ri'i rtsa bar bgro ba bzhin/dmyal khams bco brgyad du skyes nas dmyal ba'i gting rdo byed pa yin/ 'bring tsam byas pa yi dwags su skye/ chung du byas pa dud 'gror skye/ de gsum gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gang gi gang che ma gtogs bde skyid spu tsam yang med/ ngan song gsum las thar nas mi ru skyes kyang / da dung mi dge ba'i mthus/ngan 'gro'i rigs zha bo 'on pa lkugs pa/ bran g.yog sprang slong khas dman tshe thung nad mang can du skyes nas sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur/ khyed tshos brang khar lag pa zhog rang lus la dpe longs blo kha nang du log la bsam blo zhig thongs dang /deng sang lus la me btsa' bzhag pa dang / sha rjen steng du me stag lhung ba/ dgun gcer bur gos med par zhag gcigazas skom med par nyin zhag gnyis/ khyis so btab pa tsam zhig mi bzod na/ tshe phyi mar dmyal ba'i tsha grang / yi dwags kyi 491

bkres skom/ dud 'gros gcig la gcig za ba'i sdug bsngal lo bskal bar myong dgos pa ji ltar bzod/ dper na nag can gyi mi mang bo yod pa'i nang nas 'ga' res sngon du rgya mis bzung nas/ sdug 'di 'dra btang ste ngan gsod byas tshul bshad na/ nag can da dung ma bzung ba rnams kyis bzung 'dra e 'jog sdug bsngal de 'dra mi bzod snyam 'jigs skrag skyes pa ltar/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal de rnams bsams nas/sngar mi dge ba byas pa rnams 'jigs skrag cig skye dgos/dper na rgya nang du khrid nas sdug bsngal dang mya ngan mi 'dod na/ jag rkus sogs gong ma'i khrems dang 'gal ba'i las mi byed dgos pa ltar/ tshe phyi mar tsha dmyal la sogs su song nas sdug bsngal myang na mi 'dod pa rnams kyis/ de'i rgyu mi dge ba dug ltar spong dgos te/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ thob dka' 'dzam gling mi yi lus/ /de thob dus su ngan song rgyu/ /rab tu bsgrims te bcad par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ da nges par gang la bltas kyang bsam na ngan song gi rgyu mi dge ba 'di spong dgos snyam na/ spong rgyu'i mi dge ba de shes dgos/ shes pa la bla ma'i bka' chos la nyan dgos pa yin kyang / deng sang tshe phyi ma'i sdug bsngal de ma dran pa'i stabs kyis/ sdig pa spong ba phar zhog492

bla ma zhig gis sdig spong dge sgrub kyi chos zab mo zhig gsungs na yang / chos thun ring na/ de'i bar la yang mi chags par/ 'gul 'phag nyi ma la bltas/ yul la bltas/u hu zer lu/ ung zer 'khun/ kho bo la yul na las don gal chen 'di 'dra zhig yod zer/ shab shub byas thag nye'i mi 'ga' re la bshad/ skabs shig yar langs phyag gcig 'tshal/ yang na phyag kyang mi 'tshal bar langs 'gro/ yul du thon tshe/ khyim tshang bza' ba rnams la khyed cha bos ngas bshad pa de ma byas/'di ma bsgrub par nyal bsdad nas zer/ spo langs nas bza' sdigs kyi thug pa bskol ba mang / yang bla mas khyim pa pho mo glen pa 'ga' res mi go bar dogs nas/ rgyal ba'i gsung rdo rje'i tshig la chos gtam gyi shun pa ma bskon par/ kun gyis go sla ba'i phyir dmar 'byin byas bshad pa khyed 'jig rten pa'i ngo tsha'i gtam lta bu re gnyis re byung tshe/ gcig gis gcig la gru mos brgyab sen tog byas/ zur gtam byas 'dzum nas bgad/ mgo sgur gnya' gtung skyabs su mchi khong chos pa red zer/ chos bzang por nyan pa'i 'phro bcad nas yar langs 'gro ba yang mang / de 'jig rten rgan rgon rnams kyis ngo tsha ba dang mi tsha ba'i gnas ma shes pa'i rang mtshang yin te/493

rje btsun mi las/ ngo tsha ba'i gnas la ngo mi tsha/ /ngo mi tsha ba la ngo tshar byed/ /gsungs pa ltar/ tshe 'dir zas gos sogs kyis phongs nas lha mi yongs kyis khrel cing / phyi mar gos med gcer bur dmyal bar 'gro ba'i rgyu/ ma phyin len mi tshangs spyod rdzun phra ma g.yo sgyu sogs ma rabs spyod ngan rnams ngo tsha ba'i gnas yin pa la ngo mi tsha bar ma zad nyin re bzhin spyod cing /tshe 'dir zas gos sogs 'byor ba rgyas nas lha mi yongs kyis smon gnas su gyur cing / phyi mar dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can lha 'am mi yi go 'phang thob pa'i rgyu/ sbyin gtong tshangs spyod la gnas pa bden par smra ba sogs ya rabs kyi bya ba ngo tsha mi dgos pa'i gnas yin pa la/ spyod pa phar zhog spyod tshul gyi rgyal ba'i gsung / bla mas go sla skad cha byas bshad pa la yang ngo tsha nas mi nyan par 'bros pa/ ngo tsha'i byed lugs gang yin ma shes pas lan pa yin pas/ spyir ngo tsha ba'i gnas gang yin shes pa gal che/ shes na ngo mi tsha ba la ngo tsha byed don med/khyad par bla mas lhag bsam dag pas chos bshad byed pa'i skabs su tshig re ngo tsha bar bzung nas/ chos mi nyan par langs 'gro ba'i skye bo pho mo des chos ma shes par ma zad/'jig rten kyang ma shes pa yin pas glen pa nor dang mtshungs 494

te/ rgad po bsam shes tshos ngan pa sngon la ma bshad na/bzang po rjes nas mi yong zer ba'i ha yang ma go ba yin pas/mi la rtog dpyod med na dud 'gro yin/ /rta la gom 'gros med na bong bu yin/ /mi zer ram/ rtog dpyod thongs/ dper na chu bo chen po rma chu lta bu'i pha rol du sgol dus/ chu pa rnams kyis gon pa kun phud nas 'gro dus/ pha ma sring gsum 'tshogs pas mthong kyang skabs der ngo mi tsha bar lhan du 'gro ba dang / bud med 'ga' res 'doms su rma'am nad byung na/de la phan phyir sman pa 'ong nas sman dpyad gtar bsreg sogs byed dus ngo mi tsha bar sman pa'i ngag bzhin byed pa ltar/tshe 'di phyi gnyis la sdug bsngal med par bde ba'i thabs rgyal ba'i gsung kun gyis go sla ba sogs dgos pa'i dbang gis/ bla mas skad cha byas nas bshad dus ngo tsha'i gtam tshig re tsam byung yang / skabs der kun ngo mi tsha bar gnas dgos/dper na chu la rkyal mkhan rnams chu chen po de'i pha rol du son pa dang / bud med la sman dpyad byas tshar nas gon pa gon nas dus rtag tu lus sbed dgos pa ltar/ bla mas chos gsung tsam nas phyin chad kun gyis bla ma'i gsung ltar ma rabs spyod ngan gyi rigs mtha' dag la 'dzem nas ngo tsha 'jigs bcas 495

kyi sgo nas bsrung dgos/ 'o na mar ngan song gnas su lhung ba'i rgyu mi dge ba de gang yin khyed kyis nged tsho la cig shod dang zer na/ mi dge zer ba de srog gcod pa/ ma byen par len pa/ mi tshangs par spyod pa/ rdzun phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal/ brnab sems gnod sems log lta 'di rnams yin pas spong dgos/ nged khyim pa pho mo rnams shes rgya chung bas na de rnams so sor rgyas par ma bshad na mi shes par 'dug pas/da khyed kyis nged 'jig rten pa'i skad cha byas rgyas pa zhig gsungs dang / phugs su tshe 'di phyir bde zhing skyid na 'phral du ngo tsha ba'i gtam re byung yang bzod zer na/ 'o srog gcod zer ba de che ba mi nas chung ba 'bu srin yan chad gsod mi nyan pa yin te/ deng sang snyigs ma'i dus kyi skya ser pho mo rnams dug gsum rag lhag par 'dod sred che kha sha la dga' ba'i shugs kyis/ sde dgon grong yul gang na phyi ma mar 'gro ba'i las ngan pa mang bo gsog gin yod/ de ci ltar gsog zer na/ 'brog gi phyug po rnams kyis ra lug rgya la btsongs pas sdig pa de las thu ba med/ nga sngon sog phyogs na yod dus yon bdag dad can zhig yod pa des/ nas shig nyo snyam nas lug bcu tsam bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi thag nye'i shan pa yod 496

sar ded nas btsongs/ rin gyi nas bre la tshad dus/ lug bcu bo kho bo'i thag nye'i srang bar nas thag pas bstar shan pas gri bzung nas 'ong tshe/ lug kun gyis kho bo la bltas nged rnams shan pa 'di la gsod du ma 'jug zer ba ltar mig mthar chu 'khyil 'then bskor byas/ 'ga' res 'ba'/ shan pas lug gong ma'i mgo bcad tshe/ phyi ma des khyed tshang gi kha'i don du kho bo'i srog 'gro shin yod zer ba ltar/ kho bo la bltas tshe yang shan pas lug de'i mgo bcad/ de nas rim pa bzhin bcad tshe/mjug na lug gcig yod pa de kho bo la chung nas 'dris che ba zhig yin pas/ des kho gcig pu shan pa 'di la gsod du ma 'jug khyod la gsal nga snying re rje zer ba ltar byas/ kho bo la bltas nas tshur 'then nas 'ba'/ mig nas mchi ma re gnyis 'don dus/ yang shan pas mgo bcad tshe kho bo'i bya ba 'di'i rtsog ang / bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen snyam/ mig nas mchi ma mang bo btang / phyin chad mu ges mgo thur du bstan nas shi 'gro yang lug gcig rgya la btsongs ri shi snyam zhe mna' bskyal/de phyin chad ma btsong zer/ lug bcu bo de'i mgo gcod dus char zam zim zhig babs pas/ char dang khrag gnyis 'dres tshe/srang bar na khrag gi chu rgyun 'gro ba/ de mthong nas 'brog 497

gi phyug po 'ga' zhig gis lo re bzhin du ra lug brgya stong btsongs pa/ de gsod tsa na sha yi ri/ khrag gi mtsho 'khyil yod sa snang / chos 'dra ma byas na phyi mar gang du 'gro snyam pa yid la shar zer/ des na khyed tshos bsam blo re thongs dang / khyed rnams kyi gcig sha nye pha spun gyis bzung nas rgya zhig la sprad de bsad na ji 'dra red/ rgya nang du khrid nas bsad pa de las thu ba med/ des na ra lug g.yag gsum rang gis bsad pa dang /de'i rin blangs nas gzhan la gsod du bcug pa gnyis la khyad par spu tsam med/ rang gi lus la dpe mi len par bla rgan 'phung rgan kha ser 'ga' res rgya khe ba la lug sprod dus/ mi skya g.yog por khrid nas lug gi nang du song / sha bzan rke nag rna ser ya ki zungs/ ma rgan 'ong ser mgo ril ma ki zungs/thongs tsher ka zhis mchu nag pha ki zungs/ ya ya lug mi 'dug gi shor thal rem ma zungs zungs zer ba mang / sdom pa shor ba la mi phangs/ lug shor ba la phangs/ ngo tsha rgyu med par sdom ldan ltar byas nas chab tsho blangs/ chos bshad byed dus nged tsho la dgod rgyu yong / des na rgya la lug gtan nas ma btsongs par 'tsho skyong byos dang / bal gcig pu btsongs na kha sos yong /sngon mtsho sngon po'i phyogs kyi rgad po zhig gis lug gcig 498

kyang rgya la mi btsongs par 'tsho skyong byas bsdad tshe/ 'ga' res rgad po khyod kyis lug bzhag nas ci bya btsongs nas kha rgyab legs po byas te/ chos byas na bzang bzhag na don med du shi 'gro zhes bshad tshe/ rgad pos kho bos chos mi shes kyang rang lus la dpe blangs na/ chos ni ra lug tshe thar byas na/ de bas chos shig gzhan na med snyam/ lo re bzhin bal blangs nas btsongs na lto rgyab 'dang 'dug lo bcu stod tsam la lug gi rin las lhag pa 'ong / bzhag na shi los 'gro de yi mi tshad rang nyid kyang 'chi rgyu red/ de la bya thabs med/ lug shi song yang sha dang pags pa yod zer nas/ gcig kyang ma btsongs par legs par 'tsho skyong byas pas khri lug 'phel/ rgad po lo brgya thub pa byung zer/ des na ra lug ma btsongs par 'tsho skyong gyes dang bzang / yang re'u lu gu chung dus bsad nas tshar bu btsongs pa 'di ngan/ tshong pa heb rgan 'ga' res/ da lo tshar bu gong bzang gi zer g.yog po la lu gu gsod du 'jug gam/yang na rang gis gsod tshe/ lu gu chung chung yag pa rnams kyis tshur ngo la mig khra trig ge blta dus snying mi rje bar tshar bu btsongs sa thag ring na rta rgan nam/ yang na g.yag rgan zhig la zhon tshar bu rnams sha dag byas nas 'gro/ thag nye na mchan 499

khung ngam/ yang na lag tu bzung nas/ khog pa 'dod sred kyis gang / 'dis ci khug snyam nas 'dang rgyag gin 'gro/ tshar bu nom pa la brjes nas slar yul du 'ong tshe/ dgung mo ma mo rnams 'ong dus/ lu gu btang na lu gu bsad pa rnams kyi ma rgan tsher mos kyang / mo yi lu gu 'ong gin yod snyam nas mig gis lu gu 'ong tshad la bltas dus ci yang ma mthong tshe nga'i lu gu la ci zhig byung snyam/ sems sngangs nas lu gu 'dogs sar rgyug de na med tshe sba gur gang yin yang g.yas na e yod snyam nas g.yas su rgyug g.yon na e yod snyam nas g.yon du rgyugade na med tshe yar mar yongs la bltas shed kyis 'ba'/ de dus nged tsho yin na bu'i las la sems sdug nas ngus pa red/snying rje rgyu de na yod mod/ sems yod kyi mig nas mchi ma 'chor/ sems med 'ga' res bu bsad pa'i steng du da dung ma mo la yang bsha' rgyu ma ka zer/ rdo dang dbyug pa sogs kyis rgyag phyir nyin ri khar 'gro dus ma mo de lug rnams kyi mjug tu 'dug kha phyir phyogs nas 'ba'/ ri mgo la song na rtswa kham re zos/ yang bu dran nas re re 'ba'/ dgung mo lus rnams ded 'ong dus kun gyi sngon la bud nas 'ba' gin 'ong /de ltar bu la mi gces ni gcig med/ lhag par du yang dud 500

'gros gces/ nga ri bo rma chen na yod dus/ bra bo gcig gis phrug gu khrid nas 'gro dus/ khra zhig yod pa de mthong tshe bu khras 'khyer gyis dogs nas bros pas bu de 'gro ma nus tshe/ kha nang du bzung nas khung nang zhig tu bros song dus nga'i bsam pa la ma 'di snying re rje/ bu la snying thag pa nas ga 'dra zhig byams rgyu red snyam pa byung / des na mi dbang chen btsan po zhig gis shed shugs kyis khyed tsho'i bu'am bu mo zhig bsad pags pa bshus nas khyer na ci ltar yin/ khyed tsho ji 'dra zhig sdug bsam blo thongs dang / des na rang la dpe longs la ma rgan dang tsher mo'i lu gu 'di gcig ma gsod dang / tshe 'dir lug je nyung du mi 'gro je mang du 'gro/ phyi mar yang dmyal bar mi lhung mtho ris su skye/ yang khyed tsho'i phyug po mdzo mo lnga bcu yod pa rnams kyis kyang rtol bu gcig kyang mi 'jog par/ dus gnyan dang khyad par zla ba bzhi ba'i bco lnga/ gnam stong tshes brgyad yin yang mi 'dzem par sdig pa je 'phel du 'gro ba la lhag par 'di bzang zer ba ltar byas/ nyin rer mdzo mo bcu lhag tsam la rtol bu skyes kyang / snying re rje tshe phyi mar gang du 'gro ma bzang zer ba'i mi gcig med/ mdzo mo la rtol bu skyes zer thams cad la 'dzum pa langs dga' ste/ khyem mtshes nag 501

gyong nga / g.yog po gnya' thung nga / byis pa sngo mchu tsho 'ongs nas bsad/ rgad po kha ser ra/ mi gzhon ro ring nga tshos bshas nas/ ya ki tshang la ga byin/ ma ki tshang la 'di byen/ a mchod la khrag grod pu gang po ga byin dang zer/ lo re bzhin du de ltar bsad na/ mdzo mo lnga bcu can zhig gis/ lo bcu la lnga brgya lo nyi shu la rtol bu stong phrag cig bsad pa red/ phyi mar 'gro sa'i khung zhig bltas na e yod cig soms dang / phyug po tshos sdig pa ma bcad phyin chad/ chos leb re blangs/ a mchod re bzhag mchod sbyin cung zad re btang bas sdig pa'i mgo tsam yang mi non/ las can de tshang gi a mchod bzhag mchod sbyin btang zhes smon rgyu spu tsam yang med/ khyed tshos ltos dang /mdzo mos bu mthong tshe dga' nas bu'i steng du lce ldag byas/da 'di langs nas mo yi phyi la 'gro dus de nam zhig yin nam snyam/ rtol bus kyang ma la bltas 'o ma mngar mo de nam zhig 'thung thub snyam/ langs 'gyel byed dus/ g.yog po kha ro tsho song nas/ ma bu gnyis ka kha bral nas khyer 'ong na/ ma ngur nas bu'i rjes la 'ong / bus ma la bltas pa'i tshe snying rje rgyu de na yod mod/ gsod dus mig tsho kha hrig ge blta dus/ sems yod kyis lag mi 'gro/ zur nas mi chags/ phyir sgo la 'bud 502

dgos/ sems med tshos bsad bshas nas/ khyod kyi bu bsad pas brun pa 'di red da zo zer ba ltar byas rtol bu'i pags pa mdzo mo'i sngon du 'phangs/ mdzo mos gtam zhig smra ma thub pa ma gtogs/ sems na shul 'chad rgyu tshang rjes bzlog rgyu tshang /bu bzhag nas 'o ma'i phyed bzhos na ched/ bsad nas sha zos pas mi chog da dung de'i steng du mo'i 'o mas gso dgos pa 'di lag dmar la lag snum byen pa red snyam/ khong khro langs mig rtsa dmar bor song / gsod mkhan gyi mi la brdung snying 'dod/ yang brdung na mo yang gsod snyam rdung mi phod/ bya thabs gzhan ma rnyed/ bu la phangs nas 'dug ma thub/ don med kyi khyi rgan bskor ded byed/ ri mgo la song na bu de dran nas rur rgyangs byas yul du 'ong / des na khyed tsho'i bud med cig gis bu btsas ma thag tu gzhan btsan po zhig gis ma'i lag nas 'phrog ste bsad nas sha zos/ bu'i pags pa ma'i sngon du 'jog rgyu yin na ji 'dra zhig red/ bsam blo thongs dang /phyi mar rang gi thog tu de'i thu zhig 'ong nges de dus ci zhig bya/g.yang sde bsod nams can mtsho sngon po'i phyogs kyi sog po tshos rtol bu mi gsod pas khyed tshos kyang de ltar gyis mdzo mo'i rtol bu 'di cig ma gsod par zhog dang bzang / bzhag na 503

mdzo 'bri g.yag bzhin du/ bzhos na de chog khal bkal chogagal te ma sos shi song yang rgya che 'thug pa'i ko ba blangs nas/lham btab sgro ba bzos na chog sha yang zos chog khe ma gtogs/ pham kha med/ dpyid dus shi 'gro ba de/ chung dus ma'i 'o ma khog tu ma song gso ma shes bdag ma byas pas lan pa yin/ gso shes na mdzo 'bri g.yag las bzang ba ngas kyang mthong / khyed rnams la yang go mthong los yod/ tshe 'dir phyug po 'dod na yang bzhag na bzang / 'di sngon srid pa rgad po zer ba zhig gis gsod dgos zhes bshad pa de dzun kho na yin/sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab mdo rgyud gang na mdzo mo'i rtol bu 'di btsas ma thag nas gsod dgos/ 'jog mi rung zhes gsungs pa yod ma myong / phyin chad khyed rnams kyis mdzo mo'i bu 'di ma gsod/ yang khyed tshos bu mo phar la rdzong dus mna' ma tshur la len dus/ gces srog la bab pa ltar byas/ ra lug g.yag gsum po bsgyel nas bsha' gang thub byas/ gzhan tsho la sha khog re khyer shog dang ston mo byed rgyu yin zer nas/ sha khog bcu 'am bco lnga/ lnga bcu 'am/ brgya lhag tsam mi mang tshogs pa'i gral du dmar phung nge bzhag chang skyur mang bo 'thung ste/sdig pa'i sa bon btab nas phyi mar dmyal bar 'gro ba la 504

bshad rgyu med rung / 'ga' res bshad pa zhig rgyag zer/ chang phor ba gang lag tu bzung ste/ kha dar zhig phrag tu 'phangs tshe/gzhan thams cad kyis da bshad pa bshad rgyu red zer mtha' la 'dus tshe/ 'o de rang tsho nyi ma bzang bo skar ma bzang bo zer nas bshad tshe/ 'ga' res skabs skabs de yin zer/chos shes pa tshos nyan na de ring da bzang sa yod/ khyed tsho'i bya ba de yin snyam/ yang 'ga' re yar langs nas lus po 'khyog 'gram pa lag pas skyor/ e yi zer nas kha tshos 'gya 'gyu mang bo byas glu len dus/ gzhan gyis bltas na dgod rgyu 'ong / tshe phyi mar ngu bzhin dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong dgos pa'i rgyu sgrub pa ma bzang snyam nas ma ṇi re mi 'don rung / de'i steng du glu zhig len e dgos bsam blo thongs/ yang 'ga' res ku re byas bar bar thams cad ha bgad byed/ de la dgod rgyu ci yod/ tshe phyi ma'i sdug bsngal de bsam na ngu rgyu zhig mi 'ong rung /dgod rgyu zhig e 'ong gi khyed tshos cig soms dang / sha de kun sa nas yar skyes gnam nas thur du babs bar nas mis bcos pa min/ de thams cad kyi kha zum brang gshags khog tu lag pa btang srog rtsa dmar po bcad nas khyer 'ong ba sha stag yin/ khyed tsho'i lus kyi rkang lag thag pas bsdams kha zum srog 505

rtsa bcad/ sha khrag gis ston mo byed pa phar zhog mdzub mo zhig bcad nas ston mo byed e thub soms/ des na rang lus la dpe longs la khyed thams cad kyis ston mo byed dus sngon nas sdig med kyi sha tshol/ de la gzas nas srog gcod kyi las 'di ma byed sha mang bo dgos don med/ mang po zos na grang dro ma snyoms par dros 'khyag byas/ pho bar bsdad nas 'chi rgyu yin mod/ yang na dmar ngan sna gsum gdon/ sha dug gis shi zer ba mang / sha la bzang ci yang med/ ja chang zho thud go re gro ma sogs sdig med kyi zas zhim po mang bos ston mo byas/ bshad pa brgyab glu blangs gar byas na 'jig rten skyid kyi mchog chos dang yang mthun pas/ phyin chad ston mo'i dus su srog gcod 'di gtan nas ma byed/ yang khyed tshos bla ma 'ga' re phebs tshe/ ja zhus byed rgyu yin zer ra lug dkyus nas zungs zhes bshad dus/ 'ga' re nang du rgyug ra'am lug de'i rkang ba nas bzung tshe sa la 'gyel 'phag shad byed tshur khrid 'ong dus shed kyis 'ba'/ sgo 'am khyim gang rung nas mgo thur du bstan nas bsgyel/ sug bzhi thag nag gis bsdams tshe/ 'khun bu bgrang /ske gug kha sna zum dus ra lug gang yin des rnga ma ril li li g.yug gsod mkhan gyis ma ṇi shub shub shub 'don/ skabs 506

shig ril ma tsho thar thar byas phyi dbugs chad dus/ mi nag 'ga' res gri chung brdar nas shi 'am ma shi zer/ gri rnon pos brang gshags lag pa g.yas pa khog tu btang / srog rtsa dmar por brnyab nas 'then dus sngar bas lhag pa'i sdug bsngal che/nang dbugs chad nas 'chi bar 'gyur bas/ des na yon bdag pho mo drin can khyed tsho'i chos 'di su yi lugs yin 'di 'dra byed dgos su yis gsungs/ phan yon ci yod cig shod dang / bla ma 'di yis gsungs pa yin zhes bshad rgyu med snyam/khyed tshos rang gi kha sna sum la cung zad cig sdod dang / nged rang tshos sdod mi thub pa'i dus btang ba yin/ gtong rgyu min na sdug bsngal de bzod dka' bas/ des na rang lus la dpe longs la bsam blo zhig thongs dang / bla ma ja zhus byas pa de chos su song ma song khyed tshos ltos dang / bla ma de la sha drangs na chen po mi bzhes/ grwa pa dang nang zan tshos za bas/ bla ma la sha drangs pa de don gyes grwa pa gnya' thung nang zan smug ris tsho mchod pas de chos shig yin min gyi ha de go yong / bla ma mchod na gro ma zhun thud sogs phul/ 'bul ba chen po phul dang bzang / de la mi dgyes pa'i bla ma med snyam/ yod na bla ma de'i kha la thal ba yang rgyag mi dgos/ yang khyed tsho'i khyim gyi mi 507

zhig la na tsha byung na/ gcod sngags bla rgan ban de mang bo bsdus te/ ra lug g.yag gsum mang po bshas nas sgo khyem sha khrag dang rtso yis 'gengs pa 'di ngan/ sngon las kyi dbang gis nad mi sos na srog tshab tu srog 'gro tshul med de/ nga sngon pha yul na yod dus phyug po zhig gi bu na nas/ ban sngags mang bo bos tshe nga yang song / kun gyis sku rim bton dus g.yag rgan zhig khrid 'ongs nas bsad pas/ de'i 'phro la gces phrug de yang shi nas ro thog ro bzhag byas song / des na khyed tshos nad pa la rim gro ma byed ces bshad pa min/ srog gcod kyi las 'di ma byed par tshe thar mchod sbyin sogs 'di phyi gnyis ka la phan pa'i sku rim gyes dang bzang / yang khyed tshos/ mi med lung stong na nyes med ri dwags kyis/ bdag med kyi rtswa chu 'thung ba la/ 'chor med kyi me mda' sogs kyis brgyab nas ma gsod/ khyed tsho'i lus la me mdas rgyag mi dgos/ gon pa bzo dus mdzub gu khab kyis phug na ji 'dra zhig red ltos dang /ri dwags de tsho snying re mi rje rung rang tshe phyi mar song na sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa myong dgos pa la cig skrag dgos/sngon nyag phrug dmyal bar song dus/ mi gcig la 'brong sogs ri dwags mang po 'ongs nas rdung rkang lag gis brgyab/508

gcan gzan mang bos sha khrag 'thung ba zhig mthong nas/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la dris tshe/ skye ba sngon mar ri dwags bsad pa'i rnam smin red gsungs/ ri dwags gsod mkhan phal cher phyi mar song na lcags kyi shal ma li'i sdong bor 'bab 'dzeg byed dgos/ ji ltar byed zer na/ dmyal ba'i thang chen po nas stag dred spyang ki khyi sogs kyis ded tshe/ de la skrag nas bros pas yib sa ma rnyed/ thang na lcags kyi sdong bo skyes yod pa'i steng du yar song tshe/ gcan gzan 'ga' res phyi chod nas yar 'gro ba'i 'phong nas sha kham gang bcad tshe/ srog phangs kyis yar song tshe/ sdong bo de'i yal ga mdung ltar rno bas lus phug lo ma spu gri ltar rno bas sha bcad tshe/ thang du sha dum bu khrag thigs pa byas lhung ba/ gcan gzan rnams kyis zos 'thung nas yar blta/ rtse mor bsdad tshe lcags kyi bya khra mig dmar lcags mchu can mang bo 'ong nas mgo la babs te thod pa rtol nas klad khrag 'thung / 'ga' res phrag gong du babs mig 'bras 'bru kha sna gcod/ rtse mor sdod du bya khras ma bcug mar 'bab tu gcan gzan gyis ma bcug lus 'gul na lcags kyi yal gas lus phug lo mas sha bcad/ las kyi dbang gis 'chi rgyu med par bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal 509

yun ring myong / deng sang sdug bsngal 'di mi shes pa 'ga' res khyi khrid me mda' khur nyin gcig yul nas 'dug mi thub par nam langs ri byed pa 'di rnams snying re rje/ bla ma tshos ri dwags pa 'ga' rer ri dwags ma gsod ces bshad na 'ga' res lags bza' ba kha mang rgyab mang gi song nas/ kha ma sos rgyab ma khebs par sdig pa bsags pa yin/ tshe phyi ma'i sdug bsngal de ma shes pa min/ sdug thug na mi gsod pa'i thabs mi 'dug nged tsho'i las 'di shin tu ngan pas/ thugs dam skyabs 'og nas cig ma 'dor ma gtogs/ khyed rnams bzhin yon tan ni med pas/ 'di mi byed par bsdad gtong dka' lags/ zer ba de sdig pa'i kha 'gengs tshe phyi mar kha thur du song nas yar la mi 'khor ba'i snga ltas po slebs pa yin/ ri dwags ma bsad par kha mi sos na rgya bod sog gsum po gna' zhig nas 'thor tshar/ ri dwags med pa'i yul phyogs thams cad mu ges shi nas da yod rgyu ma red/ thabs med kyis sems can gyis srog bcad nas za dgos zer ba de glen gtam bshad pa yin/ mi de las blun po zhig gzhan na med/ khe tshong zhing las 'tsho skyong bzo btsem sogs gzhan pa tsho'i kha gso tshul rgyab 'geb tshul ltar byas nas/ kha mi sos rgyab ma khebs 510

na 'chi tshad la slebs pa red/ ri dwags ma bsad na mi 'chi ba'i khag ngas theg yang dpon po rgan pa 'ga' res/ gzhan sde pa tsho pa khyim tshang re gnyis ma 'grigs pa'i bar la gzu byed zer nas song / gnyom chung gi gnya' ba mnan/ btsan po'i gzengs bstod/ bden pa rdzun du btang / dzun pa bden par bsgyur/ gnyom chung pham du bcug btsan po rgyal du bcugagazu pa rnams kyi srog la babs pa ltar byas ra lug mang po gsod pa 'di mi rung / yang khyed tshos pha ma rgan rgon re shi tshe/bla ma'i 'tsho ba yin zer ra lug tshon po bshas nas sha drangs/khong rnam pa'i chab gung tshigs tsho zer ra lug g.yag gsum gyi sha 'dren pa 'di shi bo tsho la phan btags pa min gnod bskyal bathan/ bka' gdams bla ma 'ga' res/ pha ma la dge rtsa byed dus srog gcod byas na dper na/ stobs med chus khyer ba bzung nas/ rke la rdo zhig btags te slar chu nang du 'phangs pa dang 'dra gsungs/ des na 'tsho ba'am chab tsho zer ming snyan pa zhig btags kyang mi yag rgyu de rjes na yod/ srog chod la chos gyis zhes sangs rgyas kyi gsung na med pha ma la dge rtsa byed na ra lug shan pas gsod pa blus/ rang gi ra lug gi nang nas tshe thar thongs dang bzang / yang gcod pa dang sngags pa 511

'ga' re grong chog tu song na/ a khu gcod pa'am sngags pa da 'ong gi zer/ btags pa'i ra lug ma rgan gang yin yang sa la bsgyel nas lto ba phral pags pa bshus dus/ gcod sngags snying khams can rnams khyim tshang de'i yar gyi phug nas bsdad tshe yon bdag 'ga' res/ don snying tsho dmar tsa re khyer 'ongs nas 'dis ci byed rgyu yin a khu gcod pas 'di longs zer dus/ ngo tsha rgyu med par ga re 'dir byin zer gtor sgam nang du 'phangs nas/ nyi ma lnga'am bdun gyi bar du yi dam gyi lha bzang po mnol du bcug yang sha dang khrag sna 'di 'dra dgos zer skad gseng mthon pos bos da khyer shog zer/ 'bar ba'i bsreg sha zer ba sha ma drangs pa'i sngon du sha zhig 'tshod dam bsregs nas zos/ de nas ma rgan gyi pags pa brgyangs rnga rul nag lhab dud dreg ma de rkun ma bzhin du gnam la btags/khyod la rkun rogs mi du yod/ mi bshad na gsod rgyu yin zer ba ltar byas/ dbyug pas shed kyis rdung hūṃ phaṭa tsho zer thang gi mi skrag tu 'jug mar gyi 'dre thul yod med ci shes/ ston kha'i ra lug mang bo gsod nges pa yin pas 'di 'dra gtan nas mi rung ste/ sngon lho kha'i phyogs kyi shi log cig dmyal bar song dus/ zangs kyi gzhong ba dpag tshad lnga brgya tsam zhig gi 512

'og tu rdo sol ri rab tsam spungs nas/ gshin rje'i pho nya mang bos phyogs phyogs nas sbud pa drag tu brgyab ste zangs dmar bor 'gro ru bcug mtshon cha rnon po thogs pa'i gshin rje 'ga' res/ glo la ling sgam dang rkang dung btags pa'i sngags pa ral zed la/ mgo la dom lpags gyon pa'i gcod pa mgo ril mang bo bzung nas/ gson por pags pa bshus/ phur bas brgyangs/ gdan du bting /lus la gyon/zangs gzhong du gcod sngags mang bo bzhag nas bsregs tshe/ a tsha dang a na'i sgra dang gsur dris lung ba gang /skabs shig yos brngos pa ltar pho ba gas kyin 'gro ba zhig mthong nas/ a tsi 'di ci yi rnam smin ngan pa zhig yin nam snyam nas/ spu gri thogs pa'i gshin rje zhig la dris tshe 'di bod gangs can gyi gcod sngags 'ga' res mar gyi ra lug bsad nas/ sha khrag gis yar gyi lha bzang bo mnol du bcug dmar chog rkyang ba byas nas/ g.yang gzhi blangs pa'i rnam smin yin/ khyod bod yul du 'gro na/ gcod sngags mgo mdung de tsho la/ khyed tsho yar mar la mdong nge mdong nge rgyug la rem rem la shog dang / nged tshos kyang sngon na nges nges khrig khrig byas bsdad yod ces shod dang zer skad/ 'o sangs rgyas kyi zhal nas/ ji 'dra ba yi las byas pa /'bras bu 513

de 'dra smin par 'gyur/ /gsungs pa dang mthun pas/ ngas bsam na 'di shin tu bden par 'dug snyam/ khyed dad can gcod sngags rnams kyis grong chog ma byed byas pa min/ grong chog byed dus g.yang gzhi gtan nas ma len par gzhan rang gi grwa slob grogs mched rnams la len du ma 'jug dang bzang /yang khyed tsho 'ga' res pha ma dang / a khu la rlung 'dra langs e 'jog rlung bcos la sha zhig dgos zer/ ra lug gang gi gang tsho bsha' ba de/ rgan rgon lo lon tshur dang phar gnyis kyi phar la thag nye dus de mi rung / phyi mar song na gshin rje pho nya rnams kyis a khu khyod rlung gis shi nas 'ong ba yin nam zer/kha nang du sha bcad nas bzhag rlung e ldang gi ldang na da dung rlung bcos byed zer/ ja mar zho thud phye rtsam za rgyu yod phyin chad rlung gis mi 'chi ba'i khag ngas 'khur/ rong ba 'ga' res lo mang bor sha kha la ma reg pa mang / rlung gis 'chi rgyu yin na de tsho 'chi dgos kyang shi rabs med/ khyed tshos rgan rgon tsho la khag bzhag nas ra lug ma gsod/ rgan rgon tshos gsod rgyu zhig kyang yod bu tsha bos bsad nas ster bar 'dug snyam nas bsha' ru ma 'jug tshe phyi mar gnod pa'i mi tshad tshe 'dir yang rgan rgon la sha ma 'phrod par shi ba mang / sngon a rig gi 514

rgad po zhig na ba la sman pa zhig gis rlung red rlung bcos gyis zhes bshad pas/ bu yis gzhan zhig gi lag nas lug gcig nyos te tshur khrid 'ongs nas bsad/ long g.yos rgan mos khyer nas rgad po'i khar bzhag tshe/ rgad pos yar hub zer 'ga' 'jib nas mig gyen du bzlog mar hus zer long g.yos kha nang du bzung nas shi song tshe/ rgan mos o ho ho zer ngus/ de na gcod pa zhig yod pa des mthong nas 'khor ba'i bya ba 'di ci zhig red/ bu yis lug bsad lug gi g.yos kyis rgad po bsad/ rgan mo ngus bya ba de'i rtsog ang snyam rgod rgyu byung zer/yang khyed tshos khye rgan mtsher nas 'jog pa 'di mi rung / tshe stod khyi yis mi rkun ma dgos khye rkun zhig kyang 'ong gi ma bcug pas drin can de/ rgas dus mtsher nas bzhag na de bas khrel med na rag gi khyim tshang zhig gzhan na med/ khye rgan mtsher nas bzhag na/ yar rgyug mar rgyug shul chad tshang / rjes bzlog rgyu tshang / gang du song ba yin nam zer ba ltar byas ngu zug byed/ da kha thur du 'gro rgyu tshang la kha gdangs lag pa bzed nas 'chi dgos zer ba ltar byas/ mgo thur du bstan so gtsigs sder mo bgrad nas 'chi/ phyi nas mtsher tsho la song na ru bkal ba zhig dang mi 'dra dmag cig gis brgyab nas/ khye 515

yan chad bsad song ba zhig dang 'dra/ yang khyed tsho'i bud med bdud mo 'ga' res/ khye la lto mi ldud par mu ges 'chi ru 'jug pa 'di mi rung / tshe 'dir yang khye ltogs pa yul nas mi 'dug par phyogs phyogs su ldom 'gro/ yul du bsdad kyang gar yin sar nyal nas bsdad mi rkun ma dgos khyi rkun zhig kyang mi khog khyi mu ges 'chi ru bcug na tshe phyi mar rnam smin shin tu che/ sngon nyag phrug dmyal bar song dus nyag kha dmar bo zhig gi phar ltag na/ tsher phung dmar bo zhig gi rtsa ba na/ khyi mo dmar mo zhig lcags thag gis btags pa zhig gi kha nang na me dmar bo zhig 'bar nas sreg pa mthong tshe 'phags pa la dris pas/ de 'jig rten khams na yod dus rgyal po zhig gi g.yog mos khyi mo zhig la lto ma byen pa'i rnam smin red gsungs/ yang lhag par bla ma dang pha ma gsod pa dang brdung ba phar zhog tha na mgo la yang 'gom mi rung / sngon mdza' bo'i bu mo rgya mtshor 'gro dus a ma'i mgo rkang bas phul nas song ba'i rnam smin gyis/ phyis mgo la 'khor lo me 'bar ba zhig zug drag tu 'khor nas sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa myangs gsungs/ma la mig sdang gis bltas tshig ngan tsam yang smra mi rung / phyi mar gshin rje'i pho nya rnams kyis mi de'i mig phyung / lce ma mchu'i 516

'og nas blangs/ steng du lcags phur 'dom pa gang gdab gsungs/ yang sde ba phan tshun thug nas mi srog rta rke mang po len pa 'di shin tu ngan/ bsod zad 'ga' res rgyu nom pa bu tsha bo 'ga' yod tshe khyi ngan zug zug byas gyod phar btsal/cung zad cig la zhe sdang langs ngan pa de bas nged tshang la mi 'os pa 'di 'dra byas/ bu yi mi tshad bu mo ma lus kyang / bu la snying yod snying la rus pa yod na khye 'dra ba de ba'i mi gsod dgos rta ded yong dgos/ nged tshang a pha a bye'i ring nas btsan po zhig yin na ma gtogs gnyom chung zhig min zer rgad po 'phung rgan 'chi med tshos sde ba tsho ba bsdus nas khas 'phung / gsar bu thams cad song nas lag gis phar 'phung /phar gyi mi thams cad kyis tshur 'phung / 'phung gsum 'phung rdzogs tshe gzu ba 'ongs nas/ mi bsad stong yin zer nas phyi nang thams cad stong bar phud/ gson po'i kha stong bar btang shi bo phyi mar lag stong du 'gro/ mi zad rgyu zad gnyis ka byed pas 'di gtan nas byed mi rung / kha 'go byed mkhan mi gsod dmag mi thams cad shi na dmyal ba ma gtogs gzhan du 'gro sa med/ song na bskal ba mang po kha yar la 'khor ba'i dus mi 'byung / yang bla ma dpon po 'ga' res rang gi yong sgo 517

la gnod kyis dogs nas/ phrag dog gi dbang gis gzhan la dug 'dren pa dang / gcod sngags 'ga' res sha lhu che chung gral gyi mgo mjug yan chad brtsad nas/ mthu gtad ngan las byed pa dang / khe tshong dmag las jag rkus lam du 'gro ba'i phyir ra lug gis gzhi bdag mchod pa dang / nad pa sogs kyi don du yul lha gzhi bdag mchod zer ra lug gi rke len mthu gtang ngan las byed pa dang / khe tshong dmag las jag rkus lam du 'gro ba'i phyir ra lug gis gzhi bdag mchod pa dang /nad pa sogs kyi don du yul lha gzhi bdag mchod zer ra lug gi rke len pa'am/ yang na gson por khog gi snying dmar tsa re blangs lag na 'gul bzhin bsang gi nang du bzhag nas dmar bsang gtong ba dang / sha khrag gis mchod pa dang / lo yi ched du ra lug che chung gang yin yang bsad nas lha mchod pa dang /yang 'ga' res mgron po 'bod rgyu yin zer nas/ ra lug tshon po bsha' ba dang / sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs dus ra lug gsod pa dang / dgon gsar ba 'debs dus sa rdo shing len lha bzo shing bzo sogs la ra lug g.yag gsum bsad nas ster ba dang / rgyal blon bla ma dge bskos rnams kyis nyes pa cung zad re byas pa la chad pa chen po bcad nas gsod pa 518

dang / yang dgon pa'i bzho mdzo ma yin zer/ nyi shu sum cu lnga bcu bzhag nas lo re bzhin du rtol bu skyes dus gar bsad mi shes pa 'di rnams gtan nas byed mi rung / yang dgon pa'i thag nyer shan pa lag dmar bzhag ra lug gsod du bcugadagon pa'i mtha' rwa co rus pas 'gengs pa 'di mi rung /sngon nga'i bla ma a rig dge bshes rin po ches rwa rgya dgon btab nas/ nyin gcig khong bskor ba la byon dus/ dgon pa'i mtha' na rus pa yod tshad btus/ thu ba gang khyer 'ongs 'du khang gi sgor srungs nas/ grwa pa rnams bos te 'di la ltos ang las ngan po ngas dgon pa 'di ci la btab bzhag pa red/ma btab na ang / deng phyin chad khyed tshos ban rgan nga bla ma zhig gi brtsi na 'di 'dra ma byed/ gsungs pas/ de nas bzung dgon pa'i mtha' tsho gtsang sing nge gnas skad/ sngon bla ma zhig gis yon bdag 'ga' re la sems can thams cad pha ma yin pas/ srog gcod pa rdeg brdung sogs gnod pa byed mi rung /srog skyob sbyin gtong sogs phan gang thogs gyis zhes chos bshad byas pa'i mjug tu/ yon bdag gis lug gcig bsad nas sha drangs dus nang mchod byen rlabs bton nas zos/thug pa zhig drangs dus zhal zas ro brgya ma bton nas 'thung 519

tshe/ yon bdag de pa'i nang na rgya za lar zhig yod phas/ des e khyed bod kyi bla ma mi bzang gi ya zer/ de ci red dris pas/bla ma 'dis da nang chos bshad byed dus sems can thams cad skye ba sngon ma'i pha ma yin zer/ da lug bsad nas sha drangs dus/ mchil ma mid zhor la shar du pha'i ga nub tu ma'i sha tsho zer mang bo zhig bton nas zos/ thug pa drangs dus/ sha zas ro zas po nang na nyung gi zer nyung nyung zhig bton nas 'thung btang / sems can thams cad pha ma yin zer ba de brdzun bshad pa red yag po ma red ces smras tshe/yon bdag des bden bden 'dra bar 'dug zer hab bgad byas pa ltar/ deng sang bla ma 'ga' res kha nas chos bshad tshon po byas byams snying rje dang khyad par gtong len byed dgos zer/ don la babs tshe yon bdag mang pos ja zhus byed dus/ nyin re la lug bcu nyi shu sum cu re bsad nas sha drangs kyang / hub hub zer za ci thub byed pa ma gtogs/de'i nang gi gcig ma gsod tsam yang mi zer ba mang 'di 'dra'i mdzad spyod gzigs na rgyal ba sras bcas kyi thugs khrel ba phar zhog rgya za lar chos sreg yan chad kyis 'phya smod ha bgad byed pa'i rgyu zhig yin par gda'/ yang 'ga' res/ su 520

zhig gi ra lug g.yag gsum rgya la btsongs nas ngan gsod byed du bcug srog rin du nom pa blangs/ khab bsog nas 'bigs/ brgya byen nas stong dngul byen nas gser e lon bltas chos brgyad kyi g.yog byas nyi ma nam tsha btang / rgyu nom ci tsam rnyed kyang chog shes med par rnyed kyin rnyed kyin je ser ser sna je cher song / dgon pa'i grwa pa grwa rkyang tshos da lo bla ma la phyogs phyogs nas yong sgo bzang / 'gyed phogs che zhig yod mod snyam yod dus/ che ba phar zhog je chung la song kha dang phor ba gnyis ka yar rdeb shor tshe/ chos ci tsam bshad kyang gzhan rgyud la mi phan/ 'ga' res de ring chos gsung zhor la khong cig bshum gyin gda'/ skyabs su mchi zhes smras tshe/ 'ga' res ang de'i mig nas mig chu'i mi tshad ci zhig 'ongs kyang nga la dad pa 'dra skye rgyu mi 'ong gi de ngus pa sems can gyi don min/ khong rang gi don dag cig lam du ma song ba dran nas ngus pas nged tsho'i khri kha brdzad/ dgon pa mi skyong dge sbyor mi byed sha rgyag re zos khyod la ngu rgyu chen po 'ong ba bden zer khong 'dzum byed/ des na sangs rgyas tshar song yang sdig la 'dzem dgos ma 'dzem na 'gro don mi 'ong / yang dgon pa'i grwa pa rnams kyis kyang / bla mas chos ci gnang mi sems par mang ja 521

'gyed phogs ji 'dra zhig yod dam snyam/ dge sbyor rnam dag cig e 'ong mi bsam par grong chog cig e 'bud snyam/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab sngon du yod bzhin du ngo tsha rgyu med par/ kha sha dga' nas gzhan la srog gcod byed du 'jug khyad par grwa pa ngo shes phan tshun gyis rgyu nom brtsad nas gsod res byas/ de go tshe khyim pa rnams kyis nged tsho la bshad rgyu ci yod/ rgyu nom pa'i steng na khong rnam pa tshos gcig gis gcig gsod par 'dug zer dpe 'then tshad 'jog byed de'i thu bca'/ des na khong rnams kyis srog gcod kyi las rang gis byed dam/ gzhan la byed du 'jug gtan nas mi rung / rang gi shig kyang rnyed na sngo rlan steng sa phug dro sar 'phen dgos/ lag tu chud na ma thub pa'i dgra byas sen mo'am so dme po byas/ mchil mas dme lag bkru ba de mi rung / tshe phyi mar song na gshin rje chos rgyal gyi mdun nas nged tshos rgyal lon zer ba de dzun yin /sngon nyag phrug 'das log dmyal bar song dus/ skabs shig na mi mang bo ri gnyis kyi bar la gcur ba zhig mthong nas spyan ras gzigs la dris tshe/ de shig bsad pa'i rnam smin red gsungs/ kun bzang snying thig las tha na rang gi shig tsam yang gsod pa spangs shing / gzhan gyes srog gcod par 'dug na 522

yang thabs du ma'i sgo nas dgag cing 'chi ba blu bar bya/ gal te rang nyid chos sgor zhugs nas sems can chung ngu khab rtse tsam zhig bsad kyang / de'i rnam smin gyis rang lan brgyar gsod do gsungs/ des na sems can gsod pa phar zhog tha na khal rta yan chad la rdo dang dbyug pas rdung mi rung / sngon tshong pa zhig gis bong bu ma song ba'i tshe zhe sdang langs nas dbyug pas mang bo brgyab pa'i rnam smin gyis/ phyi mar song dus gshin rje zhig gis mi de sa la bsgyel nas dbyug pas shugs drag tu rdung ba nyag phrug gis mthong / nyag phrug khong gis khye rkun la rdo zhig gis brgyab pa'i rnam smin gyis/ gshin rje zhig gis pha bong chen po zhig blangs nas rked pa'i steng du brgyab pas bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal myangs gsungs/ deng sang zug gzer rgyun mi 'chad pa'i nad pa mang ba 'di rnams kyis kyang tshe sngon gzhan la brdeg brdungs byas pa'i rnam smin yin/ des na khyed tsho 'ga' res tshe phyi ma'i sdug bsngal 'di mi shes/rta g.yag re la zhon nas 'gro dus 'ob sdig byas lcag gis brgyab sna tsha snar blangs nas sprugs 'then bskor byas/ mdzo g.yag bong bu sogs de nas tshong zhig la 'gro dus/ khal rta'i 'phongs la rdo dang dbyug pas gcod sngags smyon pa 'ga' res 523

rnga rdung rdung byas shed kyis brdungs/ khye rkun re lag tu chud na rang gi lag gi rdo dang dbyug pa 'chag rag khyis gcin skyag 'chor rag gi bar du nyag nyog tu gtong ba 'di mi rung / khal rta la gang byams gyis/yang khyed tshos g.yag gi rtsid pa sor gang yod med cig bsams nas/ g.yag mnan nas rtsid pa sra shing gi mgo la dkris nas shed kyis g.yag rgan rnams kyi steng gi ko ba tsho 'gog rag bar du 'then nas blangs/g.yag 'chi la thug pa'i na tsha byung bas mi bzod par 'khun bu ma ṇi bzhin du bgrang spu'i rtsa ba na yang khrag rngul chu bzhin 'dzum du 'jug pa 'di mi rung / khyed tsho'i gcig mnan nas kha spu mchan spu 'og spu kun 'then nas blangs na mi tsha'am bsam blo thongs/ rang lus la dpe long la gzhan dbus gtsang phyogs kyi 'brog pa tshos 'breg pa bzhin du bregs dang /'breg shes na rtsid pa mang nyung la khyad par med gcig yin/ mi phyugs gnyis gas sdug bsngal myang bas thabs sdug de 'dra ma byed dang bzang / yang khyed tshos rta bong mdzo g.yag re'u lu gu brgya stong mang bo'i 'og gi 'bras bu gcig kyang mi 'jog par thams cad bcad nas/na tsha 'chi tshad pa 'byung gi bcug 'ga' res gcod mi shes bzhin nyes med dud 'gro mang bo 'chi ru 'jug pa 'di 524

'jig rten khams 'dir phyin ci log ltas ngan mi srid pa zhig dar song ba yin na ma gtogs gcod dgos don med/ ma bcad na lus stobs cher rgyas nas g.yag tsho 'brong dang 'dra bar 'gro ba la ltos/ de bzhin ra lug rta bong sgo nga ma bcad pa'i dud 'gro phal cher gyi yag lugs la ltos/ 'o na ra thug lug thug tsho dpyid dus shi 'gro ba la ci byung ba yin zer na/der gzhan thams cad bcad nas re gnyis bzhag pas ma brgya stong mang bo la byas pas lan pa yin/ thams cad bzhag na de 'dra 'byung dogs med/ sngon mtsho sngon po'i dbus kyi ri rtse na 'dug pa'i ri khrod pa 'ga' zhig gis ra ma bzung dus/ ra pho kun gyi 'og gi 'bras bu gcig kyang ma dbyung bar bzhag pas/ra pho brgya nyi/ga tsam yod pa thams cad gzhan las lhag pa'i tsho bsogs pa byung / ra pho mang ba'i shugs kyis rtsid mo la'ang re'u byung / ra ma che ba rnams la re'u gnyis re byung skad/gcod na pho skyes 'ga' res rang gi chung mas mi chog par gzhan gyi brgya nyos kyi chung ma khrid de/ sde ba tsho ba phan tshun gyod la gtugs nas mi srog rta rke mang bo len du bcug pha ma rgan rgon bla rgan rnams kyis sdig sdug gtam ngan sogs la ma 'dzem par tshe gang bo la bsags pa'i zas nor khang zhing yan 52nga/

chad nyi ma gcig la brlag tu 'jug pa dang / dge slong ban de 'ga' re dkor gyes tshos nas/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis gnang ba'i sdom pa bsrung na mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi bde skyid thams cad 'byung ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu de 'chor du bcug mar 'khor ba'i me 'obs su mchong ste dmyal ba'i rgyu mi dge ba 'ba' zhig bsgrubs pa dang / pho ngan 'ga' res rang gi chung ma dgong mo'i khrig gi ro snog snog byas sun du bcug pha ma rgan rgon rnams gnyid du mi 'jug dge slong ban de sdom ldan la 'dod chags skye ru bcug rang gi sgo nga skrang / chu ragags/ tha ma grang nad kyis jebs nas 'chi ba sogs rang gzhan yongs la gnod pa 'di 'dra'i rigs thams cad rtsa ba nas gcod dgos te sus gcod mi thub/ des na rang lus la dpe long la dud 'gro rnams kyi sgo nga ma gcod dang bzang / dud 'gro rnams rgyun du mi dang mi 'dra dus tshod gcig yin pas/ de dus shing ngam phying ba sogs kyis chags pa spyod tshul med pa'i thabs gyis/ dud 'gro'i sgo nga gcod mkhan gye mi phyi mar ngan song du skye/ gal te mi ru skyes kyang pho lus mi thob bud med kyi lus su skye/ pho ru skyes kyang dbang bo mi tshang bar skye bas 'di gtan nas byed mi rung / srog 'di la mi 526

gces pa gcig kyang med pas/ deng sang 'bri ma mo rgod ma gsum po 'dzom pa'i phyug po pha bu gnyis can zhig gi sgor/gzhan btsan po zhig gis dmag mang bo khrid nas 'ong mtha' thams cad bskor mtshon cha rnon po tshad dus/ de'i nang nas gcig gis khyed pha bu gnyis kyi gcig bsad nas rgyu nom 'jog gam/ yang na khyed gnyis bzhag nas sgo yi rgyu dang /khyem gyi zas 'khyer zhes gang 'dod 'dri rgyu yin na/ pha bu gnyis kyi su yin yang / nga sod la rgyu nom zhog mi zer/ khong gnyis ma gsod par rgyu nom khyer zer/ des na rje skal ldan rgya mtsho'i zhal nas/ srog gces pa sems can kun la gces/ /srog gcod pa'i las 'di spangs na bzang / /zhes gsungs/yang khyed tsho gcod sngags 'ga' res gto 'phen dus dbyangs byas/ mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med/ /'tsho ba'i srog la kun kyang 'jom/ /rang gi lus la dpe long la/ /gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /ces lha 'dre tsho la chos bshad byed pa ltar/ rang lus la dpe blang nas srog gcod kyi las 'di la shin tu 'dzem gal che/ ma 'dzem phyin tshe phyi mar bde bar ma re shi ma thag nas sdug bsngal gyi mgo 'dzugs pa yin pas/ bla ma'i gsung la 'dang brgyab rang gis rang nyid snying rje na/ rang du 27

'thag gi chu bcad pa bzhin du sngar sdig pa byed pa rnams kyis kyang sdig 'phro rbad kyis chod dang bzang / yang ma byin len gang yin zer na/ che ba rta mdzo gser dngul gos dar nas/chung ba ras kha kha dar khab skud yan chad/ gzhan gyis tshur la ma byin pa/ rdzun gtam g.yo sgyu byas rkus 'phrog nas len mi rung / khyad par jag rkus byas na/ pha rol de dag dbul bor gyur nas/ la la mu ges 'chi/ la las ri dwags bsad rku 'phrog byas gzhan la gnod skyel/ gzhan des kyang gzhan la gnod skyel/ phyogs de'i grong pa rnams 'thor tshe phyogs de na dgon pa yod pa rnams kyang / sbyin bdag med pas zhig ral 'thor gsum du 'gro nges/ sngon bod jag gi rkyen gyis/ sog phyogs a rig gi dgon pa bco brgyad tsam 'thor zer/ des na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sems can gyi bde skyid la gnod tshad kyi rnam smin jag rkus byed mkhan gyi steng na yod pas/ phyi mar dmyal ba ma gtogs 'gro sa med pas 'di gtan nas mi rung / tshe 'dir yang mi kha gtam ngan sdug gyong pham kha 'khon 'dzing gi rgyun mi 'chad/ mthar rgya bod sog gsum zhig gis ngan gsod byas bsad nas ri yul ngo mi thug pa mang / des na rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ jag rkun ma 'khon gyi gzhi ma yin/ /528

'di gang gi sa nas bcad na legs/ /zhes gsungs/ yang gzhan gyis tshur la g.yar ba dang bcol ba rnams kyang g.yo sgyu byas/ chag song chad song bor song ci byung ma shes med zer/phyir la mi ster ba de yang ma byin len yin pas na mi rung /phar la ster dus bre chung ba rgya ma yang mo'i steng nas byin/ tshur la len dus bre chen dang rgya ma lce mo'i steng nas len pa de yang ma byin len yin pas mi rung / bre srang la g.yo sgyu byas na phyi mar mi de'i sha bcad nas bre la gzhal/ rus pa bcag nas rgya ma la 'gyogs zhes dam pa du mas gsungs/ des na gzhan gyis tshur byen na ma gtogs/ ma byin par khab skud tsam yang len pa spangs dgos/ yang mi tshangs spyod gang yin zer na/ pho skyes kyis gzhan gyi chung ma shed shugs btsongs nas 'phrog pa dang /skyes pa med dus rku ba dang / bud med kyis gzhan pho skyes kyi kha drangs pa dang / khyad par dge slong ban de'i tshul khrims 'chal du 'jug mi rung / tshul khrims nyams su bcug pa'i bud med phyi mar song na/ gshin rje'i pho nya rnams kyis mgo thur du bstan nas/ gsang gnas la lcags kyi sbu gu btsugs te khro chu khol ma blugs nas bsregs gsungs/ rang gi ma dang sring mo tsha mo sogs la ngo tsha ba'i tshig zur tsam yang smra mi rung / rang gi 529

chung ma yin yang smyung gnas sdom pa bsrung ba'i skabs dang /sku gsung thugs rten gyi drung dang bla ma dang pha ma sogs kyi thag nye dang / dge 'dun pas mthong sa sogs nas spyod mi rung / yang rgad po 'ga' res/ ngan pa de la dga' na tha ma gcung gis 'chi zer ba ltar/ mang bo byas na nad du ma ldang khyad par mkhal rked na/ sgo nga skrangs chu 'gags nas 'chi bas/mtshan re la re gnyis tsam min spyod mi rung zhes lam rim sogs gzhung gzhan las gsungs/ de ltar byas na gzugs po ngan du mi 'gro zhing / grang nad mi bskyed pa sogs phan pa'i dgos pa mang po yod pas de lugs gyis/ yang rgad po 'ga' res/ ra bde sar mi 'dug bu mo skyid sar mi 'dug zer ba'i 'jig rten gtam dpe ltar/ bud med 'ga' res skyid che ba rgyag sa bzhag nas/ rang gi pho sgyes kyis mi chog par khye mo bzhin du pho skyes bzang ngan gnyis ka bsdus/ skabs shig rang gi pho skyes lha 'dra ba tsho bzhag nas/ gzhan 'dre 'dra ba tsho'i phyi la bud 'gro/ song na sde ba phan tshun 'khrug nas/ rmang po tshang gi bu gcig yan chad mi bzang gang gces gang dmar rnams gsod res byas/ zas nor gang bzang mang bo zad tshe snying nad che ru song nas lhag par gsod res byed/ lo mang bo'i bar du 530

gyod mi 'grig sde ba'i mi kun gyes grib nag ma des sde ba bzang bo 'di la ma bzang grib nag ma yugs sar 'bud rgyu ma zer dmod mo byed/ mthar khyim tshang de'i khye'i khye rko ka ba'i ka rdo yan chad stong yin zer nas khyer 'gro/ khyer na bza' gnyis ga'i kha stong bar 'gro/ skabs shig kha mi sos nam mi chod/ sde bas bud med de'i bya ba zer nas/ dper 'then tshad kyis 'jog da nyos no yin zer/ des na sdug sdig gtam ngan thams cad bud med 'ga' res rin byen nas nyos pa yin pas/ bud med bsam shes 'dra yod na/ rang gi pho skyes kyis chog ni gyis dang bzang / khyad par dge slong ban de rnams kyis mi tshangs spyod pa phar zhog chags sems kyis gzhan gyi bud med la rig pa dang / ngo tsha ba'i gtam smra ba dang / tha na mig zur tsam yang blta mi rung / yang deng sang ser mo 'ga' res dkor zas 'chos nas/ kha ton bzlas brjod ma byas pas dkor ma zhu tshe/ bla ma 'ga' res dkor kha la babs na mi bshad dgu bshad/ lag tu babs na mi 'khyug dgu 'khyug snying la babs na mi dran dgu dran/ gsungs pa bzhin skabs shig bud med snying la 'dod de kha nas lab lob mang bo de la bshad/ lag na ci yod de la byin lo 'ga'i 'phro 0 31

nas skya sar babs te/ log brgyab chu btang las ka mang bo byas tshe/ sngar lha 'dra ba tsho yang phyis 'dre 'dra ba tsho song /'ga' res ban+de yin dus de cig yag da cig rtsog gi zer/'ga' res a ho ho de dang po ltar bsdad na ched/ mi 'di 'dug ma thub na bya ba de'i rtsog ang zer/ des na ston pa'i gos snam 'og nas smug shan ne bsdad na bzang / bla ma dge bskul gyis bkag kyang mi thub par smag rab rib la gtad nas mar khyim gyi me nang du mig btsums nas ldang ma 'jogachags pa spyad nas len rgyu zhig yod na rgan rgon bla rgan 'ga' res gna' nas blangs tshar song / da cang yod sa med/ sdug sdig mi kha gtam ngan gyis gyong pham kha len rgyu yin mod/ de min de'i nang na len rgyu ci zhig 'dug des na skya ser pho mo su yin yang 'dod chags ma che/ 'dod chags che ba'i mi la bde ba zhig yong ba sangs rgyas kyis ma gsungs/ dzun gang yin zer na/ sngar rang gi mig gis mthong ba zhig la kho bos ma mthong ma rig rig don med zer ma mthong ba zhig la kho bos mthong /'di 'dra zhig red zer/ rna bas go ba zhig la kho bos ma go ci la thos/ thos don med zer/ ma thos pa zhig la kho bos thos/los thos los go mi go sa na med zer/ shes pa zhig la de khos 532

ma shes/ gsal cha med/ ma shes pa zhig la de khos shes gsal cha che zer/ lhag par gzhan gyi lag nas rgyu nom pa bu chung ma sogs tshur len snyam nas/ dzun sna tshogs pa bshad de tshur la ngan skyon ma byas kyang / kho bo la mi 'dis 'di 'dra byas zer gleng log 'then mi rung / phyi mar dmyal bar song nas gshin rje'i pho nya rnams kyis mi de'i kha nang gi lce phyir phyung thad bcad nas/ phyogs bzhir brgyangs tshe las dbang gis lce dpag tshad lnga brgyar 'gyur te/ de'i steng du gshin rje stong gis glang nyis stong dor sdeb thong gshol stong btsugs nas rmo zhes mdo dran pa nyer gzhag las gsungs/ yang de'i steng du kun yid ches pa'i phyir mna' bskyal gtan nas mi rung / sngon gling bza' chos skyid bar dor song dus thang chen po zhig na chu chen po zhig yod/ de la zam chen po zhig btsugs yod pas/ de'i tshur rol na chos mang po zhig brtsigs pa'i 'og tu mi zhig mnan nas gcur ba zhig mthong ste mi dkar po zhig la dris pas/ de skye ba sngon mar mna' bskyal ba'i rnam smin yin gsungs/ rdzun ma spangs na phyi mar nyes pa yod pa phar zhog tshe 'dir yang mi des skad cha ci tsam bshad kyang bden par mi 'dzin cing nyan mkhan dkon/ shes tshad kun gyis de'i skad chas ched zer 533

brnyas smod byed pa mang / bden pa zhig bshad kyang de bden nam mi bden snyam gzhan yid mi ches/ des na rdzun gye rigs mtha' dag spong dgos/ phra ma gang yin zer na/ sde ba tsho ba khyem tshang bza' ba sogs mthun po byas 'grogs yod pa'i bar la/ kha dbyen mang bo brgyab nas 'khon 'dzing byed du 'jug pa 'di yin/ kha ji ltar brgyag zer na/ sde ba tsho ba khyim tshang bza' ba sogs mthun po byas 'grogs yod pa'i bar la/ kha dbyen mang bo brgyab nas 'khon 'dzing byed du 'jug pa 'di yin/ kha ji ltar brgyag zer na/ khyem tshang bza' ba gnyis res bar la song nas/ bud med la skad cha bshad pa'i zhor la/khyed tshang gi skyes pa ri mgo tsho la song dus dang / khyod kyis mi rig pa'i la 'og lkog 'og na/ rgyu nom pa brlag bya spyod ngan pa 'di 'dra byed pas/ khos bshad pa yin ma zer ngo re tsha yin/khyod 'di byas bsdad nas ci byed/ nga khyod yin na 'di 'dra byed la ya gi gyis/ ma gi gyis zer/ pho skyes kyi rtsar song nas/thog mar skad cha gzhan bshad/ de nas khyed kyi bud med des khyod gzhan tsho la song shul na las ka mi las/ bya spyod mi'i mig tu mi 'gro ba 'di 'dra byed/ khyod mi ci zhig bzang ni red/nga'i chung ma yin na de gna' zhig nas brdzangs tshar da tsam bzhag 534

med/ bud med rul ma ya mo de gas ci bya/ ya gi tshang gi mna' ma/ ma gi tshang gi bu mo de tsho bzang ni yag ni gnyis ga red/da de 'dra zhig blangs na bzang mod/ khyod la rgyu nom pa yod tsho zer/ bza' ba gnyis ga la de 'dra mang bo bshad tshe/zhe 'gras la song nas/ gcig gis gcig la khyod kyis 'di byas ngas ma shes ma go e snyam zer/ 'khon res rdung res byas/de sus bshad pa yin snyam rtsad bcad nas shes tshe/ kha dbyen brgyag mkhan gye mi de la 'khon 'dzing byed/ bza' ba gnyis ka yang kha 'thor nas 'gro/ yang khyim mtshes gong mas gang bshad 'gab ma tshang la bshad/ 'gab mas gang bshad gong ma tshang la bshad/ skad cha tshig gcig tsam la dzun mang bo bsres nas bshad tshe/ khyim mtshes gong 'og gnyis ga'i sems la gnod zhe sdang langs nas 'khon/ gri phyung mdung bzung nas nangs shor dgong shor byas tshe/ 'ga' re 'ong nas bzung ma thub tshe/ 'di gnyis kyi gcig gis gcig gsod nyen 'dug pas khyem mtshes can po ma red/ sbra gur can zhig yin na gcig tshang la ru khol zer/ sbra rul tsho'i mchu bsdams nas song tshe/ shul na gcig po de nag tsog ge 'dug 'ga' res de kha gnyis dang po tsho cig bzang / da ci byung zer/ 'ga' res kha 535

zhig phar rtsod tshur rtsod byas/ de gnyis ga'i bar la rdo bzhag yag yin zer/ kha bshad mi de la 'ga' res khyod kyis ci tsho bshad kyi red/ kha rgya ston cig ro mgo'i mi 'dug gi na dkon cog gsum/ da khyod kha rog la sdod dang dga' mod zer/ yang sde ba tsho'i bar la tshig ngan mang bo khyer nas/ mi srog rta rke mang bo len du 'jug pa 'di tsho yin pas spangs dgos/ ma spangs na sngar bshad pa de bas kyang mang bas gshin rje'i pho nyas lce'i steng du thong gshol stong phrag mang bo btsugs nas zhing ltar yang nas yang du rmo zhes mdo dran pa nyer gzhag las gsungs/yang tshig rtsub gang yin zer na/ gzhan gyi sems la gnod pa'i tshig ngan mda' 'dra ba mdung 'dra ba smras pa de yin/ de ji ltar smras zer na/ cung zad tsam zhig la zhe sdang langs/ ngo tsho gnas 'gyur nas/ tshe thung po/ kha thur du 'gro rgyu po/ shul 'chad rgyu tshang / rjes bzlog rgyu tshang zer dmod mo byas/ g.yog po g.yog mo tsho la/ g.yog nag khye rgan/ lto rkyal/ ngo tsho cig 'dra 'dra po zer kha ming dang sna ming btags/ sgo phyugs la bsha' rgyu po/ stong zog po/ nad kyis 'chi rgyu po/ rbab tu 'dril rgyu po zer/ bud med la bdud mo ngo dmar ma ngo skrang ma zer /ngo sngon po zhig yin na sngo lu ma gdong rko ma zer/ mig nang 536

du ling tog byung ba 'dra yin na/ zhar rko ma ga khye zhar ma 'dra bas blta blta byas/ khyed kyi a pha a ma'i ro la bltas pa e yin/ga ngo mi rig gi chug khyod la 'gro sa zhig yod na da song ma 'dug zer/ kha la yong yong bshad pa 'di ngan/ sngon dge slong zhig gis dge slong zhig la khyod spre'u dang 'dra'o zhes smras pas/spre'u skye ba lnga brgya blangs/ dge tshul zhig gis dge slong dgra bcom pa skad mi snyan pa zhig la khyod kyis dbyangs 'then pa de khye zug pa dang 'dra'o smras pas khyi'i skye ba lnga brgya blangs gsungs/ dmyal bar song na gshin rje'i pho nya rnams kyis/ kha nas lce phyir phyung du bcug gri rnon pos bcad nas slar yang kha nang du 'jog ces mdo dran pa nyer gzhag las gsungs/ des na gzhan gye sems la gnod pa'i tshig ngan spu tsam yang smra mi rung / rig 'dzin gang shar rang grol gyis/ gtam 'jam pos smras pa ma gtogs pa/ /ngo gnag cing tshig rtsub smras pa sogs/ /dug bzhin du spang ba gnad du che/ /gsungs/ yang ngag 'khyal gang yin zer na/ rgan gzhon su yin yang / nyi phug dang go kha sogs nas dros tshe/ kha sos dal bzhag na/phu'i sha ba/ mdo'i dgo ba/ mi'i bzang ngan/ chu'i bska sla/ ya gi'i bu yi 'gro tshul/ ma gi'i mna' ma'i 'dug tshul sogs 537

phyogs don med kyi long gtam sna tshogs pa lab/ dpyid kyi nyi ring re gar shor mi shes par rgan rgon 'ga' re zhig gis thag ma chod ni 'dra ba ltar byas/ ja yan chad 'khyag gi bcugabashad bshad gzhan gyi rna ba sun/ bu tsha bos ja 'thung 'khyag thal smras kyang re re 'gul nas/ da dung lab tshe chags sdang sogs nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi mgo langs nas/ skabs shig tshig rkang ma 'grig 'khon la khad byed/ gzhan gye bla btsags ngan gtam nas khyed tshang la de yis 'di zer ngas 'di bshad zer/ gcig gis ngan pa des khong tshang la de zer ni e red zer/ de'i phyir nyin song nas 'khon 'dzing tsho byed/skad cha mang na mi bzang / khyad par bud med 'ga' res ri mgo chu kha tsho la song na/ mgo tsho 'phrug zhor/ shig tsho 'thu zhor la dgos mi dgos kyi skad cha mang po bshad nas/ cig re'i mgo tsho bsdad ni mang / bshad dgos thag chod kyi tshig ma gtogs/ lab lob mang po bshad mi rung / ngag 'khyal lab pa rnams dmyal bar song na/ gshin rje'i pho nya rnams kyis mi de'i lce zangs zhun rab tu 'bar bas bsregs/ de nas mgul ba bsreg de nas snying / de nas pho ba/ de nas rgyu ma bsregs nas thur du thon zhes mdo dran pa nyer gzhag las gsungs/ 538

yang brnab sems gang yin zer na/ gzhan gyi ja ras gos dar rta nor lug gsum bu chung ma g.yog po khang zhing gang yin yang /kho'i lag tu 'ong na ci ma rung snyam teb rgan 'ga' res mtshan mo nyal nas/ de lag tu 'ong ba'i thabs shig byed dgos te/ci byas na 'ong ngam snyam/ nyal sa nas kha lo phar 'khor nas 'dang brgyab/ tshur 'khor nas 'dang brgyab nas nam gung gi bar du gnyid mi 'ong / phyi nyin thun la bsdad pa ltar byas/ nyi ma'i dros kyi bar du gnyid la shor tshe/ 'ga' res gcig bos dus shi dang 'dra/ gnyis bos dus gcig gnyis 'gul/gsum bos dus ung zer/ ja 'thung zhes bshad na/ slar yang mgo nang du khyer nas gnyid/ de mtshan mo rang 'thag 'thag gi song ba min 'dang log mang bo brgyab pa'i stabs yin/ sngon gyi las 'phro zhig med na brgya bsam kyang gcig mi 'grub/ las shig yod na 'dang gcig kyang ma brgyab par gang 'dod lag tu 'ong / rgyu nom pas chos bca' ma thub na phyug po ser sna can gyis tshe 'dir bsags srung 'tsho skyong byas mi tshe sdug zad lag gtong / phyi mar yi dwags su skye/ des na brnab sems spong dgos/ yang gnod sems gang yin zer na/ rang gi yid du mi 'ong ba'i dgra ya de la nyin gcig ngan 'di 'dra zhig byas 539

nas cham la gcig 'bebs e thub blta/ yang gcod sngags rnams kyis kho bos mthu ngan sngags 'di 'dra zhig byas nas/de'i shul bcad de rgyal khams kyi mig la bstan nas ka su zhig gi byad red smas na/ de kho bo'i byad yin par go de phyin chad nas bzung / kho bo la sus reg thug mi phod par/ de gnyan po dug gi sdong bo zhig yin zer ba byung na ci ma rung / phyi mar song na dgra ya tshang gi bza' ba che chung thams cad kyi kha thur du song nas/ dmyal ba rdo rje gdan nas kha yar la ma 'khor na skyid la/ mi 'khor ba'i smon lam thobs zer/ 'di phyi gang du yang de dag la rang gis gnod pa zhig gtong e thub snyam/yang na gzhan gyis gnod pa zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam pa gnod sems yin pas 'di mi rung / gzhan 'di gsod do snyam pa yid la lan cig shar na phyi mar rang lan cig gsod/ brgya stong shar na de ltar gsod/ gzhan la gnod skyel snyam pa'i ngan sems skad cig ma ci tsam skyes pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i bskal bar dmyal bar gnas dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ngan sems bskyed pa'i grangs bzhin bskal bar ni/ /dmyal bar gnas bar 'gyur zhes thub pas gsungs/ /'di la pho gsar dpa' po byas na 'dod pa dang / sngags gsar gnyan po 540

byas na 'dod pa rnams kyis lhag par 'dzem dgos/ dper na rtsa ba dug yin na yal ga dang lo ma thams cad dug tu 'gyur ba ltar/ bsam pa ngan na lus ngag gis ci byas thams cad kyang mi dge bar 'gyur/ bsam pa mi la gnag na sbyor ba rang la 'du zer ba ltar/ gnod sems 'di khog na yod pa'i mi de gzhan kun gyis yid du mi 'ong lha 'dre mi gsum gyis sdang zhing /rang gi bsod nams 'dzad pa'i rgyu yang 'di yin te/ sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ bsod nams 'dzad khar bsam ngan skye gsungs des na gnod sems 'di dus dang rnam pa thams cad du gtan nas spong dgos/ yang log lta gang yin zer na/ bla ma dang chos bzang bo la ngan par lta ba/ grogs kyis phan btags pa la gnod du lta ba/ gzhan gyis bzang bshad pa la ngan du lta ba/ las rgyu 'bras bden pa la mi bden par lta ba sogs go log byed pa 'di la bog lta zer/ khyad par gsar rnying sa skya sa dges kyi bla ma che chung su yin yang / 'di ni bla ma bzang bo ma red/ chos lugs gang yin yang 'di chos rnam dag ma red snyam log par lta mi rung / sngon legs skar dang lhas sbyin gnyis kyis sangs rgyas kyis ci mdzad thams cad la log lta byas pas/ phyis sa gas nas tshe der gnyis ka dmyal ba 541

mnar med du lhung / yang sngon gter ston zhig la grwa pa zhig gis gsang sngags kyi chos zhus/ gsungs tshe grwa pa'i blor ma shong 'gal 'grel brtsis nas/ 'di ma red de ma red chos log cig red snyam log par bltas pas/ phyis sa gas nas rdo rje'i dmyal bar lhung gsungs/ yang bla ma zhig gis kho bo'i chos lugs 'di ma gtogs/ gzhan thams cad chos rnam dag ma yin no zhes log lta byas/ sdang sems kyis chos lugs gzhan thams cad la dgag pa mang bo btang bas/ tshe der nyin gcig grwa pa 'ga' khrid nas grong chog cig tu song nas phyir 'ong ba'i lam bar nas/ bla ma gnas 'gyur nas dug sbrul 'dom pa gang tsam yod pa zhig tu gyur nas nags shig yod pa de ru song skad/ des na log lta 'di rnam smin shin tu che bas/ bla ma dang chos lugs gang la'ang log lta mi byed pa gal che/ yang khyed khyem pa 'ga' res/ kho bos bla ma rnams kyis chos byas na tshe 'di phyi gnyis ka la bde skyid 'byung gsung ba la nyan nas/ thar mdo tsho blangs/a mchod tsho bzhag chos 'di 'dra zhig bton/ lo re bzhin du mchod sbyin yang 'di 'dra byas/ 'o da ma shes na tsha god kha zhig gis mi 'jog gi rigs rgyud re e 'ong snyam na/ bu ma dgos bu mo zhig kyang dka' 'dug zer chos la zhen pa log sa mes 542

las can zhig tshang gi chos phar zhog gzhan la gleng 'then rdzun gtam mgo bskor jag rkus la song ri dwags bsad kyang je bzang je legs su song / gcod sngags 'ga' res dmos kyang /sku rim byas pa zhig dang 'dra ste/ bu dang tsha bo 'dzom/ rgyu nom pa 'dzom/ de'i skyid cig med zer yid smon byed pa de/ chos kyi ha ma go bas skye bo mi nag pa'i glen gtam yin/ chos byas na mi 'dod pa 'ong ba de/ chos gnad du song ba'i rtags yin/dper na dug ro rnying ba zhig khog na yod pa de la sman bzang po btang na skabs der na zug chen po byung nas/ khar skyugs pa'am/ mdo ru bud nas phyis bde cham me 'gro ba bzhin/dmyal bar skye ba'i rgyu las nag po mi dge ba sngar byas tshad chos byas pa'i mthus/ mgo bo na ba tsam gyis byang zhing dag nas/tshe mjug 'di 'am phyi mar bde zhing skyid pa'i snga ltas bzang bo byung ba yin pas 'gyod mi rung / de la nag po mtha' zad zer bas shin tu bzang / sdig pa byas pa 'ga' re je legs su 'gro ba de/ mar me 'chi khar je gsal du song nas nag tshubs se 'gro ba bzhin/ mi des tshe sngon las dkar bo gang byas zad nas/ tshe mjug gam shi ma thag tu sdug bsngal gyi 'go 'dzin pa'i snga ltas ngan pa po slebs pa yin pas smon mi rung / de la 543

dkar po mtha' zad zer bas— shin tu ngan/ sngon sangs rgyas kyi dus sdig can gcig gi khyim du rin po che'i char bab tshe/blun po 'ga' res nged rang tshos chos byas na rin po che'i char 'bab pa phar zhog mi 'dod pa char ltar 'bab/ 'dis sdig pa byas par rin po che'i char bab pa ngo mtshar che las can po zer/ chos shes pa rnams kyis las ngan tshang ltas ngan byung ma bzang da bros na dga' zer/ de'i phyir nyin sa'i char bab de nas rdo'i char babs khyim tshang de sa rdo'i 'og tu shor gsungs/tshe 'dir de ltar smin pa yang yod/ ma smin yang phyi mar song na dmyal bar lhung nas tsha grang gi sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa myong dgos pa de ma shes pa'i stabs kyis/ deng sang 'di 'dra zer ba mang / yang rgan rgon 'ga' re yun ring na nas 'chi khar mnar gcod kyi sdug bsngal che tshe/ a ho khos chos 'di 'dra byas ma ṇi dmigs brtse ma sogs 'di 'dra bton na/ da kho'i nyin re'i sdug bsngal 'dis phar mi 'chi/tshur mi gson pas/ bla ma dkon mchog thugs rje che zer ba de da kho bo'i thad du chung 'gro ba 'di'i rtsog ang / kho'i las 'di'i ngan ang / kho'i steng na mi 'dag rgyu ngan pa zhig yod gi u shi a me gzhan gcig gis sdig pa 'di 'dra byas kyang las 544

can po de'i sems bzang ba e yin/ bde cog ge shi bud song zer/ dad log byed pa 'di mi rung / de dper na nyes pa chung ngu zhig byas pa'i mi la wang a 'ban sogs kyis khrims mang bo brgyab nas srog gi chad pa med par btang ba bzhin du/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa cung zad yod pa rnams bla ma dkon mchog gi byen brlabs kyis 'chi khar na zug che ba des dag nas/ phyi mar mtho ris thar ba'i gnas su skye ba yin pas bzang / sdig can 'ga' rer 'chi khar mnar gcod chung ba de/ dper na mi bsad rta ded mang bo byas pa'i rkun ma jag pa rgya yis bzung nas khrid 'gro dus/ mi brdung bar bong bu sogs la bskyon gon pa bskon zas byen nas khrid de btson khang du slebs tshe/ kun 'tshogs nas khrims chen po brgyab/ sha kham re bcad de kha nang du bzhag khrag hub re blud/ glo snying phyir phyung nas ngan gsod byed pa ltar/ sdig can 'ga' re 'chi khar bde mo byas shi 'gro ba de sems dkar ba yang min/ de'i sdug bsngal thams cad phyi na yod/ phyi mar dmyal khams bco brgyad du skyes nas sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa bskal ba mang bo'i bar du myong dgos/ de la smon rgyu spu tsam med/ bla ma rnams kyis chos gsungs pa de thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi gsung nged 545

rang tsho la bshad pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung la rdzun med bden snyam du yid ches bskyed nas/ log lta mi byed pa 'di shin tu gal che/ 'o da ngas khyed rnams la mi dge ba byas na nyes dmigs che tshul la nges shes lhag par skye ba'i phyir/ sngon byung gi gtam rgyud 'ga' bshad/ sngon rgyal go chos kyis 'phags pa zhes bya bas nyes can gyi mi zhig khrims bcad nas bsad pas/rgyal po tshe'i dus byas nas/ rgya mtsho'i nang du chu srin lus dpag tshad bdun brgya yod pa zhig tu skyes/ de nas chu srin de shi nas dmyal ba chen por skyes sdug bsngal myangs/ sngon rgyal po'i blon po dpa' bo zhig gang la mi 'jem par mtshon khar brgyugs nas/ phar mi mang bo la brgyab nas rmas pa dang bsad pas/ shi ma thag tu dmyal bar skyes nas mtshon rnon po ral gri mda' mdung sogs btsugs yod pa'i khar brgyugs tshe/mtshon chas lus phug sha bcad kyang / yang sngar bzhin du brgyugs nas sdug bsngal myangs/ de nas tshe 'phos te dmyal ba chen por skyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring bar du myangs/ sngon mi zhig gis ri dwags mang bo bsad pas shi nas dmyal bar lhung tshe/ mi lus gcan gzan dang ri dwags sogs kyi mgo can mang bos la lung du ded nas/ phyogs phyogs nas dug mda' 546

mar sne me lce 'bar ba mang bo 'phangs te g.yas nas brgyab g.yon nas phud/ des g.yon nas brgyab g.yas/ mgo nas brgyab mjug mjug nas brgyab mgo nas phud nas sdug bsngal myangs/ de nas tshe 'phos nas dmyal ba chen bor skyes nas sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa yun ring myangs/ sngon nya pa lnga brgyas nya rgya'i nang du nya chen po gnyis zin nas/ nya pa lnga brgyas 'then kyang chus 'khyer bar nye ba na/ rtswa thun shing thun grong gi mi dang bcas mi bdun khri bdun stong gis 'then grogs byas nas tshur skam la phyung ste/ shing sdong chen po zhig la btags gson por steng nas sha bcad pas/ nya gnyis kyis bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal chen po myangs tshe/ nged gnyis kyis mi 'di rnams gson por mtshon gyes gsod thub na ci ma rung snyam du sems/ shi nas nya de gnyis rgyal po 'phags skyes po dang / blon ngo ma la gnod ces bya bar sgyes/ de dus kyi mi bdun khri bdun stong bo shākya'i mi ru skyes nas yod pas/rgyal blon gnyis kyis dmag drangs te mi bdun khri bdun stong bo'i mgo gson por mtshon gyis bcad nas bsad/ de dus kyi nya pa lnga brgya po khye'u lnga brgyar skyes yod pas/ gson por lcags kyi shal mas bshal nas bsad/ de nas rgyal po 'phags 547

skyes kyis mi zhig btang nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ci gsung ltos la shog gsungs nas song tshe/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor dge slong rnams la rgyal po 'phags skyes po dang blon po ma la gnod gnyis 'khor bcas kyis/ shākya'i bden pa mthong ba'i mi bdun khri bdun stong bsad pa'i las kyis zhag bdun 'das pa na/ gson por mes tshig nas tshe'i dus byas te/dmyal ba mnar med du lhung nas/ bskal ba bdun khri bdun stong gi bar du gnas par 'gyur zhes gsungs/ smras pas/'phags skyes po 'khor bcas kyis pho brang nas me mi 'bud pa'i khrims byas/ zhag bdun gye bar du chu'i khang bar zhugs nas bsdad de/ zhag bdun 'das pa'i nangs par rgyal po pho brang du log pa na/ btsun mo'i mgo rgyan gyi me shel la nyi zer phog pas/ ras bal la me 'bar te slar pho brang la me mched nas 'phags skyes po 'khor bcas gson por mes tshig nas/dmyal ba mnar med du lhung gsungs/ sngon tsa na ga kya zhes pa zhig gis lha'i gsal snang dang nga rgyal mthar phyin pa des gshin rje gshed dngos su grub kyang / rkyen cung zad la khros nas mi zhig mthu byas bsad/ de nas tshe 'phos te dmyal ba mnar med du skyes/ de nas klu gdug pa can zhig tu sgyes/ de 548

nas yi dwags mthu bo che zhig tu skyes par 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las gsungs/ yang sngon mi sum cu so gnyis kyis glang gcig brkus nas bsad pas/ tshe rabs mang bor mi de dag gzhan gyis dus gcig la bsad cing / sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa'i dus/ glang de rgyal po gsal rgyal du gyur/ mi sum cu so gnyis po lha mtshams ma'i bur gyur nas/ rgyal pos dus gcig tu bsad/ lha mtshams ma sngon mi de dag gis glang gsod pa'i tshe/ rgan mo zhig tu gyur nas rjes su yi rang byas sha yang mnyam du zos pas/ tshe rabs thams cad du de dag gi mar gyur ma/sa/bu de dag bsad pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gdungs/ sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi dus su/ mi gcig gis dge 'dun gyi 'tsho ba'i nang nas a mra'i 'bras bu bcu gsum longs spyad pa dang /dge slong gcig gi lag nas bu lon blangs pa'i skyin pa ma mjal bas/ nyi tshe ba'i dmyal bar skyes/ de nas dmyal ba chen por sgyes/ de nas klu zhig tu skyes nas lus srin bus gang zhing rnag khrag 'dzag sngar gyi bu lon bdag po de yang klu de'i mchan khung du srin bur sgyes nas sha zos khrag 'thung / sngon sangs rgyas rnam gzigs kyi dus su bud med gcig gis/ dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang du/ dge 'dun gyi mal cha'i steng du 549

rab byung mang bo dang nyal bo byas pas/ ngan song du skyes/bskal ba 'jig pa na zhing gzhan gyi ngan song du tshe 'phos/der bskal ba 'jig pa'i dus su/ 'jig rten 'dis klu mo long ba lus rul cing rnag khrag 'ong ba sbrang bu srin 'bus za ba zhig tu skyes/ dgra bcom pa grags pas sngon gzhan gyi bud med la chags sems kyis reg cing 'khrig tshig smras pas dmyal bar skyes/ phyis mi lus thob kyang skye ba lnga brgyar lag g.yas skam pa dang / srid pa tha ma'i tshe yang lag pa g.yas mi bde bar gyur/khyim bdag dbang bo med pas/ sngon nor khyer ba mi dran no zhes dzun gcig smras pas dmyal bar skyes/ phyis mi lus thob kyang skye ba lnga brgyar mig rna ba lce med par gyur/ yang sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi dus dge slong rnams kyis/ dge bsnyen mang bo'i 'tsho ba bslangs pas/ dge bsnyen de dag gis dge slong 'di rnams kyis yi dwags bzhin rtag tu lag pa bzed par byed ces smras pas/ chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du tshe rabs lnga brgyar yi dwags su skyes/ tshem bu mkhan gyis/ sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la rang gi phu bo phyir mi 'ong ba thob pa la/ 'phye bo zhes tshig rtsub smras pas/ tshe rabs mang bor 'phye bor gyur/ dgra bcom pa u tra mtha' yas kyis sngon rang 550

sangs rgyas shig dug mdas bsad pa'i rnam smin lhag ma tsam gyis ral gris rke bcad de grongs// yang sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la dge slong ma zhig gis/ dge slong ma mang bo la ba glang rdzi mo zhes smras pas/ tshe rabs mang bor ba glang rdzir gyur/ bu mo gser mdog gis/ sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la rab tu byung ba/ rig gzugs lang tsho sogs kyis rgyags pa'i slob pa dang mi slob pa'i dge 'dun rnams la/gzugs mi sdug pa rigs ngan sogs kyi tshig rtsub smras pas/gang du skyes kyang gzugs byad dang rigs ngan zhing / mi sdug pa'i rnam grangs bco brgyad dang ldan pa byung / byang chub sems dpa' snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ sngon sangs rgyas bye ba phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi mchod de tshangs par spyad kyang / byang sems lha bzang la nal bu khyod la yon tan cang med ces smras pas/ bskal ba dgu bcur nal bur skyes/ btsas ma thag tu ma yis bor nas rgyun du khyi spyang ki sogs kyis zos/ sngon sprang po gcig gis dge 'dun 'di rnams kyi rke 'khor los bcad par bya ba zhig na zhes khros te smras pas/ ring bor mi thogs par lam gyi 'gram du nyal sar shing rta'i 'khor los mgo bo bcad/rab 'byor gyis sngon dge slong rnams 'a/ sbrul gdug pa zhes 551

smras pas klur skyes/ bu mo rdo rje mas sngon rang sangs rgyas shig la byad gzugs mi sdug pa mego'i skra rta rngog 'dra ba pags pa rtsub pa 'di mi legs zhes tshig ngan smras pas/ tshe rabs mang bor mdog mi sdug par gyur cing / phyis rgyal 7po gsal rgyal gyi sras mor skyes kyang / mdog shin tu mi sdu ga pas rtag tu mun khang du gnas dgos pa byung / sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la/ dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa zhig nga rgyal gyis khengs nas/ gzhan dag la gnag rdzi yin zhes smras pas/ skye ba lnga brgyar gnag rdzi byed par gyur/ yang sangs rgyas 'od srung gi bstan pa la/ dge slong bsam gtan bsgom pa gcig gis dge slong gzhan gyis kha ton byed pa la dge slong 'di rnams kyis mtshan mo sbal ba ltar skad 'byin to smras pas/ skye ba lnga brgyar sbal bar skyes/ ya nga dge slong zhig sangs rgyas la ma rangs nas shing gi ya la ga zhig bcad pas/ phyis mgo la shing sdong chen po skyes pa'i klu zhig tu gyur nas/ sangs rgyas 'od srung gi dus nas bzung rgyal ba shākya thub pa 'jig rten du byon pa'i bar du sdug bsngal myang / da dung yang myong dgos zhes sangs rgyas kyis gsungs/ lhas byin gyis mdo sde mang bo kha ton shes kyang /nyes pa byas te tshul khrims nyams pas mtshams med pa'i sems 552

can dmyal bar skyes/ rgyal po zhig gis mgron po skom pas gdung ba 'ga' la bur chang blud pas/ dmyal ba ngu 'bod chen por skyes zhes dran pa nyer gzhag las gsungs/ lha'i bu bsnyen gnas kyis sngon bsnyen gnas blangs pa las/ phyi dro zas zos pas tshul khrims nyams pas klur skyes te/ nyin gcig bzhin bye tshan gyi char babs te rus pa tsam lus par byed pa'i sdug bsngal myang gsungs/ yang sngon sangs rgyas gtsug tor can gyi dus/ rgyal po me tog bral gyis gtsug lag khang yo byad dang ldan pa zhig dge 'dun la phul ba/ phyis rgyal bu gtsug lag khang der gnas nas gzhan sdod du ma bcug pas/ bskal pa sum cu rtsa gcig gi bar du dmyal ba sogs ngan song du skyes/de nas klu sman pad+ma'i gdong zhes bya bar gyur lus gang gis reg kyang me 'bar nas sdug bsngal myang / yang dge slong zhig gis/ tshe 'di nyid la 'phags pa thob par yod pa la sgog pa zhig zos pas/ tshe rabs du mar mi 'thob par byas zhes 'dul ba lung las gsungs/ yang sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gi dus su/ chos smra ba zhig gis/ rgyu nom ci rnyed kyang 'khor rnams la ma byin par rang gcig pus longs spyad/ dge slong chos byed gzhan la mi snyan pa smras pas/ ngan song du lhung nas sdug 553

bsngal du ma myang / phyis sangs rgyas shākya'i rgyal po byon dus klu long ba zhig tu gyur/ slob ma rnams kyang sbal ba dang srin bur skyes nas lus la zos/ yang sngon bcom ldan 'das rnam gzigs kyi dus su/ dge 'dun pa la rin po che zhig yod pa zhal ta pa la bcol nas/ phyis dge 'dun pas blangs pa na/khyed tshos skyag pa za'am/ rin po che de nga'i yin zhes smras pas/bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gnyis kyi bar du dmyal ba mnar med du skyes/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon dus/ rgyal po'i khab na mi thams cad kyis gshang gci 'dor ba'i chu'i lteng ka zhig yod pa der srin 'bu chen po sbrul 'dra ba zhig tu skyes nas sdug bsngal myang / yang 'khor ba pas/ sngon mkhan po dus ston 'byon par lan gsum bskul yang ma byon pas/ khyod tshe rabs lnga brgyar gson por khyem nas ma phyung zhig ces tshig ngan smras pas/ ma'i mngal nas kho shi'o/ /yang lag pa can zhes bya ba/sngon dge slong zhig sbyin bdag rnams kyis 'bod pa'i phyi la 'gro ba las/ lan cig de ma rnyed pas gzhan zhig khrid pa la/de khros nas deng phyin chad khyod kyi phyi la song nas lhung bzed lag tu bzung bkrus na/ bdag gi lag pa gnyis med par gyur cig ces smras pas/ lag pa gnyis med par gyur/ 'phags pa 554

sde gus gsos kyis/ sngon wa ra ṇa sir rang gi mas sbyin pa byed la ma byed ces bkag kyang / ma khogs nga sa khang ba'i phugs su bcug sgo bcad/ mas zas bslangs pas thal ba rjo zhes smras nas/ zhag drug la zas ma byin par mu ges bsad pas/ bskal bar dmyal ba mnar med du skyes/ phyis mnyan yod kyi bram ze phyug po zhig gi bu gzugs mi mdzes pa zhi1ga tu skyes/ skyes ma thag nas ma'i 'o ma skam nas/ ma gzhaca/ gcig gnyis btsal kyang skam ste lde gus gsos/ cher lon pa na zas ma rnyed pas rab byung byas 'bad pas dgra bcom pa rngo/ba kyang / zas cung zad tsam yang ma rnyed par zhag drug zas chad/ zhag bdun pa la thal ba chu dang sbyar ba gsol nas mya ngan las 'das so/ /yang 'phags pa mo'u 'gal gyi bus/ sngozu/ rang gi ma la khros te/'di'i rkang lag 'dam bu ltar 'jom pa 'a/ 'gal ba med dam/zhes smras pas/ tshe rabs mang por sdug bsngal du ma myang /mthar dgra bcom par gyur dus mu stegs kun tu rgyu rnams kyis/ sku lus 'dam bu ltar bcom/ sngo /na bud med cig bag mar len pa ma rnyed pa la/ lan cig nang nas phyag dar dor bas rang sangs rgyase shig phyin yod pa'i nga/ bu la phog de bud med des mang bo mthong nas 'dzum shor/ de'i rnam smin gyes ka 555
