ta ya na dgra bcom pa thob nas kyang / skye bo'i tshogs mang bos sa rdo'i char chen po phab ste mnan nas mi mthong bar byas/legs 'ongs kyis sngon rang sangs rgyas shig la mu to pa kha dog ngan pa 'di zhes phyag dar phung bo'i steng du bsgyel/ phyis 'gyod de bshags pa byas smon lam btab mod kyang bskal par dmyal bar skyes/ de nas tshe rabs lnga brgyar mi dbul bor gyur/ srid pa mtha' ma'i tshe yang sprang por gyur te/ sprang po mang pos phyag dar khrod du bsgyel nas brdung / chos smra pa chos pa zhes pa zhig gis nga 'di kho na yin gyis/ gzhan min no zhes chos smra ba gcig la smad pas/ bskal pa bdun cur dmyal bar skyes/ tshe dgu khrir mi dbul po lce med par gyur/ rgyal po gcig gis byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa'i phyir/ zhag bdun bud med lnga brgyas glu gar rol mo byas pa la/ khye'u bcus/ chos smras pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de la bud med kyi skur ba btab pas lo dgu khrir dmyal bar skyes/ tshe rabs lnga brgyar za ma dang kla klo dang log lta can du skyes/ tshe rabs drug brgyar dmus long dang lce med par gyur/ yang sngon mi 'ga' zhig gis/gtsug lag khang gi rtsig pa dang ka ba la snabs lud 'phangs pas/ rtsig pa dang ka ba lta bu'i dmyal bar skyes/ dge 'dun 556

gyi shing dang lo ma dang thag pa dang phyags ma rnams brkus pas shing lta bu sogs kyi dmyal bar skyes/ dge 'dun gyi longs spyod kyi dus phyi la bsnur bas rked pa skud pa sbrel ba lta bu'i dmyal bar skyes/ yang sngon sangs rgyas 'od sdi spyong gi bstan pa la dge slong lnga brgya bslab pa'i gzhi phra mo rnams/ dang bral bas/ chu bo gaṅgā'i ngang ba dang nya dang rus sbal du skye/7sa/ yang rab byung mang bos bslab pa'i gzhi phra mo rnams 'a gus par ma byas pas/zhing rmo ba'i dud 'gror skyes/ sngo/ na sangs rgyas 'od srung 'jig rten du byon dus/ rigs gzugab/ 'byor ba che ba'i khyim bdag cig gi chung mas bud med dbul mo zhig la brnyas sgod byas tshig ngan smras pas/ tshe rabs snga brgya'i bar du dbul phongs 'tsho ba slong mo la ltos pa'i rigs su skyes/ sngon shed bu ser skyas/ slob pa dang mi slob pa'i dge 'dun rnams la/ glang bo'i mgo can khyod kyis chos sam chos ma yin pa ci shes zhes pa la sogs pa ngan smras mi 'dra ba bco brgyad byas pas/ mgo brnyan mi 'dra ba bco brgyad yod pa'i chu srin nya'i rigs su skyes te ston pa 'od srung gi dus nas shākya'i rgyal po'i bar du dud 'gror bsdad par gsungs/ sngon mnyan yod kyi dge bsnyen ma gcig gis dad pas tshul khrimab rnam par dag pa'i 557

dge slong zhig la zla ba gsum gyi bar du mchod pa 'bul zhes spyan drangs/ logs shig gi gnas khang du bzhugs su bcug nas/ bza' btung ro brgya ba dri bzang dang ldan pa sna tshogs sbyar te/ bran mo zhig yod pa de la 'dren du bcug pas/ bran mos lam nas zhim po rnams zos nas lhag ma dge 'dun pa la phul bas/ bran mo'i zo mdog je bzang du song tshe/ dge bsnyen ma yid ma ches nas/ bran mo khyod kyis dge slong la phul ba'i zas phud ma zos sam zhes dris pas/ bran mos bdag gis ma zos/ zos na bdag phyi mar gang du skyes kyang rang gi sha la za bar shog cig smras pas/ shi nas dmyal bar skyes/ rang sha rang gis zos/ de nas tshe 'phos nas dmyal ba chen por skyes sdug bsngal dpag med myangs/ sngon mi gcig gis dge 'dun bud med yin zhes ngan smras byas pas/ tshe der pho mtshan gnas 'gyur nas mo mtshan du gyur/ shi nas skye ba lnga brgyar bud med kyi lus blangs/ sngon bram ze bde byed ces bya bas gzhan las blangs pa'i la phug 'ga' zhig ma'i lag tu bzhag nas chu klung gi ngogs su khrus byed du song ste/ phyir 'ongs nas ma la nga'i la phug tshur byin zhes smras pas/ mas khyod kyi la phug rab byung bsod snyoms pa zhig la byen smras pas/ bram ze ltogs nas/558

bdag gi la phug za ba'i rab byung de ma zhu ba'i nad kyis 'chi bar shog cig tshig ngan smras pas/ tshe rabs brgya phrag mang po la la phug ma zhu nas shi phyis rgyal po gsal rgyal du gyur kyang la phug rnying ba zos nas ma zhu bar 'chi ba'i dus byas gsungs/sngon gcig gis dge slong zhig la khyod nag khung der lo drug cu'i bar du sdod cig byas pas/ tshe rang/sa lnga brgyar mngal du lo drug cu re bsdad nas skye dgos pa byung / sngon mo'u 'gal gyi bu rigs drug gi gnas su gshegs shing rgyu ba'i tshe/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram na yi dwags lus che ba ro stod gnyis can zhig 'dug de gcan gzan lcags kyi mche ba can mang bos ded nas lus kyi sha bcad de zos tshe slar yang skyes/ mi mang bos ded nas mtshon gyis ro stod gcig bcad na gcib/ skyes gcig bcad tshe yang gcig po skyes pas/ de'i sdug brwanil ma bzod par skad ngan bton nas bros kyang / de dag gis phyi ded nas 'gro ba zhig mthong bas/ de sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi dus su/ dge 'dun pa'i dbyar gye rnyed pa la bcad nas dgun gnas pa la phul/ dgun gye rnyed pa la bcad de dbyar gnas pa la phul/gnyis ka la bcad nas rang gis longs spyad/ kha cig gzhan la byen pa'i las so gsungs/ sngon gro bzhin skyes rgya mtshor nor bu 559

len du 'gro dus/ ma ngus te bu khyod kho mo dang nam zhig 'phrad pa la zer tshe/ ma 'dis bdag 'gro khar bkra mi shis pa smra'o bsam tshig rtsub mo smras pas/ mas bu la khyod kyis bshags pa gyes shig zer ro/ /der ma la bzod par gsol te gro bzhin sgyes 'khor bcas rgya mtshor bzhud nas song / nor bu lon nas slar log ste rgya mtsho'i 'gram du bsdad pas/ sngar la tshig ngan smras pa'i las kyis kho mtshan mo gnyid la shor/ tshong pa gzhan rnams snga bar langs nas 'gro dus/ gro bzhin skyes kyang langs nas snga phyi bar gsum zhig na 'ong gin yod mod snyam nas bsgyur te song bas/ kho rang gnyid sad nas bltas pas tshong pa kun med tshe/ song song nas nyi ma nub pa'i dus su gzhal med khang zhig tu phyin te/ nang na lha mo gzugs bzang ba bzhi dang skyes pa gzugs byad mdzes pa gcig dang lnga po lhan cig tu gnas te dga' mgur spyod pa mthong / zas skom byen nas nyi shar bar du bsdad/ nyi ma shar tshe gzhal med khang de mi snang bar khyi sre bo bzhis skyes bu de kha sbub tu bsgyel te sha pags bcad nas zos/ nyi ma nub tshe sngar bzhin gyur nas dga' mgur spyad pas/ gro bzhin skyes kyis/ 'di ltar gyur pa'i las ci yin dris pas/ mi des bdag gnas pa'i grong gi bshan 560

par gyur pa na srog bcad de 'tsho ba'i tsha/ 'phags pa ka t+yā na byon nas srog gcod spang du bcug pas/ nyin mo ma spangs/mtshan mo spangs pa'i las kyis 'di lta bur gyur/ khyed gnas pa'i grong du 'gro na/ bdag gi bu bshan pa zhig yod pa de la sngar gyi lo rgyus de shod la/ ral gris bcad pa'i 'og na gser bum pa gang yod pa phyung la/ 'phab/sa pa ka t+yā na la bsod snyoms phul/ bdag gi ming nas zungs 'a/ bsngo ba gyis dang /des bdag gi las ngan pa byang bar 'gyur ro zhes shod cig zer/ yang de nas song ba dang / gzhal med khang zhig tu nyi ma shar nas phyin pas/ lha mo gzugs bza nga ba gcig dang skyes pa gzugs byad mdzes pa gcig dang gnyi ga ka lhan cig tu bsdad nas dga' mgur spyod pa 'dug der zas byen nas bsdad pas/ nyi ma nub tshe de dag mi snang bar sbrul chen po zhig byung ste/sgyes bu de la lan gnyis dkris nas spyi rngo/ nas mar zos nyi ma shar ba dang sngar bzhin song tshe/ nadi ltar gyur pa las ci yin dris pas/ bdag gis gnas pa'i grong gi byi bo byed pa'i tshe/ 'phags pa kā t+yā na byon nas sdig pa spang du bcug pas/rtag tu spangs ma nus par mtshan mor ma spangs nyin mor spangs pas 'di lta bur gyur/ khyed ga nas pa'i grong du 'gro na 561

bdag gi bu mo la lo rgyus shod la/ me thab kyi 'og na gser bum pa gang yod pa de phyung la/ 'phags pa kā t+yā na la bsod snyoms phul/ bdag gi ming nas zungs la bsngo ba gyis dang /bdag gi las ngan pa byang bar 'gyur ro zhes shod cig zer/yang de nas song ba dang / lcags kyi grong khyer zhig na/ skyes bu mdog nag po bongs che ba mig dmar ba dbyug pa thogs pa zhig 'dug pa/ de la chu yod dam dris pas cang ma smras tshe/der chu zhes bya ba'i sgra de/ yi dwags lus sdong dum mes tshig pa 'dra ba/ rus kong gi lus la spu dang skras g.yogs pa/ gsus pa ri rab tsam/ rked pa dang rkang lag 'jag ma ltar shin tu phra ba gcig la de 'dra brgya stong du mas bskor ba gcig gis thos nas/ gro bzhin skyes snying rje can bdag la chu blud cig zer/bdag gis kyang chu ma rnyed par gzhan la slong na bdag la chu ga la yod smras pas/ de bden bdag cag gis yi dwags kyi grong khyer 'di nas lo bcu gnyis tsam la chu zhes bya ba'i ming yang ma go zer/ khyed cag gis sngar las ngan ci bsags pas 'dir skyes pa yin zhes dris pas/ bdag cag rnams kyis tshe sngon ser sna byas mchod sbyin cung zad tsam yang ma byas pa'i las kyis 'dir skyes so zer/ de nas yang song tsa na/ gzhal med khang 562

gcig na bud med gzugs byad mdzes nga zhig dar gos gyon nas/ ro brgya ldan pa'i zas za ba zhig ren po che'i khri ri mo sna tshogs bkra ba shin tu mdzes pa zhig gi steng na bde bar 'dugakhri de'i rkang pa bzhi la bzhin mi sdug pa'i yi dwags bzhis btegs nas 'dug pa der bud med des kho rang la zas byen nas/ 'di dag gis zas slong na ma ster zer/ de dag gis bslangs tshe byin pas/ gcig gi kha nas thub mar gyur/ gcig gi kha nas lcags kyi thu lum me 'bar ba/ gcig gi kha nas rang sha gcig gi kha nas rnag khrag tu gyur to/ /'di ltar 'gro ba ci yin dris pas/ kho mo gnas pa'i grong gi bram ze mor gyur pa na/'di dag ni bdag gi khyo dang bu mna' ma/ bran mor gyur dus/bdag gis 'phags pa kā t+yā na la bsod snyoms phul bas ma bzod par 'di bzhi po khros nas/ de'i kha nang du phub ma/lcags kyi thu lum/ kho rang gi sha nag khrag rgyob ces tshig ngan smras pas 'di lta bur gyur/ kho mo sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar skye rgyu yin pa la/ smon lam log pas yi dwags mthu chen mo 'dir sgyes/ khyed gnas pa'i grong du 'gro na/ nga'i bu mo smad tshong byed pa de la lo rgyus shod la/ sngon gyi gnas khang rnying ba na lcags zangs zung bzhi dang / gser gyi mkhar ba dang / ril 563

ba spyi blugs shig yod pa phyung la/ 'phags pa kā t+yā na la bsod snyoms phul/ bdag cag gi ming nas zungs bsngo ba gyis dang /bdag cag gi las ngan pa zad par 'gyur ro zhes shod cig zer/ de ltar phyogs phyogs su 'khyams 'khyams nas lo bcu gnyis song / de nas gnas pa'i grong du sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams rim bzhin bshad nas/ rang yul du 'ong pha ma gnyis kyis skad ngo shes nas ngus pas/ sngar bu yi phyir mya ngan mang bo byas mig nang du ling thog byung nas/ zhar yod pa phyir 'ong bas dga' bde'i gter kha rdol/ de nas gro bzhin skyes 'phags pa kā t+yā na'i drung du song rab tu byung nas/ phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob/ de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar phyin nas dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob/ sngon ston pa 'khor ba 'jig mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su/ rgyal po mdzes ldan gyes mchod rten chen po zhig byed du bcug pa na/ gla mi zhig gis 'di lta bu'i mchod rten chen po byed du bcuge par brtsam pas/nam zhig zin par 'gyur ba ma shes so/ /zhes lan gnyis su 'phyas pa la/ phyis legs par jin pa na/ 'gyod nas gla rngan gyis gser gyi dril bu byed du bcug nas mchod rten la btags pas/ mdog ngan zhing lus chung la skad snyan pa bzang 564

ldan du skyes par gsungs/ sngon rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga na bzhugs pa'i thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor pa zhig la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal gzigs pa'i dus zhal nas/ snyigs dus kyi mi thams cad la dad pa chung dug lnga che ba'i dbang gis mi dge bcu byas pa'i mthus shi tshad re gnyis ma gtogs thams cad mar dmyal bar lhung nas/ yar bla ma dam pa dang 'phags pa bdag gis kyang 'dren dka' bar 'dug ngas gdul bya bod gangs can khrod kyi skye bo pho mo dad can rnams kyis zhal gsung rtsi na mchod sbyin chen bo ma nus kyang / mi dge bcu ma byed par bla ma dang dkon mchog la dad pa gyis/ chos thams cad kyi snying bo yi ge drug ma thon gsungab// mi dge chung ngu tsam byas kyang sdug bsngal chen po myong dgos pas/ des na dus dang rnam pa thams cad du mi dge ba phra zhing phra ba yang dug ltar spong dgos/ spangs na 'chi ba'i dub/ gshin rje'i pho nya stong 'ongs nas/ rke la thag pa sbom po brgya gurgyab nas/ ngo nag po byas thur du brgya stong 'then kyang / ngan song gsum du gtan nas 'khrid mi thub/ ngan song gsum du ma song na/ mtho ris lha mi gnyis min skye sa gzhan med/ da khyed rnams kyis dge ba gzhan byed ma thub kyang / mi dge bcu spa ngas na 'di bas dge 565

ba gzhan med pas/ phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi dge ba chung ngu tsam yang gtan nas mi byed pa gal che'o/ /ngan song gsum du skye ba'i rgyu mi dge bcu byed du 'jug mkhan de rang rgyud kyi gti mug 'dod chags zhe sdang gsum yin pas/ dug gsum po 'di spong dgos/ gti mug che ba'i mi de la tshe 'dir yang gzhan gyis glen pa ma ki zer rtsi sgo med brnyas smod mang / mi shes gti mug dbang gis srog gcod ma byin len rdzun sogs mi dge ba byed nges/ byas na phyi mar ngan song du skyes nas sdug bsngal myong / dge ba dang mi dge ba'i rnam dbye shes nas/tshe 'dir yang mi dge ba spangs dge ba bsgrub na gzhan gyes mkhas pa zer mchod bstod bkur nas skyid po 'ong / tshe phyi mar song yang je bzang je mthor 'gyur/ de nas gti mug sel phyir mtshan ldan gye bla ma bsten nas chos nyan dgos/ 'dod chags can gyi mi de tshe 'dir yang gzhan gyi mi 'dod khag ngan sdug bsngal mang bo steng du 'ong / 'dod chags kyi dbang gis brnab sems rdzun ma byin len sogs mi dge ba byed nges/ byas na phyi mar ngan song du skyes nas sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa myong / 'dod chung chog shes can la tshe 'di phyi gnyis gar bde skyid snyan gsum 'byung / des na 'dod pa gang skyes spangs 566

nas 'dod chung chog shes byed dgos/ zhe sdang can gyi mi de gzhan gyis mthong na dug sbrul mthong ba dang 'dra/ sbrul gyi khog na zhe sdang che ba'i stabs kyis/ mthong na dngangs skrag sgyes/ thag nyer bsdad na 'dis ci byed mi shes snyam lhag par 'jigs/ rdo dbyug pas rgyag ci thub blta/ brgyab na 'ga' res de tshad yin zer/ snying re rje sbrul ma ki yar pang du longs/kho bos len bzang po gyes zer mkhan med/ de bzhin du zhe sdang can gye mi de mthong na skrag pa skye/ mnyam du bsdad na rkyen chung chung re la khros nas bya ba chen por slad e gtong snyam nas lhag par 'jigs/ de la kun gyis kha lag pa gnyis gas mi 'dod pa sna tshogs byed/ byas na 'ga' res de tshad red nyos no yin zer/ a khu drin can po zhe sdang che ngo tsho dmar bor song kha 'ur cha 'dra ba g.yug tshig ngan rdo log 'dra ba 'phangs nas/ gzhan mthong tshad thag ring thung gnyis ga'i snying la rgyag pas cig bzang ga yar la zhog bzang po gyis mi zer/ ga ngo mi rig gi chug de'i kha nang du thal yang ra/ rgyag de yod pa'i khyim tshang de'i sdug ang zer/ shes tshad kyis de rig na zhe sdang langs lkog tu ngan sna tshogs gtam nas dmod kun gyis mig nang gi ling thog bzhin song / rig sa mthong sa med/ de la 567

bzang zhig bshad pa'i mi gcig med/ zhe sdang gi dbang gis gzhan la gnod sems tshig rtsub brdeg brdung sogs byed nges/byas na phyi mar ngan song du skyes nas sdug bsngal yun ring myong /zhe sdang med pa'i mi de gzhan gyis mthong na dga'/ lam zhig nas thug kyang 'tshams 'dri byed/ khyim du song tshe gdan bting bza' btung sogs ci 'dod ster/ gang du song yang gnod 'tshe med/ gal te gzhan gyis gnod pa zhig byas kyang / de la de mi 'bab zer kun gyis gnod skyel mkhan de la ngan smras/ zhe sdang med pa'i mi de la mi bzang bo lha red zer snyan pa brjod/ phyi mar gang du skyes kyang lha'i bu dang bu mo bzhin gzugs byad mdzes/ des na zhe sdang spangs nas rgyun tu bzod pa sgom pa gal che/ yang nyon mongs dug gsum gyi dbang gis sngar mi dge bcu gang byas dang / phyin chad kyang cung zad tsam re byas song na/ de ma thag dug chu khol ma khog tu shor ba lta bu'i gnong 'gyod drag po'i sgos/ bla ma dkon mchog la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul te/ phyag 'tshal nas bshags pa byed dgos/ dper na snga dro dug 'thung na phyi dro sman bzang bos 'tsho ba dang / snga dro rkang ba rdo yis gcur na phyi dro sman btab nas gcud nas sos pa dang / snga dro bu mang gi pha bsad kyang /568

phyi dro lag dmar gyis rgyal po chen por skyabs btsal na tshe thar ba bzhin du/ sdig can yin yang dkon mchog gi drung nas bshags pa byas na/ sdig pa 'dag ste/ sngon sor 'phreng gis mi dgu brgya dang dgu bcu go dgu bsad pa dang / ma skyes dgras yab gzugs can snying bo bsad pa dang / bde byed kyis ma bsad kyang 'gyod sems kyis bshags pa byas pas/ sdig pa dag pa'i lo rgyus rnams bsams nas bshags pa byed pa gal che/ dper na rma la sman btab na sos gin snyam nas/ rma kha rnying ba'i nang du gri so mas yang yang brgyab na sman ji ltar bzang rung mi sos par 'chi ba bzhin/ sdig pa bshags pa byas na 'dag gin snyam yang yang byas na bshags pa ji ltar byas kyang mi 'dag ngan song gsum du lhung nas sdug bsngal bzod glags med pa myong dgos/ des na phyin chad srog la babs kyang sdig pa'i las mi byed snyam pa'i dam bca' byed dgos/ 'o de ltar mi dge spangs nas dge ba bsgrub na bzang /dge ba bsgrub na phan yon ci 'dra yod zer na/ dge ba'i mthus mi lus thob nas/ tshe ring nad med gzugs byad mdzes mthon po'i rigs su skyes/ stobs 'byor che/ 'gro rta thoga'adug gdan thog lus gos rgyan/ kha ja chang zas zhim mngar 569

dang mi 'bral/ blon 'bangs mang bo'i dbus na rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar mtho/ chos dang 'jig rten gang byed kyang rang dbang yod/ bla ma dam pa bsten nas chos byas na myur du 'tshang rgya/yang dge ba'i mthus shar phyogs mngon dga' nub phyogs bde ba can sogs sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam par dag par skyes na/ skye rga na 'chi 'du 'bral brdeg brdung sogs sdug bsngal gyi ming tsam yang med/ sa gzhi rin po che las grub pa lag mthil ltar mnyam pa reg na 'jam zhing bde ba/ dri ma med cing 'od gsal ba tsan dan sbrul gyi snying bo'i dri bsung dang ldan pa/ lha'i me tog sna tshogs gcal du dkram pa mtha' rin po che'i pha gu dang rtsig pa gser dngul mu tig gi phye ma gram par brdal ba/ ut+pal ku mud ta pad+ma dpag bsam shing gis brgyan pa/ yan lag brgyad ldan gyi mtsho dang dzing bu 'khyil ba'i khar ngang ba sogs bya sna tshogs kyi skad snyan sgog cing dga' zhing 'phyo la lding ba/ rin chen sna lnga'i khang ba/ dar zas du ma'i stan dang / mchod pa'i lha dang lha mo sogs 'dod yon longs spyod dpag tu med pa yod/ gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim ro mngar reg bya 'jam pa'i 'dod yon la spyod bzhin/zhing de'i rigs kyi bdag po de rnams kyi gsung chos la nyan/570

nyams su blangs na 'tshang rgya/ yang dge ba'i mthus sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob na/ sku mtshan bzang bo sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang bo brgyad cus spras pa/ sku mthong na mi mthun pa med cing mthong ba tsam gyes don dang ldan par byed pa/gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i gdangs pi wang gling bu las brgya stong khri 'gyur gyis ches shin tu snyan cing / rigs drug sems can so so'i skad du chos ston nus pa/ thugs kyis sems can gyi skyid sdug legs nyes thams cad lag pa'i mthil gye ri mo la bltas pa ltar/ sgrib med sa ler mkhyen cing / dgra gnyen bar ma'i sems can rnams la phyogs ris med par ma bzang mo'i bu rnams la byams pa ltar brtse ba sems can 'dul ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ sku yi sgo nas 'od zer re re tsam spros pas kyang / sems can mang bo smin grol gyi lam la 'god cing / sdug bsngal myong ba mthong na dmyal ba'i me dong chen po yin yang 'dod ldan pad+ma'i tshal du 'jug pa ltar zhugs nas sdug bsngal sel zhing / bde ba med pa'i sems can rnams la yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar/ ci 'dod kyi dngos po mtha' dag byin nas re ba skong nus/ gang du gnas kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing / gang du song kyang bde ba'i lam/ ci zhig mdzad 571

kyang sems can gyi 'gro don/ ci zhig gsung yang zab rgyas kyi chos/ mdor na skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan yin pas/rang nyid skyid pa phar zhog sems can thams cad bde skyid kyi dpal la 'god nus/'o na da mi lus thob pa dang / dag pa'i zhing du skye ba dang sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa gsum gyi gang bsgrub dgos/gcig bsgrub bam/ gnyis bsgrub/ gsum po bsgrub dgos zer na/ gcig bsgrub na gzhan gnyis shugs kyis 'grub pa yin/gcig po de gang yin zer na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yin/dper na ded dpon zhig gis gru btang ste rgya mtsho'i gling du song nas gser dngul ma blangs kyang / 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i yid bzhin gye nor bu blangs na gser dngul sogs ci 'dod thams cad nor bu la gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis 'byung ba bzhin/ da res mi lus rin po che thob dus 'dir 'thob bya bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i phyir du rnam dkar dge ba bsgrub na mngon mtho nges legs kyi bde skyid thams cad yid smon byas pa tsam gyes 'byung / des na sangs rgyas thugs rje can gyis dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal chen grangs med 572

gsum du tshogs bsags/ mthar myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa yin/ rang cag rnams sangs rgyas kyi rjes 'jug yin pas de ltar bsgrub dgos/ 'o na sems bskyed de ji ltar byed dgos zer na/ byang chub kyi sems de bskyed pa'i sngon du byams snying rje bsgom dgos/ byams snying rje ma bsgom par byang chub kyi sems legs po mi 'ong / jo bo chen po'i zhal nas/ byams pa dang snying rje sbyangs mi dgos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bod kyis shes/ zhes skyon gtam gsungs pa red/'o na ci tsug byed zhus pas/ dang po nas go rim du bslabs nas byed dgos gsungs/ des na 'o skol rnams kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma ma mchis pas na/ sa phyogs 'dir ma skyes bya ba khab rtse 'dzugs sa tsam med/ lus 'di ma blangs bya ba gcig kyang med de/ lus dor ba'i sha rus bsag rgyu zhig yin na ri rab bas kyang dpangs mtho/ khrag dang chu ser bsags na rgya mtsho bas kyang mang / sems can thams cad kyis rang gi pha ma ma byas pa gcig kyang med/ sems can re res pha ma byas pa grangs kyis mi chod/ des na nged rang tshos skabs rer pha ma sems can thams cad tsho zer ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ dud 'gro'i rten la pha ma byas dus/ kho rang gis thub tshod 'gyu tshod kyis phan 573

btags/ gnod pa bsal/ khyad par mi'i rten la pha ma byas dus tshe 'di'i pha mas ji ltar bskyangs pa bzhin drin gyes bskyangs pa sha stag yin/ mngar ba'i nu zho blud/ snyan pa'i ming nas bos/ sha'i drod la klan/ zas lce yis snyod/ snabs khas phyis/ mi gtsang ba lag pas phyis/ yar cher song nas/'jam pa'i gos bskon/ zhim pa'i zas byin/ bsags pa'i nor sprad/ sdug sdig gtam ngan gang la ma 'dzem par phan tshad med btags/ gnod pa tshad med pa las bskyabs pas na drin can sha stag yin zhes sangs rgyas kyis gsungs/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung la rdzun med bden/ sngar pha ma byas drin can yin par ma zad/ da dung yang ma 'ongs pa na rang nyid 'khor bar skyes na sems can thams cad kyis pha ma byas nas drin gyis skyong bas na drin che/ da lta yang rang res rnams kyis khar za tshad rgyab tu gon tshad thams cad pha ma sems can gyi drin yin/chos shig bsgrub na yang pha ma sems can la brten nas bsgrub dgos/ mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang / nges legs thar ba tsam dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang kyang pha ma sems can la brten nas 'thob dgos pas na drin che ste/ 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum du drin che ba'i pha ma sems can thams cad yal 574

bar 'dor ga la rung / drin gzo bzang bo zhig ci nas kyang byed dgos te/ deng sang tshe 'dir zas gos cung zad kyis phan btags pa dang / dgra'i gnod pa las bskyabs pa'i mi zhig la drin can yin zhes smras drin gzo byed na/ tshe rabs mang bor phan pa tshad med btags/ gnod pa tshad med las bskyabs pa'i pha ma sems can drin can rnams la drin gzo zhig ci la mi dgos/ tshe 'di'i pha ma gnyis la bu yis rgas dus ma byams na kun gyes bu ngan khrel med na rag zer na/ pha ma sems can yongs la drin gzo zhig med na/ de bas khrel gzhung chung ba zhig gzhan na med/ drin can gyi pha ma sems can thams cad kyi 'dod pa bde ba 'dod kyang / bsgrub pa sdug bsngal gye rgyu bsgrub zhe 'dod dang lag len phyin ci log tu song ba'i stabs kyis/ spyir 'khor ba khyad par ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal tshad med myong ba'i pha ma drin can 'di rnams snying re rje/ pha ma sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan na ci ma rung / bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces byams pa bsgom dgos/ sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i pha ma sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral na ci ma rung / sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral 575

bar gyur cig ces snying rje bsgom dgos/ nges par rang nyid bzang po zhig yin na pha ma sems can la phan thogs shig byed dgos pas mi tshad 'phyis 'phyis 'dra da ni 'dug pa'i tshod ma red/ pha ma sems can dmyal bar skye ba rnams kyis nyin rer sdug bsngal myong ba bsam na bzod glags mi 'dug sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal bsal nas bde ba dang ldan pa zhig ci nas kyang bdag gis bya/ da lta de lta bu'i nus pa ma mchis kyang da ni sems can thams cad kyi don du rang nyid skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che myur ba myur du 'thob par bya/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de 'thob pa'i phyir du/ rnam dkar dge ba'i las rnams bsgrub par bya'o snyam pas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed dgos/ de ltar byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgyed na phan yon ci yod zer na/ byams pa bsgom na/ dngos po shin tu rgya che bas phyag dang mchod pa'i zhing mchog rgyal ba rnams la dus rtag tu mchod pa byed pa las bsod nams che ste/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ bye ba khrag khrig dkrigs pa'i zhing dag na/ /mchod pa rnam mang dpag med ji snyed pa/ /skyes mchog rnams la de yis rtag mchod pas/ /byams pa'i sems kyi grangs dang char mi 576

phod/ /ces dang / 'jam dpal zhing bkod las/ byang shar mtshams na sangs rgyas dbang phyug chen pos rgyal po'i 'jig rten gyi khams stong gis brgyan pa zhes bya ba de na/ dge slong 'gog pa la zhugs pa'i bde ba bzhin du sems can rnams kyang bde ba dang ldan no/ /der lo bye ba brgya stong du tshangs par spyod pa spyad pas ni/ zhing 'dir tha na se gol gtogs pa'i yun tsam du/ sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems bskyed na snga ma las bsod nams ches mang du bskyed na/ nyin mtshan du gnas pa lta ci smos zhes gsungs/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/ rji'u tshos sum brgya'i kha zas dag /nyin re bzhin du sbyin pas kyang / /byams pa yud tsam thang gcig gis/ /bsod nams dag la char mi phod/ /lha mi byams par 'gyur ba dang / /de dag gis ni bsrung ba dang / /yid bde ba dang bde med dang / /dug dang mtshon gyi gnod med dang / /'bad pa med par don 'thob dang / /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten skye 'gyur te/ /gal te grol bar ma gyur kyang / /byams chos yon tan brgyad 'thob bo/ /zhes gsungs/ byams pa yod na lha mi byams shing ngang gis 'du ba dang / rgyal bas kyang bdud sde byams pa'i stobs kyis pham par mdzad pa/ bsrung ba'i mchog tu yang 577

'gyur ro/ /snying rje bsgom na sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal sel 'dod bde la 'god 'dod kyi blo ngang ngam shugs kyis skye ste/ de skyes na sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde bar 'god pa la rang nyid sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob dgos par go nas/ de thob thabs thos bsam bsgom gsum sogs la 'bad nges/ 'bad na myur du thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob/ thob nas kyang snying rje'i dbang gis zhi bar skad cig tsam yang mi gnas par 'khor ba ma stong bar du sems can gye don mdzad par 'gyur/ 'di la dgongs nas chos yang dag par sdud pa las/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i chos rab tu mang bo la bslab par mi bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i chos gcig rab tu bzung zhing rab tu rtogs par bgyis na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad de'i lag mthil na mchis pa lags so/ /chos gcig pu gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ snying rje chen po'o/ /bcom ldan 'das snying rje chen pos ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lag mthil na mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das dper bgyis na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i 'khor lo rin po che de gang du mchis pa der dpung gi 578

tshogs thams cad mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po gang du mchis pa der sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dper bgyi na/ srog gi dbang po mchis na dbang po gzhan rnams kyang mchis par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du snying rje chen po mchis na byang chub sems dpa'i chos gzhan rnams kyang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che bskyed na/ sems bskyed pa tsam gyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gral du chud phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyi sras su 'gyur/ rgyal ba'i sras po zhes bya ba'i ming thob cing 'gro ba lha dang mi thams cad kyi phyag dang mchod pa'i gnas su 'gyur te/ mdo sde za ma tog bkod pa las/ sems can gang yang rung ste/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga yid la sems pa med kyang / tshig tu brjod pa tsam gyis skad cig de nyid la theg pa chen po'i rigs kyi sa bon rgyud la thebs par 'gyur bas/ de ma thag tu sems dpa' zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro'o/ /gsungs/ spyod 'jug las/ de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to/ /zhes dang / byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar 579

bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing / /'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas/ bsod nams chung ngu bsags kyang bskyed nas/ bsod nams chung ngu bsags kyang 'bras bu mtha' yas pa 'byen te/gzhan yang rin po che'i phung po las/ stong gsum gye sems can thams cad so so nas sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten ri rab tsam byed la de dag la yang bskal ba bye ba snyed du bsti stang du bya ba thams cad kyis bste stang byed pa las/ byang sems kyis thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems dang ma bral bas me tog gcig tsam dor ba bsod nams mang bar gsungs/ lha rnams kyis dus rtag tu bsrung ba dang / sngags sogs bsgrub na 'grub sla ba dang / de yod pa'i sa phyogs der nad yams mu ge 'khrug rtsod sogs mi 'ong zhing / byung ba rnams kyang zhi bar 'gyur/gzhan gyis gnod pa nyung / gnod pa byung na yang yun ring drag pos mi 'debs/ brjed pa dang gnas ngan len chung / khro ba dang phrag dog chung / ngan song gsum du nam yang mi skye/myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa sogs byang chub sems kyi phan yon mtha' yas te/ dpal gyis zhus pa las/ byang chub 580

sems kyi bsod nams gang / /de la gal te gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang ste/ /de ni de bas lhag par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs jo bo chen pos rdo rje gdan la bskor ba mdzad nas/ ji ltar byas na myur du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob snyam du dgongs pa na/ sku gzugs chung ba rnams bzhengs nas che ba rnams la myur du 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas/gang la bslab par bya zhes dris pa na/ byang chub kyi sems la bslab par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ gan dzha la'i steng gi nam mkha' na bud med rgan pa zhig la gzhon pa zhig gis dris pa la'ang lan sngar ltar mdzad pa gsan pas/ byang chub kyi sems la thugs nges che bar song skad/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i zhal gye bum bzang las/ sems bskyed theg mchog lam gyi gzhung shing ste/ /rlabs chen spyod pa rnams kyi gzhi dang rten/ /tshogs gnyis kun la gser 'gyur rtsi lta bu/ /rab 'byams dge tshogs sdud pa'i bsod nams gter/ /zhes gsungs/ des na bla ma rnams kyis chos tshig bzhi zhig gi lung byed kyang / thog mar/'o mar gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin bo che ci nas kyang myur ba myur du thob par bya/581

de'i phyir du dam pa'i chos zab mo gsan par bgyi'o snyam pa'i sgo nas nyon gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin/ khyed tsho rgan rgon 'ga' res/ ma sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas pa'i ched du/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ tsho zer ba de yang phar ded na tshig rtsa ba can zhig yin/ des na khyed tshos dge ba gang sgrub kyang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi sgo nas byed pa 'di shin tu gal che/ rgyas pa mi shes pa rnams kyis bsdu na ma sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du dge ba 'di bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa'i sgo nas sgrub dgos/'o de ltar sems bskyed bzang po'i sgo nas dge tshogs ji ltar sgrub dgos zer na/ rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la ci yod kyi rgyu nom phul la/lus ngag gi zhabs tog gyis/ ci gsung gi bka' bzhin sgrubs la thugs ci mnyes gyis dang / phan yon che/ yon tan rin po che sdud pa las/ nad pa'i tshogs kyis gso phyir sman pa bsten pa ltar/ g.yel ba med par dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par bya/ ci'i phyir zhe na mkhas pa'i yon tan de las 'byung / zhes dang / thal 'gyur las/ ston pa de la yon tan 582

ni/ /dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang 'dra ba yin/ /yon tan dpag tu med pa thob/ /de la dmigs te bla ma bsten/ /zhes dang / ye shes rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ rang gi rdzas dang yo byad kyis/ /bla ma mnyes par sus byas pa/ /'dis ni khams gsum 'khor ba las/ /sprul sku'i zhing du dbugs dbyung ste/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i sar gshegs so/ /zhes gsungs/ sngon 'brom rin po ches/ jo bo rje la/sngar khong gis chos byas tshad gang lam du song lags zhes zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ bla ma se btsun pa'i sku g.yog lo 'ga' byas pa de lam du song gsungs/ yang bla ma la dad cing gus pa'i sgo nas chos zhus nas nyan na phan yon che/ thos pa'i tshoms las/ thos pas chos rnams shes par 'gyur/ /thos pas sdig las ldog par 'gyur/ /thos pas don ma yin pa spong / /thos pas mya ngan 'das pa thob/ /ces gsungs/ sngon dge slong gnyis kyis lam kha zhig nas/ chos bshad byas pa khyi mo zhig gis thos pas/ khyi mo shi nas lhar skyes/ yang 'phags pa sdud pa zhal 'don mdzad pa'i dge slong zhig gi grwa shag na bya thi ba zhig yod pa des yang yang thos pas sgrib pa dag shi nas mir skyes/ chos slob dus 'phags pa sdud pa slob ma dgos par 583

bltas pa tsam gyis shes blo la zin pa byung gsungs/ yang gser dngul sogs kyis bris pa'i thar mdo 'phags pa sogs blangs nas a mchod bzang po bzhag nas 'don du bcug na bzang /chos shig blangs na dbu khang na sku'i rten sangs rgyas kyi 'dra sku/gsung gi rten chos kho rang / thugs kyi rten mchod rten yod pas sku gsung thugs rten tshang / sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi dod du sangs rgyas kyi 'dra sku/ chos dkon mchog gi dod du chos kho rang / dge 'dun dkon mchog gi dod du a mchod yod pas/ de rnams la dkon mchog gsum gyi 'du shes bzhag nas/ nang bye dor byas/ yon chab mar me bdug spos sgon/ a mchod la zas bzang phul/ ja bzang drangs/ phyag bskor byas/'gro khar 'bul ba legs po phul na/ a mchod kyis/ bdag sogs 'khor bcas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dkon mchog gsum dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing / /dkon mchog gsum po rgyun du mchod pa dang / /dkon mchog gsum gye 'phrin las 'jug par shog /ces ja mchod bton pa ltar/ tshe rabs thams cad du dkon mchog gsum dang mi 'bral zhing / dkon mchog gsum gyi 'phrin las 'jug pa yin/ sngon sangs rgyas kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor dus tshangs pa brgya byin sogs 584

dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams kyi gsung rab 'di phyin chad sus 'don kyang / de dang de'i mi phyugs 'khor bcas la nyin mtshan kun tu bsrung skyob byed ces khas blangs yod pas/ tshe 'di'i bar chad sel ba'i sku rim la yang de min mi dgos/ chos re re bton pa'i phan yon bshad rgyu yin na/ brjod kyis mi lang /yang a mchod 'dug dus zhabs tog legs/ 'gro dus 'bul ba legs na/ a mchod kyi bsam pa legs/ legs gsum yin/a mchod yul du song nas/ khyim tshang de la tshe ring bkra shis zer/ gzhan shes tshad kyis de tshang gis a mchod de la 'di 'dra zhig byin zer/ khyem tshang bzang bo zer ba de red las can tshang zer/ 'ga' res de tshang gis phyin chad a mchod la nged kyi bla ma ban de 'di tsho'i gcig e 'jog snyam/yang bla rgan 'ga' res kho cig e 'jog snyam heb ldang / phyin chad a mchod cig dgos dus nga 'dug zer ba mang mtshan snyan grags rgyas/ kun la 'dang rtsis sgo che bas bzang yang khyed tsho'i khyim tshang 'ga' res chos leb re mi len/ a mchod re mi 'jog sngar chos dang thang ga 'dra yod pa'i mdun du spos mar me re mi 'jog thang ga dud par btang / chos kyi steng du sa rdul chags su bcug rang gi gos ngan hral hrul 585

dang snod cha yan chad bzhag skabs shig chos 'di tsho 'o brgyal la gtad ni red ri bkal 'gel dus theg yang dka' kin zer/ sa phug brag phug tsho la bskyal/ bra byis sogs kyis stan byas rlung gis khyer char gyis brlan du bcug ste/ sngar bas 'o brgyal chen por gtad nas/ phyi mar chos dang mi 'phrad pa'i las ngan bsags pa 'di mi bzang / yang 'ga' res a mchod cig bzhag kyang / yar gyi phu'i stan rdol rag gi bar du bzhag nas chos 'don du mi 'jug mar gyi 'gab du bzhag nas rkang gi lham rdol rag bar du 'tsho skyong byed du bcug zas bzang po zhig za na phud bza' mi gnyis kyis zos/ zas lhag ja 'phro a mchod la drangs zhabs tog rtsog pas 'dug tshul med/ a mchod 'gro dus/ bzung na rang nor mi nyan btsong na gzhan gyis mi nyo ba'i rta rgan 'bri rgan lug rgan re byin nas/ 'bul ba rtsog pas 'gro tshul med tshe/ a mchod kyi bsam pa de yang rtsog rtsog gsum yin/ a mchod sngar bsdad dus kho de tshang la 'phrag tu chug 'phrod du chug de'i kha rjes yar la 'gro ru chug zer bsam pa bzang po zhig yod pa de gnas 'gyur nas/a ho khos chos mang bo bton dka' las 'di 'dra myangs pa la/chos bton pa'i 'bul ba mi dgos/ 'ong ba btus pa'i 586

tshegs rin tsam yang med gi zer ba de kho la byung / brgya bsam na gcig mi 'grub rgyu tshang / ngo mi rig gi 'jug rgyu tshang /kha thur du 'gro rgyu tshang / phyin chad de tshang la mi 'gro bar shog ma rabs ser rag zer zhe sdang langs nas yul du 'gro/'ga' res de tshang gis a mchod de la 'bul ba cher ma byen 'dug de 'dra gzhan gye g.yog por bsdad kyang ster 'ong /khyem tshang de 'dra'i ma rabs yi dwags zer ngan smras byed mkhan mang / des phyin chad a mchod re 'jog 'dod kyang sdod mkhan yang dkon pas de 'dra ma byed dang bzang / yang rang gi yul phyogs dang yul gzhan gyi dge 'dun pa mchog dman gang yin yang / mthong na sngon nas bsus/ nang du bos/ gong gi bzhag bza' btung drangs/ rang gis gang 'dzoms gyi rgyu nom pa phul na bsod nams che/ sngon bram ze bu mo zhes bya bas/dge slong gcig la khab cig phul bas 'phags pa shā ri'i bur gyur/ sgyu ru ra gcig phul bas stong 'khor los bsgyur rgyal dang 'gran pa'i longs spyod can du skyes/ bud med cig gis dge sbyong zhig la zas phud zhal gang drangs pas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar skyes gsungs/ yang khyed skya bo pho mo 'ga' res/bla rgan tsho mnyam du yun ring bsdad na skyon mthong dad pa yal 587

khong tsho mnyam snyam rogs su mthong / yar la brtsi bkur mi byed/bla rgan rnams la kha ming sna ming btags/ na tsha shi chad re'i dus phan btags pa'i drin mi shes/ bla rgan gcig de heb che/yang de lto che gcig po des ser sna che/ gzhan pa de'i sdom pa khrig khrig med/ gcig tshig rtsub che rang re'i skyes pho mo tsho'i thu red zer khas btang / 'u tsho'i phyogs kyi ser mo 'di tsho'i bya ba 'di zer spyi bsdus byas smod pa 'di mi rung / yang 'ga' res bla rgan 'gab tu bzhag kho rang gong gi bsdad/ rtsag rgan nang nas 'gul 'phag zhor la/ bla rgan ci la 'ong / 'di la cig byin tsho zer zas lhag sna sne re byen nas/ brnyas sgod byed pa 'di mi rung / lhag bsam bskul ba las/ dge slong dman la brnyas pa yongs mi bya/ /bskal pa gcig gis thar ba 'thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ tshe 'dir yang khyim pa pho mo la bsod nams skye/ bla rgan rnams tsho brgya ngan rung lha mi'i rgyal pos phyag byed pa'i dge 'dun mchog gi gral yin pas khyim pa pho mos smod bya ga la yin/ skyon rig tshad mkhris nad can gyis dung dkar bo la bltas na ser por mthong ba ltar rang gi las sgrib kyi skyon yin/ sdig sgrib che bas bla rgan rnams kyi yon tan ma mthong ba yin/ bla rgan rnams dang khyed tsho 'dra na/ sang 588

'chi nangs 'chi zer ba'i nad pa tshabs chen zhig gi steng nas/bla rgan rnams kyis dbyangs byas chos bton na/ de ma thag nad sos 'khun dwangs nas/ da nad pa kha tshur 'khor 'dug a khu drin can tshos phan btags zer ba mang / khyim pa rnams brgya bzang rung chos ngo mi shes/ nad pa'i steng nas dbur zhig byas de khag bzhag nas nad pa je thur song ba mang / dper na gser med pa'i mi chen dang / gser yod pa'i mi chung chung zhig gnyis mi 'dra ba bzhin/ chos ngo mi shes pa'i khyem pa rigs mtho ba dang / chos shes pa'i bla rgan sdom ldan phar zhogasdom shor zhig dang de gnyis mi 'dra khyad che/ rin po che'i phung bo'i mdo las/ rab byung babs nas khyim par song ba la dge slong gzhan gyis smad pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong dag de skad ma zer cig dad pa dang mos pa mang ba 'gyod pa dang ldan pas mi dga' na khyim du gnas pa ni dad pa can gye chos yin te/ 'di dag ni 'di nas shi 'phos nas dga' ldan du skye zhing / phyis kyang byams pa'i bstan pa la nyan thos 'dus pa dang por chud par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/ bla rgan rnams kyis gson dus phan pa ltar/ shi bo re'i dus chos bton na phyi mar yang phan nges/ 'di phyi gnyis ka dgos pas 589

rang gi yul phyogs kyi bla rgan rnams tsho sos dal bde dus ma brnyas dang / mkho ba'i dus tshod mang po 'byung / des na mchod bstod bkur na bzang / yang sprang slong 'ong ba tshe rabs snga ma'i pha ma yin snying rje soms la/ zas gos byin dang phan yon che/ phyi mar gang byin de las brgya stong 'gyur gyis bsod nams thob/ myur mo byas byin na rang gi don myur mo byas 'grub/ khyi bkag 'jigs pa 'ong du ma bcug na rang gis rgyu nom btsal dus su 'jigs skrag mi 'ong / rang gi lag gis byen na/ rgyu nom btsal tshad mi lag mang po brgyud mi dgos par rang gi lag tu 'ong ste/ sngon bud med cig gis ngan slong zhig la lto zhig byen pas/ phyi mar rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i khang ba zhig tu ro brgya ldan pa'i zas za ba zhig tu skyes skad/yang khyed tsho'i 'ga' res khyi zug gi su red cig ltos zer bltas nas sprang slong zhig yin tshe/ ang de su ma red sprang po zhig red zer/ zas ster ba phar zhog tha na khyis 'cha' yang mi 'gog sprang po kha skom pho ba ltogs lus ngal nas 'ong dus/ khye ngan thams cad phyogs phyogs nas 'ong ste/ gson por za la khad byas tshe/ skrag cing dngangs nas khyu dang 'thab bzhin bsdad na 'ga' res/ zas cung zad cig ster kyang sprang po'i 590

skyid sdug mi shes par byis pa 'ga' re la ga sprang po ma gi la byen zhes smras kyang / byis pa rtse dga' la g.yeng nas ma khyer bar yun ring 'gor na/ rdo'i 'og tu 'jug rgyu bo ga khyer zer bsdigs na byis pas khyer tshe/ khyi rnams ngar cher song 'dzin la khad byas tshe sprang bo khyi la skrag nas sprang khug kha legs po bzed dka'/ byes pas snod du ldug mi shes/ rtsam pa yin na phyed skya tshubs se sa la 'bo/ phyed snod ngor lus/ phyed sprang khug ngo la 'gos nas zhabs su song dus/ du ba 'then rgyu tsam min med de phar ldog dus khye mang bos 'gro ru mi 'jug khyi 'ga' res rtsam khug zhabs nas bzung ste/ khug ma brtol nas rtsam pa skya tshubs se btang / thams cad sa la bsres khyi 'ga' res nywa la bzung nas khrag tsa rer btang ba mang / sprang pos de'i gces ro kha zhog zer dmod mo byed/ phar song nas de tshang gi ro 'drad cha bos de ring ma bzang der ma song na ched zer/ 'di 'dra byas na mi bzang / nga sngon mtsho snying du bsdad dus slob bu lha chen zer ba zhig yod pa khrid nas a rig tu sprang du song tshe/khyem tshang 'ga' re'i khyis 'dzin la khad byas rdo dang dbyug pas 'thab bzhin sgo nas bsdad na/ yun ring ma 'ong tshe da 'gro lags de tshang 'ong rgyu ma red khyes 'cha' gi zer/ ngas 591

sdod dang 'ong 'ong nga sngar song dus rnams su 'di las ring ba 'gor dus yod ma sun dang 'ong smras/ yun ring 'gor nas byes pa res gcig khyer 'ong dus ngo mi rig gi 'jug rgyu tshang 'di cung zad po la mi lon rgyu ci yod/ myur mo byas byin btang na ched zer dmod mo byed/ de 'dra mang po byung tshe a ho phyin chad sprang po re 'ong dus 'di 'dra byed nyan rgyu ma red zer/des na khyed tshos sprang po re 'ong na khye mi 'gog zas skom cung zad ster na yang yun ring bar du mi ster ba 'di mi rung / yang 'ga' res sprang po de rig na yar ma 'ong zer bsdigs/ 'ong na ngo tsho bltas na cig 'dra 'dra bo zer kha ming sna ming btags nas bgad brnyas smod byas/ cung zad bsdad na da song rtsam pa byin tshar da bsdad nas thal ba za rgyu e yin/ da song ma 'dug ya rgyug zer tshig ngan sna tshogs smras nas/ byen pa'i zas kyis kha mi 'gangs kyang tshig ngan mang bos byang khog stod 'gengs su 'jug pa 'di yang mi bzang / yang sprang bo 'ga' res gzhan gyi khye kha ma chod sa zos mid par ma song / rdo 'chos sos ma chod/ srog ma chod 'dug ma thub par khyem tshang 'ga' res sgor yang yang 'ong na/ 'o khyod de'i nyin zhig la 'ong yang yang 'ong nas khyod kyis gsog bzhag no 'di na yod pa e yin/592

da kha nang du thal brgyag ngan pa rnyog gi ma 'jug zer ba de khyod 'dra la zer/ yang 'ga' res bos nas/ 'e 'di de nyin 'ong ba de red ci yang ster mi dgos zer/ da ma 'dug song ci la bsdad zer zhe sdang langs nas tshig ngan mda' mdung 'dra bas sprang po'i snying la brgyab na/ sprang po de phar song nas lkog tu a ho ngo mi rig gi 'jug rgyu po/ kho bo'i 'byor ba che sa rgyu nom rnyed sa'i rigs las ngan nas ma snyogs/ thag nye'i bsdad nas ci yang med tshe sdug thug nas 'ong ba ma gtogs/ phyug nas skyid ma theg par khyed tshang gi sgor ltad mo zhig yod nas yang yang 'ong ba ga la yin/ da phyin chad mu ges 'chi rung /de'i sgor song nas ched/ zas ster mi dgos khye yang mi 'gog par 'cha' ru 'jug de'i sgo la mi 'gro ba'i smon lam thob/ kha thur du 'gro rgyu tshang zer smon lam log pa btab dmod mo byed pa yin pas 'di mi bzang / sngon bza' mi gnyis 'khon nas skyes pas bud med la gcig brdungs pas/ bud med kyis skyes pa bsgyel nas 'og tu mnan tshe 'og nas 'ga' 'phag nas khyod kho'i thad tsho'i shed can po red min shed de 'dra che rgyu mi 'dug zer bzhin/ nged rang tshos sprang po la ster ba'i za ma de sprang po'i thad tsho'i nom pa yin mod/ rtsam pa spar gang la ci 593

yang med pas/ de'i steng nas mi sems la tshig g.yag sems la gri bzhag nas mi ngan gyi rtags bstan ming ngan zhig len pa 'di mi bzang / sprang po ma gtogs rtsam pa spar gang gzhan phyug po zhig la ster rgyu yin na za ba phar zhog a kho sprang po zhig la ster ster byas khyod kyi thad tsho'i kho sprang bo red ang zer cig ro 'go'i 'dug la byed/ des na sprang bo zhig sgo la lan mang bo 'ong yang 'di snying rje zas ma rnyed par 'ongs pa los yin/ phyug po rnams lan mang 'ong ba phar zhog lan cig tsam yang mi 'ong bas/ 'di la zas shig byin na tshe 'dir ngas kho rang la phan btags pa red/ phyi mar zas byin pa 'di bsod nams brgya 'gyur gyis rang la 'ong bas na sprang po 'dis nga la phan btags 'dug don la 'di yang yang 'ong ba gnod skyel du 'ong ba ma red phan chen po 'dogs su 'ong ba red soms la lan brgya 'ong yang bzhin mdangs 'dzum bzhin gang yod ci mkho byin/ ster rgyu med dus de ring khyod la ster rgyu cang med pas/ phyi nas yod dus su shog dang yang ster zhes kha bzang shod dang / sprang bo des kyang sems la mi gnod par des sngar lan grangs mang bor 'ga' byen/ de bden nga la ngo tsha rgyu ma 'ong ba yin/ gzhan zhig yin na da tsam zhe sdang langs bsdigs 594

nas gsod la byed pa'i tshod yin/ drin can po des de ring tshig ngan tsam yang mi bshad pas tshe ring bkra shis kha rje yar la 'gro ru chug zer de ltar gyis dang bzang / yang dkon mchog gsum la dmigs nas mar me dang me tog bdug spos sogs phul dang bzang / tshe phyi mar gang du skyes kyang gzugs mdzes/dri zhim bro ba'i lus len/ sangs rgyas la dmigs nas me tog cig nam mkhar gtor na yang / mi de mthar sangs rgyas thob ces snying rje bad+ma dkar po'i mdo nas gsungs/ yang dbyar ston bla ma mar bsod dang nas bsod du phebs dus/ gang yod kyis 'brel che thogs chung thogs gyis dang bzang / nyag phrug 'das log gis/ bla ma mang pos dmyal ba'i sgo mang bo phyes nas/ sems can mang bo yar lam dkar bo gyen du 'dren pa mthong / 'ga' re gshin rje tshos 'gror mi 'jug par thur du 'khrid pa mthong nas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la dris pas/ yar drangs pa de rnams 'brel thogs rnams red/ mar 'khrid pa de 'brel med pa dang 'brel yod kyang phyi nas dad log byas khas btang ba rnams red gsungs/ yang dbyar ston bla ma mar bsod dang nas bsod pa mang bo byung tshe/ khyed tsho khyem pa bsod nams dang skal ba dman pa 'ga' res/ da lo 595

bla ma re mang gi 'di ci byung ba yin nam/ bla ma'i tshang zhig 'thor song ba zhig dang rig gi gcig 'phro la gnyis slebs nas/ byin gi byen gi 'dzad rgyu med/ a wa wa zer snang ba sun zhen pa log zhe sdang langs/ yang 'ga' res yul mi tsho bos nas 'e ya gi na bla ma dpon slob 'ga' mdung nge mdung nge 'ong gi dang bla ma zhig tshang yin pa 'dra/ yin phyin kho yul na med ces shod zer sbas yib nas bsdad bla mas kha dar phyag mdud re byin tshe stong 'og cig la 'gro ba las thu/ med rabs mug rabs kyis bshad rgyu lung ba gang yod/ bshad bshad nas kha dar phyag mdud phyir ster/ yang 'ga' res mi 'thad bzhin du tshur blangs nas ma dad pa'i rnam 'gyur rtsog pa kha gnyer mchu g.yon mchil ma 'phen/ u hu zer lu brnyas smod mang bo byas cig byin pa ma byin pa dang khyad par med/ de ltar byas tshe bla ma grwa pa thams cad kyi snang ba sun/ 'ga' res da lo 'dir ma phebs na ched/ yul 'di'i ngo mi rig tu chug khos kha dar phyag mdud khyer ba des 'di skad zer/ zhes de'i bshad tshul dang rnam 'gyur gyi lad mo byas/ yul ngan mu ge'i grong khyer 'dir phyin chad cig 'ong na zhes mi 'ong ba'i zhe mna' bskyal/de phyin chad sde ba de'i mi ngan de 'dra re gnyis kyi grib mas/596

sbyin bdag dad can 'ga' res sngar phebs pa'i bla ma rnams gdan 'dren byas kyang / grwa pa rnams kyis phebs su mi 'jug sngar phebs pa de ga'i chog da tshad yin zer bla ma bzang po'i rgyu 'grul chad nas/ bu bzang bo re shi yang bla ma sta snyi rgar rgu ra re min mi 'phrad/ des na 'di 'dra byed mi rung / bla ma thams cad kyis rgyu nom rkyang ba bsams nas 'ong ba min/'o na ci bsams nas 'ong ba yin cig shod dang ha ha zer na/chos sam yang na zang zing gi 'brel thogs su bcug nas ma 'ongs pa na yar 'dren snyam pa dang / 'brel ba bzhag tshad kyi rgyu nom pas rang gzhan gyi bsod nams rgyas pa'i phyir tshogs bsogs snyam pa dang / dge 'dun pa mang bo'i thugs dam gyi chas ka byas dge sbyor 'phel du 'jug snyam pa dang / rang gzhan gye phyag mchod kyi zhing sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs snyam/bstan 'gro gnyis gar phan pa'i dgongs gzhi du ma yod nas 'ong ba yin/ bla ma de rnams kyi nang na sa thob kyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sprul ba mang bo yod/ khas gtong mi rung / bla ma brgya stong byon kyang da lo skal ba bzang / 'di'i nang na sangs rgyas byang sems mang / sangs rgyas sgo khar phebs dus mjal dgos 'brel ba 'jog dgos soms la phyag mjal 597

longs yod tshod kyis 'brel ba zhog kha dar phyag mdud 'dra gnang ba mgo thog tu zhog nang du gdan drongs 'bul ba khyogs/ gal te rang la bya ba las don gal chen re yod dus yin na rgyu mtshan shod phyag mdud longs kha dar phar phyin la dā shog ras shog re phul ngo phyir ma ldog dang bzang / yang bla ma 'ga' res yon bdag gis gang phul chud zos btang nas ched sku gsung thugs rten re bzhengs dge 'dun gyi sde re mchod nas snying bo len snyam/ tshags byas bsogs gzhan gyi dad pas dge 'dun la phul ba'i dkor khyem pa pho mo la sbyin na me dang lcags gong me 'bar ba byen pa las nyes dmigs che ster mi rung / zhes mdo nyi ma'i snying bo sogs nas gsungs pa shes nas/ mdun tsho na dkor gyi zas phro ci yod kyang ma byin tshe/khyed tsho'i khyim pa blun po cang mi shes pa 'a res lkog na/skyabs su mchi dang khong nom gnag tshang zhig yin/ rgyu nom pa'i steng nas 'chi no mi shes cig ngan/ de zer mi nyan dang / lkog gtam pa la mdzad spyod a khu cig tshang dang khyad par med/rgyang nas phyag 'tshal rgyu tshang zhig khong yin/ thag nyer btud tshul med kho de nyin zhig la song des ja phar zhog khong gis cig bzhes gi yod pas de'i nang nas/ skal zhig tsam yang ma 598

byen nyin der cig ltogs bzhag nas zer ngan sna tshogs pa gtam pa 'di phugs ma go ba'i glen gtam zhig yin/ dgon na sku gsung thugs rten phra lam me yod pa de tsho ltos dang / bla mas rgyu nom bsags pa'i dgos pa ci yin de gcig pus shes gzhan mi dgos/ lo re bzhin dgon pa'i khong rnams la 'gyed phogs mang ja gtong ba la ltos/ bla ma ser sna e che des ha go yong / des na bla ma rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs gzhi mdzad spyod bzang ngan ci ston yang / de'i phugs skye bo mi nag pas rtogs dka'/ sngon sgra bsgyur mar ba lo tsā rin po che la/ sbyin bdag rnams kyis gon pa gang phul gser du brjes/ rgya gar du khyer nas bla ma la 'bul dgongs ma gyon ngan ngon gyon tshe/slob ma gcig gis bla ma 'dzin pa che gi snyam log lta skyes/ nyin gcig khyed kyis gon pa 'di tsho mi mnabs pa ci yin lags zhus tshe/ gon pa 'di btsongs nas gser du brjes rgya gar du song nas/ bla ma rnams la phul nas chos zhus bod du bsgyur nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar byed snyam gyon nas rnying na mi 'tshong gis ser sna byas pa ma yin gsungs/slob ma des bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs 'di shes par dka' snyam dad pa chen po skyes gsungs/ des na bla 599

ma 'ga' res rtsam khug gi kha nas bzung rung de la phan pa'i dgongs gzhi 'dra los yod/ nged rang tsho 'dra 'dra min snyam khas gtong mi rung / yang dge 'dun pa mang bo la 'gyed phogs mang ja gtong ba dang / gzhan gyis gtong ba la snon kha mar dang 'o ma sogs kyi dkar thig re brgyab na bzang / sngon nyag phrug 'das log dmyal bar song dus/ lam skabs shig na mar dang 'o ma'i mtsho 'khyel ba la longs spyod pa'i mi mang bo 'dug pa mthong bas/ spyan ras gzigs la dris tshe/ de sgye ba sngon mar gzhan gyis dge 'dun par mang ja gtong dus nang du mar dang 'o ma cung zad res dkar thig brgyab pa'i bsod nams red gsungs/ yang pha ma rgan rgon drin can la mgo'i nyi zer lan cig gi mgron po bya rgyal khu byug ltar/ da yun ring mi 'dug par 'jig rten phyi mar sang 'gro dang gnang 'gro'i tshod yin pas/ zla ba dkar ba zla stod pha ma 'dzoms pa tshe stod yin soms la yod dus 'jam pa'i gos bskon zhim pa'i zas byen/mngar ba'i ja blud/ snyan pa'i tshig shod la brtsi bkur gyis dang bzang / pha mar byams na thams cad la bzang zhig byas pa ltar/ kun gyis bu bzang bo des pha ma gnyis la cig byams pas/ de la tshe ring bkra shis zer zhing / snyan grags rgyas kun 600

gyes 'dang rtsis sgo che rgyu nom pa rnyed tshe 'dir yang bde skyid snyan gsum thob/ tshe phyi mar yang mthon po'i rigs su skye 'khor dang longs spyod 'dzom/ sngon tshong dpon zhig gis 'gron bu mang bo rnyed nas ma la byin pas/ tshe der gzhan gyis bkur lha mi'i longs spyod dpag med thob gsungs/ yang khyed tsho'i bu ngan 'ga' res pha ma rgan rgon drin che ba dang mchod na phan yon che ba mi shes/ lo lon tshe mig nang gi ling tog gi song rig sa mthong sa med/ tha na kha nas tshig gcig tsam yang bshad dbang med par kha za rgyus mi chod 'thung rgyus mi chod na da nged tsho'i rig sa nas ma 'dug sgor bud la he thobs brang la rdungs zer/ mig sdang gis bltas 'chi med ma 'phung rgan/ 'di gnyis la 'chi ba'i srog gcod kyang med pas/ 'chi bdag gi bdud de gang du song ba yin nam da 'ong na chog gi shi na tshad red zer gru mos phul rkang thos brgyab nas/ kha la chu mi skyel rgyab tu gon pa yang mi bskon par sdug bsngal myong gi 'jug pa 'di mi bzang / sde gzhan thams cad kyis de'i ngo mi rig gi chug des pha ma gnyis la sdug re 'ong gis bya ba lam du mi 'gro rgyu bo/ de dmyal ba'i mi nag cig red zer kun gyis ngan smras/ de la mi'i 'dang ma dgos khye'i 'dang yang med/ tshe 601

bsod nams mi rgyas/ shi na ngan song du 'gro bas spyod ngan 'di 'dra byed mi rung / yang pha ma drin can la tshe 'dir drin gzo chen po ma thub na/ shi dus dge rtsa dgung zhag phyi nas bla ma re la bsngo ba re zhus/ a mchod rer chos re 'don du 'jug pa sogs dge ba gyis dang bzang / sngon gling za 'das log bar dor song dus/ chu chen po zhig gi steng du zam chen po zhig btsugs nas 'dug zam de'i pha rol na sde chen po zhig 'dug pa'i nang du song dus sngar khong tshang gi lug dzi zhig rbab tu 'dril nas shi song ba de sde de'i nang na 'dug pas ngo shes nas/a ce yang 'dir slebs pa yin nam zer tshe/ khyod 'di na yod dam/ sde 'di'i ming la ci zer 'di na zas gos med pa tsho la skabs skabs 'ong ba 'di gang nas 'ong ba yin sogs dris tshe/'di ni bar do'i sde zhig yin/ zas gos med pa skabs rer zas gos 'ong ba/ shul gyi bu dang tsha bo rnams kyis dge rtsa byas pa'i 'bras bu red zer/ yang sngon nyag phrug dmyal ba nas yar ldog dus/ dmyal ba'i sems can mang pos khyod las can po yang lho 'dzam bu'i gling du 'gro ba yin na/ khong tsho'i pha yul ni 'di 'dra yin bu dang tsha bo 'di 'dra yod ming la 'di zer/khong las ngan tsho dmyal bar skyes yod pas/ khong tsho'i ched du 602

dmigs la mchod sbyin gyis ma ṇi re thon dang phan par 'dug ces shod zer skad/ des na rang yang rnyed pa'i yul nas 'dug rgyu red pha ma mi rnyed pa'i yul du song ba red snying rje drin can yin da gang zhig na 'gro shin yod dam/ ci zhig gi lus blangs bzhag ang snyam du mchi ma ltung ba'i snying rje bskyed la/ drin gzo dge rtsa re gyis dang bzang / pha mar dge bzang bo byas na tshe 'dir yang bde skyid snyan gsum thob/ de'i tshe 'ga' res de'i dge rtsa e bzang gi zhes dris na/ bla ma ban de der song ba rnams kyis dge ba cig bzang gi mod zer kha tsho lag pas bkab kyin bsdad/ de 'dra'i dge zhig da snga yan sus bcos ma myong bu rgod po de tshe ring bkra shis zer/ 'ga' res 'bul ba zhabs tog gang thad nas mi bzang ba zhig med pas/ shi bo de tsho las can red zer/ phyis gzhan gyi dge rtsa 'dra ngan na/bla rgan heb rgan tshos sngon de tshang gi dge rtsa de zer yang yang gleng / de tsho bltas na lkog gtam pa la 'di tsho dge 'dra ma red zer/ 'di tshang la yang rgyu nom pa de'i bzang red 'di la ci byung sngar des dge rtsa bcos ni 'dra ba zhig dka' gin zer 'gram chu langs mchil ma yang mid yid smon 'chor/ mi tshe gcig gnyis rer gtam snyan mang bo'i yong sgo yod pas 603

bzang / yang khyed tsho 'ga' res shi bo re'i dus su/ phan pa'i chos dge ba mi bca'/ lag pa lha khang gi sgo bas dam/ med mug ma ṇi bzhin du bton mi phan pa'i ngu 'bod byed pa 'di mi bzang / shi bo bu bzang tshul kun la drin che tshul/ na so gzhon 'chi ma ran tshul/ da dung bsdad na kho rang yang skyid tshul/kun la phan thogs 'byung tshul sogs bsams nas kha stong bar song snyam/ sngar yod dus lus kyi rnam 'gyur ngag gi bshad tshul 'gro tshul 'dug lugs rnams yid la shar nas/ da phyin chad gang nas thug snyam na gdong gi mchi ma 'dzad rgyu med pas/de dus de tsho mi bsam par skyes pho mo bsam shes rnams kyis 'di ltar soms la mya ngan sangs su chug dang bzang / spyir skyes pa'i tha ma 'chi/ 'dus pa'i tha ma 'bral ba 'jig rten 'khor ba'i chos nyid red sems sdug byas ngus nas ci bya/sngon byung rgyal ba sras bcas rgyal blon 'khor 'bangs bzang bzang thams cad kyi gcig kyang da lta mi snang / skyes nas ma shi ba su yod/ 'chi ba gcig la byung ba ma red/ snga phyi tsam ma gtogs thams cad de yi rang bzhin can red/ sngon sgra bsgyur mar ba'i sras dar ma mdo sde sogs sa thob kyi byang chub sems dpa' dang / lha'i bu dang bu mo lta bu'i gces phrug mang bo yang 604

sngon chad glo bur du shi ba mang / rgan gzhon la go rim sngon nas mi snang / rkyen ngan pa che ba rgyal blon nas/ chung ba sprang slong yan chad kyi mgor 'ong gi khyim tshang rang gcig pu'i steng du yong ba ma red/ tshe yi tshad la bab tshe rgyal ba tshe dpag med dngos su byon kyang phan mi thogs/ sku rim bsrung ba ngan nas shi song ba yang ma red/ ngus nas ci bya shi bo bar do'i skabs na gnas dus/ phyi nas gnyen bshes kyi sems sdug ngo gnag tshe sprin nag nam mkhar 'khrigs/ lce dang kha 'gul dus glog dmar 'khyug ngu 'bod byas u zhes sngam pa 'then dus 'brug ldir mig nas mchi ma byung dus rnag khrag gi char ba bya sgong tsam sran ma tsam yungs 'bru tsam shi bo'i steng du babs nas/ sdug bsngal dpag med myang gi zhes gling bza' dang nyag phrug 'das log gnyis kyis gsungs/ bla ma dge 'dun gye snyan btsos na/thams cad kyis u shu ka ma byas na ched zer/ khong rnams la shi bor phan pa'i 'don sgom mi 'ong / rang yang mang po ngus na lus kyi mdog shor sgur bo song mig mi gsal rab rib tu 'gyur/ mya ngan che ba'i rgan rgon zhar song ba mang / rta pho byang ma brgya zhon nas rgyug kyang rjes mi zin pa'i 'jig rten pha rol du song phyin chad/ ngus nas su la phan sus go shi bo de la phan 605

na ngu mod kyang / mi phan pa'i mi tshad gnod/ thos na ru mod thos pa'i sa na med/ des na rang gzhan thams cad la sdug bskol ba ma gtogs don go spu tsam yang med gi soms la mya ngan ma byed dang bzang / yang chos dge ba ma byas na/ 'ga' res de cig ngu gi zhes smras na/ 'ga' res de'i mig nas mig chus mi tshar ni zhig yong yang snying rje rgyu mi 'ong gi de rig na sgo ldang gi shi bo'i skal chad ni red dge ja tsho chu red mar yang med gi a wa de'i ched zer/ 'ga' res de 'di byas ngu zhes lus dang kha ngo'i rnam 'gyur ngag gi skad kyi sbom phra'i lad mo byas ha bgad byed/ 'ga' res mi de'i gseng na mig chu min gzhan ci yang med gi zer/ lkog na ngan smra di ri ri byed de mi shi mi kha gnyis ka mnyam por 'ong / ngus no sdug gyong yin/mang bo ngus na 'phya ni yang mang / rang la kha mi lta shag mi re ba'i thang gi mis de tshad de nyos kyang zer bas/ des na gang la bsam kyang ngu 'bod byas na mi bzang gi snyam du soms la ma ngu dang bzang / skyid mi theg ni su med/ sdug bsngal byung dus theg dgos/ theg na pho rab mo rab de la zer/ ra rgan bzhin snabs lug glang rgan bzhin sdug 'khun byas/ bong rgan bzhin has 'debs pa skye bo blun po'i chos lugs yin/ pho rab 606

mo rab bsam shes kyis blun po'i lad mo byed mi rung / skabs rer bya ba las don re'i dus shi bo de yod na de byed la 'di 'dra byed snyam/ de'i lus kyi rnam 'gyur/ ngag gi bshad tshul rnams yid la shar tshe des rkyen byas nas ngu rgyu yong dus su yang / de ma bsam par gzhan tsho la rang sems yengs su chug la nam yang mya ngan ma byed dang bzang / yang rang gi sgo yi khye'i nangs nub kyi lto 'chag gi ma 'jug par blud dang bzang /gzhan khye ldom ltogs pa la lto re ster e thub ltos dang bsod nams che/ sngon bud med cig mi lus glang gi mgo can zhig gis khrid nas lam nag po zhig la zhugs nas dmyal bar 'gro ba zhig gi sngon nas/ mi lus khye'i mgo can zhig byung glang mgo can de dang gnyis gas rdung res byas pa'i bar der/ bud med de shor nas lam dkar bo zhig la gyen du bros song bas/ de nyag phrug 'das log gis gzigs pas/ bud med des skye ba sngon mar khye ldom zhig la lto zhig blud pa'i phan yon red ces gsangs/ yang phyag 'tshal na phan yon che/ bla ma dkon mchog sku gsung thugs rte na sogs la phyag gcig 'tshal kyang ma 'ongs pa na mi de'i lus kyis non tshad kyis/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thug gi bar gyi bye ma ci yod kyi grangs las stong 'gyur 607

gyi stong 'khor los bsgyur rgyal du skye ste/ 'dul ba lung las/dge slong dag dge slong gis 'di ltar skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten la yan lag thams cad kyis phyag 'tshal te sems dwangs par byed pa la ltos btsun pa de ltar lags so/ /dge slong dag 'dis sa ci tsam non pa'i 'og dpag tshad brgyad khri bzhi stong na gser gyi 'khor lo la thug gi bar na/ bye ma ji snyed yod pa de snyed du dge slong 'dis 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid stong 'gyur du longs spyod par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs/ yang bla ma dang dge 'dun 'dus pa sku gsung thugs rten khams can la bskor ba byas na bzang / ma 'ongs pa na bskor ba gang byas kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i sa bcu lam lnga so gas thob pa'i sa bon rgyud la 'jog ba/sungs/ sngon 'bu zhig chus khyer ba mchod rten zhig yod pa de la bskor ba byas song bas/ de'i bsod nams kyis phyis sangs rgyas kyi dus su/ khyim bdag dpal skyes zhes bya bar gyur nas/ dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob gsungs/yang sku gsung thugs rten zhig pa la/ zhig gso che thub chung thub byas na phan yon che/ sngon phag zhig gi lus la 'dam 'bag 'gos pa 'gro dus mchod rten zhig yod pa de la thug pas/ mchod rten la gas kha zhig yod pa de zub pa'i bsod 608

nams kyis lhar sgyes gsungs/ yang khyed phyug po tsho'i nang na zla ba bzhi lnga zhig gi khal rta dang bro re mi 'dzom pa dang / 'gro mi thub ni med pas/ skyes pho mo skal ldan las can 'dra yod na dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du mjal du song dang bzang / rgyal ba paṇa chen rnam gnyis kyi gtso byas pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sprul ba skyes chen dam pa thams cad dbus na bzhugs/ 'brel ba re bzhag na ma 'ongs pa na 'brel thogs dag pa'i zhing du 'dren nges/ sngon rgyal ba'i sku tshe zhig la a rig gi rgad po glen pa dad can zhig dbus su song dus gser khug ma gang dang sder ma gcig dang gnyis khyer nas song /mdun du song nas sder ma'i steng du gser phyed tsam blugs nas rgyal ba rin po ches da chog gi e gsung snyam yar la bltas/ma gsungs tshe yang cig blug nas yar la bltas/ yang cig blugs nas rgyal ba'i zhal la bltas tshe/ rgyal bas 'di ci yin nam dgongs zhal cig 'dzum tshe/ ang da dga' yod gi chog ni red zer yar drangs nas/ da 'chi ba'i thad tsho khyed mkhyen zer skyabs 'jug zhus pas/ de'i lan du rgyal bas ya ya gsungs/phyi nas rgad po 'chi nad kyis thebs tshe/ gnyid ma gnyid kyi mtshams dang rmi lam du rgyal ba rin po che yin zer ba'i sku 609

mdog dung ltar dkar ba shel ltar dwangs pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ sku las 'od zer dkar bo 'dom gang tsam 'phro ba'i mtha' ma 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i mu khyud kyis bskor nas 'od 'khyil le ba zhig drung du 'bral med du bzhugs nas/ zhal gyi 'dzum mdangs bzhad bzhin rgad po 'chi ba la 'jigs mi dgos/ khyod rang shi ma thag nas nged gnyis bde ba can du 'gro ba yin gsungs pas dag snang byung / mnar gcod kyi sdug bsngal med par rgad po shi song skad/ des na rgyal ba rin po che spyan ras gzigs dngos yin/ nged rang tsho la yang dad pa yod na de 'dra 'byung nges/ 'phags pa'i thugs rje je chung du 'gro rgyur med/ snyigs dus su je che yin/ de bzhin paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa 'od dpag med dngos yin/ de bzhin du dbus phyogs kyi bla ma thams cad sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul ba sha stag yin pas/ 'brel thogs na 'chi dus de kun gyes ngo mtshar gyi rdzu 'phrul ston bzhin byon nas ngas 'dren dang khyod 'dren gsung ba mang bo 'byung ngo / /dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing gi ra sa 'phrul snang gi phyi'i gtsug lag khang dang /nang gi jo shāka rnam gnyis kyis gtso byas rten khams can ci yod mthong ba'i phan yon ni/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i 610

zhal nas/ gcig mthong na ngan song gi skye sgo chod/ gnyis mthong na lha mi'i lus thob nas thar ba thob/ gsum mthong na dug gsum rang sar zhi nas sku gsum sbyor nus/ zhes gsungs/des na lan mang bo mthong na smos ci dgos/ yang thos pa'i phan yon ni/ dud 'gro'i rna lam du thos kyang / dud 'gro'i lus las grol nas thar lam gyi sna zin no/ /lha dang mis thos na thar ba thob gsungs/ yang dran pa'i phan yon ni/ yi dam de rnams kyi yon tan rjes su dran na bskal ba lnga stong gi sgrib pa 'dag cing mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa 'thob bo gsungs/gzhan yang bskor ba byas pa'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i sa bcu dang mkhyen pa'i ye shes sogs thob pa'i sa bon rgyud la 'jog pa sogs phan yon mtha' yas pa ma ṇi bka' 'bum na yod pas der zhib tu bltas na sngar mjal ba rnams la dga' spro dang / ma mjal ba rnams la mjal 'dod rang dbang med par skye nges/ de bzhin du dpal gyi bsam yas rten brten par bcas pa mthong na sdig can gyi mi yin yang ngan 'gro med/nad gdon bgegs bar chad gang yod zhi/ ci 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis 'grub/ phyag bskor mchod 'bul byas na/ gnas skabs su bde zhing mthar thug sangs 611

rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa sogs phan yon mtha' yas pa pad+ma bka' thang na gsal/ de bzhin po ta la'i rten brten par bcas pa dang / ser 'bras dge gsum/ gtsang bkra shis lhun po/ smin grol gling / rdo rje brag sa skya khra 'brug yar lung rten gsum gnas gsum sogs kyi rten khams can la mjal ba dang / phyag bskor mchod 'bul byas pa'i phan yon ni lce brgyar sprul nas bskal brgyar brjod kyang rdzogs pa'i yul las 'das/ser 'bras dge gsum sogs dbus na dgon pa che chung ci yod la rab mang ja 'gyed phogs tha na gzhan gyis mang ja bskol ba'i nang du ja mar gyis kha 'debs zhal 'debs sogs byas na bsod nams nam mkhar mi shong / rgya mtsho'i nang du 'o ma'i thigs pa zhig brgyab na rgya mtsho ma zad bar du de mi 'dzad pa bzhin du/ bsod nams la nam yang 'dzad rgyu med de/ sngon mdo smad kyi bla ma zhig gis rang gi pha yul nas dge slong brgya phrag tsam la ji srid 'tsho'i bar du 'tsho ba'i yo byad kyis tshogs bsags pa bas/ dbus su song nas lha sa'i smon lam dus ser 'bras dge gsum la 'dren pa'i mang ja'i nang du ja mar zhig gis kha 'debs byas pa bsod nams che ang snyam pa byung gsungs/ de thugs shin tu mad de khong rnam pa khri khrag mang bo 612

tshogs pa'i nang na sa thob kyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mang bo yod nges/ dper na zhing sa bzang po zhig dang /ngan pa gnyis sa bon 'debs dus 'dra yang / ston thog len dus 'phel che chung gi khyad par shin tu che ba ltar/ skye bo tha mal pa zhig dang byang chub sems dpa' gnyis mchod dus khyad med rung / phyis bsod nams thob dus rgya che chung gi khyad shin tu che/des na bod gangs can gyi khrod du skyes nas thag nye'i bla ma dam pa rten khams chen rnams la lan cig tsam yang mi mjal bar tshe gang bor yul du nyal bsdad pa dang / 'ga' res lham ngo mang bo brdol rag gi bar du 'tsho skyong dang zhing las sogs byas pa la don go spu tsam yang med/ dbus su mjal du 'gro ba gal che/ mjal du 'gro na tshe 'dir dbus las sa phyogs thag ring dang dbus kyi bla ma dam pa dang rten khams can rnams las lhag pa'i phyag mchod kyi zhing zhig dang nam yang mjal dka' bas/ rgyu nom yod dus der mi khyer ba'i kha nang du thal rgyob/ de dus mi khyer bar nam tshod 'khyer/ tshe phyi mar khyer nas 'gro sa med pas/ phyug po rnams kyis rgyu nom khyer la song dang bzang / 'brel 'jog dgos/ rgyu nom med pa rnams kyis kyang lho kha brgyud la dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing khams su 613

mjal du song la phyag bskor khab skud kha dar tsam gyis 'brel re zhog dang / mi tshe gang bor mi'i g.yog byas mi tshe sdug zad la ma gtong / lam nas ltogs grang na nas sdug dka' las myangs kyang sdig sgrib 'dag pas shin tu bzang / gal te shi song yang spyir skyes pa'i tha ma 'chi ba yin pas don med du shi ba las/chos phyir shi na phyi mar rnyed pa chen po rnyed/ sngon sangs rgyas kyis chos phyir dka' ba spyad dus dpung yan chad bcad nas gzhan la sbyin par btang nas sangs rgyas pa yin pas/ ltas ngan mi srid pa zhig steng du byung ba min/ shi ba ma bzang zhes 'gyod pa spu tsam byed mi dgos/ da res skal ba bzang sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar zin pa yin/ ma 'ongs pa na bsod nams chen po thob snyam dga' ba bsgom dgos/ yang 'ga' res dbus su 'gro dus 'gro tshul mi shes par sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang e thob kyi phyir chos byed du 'gro ba zhig dang mi 'dra bar/dmyal bar e ltung gi phyir sdig pa bca' ru 'gro ba zhig dang 'dra ste/ yul nas lam la bro sha dgos zer lug bshas/ bla ma'i 'tsho ba dpon po'i shul du mgron po'i bro lug zer mang bo ded 'ong nas/ dgong mo'i grangs kyis bsad/ ri klung na ri dwags yod tshad la me mda' 'phangs/ rku 'phrog byas ma byin pa 614

blangs/ grogs la na zug cig byung na bdag mi byed skyur e thub blta ba 'di 'gro lugs rtsog pas/ mjal tshad chud zos su btang ba yin/ dbus su mjal ba don med rang sdug yin/chos rnam dag byed pa'i blo ldan skya ser pho mo rnams kyis dbus su 'gro dus bya spyod ngan pa 'di 'dra rgyang ring du dor dang bzang /yang sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i gnyen po'i mchog rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas yin pas/ khyed rang rnams kyis rang gi spyi por pad zla'i gdan dkar po la rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog gangs ri ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can mtshan dang dpe byad kyis mdzes pa/ sku las sgyes pa'i 'od kyi phung bo'i dbus na zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs gar zla dkyil la shel gye rdo rje rtse lnga ba gyen du langs pa'i lte bar zla gdan la/ t+t+waṃ yig dkar bo'i mthar yi ge brgya ba kha dog dkar bo g.yon bskor du bkod pa/ g.yas su 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs nas/ rang gi spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas zhugs lus kyi phyi nang bar gsum thams cad bkrus pas/ tshe 'khor ba thog med nas da bar bsags pa'i 615

sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu dang sol khu/ nad thams cad rnag khrag gdon thams cad sdom sdig sbal lcong srin 'bu sogs kyi rnam par dbang po'i sgo dang ba spu'i bu ga sogs dang / khyad par chu lam dang bshang lam gnyis nas nag nyil nyil phyir thon nas sa rim pa bdun gyi 'og tu song / lus dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur song snyam du yi ge brgya ba thon dang bzang / de ltar rdor sems bsgom bzlas mang bo byas na sngar mtshams med pa'i las byas pa dag na gzhan smos ci dgos/ yig brgya nyin re nyer gcig tsam re bton na sngar nyes ltung gang byas mi 'phel byen gyis rlabs par 'gyur/ brgya re bton na dam tshig nyams chag thams cad sor chud/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi sras su 'gyur zhing / dus rtag tu bsrung skyob mdzad/ 'bum phrag cig bton na ma 'ongs pa na nyes skyon rnam par dag pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob ces rgyud sde chen po rnams dang bla ma dam pa'i zhal nas gsungs te/snying bo rgyan las/ yi ge brgya ba cho ga bzhin/ /nyi shu rtsa ni re re bzlas/ /ltung sogs byen gyis rlabs 'gyur bas/ /'phel ba ru ni mi 'gyur zhes/ /grub pa mchog rnams kyis bshad pas/ /thun mtshams su ni spyad par bya/ /'bum phrag du ni bzlas gyur 616

na/ /rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /zhes dang /dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i snying bo 'di dag dus gcig la brgya rtsa brgyad brjod na nyams chag thams cad skong ste/ ngan song gsum las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /rnal 'byor gang zhig gis yi dam du bcings nas/ 'don na mi tshe 'di nyid la yang dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis sras dam par dgongs nas/srung ba dang skyob pa mdzad la tshe 'phos nas bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sras su gdon mi za bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang /o rgyan rin po ches/ rdor sems sgom bzlas gsungs nas/ 'dis ni bla med nang gi nyams chag bskang bas sgrib sbyong khyad par can te/ bskal ba stong gi las sgrib 'dag cing dam tshig nyams chag mtshams med lnga'i las kyang 'dag par 'gyur phyir na/ rnal 'byor pas brtson par byas na 'di nyid rang gis sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur ro gsungs/ des na sdig can dang dam nyams rnams kyis 'di la 'bad pa gal che/ yang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde skyid thams cad tshogs bsags pa las byung ba yin zhes rgyal ba sras bcas kyis gsungs/ tshogs bsags thams cad kyi nang nas tshegs chung don che ba lag pa'i brkyang bskum byas pa tsam gyis tshogs 617

gnyis bde legs su rdzogs nas sangs rgyas pa maṇ+ḍal yin pas/rab rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal/ 'bring gser zangs/ tha ma shing dang rdo ba sogs ci 'byor bya/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du tshom bu rab rin po che/ 'bring 'bru sman/ tha ma rdo dkar sogs bkod nas/rab badz+ra zu mi zhes maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma thon/ 'bring sa gzhi spos byugs ma/ tha mas i rda gu ru rat+na'i sngags thon la phul dang bzang / yang rang lus shin tu mdzes pa gos rgyan sna tshogs pas mdzes par sprul/ maṇ+ḍal rin po che du ma las grub pa'i gzhong ba chen por sprul/ steng gi tshom bu rnams nor bu g.yu byur mu men mu tig gser dngul sogs mang bor sprul nas/ bla ma lha dang dkon mchog gsum mdun du khra lam mer bzhugs par mos nas de la phul na phyir rang gis de bas brgya 'gyur stong 'gyur gyi bsod nams thob pa yin te/ dge slong lha'i rin po che/ sngon sangs rgyas gser thub kyi dus mi dbul bo zhig tu gyur nas/ dge 'dun pa rnams mchod na 'dod kyang / yo byad ci yang med tshe/ rdo rigs spar gang rin po che sna tshogs su mos nas/ dge 'dun pa 'dus pa'i tshogs gral du gtor bas/ de'i bsod nams kyis bskal ba dgu bcu rtsa gcig gi bar du rin po che dang zas gos longs spyod dpag 618

med dang ldan/ phyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dus su khyem bdag 'byor ldan zhig gi bur skyes/ de sgyes ma thag tu nam mkha' nas rin po che sna bdun gyi char babs te/ khyem thams cad gang gsungs/ yang rang rnam sras lta bur sprul maṇ+ḍal rnam sras kyi mdzod khang lta bur sprul maṇ+ḍal gyi steng gi tshom bu rnams rnam sras kyi mdzod lta bur sprul nas bla ma dkon mchog la phul na/ phyi mar de lta bu'i brgya stong 'gyur gye bsod nams thob/ yang rang lha'i dbang bo brgya byin du sprul/ maṇ+ḍal stong gsum 'dzig rten gyi khams/ steng gi tshom bu rnams stong gsum gyi lha mi'i yo byad lta bur rgya chen por mos nas phul na/phyi mar de lta bu brgya stong 'gyur gyis bsod nams thob/ yang rang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang bo lta bur sprul/maṇ+ḍal 'khor 'das kyi zhing khams lta bur mos/ steng gi tshom bu rnams 'khor 'das kyi zhing gi 'dod yon longs spyod ci yod lta bur dpag tu med par sprul nas phul na myur du tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas/ ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur zhes bla ma dam pa 'ga' res gsungs/ des na khyed shes pa rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba la brtson pa gal che/ de bzhin brgya rtsa tsha gsur/ lus sbyin sogs tshegs chung don che ba'i tshogs 619

gsog gyis dang bzang / de rnams kyis phan yon bshad kyi yin na brjod pa'i yul las 'das/ mdor na tshe 'di'i bar chad zhi zhing tshe bsod rgyas/ phyi mar ngan song du mi skye/ mtho ris lha mi'i go 'phang thob/ skye ba bzang bo brgyud nas mthar sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yang thob par 'gyur bas/ des na de dag rnams la brtson dang dal 'byor thob pa don ldan du 'gyur ro/ /yang sgyung gnas bsrung na phan yon che ste/ smyung gnas gcig bsrung kyang bskal ba bzhi khri'i 'khor ba phyir bsnyil bar 'gyur/brgya rtsa brgyad bsrung na mi de ri mgor song na de phyogs kyi rlung phog tshad kyi sems can la ngan 'gro med gsungs/ chu la brgal na chu de 'thung tshad kyi sems can la ngan 'gro med/mthong thos dran reg lus kyi grib ma phog pa yan chad la ngan 'gro med ces rgyud dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bla ma dam pa mang bos gsungs/ des na kho rang smos ci dgos/ sngon bud med cig gis rang gi bu rkang thos brgyab nas bsad/ skyes pa gtso byas mi bcu stod tsam la dug blud nas bsad pas/phyis rgas dus 'gyod pa skyes tshe/ bla ma zhig gis rgan mo de la khyod kyis smyung gnas bsrung zhes gsungs pas/ lan gsum bsrung bas mo rang shi nas dmyal bar ma song / rgya gar lho 620

phyogs kyi bram ze zhig gi sras su skyes skad/ yang sdom pa bsrung na phan yon che ste/ zla ba sgon me'i mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed la/ bskal ba gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma/ snyed du lha dang mi yi mchod pa kun gyis bsnyen bkur byas pa bas/ dam pa'i chos 'jig pa'i dus kyi nyin zhag phrug gcig tsam sdom pa thub pa bsod nams che gsungs/ sdom pa lan cig bsrung na ma 'ongs pa na lha'i dbang bo brgya byin gyes khong lta bur 'gyur gsungs/ sangs rgyas kyis de'i mi tshad ma 'ongs pa na khong lta bur 'gyur gsungs/ sngon grong dpon zhig gis srog gcod kyi sdom pa nyin gcig bsrung ba'i mthus/mthar sangs rgyas phan bzhed ces bya bar sangs rgyas gsungs/yang gru zam dang lam ngan bcos na phan yon che/ sngon mi gcig gis bsam pa bzang pos lam 'gro yongs la gnod pa'i rdo gcig yod pa phud nas mar 'phangs pas/ shi nas gshin rjes yar btang tshe/ yig drug bton nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing zhig tu skyes skad/ yang ri khrod dben pa'i dga' tshal na grogs med gcig pur 'dug pa'i bya btang bsgom chen pa bzang po la 'tsho ba phul na/ bsod nams rgya chen po 'byung ste/ rje mi la'i zhal nas/ grong yul du longs spyod la byung rgyal du spyod tshe 621

brgya 'bul ba bas/ ri khrod du dka' ba sbyod tshe zan chang re bsod nams che bar 'dug snyam pa byung gsungs/ yang brag la bsgom pa'i bsgom chen dang / /'tsho ba sbyor ba'i yon bdag gnyis/ /sangs mnyam por rgya ba'i rten 'brel yod/ /gsungs/spyir tshe 'di blos btang nas dben pa'i ri na byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi sgo nas/ dge sbyor byed pa'i rnal 'byor pa gang du gnas pa'i yul phyogs kyi nad rims mu ge 'khrug rtsod sogs bkra mi shis pa kun nye bar zhi nas/ char chu dus su 'bab cing lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa sogs/ bkra shis dang dge legs bde skyid kyis phyogs de khyab pa chos nyid yin la/khyad par dge sbyor byed mkhan de'i chos kyi mthun rkyen yul phyogs de la rag las/ de yang sbyin bdag rnams bde na 'ong bar go nas/ de'i slad du bla ma lha la gsol ba 'debs/mkha' 'gro chos skyong la 'phrin bcol byed/ tha na ja mchod cig 'don kyang mjug tu 'dod gsol la/ khyed rnams mchod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /bdag sogs gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /nad dang dbul 'phongs 'thab rtsod zhi ba dang / /chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsungs nges/ de ltar mdzad na yul phyogs de'i tshe 'di'i sku 622

rim bsrung ba la yang de bas lhag cig gzhan na med/ des na khyed khyem tshang phyug po sde ba tsho ba su yin yang / bya btang ri la sdod pa'i bsgom chen pa lo zla ba byas mchod bstod bkur thub ltos dang bzang / yang mi dang ra lug ri dwags nya sogs gzhan gyes gsod pa thabs du mas tshe thar bar byas pa dang /nad pa tshabs can la sman dang khams dang 'phrod pa'i zas byin nad g.yog byas gzhan pa rdung res byed pa'i bar bshol brdung gi ma bcug na/ tshe ring nad med par sgye/ mtshan ldan gyi bla ma dang / rgas pa'i pha ma/ khrims gtsang dge 'dun/ yul mi rgan pa sogs la brtsi bkur byas khri stan mthon por bzhagabaza' btung drangs/ rang gis dman sa bzung na/ gong ma rgyal po lta bu'i mthon po'i rigs su skye/ rten gyi drung du mar me dang me tog bla ma dam pa la na bza' gtsang ma phul/ bzod pa bsgom na lha'i bu dang bu mo bzhin gzugs byad mdzes/ bla ma dkon mchog la mnyes pa'i mchod pa rgya chen po dang /dbul bo nyam thag la sbyin gtong legs pa/ g.yas g.yon khyim mtshes la phan thogs dang g.yor skyi byas na rnam thos sras dang /stong 'khor los sgyur rgyal la 'gran pa'i longs spyod can du skye/gzhan gyis sku gsung thugs rten dge 'dun pa'i 'du khang 623

sogs las dus grogs byas zas byen na glang bo che bas stobs che bar skye/ bla ma dge 'dun la dril bu ting shags dung dkar sogs sgra snyan phul na/ skad snyan mo dang chen po 'ong / des na tshe ring nad med mthon po'i rigs su sgye ba dang / gzugs mdzes 'byor ba che stobs che skad snyan par 'dod na de ltar byed dgos/ yang rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma spyi bo dang snying dbus sogs su bsgom nas gsol ba btab na bzang / a ti bkod pa chen po las/ drin dang ldan pa'i bla ma de/ /snying gi dkyil dang spyi bo'i gtsug /yan lag mthil du gang bsgom pa/ /sangs rgyas stong gi yon tan de/ /gang zag de yis 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dam tshig bkod pa las/ mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa'i lha/ /bskal ba 'bum du bsgom pa las/ /bla ma dran pa 'bum char min/ /gnyen sgrub bzlas pa sa ya bas bla ma'i gsol 'debs lan cig dga'/ /zhes dang / o rgyan rin po ches/ nyams su blangs na bla ma'i byen brlabs bum pa gang byo'i tshul du thob nas/ tshe gcig gis mgon po rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par byed pa la/ zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor ro/ /zhes gsungs/ bla ma la gsol ba btab pa tsam gyes phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi byin brlabs kyang gang 624
