zag de'i rgyud la 'jug gsungs na/ bla ma'i byen rlabs sgos ci dgos/ yang tshe 'di'i bar chad sel ba/ phyi ma'i lam sna 'dren pa la lha gzhan las lhag pa bod kyi lha skal 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba btab na bzang / sngon nyag phrug 'das log bar dor 'khyams dus 'jigs skrag sna tshogs byung nas bros tshe/ mdun du 'od dkar po zhig byung ba'i sne mo na/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar gsal zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams can/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon pad+ma dkar bo'i sdong bu 'dzin pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ mtshan dpe gzi byen mchog tu 'bar ba zhig mngon sum du byon nas/ bu ma 'jigs par shog dang / 'di na nga yod do/ /nga ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug go /khyod kyi lam sna 'dren du 'ong ba yin zhes zhal gsungs dron bo gnang tshe/ nyag phrug lus kyi ba spu g.yo zhing / mig nas mchi ma 'khrugs pa'i dad pa skyes/ zhabs la mgo bos phyag byas/ nga 'di ltar nyam thag tshe rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyu gang yin zhus tshe/thugs rje chen po'i zhal nas/ khyod kyi skye ba sngon ma zhig tu rgyal po zhig gi glang rdzi byas/ de dus glang chen gyi phrug gu zhig mtha' la 'phangs pa'i rnam smin gyis/ skye ba phyi ma de la khyod 625

mtha' zhig tu lhung / de'i dus khyod kyis 'phags pa thugs rje chen po mkhyen zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ngas khyod mtha' de las skyabs/ de nas bzung tshe rabs thams cad du ngas khyod rjes su bzung ba yin/ nga la sus gsol ba lan cig tsam btab kyang / 'di ltar rjes su 'dzin pa yin zhes gsungs/des na bla ma dang thugs rje chen po dbyer med byas mdun gyi nam mkha' 'am rang gi spyi bor bsgom nas/ tshe 'di'i bar chad sol phyi ma'i lam sna drongs snyam du/ ma bzang mo bu chung gis 'bod pa ltar chos thams cad kyi snying bo yi ge drug ma gsol 'debs kyi tshul du lhang lhang bton nas gsol ba 'debs pa gal che/ nyin rer ma ṇi re re tsam bton na dud 'gror mi sgye/brgya re bton na sngar byas kyi sdig sgrib dag nas ngan song du mi skye/ stong tsho re bton na nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su skye/ khri tsho re bton na 'phags pa sbyan ras gzigs lta bur gyur nas 'gro don byed nus zhes gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal nas gsungs/ sngon ci yang mi shes pa'i ra rdzi blun po zhig gis mi tshe gang bor ma ṇi rgyun chad med par bton pas/phyis shi tshe ro las 'ja' tshon byung steng phyogs su song mkha' spyod du thim pa gzhan gyes mthong / thod pa'i mtha' la yi ge 620

drug ma rang byung du 'khor ba byung / thod pa de bshes gnyen dam pas mchod gnas byas skad/ yang dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs sprul/ skye 'chi bgres rgud dang bral ba'i o rgyan rin po che la gsol ba btab na bzang / sngon o rgyan la dad pa che ba'i a rig gi rgad po zhig la tsha ba'i nad byung sdod ma thub tshe/ dgung mo o rgyan rin po che la gsol ba 'debs bzhin gnyid song bas rmi lam la/ zhwa dmar po gyon pa'i bla ma zhig 'ongs nas/ rgad po phyag tu blangs shin tu grang ba'i mtsho zhig gi dkyil du rgyangs nas 'phangs pas/ rgad pos 'phags 'phags nas mtsho 'gram du thon dus gnyid las sad tshe/ lus kyi na tsha kun zhi nas bsil sing nge ba byung skad/ yang sngon lho kha'i phyogs kyi rgad po zhig gis badz+ra gu ru kha ton byas dung phyur gcig lhag tsam song ba de phyis 'chi nad kyis jebs pas mtshan mo rmi lam du/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i thad nas sprin dkar bo 'o ma 'phyur ba bzhin langs pa'i sne la o rgyan rin po che byon te khong gi zhal nas/ rgad po nangs par nyi ma shar tsam la zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtse mo nas ngas 'dir dar yug cig 'then/ dar de'i sne mor 'jus la yar shog cig gsungs pa zhig rmis pa nangs dus bza' mi 'ga' rer bshad/ nyi shar la 627

rgad po shi song / de dus lho phyogs nas 'ja' tshon kha dog lnga ldan snam bu brkyangs pa lta bu zhig rgad po gnas pa'i khang steng du 'then pa kun gyes mthong / mthar je thung je chung du gyur nas lho nub kyi phyogs su yal song / yang rje rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rgyal ba bzhin bam/'a drin lhag par che ba'i khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rje rin po che la gsol ba btab na bzang /sngon dbus phyogs kyi bla ma zhig rgyal gdon gyis na ba'i rkyen byas/ thugs dam gye gtso bo dmigs brtse ma la byas pas rgyal nad kyang drag mtshan mo rmi lam zhig tu/ rje rin po cher mjal khyod lo 'di lta bu zhig la dga' ldan du 'ong dgos gsungs pa rmis pa slob ma 'ga' rer bshad/ phyis lo de'i nang la sku gshegs gdung bzhu ba'i dus steng phyogs nas sprin dkar bo zhig gdung steng du 'then/ gdung bzhus pas rgal tshigs kyi rus pa sogs kyi steng du/ dmigs brtse ma'i yi ge rang byon du byung skad/ yang khyed tshos rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas kyi gtso byas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas gcig kyang ma lus par byon nas mngon sum khra lam mer bzhugs pa/ chos rnams kyang pu ti'i rnam par gdong dar tsho khra chem mer yod par mos/ rang gi mtha' bskor du sems can thams cad kyang 628

yod par mos la/ spyir 'khor ba dang khyad par ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal gyis mnar nas/mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi bde ba gang yang med pa'i bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyis khyod rnams la skyabs btsal ba yin pas thugs dam skyabs 'og nas ma 'dor/ khyed rnams ma gtogs re sa med/ tshe 'di'i bar chad sol/ phyi ma'i lam sna drongs la myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa zhig khyed rnams mkhyen snyam pa'i sgo nas/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sogs skyabs 'gro gang shes thon la skyabs 'gro gyis dang bzang / dper na bu nyam chung gis a ma bzang mo la re ltos bcos/ da ltogs gi skom gi grang gi 'di 'dra dgos zhes ngus nas lan mang bo bshad tshe/ ma des sems kyis mi nus par 'dzum bzhin bu de la ci 'dod kyi bza' btung byin gon pa bskon pa ltar/ skyabs 'gro lan mang byas tshe mdun gyi tshogs zhing thams cad kyis thugs brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur zhal 'dzum zhing bzhad bzhin sku las bdud rtsi 'od zer dpag med 'phros/rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi lus sems la zhugs/tshe 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag tshe dpal bsod nams lung rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad 'phel 629

zhing rgyas par byas/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad gnas skabs bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas song snyam pa gyis/ de ltar skyabs 'gro lan cig byas pas kyang / nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i gral du tshud/ sdom pa thams cad kyi rten du 'gyur zhing / sngar bsags kyi las sgrib rnams srab cing zad par 'gyur te/ bsod nams rgya chen po gsog cing ngan song gsum du mi ltung / mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas mi tshugs/ yid la ci bsam thams cad 'grub cing myur du sangs rgyas pa sogs skyabs 'gro'i phan yon mtha' yas te/ gang zhig skyabs song 'di la gzugs yod na/ /'jig rten stong khams 'di yang snod du chung / /gsungs/ sngon mi rkang zha zhig yod pa rkun ma 'gas khyer nas/ kho rang tsho la gnod sbyin zhig yod pa sha khrag gis mchod snyam nas gsod grabs byas tshe/mi rkang zha de skrag nas sangs rgyas la skyabs 'gro byas pas/sangs rgyas kyis mkhyen nas gnod sbyin de 'dra zhig tu sprul nas 'ong / 'di ma gsod par bdag la gson por phul smras pas/ rkun ma rnams kyis gnod sbyin yin snyam nas ma bsad par phul bas tshe thar gsungs/ yang sbrul gnyis la mkha' lding gis gtses dus/ skyabs 'gro byas pas mkha' lding gis gnod 630

ma nus pas/ khyed gnyis gnod skyel mi thub pa ci yin dris pas/ sbrul gnyis kyis skyabs 'gro byas pa yin smras pas/mkha' lding gnyis kyang ngo mtshar skyes/ bzhi bos skyabs 'gro byas pas/ phyis phyogs bzhi'i rgyal chen sde bzhir gyur/ yang sngon rgya mtsho'i gling du tshong pa mang bo song ba/ chu srin gye khar chud pas skyabs 'gro byas pas chu srin gdug pa can gyi kha nas thar ro/ /yang sngon rkun ma zhig gis bla ma skyabs 'gro byed mkhan zhig la rkus byed du song bas/ bla mas skyabs 'gro byas pa'i mthus nang du 'dzul ma nus par sgo brdung bos nas khyod la yon bdag 'di 'dra zhig gis byin pa'i nom pa 'dra zhig yod pa de nga la mar byin/ mi ster na nang du 'ongs nas ngan gsod byas khyer ba yin zhes sdig nas skrag bslangs tshe/ bla ma skyabs 'gro pas skrag pa ltar mdzad de/ ya ya nang du 'ongs nas ma gsod dang mar khyer 'ongs nas ster zhes thag pa zhig khyer/ sgo ma phyes par sgo khung zhig yod pa de nas rkun ma la khyod kyis lag pa tshur thongs dang ngas ster smras pas/ rkun mas lag pa btang tshe lag mgo nas bzung thag pas bsdams nas ka ba zhig yod pa de la btags/ bo co sbom bo zhig bzung nas sgo phyes te song rkun ma'i steng du/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o 631

zhes shed kyis gcig brgyab/ chos la skyabs su mchi'o zhes yang gcig brgyab/ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o zhes yang gcig brgyab/ gsum po de brgyab nas slar nang du song sgo brgyab thag pa grol nas btang tshe/ rkun ma 'khyog gi 'khyog gi phar song /'gro ma thub par zam pa zhig gi 'og nas bsdad de 'dang brgyab nas/ dkon mchog gsum yin ne bzang / bzhi lnga tsam zhig yod kyi yin na des rang gsod gi dkon mchog gsum po thugs rje che snyam dad pa zhig skyes/ skyabs 'gro byed kyin bsdad pas/ zam pa de'i steng du lha 'dre mang bo 'gro ma nus par zam pa'i sne la 'tshogs nas sdod pa la/ gzhan lha 'dre mthong mkhan zhig gis khyed tsho mi 'gro bar 'di ru ci la 'tshogs bsdad ces dris pas/ lha 'dre rnams kyis zam 'og 'di na mi zhig gis skyabs 'gro byas pa'i stabs kyis 'gro ma nus zer/yang sum cu rtsa gsum/ gyi lha'i bu gcig gis me tog gi rgyan rnying ba sogs 'chi ltas byung zhing / shi nas rgyal po'i khab tu sha za mo phag mgo can gyi mngal du skye ba shes nas/ kyi hud sum cu rtsa gsum zhes smre sngags 'don zhing sdug bsngal bsran mi bzod pa lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis mthong nas dris pas sngar gyi 'chi ltas de dag bshad tshe/ de nas brgya byen snying rje chen po skyes 632

nas/ thabs gzhan med kyi skyabs 'gro gyis shig ces gsungs/lha des skyabs 'gro byas pas shi nas dga' ldan du skyes gsungs/ des na dus rgyun du blo rtse dkon mchog gsum la gtad nas nangs nub kun tu skyabs 'gro byed pa gal che/ yang lha la yon chab mar me bdug spos maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul yang /dge ba 'di'i mthus bdag myur du sangs rgyas nas sems can thams cad la phan rgya chen po thogs par gyur cig ces sgon sems bskyed dang bzang / ri mgo tsho la song dus/ me tog mdzes pa chu mtsho yid 'ong lo tog bzang po nags tshal me tog 'bras bus brgyan pa sogs/ dngos po yid du 'ong ba ci mthong yang yid kyis mdun gye nam mkhar bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad khra lam me bzhugs par mos la drung du phul bar dmigs la/ bdag gis dge ba 'dis mtshon pa'i dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ bdag ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig ces smon sems bskyed dang bzang / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen bo rje dge legs rgya mtshos/ ne'u gsing me tog gis brgyan pa gzigs na yang /sa gzhi spos byugs ma gsungs nas maṇ+ḍal phul/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma gsungs nas sems bskyed re gnang skad/ de ni 633

gnad shin tu che ste/ sngon bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong gi nang nas 'ga' res/ shing bu rde'u rtswa'i sgron me skud pa'i chun po ras kyi kha tshar sogs phul nas/ dge ba 'di'i mthus bdag gis ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par shog ces sems bskyed mdzad nas sangs rgyas pa yin pas/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang de ltar deng sang byas na ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas pa'i skal ba yod nges/ de ltar dngos po yid du 'ong ba ci mthong yang sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la mchod par phul nas sems bskyed sbyong ba'i tshul mdo sde dkon mchog sprin las gsal bar gsungs so/ /yang khyed blo ma thob rnams kyis bdag 'dzin 'joms pa'i tho ba/ dge tshogs sdud pa'i rgya mtsho/ rang gzhan 'tshang ba'i nor bu lta bu'i theg chen blo sbyong ltar/ bdag gzhan bde sdug brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che sgoms dang bzang / de ji ltar sgom zer na/ tshe sngon drin gyis yang yang bskyangs pa'i pha ma sems can thams cad spyir 'khor ba khyad par ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal gyes mnar ba 'di kun snying re rje sdug bsngal dang bral nas bde ba dang ldan na ci ma rung / da ni bdag gis pha ma sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal tshur blangs nas sdug bsngal dang bral bar bya/ bdag gi 634

bde dge phar byin nas bde ba dang ldan pa zhig bya snyam du/thog mar rang gi tshe 'di'i ma'i sdug bsngal sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa 'od zer nag po'i rnam par tshur byung /rang gi snying dkyil na rgyun du nga nga zer ba'i mi dgos dgu dgos mi 'khyug pa'i bdag 'dzin 'phung rgan gyi steng du babs nas nag thul le btang / ma sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu thams cad dang bral song snyam du bsgom/ yang rang gi bde dge thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par song nas rang gi ma'i lus la sib sib thim pas/ ma gnas skabs su bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgya nus pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag song snyam du sgom/ de bzhin pha la bsgom/ de nas ma sems can thams cad kyi lus kyi na tsha sems kyi sdug bsngal las nyon gyi sgrib pa thams cad tshur blangs nas sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral song snyam du bsgom/ yang rang gi bde ba dang dge tshogs thams cad phar btang ba'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par bsgom/ de ltar bsgom na dngos su bde sdug brje ma thub kyang / bsam pa bzang po de 'dra ba lan cig yid la dran kyang bsod nams dpag med thob ste/ sngon rgan mo ma bu gnyis chus khyer bas ma yis bu mo gces phrug ma 'dis 635

chu 'di'i phar khar nyes skyon med par bud na ci ma rung mo shi yang ched snyam/ bu mos a ma drin can ma 'di chu yi pha khar nyes skyon med par bde mo byas cig bud na ci ma rung snyam pa'i ngang nas shi song bas ma bu gnyis ka lha yul zhig tu skyes song / yang sngon bya sa'i ko khar mi mang bo ko ba la zhugs nas song / chu dkyil du thon dus gru chu nang du byung snyam byas tshe gru pas/ chu la rkyal shes pa zhig yod na gru nang nas phyir bud dang cung lci song zer/ chu la rkyal shes pa med pas ma bud tshe/ nang nas bang chen pa gcig gis mi 'di kun chu nang du ma song ba byas/bdag gcig pa shi na drag snyam chu la rkyal mi shes rung mig zum nas chu nang du lding bas/ de ma thag nam mkha' nas gru khar 'ja' tshon 'then/ kho rang yang ma shi bar chu'i pha khar thon skad/ yang sngon mdza' bo'i bu mo rgya mtshor 'gro dus/ mas bu yi rkang ba nas bzung ste/ kho mo bor nas ma 'gro zhes ngus nas bshad kyang ma nyan khros nas ma'i mgo rkang bas phul te song /gru btang nas rgya mtshor zhugs nas song tshe chu srin dang nya'i rigs kyis gru bshig pas tshong pa lnga brgya tsam zhig chu nang du shor tshe/ mdza' bo'i bu mo gru tshal zhig la 'jus nas skam sar phyin/ grong khyer bzhi mthong nas rim bzhin song bde ba myang /636

de nas lcags khang zhig mthong nang du zhugs pa dang sgo bcad/de bzhin sgo gsum gyi nang du rim gyes zhugs pa dang rim pa bzhin sgo bcad do/ /de na skyes bu lus rab tu che ba zhig gi mgo la lcags kyi 'khor lo me 'bar ba me lce gcig tu gyur pa zhig 'khor bas mgo las rnag khrag byung ba za ba mthong nas/ khyod ci'i phyir 'di ltar gyur zhes dris pas/ ngas ma la gnod pa byas phyir ro smras/ mdza' bo'i bu mos ngas kyang ma la gnod pa byas pa'i las kyis 'dir khrid nas 'ong snyam pa dang / de ma thag nam mkha' nas bcings pa thar ma bcings pa bcings zhes pa'i sgra byung ma thag tu mdza' bo'i bu mo'i mgo thog tu 'khor lo me 'bar ba de byung nas drag tu 'khor bas sdug bsngal gyes gzir tshe/ sems can rnams la snying rje skyes/ ngas sems can thams cad kyi don du 'khor lo 'di bzod par bya yi/ gzhan gang gis kyang 'di 'dra'i las byas pa de dag 'dir ma 'ong cig ces smras ma thag tu/ mgo yi 'khor lo de nam mkha' la 'phags nas 'dug pa dang / de'ang shi 'phos nas dga' ldan du skyes gsungs/ yang de bzhin gshegs pa dmyal ba'i shing rta 'dren pa'i gyad du sgyes pa'i tshe/ khong dang dmyal ba pa gzhan zhig gis a ba glang gi shing rta lcags kyi sa gzhi me 637

'bar ba'i thang la drangs pa dang / khong gnyis stobs chung bas ma 'drongs pas/ dmyal srung rnams kyis mtshon cha rab tu 'bar bas bsnun cing 'tshog pa'i tshe shin tu sdug bsngal ba la/khong gi bsam pa la gnyis gas kyang mi 'drongs pas nam yang sdug bsngal mtshungs par 'dug bdag gcig pus drangs te sdug bsngal bar byas la/ 'di bde bar bzhugs dgos dgongs te/ dmyal bsrung rnams la 'di'i thag pa yang nga'i gnya' bar thogs shig bdag gcig pus drangs par bya'o/ /zhes pas dmyal srung na re/ khyod snying rje che ba zhig yod zer nas lcags kyi tho ba mgo la brgyab pas/ khong tshe 'phos te lhar skyes gsungs/ des na phan yon shin tu che/ de ltar 'dun pa drag pos gtong len yang yang byas na dngos su gtong len thub pa'i dus kyang yod srid de/ sngon bla ma zhig gis mthong yul gye khye rkun gcig la gzhan mi zhig gis rdo yis brgyab pa bla mas tshur khong gi steng du blangs pas/ na zug byung nas a yo gsungs pa grwa pa rnams kyis e bden snyam je tshom skyes tshe/ bla ma des rgyab bstan pas sku sha skrangs yod pa mthong nas kun yid ches dad pa skyes skad/ de ltar len nus na rang gis mi dge ba byas pa'i rnam smin min/ bsam bzhin ma sems can 638

thams cad kyi sdug bsngal blangs bde dge btang ba las byung ba yin pas myur du tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag nas 'tshang rgya ba yin/ gal te tshe 'dir 'tshang mi rgya yang / shi ma thag nas bde ba can sogs sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam par dag par skye ste/ sngon bka' gdams bla ma zhig gis sku gshegs khar grwa pa rnams la/ ma bzang ngas bsam pa ltar mi 'grub kyi gsungs/khong gi thugs dgongs gang lags zhus tshe/ sdug bsngal tshad med myong ba'i drin can pha ma sems can thams cad dmyal bar 'gro ba'i tshab tu bdag gcig pu song nas dmyal ba'i me nang nas bsdad na snyam pa yin te/ 'dod thog tu mi 'gro bar gda'/ da dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig 'char ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams zhig tu 'gro nges gsungs/ 'o na rang nyid sangs rgya ba'i ched du dmigs nas dge ba gang byas thams cad sems can thams cad la btang na/ rang nyid sangs e rgyas snyam na/ dper na khyem tshang zhig gis gro nas sran ma sogs khyem na gang yod zhing sa bzang bo phar btab na/ ston brgya stong 'gyur gyis 'phel tshe de kun tshur blangs na/ myur du phyug por 'gyur ba bzhin 'di ltar dge ba gang byas mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad la phan phyir btang na/ sems can la 639

grangs med pa bzhin bsod nams dpag tu med pa 'byung / de kun rang sangs rgyas phyir bsngos na myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur gsungs/ yang rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis snang kyis snang ba 'di thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam chu zla ltar rang bzhin gyis grub pa rdul tsam yang med pas de bzhin sgoms gsungs pa ltar/ rang gi lus sems yul mkhar khang khyim sa chu me rlung / sems na thams cad snang yang 'dzin rgyu bcing rgyu gang yang med/ dper na rgya sgyu ma mkhan gyis sgyes pa bud med rta dang glang bo sprul ba snang yang rang bzhin gyis grub pa med pa dang / mtshan mo gnyid dus su rmi lam bzang ngan gang rmis kyang rang bzhin gyis grub pa med pa dang / chu nang du zla gzugs shar ba sa ler snang yang 'dzin rgyu reg rgyu gang yang med pa dang 'dra snyam du sgoms dang bzang / de ltar sgyu ma lta bu'i stong nyid bsgom nus na/ skabs shig lus bal ltar brgyangs 'dam ltar brdzis kyang sdug bsngal mi 'byung / gzhan pha rol gyi mi dang dud 'gro sogs kyis sems la gang dran shes pa sogs mngon shes 'char/ nam mkha' la 'phur ri brag la 'dzul nus pa sogs rdzu 'phrul kyang thob par 'gyur gsungs/yang sngon gyi rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi rnam thar ltar 640

sdug bsngal mi dge nyon mongs thams cad skye ba'i gzhi khyem nas rab tu byung na bzang / khyem ni sdug bsngal gye 'byung khungs yin te 'byor na nyin par gyi lto bcag mtshan mo'i gnyid bcag nas bsrung dgos pa'i sdug bsngal/ dbul na sha thang thang du btsal kyang mi rnyed pa'i sdug bsngal sogs shin tu che ste/ skyes rabs las/ btson ra 'dra ba'i khyim la ni/ /nam yang bde bar ma sems cig /phyug gam yang na dbul yang rung / /khyim na gnas pa nad du che/ /gcig ni bsrung ba'i nyon mongs la/ /gnyis pa 'tshol bas sha thang ngo / /zhes gsungs/khyem bzung na/ zhing las 'tsho skyong thabs med du byed dgos/ma byas na kha mi sos/ byas phyin chad mi dge sdig pa mi byed pa'i rang dbang med/ dge ba zhig yong dka'/ rong gi zhing pa rnams kyis mdzo glang la sdug bsngal bskol lcag dang dbyug pas rdung cung zad ma song bar bsdad na shugs drag rdung / ded nas zhing rmos dus zhing gi steng na 'bu ci yod thams cad sa 'og tu 'gro/ sa 'og na 'bu ci yod sa steng du 'phud/ bya bye'us 'thu nyi mas bsregs/ zhing la chu gtong dus nya che chung mang bo zhing gi steng du bkram/ zhing steng na grog ma sogs 'ba' 'bu yod tshad chu'i nang du 'gro/ zhing re re'i steng nas 641

'bu khri phrag mang bo gsod/ gro dang / nas dang / lhag par sran ma 'breg dus steng na 'bu sngo ljang chung chung bye ba dung phyur yod pa/ rkang lag gnyis gas gcur/ de bzhin du log rgyag dus/ bo tho rdung dus ldum bu bsal dus rnams su sems can phra mo bgrang gis mi langs pa gsod/ 'brog gi phyug po rnams kyis/ nyin re bzhin rta nor rnga mong lhag par ra lug brgya stong mang bo dus gcig tu ri la ded dus/ lam dang ri mgo de na 'bu yod tshad rmug bsdus byas gcur/ rtsi shing me tog bcom lug dzi yar langs dus phar song dus/ sar bsdad dus rnams su 'bu mang bo gcur/ ma mo lug gi rgyab kyi bal len dus dang /ra lug la shig rtsi byed dus gte le dang shig khri phrag 'bum phrag 'chi/ nor gyi lci ba rlon pa spang steng du skyar dus 'bu mang bo gsod/ khang ba'i sa rdo re len dus kyang 'bu mang bo gsod/dbyar gye lci skam dang shing skam rul ba'i me 'bud dus 'bu mang bo mes 'tshig lo re bzhin ra lug 'bri g.yag rtol le lu gu rnams rang gis bsad pa dang / gzhan rgya sogs la btsongs nas bsad pa dang / rta bong mdzo g.yag re'u lu gu brgya stong mang bo'i 'og gi 'bras bu dbyung ba sogs zhib tu soms dang shin tu ngan/ khyem pa 'ga' res kho bos sdig pa ma byas/642

gzhan zhig la yang sdig pa med zer ba de glen gtam rdzun bshad ni yin ga la med/ gzhan yang ma byen len mi tshangs spyod dzun phra ma tshig rtsub ngag 'khyal/ brnab sems gnod sems log lta/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal phrag dog ser sna sogs mi byed pa'i dbang med de/ skyes rabs las/khyem gyi so nam byas na ni/ /dzun du mi smras mi rung zhing / /pha rol nyes pa byed pa la/ /nan tur mi bya mi rung ngo / /zhes gsungs/ khyim thab bzung phyin steng du nyi ma re re bzhin sdig pa khal dang khur bo byas 'ong tshul bsam na phyi mar gang du 'gro snyam 'jigs skrag skye/ khyem par mi skye ba'i smon lam thobs/rab byung las can tsho de'i skyid la/ mar log 'jog pa rnams kyi snying la gdon ci zhig zhugs pa yin nam zer dgos pa'i tshod yi // des na khyod tsho'i bu tsha re yod pa rnams kyis thams cad khyem gyi me dong du ma 'phen dang bzang / yang bu 'ga' res pha ma la nga rab tu byung chos shig byed ces gnang ba zhus na gnang ba mi ster ba 'di sdig pa shin tu lci ste/ 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ gang zhig rab tu byung bar 'dod pa de'i gegs byas shing / bshol btab par gyur na ni/khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi mig phyung ba'i sdig 643

pa dang mnyam gsungs/ grogs byas na khams gsum gye sems can thams cad kyi mig phyung ba la slar mig bcug pa bas bsod nams che gsungs/ bu rab tu byung chos sgrub na cha bzhi byas pas cha gnyis ma'i thob cha gnyis pha dang bu la thob pas pha ma bu gsum la bzang / bu khyim du bsdad de sdig pa byas na cha bzhi byas pas cha gnyis mar thob/ cha gnyis pha dang bu gnyis la thob pas lhag par ma la ngan/ des na pha ma bu gsum 'tsheng bar 'dod pas gnang ba byen nas rab tu byung chos byed du bcug na bzang / rab tu byung ba dang chos byed 'dod pa la bar chad byas na pha ma yin yang bdud yin te/ yum las/ bdud slob dpen gyi cha byad can/ pha dang ma'i cha byad can/ bu dang bu mo sring mo la sogs pa'i cha byad can no zhes gsungs/ bka' gdams bla ma 'ga' res/ sdig pa'i grogs po yin zer nas/ lus la ras gos gyon gdong la thal ba byugs lag tu dbyug pa bzung / kha gdangs so gtsigs mig gcer nas nub nam gung brgyud nas mngon sum du 'ongs nas bar chad byed mkhan zhig med de/ sha tsha tsha snying nye nye byas rgyu nom bza' btung cung zad re byin thabs kyis tshe 'dir khrid nas/ chos byed du ma bcug na pha ma yin yang bdud yin pas/644

de dang rgyab sprod byed dgos gsungs/ sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la yang yab dang blon 'bangs sogs kyis gnang ba ma byin tshe/ mtshan mo zhig la bros nas song / mchod rten chen po rnam dag drung nas dbu skra bsil rab tu byung ba yin/ pha mas gnang ba gtan nas mi ster na/ bu rgod rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar ltar la yog nas bros/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung du song la rab byung gyis/ khyem pa dang rab byung gnyis ka khyad par gnam sa bas kyang che ste/ khyem na gnas pa rnams me 'obs su gnas pa dang 'dra/ rab tu byung ba rnams bsil sar thon pa dang 'dra/ zhes sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis khyem pa dang rab byung gnyis la khyad par che tshul brgya phrag mang bo gsungs/ rab tu byung na khyem pa ltar mi dge sdig pa byed mi dgos pas dge ba shugs kyis yong / rab tu byung ba'i phan yon bshad rgyu yin na ri rab lhun po bas kyang dpangs mtho/ rgya mtsho bas kyang gting zab/nam mkha' bas kyang rgya che gsungs/ des na sngon yul ko sa li zhes bya ba'i khyem bdag tan byi lis zer ba zhig la/ rin chen sna lnga'i khang bzang lha yi bu mo las mdzes pa'i chung ma/ ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas/ 'jam mdzes yang ba'i gos chen/ nor bu 645

'od 'bar sogs 'dod yon longs spyod dpag med yod kyang bskyur nas/ sangs rgyas kyi drung du song nas rab tu byung gsungs/ de la bltas na rang res tsho khang rnying dud dreg ma dang / chung ma sngo mchu re nor rdzas ngan ngon re la chags nas rab tu mi 'byung ba de dper na khye rgan rus to dang / phag pa mi gtsang ba la chags pa dang 'dra bas/ khyem gyi nyes dmigs dang rab tu byung ba'i phan yon bsams nas rab tu byung ba shin tu gal che/ rab tu byung ma thag nas tshe 'di'i bya ba spangs nas chos ldan gyi bya ba byed dgos pas/ bla ma bsten la bka' chos nyon rab kyis ri khrod dben pa/ 'bring gis dgon pa gang bzang / tha mas yul du 'dug kyang rang shong khang ba bzos nas/ sku gsung thugs rten bkram/ mchod bshams legs pa byos dge sbyor rnam dag gyis/ rab tu byung nas dge ba bsgrub na bsod nams chen po thob/ khyim pas mar khu rgya mtsho tsam la sdong bu ri rab tsam zhig btsugs nas lha la mar me phul ba bas/ rab tu byung bas mar khu thigs pa tsam la sdong bu khab rtse tsam zhig btsugs nas mar me phul ba bsod nams che ste/ rin po che'i phung bo las/ stong gsum gyi sems can thams cad theg chen la zhugs te 'khor bsgyur gyi rgyal srid dang ldan 646

pa re res kyang / mar me'i snod rgya mtsho tsam la snying bo ri rab tsam gye mar mes sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten la mchod pa las/byang sems khyim nas byung bas mar me snying bo 'bru mar gyes bskus pas mchod rten gyi drung du 'dzin pa'i bsod nams kyi brgya'i char yang mi phod par gsungs/ de bzhin du khyem pas nas khal brgya stong sprang slong la sbyin pa btang ba bas rab byung gis zan chang zhig byin pa bsod nams che ste/ de bzhin kha ton bzlas brjod thos bsam bsgom gsum gang byas kyang bsod nams che/ des na rab tu byung nas dge ba bsgrub na khe che ste/ yang deng sang rab byung byas pa phal cher de phar khyem nas khyem med par rab tu byung ba zhig dang mi 'dra/ tshur khyim bdag gi chung ma'am mna' ma'i thog tu byung ba zhig dang 'dra ste/ rab tu byung ma thag tu khyim tshang nas blo rgod yar 'jog can zhig gis song / de'i steng du rgyu nom rtsad nas 'then sprug rgyongs gsum byed dus shed can zhig tu song / skabs shig rtsag rgan skya ldang nga che zhig lus la gon gzan chung chung zhig rked du bcings/ dgung mo lon na mi skya'i chung ma'am yang na mna' ma/yang na gzhan khyim tshang 'ga' res can du lhab lhab lhab rgyuganyin par lon na na tsha yod pa'am yang na she chad dang tshong zhig 647

gar yod sar rgyug mi slebs sa med/ grong chog rkyang byas/rgyu nom rkyang btsal tshar dom rkyang btang / khe tshong rkyang byas/khab bsog nas 'bug 'bug bsogs nas gri byed e thub/kha dar ras kha tsam re'i steng nas kyang 'chi no mi shes/ gzhan la na tsha shi chad cig byung ba go na kho bo e 'bod snyam/ grong chog byed bsam na mtshan mo gnyid mi 'ong / song na ja mar bzang ngan go re'i che chung stan gyi srab 'thug bud med kyi yag rtsog sogs bshad nas cho ga smon lam gtsang ma zhig mi 'don/de ring 'bul ba ji 'dra zhig yod snyam 'bul ba ngan nam chung na sems mi dga'/ khos sha rin ma lon ni 'dra ltar byas de tshang la ngan gtam/ tshur 'ong khyem tshang bza' ba kha tshag byas sdig rdung / lug gcig gsod kyang ga zer kha slebs/lag kyang slebs la byed/ skabs shig nas tsha bo dang mna' ma'i lag tu dbang shor/ rgas pas grong chog tu 'gro mi thub/bsda da na khyem tshang gis mi 'dod/ shi tshe khye shi ba bzhin bla rgan gar shi mi shes/ 'ga' res bla rgan de zhes smras na de gna' zhig nas shi tshar zer/ a ma khos da min ma go yod 'dang byas/de tshang phyug po yin bla rgan la dge ji 'dra zhig bcos zhes dris na/ kha rgod 'ga' res bcos bcos sde ba'i mi thams cad 648

kha la 'bab ni zhig bcos/ phyin chad dpe 'then tshad du 'jog ni zhig bcos zer ha bgad byed/ yang 'ga' res dgon du bsdad kyang rgyab 'gres rgyab/ rgyu nom pa'i steng nas mgo brdung / rdzun g.yo sgyu byas/ khe tshong zhing las la 'bad/lkog nas nag mo dang dud chang bsten/ 'grig lam kun spyod mi brtsi/ bshig e thub blta/ bla ma la ngan sna tshogs gtam/ dge bskul dbu mdzad la lan byas/ dge 'dun pa'i thugs dkrugs pa sogs byas na/ rab tu ma byung ba'i khyim pa rnams las thu/ khyem pas de'i lhag mi byed/ 'di mi byed pa'i phyir rab tu byung ba yin mod/ byed na rab tu byung nas ci byed/ de la dgongs nas rje mi las kyang / grong ltag gi dgon chung khra bo de/ /ming dgon par btags kyang grong pa yin/ /bka' gdams kyi btsun chung sring rdo mgo /ming btsun par btags kyang lus bsgyur yin/ /zhes gsungs pa red/ rab tu byung nas sdig pa byas na nyes pa shin tu che/ khyim pas gzhan gye mi zhig bsad pa bas/ rab tu byung bas rang gi shig gcig bsad pa nyes pa che/ khyem pas rta zhig brkus pa bas/ rab tu byung bas khab gcig brkus pa nyes pa che/ de bzhin du chos min gye bya ba chen po byas na nyes pa shin tu che ba sgos ci dgos/ gong gi tshig 649

de'i nang du 'dus yod soms dang ha go yong / des na rab tu byung ba rnams kyis chos min gyi bya ba 'di 'dra gtan nas byed mi rung / yang gang du 'gro'am 'dug kyang dus rgyun du bsam pa dkar bo gyis dang bzang / bsam pa dkar bo ci ltar byed dgos zer na/ nad kyis thebs pa'i skye bo/ shan pas gsod pa'i ra lug rngon pa'i khye yis 'ded pa'i ri dwags/ khra yis 'dzin pa'i bya bye'u/ rkang bas gcur ba'i 'bu ro smad sa la 'byar nas ro stod 'gul ba/ khye la rdo dang dbyug pas brgyab nas skad ngan ring nge ba sogs/ sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i sems can mthong na/ rang gi skye ba sngon mar pha mar gyur pa'i sems can 'di rnams kyis da lta sdug bsngal myong ba snying rje/da sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral na ci ma rung /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur ces snying rje tshad med bsgom/ yang zas gos med pa'i sprang slong / rtswa chu ma rnyed pa'i dud 'gro/ rgyu nom ma rnyed pa'i dbul bo/ bu dang tsha bo med pa'i rab chad/ lha chos med pa'i skye bo pho mo sogs/bde ba med pa'i sems can mthong na/ skye ba sngon ma rnams su rang gi pha dang ma byas pa'i drin can 'di rnams la da lta bde ba gang yang med pa snying re rje/ da bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu 650

dang ldan na ci ma rung / bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces byams pa tshad med bsgom/ yang lus la na zug sems la sdug bsngal med par 'khor nor longs spyod 'dzom dam pa'i lha chos byas shin tu bde zhing skyid pa'i sems can mthong na/ rang gi skye ba sngon ma rnams su pha ma byas nas drin gyis bskyangs pa'i sems can 'di rnams la 'di 'dra'i kha skyid po lus bde mo byung bde ba'i rgyu chos kyang byed pa 'di a re dga' dwangs re spro/ da 'di sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba 'di dang nam yang ma bral na ci ma rung / sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig ces dga' ba tshad med bsgom/yang rang gzhan la nye ring gnyis phyes/ rang phyogs kyi sems can gang la zhen cing chags nas phan gang thogs byas/ gzhan phyogs kyi sems can gang mthong yang zhe sdang langs nas ngo tsho gnas 'gyur dmar bo'am nag por song / tshig ngan smras brdeg brdung byed pa'i sems can mthong na/ rang gi skye ba sngon ma'i pha ma 'di rnams kyis nye ring chags sdang byas/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal gyi rgyu rnams sgrub pa snying re rje/ da 'di rnams nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral nas pha ma spun zla ltar 'grogs/ gcig gis gcig la gang mkho sbyin par 651

btang / skyid na mnyam skyid byas/ skyid sdug mgo snyoms po zhig byung na ci ma rung / nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces btang snyoms tshad med bsgom/ de bzhin du nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la tshad med bzhi bsgom dgos/ de ji ltar bsgom na/ rang gi tshe 'di'i drin can pha ma rgan rgon gnyis kyis gtso byas pas ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che ma thob bar du bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang dge ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba dang bral/ sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang skad cig tsam yang ma bral/ nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas na ci ma rung snyam du/ ngag 'don du/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces brjod/ tshad med bzhi 652

bsgom pa 'di la bsam pa dkar bo zer/ bsam pa dkar po zer ba de dung dang zho 'dra bas/ dkar bo gcig la mi zer/'di ltar bsam pa dkar bo byas na phan yon shin tu che/dper na ras gzhi dkar bo'i ngos la lha sku ci bris kyang legs pa bzhin mi des ci byas thams cad legs/ rtsa ba sman yin na yal ga dang lo ma thams cad sman du 'gyur ba ltar/ bsam pa dkar ba'i mi des lus ngag gis ci byas thams cad dge bar 'gyur ci bsam thams cad yid bzhin 'grub/ bsam pa dkar bo zhig khog na gnas phyin mi de la de'i phan gyi dge ba mi dgos/ yid bzhin gye nor bu yod pa'i mi la kun rtsis che zhing mchod bstod bkur ba ltar/ bsam pa dkar ba'i mi de la thams cad kyis 'dang che/ lha 'dre mi gsum gyis byams/ yid bzhin gye nor bu las ci 'dod zas nor longs spyod thams cad 'byung ba ltar/ bsam pa dkar bo las ci 'dod bde skyid thams cad 'byung / bod gangs cad khrod kyi sems can thams cad la sdug bsngal med par bde na snyam na/ tshe phyi mar de la dbang ba'i rgyal por skye/ lho 'dzam bu gling lta bu'i sems can thams cad la sdug bsngal med par bde na snyam na/ de la dbang ba'i rgyal po chen por skye/ gling bzhi'i sems can thams 653

cad la sdug bsngal med bde ba dang ldan na snyam na/ de la dbang bsgyur ba'i stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por skye/stong gsum gyi sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral bde ba dang ldan na snyam na/ de la dbang ba'i lha chen tshangs pa lta bur skye/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can ci yod yongs su rdzogs pa sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang ldan na ci ma rung bsam na/ ma 'ongs pa na 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon skyabs byed pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob gsungs/ des na phyi lus ngag gis chos chen po byed ma thub kyang / nang sems kyi bsam pa dkar bo gyis dang / 'di bas lhag pa'i chos shig gzhan na med bsam pa dkar bo byed pa 'di la rgyu nom pa phar 'chor mi dgos tshegs chung don che/des na ma bzang mos bu chung de mi brjed pa dus rtag tu sems kyis byams pa ltar/ ma sems can thams cad sems kyis mi brjed par dus rtag tu bsam pa dkar bo byed pa 'di shin tu gal che/ yang rgyu nom pa yod pa'i phyug po phal cher gyes/rgyu nom gyi mchod sbyin byas na zad 'gro bas/ zad na khyem tshang bza' mi'i kha skyid po lus bde mo mi 'ong gi gzhan gyis 'dang rtsis sgo med snyam nas/ rgyu nom yod kyin yod kyin je ser du 654

song brgya thog tu stong mkho/ khyem phyags nang gi nas 'bras bal rdul yan chad blangs nas yar tshags byas/ bla ma bsod snyoms pa byung na sgor mi 'bud/ sprang slong nyam thag byung na khye mi 'gog rgyu nom cung zad tsam yang gzhan la ster ba phar zhogakhyem tshang bza' ba'i khar za ru mi 'jug rgyab tu gon du mi 'jug rang gis khar za ma phod rgyab tu gon mi thub/ ngan ngon re zos rtsag chad re gon pas ming phyug po zer yang / don gye dbul bo'i lus blangs pa'i ser sna can gye rgad po kha ser ra mgo che/ rgan mo ske phra mgo zing nga tshos cung zad khom dus dang mtshan mo nyal ba'i dus 'di ltar 'dang re rgyobs dang / mchod sbyin re byed nus/ 'ga' res rgyu mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil ba 'dra zhes sangs rgyas kyi gsung / rtswa kha'i zil ba de skam ni ma 'dod kyang / nyi ma phog na rtswa rtse na yod pa rnams dkar khrom mer rtsa bar lhung nas sa la thim pa dang nyi mas skam pa gnyis ka byas yun ring mi 'gor bar/ dang po byung ba'i shul tsam yang mi shes par skam thag ge 'gro ba ltar/ rgyu nom gcig tsam nga/nga rang gis zad na mi 'dod kyang / dbang chen gyis 'phrogadabang chung gis rkus/ nad dang mu ge gnyis kyis shi nas yun ring mi 'gor bar rgyu nor byung ba'i shul tsam yang mi shes par 655

stong hang nge 'gro ba'i dus tshod cig yong nges/ mi na ning yod pa da lo med/ /zas kha sang yod pa de ring tshar/ /zer ba ltar/na ning rta brgya yod pa/ rkun mas khyer/ jag pas ded/ nad dang mu ge byung nas shi da lo rta rgan rgod ma bcu stod re'am/re gnyis re ma gtogs med pa mang / de bzhin sngar lo ra lug stong phrag can tsho nad dang mu ges shi kha bas mnan nas/phyir lo lnga brgya'am brgya re lnga bcu re min med pa mang / nor brgya phrag yod pa rnams kyang nor nad gor dang sa skyon mu ge sogs byung nas shi bas nor gcig gnyis min med pa yang mang / des na sangs rgyas kyis/ rgyu mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil ba 'dra/gsungs pa de bden mi bden bsam shes tshos soms dang ha go yong / rgyu med tshe gzhan 'ga' res na ning de la nor lug cig mang / da ci yang med par lhas tsho stong ba red zer/ khyem tshang bza' ba 'ga' res/ a ho na ning nor lug de 'dra zhig yod dus chos shig bcos na ched de dus ci byung / da ma bzang zer 'gyod pa skyes/ yang rgyu nom pa ci tsam yod kyang 'chi ba'i nangs par 'jog lo brgya 'dang ba'e zas yod kyang / 'chi ba'i nangs par khog stong 'gro/ lo brgya thub pa'i gos yod kyang / 'chi ba'i nangs par gcer bur 'gro/ gser dngul 656

g.yu byur brgya yod kyang / 'chi ba'i nangs par lag stong 'gro/rta mdzo glang chen brgya yod kyang / 'chi ba'i nangs par rkang thang 'gro/ gnyen bshes mdza' grogs brgya yod kyang / 'chi ba'i nangs par gcig pur 'gro/ gsungs/ des na sngon chad phyug po ser sna can 'ga' res rgyu nom pa bsags bsags nas/ bsags tshad 'chi ba'i nangs par bkal khur nas song zer ba e yod cig ltos soms dang / nam yang gzhan gyis khyer rgyu yin na da lta rang gi mig gis bltas lag gis yar dkon mchog la mchod pa/ mar dbul bo la sbyin pa byas na bzang mod/ ma 'ongs pa na brgya stong 'gyur gyes bsod nams thob pas don la phyi mar khyer ba dang khyad med/ lhag par khyer tshul de legs dka' las mang mi dgos gcig tsam chud zos su 'gro ba phar zhog brgya stong 'gyur gyi je mang je cher song /phyi mar song na bcol ba'i nor dang 'phrad pa ltar 'phrad nas blangs chog des na mi yi skye 'chi la khrig khrig med sang gnangs lta bu la yang rang mi 'chi ba'i nges pa med/ phyug po'i gces phrug tsho glo bur du shi ba soms dang / thams cad de'i rang bzhin yin/ nam 'chi cha med shi dus rgyu nom pa shul du bsdus/lus na sngar byin na mi 'dod pa'i don med rkyang ba'i lag tu 657

song / rang phyi mar lag stong du 'gro/ yang rgyu nom pa 'di bsam pa nag thog mar cung zad phan/ phyi nas pham chen po glan/ phyug po rta nor 'dzom dus cung zad skyid kyang / phyis nad dang mu ges shi na sems sdug jag pa rkun mas ded na dngangs shing skrag phyi la ra mda' rgyug na pha gsod pa'i steng du bu gsod/ bu'i steng du tsha bo yang rmas nas nyin re la mi zad rgyu zad gnyis ka dus gcig 'byung / bla rgan 'ga' res grong chog rkyang bdas/ khe tshong rkyang byas/ rgyu nom mang bo 'dzom tshe/ rkun ma heb rgan tshos go na 4 'ong / nub nam gung la gtad de nyal sa nas mnan bla rgan gyis 'di ci yin snyam mgo yar btegs tshe/ rdo yis brgyab nas he ring nge gtong he btab na gon pa kha nang du brdzangs nas kha sna zum/ 'phags na rdo dang dbyug pas brdung rkang lag bkyigs nas gsod la byas/ sngar sdug dka' las myangs nas bsags tshad thams cad dgong ma gcig la khyer nas stong hang nge gtong / ngas de 'dra sngar mang bo go khyed tshos kyang los go mthong ni yang los yod/ rgyu nom bsags na e bzang gi zhib tu soms dang / rgyu nom mchod sbyin byas na sdug bsngal de 'dra 'byung dogs med/ sngon nga sog phyogs na yod dus nga'i bla ma chos rgyal ngag dbang wang bde gshegs 658

rin po ches/ rgan rgon phyug po gnyis la rta pho dang rgod ma sum cu tsam yod pa/ rgad po nam mdun du 'ong kyang rta cha bo ma 'dzin bla ma re la phul nom pa re brjes min/ jag pa cha res khyod kyi lag nas 'phrog nyen yod dgra phyogs su 'chor gi ma 'jug ces yang yang gsungs kyang kha nas legs so ya ya zer/phyis jag pa 'ga' 'ongs nas dgong mo mi nyal rgyab la rta gdang gri yis bcad nas rta rnams ded tshe/ rgad po langs nas mdung bzung rgyug pas/ jag pa gcig gis lag gi mdung 'phrog gcig gis phyi nas rdo mi mgo tsam zhig gis rgad po'i rgyab tu gcig brgyab nas kha sbub tu bsgyel/ rgad po dbang bo shor/ rgan mos rgad po bsad btang zhes he btab tshe/ jag pa gcig 'ongs nas kha nang du lci ba bzhag da he thobs zer rgan mos g.yag tsho 'chor rag gi bar du kha sna zum/ de nas la lo rnams kyi nang nas rgod ma rta phyir 'gro mi nus pa gcig lus pa ma gtogs gzhan thams cad dgong ma gcig po la ded song ba wang rin po ches gsan tshe/ ang de de zer/ rgad po langs 'dug ma thub par nyi ma mang bo'i bar du nyal sa lhung kha nang du chu yang ma song bar sdug bsngal myangs/ phyis drag nas wang rin po che'i gsung de shin tu bden gi lung bstan red snyam 659

skyes/ de nas bzung mchod sbyin byas rkyen ngan dge ba'i bskul mar song / yang rgyu nom pa kha mi ltogs rgyab mi grang ba'i tshod yod na tshad yin/ mang bo yod nas chos ma byas na yod kyi na yod kyi na skyid je cher song ba min/ sdug bsngal je cher song ba yin/ yod pos 'tsho skyong mi thub pa'i sdug bsngal/ med pos btsal na mi rnyed pa'i sdug bsngal gnyis ka khyad par spu tsam med/ lhag par phyug po ser sna can 'ga' res g.yog po g.yog mo 'jog mi thub/ kho rang nyi ma'i grangs kyis g.yag rgan rer zhon pa'am/ yang na rkang thang du bud nas/ snga dro lug phyi dro rta/ nyin gung nor gyi phyir song / yud tsam pa la 'dug dus med/ sbyang ki jag rkun byung gi dogs sems khur che/ yar rgyug mar log phar song tshur 'ong / sdug bsngal khol 'thag 'thag yos brngo brngo byas/ nyin rer ja yang re gnyis tsam min 'thung mi thub/ char chu mun nag gi nang du dbyar zhwa rdib rdib cig gon/ rta rgan g.yag rgan re zhon/ lag tu bo co re bzung nas/chu tsa ra ra 'gro dus/ med po phal cher sba chung re nang na me la bsros/ skam tse re bsdad yod pas de skyid/ bud med kyis nyi ma gnam la du shar bo/ nangs kyi langs snga dgong gi nyal 'phyi byas/ mdzo 'bri bzhos/ 'o ma bskol/ zho bsnyal/ 'o ma dkrogs/660

mar blangs/ dar ra skol/ chur ra bskam/ lci ba phul/ 'bud rgyu btus/ me bus/ ja bskol/ thal 'pho/ phyugs btang / tshur btags/ cung zad tsam yang 'dug dus med/ sbra gur khang ba gang yin yang sgo phyi nang gnyis shar bud nas/ phug ron kha lo 'khor 'khor byas sdug bsngal myong / de la bltas na med po 'ga' re'i bud med sos dal bde bar bsdad pas skyid/ pho skyes ri na sdug bud med yul nas sdug gnyis ka mnyam sdug byas/ pho sgyes 'ga' res mi gzhan gye skyid sdug mi shes pa phar zhog tha na rang gi bud med kyi skyid sdug mi shes par nga'i sdug 'di ngan/ khyod yul nas nyal bsdad nas khyod nga'i dbon mo red la/ nga khyod kyi g.yog po red ang zer bza' sdig gis thug pa bskol/ bud med kyis ston rgyu med pa'i yul sdug de bsam nas zhe sdang langs/ lan byas na a zer rdo dang dbyug pas rdung / nyin re bzhin kha 'khon lag 'dzing byas/ za ma bzang bo zhig za dus med/ gos yag po zhig gon dus med/gtam snyan mo re nyan dus med/ mi tshe sdig sdug gtam ngan gye ngang la zad nas/ tha na oṃ ma ṇi zhig kyang 'don mi thub/ des na rgyu nom pa yod kyin skyid je che ma red/ sdug je che red soms la mchod sbyin re gtong e thub ltos/ yang tshe 'dir chos ma 661

byas rgyun tu ser sna rkyang byas na ser sna can gyi mi de gzhan gyis mthong na yid du mi 'ong thag nyer bsdarā na mi 'dod/'ga' res ka ngo mi rig gi chug rgyu nom yod nas ci bya/g.yog po g.yog mo tsho la ltogs skom re 'ong gi mod zer/'ga' res de'i lus kyi rnam 'gyur/ ngag gis ci bshad kyi lad mo byas ha bgad byed 'ga' res de'i thad na zer/ dper 'then tshad kyi 'jog rgyu nom dgra phyogs su shor tshe/ de tshad des nyos zer/ ster mkhan phar zhog g.yor skyi byed mkhan yang med/ khyod kyis dang po tsho khe phan btags mod drin can po zer ngo mtshang 'dri/ phyi nang bar gsum gyi mis la yog na ngan smras mang / yang ser sna che na tshe phyi mar yi dwags su skyes nas bkres skom gye sdug bsngal myong / sngon 'phags pa moṅgal gyi bu ljongs rgyu zhing song ba la/ yi dwags mo zhig la phru gu mang po skyes bkres skom gyis nyen pa gcig dang 'phrad tshe yi dwags des khyed byon pa'i lam nas/ yi dwags chu 'tshol du song ba 'phrad na/ chu myur du khyer shog dang / mo 'chi la khad yod ces shod smras pas/ yi dwags pho ci 'dra zhig yin dris tshe/ sha rtsa ser la rid pa lag na shu gu thogs pa zhig yin zer/ lam nas yi dwags de la 'phrad nas gong ltar smras pas/ mo ma dgos khos 662

kyang lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du chu'i ming tsam yang ma thos/ dge tshul zhig gis lud pa dor ba de yi dwags mang pos su thob byas pas/ bdag la thob tshe yi dwags shed can mang pos rub nas kho la mang po brdungs pas 'gro ma thub zer/ lud pa lag mthil du bzung khu tshur rtag tu bcings bsdad pas sen mo skyes pa lag pa'i rgyab tu sngo sing nge bud snang / der 'phags pas kho bo ngom pa'i chu sbyin btang / shu gu chu yis bkang nas yi dwags mo ma bu yongs la bskur ro/ /de ni sngon mchod sbyin ma byas ser snas lag pa bcings nas bsdad pa'i rnam smin red gsungs yang moṅgal gye bu ri bo bya rkang du yang dag 'jog la gnas pa'i skabs shig der yi dwags mo shin tu 'jigs su rung ba/ mig g.yas dang mchu g.yon du yo ba/ skra zing ba mgrin pa phra ba/ gsus pa che ba rkang lag phra bas mi theg kha dang rkang lag nas me 'bar ba/ tshigs rnams nas me stag 'phro ba/ kha nas ma sbyin ma che/ med sogs sgra rnam pa lnga brjod cing phyogs kun tu rgyug pa zhig mthong nas/ bcom ldan 'das la zhus pas/ de sngon bud med ser sna shin tu che ba zhig chu len du song ba la/ rang sangs rgyas shig gis chu bslang ba ser sna byas ma sbyin pa'i rnam smin yin gsungs/ yang lug rgya la btsongs/663

tshar bu blangs/ rtol bu bsad/ gzhan gyi nor 'phrog sprang bor sdigs/ g.yog por brdungs/ khyem mtshes 'khon/ mi dge ba stabs dang shugs kyis byed nges/ byas na tshe phyi mar dmyal bar skyes nas tsha grang gi sdug bsngal myong / sngon moṅgal gyi ma ser snas bcings/ mchod sbyin ma btang / dge 'dun pa la mi dad cing skur ba btab/ dbul bo rnams la mi byams sdigs shing nor rdzas 'phrog khyem mtshes dang nye 'khor rnams la tshig ngan smras nas brdungs/ srog gcod kyi las rang gis byas gzhan la byed du bcug pa sogs mi dge ba sna tshogs byas pas/shi ma thag tu dmyal bar lhung nas/ btso sreg tsha ba'i sdug bsngal dpag med myangs gsungs/ yang rgyu nom pa yod na de la zhen chags mi skye ba med/ zhen chags skyes phyin chad phyi mar lus ngan pa len/ sngon sangs rgyas kyi dus su dge slong zhig chos gos la chags nas shi tshe/ sbrul zhig tu skyes nas chos gos steng du 'khyil nas bsrung / yang dge slong zhig lhung bzed la chags bzhin shi nas sbrul zhig tu skyes lhung bzed nang du 'khyil nas bsdad/ yang dge slong zhig g.yu rdog cig yod pa la chags te/ shi nas sbal ba zhig tu skyes pas/ g.yu 'og tu bzung nas bsdad gsungs/ sngon rgyal po'i khab kyi sar phag 664

ces bya ba'i chung mas me long la bltas pas/ rang gi byad bzhin bzang bar mthong nas chags pas shi nas sbrul zhig tu skyes/ ro yi kha nang nas zhugs na sna nang nas bud/ mig nang du zhugs nas rna ba'i nang nas tshur byung / sbrul de shi nas dmyal bar skyes sdug bsngal dpag med myangs/ dper na rang dgra la sprod pa'i nang ma de thag nye nas bzhag nas/ thog mar phan 'dogs pa ltar byas/ de nas nyin gcig rang dgra de la sprad nas sdug bsngal tshad med myong du 'jug pa ltar/ rgyu nom pa bzhag na thog mar phan pa 'dra ba zhig yin/ skabs shig nas tshe 'di phyi gnyis shar sdug bsngal khal dang khur bo byas 'ong du 'jug dper na dbyar sha bzhag na thog mar rang gis zos chog kyang / skabs shig 'bu btab g.yeng 'khyer ba ltar/rgyu nom bsags na thog mar rang gis cung zad longs spyad chog kyang / skabs shig dgra 'dre gnyis ka 'ong ste phyogs phyogs su g.yeng nas 'khyer/ des na phyug pos chos re ma byas na tshe 'di sdug phyi sdug 'di med phyi med gnyis ka yin pas/ phyug po ser sna can gyi mi skye ba'i smon lam thob zer dgos/ rgyu nom mchod sbyin byas na phan yon che ba yin/ dper na nas sran ma 'bras ci yod khyem nas chen po ma bzung bar lo re bzhin du/665

zhing bzang po la dpyid dus btab na/ ston tshur len dus brgya stong 'gyur gyi 'phel che ba ltar/ phyug pos chos byas na tshe 'dir yang rgyu nom phar btang ba de bas tshur la 'ong / sa skya paṇa chen gyis/ phongs pa slong ba 'du ba bzhin/ /'bul bar 'dod pa de bas mang / /gsungs/ rgyu nom zhig mkho dus gzhan su la bshad kyang mi ster ni med/ snyan grags che mi de la kun gyis brtsi bkur che tshig la nyan/ kun gyis a khu drin can pos bshad pa ga yin ga ltar gyis/ de ltar byed dgos zer/ tshe phyi mar sangs rgyas/ yang na bde ba can du skye/ yang na mi yul du skyes kyang gong ma rgyal po las lhag pa'i stobs 'byor can du skye/chos byas phyin tshe 'di yod phyi yod 'dir skyid phyir skyid gnyis ka yin pas/ phyug po sbyin gtong can du skye ba'i smon lam 'debs dgos/ des na rgyu nom bzhag pa'i nyes dmigs dang /chos phyogs su btang ba'i phan yon rnams soms la/ khyed phyug po rnams kyis da mchod sbyin mi byed la nam byed/ byed dgos pa'i mi tshad 'phyis 'phyis 'dra/ da byed snyam du lo re re bzhin du yar bla ma dkon mchog la mchod pa/ mar dbul bo nyam thag la sbyin pa/ bar khyim mtshes g.yas g.yon gnyen gzhi rtsa lag la phan thogs dang g.yor skyi byed pa 'di shin tu gal che/666

yang zang zing gi sgo nas chos byed 'dod pa'i med po rnams kyis 'di ltar gyis dang phyug por 'gyur/ rang la rgyu nom yod pa chud zos su ma gtong bar do dam gang drag gyis/ sha ma nyo/chang nag ma 'thung / du ba ma 'then/ zhor rgyan ma bca'/chen ngo ma za/ mthun par 'grogs/ zhing pa yin na zhing las legs po gyis/ 'brog pa yin na 'tsho skyong legs po gyis/ shes na khe tshong gyis/ bla dpon gyi zhabs phyir song / phyug po'i snga phyir rgyug sngo tshod longs/ gro ma brkos/ gzhon pas ri las dang / rgan pas yul las la 'bungs/ bla ma dang ban de yod na rgyu nom rnyed sar song la rgyu nom tshol/ mgron po lha bzhin bkur dang dga'/ phyi nas zas nor ster/ bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba thobs/ yul lha gzhi bdag la bsang mchod gyis dang bsod nams skye/ gzhan gyis las ka ma thub dus ma bos kyang song la las grogs gyis dang dga' nas/ khyed kyis de ring nga bzang byas drin can po zer mar sogs ster/ phyi nas g.yor skyi zhig byed dgos pa'i mi tshad ster dgos zer/ rgyu nom zhig rnyed kyang yul du khyer shog khab bsags nas 'bugs/'bugs bsags nas gri byed thub blta dgos/ klong rdol drung yig rin po ches/ lag tu byung tshad kha la za ba 'di/ /snyigs 667

dus skya sar rnams kyi chos lugs yin/ /gsungs pa ltar/ cig rnyed na rem nas kha nang du sgrub ma gtong / mi 'ga' res/ ja 'thung ma dang chu 'thung ma/ /nam mkha' langs na 'dra 'dra yin/ /zer ba ltar/ rgyu nom pas chos re bca' ma thub pa na/ja dang za ma bzang ngan gang zos 'thung yang / mi de gnyis la khyad med 'dra 'dra yin/ lhag par zas snum can mang bo zos zos na skabs shig tsho bsogs nas/ 'gro dus tsho rang thad du 'gro ba zhig dang mi 'dra bar/ ro zhig rgyab tu khur nas ma theg par 'gro ba zhig dang 'dra ste/ dbugs 'tsheng u shu zer yar gyi la mi chod 'chi la khad byed/ rta la zhon dus sga tsho tsag tsag byed cing / zhon nas song na rta tsho nyo ro ro byed/ rta gang yin gyis mi 'drongs/ zas kyi tshod ma zin na nad mang bo 'ong /sman pas sman ster dgos/ shi na ro khur na mi theg bya rgod dang khye yis 'chos na mi tshar 'ga' res da dung ma tshar 'dug zer zas bzang po zos nas sangs rgyas pa med/ za ma chen po ma zos na yon tan yod/ dkor sgrib chen po mi 'ong / rgyug dgos dus shig la rta bas mgyogs/ 'bros dgos dus shig la dgra kha'i thar/ lus shing bal bya sgo bzhin du yang / nad dang ngal dub kyi sdug bsngal med/ yang sdug bsngal cung zad myong 668

yang snang ba ma sun/ skyid pa'i dus yod/ spyan snga pas/ ngu ru bro ba ma byas par/ /rgod re bro ba'i zas mi myong / /kha yis zhim po za 'dod na/ /lag pa lcags 'dra'i bsran thub dgos/ /gsungs/ sngon dbus phyogs kyi bza' mi gnyis kyi pho skyes kyis bud med la khyod kyis tshe gang bo zas za'am/ lo gcig la zas za 'dod dris pas/ bud med na re tshe gang po zas za 'dod smras pas/ de yin na lo gcig po 'di la zas chen po ma zos par ma shi ba tsam byed dgos zhes/ khyem na gang yod kyis khe tshong byas/ bud med kyis so nam la rem pas/ de'i phyir lo nas nor rdzas kyi gzhi chags/ lo 'ga'i 'phro nas phyug po zhig tu song skad/ phyug por gyur nas ser sna byas na/ dbul dus dang khyad par med pas/ mchod sbyin byed pa gal che/ yang khyed tsho'i med po 'ga' res/ rang gi khyim na yod tshad kyis sha nyos zos/ chang nyos nas 'thung / ja nyos nas bskol/ du ba nyos nas 'then/ gos rgyan nyos te btags nas/ rang tshod la mi dpe ni bca' ba 'di mi bzang / sha chang gi don du phyug po tsho yang yal ba mang / khyim tshang la dud 'then mang na yar 'ong med/ za 'dre gang bo the'u rang kha zhugs pa las thu/ yang 'ga' res/ zhing las mi byed/ sgo phyugs mi 'tsho/ la la nyal/669

la la 'khyams/ la la go khar 'tshogs nas bsdad na/ zhing la ston thog mi 'ong / sgo phyugs ltogs 'khyag nas 'chi/ rkun ma spyang gis gsod/ khyim mtshes g.yas g.yon la mi cha/ kha 'khon lag 'dzing byed pa 'di mi bzang / yang 'ga' res/ sgo phyi nang gnyis khyem phyags thal bas bkang / sbra'am khang ba'i gru na khyem phyags rnying ba za rgyu yin pa ltar byas phung log ger bzhagatha na chu chad shing yang med/ mgron po zhig slebs na mi bsu/khyem na cha bos gong 'gab byas/ sdig re rdung re'i sna nas bsdad/ rgad pos rgan mor sdang mig bltas/ rgan mos rgad po khog nas snying 'phyas btang / mchu gcu sna gnyer lkog shub mang / bu yis chung ma rdung / chung mas zangs rgyag thom rgyag byas/ mgron pos e tshang ci yin de ma byed zer/ 'ga' res bza' ba 'di'i nang gi mi skye ba'i smon lam thobs mgron po khyed kyis sos dal gyis/ khong gi bya ba 'di yin zer/ mgron po'i snang ba sun/ kho la las don gal chen yod zer/ dzun smras langs nas 'gro/ yul du song nas/ las ngan de tshang gi ngo mi rig tu chug kho da nangs song tshe cha bos bza' sdig gi thug pa bskol/ skyug re rdzogs yod mod zer/ phyin chad khyem der bos kyang mi 'gro/ yang 'ga' res 'grul par khyi yang mi 670

'gog 'grul pa des kho de tshang la kha sang zhig song bas ja phar zhog khyi yang mi 'gog par btang bzhag kha thur du 'gro rgyu tshang / phyin chad tsho 'dir 'ong na kha nang du thal yang ma rgyag zer/ yang 'ga' res gcig rnyed na de ma thag kha zhim byas gon pa zhig bzos nas gon pa 'di med po zhig gi bya ba min/phyug po zhig gi bca' tshul yin/ med po za dga' na za yun thung / phyug po ser sna che na rang mchu bcings/ zer bas de byas na khye rkun rnga bcad la nam langs pa bzhin/ 'gro sa 'dug sa mi rnyed/ sngar ci yod za nyes gon rtsog byas gzed phyi nas so nam ma byas yo byad ma bsags na/ sgo yi rgyu khyim gyi zas zad tshe 'dug mi thub par gzhan gye sgo ru 'gro dgos/ song nas log dom blangs na/ phyi nas kher zog khang zhing yan chad 'chor/ ltogs 'khyag tshe rku 'phrog byas/ rkus bud tshe gang yod 'jal du 'chor/ shor na bza' tshang 'thor/ gzhan gyi g.yog byas sprang nas sdug bsngal myangs/ chos/ bca' mi dgos kha yang mi sos/ khyed tshos ltos dang / phyug po'i shul gyi bu ngan khrel med 'ga' res gang yod zad/ so nam ma byas na na tsha shi chad ma byung kyang stong hang nge song log dom len pa mang / 'ga' res de'i tshod min de la ci byung zer/ des na chos sgrub shes 671

dgos pa phar zhog 'jig rten 'di'i kha gso tshul yang shes dgos/ khyem tshang ya rabs tshang la ltos/ rgan pa blo ldan bsam dkar la dris la bgyis dang lo re bzhin je bzang je bzang du song / lo 'ga'i 'phro nas phyug por gyur nas/ chos bca' zhor la skyid kyang brgyab chog pas/ med po chos byed 'dod pa rnams kyis de ltar byed pa gal che/ da dge ba chung ngu byas kyang phan yon chen po 'byung ba la nges shes lhag par skye ba'i phyir/ sngon byung gtam rgyud 'ga' bshad/ sngon bram ze bza' mi gnyis kyis/ rang sangs rgyas shig la chos ston drangs pas/ tshe de nyid du zhing la gser gyi lo tog skyes/ sngon pad+ma'i mig gis sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten la/ rin po che mthon ka zhig phul bas bskal ba dgu bcu rtsa gnyis kyi bar du stobs 'byor che bar gyur/ srid pa tha ma'i tshe yang skyes ma thag tu mgo la nor bu mthon ka byung ste/ 'od kyis ser skya'i gnas thams cad gsal bar byung / 'bras bu thob pa'i smon lam btab pas dgra bcom par gyur/ sngon rgyan pa rgyal ba zhes bya ba shin tu dbul zhing 'phongs pa zhig gis chos smra ba zhig la/ rang gi stod g.yogs smad g.yogs gnyis/ gdugs gcig lham gcig 'gron bu spar gang phul bas/ khyim du slebs pa na khron pa'i 672

nang nas gser bum pa bdun byung / yul de'i rgyal po thob/tshe 'phos nas lha dang mi'i rgyal po brgya phrag du ma byas par gsungs/ sngon mi zhig rgyal po'i khrims kyis gsod pa la blon po zhig gis thugs brtse bas skyabs nas/ dben par lam bsgom du bcug pa dang / rang sangs rgyas la mchod de 'bras bu thob pa'i smon lam btab pa'i mthus/ tshe rabs thams cad du srog gi bar chang dang bral zhing / longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang / mthar bcom ldan 'das dang mjal nas chos bstan pa tsam gyes dgra bcom thob/ dge slong gser dbyig ces bya ba sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung 'jig rten du byon dus su mi dbul bo zhig tu gyur tshe/ dong tse gnyis rnyed pa sangs rgyas gser thub la phul te smon lam btab pas bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig gi bar du/ longs spyod zad mi shes par gyur cing /ston pa shākya thub pa 'jig rten du byon dus su lag na gser gyi dong tse dang bcas te skyes nas/ mthar bsnyen par rdzogs nas dgra bcom pa thob/ dge slong lha'i me tog sngon sangs rgyas gser thub kyi dus mi dbul bo zhig tu gyur nas/ nor gzhan med pa la/ dad pas spang dang ne'u gsing las me tog btus nas/ sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pa la gtor nas smon 673

lam btab pas/ bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig gi bar du gzugs byad mjes shing gang bsam thams cad 'grub pa dang /mthar thub pa dang mjal nas dgra bcom thob/ dge slong lha'i rin chen gyis/ sngon sangs rgyas gser thub la rde'u dkar po spar gang gtor nas smon lam btab pas/ tshe rabs thams cad du nor dang rin po ches ma phongs shing / sangs rgyas la dad pa'i mthus phyis bcom ldan 'das dang mjal nas dgra bcom pa thob/ dge slong ma dkar mo sngon dbul mor gyur tshe/sangs rgyas bsod nams skyabs la/ lus la ras gos dri ma can zhig yod pa de phud nas/ phul bas tshe rabs thams cad du ras gos dang bcas te skyes shing / gang gis kyang ma phongs pa dang / dam pa'i chos nyan pa'i mthus/ bcom ldan 'das dang mjal nas dgra bcom pa thob/ bran mo ka tsang gas/'phags pa ka t+ya ya na la chu lhung bzed gang phul zhing chos zhus nas sangs rgyas yid la byed cing shi nas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lhar skyes bden pa mthong gsungs/ dge slong gser lha sngon sangs rgyas rnam gzigs kyi dus su mi dbul bor gyur pa na/rdza bum gsar ba chu gtsang mas bkang ste/ gser gyi dong tse gcig nang du bcug me long gcig gis kha bcad de dge 674

'dun la phul bas/ skye ba thams cad du gzugs bzang gser gyi kha dog lta bu dang dad pa'i mthus bcom ldan 'das dang mjal nas dgra bcom thob/ rgyal po ka bi nas/ sngon sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi mchod rten la zhig gso byas pas tshe rabs thams cad du phun sum tshogs pa thob cing stobs dang mnga' thang gzhan las 'phags pa byung / dad pa dang smon lam gyi mthus dgra bcom thob/ sngon sangs rgyas zhal bzhugs dus/byes pa chung ngu zhig gis/ sangs rgyas la dad pa'i sems kyis sa snyim pa gang phul bas/ de'i 'bras bu 'dzam gling la stobs kyis 'khor los bsgyur ba chos rgyal mya ngan med du gyur/ bram ze mo bde byed mas ci yang med de dbul phongs pa'i nor thob par 'dod nas/ bcom ldan 'das mchod pas tshe de nyid la rnam thos sras kyi 'byor ba lta bu byung / bsnyen gnas bsrung bas srin po'i gnod pas ma tshugs par srin pos gser bum pa gsum byin bden pa mthong / bud med dbul mo gnyen dga' mo zhes bya bas/ sangs rgyas la mar me chung ngu zhig phul bas/ bsod nams 'dis ma 'ongs pa'i dus su bdag shes rab kyi mar me dang ldan te/ sems can thams cad kyi mun pa'i dri ma bsal bar shog cig ces smon lam btab/ de'i tshe 675

bcom ldan 'das kyis khyod ma 'ongs pa na sangs rgyas te mtshan yang mar me 'od ces bya zhes lung bstan/ sngon spre'u zhig gis bcom ldan 'das la sems dang bas sbrang rtsi phul bas/ shi nas rigs mthon por skyes te/ snod thams cad sbrang rtsis gang ba dang / rab tu byung nas dge 'dun dang lhan cig tu rgyu ba'i tshe nam mkha' la lhung bzed bor na de ma thag sbrang rtsis khengs te dge 'dun dang lhan cig longs spyod chog pa byung / sngon dad pa'i mthus dgra bcom thob/ khyem bdag ngan byi lis/sangs rgyas rnam gzigs kyi bstan pa la grogs dge slong bzhi'i 'tsho ba sbyar bas/ tshe rabs thams cad du rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i khang bzang / mdzes shing yid 'ong blta bas chog mi shes pa'i btsun mo/ ro brgya ldan pa'i kha zas/ 'dod 'byung nor bu 'od 'bar sogs lha mi'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa thob cing / chos la dad cing smon lam btab pa'i mthus dgra bcom thob/ sngon mi zhig gis sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi mchod rten gyi glang po'i gzugs zhig pa bcos shing ldong ros kyis bskus te/ smon lam btab pas tshe rabs thams cad du gzugs bzang zhing longs spyod che ba/ gser gyi glang bo rtag tu yod par gyur/ sngon sangs rgyas la dad cing smon lam btab 676

pas dgra bcom thob/ sngon sangs rgyas bur shi 'jig rten du byon pa'i tshe/ bram ze'i khye'u zhig gis sangs rgyas la dad pa'i sems kyis sran ma spar gang gtor bas/ 'bru bzhi lhung bzed du lhung / gcig dbu'i gtsug tu chags pas/ de'i rnam smin gye gling bzhi dang 'dod lha rigs gnyis la dbang ba/ sgyur ba'i 'khor los bsgyur rgyal nga las nu zhes bya bar gyur te/ bde ba tshad med pa myangs/ dge slong ris gnyis pas/ sngon sangs rgyas rnam gzigs la dong tse gcig phul te srog gcod spong ba'i bslab pa nod pas/ tshe rabs thams cad du srog gi bar chad dang bral zhing tshe ring ba dang nad med pa longs spyod che ba byung / sngon dad pa dang chos thos pa'i rkyen gyis dgra bcom thob/ bu mo zhig gis bdag cag gi ston pa la gos phul zhing /dbu skra dang sen mo'i mchod rten la dri bzang dang til mar gyis byugs pa phul bas/ shi 'pho sa nas mnyan yod du tshong dpon chen po'i bu mo gser mdog tu gyur nas/ longs spyod dang dbang phyug phun sum tshogs par gyur cing / bstan pa la zhugs nas dgra bcom thob/ sngon ba glang rdzi mo zhig gis/bcom ldan 'das la dad pa'i sems kyis ko sha ta ga'i me tog gis gtor te chos zhus pas/ shi 'phos nas lhar skyes/ bcom 677

ldan 'das las chos thos nas bden pa mthong / sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das chu bo gang gyur phebs tshe/ ngang ba dang nya dang rus sbal lnga brgyas bskor te bskor ba byas pa la chos gsungs/ de rnams kyis chos yid la byed cing zas bcad pas/shi 'phos nas rgyal chen bzhi'i lha'i rigs su skyes/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs drung du 'ongs nas me tog gtor nas chos nyan te bden pa mthong / yi dwags lnga brgyas sangs rgyas la chu bslang bas dzu 'phrul gyis yi dwags rnams chus tshim par mdzad pas/ yi dwags rnams sangs rgyas la dad bzhin du tshe'i dus byas nas lhar skyes/ sangs rgyas dang mjal nas bden pa mthong / yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das po ta lar phebs dus/ zhing pa lnga brgyas zhing rmo ba'i dud 'gro stong gis sangs rgyas kyi sku mthong tshe dad pa skyes pa na/ sangs rgyas kyis chos gsungs pas/ de dag sangs rgyas la dad bzhin du tshe 'phos nas lhar skyes/ bcom ldan 'das dang mjal nas bden pa mthong / mdza' bo'i bu mo zhes bya ba bu yin kyang sngar bu gang skyes shi bas/ bu mo'i ming btags pa des/ tshong byas nyin gcig gar+sha pa ni bzhi rnyed pa ma la byin/ nyin gcig brgyad/nyin gcig bcu drug yang nyin gcig sum cu rtsa gnyis rnyed 678

pa ma la byen pas tshe der phyi'i rgya mtsho'i gling du song dus/dga' ba zhes bya ba'i grong khyer mthong nas der song lha'i bu mo gzugs mdzes shing lta na sdug pa bzhi byung ste/ bde bar 'ongs sam tshur byon la bdag cag gi bza' btung dang gos dang /rin po che'i khang ba 'di dag bzhes la bdag cag dang lhan cig tu bzhugs shig ces pas/ de dag dang lhan cig lo brgya stong mang bor bsdad nas bde ba myangs/ de nas rtag tu ra ro zhes bya ba'i grong khyer mthong nas der song ba na/ sngar gye lha mo bzhi bo de bas gzugs mdzes yid 'ong blta bas chog mi shes pa lha'i bu mo brgyad byung ste/ bde bar yong ngam sogs sngar ltar smras pas/ de dag dang lhan cig lo brgya stong mang bor bde ba myangs/ de nas yang dga' ba can zhes bya ba'i grong khyer zhig mthong nas der song ba na/ sngar gyi lha mo brgyad po de bas gzugs mdzes pa phar bltas gdong nas mig tshur mi lon pa bcu drug byung ste sngar ltar smras/ de dag dang lhan cig lo brgya stong mang bor bsdad nas bde ba myangs/ de nang tshangs pa'i bla ma zhes bya ba'i khang ba zhig mthong nas sgor phyin pa dang / sngar gyi lha mo bcu drug po de bas kyang brgya 'gyur gyes gzugs mdzes shing skad snyan sems bzang ba 'jig rten na 679

'gran zla mtshungs pa med pa'i lha mo sum cu rtsa gnyis byung ste bde bar yong ngam/ tshur byon sogs sngar ltar smras pas/ de dag dang lhan cig bsdad nas lo brgya stong mang bo bde ba tshad med pa myangs gsungs/ sngon 'das pa'i dus na yul phan rtsa li zhes bya ba na/ rgyal po dgra las rgyal ba zhes bya ba yod de/de na dur sa chen po kha lam pa zhes bya ba shin tu 'jigs pa'i gnas shig yod/ gnod sbyin dang srin po yang mang du gnas so/ /yul der nyes pa byas pa bsad pa thob pa zhig bcing ba lngas bcings nas dur sa der bskyal/ srin po dang 'byung bo rnams la zar bcug pas/ de 'chi bas 'jigs nas/ skra dang kha spu bregs/ chos gos kyi tshal bu zhig mgul du btags pa dang / de'i nub mo srin mo chen mo mtshon chas lag gi zhes bya ba 'khor lnga stong dang bcas pa der lhags so/ /de dag mi des mthong nas skrag go /srin mo g.yog lnga stong dang bcas pas/mi de mthong nas za bar bsam pas/ chos gos kyi tshal bu mthong nas/ g.yas nas bskor te phyag byas thal mo sbyar nas/mi de la skyes bu khyod ni ma dngangs par bde bar bzhugs/khyod la bdag cag gis gnod par mi bgyid do/ /skra bregs chos gos gyon pa khyod mthong nas/ bdag kyang sangs rgyas rjes su 680

dran par gyur/ khyod la nam yang gnod pa mi bgyed do/ /zhes pa la sogs nga tshigs bcad mang du zer skad/ sngon sprang po zhig gis dge 'dun pa la sems dang bas/ 'di rnams lha'i bdud rtsis mchod du yod na ang byas pas bsod nams chen po skyes tshong dpon chen po'i rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur gsungs/tha ga pa zla ba zhes bya ba dbul po zhig gis sangs rgyas la ras kyi kha tshar phul te/ bdag 'gro ba thams cad kyi 'dren pa sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar shog cig ces smras pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis khyod sangs rgyas tshar tshar bla ma zhes bya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan/ dge slong ma zla bas sngon sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi dus su thos pa mang du byas shing bzung bas/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pas ci gsungs pa bskyar mi dgos par lan gcig la zin cing dgra bcom thob/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi dus su gcig gis dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blangs pa shor/ 'on kyang lhag ma bsrung bas phyis ne tsor skyes/ sangs rgyas mthong bas dad pa skyes/ chos la nyan chos de'i rkyen gyis lhar sgyes/lha'i rten la bden pa mthong / sngon bu mo bde mchog skyes kyis mchod rten bya rung kha shor bzhengs nas bum pa ma 'grub pa'i bar der tshe'i dus byas pas/ dam tshig lha mo bra mo har sangs 681

rgyas/ de'i bu bzhis mchod rten la bum pa btags nas smon lam btab pas/ phyis rgyal po khri srong sde'u btsan dang / o rgyan rin po che/ mkhan po bo rnyi sa twa/ sba mi khri bzher dang bzhir gyur nas/ bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i nyi ma 'char du bcug tsu li phar tas tshigs su bcad pa gcig las mi shes kyang / tshul khrims bsrung bas dgra bcom par gyur/ sngon mi zhig gis zas snum can zhig me yis dros su bcug nas zos pas/ snum cung zad me nang du song tshe bcom ldan me lha mchod smras pas/ me lhas dngos grub byin te longs spyod dpag tu med pa byung / yang sngon dzi bo zhig gis ri nas nyin gung bro zos nas bro rdul yod pa grog tshang zhig la btab pas yul gru chen po zhig gi rgyal por skyes/ yang sngon gnas brtan tshul khrims skyabs zhes bya ba'i btsun pa zhig mdze nad kyis thebs pas 'jam dpal mtshan brjod nyin mtshan med par bton pas mje nad drag phyis mdze nad sogs nad pa gzhan gyis mgor mtshan brjod bton pa'i nad pa mang bo sos pa byung / sngon sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi dus/ rgan mo dkon mchog la dad pa zhig yod pa des/ spos mang bo nyos te mar dang sbyar nas mchod rten zhig gi steng du bskus pas/ mi sum cu rtsa gnyis 'ongs 682

nas bskus grogs byas/ rgan mos de rnams la bskus grogs byas pa bzang / 'di'i bsod nams kyis ma 'ongs pa na khyed thams cad gang du skyes kyang gzugs byad legs pa dang mthu rtsal dang ldan par gyur cig ces smras/ mi de dag rnams kyang dga' bzhin bsod nams 'dis bdag cag rnams gang du skyes kyang rigs mtho zhing btsan phyug dang ldan pa dang / rgan mo 'di yang rtag tu bdag cag gi mar gyur te/ bdag cag kyang 'di'i bur gyur nas/ rtag tu sangs rgyas chos dang mi 'bral zhing / 'bras bu yang myur du thob par shog ces smon lam btab tshe/ rgan mos kyang de bzhin du gyur cig spras pas/de dag rnams tshe rabs lnga brgya'i bar du rigs mtho zhing gzugs mdzes stobs 'byor che bar gyur/ rgan mos kyang tshe rabs lnga brgya'i bar du de dag gi ma byas/ phyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang mjal nas thams cad kyis rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur/ sngon rgyal po ba si la zhes bya ba'i bu mos/ mar me'i yo byad thams cad dge slong 'phags pa'i gnyen zhes bya ba la byen nas/ sangs rgyas rin chen gtsug phud can 'khor dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la mar me 'bul du bcug pas/ dge slong de dang rgyal po'i bu mo 683

gnyis kyis kun la phan pa'i don rgya chen po'i sems bskyed nas/ zla ba gsum gyi bar du mar me phul ba/ ma 'ongs pa na dge slong 'phags pa'i gnyen sangs rgyas mar me mdzad du 'gyur/ bu mo de sangs rgyas shākya thub par 'gyur/ zhes sangs rgyas des lung bstan/ dge slong dang bu mo de gnyis bskal pa grangs med par gzugs byad mdzes shing lha dang mi'i bde ba tshad med pa myangs pas/ mthar sangs rgyas mar me mdzad dang shākya thub par gyur/ sngon 'bangs kyi bu mo phreng ldan ma skyed mos tshal du me tog 'thu ba la song nas/ der bcom ldan 'das gshegs pa mthong nas yid dad pas bsod snyems phul nas phyag 'tshal te/ dge ba 'di'i mthus bdag gzhan gyi bran mor mi 'gyur bar rje mor gyur cig smras pas/ tshe der rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi btsun mor gyur/ sngon mi'i rgyal po zhig dang klu gnyis kyis bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa lan cig srungs pa'i mthus/shi nas gnyis ka lha gnas gcig tu skyes nas de gnyis nam gyi cha stod la rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal 'od kyis 'gengs bzhin sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar 'ongs nas/ chos bstan pas rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu thob nas ngan song gsum yongs su bral te lha dang mi'i nang du skyes nas/ mthar mya ngan las 'das rag 684

bar du lha mi'i bde skyid tshad med pa myangs gsungs/ sngon bram ze'i khye'u zhig gis ston pa shākya thub pa la shel dkar phreng ba brgya rtsa phul nas sems bskyed pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta mang bor skye ba blangs snyigs dus 'dir khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rje tsong kha pa rin po cher gyur nas 'gro don rgya chen po mdzad de/dga' ldan du gshegs nas rgyal ba byams pa'i drung du byang chub sems dpa' mtshan 'jam dpal snying bo zhes bya bar gyur/sngon rgya gar gyi rgyal po gnyis kyis gcig gis gcig la ngo mtshar ba'i 'khor dang longs spyod ci 'dra yod dris pas/ rgyal po gcig gis kho la 'khor gyi nang na ngo mtshar ba'i rta dzi tshe gcig po rdzun spu tsam mi smra ba gcig yod smras pas/ rgyal po gcig pos de 'dra yod mi srid rta dzi de la kho bos dzun smra ru 'jug thub smras pas/ rgyal po des de mi thub smras tshe/ rgyal po gcig pos de yin na rgyal 'jog la rdzun smra ru 'jug thub mi thub blta smras pas/ rgyal pos de chog smras gnyis gas rgyal sa'i phyed rgyal du bzhag nas/ rgyal po gzhan ma des bu mo mdzes ma zhig rta dzi yod sar btang nas zla ba gcig tsam lhan cig tu bsdad/ dzun spra ba'i thabs byas/ de nas nyin gcig rta dzi de rgyal po gnyis yod sar bos nas rdzun e smras phyir khyod kyis ci 685

byas dris pas/ rta dzis rang gis gang byas thams cad drang por smras pas/ rgyal pos rgyal lon nas shin tu dga' bas rta dzi de blon po byas nas bde skyid myangs/ sngon rgyal po 'jig rten dbang phyug gis/ rang gi nor rdzas yid bzhin gyi nor bu sras dang sras mo btsun mo yan chad sbyin par btang bas/ de rnams la bde skyid chen po byung / sku tshe mjug tu sngar sbyin par btang ba'i nor bu yum sras sras mo rnams/ de rnams kyi phyir phul longs spyod dpag med byung / mthong thos dran reg thams cad mnga' 'og tu 'dus/ rgyal blon 'khor 'bangs thams cad kyis rdzogs ldan gyi dus bzhin bde skyid tshad med pa myangs/thams cad la chos gsungs pa kun gyis nyams su blangs pas/'jig rten gye khams de na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad kyis dgra bcom pa'i go 'phang thob/ rgyal po myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas/ mtshan sangs rgyas kun nas 'od zer dpal brtsegs kyi rgyal po zhes bya bar gyur/ sngon rgyal bu dri med kun ldan gyes rang gi nor rdzas nor bu sras dang sras mo spyan yan chad sbyin par btang nas/ nyam thag 'gro la zang zing gi sbyin pa'i char chen po phab nas kun tshim par byas/ 'chi ba mi rtag 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs byams snying rje byang chub kyi 686

sems/ yang dag pa'i lta ba la sogs pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa btang bas/ de rnams kyis bka' bzhin bsgrubs pas mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang / nges legs thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob/ rgyal bu'i snyan grags nam mkha'i mtha' ru khyab cing spyan yang phyir 'ong / nor bu sras sogs phyir phul/ zas nor longs spyod thams cad char bzhin babs/ rgyal po khre phrag mang bo mnga' 'og tu 'dus/'dzam bu gling gi mi thams cad bde la bkod rgyal bu mthar sangs rgyas so/ /des na chos thams cad lo yag dus kyi snye ma 'dra bas mi bzang ba gcig kyang med pas/ gcig la bltas pas gcig bzang / gang gis gang bzang yin te/ dper na rin chen gser gyi gling nas gser che ba lon nam chung ba lon nam 'tsheng ba bzhin/ chos che chung gang byas kyang de'i tshod kyi phan yon 'byung / khyed phyug po rnams kyis de'i tshod kyi chos gyes/ med po rnams kyis de'i tshod kyi chos gyis/ chos ngo shes pa rnams kyis de'i tshod kyi chos gyes/ mi shes pa rnams kyis de'i tshod kyi chos gyis/ chos gang byed kyang ngas 'di mi nus snyam nas dpa' mi zhum par/ snying stobs cher bskyed nas byed pa dpa' bo g.yul du 'jug pa lta bu/ rgyun chad med par dge 687

la 'bad pa chu bo chen po'i rgyun lta bu/ skyo ngal med par lha chos byed pa zhing pas so nam byed pa lta bur gyis shig de ltar dge ba gang byas kyi mjug tu bsngo smon byed pa gal che/ bsngo smon byed tshul mi 'dra ba mtha' yas kyang 'dir dge ba gang du bsngo na/ bla ma zhang rin po che'i zhal nas/ bsngo na sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo bar bya ste/ de bsngos na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad mi 'dod kyang zhor la 'byung bar 'gyur te/ 'bras dkar po'i lo legs na phung sogs zhor la 'byung ba bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dge ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo dgos/ de ji ltar bsngo na/ bdag gis dge ba 'dis mtshon pas sngon chad dus da lta bas bsags tshad/ ma 'ongs pa na bsog par 'gyur ba'i dge ba thams cad ma sems can thams cad bde la 'god pa'i don du/ rang nyid skyon kun zad yon tan kun ldan thob bya bla na med pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che myur ba myur du thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag pos ngag 'don du/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yis /688

dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen por bsngo/ /'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang / /kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin du/ /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing / /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis/ /bsngo ba gang la'ang mchog tu bsngags pa der/ /bdag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang / /bzang bo spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi/ /zhes pa la sogs bsngo ba'i tshig bzhi gang shes bton nas bsngo dgos/ dper na mgar ba bzang pos gser bzang po la gser sku legs po brdung na kun gyes spyi bor bzhag phyag dang mchod pa 'bul ba ltar rang gi bsam pa rnam dag gi sgo nas dge ba rnam dag sgrub bsngo ba rnam dag byas na sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob nas/ 'gro ba rnams kyis zhabs rdul spyi bor len cing phyag dang mchod pa byed par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob pa'i gnas skabs thams cad du ngan song gsum dang ngan 'gro'i rigs su nam yang mi skye/lha dang mi'i go 'phang thob lha mi'i rten la sngar gye dge ba'i 'bras bu la ci tsam longs spyad kyang nam yang zad par mi 'gyur ste/ ji skad du/ blo gros rgya mtsho'i zhus pa'i mdo las/ ji 689

ltar rgya mtsho che nang chu thigs lhung / /rgya mtsho ma zad bar du de mi 'dzad/ /de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang /byang chub ma thob bar du de mi 'dzad/ /ces gsungs/ 'o na smon lam ji ltar 'debs dgos zer na/ bdag gi dge ba 'dis mtshon pa'i dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams kyi mthus/ ma sems can thams cad kyi don du rang nyid yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che myur ba myur du thob par gyur cig thob nas zhi bar skad cig tsam yang mi gnas par gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul ba bye ba phrag brgya dpag tu med pa 'gyed nas/ tshe 'di'i pha mas thog drangs te mar gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi lus kyi na tsha sems kyi sdug bsngal mtha' dag bsal/ zas nor longs spyod gang la gang 'dod sprul nas byen te gnas skabs kyi bde bar bkod/ zab rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun chad med par bskor bas gtan bde thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la bkod nas/ 'khor ba'i gnas thams cad du btsal kyang sems can gcig kyang mi rnyed bar du/ 'gro ba'i don la nyin mtshan g.yel ba med par brtson par gyur cigade lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob pa'i gnas skabs 690

thams cad du ngan song gsum dang / ngan 'gro'i rigs su nam yang mi skye bar/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bsgrub pa'i rten dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus rin po che thob par gyur cig yang na shar phyogs mngon dga'/ nub phyogs bde ba can la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam par dag par skye bar gyur cig ces smon lam 'debs dgos/ smon lam tshigs bcad 'don na/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrugs pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /'gro ba'i nang nas rang nyid sangs rgyas nas/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bsgral ba'i/ /skye bo'i tshogs rnams bdag gis sgol bar shog /kun mkhyen sangs rgyas go 'phang ma thob bar/ /ngan song ngan 'gro'i rigs su mi skye zhing / /mtho ris yon tan bdun gyis mdzes brgyan pa'i/ /dal 'byor tshang ba'i mi lus thob par shog /yang na 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing / /mngon dga' dpal ldan zhing dang bde ba can/ /las/ rab rdzogs dang mkha' spyod dga' ldan sogs/ /ngo mtshar dag pa'i zhing du skye bar shog /ces pa sogs smon lam gang 691

shes thon dang bzang / de ltar smon lam btab pa'i mjug tu smon lam 'grub pa'i bden tshig dang gzungs 'di rnams kyang brjod na legs/ rmad byung sras bcas rgyal ba'i byen rlabs dang / /rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / /bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /rnam dag smon pa'i gnas kun myur grub shog /shākya'i dbang po 'dren pa 'od dpag med/ /mi pham 'jam dbyangs gsang bdag spyan ras gzigs/ /bde gshegs 'khor bcas rten 'brel mi bslu ba'i/ /bden pa'i smon lam ci btab myur 'grub shog /sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byen rlabs dang / /chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byen rlabs dang / dge 'dun mi phyed 'dus pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /ji ltar smon lam btab bzhin myur 'grub shog /dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang / tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang rin po che dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pa'i stobs kyis ji ltar smon pa'i gnas rnams de de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig tar+ya thā/ oṃ bañtsi gri ya a pa bo rnya na ye swā hā/ de ltar smon lam btab na dper na bu bzang 692

pos rta bzang po'i kha srab bzang pos bsgyur na gang 'dod kyi gnas su phyin pa ltar/ bsam pa rnam dag gis/ dge ba rnam dag byas pa'i mjug tu smon lam rnam dag btab na smon lam ci btab myur du 'grub par 'gyur te/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ chos rnams thams cad rkyen bzhin du/ /'dun pa'i rtsa la rab tu gnas/ /gang gis smon lam ci btab pa/ /de 'dra'i 'bras bu smin par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /da mdor bsdu na byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi sgo nas/ mchod sbyin phyag bskor/ kha ton bzlas brjod/ thos bsam sgom gsum sogs byas nas/ mjug tu bsngo ba dang smon lam btab na skye ba 'di'am ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba bzang po brgyud nas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro/ /smras pa/ mnyam med zas gtsang sras po de nyid kyi/ /mjes sku'i 'od kyis phyogs kun 'gengs bzhin du/ /lha mi yongs la chos 'khor bskor ba kun/ /bsdu na sdig spong dge sgrub gnyis su 'dus/ /bla ma'i drin gyes tshogs drug rang grol ngas/ /nag po mi dge rnam dkar dge ba yi/ /rnam dbye cung zad shes pa blo dman la/ /go sla skad cha byas nas bshad tshar song / /ma rgan 'gro ba'i bde skyid srog 'phrog pa'i/ /mi dge bcu yi reg phung 693

dug gi chu/ /dug gsum snod bcas gsal bar bstan pa 'di/ /kun gyis shes bzhin 'dud rtsi bzhin ma 'thung / /'gro kun 'chi med rdo rje sku brnyes phyir/ /byams dang snying rje byang sems gser snod du/ /rnam dkar dge ba'i bdud rtsi blugs pa 'di/ /kun gyis dug bzhin ma 'dor ngoms med 'thung / /chos bshad nang gi lung 'dren gtam rgyud la/ /lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nongs pa gang byung ba/ /gangs can mkhas pa rnams kyi spyan sngar bshags/ /slar yang chos bzhin bcos na thal mo sbyor/ /sngon med chos bshad gzhan phan nyi ma 'dis/ /'gro kun mi shes mun pa kun bsal nas/ /dge sdig legs nyes blang dor gnas rnams kun/ /mthong nas sdig spangs dge ba bsgrub par shog /ces chos bshad gzhan phan nyi ma zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dad gtong blo gros che ba'i slob bu kun bzang rang grol/ lhun grub rig 'dzin/ bstan 'dzin nyi ma/ brtson 'grus rgya mtsho sogs kyis khyed kyis sngar gzhan skya ser pho mo mchog dman 'bring gsum la chos bshad gnang ba gzhan kun la phan thogs chen po byung / da de kun phyogs gcig tu yi ger bkod na phyi rabs rjes 'jug gdul bya rnams la bka' drin lhag par che/ zhes lha rdzas dri med bcas yang yang bskul ngor/ gtam rgyud dang lung 'dren phal cher gyi dpe ma 'dzoms kyang / dper na/ sbyin gtong mkhan gyis snod nang na ci yod thams cad kha mar g.yon nas/ snod ngo yan chad sprugs nas ras gos sa la brdal ba'i steng du blugs pa ltar/ bya btang tshogs drug rang grol gyis gzhan phan gyi bsam pa bzang po'i sgo nas/ blo na ci yod yongs su rdzogs par shog gu'i steng du yi ger phab pa'o/ /'dis kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa 694

dang / 'gro ba yongs la 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du phan rgya chen po thogs par gyur cigasarba maṅga / shu ste dza yartu/ /oṃ swa sti/ 'di phyi'i skyabs gnas bla ma dkon mchog la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig ltung thams cad bshags/ /dge la yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs/ /dge tshogs 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ /me tog nang nas pad+ma dkar po ltar/ /rnam 'dren stong gi nang nas rab bsngags pa'i/ /skyon zad yon tan kun dang ldan pa yi/ /ston pa sangs rgyas gsungs pa'i rgyu 'bras chos/ /blun po ba lang rdzis kyang go ba'i phyir/ /yu ba gye skad dang bstun nas bshad pa yi/ /chos bshad gzhan phan nyi ma zhes bya 'di/ /phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa'i phyir/ /par yig dbu mdzad skal bzang skyabs kyis bris/ /par shing khams ra'i sngags 'chang rnams kyis blangs/ /par de ngag dbang bstan 'dzin bzang pos brkos/ /par yon sbra nag yon bdag rnams kyis byen/ /thub bstan dpag bsam ljon pa rab rgyas shing / /'gro kun phan bde 'bras bzang la spyod phyir/ /chos sbyin 'dzad med par gyi chu rgyun 'di/ /a chung gnam rdzong zhes bya'i gnas na yod/ dge 'dis sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par shog /bstan 'dzin skyes bu sku tshe ring bar 695

shog /'gro kun gnas skabs kun tu bde bar shog /mthar thug sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par shog /chos bshad 'di nyid mthong thos dran reg gi /rgyud kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kun zhi nas/ /phan pa byang chub sems dang ldan gyur te/ /rtag tu chos la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /ces par byang gi smon tshig 'di ni dad can par rkon gyis bskul ngor zhabs dkar pas sbyar ba'o/ /sarba maṅga lam̐// dge'o// dge'o// dge'o//696
